metadata.title: 兒童複習用英文單字庫
metadata.primary_source: 大考中心高中英文參考詞彙表6,012詞條
metadata.classification_source: 十二年國教英語文課綱附錄五參考字彙表
metadata.entry_order: 高中詞彙表級別順序；各級內依原表字母順序

list_rules_zh_tw.basic: 可對應國中基本1,200字表的高中詞條
list_rules_zh_tw.advance: 未對應basic，但可對應其他常用800字表的高中詞條
list_rules_zh_tw.expert: 無法對應上述兩表的高中詞條

metadata.category_rule_zh_tw: category為陣列，完整保留2,000字表表三可對應的所有類別，並依表三編號排序。表三未直接對應的7個basic／advance詞條依字義補上最接近的既有類別。
metadata.scenario_rule_zh_tw: scenario預設為空陣列，供未來加入機場、餐廳、校園、旅館或看醫生等自訂複習情境。
metadata.matching_rule_zh_tw: 比對時展開斜線替代形式、括號內別名或變化，以及agree(ment)、wood(s)等括號衍生形式；若同時命中basic與advance，採basic。
metadata.scope_note_zh_tw: 依需求以高中6,012詞條為唯一主表，未將高中表中不存在的國中詞條額外插入entries。

examples.en: I saw a rabbit near the school gate.
examples.zh: 我在校門附近看到一隻兔子。

examples.en: She ate an orange after lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐後吃了一顆橘子。

examples.en: We need an umbrella because it is raining.
examples.zh: 因為正在下雨，我們需要一把雨傘。

explains: This short grammar word comes before one countable thing. It is useful when the listener does not know which thing you mean. Its form can change to match the first sound of the next word.
Use this word when you mean one item in general. One form comes before consonant sounds. Another form comes before vowel sounds.
This word can come before the name of one person, place, or object. It helps show that you mean one, but not one special thing. It is often used before jobs and things people can count.

examples.en: Mia has the ability to draw bright pictures.
examples.zh: Mia有畫出色彩鮮明圖畫的能力。

examples.en: Practice can build your ability to swim well.
examples.zh: 練習可以培養你游得很好的能力。

examples.en: His ability to stay calm helped the team.
examples.zh: 他保持冷靜的能力幫助了整個團隊。

explains: It is the power or skill to do something. People can build it through practice. It can help someone finish a task or solve a problem.
This is what someone can do well. It may come from learning, practice, or natural skill. A person can have it in music, sports, or school work.
It means having the strength or skill needed for a job. Some people use it to help others. It can also grow as they learn more.

examples.en: The young bird is able to fly across the yard.
examples.zh: 這隻小鳥能夠飛過院子。

examples.en: Are you able to carry this box by yourself?
examples.zh: 你能自己搬這個箱子嗎？

examples.en: With a map, we were able to find the lake.
examples.zh: 有了地圖，我們得以找到那座湖。

explains: It describes someone who can do something. The person may have the skill or strength needed. It often comes before the word to and the name of an action.
This word tells that something is possible for someone. A person may learn how to do it. Practice can make the task easier.
Use it to say that someone has the chance or power to do a task. It can describe people, animals, or things. It is often followed by a short word that starts an action phrase.

examples.en: We learned interesting facts about marine life today.
examples.zh: 我們今天學到了許多關於海洋生物的有趣知識。

examples.en: The express train ride takes about forty-five minutes to reach Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 搭乘自強號列車大約需要四十五分鐘抵達台北火車站。

examples.en: What do you think about adopting a rescued stray kitten from the shelter?
examples.zh: 你對於從收容所認養一隻流浪小貓咪有什麼看法？

explains: This word can name a subject someone is discussing. It can also mean close to a number or amount. The sentence tells which meaning fits.
Use it to connect one idea with a topic. It can also show that an amount is not exact. A speaker may use it when making a guess.
It can tell what subject someone is discussing. It can also mean nearly or close to a stated amount. Context helps the reader know the sense.

examples.en: The airplane flew high above the clouds.
examples.zh: 飛機在高高雲層上方飛行。

examples.en: Temperatures in southern Taiwan frequently rise above thirty degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 南台灣的氣溫經常飆升至攝氏三十度以上。

examples.en: Please read the terms and conditions outlined above before signing.
examples.zh: 簽名之前，請詳閱上方列出的各項條款。

examples.en: The airplane flew smoothly above the thick white clouds.
examples.zh: 飛機在厚厚的白雲上方平穩地飛行。

examples.en: Yushan's peak rises nearly four thousand meters above sea level.
examples.zh: 玉山主峰聳立於海拔近四千公尺的雲天之巔。

examples.en: Please write your full name clearly in the space provided above.
examples.zh: 請在上方預留的空白橫線上端正書寫您的中文全名。

explains: It can show that one thing is higher than something else. It can also mean more than a number or level. Sometimes it describes a place or part that is higher.
Use it for something located over another thing. It may also show that an amount has passed a limit. In a list, it can point to words written earlier.
This word can describe a higher place. It can compare a number with a limit. It may also tell where something is on a page.

examples.en: My aunt lives abroad and calls us every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我的阿姨住在國外，每星期日都會打電話給我們。

examples.en: Leo hopes to study abroad next year.
examples.zh: Leo希望明年到國外讀書。

examples.en: They traveled abroad to visit their cousins.
examples.zh: 他們到國外旅行，探望表兄弟姊妹。

explains: It means in or to another country. People may go there to study, work, or travel. The place is outside their own country.
This word describes being far from home in another land. Someone can live there for many years. Someone can also go there for a short visit.
Use it when talking about a place beyond your country. Families may visit that place during a trip. Students may go there to learn.

examples.en: The convenient grocery store is just across the street.
examples.zh: 便利的雜貨店就在街道正對面。

examples.en: We took a ferry ride across the sunlit harbor to Cijin Island.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘渡輪橫越陽光普照的港灣前往旗津島。

examples.en: She glanced across the busy room and locked eyes with her dear friend.
examples.zh: 她望向熱鬧擁擠的房間對側，目光與她的摯友交會。

examples.en: Pedestrians walked safely across the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 行人安全地穿過行人穿越斑馬線。

examples.en: The graceful suspension bridge spans across the scenic turquoise river valley.
examples.zh: 這座造型優雅的景觀吊橋橫跨在碧綠如玉的美麗深山溪谷上方。

examples.en: We sat at a seaside cafe across the street watching the waves roll in.
examples.zh: 我們坐在街道正對面的露天濱海咖啡廳，靜靜凝望著海浪拍打沙灘。

entries.definition: 在…對面；橫越；穿過；橫跨；在對面
explains: It can mean from one side to the other side. It can also describe a place on the other side of a road. The sentence shows whether someone moves or stays.
Use it for movement over a space, such as a bridge or street. It can also mean opposite something. A person may look from one side of a room to the other.
This word tells that something goes from one side to the next. It may name a place opposite another place. It can also describe a path over an open space.

examples.en: We should act quickly when someone needs help.
examples.zh: 有人需要幫助時，我們應該立刻採取行動。

examples.en: The first act of the play made the children laugh.
examples.zh: 這齣戲的第一幕逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: His kind act made the new student feel welcome.
examples.zh: 他善良的舉動讓新同學感到受到歡迎。

explains: As a verb, it means to do something. People may do it to help or change a situation. As a noun, it can mean one thing someone does or one part of a play.
This word can describe taking steps instead of waiting. It can also name a deed, such as helping a friend. In a show, it can name one large part of the story.
It may mean to behave in a certain way. It may also mean one deed done by someone. A play or show can be split into parts with this name.

examples.en: Low, silky string action allows classical concert soloists to perform blistering arpeggios fatigue-free.
examples.zh: 設定完美、低平滑順的「舒適弦距」（Action），讓古典吉他演奏家在彈奏高速琶音時手部絲毫不感疲累。

examples.en: Bold political leadership requires swift decisive action to address pressing economic inflation.
examples.zh: 卓越果敢的國家領導力，亟需在面臨急迫的惡性物價通膨考驗時果斷採取雷厲風行的行政行動。

examples.en: Stunt coordinators choreographed high-intensity action sequences for the upcoming espionage thriller.
examples.zh: 動作指導團隊為這部即將上映的跨國諜報動作驚悚大片，精心設計了連場高難度近身格鬥打戲。

entries.definition: 第十二品弦高僅 2.5mm 之極致舒適低弦距；動作
explains: It means something someone does. A quick choice or movement can be one. In a story, it may also mean what a person does next.
This word can name a deed or step. People may take one to solve a problem. It can also describe the work of doing something.
It is a thing done by a person or group. It can change what happens next. In a play, it may be one part of the story.

examples.en: The lead actor gave an emotional and convincing performance.
examples.zh: 男主角帶來了極富感染力且令人信服的精湛演出。

examples.en: He auditioned for several roles before landing his breakthrough part as a dramatic actor.
examples.zh: 在獲得突破性的戲劇要角之前，他參加過許多角色的試鏡。

examples.en: Many renowned theater actors also teach masterclasses at acting academies.
examples.zh: 許多著名的劇場演員也在戲劇學院講授大師班課程。

explains: This is a person who plays a part in a movie or show. The person speaks or moves to help tell a story. The role can be funny, serious, or exciting.
A person with this job pretends to be someone in a story. The work may happen on a stage or in a film. The performer learns lines and actions.
This person helps bring a story to life for an audience. The work can be done for a play, movie, or television show. People watch the performer speak and move.

examples.en: Please add two more chairs to the table.
examples.zh: 請再多加兩張椅子到桌邊。

examples.en: Add the red numbers to find the total.
examples.zh: 把紅色的數字相加，找出總和。

examples.en: Would you like to add your name to the list?
examples.zh: 你想把名字加到名單上嗎？

explains: It means to put something together with something else. This can make the amount larger. In math, it can mean joining numbers to find a total.
Use it when you want one more thing in a group. You can also use it when putting a new name on a list. In number work, it tells you to find the sum.
This word can mean to include something extra. It can make a recipe, group, or message bigger. A teacher may ask children to join numbers with this action.

examples.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes in English.
examples.zh: 不要害怕說英語時犯錯。

examples.en: The little girl is afraid of thunder and hides under blankets.
examples.zh: 小女孩害怕雷聲，會躲進被窩裡。

examples.en: I am afraid we have run completely out of stock on that item.
examples.zh: 恐怕那款商品我們已經全數售罄缺貨了。

explains: It describes feeling scared or worried. Someone may feel this way before a test. A kind friend can help the person feel safe.
This word tells that someone feels fear. A loud sound may cause the feeling. It can also describe worry about what might happen.
Use it when someone does not feel brave or calm. The feeling may come from danger or a hard task. Talking with someone can make it easier.

examples.en: Let's play basketball together after school today.
examples.zh: 今天放學後我們一起去打籃球吧。

examples.en: After completing the challenging university entrance exams, she felt huge relief.
examples.zh: 在考完具挑戰性的大學入學統測後，她感到如釋重負。

examples.en: After that wonderful experience, he decided to pursue a culinary career.
examples.zh: 在經歷了那次美好的體驗後，他毅然決定投身餐飲廚藝事業。

explains: It can tell that one thing happens later than another. It may also mean following someone or something. The sentence shows which meaning is meant.
Use this word for a time that comes next. It can connect two events in order. It may also describe following a person or goal.
It points to a later time or place in a series. It can show what happens next. It can also mean following a person or plan.

examples.en: We have PE class this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們今天下午有體育課。

examples.en: They often enjoy afternoon tea at a cozy café.
examples.zh: 他們經常在溫馨的咖啡館享用下午茶。

examples.en: It usually rains in the afternoon during summer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 台北夏天的下午經常下陣雨。

explains: This is the part of the day between noon and evening. Children may go to school during this time. The sun is still up for much of it.
It is the time after the middle of the day. People may eat lunch or do homework then. It comes before evening.
This word names a part of the day. It begins when noon has passed. It ends when evening starts.

examples.en: Could you please repeat that again?
examples.zh: 可以請你再重複一次嗎？

examples.en: Once again, our school choir gave a breathtaking performance.
examples.zh: 我們的學校合唱團再次帶來了令人屏息的精彩演出。

examples.en: Practice the song again and again until you can play it effortlessly.
examples.zh: 一遍又一遍地反覆練習這首曲子，直到你能毫不費力地彈奏。

explains: It means one more time. Someone may repeat a task after making a mistake. It can also mean that something has happened before.
Use this word when something happens once more. You can repeat a song or read a page one more time. It shows that the event is not new.
This word tells that an action happens another time. It may follow a pause or a change. It can help someone repeat what they just did.

examples.en: Please write down your full name and age on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上寫下你的全名和年齡。

examples.en: At the age of seven, she began learning classical violin.
examples.zh: 在七歲那年，她開始學習古典小提琴。

examples.en: We are fortunate to live in a modern digital age with instant information access.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運生活在一個能夠即時獲取資訊的現代數位時代。

explains: It can tell how many years someone has lived. It can also name a period in history. As a verb, it can mean to grow older.
This word may name the number of years in a life. It may also describe a long time in the past. People use it to talk about growing older.
It tells how long someone has been alive. It can also point to a time in history. When used as an action, it means becoming older.

examples.en: I moved to this town two years ago.
examples.zh: 我兩年前搬到這個城鎮。

examples.en: The movie began ten minutes ago.
examples.zh: 電影在十分鐘前開始。

examples.en: We met at the park a long time ago.
examples.zh: 我們很久以前在公園見過面。

explains: It tells that something happened before now. It often comes after a time period. The time period shows how far back the event was.
This word points to the past. You can put it after words such as days or years. It helps say when something took place.
Use it to talk about an event that is already over. It can follow a short or long time amount. The listener learns how long before now it happened.

examples.en: I totally agree with your environmental proposal.
examples.zh: 我完全贊同你的環保提議。

examples.en: After a fruitful discussion, both sides agreed to sign the cooperation agreement.
examples.zh: 經過卓有成效的討論後，雙方同意簽署合作協議。

examples.en: We all agree that safety must always be our highest priority.
examples.zh: 我們大家一致同意安全必須永遠是我們的最高原則。

examples.en: They reached a trade agreement after weeks of negotiation.
examples.zh: 經過數週談判後，他們達成了貿易協定。

examples.en: Everyone in the meeting was in agreement with the new proposal.
examples.zh: 會議上的每個人都一致贊同這項新提案。

examples.en: Sign the user agreement before creating a new software account.
examples.zh: 在建立新的軟體帳號前請先簽署使用者條款協議。

examples.en: Leading semiconductor fabs signed a twenty-year corporate power purchase agreement for offshore wind output.
examples.zh: 晶圓製造大廠與離岸風電開發商簽署了為期二十年的長約企業購售電合約。

examples.en: Negotiating a long-term power purchase agreement guarantees fixed electricity prices for the data center.
examples.zh: 透過談判簽署二十年期長期企業購售電合約（CPPA），能為跨國資料中心鎖定長期可預期的電力成本。

examples.en: Institutional banks approve billion-dollar wind loans only after seeing a signed corporate purchase agreement.
examples.zh: 國際聯貸銀行團唯有在查驗審核具有高信評企業簽署的長期購電合約後，方始核准數百億元的專案融資。

entries.definition: 同意；贊同；協定；協議；一致；企業綠電採購長期購售電合約 (CPPA)
explains: It means sharing the same idea or saying yes to a plan. People may choose one plan together. It can also name a promise or plan they accept.
This word can show that people have the same view. It can also name a deal made between people. They may write down the details.
Use it when someone accepts an idea or choice. A written plan can set out what people have accepted. People may talk until they share one view.

examples.en: The mountain air is crisp, cool, and fresh.
examples.zh: 山上的空氣清新、涼爽又新鮮。

examples.en: Open the windows every morning to let fresh air circulate.
examples.zh: 每天早晨打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣流通。

examples.en: Air pollution in urban cities is becoming a serious health concern.
examples.zh: 都會區的空氣污染正成為嚴重的健康隱憂。

explains: This is the mix of gases around Earth that people breathe. It cannot usually be seen. Wind is gas that moves.
People need this invisible gas mix to breathe. It fills open spaces around us. Moving wind can make leaves or flags wave.
This unseen mix surrounds our planet. Humans and animals take it into their bodies when they breathe. When it moves, we feel wind.

examples.en: We watched the airplane take off at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場看著飛機起飛。

examples.en: Please turn your mobile phones to airplane mode during flight.
examples.zh: 飛行期間請將手機轉為飛航模式。

examples.en: It takes about three hours by plane from Taipei to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 從台北搭飛機到東京大約需要三個小時。

examples.en: The craftsman adjusts his wooden hand plane to shave paper-thin translucent ribbons of cedar.
examples.zh: 木匠屏氣凝神細心微調手作木工刨刀，輕輕一推便刨出薄如蟬翼、半透明的優美木花。

examples.en: We booked our flight on an eco-friendly modern passenger plane powered by efficient turbofan engines.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了一架由高效渦輪風扇發動機驅動的現代環保型噴射客機機票飛往海外。

examples.en: The mathematician drew two intersecting geometric lines across an infinite two-dimensional plane.
examples.zh: 數學家在黑板上的二維無垠平面上，用粉筆畫出了兩條相互垂直相交的幾何直線。

entries.definition: 飛機；手工木工推刨刨刀；刨平
explains: This is a large machine that carries people through the sky. It has wings and an engine. It can take travelers to far places.
People ride inside this flying machine to reach another city or country. Its wings help it stay in the air. A pilot guides it.
This kind of transport travels above the ground. It can carry many passengers across long distances. The crew helps guide the trip.

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport is very busy.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場非常繁忙。

examples.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
examples.zh: 我們在航班起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

examples.en: An airport express train links the terminal directly to the city center.
examples.zh: 機場快捷列車將航廈直接連結至市中心。

explains: This is a place where people go to begin or end a trip by air. Travelers check bags there. They wait for their flight to leave.
A large travel center has places for planes to stop. People arrive there before flying away. Signs help them find their gate.
This place has runways and buildings for air travel. Travelers meet the crew and board their flight there. Families may also wait there to welcome someone.

examples.en: All students should listen to the teacher.
examples.zh: 所有學生都應該聽老師講課。

examples.en: We played soccer in the rain all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在雨中踢足球。

examples.en: All of us are excited about the upcoming school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們所有人都對即將到來的校外教學感到興奮。

explains: It can mean every person or thing in a group. It can also mean the whole amount. The sentence may use it to describe everyone or everything.
Use this word when nothing in a group is left out. It can point to the full set of items. It may also mean completely.
This word includes each person or thing being talked about. It may describe the whole group. It can also tell that something is complete.

examples.en: The teacher will allow us to read outside today.
examples.zh: 老師今天會允許我們到戶外閱讀。

examples.en: This ticket allows one child to enter the museum.
examples.zh: 這張票允許一位孩子進入博物館。

examples.en: Dad does not allow food near the computer.
examples.zh: 爸爸不允許在電腦附近吃東西。

explains: It means to let someone do something. A parent may give permission for a child to go out. A rule can also say what people may do.
Use this word when someone says yes to an action. A pass may give someone the right to enter. A rule may stop an action instead.
It can mean making something possible. A quiet room may help someone read. A person in charge can also give permission.

examples.en: We are almost at the top of the mountain trail!
examples.zh: 我們就快要走到登山步道頂端了！

examples.en: I have almost finished reading this five-hundred-page fantasy novel.
examples.zh: 我幾乎快要把這本長達五百頁的奇幻小說讀完了。

examples.en: The auditorium was almost full by the time the keynote speech started.
examples.zh: 在專題主題演講開始之時，大禮堂幾乎已經座無虛席。

explains: It means very nearly, but not fully. Someone may reach the door just before the bell rings. The expected thing is close to happening.
Use it when something is close to a number or result. The result has not quite been reached. It shows that only a little more is needed.
This word tells that something is close to true. It can describe a task that is nearly done. It may also describe an amount just below a number.

examples.en: We took a scenic stroll along the riverbank path.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河岸步道悠閒漫步。

examples.en: Bring your friend along so we can all enjoy the outdoor barbecue together.
examples.zh: 把你的朋友一起帶過來吧，這樣大家可以一起享受戶外烤肉。

examples.en: Planting flowering trees along rural highways beautifies the whole countryside.
examples.zh: 在鄉村公路沿線種植開花路樹美化了整個鄉村景致。

examples.en: We rode YouBikes along the Tamsui River cycling path.
examples.zh: 我們騎著 YouBike 沿著淡水河畔的自行車道悠閒騎行。

examples.en: Cherry blossoms bloomed gorgeously all along the winding mountain road.
examples.zh: 盛開的粉嫩櫻花沿著整條蜿蜒起伏的山區公路兩旁一路美艷綻放。

examples.en: Bring your younger sister along with us when we visit the science museum!
examples.zh: 咱們下午去科教館參觀常設展時，把妳可愛的小妹妹也一道帶上吧！

explains: It can describe movement beside a road or river. It can also mean coming with someone. The sentence shows which idea is meant.
Use it when someone moves beside a long path. It may also show that people go somewhere together. It can point to one direction over a distance.
This word can tell where someone moves in relation to a road or wall. It can also mean together with another person. It helps show direction or company.

examples.en: I have already finished my English report.
examples.zh: 我已經完成我的英文報告了。

examples.en: Has the express train to Hualien already departed from platform three?
examples.zh: 開往花蓮的特急列車已經從第三月台發車了嗎？

examples.en: He already knows how to code simple computer games in Python.
examples.zh: 他已經學會如何用 Python 編寫簡單的電腦遊戲了。

explains: This word points to an earlier time. It can tell that an action is finished before now. It is useful when something happened sooner than expected.
Use this word for something that is true now because it happened earlier. A person may finish work before a set time. It can show that the waiting is over.
This word points to an earlier time. It can tell that an action is done. It is useful when something happened sooner than expected.

examples.en: Peter likes playing baseball, and he also likes swimming.
examples.zh: 彼得喜歡打棒球，而且他也喜歡游泳。

examples.en: The mobile phone is not only stylish, but it also has a long battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機不僅外型時髦，同時電池續航力也很長。

examples.en: Regular walking not only boosts energy, but it also improves sleep quality.
examples.zh: 規律散步不僅能增進體力，也能改善睡眠品質。

explains: It means one more thing is true. A friend may join a game, and this word can add that idea. It helps connect extra information.
Use this word to add another point. It can show that two things are true together. A speaker may use it when giving one more reason.
This word adds information to what was just said. It can show that something is true too. It helps a sentence carry an extra idea.

examples.en: Although it rained, we still enjoyed our weekend trip.
examples.zh: 雖然下雨，我們依然很享受週末旅行。

examples.en: Although English grammar seems complex at first, consistent practice makes it intuitive.
examples.zh: 雖然英語文法起初看起來很複雜，但持續練習會讓它變得直覺自然。

examples.en: Although he is busy managing his business, he always makes time for his family.
examples.zh: 儘管經營事業十分繁忙，他總會抽空陪伴家人。

examples.en: Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert continued enthusiastically.
examples.zh: 雖然下著滂沱大雨，戶外演唱會依然熱情開唱。

examples.en: Although she was exhausted after work, she still cooked a healthy dinner for her family.
examples.zh: 儘管下班後身心感到十分疲憊，她依然堅持親手為家人烹煮一頓營養晚餐。

examples.en: Although modern technology connects us instantly, deep human relationships take patience.
examples.zh: 雖然當代科技能讓人們瞬間即時互聯，但真摯深刻的人際連結仍需耐心經營。

explains: It joins two ideas that do not fully match. One thing may happen even when another thing makes it hard. The main event still takes place.
Use it to show a surprising result. Rain may fall, but a team may still play. It connects the two parts of the thought.
This word links an idea with something that could stop it. The second event still happens. It shows that the result is unexpected.

examples.en: She always arrives at the office on time.
examples.zh: 她上班總是準時抵達辦公室。

examples.en: My mother always reminds me to wear a helmet when riding a scooter.
examples.zh: 我媽媽總是提醒我騎機車時要戴安全帽。

examples.en: True friends are always there to support you through difficult times.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友總會在艱難時刻支持著你。

explains: It means something happens every time or on nearly every day. A person may do the same thing each morning. It can also mean for all time.
Use this word for a habit that does not often change. It can describe something that keeps happening. In some sentences, it means without end.
This word can tell that an event happens again and again. It may describe a regular habit. It can also point to time without a clear end.

examples.en: The train leaves at 7:30 a.m.
examples.zh: 火車在上午七點半出發。

examples.en: We have music class at 10 a.m. on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們星期一上午十點有音樂課。

examples.en: The shop opens at 8:00 a.m.
examples.zh: 商店上午八點開始營業。

explains: This short time label shows that the clock time is after midnight and before noon. It is used with numbers on a clock. It helps tell morning hours apart from later hours.
It marks an hour during the first part of the day. A clock number can come before it. People use it when writing down an early meeting or trip.
This label tells the reader that a time comes before midday. It may appear in a schedule or on a clock. It makes the time of day clear.

examples.en: I like apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 我喜歡蘋果和柳橙。

examples.en: He is smart, kind, and always willing to help his classmates.
examples.zh: 他聰明、善良，而且總是樂於幫助同學。

examples.en: You and I should cooperate closely to finish this science assignment.
examples.zh: 你和我應該緊密合作以完成這項自然科學作業。

explains: This small joining word links two words or ideas. It can connect names, things, or actions. It shows that both parts belong together.
Use this word to put two items in one list. It may also join two parts of a sentence. It helps the reader see that both ideas matter.
It links one person or thing with another. It can join two actions in one thought. Lists often use it before the final item.

examples.en: Mom was angry because I didn't finish my homework.
examples.zh: 媽媽很生氣因為我沒寫完功課。

examples.en: Take a deep breath to calm down when you feel angry.
examples.zh: 感到生氣時，深吸一口氣以平復情緒。

examples.en: He was angry with his classmate for breaking a trusted promise.
examples.zh: 他對同學違背可信賴的承諾感到很憤怒。

examples.en: Dad got angry when I broke the antique vase.
examples.zh: 當我打破古董花瓶時爸爸非常生氣。

examples.en: It does not help to stay angry; let's talk and resolve our differences calmly.
examples.zh: 一直生氣無濟於事，讓我們心平氣和地溝通並化解分歧吧。

examples.en: Customers grew angry when the high-speed rail was delayed without prior notice.
examples.zh: 當高鐵未事先通知而延誤時，旅客們紛紛感到十分氣憤不滿。

explains: It describes someone who feels mad or upset. A person may feel this way when something seems unfair. A calm talk can help.
This word tells that someone has a strong unhappy feeling. A broken toy may cause it. Taking a breath can help the person settle down.
Use it for a person who is not pleased and may want to shout. A small problem can cause this feeling. Kind words may help make things better.

examples.en: The Taipei Zoo cares for thousands of animals.
examples.zh: 台北市立動物園照料著數千隻動物。

examples.en: It is our duty to protect rare and endangered wild animals.
examples.zh: 保護稀有與瀕危野生動物是我們的責任。

examples.en: Dogs and cats are among the most popular domestic animals.
examples.zh: 狗和貓是最受歡迎的家養寵物動物之一。

explains: This is a living thing that can move and needs food. Dogs, birds, and fish are examples. Many kinds live on land or in water.
A living creature can breathe, grow, and find food. Some have fur, while others have feathers or scales. People care for many of them as pets.
This word names a living creature other than a plant. It may walk, swim, or fly. Different kinds live in many places.

examples.en: Would you like another cup of hot soy milk?
examples.zh: 你想要再來一杯熱豆漿嗎？

examples.en: The team faced another difficult challenge after winning the semi-finals.
examples.zh: 在贏得準決賽後，該團隊面臨了另一項艱鉅考驗。

examples.en: If this shirt doesn't fit, I can fetch another one from the stockroom.
examples.zh: 如果這件襯衫不合身，我可以從庫房再拿另一件過來。

explains: It means one more person or thing of the same kind. You may take one cookie now, then choose one more. It can also mean a different choice.
Use this word when you want one extra item. It can also point to a different person or thing. The sentence tells which meaning fits.
This word can name one more member of a group. It may also mean a different one. It helps talk about an extra choice.

examples.en: She raised her hand to answer the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 她舉手回答老師的問題。

examples.en: He answered the telephone on the very first ring.
examples.zh: 電話剛響第一聲他就接了起來。

examples.en: Check your answers carefully before handing in the exam sheet.
examples.zh: 繳交試卷前請仔細檢查你的答案。

explains: It can mean words given to a question. It can also mean the words someone says or writes back. As a verb, it means to reply.
Use this word when someone responds to a question. The reply itself can have this name. It can also mean the result of a problem.
This word names what someone says after being asked something. It can also describe the act of replying. A math question has a result with this name.

examples.en: Ants work hard together to gather food for winter.
examples.zh: 螞蟻齊心協力儲存過冬糧食。

examples.en: A long trail of tiny black ants marched steadily across the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 一長串黑色小螞蟻整齊地列隊爬過廚房流理台。

examples.en: She is always as busy as an ant preparing for upcoming examinations.
examples.zh: 她總是像隻忙碌的小螞蟻一樣忙著準備即將到來的考試。

explains: This is a very small insect that lives in groups. It has six legs and can carry bits of food. Many of them build homes under the ground.
A tiny crawling insect works with many others in a group. It may carry crumbs back to its nest. Some kinds live in a hill of soil.
This little insect has a narrow body and six legs. It often follows a trail with others. Its home may be hidden in soil or wood.

examples.en: Do you have any questions about the lesson?
examples.zh: 你對這堂課有任何疑問嗎？

examples.en: You can call me any time if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，隨時都可以打電話給我。

examples.en: I didn't see any cars on the quiet country road.
examples.zh: 在寧靜的鄉間小路上我沒看到任何車輛。

explains: It can mean one or more choices, with no exact one named. A person may pick one from a group. In questions, it can ask whether even one exists.
Use this word when the choice is not known or does not matter. It can point to one thing from a group. A question may use it to ask whether something exists.
This word leaves the choice open. It may refer to one member of a group or more than one. It is often used in questions and offers.

examples.en: Does anyone know the opening hours of the museum?
examples.zh: 有人知道這家博物館的開放時間嗎？

examples.en: Is anyone interested in joining the weekend hiking trip to Yangmingshan?
examples.zh: 有人有興趣參加週末去陽明山的健行活動嗎？

examples.en: If anyone calls for me, please tell them I will return after three.
examples.zh: 如果有人打電話找我，請轉告他們我三點後會回來。

explains: It means one person, but the person is not named. A visitor may leave a note without giving a name. The listener knows that a person is involved.
Use this word when talking about an unknown person. It can point to one person in a question or statement. It does not tell who the person is.
This word refers to a person whose name is not known. It may describe someone in a group. It can also be used when asking whether a person is there.

examples.en: Would you like anything to drink with your lunch?
examples.zh: 你的午餐想搭配任何飲品嗎？

examples.en: If you need anything during your stay, please contact room service.
examples.zh: 住宿期間如果你需要任何東西，請隨時聯繫客房服務。

examples.en: She was so exhausted that she couldn't eat anything for dinner.
examples.zh: 她太疲累了，以至於晚餐什麼東西都吃不下。

explains: It means one thing, but the thing is not named. A person may put one object into a bag. The sentence gives more information about it.
Use this word for an unknown thing or matter. It can stand for an object, idea, or event. The speaker may not know what it is yet.
This word points to a thing without saying its name. It can refer to an object or an idea. A question may use it when the answer is not known.

examples.en: We rent a small apartment near the station.
examples.zh: 我們在車站附近租了一間小公寓。

examples.en: Her modern apartment has a breathtaking view of Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 她的現代公寓享有台北 101 的壯麗景觀。

examples.en: The apartment building provides twenty-four-hour security management.
examples.zh: 這棟公寓大樓提供全天候二十四小時保全管理。

examples.en: Renting a modern apartment near an MRT station is convenient.
examples.zh: 在捷運站附近租一間現代化公寓非常方便。

examples.en: She shared a three-bedroom apartment with two college friends.
examples.zh: 她與兩位大學朋友合租了一間三房公寓。

examples.en: The landlord decorated the apartment with hardwood floors and bright lighting.
examples.zh: 房東用實木地板與明亮的照明裝潢了這間公寓。

explains: This is a home with rooms inside a larger building. One person or family may live there. It often has a kitchen, bathroom, and bedrooms.
People can rent or own this home in a building with many homes. Neighbors may live above or beside them. It gives a family rooms for daily life.
This word names one home inside a larger building. It usually has its own front door. People use it for sleeping, cooking, and relaxing.

examples.en: A rainbow appeared after the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 雨停後出現了一道彩虹。

examples.en: The moon appears bright on a clear night.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，月亮看起來很明亮。

examples.en: Please appear at the office before nine.
examples.zh: 請在九點前到辦公室出席。

explains: It means to come into view. Something may become seen after being hidden. It can also mean to arrive at a place for a meeting or event.
Use this word when someone or something becomes visible. A person can also come to a planned place. It may describe how something seems to look.
It can mean showing up where people can see you. It can also describe how a thing looks to others. A star may become visible when the sky grows dark.

examples.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
examples.zh: 一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。

examples.en: She cut the red apple into four equal slices.
examples.zh: 她把紅蘋果切成均等的四片。

examples.en: My grandmother baked a warm and fragrant apple pie.
examples.zh: 我奶奶烤了一個溫熱香氣四溢的蘋果派。

explains: This is a round fruit with firm skin. It may be red, green, or yellow. People can eat it fresh or bake it in a pie.
A sweet fruit grows on a tree in many places. It has small seeds inside. A person may pack one for lunch.
This fruit is crisp when someone bites it. Its skin can have different colors. It is often used in juice, snacks, and pies.

examples.en: The children played in a grassy area beside the school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校旁的草地上玩耍。

examples.en: Draw a circle around the shaded area on the map.
examples.zh: 在地圖的陰影區域外畫一個圓圈。

examples.en: Math is an area of study that uses numbers.
examples.zh: 數學是一門運用數字的學科。

explains: It is a part of a place or piece of land. A park may have one space for games and one for quiet rest. It can also mean one subject or field of study.
This word can name a space with clear edges. A map may show where that space begins and ends. It may also name one kind of work or learning.
Use it for one section of a room, town, or country. People can gather there or do a task there. It can also mean one part of knowledge.

examples.en: He broke his arm during the baseball game.
examples.zh: 他在棒球比賽中摔斷了手臂。

examples.en: She held the sleeping baby safely in her arms.
examples.zh: 她將熟睡的嬰兒安穩抱在懷裡。

examples.en: Lift both arms above your head during the stretch.
examples.zh: 伸展時請將雙臂高舉過頭。

explains: This is the body part between the shoulder and the hand. People use it to lift, reach, and hug. As a verb, it can mean giving weapons to a group.
One of the two long parts on the upper body helps people carry things. It bends at the elbow. The same word can also mean supplying weapons.
This body part helps with holding and reaching. It begins at the shoulder and ends at the hand. It can also be used as a verb about giving a group weapons.

examples.en: We rode bicycles around Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我們騎著自行車環繞日月潭。

examples.en: The morning bus should arrive around eight fifteen at the stop.
examples.zh: 早班公車應該會在八點十五分左右到達車站。

examples.en: Backpackers dream of embarking on a year-long journey around the world.
examples.zh: 背包客們夢想著能踏上一趟為期一年的環遊世界之旅。

explains: It can mean on every side of something. It may also mean close to a place. When used with a number, it can mean roughly that amount.
Use this word for a position that goes on more than one side. It can also describe a nearby location. With time or number, it often means nearly.
This word can describe people or things on different sides of one place. It may point to a nearby spot. It can also make a number less exact.

examples.en: The flight will arrive at Taoyuan Airport on schedule.
examples.zh: 班機將準時抵達桃園機場。

examples.en: We arrived at the scenic campsite just as the sun set behind the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們在夕陽剛好落入山巒後方時抵達了風景秀麗的露營地。

examples.en: Guests began to arrive early carrying festive holiday gift baskets.
examples.zh: 客人們提早陸續抵達，手上提著洋溢節慶氛圍的賀禮籃。

explains: It means to reach the place where you are going. A bus may reach its stop after a long ride. A guest may come to someone’s home.
Use this word when someone reaches a goal or destination. A person may come to school before class begins. It tells that the trip is over.
This word tells that someone has reached the planned place. It may follow travel by car, bus, or foot. It can also describe reaching a time or point.

examples.en: We painted watercolors during art class today.
examples.zh: 我們今天在美術課畫了水彩畫。

examples.en: The art museum is showcasing an exhibition of modern Taiwanese oil paintings.
examples.zh: 美術館正在展出台灣現代油畫特展。

examples.en: Cooking good food is both a careful science and a creative art.
examples.zh: 烹調美食既是一門嚴謹的科學，也是一種富創意的藝術。

explains: This is work made to share ideas or beauty. A picture, song, or statue can be one example. People may make it for others to enjoy.
People use skill and ideas to create pictures, music, or other works. Some people visit a museum to see these works. The word can name this field of study.
This word names creative work made by people. It can be seen, heard, or touched. A class may teach students to draw or make such work.

examples.en: She works diligently as an English teacher in Tainan.
examples.zh: 她在台南擔任英語老師，工作十分勤勉。

examples.en: Call me as soon as you arrive safely at the train station.
examples.zh: 當你平安抵達火車站時請立即撥通電話給我。

examples.en: As time passed, her confidence in conversational speaking grew tremendously.
examples.zh: 隨著時間推移，她在英語口語對話方面的自信心大幅增強。

explains: It can mean in the role of something. It may also join two ideas that happen at the same time. It can compare one thing with another.
Use this word to describe a job or purpose. It can connect two events that happen together. It may also show that two things are alike.
This word can tell what job someone has. It may link one event with a second event. It can also help compare two things.

examples.en: Feel free to ask questions if you don't understand.
examples.zh: 如果你不懂，請隨時發問。

examples.en: The tourist asked the police officer for directions to Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 觀光客向警察詢問前往台北 101 的路線方向。

examples.en: Can I ask you for a small favor?
examples.zh: 我可以請你幫個小忙嗎？

explains: It means to say something because you want information. It can also mean requesting someone to do something. The person may answer or help.
Use this word when you want someone to tell you something. It may also be a polite way to request help. A student may seek advice from a teacher.
This word describes speaking to get information or help. It can also mean making a request. The other person may give a reply or do the task.

examples.en: The children meet at the library after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後在圖書館碰面。

examples.en: Our bus leaves at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 我們的公車早上六點出發。

examples.en: Look at the bright star above the trees.
examples.zh: 看看樹上方那顆明亮的星星。

explains: This short word points to one exact place or time. It can show where something happens, such as near the door. It can also show when something happens, such as noon.
Use this word to name the place where someone is. It can also connect an event with one clock time. It often comes before the name of a place or hour.
It helps give a clear point on a map or clock. Someone can wait beside one building with it. A meeting can begin when the clock shows one stated hour.

examples.en: The storm may attack the old bridge with strong waves.
examples.zh: 暴風雨可能用強浪沖擊那座老橋。

examples.en: The dog did not attack the child.
examples.zh: 那隻狗沒有攻擊小孩。

examples.en: The team planned an attack on the other side of the field.
examples.zh: 隊伍計畫從球場另一側發動進攻。

explains: It can mean trying to hurt someone or something. It can also name a sudden move against an opponent. The sentence shows which sense fits.
This word may describe using force against a person or place. In a game, it can mean moving forward to score. It can also name the move itself.
It tells that someone or something is being harmed on purpose. It may also describe a strong move in a contest. Context helps explain the meaning.

examples.en: Aunt Mary always bakes tasty pineapple cakes for us.
examples.zh: 瑪麗阿姨總是為我們烤美味的鳳梨酥。

examples.en: My aunt is a talented landscape painter whose art exhibits in major galleries.
examples.zh: 我的姑姑是一位富有才華的風景畫家，她的畫作在各大美術館展出。

examples.en: We visited Aunt Susan in Tainan and tasted authentic savory beef soup.
examples.zh: 我們去台南探望蘇珊阿姨，並品嚐了道地鮮甜的清燙牛肉湯。

explains: This is the sister of one of your parents. She may be the mother of your cousin. Families may use different names for this person.
She is a woman in your family from your mother’s or father’s side. You may visit her during a holiday. She may also be called by a family name that shows which side she comes from.
This word names one of your parents’ sisters. The person may be married or unmarried. She is part of your wider family.

examples.en: The children ran away from the loud thunder.
examples.zh: 孩子們被巨大的雷聲嚇得跑開了。

examples.en: My grandparents live far away from the city.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在離城市很遠的地方。

examples.en: Please put the toys away after you play.
examples.zh: 玩完後請把玩具收好。

explains: It means at some distance from here. It can also tell that someone leaves a place. A person may put things in their proper place with this word.
Use it to show that something is not nearby. It may describe leaving a place or moving out of sight. It can also mean storing something neatly.
This word can tell where someone or something is not. It may describe moving to another place. It can also show that a task or visit is finished.

examples.en: The baby is sleeping soundly in the crib.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒正在嬰兒床裡熟睡。

examples.en: Don't make loud noises or you will wake the baby.
examples.zh: 不要發出大聲音，否則你會吵醒小嬰兒。

examples.en: The baby took her very first steps yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 小寶寶昨天下午跨出了她的第一步。

explains: This is a very young child. It needs care from adults. The word may also be used as a loving name for someone.
A child who is only a few months or years old has this name. Such a child needs food, sleep, and help. Some people use the word kindly for a loved one.
This word names a very young person. Parents and family members watch over this child. It can also be a warm name for someone dear.

examples.en: The back of the book has a map.
examples.zh: 書的背面有一張地圖。

examples.en: We will come back after lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐後會回來。

examples.en: My older sister will back me in the game.
examples.zh: 我姊姊會在比賽中支持我。

explains: It can name the rear part of a body or thing. It can also mean returning to a place. As a verb, it may mean giving help or support.
This word can describe the side opposite the front. It may tell that someone is returning. It can also mean standing with a person or idea.
Use it for the part behind the front. It can also describe going to a place again. A person may use it to say they support someone.

examples.en: Eating too much fried food is bad for your health.
examples.zh: 吃太多油炸食物對健康有害。

examples.en: The bad weather forced the airline to delay all outbound flights.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使航空公司延誤了所有出港航班。

examples.en: He had a bad dream and woke up startled in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 他做了一個噩夢，在半夜驚醒。

explains: It describes something that is not good or does not work well. It may also describe behavior that can hurt someone. The meaning depends on the thing being discussed.
Use this word for poor quality or an unhappy result. It can describe a choice that may cause harm. It may also tell that someone feels sick.
This word can mean wrong, harmful, or low in quality. A broken tool may work poorly. A person may also use it to describe an unkind choice.

examples.en: Put your homework in your school bag.
examples.zh: 把你的功課放進書包裡。

examples.en: She packed her travel bag for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 她為週末旅行收拾了旅行提袋。

examples.en: Please don't forget to bring a reusable shopping bag.
examples.zh: 請不要忘記攜帶環保購物袋。

explains: This is a container used for carrying things. It may have handles or a zipper. Students often use one to carry books.
People put small items inside this container. It may be made of paper, cloth, or leather. A traveler can carry it by hand or on a shoulder.
This word names a soft or firm container. It can hold food, school supplies, or personal items. Some kinds close with a zipper.

examples.en: The children kicked a ball across the grass.
examples.zh: 孩子們把球踢過草地。

examples.en: We saw a bright ball of light in the sky.
examples.zh: 我們看見天空中有一團明亮的光。

examples.en: The guests wore fine clothes to the school ball.
examples.zh: 賓客穿著漂亮衣服參加學校舞會。

explains: This is a round object used in many games. It can also mean a round shape or mass. A formal dance for many people has this name too.
People throw, kick, or hit this round object in sports. It may also name something shaped like a round lump. At a large dance, guests listen to music and move together.
This word can name a toy or sports object that rolls. It can describe a round group of light or fire. It can also name a special dance event.

examples.en: Monkeys love eating yellow bananas.
examples.zh: 猴子喜歡吃黃色香蕉。

examples.en: I bought a bunch of ripe bananas from the fruit stall.
examples.zh: 我在水果攤買了一串熟成的香蕉。

examples.en: Eating a banana before running gives you quick energy.
examples.zh: 跑步前吃根香蕉能快速補充能量。

explains: This is a long yellow fruit with soft flesh inside. It grows in bunches on a tropical plant. People often peel it before eating.
A sweet fruit has a yellow skin when ripe. It is easy to carry as a snack. Its soft inside can be mashed or mixed into food.
This fruit is curved and grows in warm places. Its skin protects the soft part inside. Many people eat one for breakfast or a snack.

examples.en: Mayday is Taiwan's most famous rock band.
examples.zh: 五月天是台灣最著名的搖滾樂團。

examples.en: The school marching band led the morning street parade.
examples.zh: 學校的行進樂旗隊引領了早晨的踩街遊行。

examples.en: He formed an indie pop band with three college classmates.
examples.zh: 他和三位大學同學組建了一支獨立流行樂團。

explains: It can mean a group of musicians who play together. It can also name a narrow strip of cloth or metal. The sentence shows which meaning fits.
A music group may sing or play instruments together. This word can also describe a ring-shaped strip that holds things. People may wear such a strip around a wrist.
Use this word for musicians who perform as a group. It may also mean a long, narrow strip. A watch may have one that goes around the wrist.

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the bank.
examples.zh: 我需要從銀行領一些現金。

examples.en: We sat on the grassy river bank and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我們坐在青草叢生的河岸邊欣賞夕陽。

examples.en: She opened a savings account at the post bank yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在郵局銀行開立了一個儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Bank of Taiwan operates multiple branches in every county.
examples.zh: 臺灣銀行在各縣市均設有多家分行。

examples.en: We sat on the grassy river bank enjoying a peaceful picnic.
examples.zh: 我們坐在青草如茵的河岸邊享受愜意的野餐。

examples.en: Don't bank on good weather for your mountain hike tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天的登山健行可別指望一定會有好天氣。

explains: This is a place where people keep money and make payments. It can also mean the land beside a river. As a verb, it can mean putting money away.
People may visit this place to save or take out money. The word can also name the sloping edge of a river. Someone may put money into an account there.
This word can mean a money service building. It may also mean the ground beside a stream. As an action, it can mean saving money for later.

examples.en: Baseball is considered Taiwan's national pastime.
examples.zh: 棒球被視為台灣的國球。

examples.en: He hit a stunning home run in the bottom of the ninth inning.
examples.zh: 他在九局下半擊出了一記精彩絕倫的全壘打。

examples.en: Fans cheered loudly at the professional baseball stadium in Taichung.
examples.zh: 球迷在台中職業棒球場上爆發出熱烈的歡呼聲。

examples.en: Passionate fans chant rhythmic cheers at Chinese Professional Baseball League games.
examples.zh: 熱血沸騰的棒球迷在中華職棒（CPBL）例行賽看台上整齊劃一跳著嗆司應援曲。

examples.en: Little League baseball tournaments ignite national pride during summer championships.
examples.zh: 每年夏天盛大登場的世界少棒錦標賽總能瞬間點燃全台灣熱血沸騰的國球榮耀感。

examples.en: Dad gave his son a leather glove and taught him how to catch a baseball in the backyard.
examples.zh: 爸爸送給兒子一只真皮手套，並在後院親自教導他如何穩穩接住棒球。

explains: This is a team sport played with a bat and a ball. Players run between four bases. One team hits while the other team tries to catch the ball.
Players hit a small ball and run around a field. The game has two teams. People often wear gloves to catch the ball.
This sport uses a bat, gloves, and four bases. Players try to score by running around the field. The other side works to stop them.

examples.en: The precision 18-gram filter basket features micro-machined holes that promote uniform bottom extraction.
examples.zh: 採用微米雷射雕刻微孔的精密濾壓粉碗，能確保水流在整個粉餅底部均勻通過。

examples.en: Nanotech coatings applied to the stainless steel basket ensure effortless knock-out of spent coffee pucks.
examples.zh: 不銹鋼粉碗表面被覆的先進奈米抗沾塗層，讓敲打手把倒出咖啡渣餅變得俐落乾脆毫不沾黏。

examples.en: Upgrading to a high-extraction ridgeless basket increases total dissolved solids by two percent.
examples.zh: 換裝無內圈凹槽的高流速精密粉碗，能讓義式濃縮咖啡的總溶解固體萃取濃度顯著提升兩個百分點。

entries.definition: 精密雷射微孔奈米塗層濾壓粉碗；籃子
explains: This is a container with open spaces between its strips. People use it to carry fruit or other items. It may be made from woven material.
A person can place groceries or clothes inside this container. Its sides may be made from reeds or plastic. It is often easy to carry by a handle.
This word names an open container used for carrying things. It can be woven from thin strips. A handle may sit over the top.

examples.en: Let's play basketball on the outdoor court.
examples.zh: 我們去戶外球場打籃球吧。

examples.en: He practiced free throws until he could shoot ten baskets in a row.
examples.zh: 他反覆練習罰球，直到能連續命中十顆籃球為止。

examples.en: Joining the basketball team helped him stay healthy and make loyal friends.
examples.zh: 加入籃球隊讓他維持強健體魄並結交了忠實摯友。

explains: This is a game played by two teams on a court. Players bounce and throw a large ball through a high hoop. The team with more points wins.
People play this sport by passing and shooting a ball. Each side tries to send it through a raised ring. Players move quickly across a flat court.
This team game uses a round ball and two high hoops. Players score when the ball goes through a hoop. It is often played indoors.

examples.en: The baseball player swung the bat and hit the ball.
examples.zh: 那位棒球選手揮棒擊中了球。

examples.en: A bat flew out of the dark cave.
examples.zh: 一隻蝙蝠飛出黑暗的洞穴。

examples.en: She will bat first for our team.
examples.zh: 她會擔任我們隊的第一位打擊手。

explains: It can name a small animal that flies at night. It can also name a long tool used to hit a ball. As a verb, it means striking something with that tool.
This word may describe a flying animal that sleeps in dark places. It may also mean a wooden or metal sports tool. A player can use it to hit a ball.
One meaning is a night animal with wings. Another meaning is a tool used in some ball games. The verb describes hitting with that tool.

examples.en: Duck breasts cook gently inside the calibrated water bath for two hours until perfectly pink throughout.
examples.zh: 鴨胸肉在攝氏五十六度的「恆溫水槽」（Water Bath）中靜置慢煮兩小時，呈現通體均勻的粉嫩肉質。

examples.en: After a long mountain hike in winter, sinking into a steaming hot spring bath restored her energy.
examples.zh: 冬季經過漫長的山林健行後，浸泡在熱氣騰騰的溫泉浴池中讓她徹底恢復了元氣。

examples.en: Laboratory technicians place chemical test tubes into an ultrasonic water bath to dissolve crystals.
examples.zh: 實驗室技術人員將化學試管浸入超音波恆溫水浴槽中，加速結晶物質溶解。

entries.definition: 均勻控溫於 56.5°C 之精準舒肥低溫水槽；洗澡
explains: This is the act of washing your body in water. People may sit in a tub or wash under running water. Soap can help clean the skin.
A person does this to get clean. Warm water may make the time feel relaxing. It can happen in a tub or shower.
This word names washing the body with water. People may do it after exercise or before bed. It helps remove dirt and sweat.

examples.en: May I use your bathroom, please?
examples.zh: 請問我可以借用一下洗手間嗎？

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands with soap in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 記得在洗手間用肥皂把手洗乾淨。

examples.en: The hotel room includes a modern, spotless private bathroom.
examples.zh: 飯店房間內設有一間現代化且一塵不染的私人浴室。

explains: This is a room with a toilet and a place to wash. People go there to use the sink or take a shower. It is usually found inside a home or public building.
A home has this room for washing and personal care. It may contain a sink, toilet, and shower. People keep soap and towels there.
This word names a room used for washing. A person may brush their teeth there. Many have a toilet and a shower.

examples.en: I want to be a kind and helpful friend.
examples.zh: 我想成為一位善良又樂於助人的朋友。

examples.en: The keys are on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 鑰匙在廚房桌上。

examples.en: Please be quiet while the baby sleeps.
examples.zh: 寶寶睡覺時請保持安靜。

explains: This verb connects a person with a name or quality. It can also link something to a place. It helps make many kinds of statements.
This verb can link a person to a description. It can tell where someone lives or stands. It can also help form a command or a question.
This small verb can show that something exists or has a certain state. It links a subject with more information. It also appears in many questions and instructions.

examples.en: We built sandcastles on the sandy beach in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們在墾丁的沙灘上堆沙堡。

examples.en: Walking along the beach at sunset feels very relaxing.
examples.zh: 在日落時分沿著海灘漫步感覺非常放鬆。

examples.en: Volunteers gathered on Saturday for a beach cleanup event.
examples.zh: 志工們週六齊聚一堂參加淨灘活動。

examples.en: Baisha Bay in Kenting features soft golden sand and crystal clear water.
examples.zh: 墾丁白沙灣擁有柔軟細緻的金黃沙灘與清澈碧藍的海水。

examples.en: Families enjoy building sandcastles and picking shells along the sunny beach.
examples.zh: 一家大小在陽光普照的沙灘上開心地堆沙堡與撿拾美麗貝殼。

examples.en: Please pack away all plastic bottles and food trash when leaving the public beach.
examples.zh: 離開公共海灘時，請務必將所有隨身喝過的塑膠水瓶與食物垃圾打包帶走。

explains: This is the land beside the sea or a lake. People may walk on the sand and play near the water. As a verb, it can mean bringing a boat onto shore.
Families may visit this place to swim or build sand shapes. It lies beside a large body of water. A boat can also be brought onto land there.
This word names a shore where people can rest or play. Sand or small stones may cover the ground. It can also mean guiding a boat onto land.

examples.en: A green bean fell from the basket.
examples.zh: 一根四季豆從籃子裡掉了出來。

examples.en: My uncle grows beans in his garden.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔在他的花園裡種豆子。

examples.en: She ate rice with black beans for lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐吃了配黑豆的飯。

explains: This is a small seed that people can cook and eat. It grows inside a long pod. Some kinds are green, while others are dry and hard.
People eat this food in soups, rice, or salads. It grows as a seed in a pod. Many kinds provide useful food for the body.
This word names a seed or the plant that makes it. The food may be fresh, dried, or cooked. Farmers grow many kinds around the world.

examples.en: The Formosan black bear is a protected animal.
examples.zh: 台灣黑熊是保育類動物。

examples.en: I cannot bear the scorching heat in midsummer without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 盛夏沒有冷氣我實在無法忍受那股酷熱。

examples.en: A polar bear has thick fur to stay warm in the Arctic snow.
examples.zh: 北極熊擁有厚實的毛皮，能在北極風雪中保持溫暖。

explains: This is a large wild animal with thick fur. It has strong legs and sharp claws. Some kinds sleep through much of the cold season.
The animal can stand on two legs or walk on four. It eats plants, fish, or other food depending on its kind. People should watch it from far away.
This word names a powerful animal found in forests and mountains. It has a large body and a short tail. As a verb, it can mean to put up with something hard.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake boasts beautiful mountain views.
examples.zh: 日月潭坐擁美麗的湖光山色。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful traditional dress to the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件美麗的傳統服飾參加文化祭典。

examples.en: Sunsets over the western coast are breathtakingly beautiful.
examples.zh: 西海岸的夕陽景致美得令人屏息。

explains: It describes something that is pleasant to see or hear. A lovely view may make people stop and look. Kind actions can also seem pleasing.
Use this word for a person, place, or thing that gives joy to the senses. A song can sound pleasing. A picture can look lovely.
This word tells that something has a pleasing look or sound. It may describe nature, music, or a person. The sight or sound can make someone happy.

examples.en: I am studying English because I want to travel.
examples.zh: 我學英文是因為我想去旅行。

examples.en: The baseball match was postponed because of the heavy thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 棒球比賽因為猛烈的雷陣雨而延期了。

examples.en: Just because a task seems difficult does not mean it is impossible.
examples.zh: 僅僅因為一項任務看似困難，並不代表它是不可能的。

explains: This word gives the reason for an action or idea. The words that follow explain why something happened. It connects a cause with a result.
Use it to tell why someone did something. The next part of the sentence gives a reason. It helps explain a choice or event.
This small joining word introduces a reason. It tells what caused an event. It can help the listener understand a decision.

examples.en: She worked hard to become an excellent teacher.
examples.zh: 她努力用功成為了一名優秀的老師。

examples.en: Autumn arrives in November, and the weather gradually becomes cool.
examples.zh: 十一月秋意漸濃，天氣逐漸變得涼爽。

examples.en: After years of friendship, they decided to become business partners.
examples.zh: 經過多年的深厚情誼，他們決定成為事業合夥人。

explains: It means to change into something else. A tadpole can turn into a frog. A child may grow into an adult.
Use this word when someone or something changes over time. Milk can turn sour. A small seed can grow into a plant.
This verb tells that a new state or form is reached. A caterpillar changes into a butterfly. A person can grow into a leader.

examples.en: I go to bed at ten o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 我每晚十點上床睡覺。

examples.en: Make sure you make your bed before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請務必整理好床鋪。

examples.en: The hotel bed was very soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 飯店的床非常柔軟舒適。

explains: This is a piece of furniture used for sleeping. It usually has a soft place for a person to lie down. Sheets and blankets cover it.
People rest on this furniture at night. It may have a frame, a mattress, and pillows. A room can hold one or more.
This word names the place where someone sleeps. It is often covered with sheets and a blanket. People lie on it when they are tired.

examples.en: My bedroom is quiet and comfortable.
examples.zh: 我的臥室安靜又舒適。

examples.en: She painted her bedroom walls a soothing shade of pale green.
examples.zh: 她把臥室牆壁漆成了令人放鬆的淺綠色。

examples.en: Please knock before entering someone else's private bedroom.
examples.zh: 進入別人的私人臥室前請務必敲門。

explains: This is a room where people sleep. It may have a bed, clothes, and a small table. A house can have several of these rooms.
People go to this room at night to rest. They may keep clothing and personal items there. It often has a bed and a closet.
This word names a private room for sleeping. It can belong to one person or several people. Homes often have more than one.

examples.en: Honey bees fly from flower to flower collecting nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花叢間穿梭採集花蜜。

examples.en: Be careful not to disturb the beehive or bees might sting you.
examples.zh: 小心不要驚擾蜂窩，否則蜜蜂可能會蜇你。

examples.en: He has been a busy bee all morning cleaning every room.
examples.zh: 他整個早上就像隻勤勞的小蜜蜂一樣打掃每間房間。

explains: This small flying insect visits flowers to gather food. It collects pollen and sweet liquid called nectar. Some kinds make honey.
Its body is often covered with tiny hairs. These hairs carry pollen from flower to flower. This helps many plants make seeds.
Some kinds live in large groups while others live alone. A group may build a home with many small cells. Many kinds can sting to defend themselves.

examples.en: Do you want beef or chicken for dinner?
examples.zh: 你晚餐想要吃牛肉還是雞肉？

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its fresh beef soup breakfast.
examples.zh: 台南以新鮮牛肉湯早餐聞名。

examples.en: He ordered a medium-rare beef steak at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐廳點了一客五分熟的牛排。

explains: This is meat from a cow. People cook it in many ways. It can be served in a soup, sandwich, or meal.
Food made from cow meat has this name. A cook may roast, grill, or boil it. Some people eat it with vegetables.
This word names meat from a large farm animal. It can be cut into steaks or small pieces. Cooking makes it ready to eat.

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly before eating meals.
examples.zh: 吃飯前請務必將雙手徹底洗乾淨。

examples.en: Always review the lesson notes before taking the unit quiz.
examples.zh: 在參加單元小考之前，務必先複習課堂筆記。

examples.en: The peaceful mountain village looked just as enchanting as before.
examples.zh: 這座安詳的山村看起來就像以往一樣迷人美麗。

explains: It means earlier than a time or event. You may wash your hands earlier than a meal. It can also tell that something happened in the past.
Use this word for a time that comes first. It can connect one event with a later event. It may also mean in earlier days.
This word points to something that comes first in time or order. It can tell when someone should do a task. It may also refer to an earlier period.

examples.en: The movie will begin at seven tonight.
examples.zh: 電影今晚七點開始。

examples.en: Let us begin our science lesson with a question.
examples.zh: 讓我們用一個問題開始科學課。

examples.en: She began to read when the room grew quiet.
examples.zh: 房間安靜下來後，她開始閱讀。

explains: It means to start doing something. A class can start when the teacher arrives. A story can start with the first event.
Use this word when an activity or event starts. It can tell when someone starts a task. It may also name the first part of a story.
This verb tells that something is starting. A game, lesson, or trip may start at a stated time. It can also mean taking the first step.

examples.en: Who is standing behind the curtain?
examples.zh: 誰站在窗簾後面？

examples.en: The playground is located behind the gymnasium.
examples.zh: 遊樂場位於體育館後方。

examples.en: Don't leave your personal belongings behind when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時不要遺落你的個人隨身物品。

explains: It means at the rear side of something. A person may stand there and wait. It can also describe being late or not as far along.
Use this word for a place on the far side from the front. It may tell that someone is late in a race. A part of a building can hide someone from view.
This word can describe the position at the rear. It may also mean slower than others. A person can stay out of sight there.

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your abilities.
examples.zh: 永遠要相信你自己和你的能力。

examples.en: Believe it or not, she learned to speak fluent Spanish in just six months.
examples.zh: 信不信由你，她僅僅花了六個月就學會了說一口流利的西班牙語。

examples.en: Scientists believe that regular physical exercise improves cognitive brain function.
examples.zh: 科學家們相信規律的身體運動能增進大腦認知功能。

explains: It means thinking that something is true. A person may trust a friend’s words. It can also show confidence in someone.
Use this word when you accept an idea as true. People may rely on someone they trust. It can describe faith in a person or plan.
This verb tells that someone thinks something is true. It may also mean trusting another person. A strong hope can rest on that trust.

examples.en: The school bell rang at the end of class.
examples.zh: 下課時學校的鐘響了。

examples.en: A small bell hung above the shop door.
examples.zh: 商店門上方掛著一個小鈴鐺。

examples.en: Ring the bell if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，請按鈴。

explains: This is a small object that makes a clear sound when it moves. Schools may use one to mark the start or end of class. A person may ring it to get someone’s attention.
It is a sound-making object found on doors, bikes, or desks. Someone can move it to make a ringing sound. A school may use one to tell students when class changes.
This object can make a bright ringing noise. It may hang near a door or sit on a counter. People use its sound to call someone.

examples.en: These books belong to the school library.
examples.zh: 這些書屬於學校圖書館。

examples.en: I feel that I belong in this music group.
examples.zh: 我覺得自己是這個音樂團體的一分子。

examples.en: Please put the clean cups where they belong.
examples.zh: 請把乾淨的杯子放回它們該放的地方。

explains: It can mean being owned by someone. It can also mean feeling welcome in a group. A thing may fit in one place better than another.
Use this word to say who owns something. It may also describe feeling like part of a team. It can tell where an item should be kept.
This verb can show that something is someone’s property. It can describe being accepted by a group. It may also mean that something fits in the right place.

examples.en: The temperature dropped below ten degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 氣溫下降到了攝氏十度以下。

examples.en: Divers marvel at the rich variety of marine life swimming below them.
examples.zh: 潛水員驚嘆於在他們下方遊動的豐富海洋生物。

examples.en: Please check the detailed schedule listed in the table below.
examples.zh: 請參閱下方表格中所列出的詳細時程表。

examples.en: Temperatures in high mountains often drop below zero in winter.
examples.zh: 高山地區冬季氣溫經常驟降至零度以下。

examples.en: Look at the photo gallery printed below to identify local wetland birds.
examples.zh: 請詳加參閱下方印製的彩色圖鑑，辨識常見的在地濕地水鳥。

examples.en: Divers swam down below the water's surface to photograph coral fish.
examples.zh: 潛水員深潛至波光粼粼的水面下方，拍攝穿梭珊瑚礁間的熱帶魚群。

explains: It means in a lower place. A picture may hang under another picture. It can also compare a number with a stated level.
Use this word for something at a lower position. A temperature may be less than a set number. A name may appear farther down on a page.
This word points to a place under something else. It can show that an amount is less than a limit. A person may look lower on a map or list.

examples.en: He wore a leather belt around his waist.
examples.zh: 他在腰間繫了一條皮帶。

examples.en: The belt keeps my trousers from falling down.
examples.zh: 這條皮帶讓我的長褲不會掉下來。

examples.en: The machine uses a belt to move its parts.
examples.zh: 這台機器用皮帶帶動零件。

explains: This is a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes in place. It may be made of leather or cloth. A machine can also use a moving strip with this name.
People fasten this strip around their waist. It helps keep trousers in place. Some tools and machines also use one to carry movement.
This word names a long narrow strap. It can hold clothing at the waist. In a machine, a similar strip can move power from one part to another.

examples.en: We sat on a bench beside the playground.
examples.zh: 我們坐在遊樂場旁的長椅上。

examples.en: The coach asked the players on the bench to stand up.
examples.zh: 教練請坐在替補席上的球員站起來。

examples.en: My grandfather built a wooden bench for the garden.
examples.zh: 我的祖父為花園做了一張木長椅。

explains: This is a long seat for two or more people. It may stand in a park or near a sports field. A judge may also work at a raised desk with this name.
People can sit together on this kind of seat. It is often made of wood or metal. In sports, it can name the place where extra players wait.
This word can name a long seat without arms. It may be found outside or in a hall. It can also mean a high work seat used by a judge.

examples.en: Come sit beside me so we can share the book.
examples.zh: 來坐在我旁邊，我們才能一起看這本書。

examples.en: A beautiful crystal vase filled with fresh lilies stood beside the bed.
examples.zh: 床邊擺放著一只插滿新鮮百合的美麗水晶花瓶。

examples.en: He parked his compact scooter right beside the convenience store entrance.
examples.zh: 他把輕巧的機車恰好停放在便利商店入口旁邊。

examples.en: She sat beside her best friend during the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮上她坐在最好的摯友身旁。

examples.en: Place the floor lamp beside the armchair so you can read comfortably.
examples.zh: 把立式閱讀燈擺設在單人扶手沙發身旁，這樣看書才夠明亮舒服。

examples.en: Beside the massive Pacific Ocean, our tiny boat felt small and fragile.
examples.zh: 與浩瀚無邊的太平洋相比，我們搭乘的觀光小艇顯得格外渺小脆弱。

explains: It means next to something. Two people may sit side by side. It can also introduce a comparison with a second thing.
Use this word for a place immediately next to another place. It may also help compare one thing with another. The sentence shows which use is meant.
This word tells that something is at the side of something else. It can describe two people sitting close together. It may also show a contrast.

examples.en: This is the best drawing in the class.
examples.zh: 這是班上最好的畫。

examples.en: She runs best when she feels relaxed.
examples.zh: 她放鬆時跑得最好。

examples.en: We hope for the best on our trip.
examples.zh: 我們希望這趟旅程一切順利。

explains: It describes the highest quality in a group. It can also show the greatest skill someone has. As a noun, it may mean the most good result that can happen.
Use this word for the top choice among several things. It can tell that someone does something better than others. It may also name the most hopeful result.
This word points to the finest or most helpful option. It can describe someone’s strongest work. People may use it when they hope for a good result.

examples.en: The convenience store is between the bank and the clinic.
examples.zh: 便利商店在銀行與診所之間。

examples.en: What is the main difference between these two grammar rules?
examples.zh: 這兩條文法規則之間的主要差異是什麼？

examples.en: Keep this secret strictly between you and me.
examples.zh: 請把這個秘密嚴格保留在你我之間。

examples.en: The high-speed rail runs swiftly between Nangang and Zuoying.
examples.zh: 高鐵在南港與左營兩站之間快速奔馳。

examples.en: Choose between oolong tea and black tea to pair with your afternoon pineapple cake.
examples.zh: 在清香烏龍茶與濃郁紅茶兩者之間做出選擇，搭配可口的午後鳳梨酥。

examples.en: There is a deep, unbreakable bond of trust between the two business partners.
examples.zh: 這兩位創業夥伴之間存在著極其深厚、堅不可摧的無條件信賴默契。

entries.definition: 在…之間（兩者間）；在…兩者之間
explains: It means in the space separating two things. A path may pass through that space. It can also describe a choice shared by two people.
Use this word for something with one thing on each side. It may describe a place or a time. It can also show a link shared by two people.
This word points to the middle space of two things. It can tell where someone stands. It can also describe a connection shared by two people.

examples.en: YouBike is a popular bicycle rental system in Taiwan.
examples.zh: YouBike 是台灣受歡迎的公共自行車系統。

examples.en: Riding a bicycle along the riverside is a wonderful weekend activity.
examples.zh: 週末沿著河濱騎腳踏車是一項很棒的活動。

examples.en: Remember to lock your bike when you park it outside.
examples.zh: 將腳踏車停在室外時記得上鎖。

explains: This is a vehicle with two wheels and pedals. A rider pushes the pedals to move it. It can be used for travel or exercise.
People sit on this two-wheeled machine and move the pedals with their feet. It has a handlebar for steering. Many children learn to ride one.
This word names a light vehicle powered by a rider’s legs. It has two wheels and a seat. People use it on roads and paths.

examples.en: Taipei 101 is a very big skyscraper.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是一棟非常巨大的摩天大樓。

examples.en: Passing the entrance examination was a big milestone in her life.
examples.zh: 通過入學考試是她人生中的一個重大里程碑。

examples.en: The smiling child greeted his grandparents with a big hug.
examples.zh: 面帶微笑的孩子給了祖父母一個大大的擁抱。

explains: It describes something with a large size. A tree may be much taller than a child. The word can also mean important.
Use this word for something that takes up much space. It can describe a large number or a strong change. It may also tell that an event matters a lot.
This word means large in size or amount. It can describe a house, crowd, or sound. It can also mean important to many people.

examples.en: The early bird catches the worm.
examples.zh: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

examples.en: Flocks of migratory birds visit the river wetlands every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天成群的候鳥都會造訪河口濕地。

examples.en: We woke up to the cheerful chirping of wild birds.
examples.zh: 我們在野鳥歡快的鳴囀聲中醒來。

explains: This is an animal with feathers and wings. Most kinds lay eggs. Many can fly, while some move on land or water.
The animal has a beak and two legs. Feathers cover its body. It may build a nest for its eggs.
This word names a feathered animal. It can fly, walk, or swim depending on its kind. Some people keep one as a pet.

examples.en: The dog gave the toy a gentle bite.
examples.zh: 狗輕輕咬了一下玩具。

examples.en: Be careful not to bite your tongue.
examples.zh: 小心不要咬到舌頭。

examples.en: A mosquito bite made his arm itch.
examples.zh: 蚊子叮了一口，讓他的手臂發癢。

explains: It can mean cutting food with your teeth. It can also name one small mark made by teeth or an insect. A person may feel pain or itching there.
Use this word for pressing teeth into something. It may also mean one small wound from an insect. Context shows who or what caused the mark.
This word can name the action of using teeth. It can also describe a little hurt place on the skin. Some insects leave one when they feed.

examples.en: He wore a black jacket to the party.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件黑色夾克去參加聚會。

examples.en: The teacher wrote key concepts with chalk on the black board.
examples.zh: 老師用粉筆在黑板上寫下核心概念。

examples.en: My father prefers his coffee black without any sugar.
examples.zh: 我父親喜歡喝不加糖的黑咖啡。

explains: It describes the darkest common color. The night sky may look this way when there is no moon. The word can also name that color.
Use this word for a very dark shade with little or no light. Ink and coal may have this color. It can be used as a describing word or a color name.
This word names a color darker than white or gray. It can describe clothes, hair, or paint. It may also mean a person from a certain group, depending on context.

examples.en: The guide helped a blind traveler cross the street.
examples.zh: 導遊協助一位失明的旅客過馬路。

examples.en: Bright light can blind you for a moment.
examples.zh: 強光可能會讓你暫時看不清楚。

examples.en: Close the blind to keep the room dark.
examples.zh: 把百葉窗關起來，讓房間保持昏暗。

explains: It can describe someone who cannot see. It can also mean stopping someone from seeing for a short time. A window cover with this name can block light.
Use this word for a person with little or no sight. A sudden bright light may make someone unable to see clearly. It may also name a cover for a window.
This word can describe loss of sight. It can also mean making vision unclear with light or smoke. A window shade may have this name too.

examples.en: A large block of ice floated in the water.
examples.zh: 一大塊冰漂浮在水面上。

examples.en: The road block stopped cars from entering the street.
examples.zh: 路障阻止汽車進入街道。

examples.en: We live two blocks from the library.
examples.zh: 我們住在離圖書館兩個街區的地方。

explains: It can name a solid piece of material. It may also mean a group of streets in a town. As a verb, it can mean stopping something from moving or happening.
Use this word for a square piece of stone or ice. It can also name a town area between streets. A person may stop a path with an object.
This word may mean one solid piece. It may describe a small area of a city. It can also mean making a road or action unable to continue.

examples.en: Please blow gently on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 請輕輕地對著熱湯吹氣。

examples.en: The wind blew the leaves across the yard.
examples.zh: 風吹著樹葉飄過院子。

examples.en: He blew up a balloon for the party.
examples.zh: 他為派對吹了一個氣球。

explains: It means pushing air out through the mouth. Wind can also move leaves or clouds. A person can fill a balloon by sending air into it.
Use this word for moving air with your breath. It can also describe wind moving something. A balloon grows larger when someone sends breath inside.
This verb can mean making air move from the mouth. It can describe wind pushing things along. It may also mean filling something with air.

examples.en: The ocean looks deep blue today.
examples.zh: 今天的海洋看起來一片深藍。

examples.en: She wore a lovely sky-blue dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的天藍色洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: Whenever I feel blue, listening to gentle music cheers me up.
examples.zh: 每當我心情沮喪時，聽輕柔的音樂總能讓我振作起來。

explains: It names the color of a clear daytime sky. The same word can describe a sad feeling. Context helps the reader know which sense is meant.
Use this word for a cool color between green and violet. It can describe the sea or a shirt. It may also mean feeling unhappy.
This word can name a color seen in the sky on a clear day. It can also describe a low, sad mood. The sentence makes the meaning clear.

examples.en: We took a boat tour around Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我們搭船遊覽日月潭。

examples.en: The fishermen returned to port with their small wooden boats.
examples.zh: 漁夫們划著他們的小木船返回港口。

examples.en: A rowing boat is available for rent in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有提供划艇租借。

explains: This is a small vehicle that travels on water. People may use it for fishing or crossing a lake. It can move with a motor, oars, or sails.
People ride in this watercraft on rivers, lakes, or the sea. It may carry a few people or many. A person can guide it with oars or a motor.
This word names a craft that floats on water. Some are small enough for one family. Others carry people or goods from place to place.

examples.en: Regular exercise keeps your body strong.
examples.zh: 規律運動能保持身體強健。

examples.en: Water makes up about sixty percent of the human body.
examples.zh: 水分大約佔了人體重量的百分之六十。

examples.en: Good posture keeps your body and spine healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的體態能維護身體與脊椎健康。

examples.en: Sumatran Mandheling delivers a rich, buttery body with earthy cocoa notes that coats the entire tongue.
examples.zh: 蘇門答臘曼特寧展現出厚實如融化奶油般的醇厚口感油脂感，深沉可可風味包覆整個舌頭。

examples.en: Light-roast Geisha lots are prized for a delicate, tea-like body rather than heavy syrupy thickness.
examples.zh: 淺度烘焙的高海拔藝伎精品豆，以其宛如大吉嶺紅茶般清透空靈的茶感質地見長，而非濃郁厚重。

examples.en: French press immersion brewing allows natural oils to pass into the cup, producing an exceptionally round body.
examples.zh: 法式濾壓壺全浸泡沖煮能讓咖啡生豆豐富的未乳化天然油脂完全保留在杯中，營造極致圓潤的醇厚口感。

entries.definition: 身體；身軀；絲滑醇厚、如奶油般之油脂醇厚度
explains: This is the whole physical part of a person or animal. It includes the head, arms, and legs. People also use this word for the main part of an object.
It names the physical parts of a living thing. Food, rest, and exercise help keep it healthy. The word can also mean the main part of a written work.
