explains: This is a place where doctors and nurses care for sick people. A patient may stay there overnight. It has rooms for treatment and healing.
People go to this building when they need medical care. Workers may take an X-ray or give medicine. Some patients rest there for several days.
This word names a large health center. Doctors help people get better there. An ambulance may bring patients to it.

examples.en: Summer in southern Taiwan is very hot.
examples.zh: 台灣南部的夏天非常炎熱。

examples.en: Enjoying a hot spring bath is relaxing in cold winter weather.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬日裡享受溫泉泡湯非常放鬆。

examples.en: Be careful not to burn your tongue on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 小心別被滾燙的熱湯燙到舌頭。

explains: It describes a high temperature. A soup may feel this way just after cooking. It can also describe spicy food or something popular.
Use this word for something that has much warmth. A summer day may feel this way. It may also mean fashionable or in demand.
This word tells that something has a high temperature. Pepper may give food this quality. A new song may be very popular.

examples.en: We booked a cozy hotel room near the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市附近訂了一間溫馨的飯店房間。

examples.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast and shuttle service to the airport.
examples.zh: 飯店提供免費早餐以及往返機場的接駁車服務。

examples.en: Check-in time at this boutique hotel is after three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 這家精品飯店的入住登記時間為下午三點之後。

explains: This is a building where travelers pay to sleep. It may have many guest rooms. A desk worker helps visitors check in.
People stay at this place during a trip. It may offer meals and a bed. Guests keep their belongings in a room.
This word names a place for visitors to sleep away from home. Workers may clean rooms and welcome guests. A person pays to stay there.

examples.en: The movie lasts for two hours.
examples.zh: 這部電影長達兩個小時。

examples.en: It took us an hour to finish the science project.
examples.zh: 我們花了一小時才完成自然科學專題。

examples.en: The train leaves in half an hour.
examples.zh: 火車半小時後發車。

explains: This is a unit of time equal to sixty minutes. A class or trip may last one of them. A clock shows how many have passed.
People use this time unit to plan a meeting. It has sixty minutes. A workday may last many of them.
This word names a period measured by a clock. It is longer than a minute and shorter than a day. People use it when telling how long something takes.

examples.en: They bought a lovely house in Yilan.
examples.zh: 他們在宜蘭買了一棟可愛的房子。

examples.en: This museum houses thousands of ancient historical relics.
examples.zh: 這座博物館收藏了數千件古老的歷史文物。

examples.en: We had a lively housewarming party with our new neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們和新鄰居們舉辦了一場熱鬧的喬遷派對。

explains: This is a building where people live. It may have rooms, a kitchen, and a roof. The verb can mean giving shelter to someone.
Families may sleep and eat inside this building. It can be made from wood, stone, or brick. A group may provide rooms for guests.
This word names a place built for people to live. It usually has walls and a roof. As a verb, it means giving space to someone or something.

examples.en: My grandmother was a housewife for many years.
examples.zh: 我的祖母當了多年的家庭主婦。

examples.en: The housewife planned meals for the week.
examples.zh: 這位家庭主婦規劃了整週的餐點。

examples.en: She worked as a housewife while raising her children.
examples.zh: 她養育孩子時擔任家庭主婦。

explains: This is an older term for a woman who manages a home and cares for family members. She may cook, clean, and plan daily tasks. The term describes a role, not a job outside the home.
A woman may care for a home and children full time. She may organize meals and household work. Some people use this older word for that role.
This word names a woman whose main work is caring for her home. She may look after children and plan family needs. People may now use a more modern phrase for the same role.

examples.en: How do you get to school every day?
examples.zh: 你每天是如何去學校的？

examples.en: How much does a round-trip ticket to Kaohsiung cost?
examples.zh: 前往高雄的來回車票要多少錢？

examples.en: She explained how modern solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
examples.zh: 她解釋了現代太陽能板如何將陽光轉化為電能。

explains: It asks about the way something happens. A person may want steps or instructions. It can also ask about someone’s condition.
Use this question word when asking about a method. It may ask what a person feels like. The answer often gives details.
This word helps ask for information about manner or condition. A teacher may use it when asking for a process. A friend may use it to ask about someone’s health.

examples.en: I wanted to go jogging; however, it started pouring rain.
examples.zh: 我本想出門慢跑；然而，天公不作美下起了傾盆大雨。

examples.en: The team practiced tirelessly every weekend; however, they lost the final match by one point.
examples.zh: 該校隊每個週末都夜以繼日刻苦集訓；然而，他們在總決賽中以一分之差惜敗。

examples.en: However difficult the coding challenge seems, break it down into smaller functions.
examples.zh: 無論這道程式演算法難題看似多麼棘手，只要將其拆解為細小函式即可迎刃而解。

explains: It joins ideas that do not seem to agree. It can also mean in any way or by any means. The sentence shows which use fits.
Use this word to introduce a contrast. A plan may be hard, but a team may still try. It can also show that something will happen no matter what.
This word often points to an opposite idea. It may mean even so. In a different sentence, it may mean in whatever way is possible.

examples.en: This meal costs one hundred NT dollars.
examples.zh: 這頓飯花費新台幣一百元。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans waited outside the concert hall.
examples.zh: 數百名歌迷在音樂廳外守候。

examples.en: There are one hundred centimeters in one meter.
examples.zh: 一公尺等於一百公分。

explains: This is the number ten times ten. It has two zeros after the one. People use it when counting money, years, or objects.
Use this word for the number 100. It comes after ninety-nine. A group of ten tens makes this amount.
This word names a number equal to ten groups of ten. A century has this many years. People may use it for a large count.

examples.en: Let's grab some snacks; I am really hungry.
examples.zh: 我們去買點點心吧，我真的很餓。

examples.en: Staying hungry for knowledge drives students to read broadly.
examples.zh: 對知識保持渴望驅使學生廣泛閱讀。

examples.en: The hungry stray dog was grateful for a bowl of clean food.
examples.zh: 飢餓的流浪狗對一碗乾淨的食物充滿感激。

explains: It describes needing food. A person may feel this way before lunch. Eating a meal can make the feeling go away.
Use this word when the body wants food. A long walk may make someone feel this way. A snack can help.
This word tells that someone wants to eat. The feeling may grow when a person skips a meal. Food helps satisfy it.

examples.en: My left knee hurts after running ten laps.
examples.zh: 跑了十圈後我的左膝蓋很痛。

examples.en: Be careful playing on the playground so you don't get hurt.
examples.zh: 在遊樂場玩耍時要當心，別讓自己受傷了。

examples.en: Harsh words can hurt someone's feelings deeply for a long time.
examples.zh: 刻薄刺耳的話語會深深傷害別人的感情長達許久。

explains: It means feeling pain or causing pain. A person may get injured after falling. The noun can name the pain itself.
Use this word when someone has an injury. A sharp object may cause pain. It can also describe feelings that are upset.
This verb means causing pain or damage. A person may need care after an accident. As a noun, it can name a sore place or sad feeling.

examples.en: Her husband works at the city library.
examples.zh: 她的丈夫在市立圖書館工作。

examples.en: The husband and wife walked home together.
examples.zh: 夫妻兩人一起走回家。

examples.en: She thanked her husband for the kind gift.
examples.zh: 她感謝丈夫送的貼心禮物。

explains: This is a man who is married to someone. He may share a home and family with his partner. The female partner is his wife.
A woman may call the man she married this name. They may care for a home together. The word describes their relationship.
This word names a married man. He may be a partner and parent. His spouse may be called a wife.

examples.en: I am a high school student in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我是台灣的高中生。

examples.en: I enjoy reading books on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在下雨天看書。

examples.en: Can I ask you a quick question?
examples.zh: 我可以問你一個簡短的問題嗎？

examples.en: I cooked a bowl of beef noodle soup for myself.
examples.zh: 我為自己煮了一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: I promised myself to read at least one chapter every evening.
examples.zh: 我向自己保證每晚至少要讀完一個章節。

examples.en: I built this wooden bookshelf all by myself over the weekend.
examples.zh: 我利用週末完全靠自己親手打造了這個木製書架。

explains: This pronoun points to the person speaking. It often begins a sentence about that speaker. Other forms show ownership or receive an action.
Use this pronoun when the speaker talks about themselves. Its forms change when the person owns something or is the object. It is written with a capital letter.
This word group refers to the speaker. One form acts as the subject of a sentence. Other forms show possession or point back to the same person.

examples.en: Water ice trapped in permanently shadowed polar craters can be split into hydrogen and oxygen rocket propellant.
examples.zh: 隱藏在月球極地永久陰影坑深處的水冰資源，可透過電解製造出火箭急需的液氫與液氧燃料。

examples.en: After twisting her ankle while playing basketball, she applied an ice pack to reduce the swelling.
examples.zh: 在打籃球不慎扭傷腳踝後，她立即拿冰敷袋冰敷患部，以迅速消腫並減輕疼痛。

examples.en: Salt is routinely spread over frosty roads in cold northern regions to melt winter road ice quickly.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的北方雪國地區，工務單位常在結霜結冰的柏油路面上撒鹽，以加速融化路面結冰。

entries.definition: 月球永久陰影坑深處珍貴水冰資源
explains: This is water that has become solid because it is very cold. It may form on a lake in winter. People put it in drinks to make them cool.
When water freezes, it turns into this hard material. A freezer makes small pieces of it. It melts when it gets warm.
This word names frozen water. It can cover a pond in winter. Small pieces may chill juice or tea.

examples.en: That sounds like a wonderful idea for the weekend!
examples.zh: 這聽起來是個超棒的週末點子！

examples.en: Brainstorming meetings encourage team members to propose innovative ideas freely.
examples.zh: 腦力激盪會議鼓勵團隊成員自由提出創新的想法。

examples.en: I have no idea where I misplaced my car keys this morning.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道今天早上把車鑰匙落在何處了。

explains: This is a thought or plan in someone’s mind. A person may share one with a friend. It can help solve a problem.
Use this word for something someone thinks of. It may be a plan, belief, or suggestion. A good one can lead to action.
This word names a thought or suggestion. People may talk about it together. It can be new or based on something learned.

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the game will be canceled.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，比賽將會取消。

examples.en: Please let me know if you need any additional stationery.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何額外的文具，請告訴我。

examples.en: If possible, arrive at the examination venue ten minutes early.
examples.zh: 如果可能的話，請提前十分鐘抵達考場。

explains: It joins a condition with a possible result. A person may say what will happen under one situation. It often begins one part of a sentence.
Use this small joining word to talk about a possibility. The next event depends on the condition. A question may ask whether something is true.
This word introduces a condition. It tells that one thing may happen only when another is true. It can also show doubt in a question.

examples.en: Getting adequate sleep is important for health.
examples.zh: 擁有充足的睡眠對健康非常重要。

examples.en: Effective communication plays an important role in fostering teamwork.
examples.zh: 有效的溝通在促進團隊協作中扮演著至關重要的角色。

examples.en: Never disclose important confidential personal passwords to strangers.
examples.zh: 切勿向陌生人透露重要的機密個人密碼。

explains: It describes something that matters a lot. A safety rule may have this quality. People should pay attention to it.
Use this word for a person or thing with great value. A test may matter for a student’s grade. It can describe a key idea.
This word tells that something is not minor. It may affect what happens next. People may give it special attention.

examples.en: My wallet is in the backpack.
examples.zh: 我的皮夾在背包裡面。

examples.en: We study in the classroom every weekday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個平日早晨都在教室裡學習。

examples.en: She was born in Taichung in 2008.
examples.zh: 她於 2008 年在台中出生。

explains: This short word can show that something is within a place. It may also tell a time period or condition. A sentence gives the exact sense.
Use it to point to a position surrounded by something. It may also describe a month, year, or state. The nearby words help show its meaning.
This word may tell that someone is surrounded by a space. It can name a time or situation. It often links a thing with its location.

examples.en: The ruler is twelve inches long.
examples.zh: 這把尺有十二英吋長。

examples.en: The book is about one inch thick.
examples.zh: 這本書大約有一英吋厚。

examples.en: The screen measures six inches across.
examples.zh: 這個螢幕寬六英吋。

explains: This is a small unit used to measure length. Twelve of them make one foot. A ruler may show the marks.
People use this measurement for short distances. It is equal to about two and a half centimeters. A person may measure a screen this way.
This word names a unit of length. It is smaller than a foot. Some countries use it on rulers and height charts.

examples.en: Butterflies and bees are helpful insects.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶和蜜蜂是有益的昆蟲。

examples.en: Some harmless insects camouflage themselves to blend into tree bark.
examples.zh: 有些無害的昆蟲會偽裝自己以融入樹皮環境。

examples.en: Put on protective bug spray to repel biting insects during night walks.
examples.zh: 夜間散步時噴上防蚊液，以驅趕叮人的昆蟲。

explains: This is a small animal with six legs. Many kinds have wings. Ants, bees, and butterflies belong to this group.
The creature has three main body parts and six legs. It may crawl or fly. Some kinds help plants grow.
This word names a small animal with six legs. It may have wings or feelers. Scientists study many kinds.

examples.en: Come inside and warm up with some hot tea.
examples.zh: 快進來喝點熱茶暖暖身子。

examples.en: What treasures are stored inside that mysterious wooden locked chest?
examples.zh: 那口神秘上鎖的木箱裡究竟存放了什麼寶物？

examples.en: He turned his jacket inside out to let the damp lining dry.
examples.zh: 他把夾克翻過來讓潮濕的內裡晾乾。

explains: It means the inner part of a place or object. It can also name the area that is not outside. The word may be a noun, adjective, or adverb.
Use this word for a position within a space. A box has an inner space. It can also describe movement past a door.
This word points to the part covered by walls or sides. It may describe a room or container. A person may move there from outdoors.

examples.en: Fixed-deposit accounts provide steady annual interest earnings.
examples.zh: 定存帳戶能提供穩定的年利息收益。

examples.en: She showed a keen interest in learning conversational Spanish.
examples.zh: 她對學習西班牙語日常會話表現出了濃厚的興趣。

examples.en: It is in your own best interest to consult a legal specialist.
examples.zh: 諮詢法律專業人士最符合你自身的利益。

explains: It can mean money paid for borrowing. It can also mean a feeling of wanting to learn about something. As a verb, it means making someone curious.
Use this word for curiosity about a topic. A book may catch someone’s attention. A bank may add a fee when money is borrowed.
This word can name curiosity or a fee paid on borrowed money. As an action, it means making a person want to know more. Context tells which meaning fits.

examples.en: He is interested in space and stars.
examples.zh: 他對太空和星星感興趣。

examples.en: The students were interested in the science show.
examples.zh: 學生們對科學展覽很感興趣。

examples.en: Are you interested in learning to cook?
examples.zh: 你對學做菜有興趣嗎？

explains: It describes someone who wants to learn more about a subject. A person may listen closely during a talk. They may ask questions afterward.
Use this word for a person whose attention has been caught. A new story may make someone curious. The feeling can lead to more questions.
This word tells that someone wants to know more. A person may feel this way about science or music. A good story can create that feeling.

examples.en: Science experiments are both fun and interesting.
examples.zh: 自然科學實驗既好玩又很有趣。

examples.en: He shared an interesting story about his adventurous backpacking trip.
examples.zh: 他分享了一段關於他充滿冒險的背包旅行趣事。

examples.en: The historical documentary revealed fascinating and interesting facts about our ancestors.
examples.zh: 這部歷史紀錄片揭露了關於我們祖先許多引人入勝的有趣事實。

explains: It describes something that holds attention. A book with surprises may have this quality. People may want to learn more about it.
Use this word for a story, lesson, or fact that makes people curious. It may be new or surprising. The listener may ask questions.
This word tells that something is fun to learn about. It may hold someone’s attention. A surprising event can make a story this way.

examples.en: Prepare thoroughly before going to a job interview.
examples.zh: 去求職面試前應做好充分準備。

examples.en: The television network broadcasted a live interview with the championship-winning coach.
examples.zh: 電視新聞網現場直播了對冠軍教練的深度專訪。

examples.en: She answered every tough interview question with composure and confidence.
examples.zh: 她沉著冷靜、自信滿滿地回答了面試官提出的每一個刁鑽問題。

examples.en: Wear neat professional business attire for the job interview.
examples.zh: 參加求職面試時請穿著整潔得體的專業商務正裝。

examples.en: The tech journalist interviewed the visionary CEO about the company's electric car plans.
examples.zh: 科技線記者就該公司未來的智慧電動車全球布局藍圖，深度專訪了極具遠見的執行長。

examples.en: Practicing common behavioral questions builds great confidence before any interview.
examples.zh: 面試前反覆模擬練習常見的行為面試經典提問，能為你在應試時建立莫大信心。

explains: This is a planned talk where someone asks questions. It may be used when choosing a person for a job. A reporter may also speak with a famous person.
A worker may meet with someone who wants to learn about their skills. A news writer may ask a person about an event. The same word names both talks.
This word names a question-and-answer meeting. It may help a company select a worker. It can also be a talk shown in the news.

examples.en: Put the fresh vegetables into the shopping basket.
examples.zh: 把新鮮蔬菜放進購物籃中。

examples.en: The caterpillar transformed miraculously into a dazzling, colorful butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲奇蹟般地蛻變為一隻光彩奪目、色彩斑斕的蝴蝶。

examples.en: The police detective conducted an in-depth investigation into the suspicious bank transfer.
examples.zh: 警探針對這筆可疑的銀行轉帳展開了深入詳盡的調查。

examples.en: She poured fresh warm soy milk into her ceramic mug.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮熱豆漿倒入陶瓷馬克杯中。

examples.en: The inquisitive child peered excitedly into the deep marine aquarium tank.
examples.zh: 好奇心旺盛的小朋友興高采烈地把臉貼在巨型水族箱玻璃上往裡頭張望。

examples.en: Over the past decade, the modest fishing harbor evolved into a popular tourist destination.
examples.zh: 過去十年間，這座質樸的小漁港逐漸轉變發展成為極受歡迎的觀光勝地。

entries.definition: 進入…之中；深入；進入；到…裡面；轉變為
explains: It means moving toward the inner part of something. A person may step through a doorway. It can also describe changing to a new state.
Use this word for motion toward the inner part of something. Water may flow through a pipe toward a cup. A person may turn to a new role.
This word shows movement toward the inside. It can describe going through an opening. It may also show a change from one form to another.

examples.en: Ken invited all his classmates to his birthday party.
examples.zh: 肯恩邀請了全班同學參加他的生日聚會。

examples.en: The school invited a renowned marine biologist to deliver a guest lecture.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位著名的海洋生物學家前來進行專題演講。

examples.en: Leaving open food on kitchen counters invites troublesome ants and flies.
examples.zh: 將食物裸露放在廚房流理台上會招引討厭的螞蟻與蒼蠅。

explains: It means asking someone to come to an event. A person may send a card or message. The noun can mean an offer to attend.
Use this word when asking a friend to join a party. It may also mean causing someone to take part. A written message may carry the request.
This verb means asking another person to attend. It can also mean asking for a response or action. People may do it with a call or note.

examples.en: Taiwan is a stunning island known for scenic landscapes.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座以壯麗景觀著稱的迷人島嶼。

examples.en: Green Island and Orchid Island are famous diving destinations.
examples.zh: 綠島和蘭嶼是著名的潛水勝地。

examples.en: The small tropical island has pristine white sand beaches.
examples.zh: 這座熱帶小島擁有原始純淨的白沙灘。

examples.en: The large kitchen island serves as a food prep station, breakfast bar, and social hub.
examples.zh: 寬達三米的大型多功能廚房中島吧檯既是料理備餐檯，更是全家人聊天小酌的溫馨社交核心。

examples.en: Taiwan is a vibrant Pacific island celebrated worldwide for friendly people and night market delicacies.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座矗立於西太平洋上的美麗活力島嶼，以熱情友善的濃厚人情味與道地夜市美食聞名全球。

examples.en: Install a sink and pop-up electrical outlets directly into the kitchen island for ultimate convenience.
examples.zh: 在廚房中島檯面上直接整合內嵌不鏽鋼水槽與隱藏式電動升降插座，能讓下廚烹飪變得無比便捷。

examples.en: Expanding rooftop greenery and planting 10,000 native trees combats the oppressive urban heat island effect.
examples.zh: 大力推廣屋頂綠化與廣植萬株台灣原生樹種，能強效緩解悶熱難耐的都會「都市熱島效應」（Heat Island）。

examples.en: Taiwan is a geographically diverse subtropical island featuring towering mountains and coral reefs.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座地貌極具多樣性的美麗亞熱帶海島，擁有巍峨壯闊的百岳高山與五彩斑斕的墾丁珊瑚礁海岸。

examples.en: The open-concept kitchen features a spacious central marble island perfect for meal prep and casual dining.
examples.zh: 這間開放式現代廚房中央規劃了一座寬敞氣派的義大利天然大理石中島吧台，兼具料理備料與日常輕食機能。

examples.en: Cool roofs painted with reflective white coatings help mitigate the suffocating urban heat island effect.
examples.zh: 在屋頂塗刷高反射率白色降溫塗料，能有效緩解高樓林立、熱氣滯留的都會熱島效應。

examples.en: Replacing asphalt parking lots with tree groves reduces the intensity of the summer heat island.
examples.zh: 將滾燙吸熱的柏油露天停車場全面改建為林蔭透水綠地，能大幅削減盛夏都市熱島效應的威力。

examples.en: Urban satellite data shows that dense downtown areas suffer from a five-degree heat island penalty.
examples.zh: 氣象衛星熱輻射影像清晰顯示，缺乏綠地的高密度市中心飽受比郊區高出攝氏五度的熱島效應煎熬。

entries.definition: 島嶼；廚房中島吧檯；減緩都市熱島效應 (Heat Island)；緩解都會區熱島效應降溫兩度
explains: This is land with water all around it. It may be small or large. People often reach one by boat or plane.
The land sits apart from a larger land area. It may have beaches and hills. People who live there may travel by ferry.
This word names a piece of land surrounded by water. Some have only a few homes. Others are large places with many towns.

examples.en: It is a sunny day today.
examples.zh: 今天是個大晴天。

examples.en: I found my lost key; it was under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我找到遺失的鑰匙了，它在沙發下面。

examples.en: It takes only ten minutes to walk there.
examples.zh: 走路到那裡只要十分鐘。

examples.en: The smart robot vacuum cleaner charges itself automatically.
examples.zh: 這台智慧掃地機器人會自動幫自己充電。

examples.en: History often repeats itself if societies fail to learn from past errors.
examples.zh: 如果社會未能從昔日錯誤中吸取教訓，歷史往往會重蹈覆轍。

examples.en: The majestic antique mansion is an architectural masterpiece in itself.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉的古典宅邸本身就是一座令人讚嘆的建築傑作。

explains: This pronoun refers to a thing, animal, or idea already named. Another form shows ownership. A reflexive form points back to the same noun.
Use this pronoun when talking about a non-human subject. Other forms change when showing ownership. One form can point back to that subject.
This word group may refer to an object or animal. One form acts as a subject or object. Other forms show possession or self-reference.

examples.en: Please choose one item from the menu.
examples.zh: 請從菜單中選一道餐點。

examples.en: Each item has a price tag.
examples.zh: 每件商品都有價格標籤。

examples.en: This item belongs in the top drawer.
examples.zh: 這個物品應該放在最上面的抽屜裡。

explains: This is one thing on a list or in a group. It may be a product for sale. People can count several of them.
Use this word for one object or point being discussed. A store may list goods for sale. A form may have one line for every entry.
This word names one object or detail. It can be part of a set. A shop may show its price and number.

examples.en: Do not forget to bring a light jacket.
examples.zh: 別忘了帶一件薄夾克。

examples.en: He zipped up his leather jacket as the wind grew stronger.
examples.zh: 隨著風勢變強，他拉上了皮夾克的拉鍊。

examples.en: It was cool in the evening, so I wore a denim jacket.
examples.zh: 傍晚天氣轉涼，所以我穿了一件牛仔夾克。

examples.en: Steel jacket foundations pinned with giant underwater piles support massive wind towers in typhoons.
examples.zh: 採用重型鋼結構四腳套管式水下基礎（Jacket）打入海床深處，能在強烈颱風中穩穩支撐百米風機。

examples.en: Fabricating a 2,000-tonne steel jacket requires precision welding standards certified by global maritime bureaus.
examples.zh: 在重工廠重件碼頭打造一座高達七十米、重達兩千噸的巨型套管水下基礎，需遵循最嚴苛的國際海事焊接規範。

examples.en: Marine engineers inspect the jacket legs with ultrasound scanners to verify weld structural integrity.
examples.zh: 海事檢驗工程師運用高階超音波探傷儀器仔細檢驗水下鋼構管件焊道，確認無任何肉眼看不見的應力裂縫。

examples.en: Four-legged steel jacket foundations provide earthquake-resistant stability in deep, choppy offshore waters.
examples.zh: 四腳鋼管桁架結構的套筒式水下基礎，在深水波濤與地震斷層帶展現卓越的抗震穩定性。

examples.en: The towering eighty-meter jacket was fabricated at a domestic heavy engineering shipyard in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 這座高達八十公尺的巨大鋼構套筒式水下基礎，由高雄興達港本土重造船廠自主焊接打造組裝。

examples.en: Subsea pin piles anchor the four corners of the jacket deep into the marine sediment.
examples.zh: 釘入海底岩層的水下插樁基樁，將套筒水下基礎的四個端角深沉牢固地錨定在海床深處。

entries.definition: 夾克；短外套；水下套管式水下基礎；夾克外套；四腳鋼構套筒式水下桁架基樁
explains: This is a short coat worn over a shirt. It usually covers the upper body and arms. A zipper or buttons may hold it closed.
People wear this garment when the weather is cool. It may have pockets. It is often shorter than a long coat.
This word names an outer garment with sleeves. It can be made of denim or leather. Someone may wear one over a shirt.

examples.en: Blue jeans are comfortable for everyday wear.
examples.zh: 藍色牛仔褲非常適合日常穿著。

examples.en: She wore a pair of classic blue jeans with sneakers.
examples.zh: 她穿著一條經典的藍色牛仔褲搭配運動鞋。

examples.en: These denim jeans are very durable and never go out of style.
examples.zh: 這條丹寧牛仔褲非常耐穿且永不退流行。

explains: These are strong trousers made from denim. They often have pockets and metal buttons. Many people wear them every day.
This clothing covers the legs. It may be blue, black, or another color. The fabric is thick and lasts a long time.
This word names casual pants made from sturdy cotton cloth. They can be worn at school or outdoors. They often have five pockets.

examples.en: Good job! Keep up the great effort.
examples.zh: 做得好！繼續保持這份努力。

examples.en: Finding a fulfilling job requires discovering what you truly enjoy doing.
examples.zh: 尋覓一份有成就感的工作需要發掘你真正喜愛做的事。

examples.en: He works two part-time jobs while completing his college degree.
examples.zh: 他在完成大學學業的同時兼了兩份打工差事。

explains: This is work a person does to earn money. It may be full time or part time. People may apply for one after school.
Use this word for a position or task at work. A person may have duties and a manager. It can also mean a small piece of work to finish.
This word names paid work. It may be at a store, office, or school. A person may need skills to do it.

examples.en: Would you like to join our school badminton club?
examples.zh: 你想加入我們學校的羽球社嗎？

examples.en: Thousands of passionate runners joined the Taipei International Marathon.
examples.zh: 數以千計熱情的跑者參加了台北國際馬拉松大賽。

examples.en: The new railway bridge will join the two coastal cities together.
examples.zh: 這座新的鐵路大橋將把兩座濱海城市緊密連結在一起。

explains: It means becoming part of a group or activity. It can also mean connecting two pieces. Friends may do this when they start a game.
Use this word when someone comes together with others. A road may connect another road. A person may sign up to take part.
This verb means taking part with a group. It can also describe linking two things. A person may do it at a meeting or event.

examples.en: He told a funny joke at lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐時講了一個有趣的笑話。

examples.en: Do not joke about someone’s feelings.
examples.zh: 不要拿別人的感受開玩笑。

examples.en: The joke made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 這個笑話讓大家都笑了。

explains: This is something said to make people laugh. It may be a short story with a funny ending. As a verb, it means speaking in a playful way.
People may tell this to friends during a meal. It can make others smile. The verb can mean making a light remark.
This word names a funny story or remark. It is meant to cause laughter. A person may tell one to cheer up a friend.

examples.en: Standing ovations and thunderous applause reflected the profound auditory joy shared by the audience.
examples.zh: 全場兩千名聽眾起立熱烈鼓掌喝采，洋溢著沉浸在天籟之音中的「純粹藝術喜悅」（Auditory Joy）。

examples.en: Grandparents watched with immense joy as their young grandchildren opened colorful holiday gifts.
examples.zh: 祖父母慈祥看著活潑可愛的小孫子們興高采烈拆開包裝精美的節慶禮物，眉宇間流露出無比溫暖欣慰的喜悅。

examples.en: Cultivating a beautiful garden and sharing fresh blossoms with neighbors brings her genuine daily joy.
examples.zh: 親手在陽台蒔花弄草悉心照料花木，並隨手將現剪芬芳鮮花分送左右鄰居，為她的退休生活帶來純粹真實的快樂。

examples.en: There is no greater happiness than the pure, radiant joy of understanding and being understood globally.
examples.zh: 世上再沒有比自由暢談世界、體會被全球理解與心靈相通更為燦爛純粹的「溝通喜悅」（Joy）。

examples.en: The room was filled with laughter and shared joy as families reunited for the Lunar New Year holiday.
examples.zh: 農曆新年佳節親友團聚的溫馨客廳裡洋溢著陣陣歡笑聲，流淌著無比真切溫暖的團聚喜悅。

examples.en: Discovering that you can read foreign literature without a dictionary brings immense intellectual joy.
examples.zh: 當你驚喜發現自己不需頻繁翻閱字典就能順暢閱讀外國文學作品時，心中湧現無比充盈的求知喜悅。

entries.definition: 兩千名觀眾同頻呼吸、熱淚盈眶之純粹藝術喜悅；喜悅；與世界自由暢談、聽懂彼此之純粹溝通喜悅
explains: This is a strong feeling of happiness. A person may feel it when meeting a loved one. It can also name great pleasure.
Use this word for deep happiness. A child may feel it on a special day. A kind act can bring this feeling.
This word names a happy feeling that is strong. It may come from success or time with family. People can share it with others.

examples.en: I love fresh orange juice with breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐喜歡配新鮮柳橙汁。

examples.en: Would you like apple juice or grape juice?
examples.zh: 你想要蘋果汁還是葡萄汁？

examples.en: Fresh watermelon juice is very refreshing on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 炎熱的夏天喝新鮮西瓜汁非常消暑解渴。

explains: This is liquid from fruit. People may drink it with breakfast. Oranges and apples can make it.
A person may squeeze fruit to get this drink. It can be sweet or sour. Some kinds have bits of fruit inside.
This word names a drink made from fruit. It may be served cold. People can pour it into a glass.

examples.en: The children jumped with joy when they heard the good news.
examples.zh: 小朋友們聽到好消息時高興得跳了起來。

examples.en: You can jump rope for ten minutes to boost your stamina.
examples.zh: 你可以跳繩十分鐘來增強體能耐力。

examples.en: The energetic frog jumped gracefully into the garden pond.
examples.zh: 那隻精力充沛的青蛙撲通一聲優雅地跳進了花園池塘。

explains: It means pushing off the ground and moving into the air. A child may do this over a puddle. It can also name the movement itself.
Use this word when both feet leave the ground. An athlete may do it to reach higher. The noun names one upward movement.
This verb means springing up with the body. It may help someone cross a small gap. The action can be quick or high.

examples.en: The train just arrived at platform two on time.
examples.zh: 火車剛好準時抵達第二月台。

examples.en: Just a moment, please; I will check your reservation in the system.
examples.zh: 請稍等片刻，我馬上在系統中為您確認訂房紀錄。

examples.en: A fair and just judge treats all citizens with equal dignity before the law.
examples.zh: 一位公正廉明的法官在法律面前以同等的尊嚴對待所有公民。

explains: It can mean only or simply. It may also show that something happened a short time ago. As an adjective, it can mean fair.
Use this word to make a statement smaller or more exact. It may tell that an event happened moments ago. It can also describe fair treatment.
This word can mean exactly or no more than something. It may point to a recent event. It can also mean treating people fairly.

examples.en: Please keep the door closed.
examples.zh: 請讓門保持關閉。

examples.en: She keeps her books on a small shelf.
examples.zh: 她把書放在小書架上。

examples.en: The farmer keeps chickens in the yard.
examples.zh: 農夫在院子裡養雞。

explains: This verb can mean to save something instead of giving it away. A child may put a special card in a box for many years. The child wants to have it for a long time.
This verb can also mean to continue doing something. A child may carry on trying a puzzle after making a mistake. The action continues instead of stopping.
As a noun, this can name a strong tower in an old castle. People could go there for safety during an attack. Its thick walls helped protect those inside.

examples.en: Don't forget your house key when leaving.
examples.zh: 出門時別忘了帶家裡的鑰匙。

examples.en: Consistency and patience are the key to learning a new language.
examples.zh: 持之以恆與耐心是學習一門新語言的關鍵所在。

examples.en: Insert the metal key into the keyhole and turn clockwise.
examples.zh: 將金屬鑰匙插入鎖孔並順時針旋轉。

explains: This can open a lock. It may also mean the most important part of an answer. As an adjective, it describes something necessary.
Use this metal object to open or close a lock. It may also mean the main idea that solves a problem. A map may show one central fact.
This word can name a tool for a lock. It can also mean the main part of a plan. A person may use it to explain what matters most.

examples.en: The boy kicked the ball into the goal.
examples.zh: 男孩把球踢進球門。

examples.en: She gave the door a gentle kick.
examples.zh: 她輕輕踢了一下門。

examples.en: The horse kicked up dust on the road.
examples.zh: 馬在路上踢起了灰塵。

explains: It means striking something with the foot. A player may send a ball across the field. It can also name the action itself.
Use this word when the foot hits or pushes something. A person may do this to a ball in a game. The noun can mean one such hit.
This verb describes hitting with a foot. A child may do it to move a ball. It can also mean a strong feeling or thrill.

examples.en: The kids played tag after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後玩鬼抓人。

examples.en: The kid asked many questions in class.
examples.zh: 那個小孩在課堂上問了很多問題。

examples.en: Do not kid your little sister.
examples.zh: 不要逗弄你的妹妹。

explains: This is an informal word for a child. It can also mean teasing someone. Adults may use it when speaking kindly.
People sometimes use this casual word for a young person. The verb may mean making fun of someone. The tone helps show which meaning is meant.
This word can name a child or young person. It may also mean joking with someone. Friends may use it in a playful way.

examples.en: The hunter killed the snake to keep everyone safe.
examples.zh: 獵人殺死了那條蛇，確保大家安全。

examples.en: The storm killed many small plants.
examples.zh: 暴風雨摧毀了許多小植物。

examples.en: The police worked to prevent the killing of animals.
examples.zh: 警方努力防止動物遭到殺害。

explains: It means causing a living thing to stop living. It is a serious action. Stories may use it when a character causes another’s death.
Use this word for causing death. It may describe a person, animal, or plant. People should treat all living things with care.
This verb means ending the life of a person or animal. A dangerous accident may do this. The noun can name a strong desire to succeed.

examples.en: It is very kind of you to help me with the luggage.
examples.zh: 你幫我搬行李真是太好心了。

examples.en: What kind of music do you like listening to while working?
examples.zh: 你工作時喜歡聽哪種類型的音樂？

examples.en: She has a kind heart and frequently volunteers at the shelter.
examples.zh: 她有一顆善良的心，經常在收容所擔任志工。

explains: It can describe someone who treats others gently. It can also name one type or group of things. The sentence shows which meaning fits.
Use this word for a person who is helpful and warm. It may also mean a sort of thing. A teacher can show this quality through patient actions.
This word may mean friendly and caring. It can also name a type or class. People often value this quality in a friend.

examples.en: The king wore a golden crown.
examples.zh: 國王戴著金色王冠。

examples.en: The king spoke to the people in the square.
examples.zh: 國王在廣場上對人民說話。

examples.en: The white king is on the chessboard.
examples.zh: 白王在棋盤上。

explains: This is a male ruler of a country or people. He may live in a palace. A queen is a female ruler with a similar role.
A country may once have been ruled by this man. He may wear a crown. In a chess game, one important piece has this name.
This word names a man with the highest royal rank. Stories may show him ruling a land. A crown is a common sign of his role.

examples.en: She gave her mother a kiss on the cheek.
examples.zh: 她親吻了媽媽的臉頰。

examples.en: The child kissed the puppy gently.
examples.zh: 孩子輕輕親了小狗。

examples.en: He blew a kiss to his family.
examples.zh: 他向家人飛吻。

explains: This is a gentle touch of the lips that shows love or care. People may give one to a family member. It can also mean touching someone this way.
People may do this to greet or show affection. It is often given on the cheek. The noun names one such act.
This word can mean pressing the lips gently against someone or something. Parents may do this to a child. It can show love or respect.

examples.en: Dad is making soup in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在廚房煮湯。

examples.en: Wipe the kitchen counter clean after cooking meals.
examples.zh: 做完飯後請把廚房流理台擦拭乾淨。

examples.en: Delicious baking smells drifted out from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡飄出了誘人的烘焙香氣。

explains: This is a room where people prepare food. It usually has a sink and stove. Families keep dishes and cooking tools there.
A home often has this room for cooking. People may store food in cupboards. A table or counter gives space to work.
This word names the part of a home used for making meals. It may have a refrigerator and oven. People wash dishes there.

examples.en: Flying kites at the seaside park is fun on windy days.
examples.zh: 在風大的日子去海邊公園放風箏很有趣。

examples.en: The colorful dragon kite soared high up in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的長龍風箏在蔚藍的天空中高高翱翔。

examples.en: The boy held the kite string tightly as the gust blew.
examples.zh: 強風吹來時小男孩緊緊抓著風箏線。

explains: This is a light frame covered with paper or cloth. Wind lifts it into the sky on a string. Children may fly one in a park.
People run while holding a string to send this object up. It may have a diamond shape. A strong breeze helps it stay high.
This word names a toy that flies in the wind. A long string connects it to the person holding it. It may have a tail.

examples.en: He hurt his knee while playing soccer.
examples.zh: 他踢足球時弄傷了膝蓋。

examples.en: She knelt on one knee to tie her shoe.
examples.zh: 她單膝跪下綁鞋帶。

examples.en: The doctor examined my knee.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了我的膝蓋。

explains: This is the joint in the middle of a leg. It bends when a person walks or sits. A child may scrape it after a fall.
People bend this part to kneel. It connects the upper and lower parts of a leg. A doctor may examine it when someone feels pain.
This word names a leg joint. It helps a person bend and move. A cushion may protect it while someone kneels.

examples.en: Be careful! That kitchen knife is very sharp.
examples.zh: 小心！那把菜刀非常鋒利。

examples.en: Use a butter knife to spread peanut butter on toast.
examples.zh: 用奶油刀將花生醬抹在吐司上。

examples.en: Keep sharp knives out of reach of young children.
examples.zh: 把鋒利的刀具收在幼童碰不到的地方。

explains: This is a sharp tool used for cutting food. It usually has a handle and a metal edge. People should use it carefully.
A cook may use this tool to slice fruit or bread. The edge is sharp. A safe holder can protect the blade.
This word names a common cutting tool. It may be used at a table or in a kitchen. The handle keeps hands away from the sharp part.

examples.en: Someone knocked on the front door.
examples.zh: 有人敲了前門。

examples.en: There was a knock at the window.
examples.zh: 窗戶上傳來敲擊聲。

examples.en: He knocked over the cup by accident.
examples.zh: 他不小心把杯子撞倒了。

explains: It means hitting a door with the hand. A visitor may do this before entering. It can also name the sound made.
Use this word when someone taps on a door to get attention. It may be done with fingers or a tool. The noun means one such sound.
This action makes a short sound on a door or hard surface. People do it to let someone know they are there. It can also mean striking or criticizing.

examples.en: Do you know where the nearest post office is?
examples.zh: 你知道最近的郵局在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: I have known my best friend since kindergarten.
examples.zh: 我從小學幼兒園就認識了我最好的朋友。

examples.en: The more you read, the more you will know about the world.
examples.zh: 閱讀得越多，你對這個世界的認識就越豐富。

explains: It means having information in the mind. A person may understand a friend well. Learning and practice help build this ability.
Use this word when someone understands a fact or person. A student may learn new information in class. It can also mean being familiar with someone.
This verb tells that a person has learned something. It may describe understanding how a tool works. A person can also recognize someone from before.

examples.en: Reading good books enriches our minds and broadens our knowledge.
examples.zh: 閱讀好書能豐富我們的心靈並拓寬我們的知識見聞。

examples.en: Practical hands-on experience transforms textbook theory into applicable real-world knowledge.
examples.zh: 實務操作經驗能將教科書理論轉化為切實可行的實務知識。

examples.en: To the best of my knowledge, the project deadline has not been altered.
examples.zh: 據我所知，該專案的最後截止期限並未遭到任何修改變動。

explains: This is information learned through study or experience. It may help someone solve a problem. Books and teachers can share it.
People gain this through reading, practice, or listening. It helps them understand the world. A person may share what they have learned.
This word names facts and ideas someone has learned. It may come from school or daily life. A lot of it can help with a task.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is a famous scenic spot in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 日月潭是台灣著名的觀光景點。

examples.en: We rented a paddle boat and glided peacefully across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘腳踏船，在寧靜的湖面上悠閒泛舟。

examples.en: Mist covered the surface of the mountain lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨拂曉時分，薄霧輕籠著高山湖泊的湖面。

explains: This is a large area of water surrounded by land. It may be deep or shallow. Fish and plants live there.
People may swim or boat on this body of water. It is not as large as the sea. A river may flow into one.
This word names water held within land. It may be natural or made by people. Ducks often swim on it.

examples.en: I turned on the desk lamp to read my book.
examples.zh: 我打開檯燈閱讀我的書。

examples.en: The warm yellow lamp created a peaceful ambiance in the study.
examples.zh: 溫暖的黃色燈光在書房營造了祥和寧靜的氛圍。

examples.en: Remember to switch off your bedside reading lamp before falling asleep.
examples.zh: 入睡前記得關閉床頭閱讀燈。

explains: This is a device that gives light. It may sit on a desk or hang from a ceiling. A switch turns it on and off.
People use this object to brighten a dark room. It may have a shade around the bulb. A bedside one helps someone read.
This word names a light-making object. It may stand on a table or be fixed to a wall. It uses a bulb or other source.

examples.en: The plane landed smoothly on the runway.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩降落在跑道上。

examples.en: The farmer owns fertile agricultural land suitable for growing organic tea.
examples.zh: 這位農夫擁有適合種植有機茶葉的肥沃農地。

examples.en: After weeks sailing on rough seas, the sailors were overjoyed to see land.
examples.zh: 在波濤洶湧的大海上航行數週後，水手們看到陸地時欣喜若狂。

explains: It can mean the solid part of the Earth. It may also mean coming down from the air onto a surface. A plane does this after a flight.
Use this word for soil or a part of the world that is not covered by water. A bird may come down on a branch. A pilot brings a plane safely to the ground.
This word can name dry ground or a country. As a verb, it means coming down from the air. A person may own a piece of it.

examples.en: She speaks three languages.
examples.zh: 她會說三種語言。

examples.en: English is the language we use in class.
examples.zh: 英語是我們在課堂上使用的語言。

examples.en: Body language can show how someone feels.
examples.zh: 肢體語言可以表達一個人的感受。

explains: This is a system of words people use to speak or write. It may have its own sounds and rules. People can learn more than one.
A community shares this way of speaking. It helps people share ideas. English, Spanish, and Mandarin are examples.
This word names a way people communicate. It includes spoken words, writing, and signs. Different places may use different systems.

examples.en: They live in a large house near the park.
examples.zh: 他們住在公園附近一棟大房子裡。

examples.en: A large crowd gathered for the game.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚集來看比賽。

examples.en: The elephant has large ears.
examples.zh: 大象有大大的耳朵。

explains: It describes something with a lot of space or a very big size. A family may live in a home with many rooms. It can also describe a number.
Use this word for something bigger than average. A tree may spread wide branches. A group may have many members.
This word means bigger in size or amount. It can describe a room or a crowd. It may also mean important.

examples.en: This was the last cookie in the box.
examples.zh: 這是盒子裡最後一塊餅乾。

examples.en: The meeting lasted for two hours.
examples.zh: 會議持續了兩個小時。

examples.en: The old shoes will last another year.
examples.zh: 這雙舊鞋還能再穿一年。

explains: It can mean the final one in a series. It may also mean continuing for a time. As a verb, it can mean managing to remain.
Use this word for something that comes at the end. A show may continue for two hours. A person may make supplies stay for a trip.
This word can point to the final part. It can describe how long something continues. As a verb, it may mean surviving a difficult time.

examples.en: Don't be late for the meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天開會千萬不要遲到。

examples.en: Staying up late harms your immune system and concentration.
examples.zh: 熬夜會損害你的免疫系統與專注力。

examples.en: She apologized sincerely for arriving late due to MRT delays.
examples.zh: 她因捷運延誤而遲到，誠懇地向大家致歉。

explains: It describes arriving after the planned time. A bus may not arrive on time. As an adverb, it can mean after the expected hour.
Use this word when someone is not on time. A student may arrive after class starts. It can also mean doing something near the end of a period.
This word tells that an event happens later than planned. A person may miss the first part of a show. It can also describe something that is no longer alive or active.

examples.en: I will see you later today.
examples.zh: 我今天晚一點會見到你。

examples.en: She arrived later than her brother.
examples.zh: 她比哥哥晚到。

examples.en: Let us talk later.
examples.zh: 我們晚點再談。

explains: It means at a time after now. A person may say they will return after finishing a task. It can also be a friendly way to say goodbye.
This word tells that something will happen afterward. It can follow a number of minutes or hours. People may use it in a casual farewell.
This word tells that something will happen at a time after now. It can follow a number of minutes or hours. People may use it in a casual farewell.

examples.en: The hilarious sitcom made the entire class laugh.
examples.zh: 這部搞笑情境喜劇逗得全班哄堂大笑。

examples.en: It feels wonderful to sit together and laugh with lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 和相交一生的摯友圍坐在一起開懷大笑感覺無比美好。

examples.en: Laughter is often described as the best medicine for relieving daily stress.
examples.zh: 笑聲常被譽為緩解日常壓力的最佳良藥。

explains: It means making a happy sound when something is funny. People may do it at a joke. The noun can name the sound itself.
Use this word when someone finds a story amusing. A silly face may make a child do it. It can also mean making fun of someone.
This action shows happiness or amusement. A joke may cause it. The noun names the sound people make.

examples.en: You should consult a qualified lawyer before signing contracts.
examples.zh: 簽署合約前應諮詢合格的律師。

examples.en: The defense lawyer presented compelling evidence that proved the client's innocence.
examples.zh: 辯護律師提出了極具說服力的確鑿證據，證明了當事人的清白。

examples.en: Passing the bar exam to become a licensed practicing lawyer requires years of dedication.
examples.zh: 通過司法官律師高考成為執業律師需要付出多年的辛勤苦讀。

explains: This is a person trained to understand rules and help with legal problems. They may speak for someone in court. They can also prepare legal papers.
Someone with this job gives advice about laws. A client may ask for help with a court case. The worker studies rules carefully.
This word names a legal professional. They may speak for a person before a judge. They can explain rights and prepare documents.

examples.en: Don't be lazy; get up and do morning exercises.
examples.zh: 別偷懶了，起床做早操吧。

examples.en: We spent a lazy Sunday afternoon lounging on the beach reading books.
examples.zh: 我們在海灘上悠閒放鬆地看書，度過了一個慵懶的週日下午。

examples.en: A lazy attitude toward studying will hinder your long-term personal growth.
examples.zh: 對學業抱持懶散的態度會阻礙你長遠的個人成長。

explains: It describes someone who does not want to work or move much. A person may delay chores. The word can also describe a slow day.
Use this word for someone who avoids effort. They may choose to rest instead of doing a task. Too much of this behavior can cause problems.
This word tells that someone is unwilling to work hard. A student may put off studying. A slow animal may seem to move very little.

examples.en: The teacher will lead our class on the trip.
examples.zh: 老師會帶領我們班出遊。

examples.en: Our team has a one-point lead.
examples.zh: 我們隊領先一分。

examples.en: The old pipe contains lead.
examples.zh: 那根舊管子含有鉛。

explains: It means showing others where to go. A person may guide a team. It can also name the top position or a soft metal.
Use this word when guiding a group or action. A runner may be ahead of others. It can also name a heavy metal used in old pipes.
This verb means guiding people toward a goal. The noun may mean the first place in a contest. It can also name a soft, heavy metal.

examples.en: She is the team leader for our science project.
examples.zh: 她是我們自然科學專題的小組隊長。

examples.en: A visionary leader inspires colleagues to innovate, persevere, and excel.
examples.zh: 一位富有遠見的領袖能激勵同仁勇於創新、堅持不懈並追求卓越。

examples.en: Taiwan is recognized as a global industry leader in cutting-edge microchips.
examples.zh: 台灣被公認為尖端晶片製造領域的全球產業領頭羊。

explains: This is a person who guides a group. They may help others make a plan. People often look to them for direction.
A team may choose someone to organize its work. The person listens and helps everyone move toward a goal. Good ones take responsibility.
This word names a person who shows others what to do. They may guide a club or country. Others may trust their decisions.

examples.en: Children learn languages very quickly.
examples.zh: 小孩學習語言非常快。

examples.en: We can learn valuable lessons from our past mistakes.
examples.zh: 我們能從過去的錯誤中學到寶貴的經驗。

examples.en: She wants to learn how to play the classical guitar this summer.
examples.zh: 她想在今年夏天學習彈奏古典吉他。

explains: It means gaining information or a new skill. A student may practice a language. Books, teachers, and mistakes can all help.
Use this word when someone gains new knowledge. A person may watch and try a task. Practice can make the skill stronger.
This verb tells that someone is gaining an ability. It may happen through reading or practice. A person can gain skill from errors.

examples.en: At least ten students joined the club.
examples.zh: 至少有十位學生加入社團。

examples.en: This is the least expensive choice.
examples.zh: 這是最便宜的選擇。

examples.en: He ate the least of all the children.
examples.zh: 他在所有孩子中吃得最少。

explains: It means the smallest amount or degree. One person may have less of something than the others. It can also mean at the very smallest level.
Use this word to compare amounts. A short task may need the smallest amount of time. It can also mean at minimum.
This word points to the lowest amount among choices. It may describe the smallest number. It can also show the minimum that is needed.

examples.en: The train will leave the platform in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在十分鐘後駛離月台。

examples.en: Never leave young children unattended in a parked car.
examples.zh: 切勿將年幼孩童單獨留在停放的汽車內。

examples.en: She applied for three days of annual leave to attend a family wedding.
examples.zh: 她請了三天年假去參加親戚的家族婚禮。

examples.en: Employees enjoy thirty days of fully paid annual leave and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
examples.zh: 全體正職員工享有每年三十天全薪特休年假以及涵蓋配偶子女的高規格全球頂級商業醫療保險。

examples.en: New parents are entitled to flexible parental leave under progressive company wellness policies.
examples.zh: 該前瞻科技外商制定了友善家庭福利政策，讓新手爸媽皆能享有彈性靈活的有薪育嬰留職停薪假期。

examples.en: Remember to set up an automated out-of-office email notification before taking annual leave.
examples.zh: 在正式休年假展開充電渡假之前，切記務必在公司信箱設定好自動回覆的「休假外出」提醒信。

entries.definition: 離開；留下；休假；特別休假 (特休)；請假
explains: It means going away from a place. It can also mean keeping something behind. As a noun, it may name time off work.
Use this word when someone departs. A person may also place an item somewhere and not take it. A worker may take a day away from work.
This verb can mean departing or allowing something to remain. It can describe a person going out. The noun may mean permission to be away from work.

examples.en: Turn left at the next traffic light.
examples.zh: 在下一個紅綠燈路口左轉。

examples.en: The post office is on the left side of the street.
examples.zh: 郵局位於街道的左手邊。

examples.en: She left her umbrella on the bus by mistake this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上不小心把雨傘遺落在公車上了。

explains: It means the side opposite right. It may also mean remaining after others are gone. As a verb form, it can describe someone who went away.
Use this word for the direction toward the west when facing north. It can also mean what remains. A person may turn that way at a road.
This word names one side of a pair of directions. It can also mean still present after others have gone. Context shows the sense.

examples.en: My legs feel tired after climbing the stairs.
examples.zh: 爬完樓梯後我的雙腿感到很痠。

examples.en: He stretched his legs during the long flight to relax.
examples.zh: 在長途飛行途中他伸展雙腿以放鬆身心。

examples.en: Flamingos often stand on one slender leg in shallow water.
examples.zh: 紅鶴在淺水中經常單腿獨立。

explains: This is the body part between the hip and foot. People use two of them to stand and walk. It can also be one section of a trip or race.
A person bends this body part to run or climb. Trousers cover it. A long journey may be split into parts with the same name.
This word names a part of the body used for walking. A table may also have a support with this name. A trip may have one stage called this.

examples.en: Squeeze a slice of fresh lemon into your iced tea.
examples.zh: 擠一片新鮮檸檬到冰茶裡面。

examples.en: Hot honey lemon water is wonderful for soothing a cough.
examples.zh: 熱蜂蜜檸檬水對舒緩咳嗽很有效果。

examples.en: Lemons have a naturally sour taste but add vibrant freshness to cooking.
examples.zh: 檸檬天生帶有酸味，卻能為料理增添鮮明清爽的風味。

explains: This is a yellow fruit with a sour taste. People squeeze its juice into food or drinks. It has a strong fresh smell.
The fruit has a thick yellow skin. Its juice may flavor water or fish. A slice can be added to tea.
This word names a sour citrus fruit. It may grow on a small tree. People use its juice in cooking.

examples.en: We need less sugar in the tea.
examples.zh: 我們的茶需要少放一點糖。

examples.en: She spends less time watching television.
examples.zh: 她花比較少時間看電視。

examples.en: There is less water in the bottle now.
examples.zh: 現在瓶子裡的水比較少。

explains: It means a smaller amount. A person may eat a smaller piece of cake. It can compare two things or describe not as much.
Use this word when one amount is lower than another. A short walk may take a smaller amount of time. It often compares things.
This word points to a reduced amount or degree. It can describe something not as great. A person may want a smaller serving.

examples.en: Today's lesson is about environmental protection.
examples.zh: 今天的課是有關環境保護。

examples.en: We learned a valuable lesson about team cooperation during the robotics contest.
examples.zh: 我們在機器人競賽中學到了團隊合作的寶貴一課。

examples.en: She takes private piano lessons every Tuesday after school.
examples.zh: 她每週二放學後都會去上私人鋼琴課。

explains: This is a period of teaching or learning. A teacher may explain a subject to students. It can also mean advice learned from an event.
Students may attend this at school. It can last for an hour. A hard mistake may teach someone a useful truth.
This word names a class or a piece of instruction. It may help a person gain a skill. It can also mean a helpful message learned through experience.

examples.en: Let us know if you need any assistance.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何協助，請告訴我們。

examples.en: Let me see the map before we decide which route to take.
examples.zh: 在我們決定走哪條路線之前，先讓我看一下地圖。

examples.en: Don't let minor setbacks discourage you from pursuing your goal.
examples.zh: 別讓一時的小挫折阻止你追求自己的目標。

explains: It means allowing someone to do something. A parent may give permission to play outside. It can also mean renting a place or object.
Use this word when giving someone permission. A rule may allow a person to enter. The noun can mean money paid to use land or a home.
This verb means allowing an action to happen. A teacher may allow students to ask questions. It can also mean renting out a room.

examples.en: Write a thank-you letter to your teacher.
examples.zh: 寫一封感謝信給你的老師。

examples.en: The English alphabet consists of twenty-six letters.
examples.zh: 英文字母由二十六個字母組成。

examples.en: My grandmother still enjoys writing handwritten letters to her childhood pen pals.
examples.zh: 我奶奶仍然喜歡親筆寫信給她兒時的筆友。

examples.en: She wrote a heartfelt thank-you letter to her English teacher.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封真摯的感謝信給她的英文老師。

examples.en: There are twenty-six letters in the modern English alphabet.
examples.zh: 現代英文字母表一共有二十六個字母。

examples.en: Follow the instructions to the letter to achieve the best results.
examples.zh: 嚴格絲毫不差地遵循指示說明，以獲得最佳成果。

explains: This can be a written message sent to someone. It can also be one symbol in an alphabet. A card may contain several.
People send this paper message through the mail. It may carry news or thanks. A single sign such as A or B has the same name.
This word can name a written note sent to another person. It can also mean a character used to spell words. The context tells which meaning fits.

examples.en: The water reached the same level on both sides.
examples.zh: 兩邊的水面高度相同。

examples.en: This game has three difficulty levels.
examples.zh: 這個遊戲有三個難度等級。

examples.en: The table is level with the window.
examples.zh: 桌子和窗戶一樣高。

explains: This is a height or position compared with others. It may also mean a stage of skill. A floor can be even and flat.
Use this word for a point on a scale. A player may move up to a harder stage. The surface may be flat from side to side.
This word names a position or degree. It may describe how hard a game is. As an adjective, it can mean even or flat.

examples.en: You must remain quiet in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館內必須保持安靜。

examples.en: I borrowed three English storybooks from the municipal library.
examples.zh: 我從市立圖書館借了三本英文故事書。

examples.en: The university library stays open late during exam week.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館在考試週期間會延長開放至深夜。

explains: This is a place where people borrow books. It may also have computers and quiet study areas. A worker helps visitors find what they need.
People visit this building to read or borrow books. They may return items by a set date. Students often study there.
This word names a public place for books and learning. A person can read inside. Many let people take books home for a time.

examples.en: The dog likes to lie in the sun.
examples.zh: 狗喜歡躺在陽光下。

examples.en: Do not lie about what happened.
examples.zh: 不要對發生的事說謊。

examples.en: The book lies on the table.
examples.zh: 書放在桌上。

explains: It can mean saying something that is not true. It can also mean resting with the body flat. The sentence makes the meaning clear.
Use this word for a false statement. It may also describe a person resting on a bed or the ground. Tone and context show which use is intended.
This word has two meanings: telling an untrue story or resting in a flat position. A person may do the first to avoid trouble. A tired person may do the second.

examples.en: She saved a life by calling for help.
examples.zh: 她打電話求助，救了一條命。

examples.en: Life in the village is quiet.
examples.zh: 村裡的生活很平靜。

examples.en: Plants need water for life.
examples.zh: 植物需要水才能生存。

explains: This can mean the time between birth and death. A tree may grow for hundreds of years. A tiny insect may exist for a much shorter time.
Use this word for the period from birth until death. It may also describe someone’s daily way of living. People may tell stories from their own experiences.
This word names being alive. It can mean a person’s time on Earth. It may also describe the choices and activities that fill that time.

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請隨手關燈。

examples.en: The morning sunlight illuminated the entire classroom.
examples.zh: 晨曦的陽光照亮了整間教室。

examples.en: Pack a light backpack when going on a day hike.
examples.zh: 一日健行出發時，請準備輕便的隨身背包。

examples.en: Carry a light jacket in case the weather turns cool.
examples.zh: 帶件薄夾克以防天氣轉涼。

examples.en: She prefers a light breakfast like yogurt and sliced fruit.
examples.zh: 她偏好清淡簡單的早餐，例如優格和切片水果。

examples.en: This aluminum laptop is exceptionally light and portable.
examples.zh: 這款鋁合金筆記型電腦格外輕巧便攜。

examples.en: Aluminum is a durable and very light metal.
examples.zh: 鋁是一種耐用且非常輕盈的金屬。

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the bedroom window, illuminating the wooden desk.
examples.zh: 陽光透過臥室窗戶灑落進來，照亮了質樸的木製書桌。

examples.en: Pack light when traveling so you can walk comfortably between city transit lines.
examples.zh: 旅行時請輕裝簡行，這樣在城市各交通轉運路線之間移動才會輕鬆自如。

examples.en: Forensic science shines an unwavering light into the darkest shadows of crime, bringing hidden facts into the open.
examples.zh: 鑑識科學宛如一柄永不熄滅的正義之光，穿透罪惡最深沉的黑暗陰影，讓真相大白於天下。

examples.en: Each recovered fingerprint and DNA match serves as a beacon of light piercing through criminal deception.
examples.zh: 每一枚被顯影比對出的指紋與每一次 DNA 吻合，皆如刺破犯罪謊言與偽裝欺騙的璀璨希望之光。

examples.en: The relentless search for evidence ensures that the light of truth prevails over the cover-ups of corruption.
examples.zh: 對物證永不停歇的客觀鑑識與追尋，確保了真理正義之光終將徹底驅散官商勾結與毀屍滅證的暗黑陰霾。

entries.definition: 光線；燈；明亮的；點燃；輕的；淺色的；輕盈的；鑑識科學之光驅散黑暗照亮司法正義
explains: This is what lets people see in a dark room. It may also name a lamp or a pale shade. As a verb, it can mean setting something on fire.
Use this word for brightness from the sun or a bulb. It can describe something that does not weigh much. A match may help a person start a flame.
This word may mean brightness or a source of brightness. It can describe a pale color or a small weight. As an action, it means making a flame start.

examples.en: I like milk tea with less sugar and no ice.
examples.zh: 我喜歡微糖去冰的奶茶。

examples.en: He looks just like his father when he smiles.
examples.zh: 他微笑時看起來就像他父親一樣。

examples.en: What would you like to have for dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃點什麼呢？

examples.en: Don't forget to hit like and subscribe to our channel!
examples.zh: 別忘了按讚並訂閱我們的頻道！

examples.en: Her latest travel photo album garnered thousands of likes within an hour.
examples.zh: 她最新的旅行相簿在一小時內就收穫了數千個讚。

examples.en: Like his father, he has a profound passion for classical literature.
examples.zh: 就像他的父親一樣，他對古典文學懷抱著無比深沉的熱情。

explains: It means enjoying or preferring something. It can also compare two things that are similar. A small symbol may show that someone approves of a post.
Use this word to say what someone enjoys. It may show that two things are similar. Online, it can mean pressing a symbol to show approval.
This word can name a preference. It may also mean similar to another thing. The noun can be an approval mark on a website.

examples.en: Please wait in line behind the yellow line.
examples.zh: 請在黃線後方依序排隊等候。

examples.en: Draw a straight line across the paper using a plastic ruler.
examples.zh: 用塑膠直尺在紙上畫出一條直線。

examples.en: Remember to rehearse your spoken lines before tomorrow's drama rehearsal.
examples.zh: 在明天的戲劇排練前，記得熟記你的台詞。

explains: This is a long narrow mark. People may wait in an ordered row. As a verb, it can mean waiting in such a row.
A straight mark may be drawn on paper. It can also mean a row of people waiting. The verb means forming such a row.
This word can name a mark from one point to another. It may be a sentence in a song. People can wait one behind another.

examples.en: The lion is often called the king of the jungle.
examples.zh: 獅子常被稱為萬獸之王。

examples.en: A pride of lions rested quietly under the shade of an acacia tree.
examples.zh: 一群獅子在金合歡樹蔭下安靜休息。

examples.en: He showed lionhearted courage when facing the sudden emergency.
examples.zh: 面對突如其來的緊急狀況，他展現了雄獅般的勇氣。

explains: This is a large wild cat with tawny fur. A male often has a thick mane. It is sometimes called the king of the animals.
The animal lives in groups called prides. It has strong legs and sharp teeth. Its loud roar can be heard far away.
This word names a powerful animal from Africa and Asia. The male has long hair around its head. It hunts for food with its group.

examples.en: Her lips were dry in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 寒風中她的嘴唇很乾。

examples.en: He smiled and pressed his lips together.
examples.zh: 他微笑著抿起嘴唇。

examples.en: The baby had a little milk on her lip.
examples.zh: 寶寶的嘴唇上沾了一點牛奶。

explains: These are the soft parts around the mouth. People use them to speak, eat, and smile. A balm can keep them from drying.
A person has an upper and lower one around the mouth. They help form sounds. A smile may turn them upward.
This word names the outer edge of the mouth. It may be red or pink. People can press them together when thinking.

examples.en: Write a list of things to buy.
examples.zh: 寫一張購物清單。

examples.en: The teacher listed the books for summer reading.
examples.zh: 老師列出了暑假閱讀書單。

examples.en: Please check your name on the list.
examples.zh: 請在名單上確認你的名字。

explains: This is a set of names or things written one after another. A shopper may write items to buy. As a verb, it means naming things one by one.
People use this to remember tasks. It may be written on paper or kept on a phone. The verb means giving names or details in order.
This word names an ordered set of items. A student may write one for a project. As an action, it means stating items in order.

examples.en: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
examples.zh: 請仔細聆聽說明。

examples.en: I like to listen to classical piano music while studying.
examples.zh: 讀書時我喜歡聽古典鋼琴音樂。

examples.en: You should always listen to your parents' sincere advice.
examples.zh: 你應該始終傾聽父母誠懇的建議。

explains: It means paying attention to sounds. A student may focus on a teacher’s words. People can do this to music or a story.
Use this word when someone tries to hear carefully. A person may focus on a friend’s story. It can show respect and care.
This verb means giving attention to sounds. People may do it while learning or relaxing. A good listener does not interrupt.

examples.en: Add a little sugar to the coffee.
examples.zh: 在咖啡裡加一點點糖。

examples.en: A little boy was feeding the ducks by the pond.
examples.zh: 一個小男孩正在池塘邊餵鴨子。

examples.en: She had little patience for rude behavior.
examples.zh: 她對無禮的行為幾乎毫無耐心。

explains: It means small in size or amount. A child may have a small toy. As a noun, it can mean a short time or a small amount.
Use this word for something not large. It can describe a young child. It may also name a small amount of food or time.
This word tells that something is small. It may describe size or amount. People may use it warmly for a young person.

examples.en: I live with my family in Kaohsiung City.
examples.zh: 我和家人住在高雄市。

examples.en: Marine creatures live in deep coral reef ecosystems.
examples.zh: 海洋生物棲息在深海珊瑚礁生態系中。

examples.en: Millions of viewers watched the live broadcast of the sports finals.
examples.zh: 數百萬觀眾收看了這場體育決賽的現場直播。

explains: This verb means to have your home in a place. You might have your home in a town near the sea. You eat, sleep, and spend much of your time there.
Use this word when talking about where someone has a home. A music show may be happening before an audience right now. The adjective can describe that kind of show.
This verb means having a home in a place. It can also mean being alive. As an adjective, it describes a broadcast or show happening now.

examples.en: Call your grandparents so they won't feel lonely.
examples.zh: 打通電話給祖父母，讓他們不會感到孤單。

examples.en: Moving to a bustling foreign city alone can feel quite lonely at first.
examples.zh: 隻身搬遷到繁華的異國城市起初可能會感到相當孤寂寂寞。

examples.en: Adopting a rescue dog helped heal her lonely heart after moving away.
examples.zh: 在搬家後，領養一隻流浪搜救犬撫平了她孤獨寂寞的心靈。

explains: It describes someone who feels sad because they are alone. A person may miss friends after moving to a new town. A visit can help them feel better.
Use this word for someone who wants company. A child may feel this way on a quiet day. Talking with a friend can bring comfort.
This word tells that someone feels alone or left out. A person may wish for someone to talk with. Kind company may help.

examples.en: We have a long summer vacation in July and August.
examples.zh: 我們在七八月有漫長的暑假。

examples.en: The Great Wall of China stretches across a remarkably long distance.
examples.zh: 中國萬里長城綿延極其漫長的距離。

examples.en: After months of lockdown, everyone longed for outdoor freedom.
examples.zh: 經過數月的封閉生活，大家都渴望戶外的自由自在。

explains: It can describe a great distance from one end to another. It may also describe time that lasts many hours. As a verb, it can mean wishing strongly for something.
Use this word for something with much length. It can describe a speech that takes much time. A person may strongly desire a place or friend.
This word can mean having great length or lasting a while. It may describe a road or wait. As an action, it means wanting something deeply.

examples.en: Look at the beautiful rainbow in the sky!
examples.zh: 快看天上美麗的彩虹！

examples.en: She looks very elegant in her traditional festival costume.
examples.zh: 她穿著傳統節慶服裝看起來十分優雅。

examples.en: Can you help me look for my lost bus card?
examples.zh: 你能幫我找一下我遺失的公車卡嗎？

explains: It means using the eyes to see. It can also mean seeming a certain way. As a noun, it can name someone’s appearance.
Use this word when directing the eyes toward something. It can describe how a person seems. The noun may mean a style or appearance.
This verb means seeing or watching. It may also mean seeming to be a certain way. A person’s face or style can be described with the noun.

examples.en: Don't lose hope even if you fail this time.
examples.zh: 即使這次失敗了，也千萬不要失去希望。

examples.en: Be careful not to lose your passport while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊時千萬要小心別遺失了護照。

examples.en: Our basketball team fought hard and did not want to lose the final match.
examples.zh: 我們的籃球隊奮力拚搏，不想輸掉這場決賽。

explains: It means no longer having something. A person may leave a toy on a bus. It can also mean not winning a game.
Use this word when an item cannot be found. A team may not win a contest. It can describe wasting time or a chance.
This verb tells that something is gone or no longer owned. A player may fail to win. A person may also become confused in a place.

examples.en: We parked in a lot near the museum.
examples.zh: 我們把車停在博物館附近的停車場。

examples.en: A lot of people came to the show.
examples.zh: 很多人來看這場表演。

examples.en: They bought a lot beside the river.
examples.zh: 他們買了河邊的一塊地。

explains: This can mean a large amount of something. It can also name a piece of land for sale. A person may have many tasks to do.
Use this word for a great number or amount. It may also mean a marked piece of property. The sentence gives the meaning.
This word can describe many items or much time. It may name an area of land. A person may say they have several things to finish.

examples.en: The music was too loud for the baby.
examples.zh: 音樂聲對寶寶來說太大了。

examples.en: Please speak loud enough for everyone to hear.
examples.zh: 請把聲音說大一點，讓大家都聽得見。

examples.en: The loud thunder woke me up.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲把我吵醒了。

explains: It describes a sound that is easy to hear from far away. Music at a party may be this way. A person may speak this way in a crowd.
Use this word for a sound with much strength. A bell may ring this way. It can also describe a color that looks strong and clear.
This word tells that a sound has high volume. A voice may rise above other sounds. A busy street can seem this way.

examples.en: I love traveling around Taiwan by train.
examples.zh: 我喜歡搭火車環島旅行。

examples.en: Parents show unconditional love to their growing children.
examples.zh: 父母對成長中的孩子展現了無條件的愛。

examples.en: They fell in love during their college volunteer program.
examples.zh: 他們在大學志工服務活動中相戀了。

explains: It means caring for someone very much. People may show it with kind words or actions. As a noun, it names the feeling.
Use this word when someone has deep affection. Parents may feel this for their children. The noun can also name a favorite activity.
This word describes caring strongly for a person or thing. It may lead someone to give time and support. The feeling can be warm and lasting.

examples.en: Thank you for hosting such a lovely dinner.
examples.zh: 感謝你舉辦如此美好的晚餐聚會。

examples.en: What a lovely garden filled with blooming red roses!
examples.zh: 多麼美麗別緻、開滿盛開紅玫瑰的花園啊！

examples.en: She has a lovely voice and sings lullabies softly.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音很甜美，輕聲哼唱著搖籃曲。

explains: It describes something pleasing or charming. A garden may have this quality. People may use it to praise a person or day.
Use this word for a sight or action that gives pleasure. A kind gift may seem charming. A warm smile can make someone happy.
This word tells that something looks or feels pleasant. It may describe a place or person. A sweet gesture can have this quality.

examples.en: The shelf is too low for the tall books.
examples.zh: 這個架子對高書來說太低了。

examples.en: The plane flew low over the sea.
examples.zh: 飛機低低地飛過海面。

examples.en: The store sells low-cost school supplies.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售低價的學用品。

explains: It describes a position near the bottom. A quiet sound may have little volume. It can also name a deep tone.
Use this word for something not high. A shelf may sit near the floor. A person may speak softly with a gentle voice.
This word can mean not high in place or amount. A soft voice may have this quality. It can also describe a small price.

examples.en: We were lucky to find our lost dog.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運找到了走失的狗。

examples.en: She had a lucky day at the fair.
examples.zh: 她在園遊會上度過幸運的一天。

examples.en: It was lucky that the bus arrived on time.
examples.zh: 公車準時到達，真是幸運。

explains: It describes someone who has good things happen by chance. A person may find a lost coin. The word can also mean feeling fortunate.
Use this word when events turn out well without planning. A team may win at the last minute. A person may feel pleased about it.
This word tells that someone has good fortune. A small surprise may make someone feel this way. It can describe an event that ends well.

examples.en: What did you bring for your lunch box?
examples.zh: 你的便當帶了什麼午餐？

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the classroom around noontime.
examples.zh: 學生們大約中午在教室裡吃午餐。

examples.en: Let's go to the cafeteria to have lunch together.
examples.zh: 我們一起去學生餐廳吃午餐吧。

explains: This is the meal people often eat in the middle of the day. It may include soup or a sandwich. Students may eat it at school.
People pause from work or class to eat this meal. It usually comes after breakfast. A cafeteria may serve it at noon.
This word names a daytime meal. It can be brought from home or bought at a shop. Friends may eat together during the school day.

examples.en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
examples.zh: 洗衣機發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: This machine can cut wood quickly.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以快速切割木頭。

examples.en: The machine stopped working during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，機器停止運作。

explains: This is a tool with moving parts that does work. A person may use one to wash clothes. It often needs power.
People use this device to do work more easily. It may have buttons or a screen. A factory may use many of them.
This word names a device that performs a task. It can use electricity or fuel. A person may use one at home or work.

examples.en: He was mad when his bike was stolen.
examples.zh: 腳踏車被偷時，他很生氣。

examples.en: She went mad with joy when she won.
examples.zh: 她獲勝時高興極了。

examples.en: That mad plan could never work.
examples.zh: 那個瘋狂的計畫絕不可能成功。

explains: It describes someone who feels angry. It can also mean not thinking clearly. A small problem may upset someone.
Use this word for a strong angry feeling. It may describe someone who is acting wildly. Context shows which meaning fits.
This word tells that someone is very upset. It may also mean mentally unwell in older or casual speech. Calm words can help.

examples.en: Great cooking is true alchemy—a timeless magic that connects human hearts across cultural boundaries.
examples.zh: 偉大的烹飪是真正的現代煉金術——一種能跨越語言與文化隔閡、深深溫暖人心的「餐桌魔法」（Magic）。

examples.en: The street magician captivated the crowd by pulling fluttering white doves from an empty silk handkerchief.
examples.zh: 街頭魔術師從一條空無一物的絲質手帕中憑空變出拍翅飛翔的白鴿，讓駐足圍觀的大批群眾讚嘆稱奇。

examples.en: Watching the sunrise illuminate mountain mist felt like witness to ancient natural magic.
examples.zh: 站在山嶺看著晨曦金色朝陽穿透層層山嵐雲霧，那一刻彷彿親眼目睹了天地間古老神聖的大自然魔法。

entries.definition: 廚藝大師將平凡食材點化為傳奇的餐桌魔法；魔法
explains: This is the power to do things that seem impossible. Stories may show a person making objects disappear. It can also describe a surprising skill.
People may perform tricks that seem mysterious. A wand or special words may appear in stories. Something wonderful can be called this too.
This word names tricks that seem beyond normal ability. A show may use cards or lights to amaze people. In a story, a spell may have this power.

examples.en: Did we receive any snail mail or registered letters today?
examples.zh: 我們今天有收到任何實體信件或掛號信嗎？

examples.en: Please check your junk mail folder if you haven't received our confirmation email.
examples.zh: 如果您尚未收到確認信，請檢查您的垃圾郵件匣。

examples.en: I will mail this birthday present to my sister in Melbourne tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天會把這份生日禮物郵寄給我人在墨爾本的妹妹。

explains: This is a group of letters or packages sent to people. It can also mean sending them through a delivery service. A worker brings it to homes.
People receive bills and cards through this service. The verb means sending a letter or package. A stamp may be needed.
This word names letters and parcels carried to a home. A person can use it to send a note. A worker may sort it by address.

examples.en: The main road leads to the town center.
examples.zh: 主要道路通往鎮中心。

examples.en: What is the main idea of the story?
examples.zh: 這個故事的主旨是什麼？

examples.en: The main office is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 總辦公室在二樓。

explains: It means the most important or largest part. A road may have a central route. It can also name the primary water pipe in a system.
Use this word for the part that matters most. A story may focus on one person. It can describe the biggest road or pipe.
This word tells that something is central or chief. It may describe a key idea. A town may have one primary street.

examples.en: Let's make a cup of hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 我們來泡一杯熱巧克力吧。

examples.en: Please make sure that all the classroom windows are closed.
examples.zh: 請務必確認教室的所有窗戶都已關妥。

examples.en: Joining after-school clubs is a fantastic way to make new friends.
examples.zh: 參加課後社團是結交新朋友的絕佳途徑。

explains: It means producing or building something. A person may use wood to form a chair. It can also mean causing a feeling or result.
Use this verb when someone brings a new thing into being. A cook may prepare a meal. A choice may cause a result.
