This word means forming something from parts. It may describe preparing food or goods. It can also mean causing an effect.

examples.en: The tall man is our principal.
examples.zh: 那位高個子的男人是我們的校長。

examples.en: A young man helped the old lady cross the street.
examples.zh: 一位年輕男子幫忙老太太過馬路。

examples.en: That man works as an engineer at a tech company.
examples.zh: 那位男士在一間科技公司擔任工程師。

explains: This is an adult male person. The word can also mean humans in general in some old writing. A person may work as a helper or worker.
Use this word for an adult male. In older language, it can refer to all people. The sentence shows how it is being used.
This word names an adult male person. It may appear in job names. In some older texts, it means humankind.

examples.en: There are many trees in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有許多樹木。

examples.en: How many students are attending the summer workshop?
examples.zh: 有多少位學生會參加暑期工作坊？

examples.en: Many people prefer to read digital books nowadays.
examples.zh: 現今許多人偏好閱讀電子書。

explains: It means a large number of people or things. It is used with items that can be counted. A crowd may have this quality.
Use this word when there are more than a few. Students may read a large number of pages. It often comes before a plural noun.
This word tells that the number is high. It may describe people, books, or days. It can stand alone when the noun is clear.

examples.en: Use Google Maps to find the best route.
examples.zh: 使用 Google 地圖來尋找最佳路線。

examples.en: The MRT network map clearly displays all transfer stations.
examples.zh: 捷運路線圖清楚標示了所有的轉乘站點。

examples.en: Explorers carefully mapped the uncharted coastal islands in the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 探險家在十七世紀仔細繪製了未探明海岸島嶼的地圖。

explains: This is a drawing that shows roads, places, or land. Travelers use it to find a way. As a verb, it means showing where things are.
A paper or screen may show where cities and rivers lie. A person can use it to plan a trip. The verb means marking places on a drawing.
This word names a guide to places. It can show streets or the whole world. The action means making such a guide.

examples.en: There is a black mark on the page.
examples.zh: 頁面上有一個黑色記號。

examples.en: The teacher marked the tests carefully.
examples.zh: 老師仔細批改了考卷。

examples.en: A check mark shows that the answer is right.
examples.zh: 勾號表示答案正確。

explains: This is a sign or line left on a surface. It can show where something touched. As a verb, it can mean grading work or noting a spot.
A small spot may show on a wall. A teacher may give a score for work. The verb can mean making a sign.
This word names a visible sign or score. It may show damage or a place to remember. As an action, it means placing a sign or judging work.

examples.en: Mom buys fresh vegetables at the morning market.
examples.zh: 媽媽在早市買新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The global stock market experienced noticeable fluctuations this week.
examples.zh: 全球股市本週經歷了顯著的波動。

examples.en: The traditional market is always crowded with lively shoppers on weekends.
examples.zh: 傳統市場在週末總是擠滿了熱鬧採買的人潮。

examples.en: Developing Asian markets create great business opportunities.
examples.zh: 新興亞洲市場創造了巨大的商業契機。

examples.en: Farmers sell freshly harvested organic vegetables at the morning farmers market.
examples.zh: 農夫們在清晨的農夫市集上擺攤販售當日現採的有機生鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The tech startup hired a creative agency to market their fitness smartwatch.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創公司聘請了一家創意廣告代理商來行銷其健身智慧手錶。

explains: This is a place where people buy and sell goods. It may be outdoors or inside a building. As a verb, it means promoting goods to buyers.
People visit this place to buy food or clothing. Sellers display their goods. A company may try to make more people want a product.
This word names a place for trading. It can also mean the group of people who buy something. The verb means promoting a product.

examples.en: Are you married or single?
examples.zh: 請問你是已婚還是單身？

examples.en: They have been happily married for over thirty fruitful years.
examples.zh: 他們結為連理恩愛相伴已逾三十個幸福美滿的春秋。

examples.en: Married life requires continuous empathy, compromise, and heartfelt teamwork.
examples.zh: 婚姻生活需要持續不斷的同理心、互相包容與真誠的團隊協作。

explains: It describes someone who has a husband or wife. The person may wear a ring. A wedding often joins two people this way.
Use this word for a person who has legally joined with a partner. They may share a home and responsibilities. The opposite state is single.
This word tells that two people are joined as spouses. They may care for a family together. A wedding may mark the start.

examples.en: Practice makes math problems much easier.
examples.zh: 多加練習會讓數學題目容易得多。

examples.en: We will have a comprehensive math quiz covering fractions next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一將舉行涵蓋分數單元的數學綜合測驗。

examples.en: Learning math strengthens your problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
examples.zh: 學習數學能強化你解決問題與批判性思維的能力。

explains: This is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns. Students may add, subtract, or solve problems. It helps people measure and plan.
People use this school subject to work with amounts. It includes shapes and equations. Builders use it to measure materials.
This word names the study of numbers and space. It can help answer practical questions. Students may use it to solve puzzles.

examples.en: It doesn't matter; mistakes help us learn.
examples.zh: 沒關係要緊，錯誤能幫助我們學習。

examples.en: What is the matter with your computer screen? It keeps flickering.
examples.zh: 你的電腦螢幕怎麼了？它一直閃爍不停。

examples.en: Every small daily effort matters in protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 在保護生態環境方面，每個人日常的一點一滴努力都至關重要。

examples.en: Invisible dark matter exerts gravitational pulls that prevent rotating galaxies from flying apart into space.
examples.zh: 看不見摸不著的「暗物質」（Dark Matter）提供強大引力膠水，牢牢維繫著高速自轉的星系不致四分五裂。

examples.en: The fundamental states of matter commonly studied in physics include solids, liquids, gases, and plasmas.
examples.zh: 基礎物理學中常見的物質相態涵蓋了固態、液態、氣態以及高溫游離的電漿態。

examples.en: Resolving the environmental crisis is an urgent matter that requires global diplomatic cooperation.
examples.zh: 妥善解決全球氣候與環境生態危機，是一件刻不容緩且需要各國攜手外交合作的嚴肅緊要事項。

entries.definition: 要緊；事情；物質；佔宇宙質量 85% 卻看不見之神祕暗物質
explains: It can mean an issue or subject people talk about. It can also mean physical material. As a verb, it can mean being important.
Use this word for something that needs attention. It may name the substance that makes up an object. A problem may be important.
This word can name a topic or problem. It may also mean physical substance. As an action, it means being important to someone.

examples.en: May I ask a quick question about this lesson?
examples.zh: 請問我可以問一個關於這課的小問題嗎？

examples.en: It may rain later this afternoon, so don't forget your umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午晚些時候可能會下雨，所以別忘了帶傘。

examples.en: You may start writing your examination answers now.
examples.zh: 你們現在可以開始作答考試了。

explains: It shows that something is possible. It might also ask or give permission. The fifth month of the year has the same spelling.
Use this helper verb to speak about possibility or permission. A person might ask politely to leave. It can also make a suggestion.
This word tells that something could happen. It might be used to ask permission. It is also the name of a spring month.

examples.en: Maybe we can go to the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 也許我們午餐後可以去公園。

examples.en: She will maybe call us this evening.
examples.zh: 她可能今晚會打電話給我們。

examples.en: Maybe the rain will stop soon.
examples.zh: 也許雨很快就會停。

explains: It means perhaps or possibly. A person may not be sure about a plan. The word can make a statement less certain.
Use this word when something could be true but is not known. A friend may arrive later. The speaker is guessing.
This word shows that an idea is possible. It can answer a question without giving a firm yes. It signals some doubt.

examples.en: We had a hot meal after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後我們吃了一頓熱食。

examples.en: The meal included soup and fresh bread.
examples.zh: 這餐有湯和新鮮麵包。

examples.en: She cooked a meal for her family.
examples.zh: 她為家人煮了一頓飯。

explains: This is food eaten at one time of day. Breakfast and dinner are examples. People may share it with family or friends.
People prepare and eat this at a table. It may have several foods. A restaurant serves many kinds.
This word names food eaten at one sitting. It can be small or large. A person may cook it for guests.

examples.en: What does this new English vocabulary word mean?
examples.zh: 這個新英文單字是什麼意思？

examples.en: I am so sorry; I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
examples.zh: 非常抱歉，我絕不是有意要傷害你的感情。

examples.en: It was unkind and mean of him to tease the younger child.
examples.zh: 他去取笑年紀較小的孩子是很刻薄且不友善的行為。

explains: It can show what a word or sign stands for. It can also show a person’s purpose. As an adjective, it can describe an unkind person.
Use this word when explaining the sense of something. It can tell what someone plans to do. It may also describe someone who is not generous.
This word can ask what an idea stands for. It may show a person’s purpose. It can describe speech or behavior that is unkind.

examples.en: Vegetarians do not eat meat.
examples.zh: 素食者不吃肉類。

examples.en: Keep the raw meat in the freezer until you are ready to cook.
examples.zh: 在準備烹煮之前，請將生肉保存在冷凍庫。

examples.en: Eating too much red meat may not be good for health.
examples.zh: 吃太多紅肉可能對健康無益。

explains: This is food from the bodies of animals. People may cook it with vegetables. Chicken and beef are kinds.
Many people eat this food as a source of protein. It may be roasted or fried. A vegetarian chooses foods without it.
This word names the flesh of an animal used as food. It may come from a cow, pig, or bird. A cook prepares it before serving.

examples.en: Traditional media and social platforms report news from different angles.
examples.zh: 傳統媒體與社群平台從不同角度報導新聞。

examples.en: Critical thinking helps citizens evaluate information presented in digital media.
examples.zh: 批判性思維能幫助公民客觀評估數位媒體呈現的各項資訊。

examples.en: Media coverage of the charity concert raised millions for disaster relief.
examples.zh: 媒體對慈善音樂會的廣泛報導為災後重建籌集了數百萬元善款。

explains: These are ways to share news and information with many people. Television and newspapers are examples. A company may use them to reach an audience.
People use these channels to learn about events. They include radio, websites, and printed papers. They can also share entertainment.
This word names tools for sending information to many people. It may include video, sound, or writing. Reporters work with it.

examples.en: Take your cold medicine after meals three times a day.
examples.zh: 感冒藥請三餐飯後服用。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese medicine often uses natural roots and herbs.
examples.zh: 傳統中醫藥常使用天然植物根部與草藥。

examples.en: Modern medicine has made remarkable advances in treating complex diseases.
examples.zh: 現代醫學在治療複雜疾病方面取得了顯著的進展。

explains: This is a substance used to treat illness or pain. A doctor may tell someone how much to take. It can also mean the study of health and treatment.
People take this to help their bodies get well. It may come as a pill or liquid. The wider field studies how to care for sick people.
This word can name a drug used for treatment. A person should follow directions when taking it. It can also mean the science of caring for health.

examples.en: I would like a medium bubble milk tea, please.
examples.zh: 我想要一杯中杯珍珠奶茶，謝謝。

examples.en: He usually wears medium-sized polo shirts for casual outings.
examples.zh: 他休閒外出時通常穿著中號（M號）的 Polo 衫。

examples.en: How would you like your steak cooked? Medium, please.
examples.zh: 您的牛排要幾分熟？請幫我烤五分熟。

explains: It means in the middle size or amount. It may also name a way to share a message. The sentence tells which meaning is intended.
Use this word for something neither small nor large. It can describe a shirt size. It may also mean a channel such as radio or print.
This word points to a middle choice. It can name the material used to create art. It may also describe a way information travels.

examples.en: Nice to meet you!
examples.zh: 很高興認識你！

examples.en: Let's meet at the MRT station entrance at two o'clock tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天下午兩點在捷運站出入口碰面吧。

examples.en: The student athlete won two gold medals at the regional track meet.
examples.zh: 這位學生運動員在區域田徑運動會上勇奪兩面金牌。

explains: It means seeing someone or coming together with them. People may arrange to talk. A runner may also reach a goal or standard.
Use this word when two people come together. A team may face another team in a contest. It can also mean reaching a need or rule.
This verb means coming face to face with someone. It may describe a planned visit. It can also mean satisfying a requirement.

examples.en: We have a weekly team meeting every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週一早上都會召開團隊週會。

examples.en: The client asked to reschedule our meeting to Thursday.
examples.zh: 客戶要求將我們的會議改期到週四。

examples.en: Over twenty managers attended the annual budget meeting.
examples.zh: 二十多位經理出席了年度預算會議。

explains: This is a planned time when people come together to talk. They may share news or make decisions. A leader may guide the discussion.
Workers may gather in a room or online for this event. They can discuss a project. Notes may be taken.
This word names a gathering for discussion. People may plan work or share ideas. It usually starts at a set time.

examples.en: There are five members in my project group.
examples.zh: 我的專題小組有五位成員。

examples.en: Gym members enjoy unlimited access to swimming facilities and fitness classes.
examples.zh: 健身房會員享有無限次使用游泳設施與健身課程的權益。

examples.en: Every family member gathered around the dining table for the reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 每位家庭成員都圍坐在餐桌旁享用溫馨的除夕團圓飯。

explains: This is one person who belongs to a group. A club may have many people with this role. They share some rights or duties.
A person may join a team or organization. They then become one of its people. The word can also name a body part.
This word names someone who belongs to a group. They may pay dues or take part in activities. A family or club may have several.

examples.en: Could we please see the dessert and drink menu?
examples.zh: 請問能讓我們看一下甜點與飲品菜單嗎？

examples.en: Vegetarian dishes are clearly marked on the restaurant's dinner menu.
examples.zh: 餐廳晚餐菜單上明確標註了素食菜餚。

examples.en: Click on the navigation menu at the top of the webpage.
examples.zh: 點擊網頁頂端的導覽選單。

explains: This is a list of food and drinks offered at a restaurant. A customer reads it before ordering. A computer program may also show options with this name.
People look at this paper or screen to see what they can order. It may show prices. A café may have drinks and snacks on it.
This word names a list of available choices. A restaurant uses one for food. A computer may use one to show commands.

examples.en: The bank is in the middle of the shopping street.
examples.zh: 銀行就在這條商店街的中間位置。

examples.en: She woke up suddenly in the middle of the night hearing rain.
examples.zh: 她在半夜聽見雨聲時突然驚醒。

examples.en: Sit in the middle seat so you can talk easily with everyone.
examples.zh: 坐在中間座位，這樣你能輕鬆跟每個人交談。

explains: This is the part between the two ends of something. On a row of five seats, the third seat is in this place. Two seats are on each side of it.
A story has a beginning and an end. Many events happen in the part between them. This part helps show how the problem grows or gets solved.
A child with an older sister and a younger brother has this place in the family. The child is neither the oldest nor the youngest. There is one child on each side in age.

examples.en: Drinking milk is good for your bones.
examples.zh: 喝牛奶對骨骼有益。

examples.en: Put the carton of milk back into the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 請把那盒牛奶放回冰箱裡。

examples.en: She poured some warm milk into her cereal bowl.
examples.zh: 她在麥片碗裡倒了一些溫牛奶。

explains: This is a white drink made by female mammals. People often get it from cows. It is used in cereal and cheese.
A baby may drink this from its mother. People may pour it into tea or coffee. It contains nutrients for growing bodies.
This word names a common drink from cows. It is also used to make butter and cheese. It may be served cold.

examples.en: The town has a million people.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮有一百萬人口。

examples.en: A million stars seemed to fill the sky.
examples.zh: 彷彿有一百萬顆星星布滿天空。

examples.en: The book sold over a million copies.
examples.zh: 這本書賣出超過一百萬冊。

explains: This is the number after 999,999. It has six zeros after the one. People use it for very large amounts.
Use this word for one thousand groups of one thousand. A large city may have this many people. It is a very high number.
This word names a number equal to 1,000,000. A singer may sell this many records. It comes after nine hundred ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine.

examples.en: Do you mind if I open the window for fresh air?
examples.zh: 你介意我打開窗戶通風嗎？

examples.en: Keep in mind that consistent review is key to mastering vocabulary.
examples.zh: 請牢記在心：持續溫習是牢記掌握單字的關鍵所在。

examples.en: A calm and peaceful mind helps you make rational, wise choices.
examples.zh: 平靜沉著的心智有助於你做出理性明智的抉擇。

explains: This is the part of a person that thinks, remembers, and feels. It can also mean paying attention to someone’s request. People use it to solve problems.
Use this word for thoughts and memory. It may also mean being bothered by something. A person can change their opinion.
This word names the thinking part of a person. It can mean attention or intention. As a verb, it may mean caring about a concern.

examples.en: The miners worked deep in the mine.
examples.zh: 礦工在礦坑深處工作。

examples.en: That red backpack is mine.
examples.zh: 那個紅色背包是我的。

examples.en: They found gold in an old mine.
examples.zh: 他們在一座舊礦坑裡找到黃金。

explains: This can mean a place where people dig for valuable minerals. It can also mean something that belongs to the speaker. A sentence shows which meaning fits.
Workers dig this place to find coal or metal. The pronoun form means something is owned by the speaker. Context tells the sense.
Workers dig this place to find coal or metal. Another use points to something owned by the speaker. The surrounding words show which use is intended.

examples.en: Please wait a minute, I will be right back.
examples.zh: 請等一分鐘，我馬上回來。

examples.en: The noodles will be cooked in three minutes.
examples.zh: 麵條煮三分鐘就好了。

examples.en: We still have ten minutes before class begins.
examples.zh: 距離上課我們還有十分鐘時間。

explains: This is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds. A short wait may last one of them. A clock can show it.
People use this time unit when measuring a short task. It has sixty seconds. There are sixty of these in an hour.
This word names a small period on a clock. It may pass while someone waits for a bus. It is longer than a second.

examples.en: Miss Wang will teach us art today.
examples.zh: 王小姐今天會教我們美術。

examples.en: Miss Davis is always patient with her young students.
examples.zh: 戴維斯小姐對她年幼的學生總是非常有耐心。

examples.en: I miss my childhood friends in my hometown.
examples.zh: 我很想念家鄉童年的朋友們。

explains: It can mean failing to hit or reach something. A ball may pass beside the goal. A person may also feel sad when someone is away.
Use this word when someone does not arrive at a place or event. It can also mean feeling the lack of someone. It may describe not seeing or hearing something.
This word can tell that a chance or target was not reached. It may describe feeling sad about a person who is far away. It can also mean not noticing something.

examples.en: I made a mistake on the math test.
examples.zh: 我在數學考試中犯了一個錯誤。

examples.en: Do not mistake kindness for weakness.
examples.zh: 不要把善良誤認為軟弱。

examples.en: She corrected her mistake quickly.
examples.zh: 她很快改正了自己的錯誤。

explains: This is something done incorrectly. A person may use the wrong word. As a verb, it can mean understanding something the wrong way.
Use this word for an error in work or action. A student may write the wrong answer. The verb means taking someone’s words the wrong way.
This word names a wrong choice or action. It may happen when someone is learning. A careful look can help fix it.

examples.en: They live in a modern apartment.
examples.zh: 他們住在一間現代化公寓裡。

examples.en: The museum has modern art on display.
examples.zh: 博物館展出現代藝術。

examples.en: Modern phones can take clear pictures.
examples.zh: 現代手機可以拍出清晰的照片。

explains: It describes something from the present time rather than the past. New tools may be used in this way. The word can describe current styles.
Use this word for something recent or up to date. A building may use new design ideas. It can describe life in the present age.
This word tells that something belongs to the current age. It may describe art, clothing, or technology. It is the opposite of ancient.

examples.en: Wait a moment while I get my coat.
examples.zh: 等我一下，我去拿外套。

examples.en: For a moment, the room was silent.
examples.zh: 有一瞬間，房間裡很安靜。

examples.en: The best moment of the trip was seeing the sea.
examples.zh: 旅程中最美好的時刻是看見大海。

explains: This is a very short period of time. A person may wait for one before speaking. The word can also mean a particular point in time.
Use this word for a brief time. A happy event may last only a short while. People may say they will be ready soon.
This word names a small amount of time. It can describe a pause. It may also mean a special point in someone’s life.

examples.en: How much money do you need for the trip?
examples.zh: 這次旅行你需要多少錢？

examples.en: It is important to learn how to save money from a young age.
examples.zh: 從小學習如何存錢非常重要。

examples.en: He spent all his pocket money on new video games.
examples.zh: 他把所有零用錢都花在買新電玩遊戲上了。

explains: This is what people use to buy things. It may be coins, bills, or numbers in a bank account. People earn it through work.
People save this to pay for food and housing. A store accepts it in exchange for goods. It can be given as coins or notes.
This word names the value used for payment. People may earn it, save it, or spend it. Banks help keep it safe.

examples.en: You can see Formosan rock macaques on Shoushan.
examples.zh: 你可以在壽山上看到台灣獼猴。

examples.en: Stop monkeying around and finish your homework first.
examples.zh: 別再胡鬧搗蛋了，先把作業寫完。

examples.en: The clever monkey peeled the sweet banana effortlessly.
examples.zh: 聰明的猴子毫不費力地剝開了香甜的香蕉。

explains: This is an animal that lives in trees and has a long tail. It can use its hands to grab branches. Some kinds eat fruit.
The animal may swing from branch to branch. It has a face that looks a little like a person’s. Some are small, while others are strong.
This word names a clever animal from warm forests. It may eat fruit or insects. Its tail can help it balance.

examples.en: We will go on vacation next month.
examples.zh: 我們下個月要去度假。

examples.en: February is usually the shortest month of the year.
examples.zh: 二月通常是一年中最短的月份。

examples.en: She has been learning Spanish for three months.
examples.zh: 她已經學了三個月的西班牙文。

explains: This is one of the twelve named parts of a year. January is one example. A calendar shows the days in each part.
This calendar unit is longer than a week. It has twenty-eight, twenty-nine, thirty, or thirty-one days. February is the shortest one.
People use this unit to plan birthdays and other events. Twelve of them make a full year. Each has a name and a place in the calendar.

examples.en: We enjoy mooncakes and barbecue under the full moon.
examples.zh: 我們在滿月下品嚐月餅並烤肉。

examples.en: The gravitational pull of the moon creates ocean tides on Earth.
examples.zh: 月球的引力在地球上引發了海洋潮汐。

examples.en: The crescent moon shone like a delicate silver boat in the dark night.
examples.zh: 一彎娥眉月在黑夜中宛如一艘精巧的銀色小船。

explains: This is the round object that travels around Earth. It looks bright at night because it reflects sunlight. People may see different parts of it each month.
It is a natural object in space near Earth. Its shape appears to change during the month. It shines in the night sky.
This word names the body that circles our planet. It can look like a thin curve or a full disk. It helps light the night.

examples.en: Would you like more soup?
examples.zh: 你想再多喝一點湯嗎？

examples.en: We need more chairs for the guests.
examples.zh: 我們還需要更多椅子給客人。

examples.en: The blue bag costs more than the red one.
examples.zh: 藍色的袋子比紅色的貴。

explains: It means a greater amount or number. A person may ask for an extra serving. It can also describe something additional.
Use this word to compare amounts. One cup may hold a greater amount than another. It can mean an extra item.
This word points to a larger number or degree. It may describe extra time or food. A speaker can use it to ask for an additional amount.

examples.en: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
examples.zh: 早安！你睡得好嗎？

examples.en: I like to do some light exercise in the morning.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在早晨做一些輕度運動。

examples.en: It was a cold and foggy morning in the mountains.
examples.zh: 山區的早晨既寒冷又多霧。

explains: This is the part of the day when people first wake. The sun rises during it. Many people eat breakfast then.
It is the early part of the day. Children may get ready for school during this time. Birds often sing then.
This word names the time between night and noon. People may travel to work or school then. It begins when a new day starts.

examples.en: Most Taiwanese students learn English at school.
examples.zh: 大多數台灣學生在學校學習英語。

examples.en: Pearl milk tea is the most popular beverage export from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶是台灣最受歡迎且聞名遐邇的出口飲品。

examples.en: Most of the old town's historical brick architecture remains well preserved.
examples.zh: 老鎮上大多數的歷史紅磚建築至今依舊保存得相當完善。

explains: It means the greatest number or amount in a group. A person may have the greatest score. It can also mean very much.
Use this word when something is above all the others in amount or degree. A team may score more than every other team. It can describe the greatest part.
This word points to the largest share. It may describe the highest degree. A person can use it to compare several things.

examples.en: Her mother works as a nurse.
examples.zh: 她的母親擔任護理師。

examples.en: My mother always reminds me to eat more vegetables.
examples.zh: 我媽媽總是提醒我要多吃蔬菜。

examples.en: We gave mother a bouquet of flowers on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 我們在母親節送了一束花給媽媽。

explains: This is a female parent. She may care for a child and teach them. A child may call her Mom.
A person’s female parent has this family role. She may share a home with her children. People often use a warm name for her.
This word names the woman who gives birth to or raises a child. She may offer care and advice. Some families use another name when speaking to her.

examples.en: Jade Mountain (Yushan) is the highest peak in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 玉山是台灣第一高峰。

examples.en: We hiked up the mountain trail early to catch the magnificent sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們清晨徒步攀登登山步道，只為捕捉壯麗的日出美景。

examples.en: Fresh mountain air makes hikers feel energetic and healthy.
examples.zh: 清新的高山空氣讓登山客感到精神充沛且身心舒暢。

explains: This is a very high area of land with steep sides. Its top may be covered with snow. People may hike up it.
A tall natural rise stands above the land around it. Climbers may follow a path to the top. Trees may grow near its base.
This word names a high part of the land. It is taller than a hill. Some have sharp peaks.

examples.en: Double-click the left mouse button to open the file.
examples.zh: 按兩下滑鼠左鍵以開啟檔案。

examples.en: An ergonomic wireless computer mouse reduces wrist fatigue.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的無線電腦滑鼠能減輕手腕疲勞。

examples.en: The tiny brown field mouse scurried quickly under the wooden barn door.
examples.zh: 嬌小的棕色田鼠迅速溜進了木製穀倉門底下。

entries.definition: 老鼠；電腦滑鼠（複數 mice）
explains: This is a small animal with a long tail and pointed ears. It may live in a home or in a field. It likes to eat cheese in stories.
The animal has whiskers and sharp teeth. It may hide in a wall or hole. A larger one may be kept as a pet.
This word can name a small furry animal. It moves quickly and finds food with its nose. The same word names a device used to move a computer pointer.

examples.en: Open your mouth so the doctor can check.
examples.zh: 張開你的嘴巴讓醫生檢查。

examples.en: Don't speak with your mouth full of food.
examples.zh: 嘴裡塞滿食物時不要說話。

examples.en: A wide smile spread across the little boy's mouth.
examples.zh: 小男孩的嘴角揚起了燦爛的微笑。

explains: This is the opening in the face used for eating and speaking. It has lips, teeth, and a tongue. As a verb, it can mean moving the lips to form words.
People use this part to chew food and make sounds. A baby may put food inside it. It can also mean speaking without sound.
This word names the opening at the lower part of the face. It helps people eat and talk. The verb means forming words with the lips.

examples.en: The movement of the dancers was smooth.
examples.zh: 舞者們的動作很流暢。

examples.en: Please move the chair closer to the table.
examples.zh: 請把椅子移近桌子。

examples.en: The story has a movement from sadness to hope.
examples.zh: 故事從悲傷轉向希望。

explains: It means changing place or position. It can also name a change in a story or dance. A person may shift a chair across a room.
Use this word when someone changes where they are. A dancer may make one step or turn. The noun can mean a change in position.
This verb means going from one place to another. The noun may name one action in a game or story. A person can shift an object too.

examples.en: Let's go watch an exciting action movie.
examples.zh: 我們去看一部刺激的動作電影吧。

examples.en: The movie was so touching that many viewers were moved to tears.
examples.zh: 這部電影太感人了，許多觀眾感動得熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: Watching English movies without subtitles is a challenging listening exercise.
examples.zh: 觀看不帶字幕的英語電影是一項具挑戰性的聽力練習。

examples.en: The Golden Horse Film Festival celebrates exceptional Mandarin cinema.
examples.zh: 金馬影展表揚傑出的華語電影作品。

examples.en: Vintage photography enthusiasts love shooting street scenes on 35mm film.
examples.zh: 復古底片攝影愛好者熱愛用 35mm 膠卷拍攝街頭風光。

examples.en: A thin oily film floated on the surface of the harbor water.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的油漬薄膜漂浮在港灣水面上。

explains: This is a story shown on a screen. People watch moving pictures and hear sound. It may make them laugh or feel sad.
A theater shows this kind of entertainment. It often has actors and a story. People may watch one at home.
This word names a moving-picture story. It can be shown on television or a large screen. People may call it a picture show.

examples.en: Mr. Lin is our new math teacher.
examples.zh: 林先生是我們的新數學老師。

examples.en: Mr. Brown will give a speech in the auditorium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 布朗先生明天將在禮堂發表演講。

examples.en: Excuse me, is Mr. Wang in his office right now?
examples.zh: 請問王先生現在在辦公室嗎？

explains: This title is placed before a man’s name. People use it to speak politely. It does not tell whether he is married.
Use this respectful title before a male person’s family name. It may be written with a dot. A teacher or customer may be addressed this way.
This word is a polite title for a man. It comes before his name in writing. The title can be used for married or unmarried men.

examples.en: Mrs. Chen works at a bank.
examples.zh: 陳太太在一家銀行工作。

examples.en: Mrs. Smith baked some delicious cookies for the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 史密斯太太為鄰居烤了一些美味的手工餅乾。

examples.en: We bought some fresh vegetables from Mrs. Lee's farm stand.
examples.zh: 我們向李太太的農產攤位買了一些新鮮蔬菜。

explains: This title comes before the name of a married woman. It is used in polite speech or writing. The title often has a dot after it.
People may place this form before a woman’s family name. It traditionally shows that she is married. A letter may begin with it.
This is a respectful title for a woman who has a husband. It is written before her name. Some people prefer a different title today.

examples.en: Please give this form to Ms. Huang.
examples.zh: 請把這份表格交給黃女士。

examples.en: Ms. Chang is the head manager of the sales department.
examples.zh: 張女士是業務部門的總主管。

examples.en: You can contact Ms. Taylor by email or phone.
examples.zh: 你可以透過電子郵件或電話聯絡泰勒女士。

explains: This polite title comes before a woman’s name. It does not say whether she is married. People may use it in a letter or introduction.
Use this respectful form before a female person’s name. It works for married and unmarried women. The title often has a dot.
This word is a title used before a woman’s family name. It leaves her marriage status unknown. It is common in formal writing.

examples.en: How much does this milk tea cost?
examples.zh: 這杯奶茶多少錢？

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind assistance.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你親切的協助。

examples.en: There isn't much time left before the exam begins.
examples.zh: 距離考試開始所剩時間不多了。

explains: It can mean a large amount when talking about things that cannot be counted one by one. It can also add strength to a feeling. A person may have a lot of work.
Use this word for a great amount of water, time, or effort. It may also mean very. A sentence may use it to make a description stronger.
This word points to a large amount. It often describes something not counted as separate pieces. It can also make an adjective stronger.

examples.en: Mixing texture paste with brown pigments and static grass produces heavy clumpy mud stuck to tank tracks.
examples.zh: 將紋理石膏膏體與深褐色顏料、碎草絲均勻攪拌，能做出死死卡在履帶縫隙中的厚重泥濘。

examples.en: Children laughed joyfully as they splashed through muddy brown puddles in their waterproof rubber boots.
examples.zh: 小朋友們腳踩著五顏六色的防水橡膠小雨鞋，歡呼雀躍地在下雨後的泥濘水坑中盡情踩水嬉戲。

examples.en: Off-road rally racers must navigate deep mud ruts without losing wheel traction on unpaved mountain roads.
examples.zh: 越野拉力賽車手在蜿蜒險峻的非鋪裝山路賽道上馳騁時，必須沉著操控方向盤衝過深深的泥巴車轍而不打滑失控。

examples.en: Pumping synthetic high-temperature drilling mud cools the spinning bit and carries crushed rock to surface.
examples.zh: 不斷向下泵入特製耐高溫「鑽井泥漿」（Drilling Mud），能冷卻高速旋轉的鑽頭並將碎石屑帶回地表。

examples.en: Torrential monsoon rains turned the unpaved construction path into thick slippery mud.
examples.zh: 連日傾盆而下的季風豪雨，將工地上未鋪設瀝青的泥土便道沖刷成一片深陷腳踝、寸步難行的泥濘厚泥。

examples.en: Luxury day spa packages offer mineral-rich volcanic mud wraps that soothe joint inflammation and soften skin.
examples.zh: 奢華溫泉渡假村推出富含礦物質的天然火山礦物泥敷體療程，深層舒緩關節肌肉酸痛並使肌膚柔滑細緻。

entries.definition: 履帶厚重泥漿泥濘立體紋理膏；潤滑冷卻耐攝氏三百五十度高溫鑽井泥漿；泥巴
explains: This is soft wet earth made when soil mixes with water. It sticks to shoes. Children may splash through it after rain.
A puddle can turn dirt into this sticky material. It may cover a path or field. Boots help keep feet clean.
This word names wet soil. It feels soft and messy. A pig may roll in it.

examples.en: The National Palace Museum preserves precious historical relics.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院典藏珍貴歷史文物。

examples.en: Photography without flash is permitted inside the modern art museum.
examples.zh: 這座現代藝術博物館內允許在不開啟閃光燈的情況下拍照。

examples.en: Visitors can rent multilingual audio guides at the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在博物館入口處租借多語音訊語音導覽機。

examples.en: The Chimei Museum in Tainan exhibits Western art and antique instruments.
examples.zh: 台南奇美博物館展出西方藝術品與古董樂器。

examples.en: Admission to the science museum is free on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 每個月的第一個星期一參觀科學博物館免費入場。

examples.en: A knowledgeable museum guide walked us through the Egyptian ancient relics gallery.
examples.zh: 一位見多識廣的博物館導覽員帶領我們參觀埃及古文物展廳。

examples.en: The National Palace Museum houses nearly 700,000 priceless ancient Chinese artifacts and imperial treasures.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院珍藏了近七十萬件彌足珍貴的古代宮廷書畫、青銅玉器與御用陶瓷國寶。

examples.en: Admission to the municipal history museum is free on the first weekend of every month.
examples.zh: 每個月的第一個週末，市歷史博物館皆開放所有民眾免費入館參觀。

examples.en: School field trips to the science museum ignite children's curiosity about natural history and robotics.
examples.zh: 學校安排參訪科學教育館的校外教學，能有效激發孩子們對自然歷史與機器人科學的探索熱忱。

entries.definition: 博物館；國家級博物館；美術館
explains: This is a building where people see old or special objects. It may show art, animals, or history. Visitors walk through rooms to learn.
People visit this place to look at collections. A guide may explain what the objects are. Some places let visitors touch certain displays.
This word names a public place for learning and seeing objects. It may have paintings or bones from old animals. Schools often take trips there.

examples.en: Listening to soft music helps me relax.
examples.zh: 聆聽輕柔的音樂能幫助我放鬆。

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese folk music features unique string instruments.
examples.zh: 台灣傳統民俗音樂具有獨特的弦樂器特色。

examples.en: She has a deep passion for composing original piano music.
examples.zh: 她對創作原創鋼琴音樂懷有深厚的熱忱。

explains: This is organized sound made by voices or instruments. People may listen to it for fun. A song is one kind.
A band may play this at a concert. It can be quiet or loud. People may dance when they hear a beat.
This word names sounds arranged in a way people enjoy. It can be sung or played. A radio often sends it into homes.

examples.en: Motorcycle riders must wear helmets by law.
examples.zh: 法律規定機車騎士必須佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Visiting the historic night market is an absolute must when traveling in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 造訪歷史悠久的夜市是來台灣旅遊絕對必去的行程。

examples.en: You must wash your hands thoroughly before handling food.
examples.zh: 處理食物前你必須徹底把雙手洗乾淨。

explains: It shows that something is required. A rule may say that students wear shoes. The word can also name something very popular or useful.
Use this helper verb when an action is necessary. A driver needs to stop at a red light. As a noun, it can mean something people strongly want.
This word tells that there is no choice about an action. A person may need to follow a law. It can also name a thing considered essential.

examples.en: What is your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字是什麼？

examples.en: Please write your name clearly on the test sheet.
examples.zh: 請在試卷上清楚寫下你的名字。

examples.en: They named their newborn daughter Emily.
examples.zh: 他們把剛出生的女兒命名為艾蜜莉。

explains: This is the word used to identify a person or thing. It may be written on a card. As a verb, it means giving someone or something a label.
People use this word when introducing themselves. A label may show who an object belongs to. The verb means saying what someone is called.
This word can mean a personal label. It helps people know who someone is. As an action, it means choosing a title for a person or object.

examples.en: The national flag flew above the school.
examples.zh: 國旗在學校上方飄揚。

examples.en: They celebrated a national holiday together.
examples.zh: 他們一起慶祝國定假日。

examples.en: The team won the national championship.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍贏得全國冠軍。

explains: It describes something connected to a whole country. A flag is one sign used for this purpose. A holiday may celebrate the country’s history.
Use this word for things that belong to or represent a country. The government may hold a special day. A sports team may compete for its homeland.
This word tells that something relates to a nation. It may describe a law, team, or holiday. It can also mean a citizen of a country.

examples.en: We enjoy walking in nature.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡親近大自然。

examples.en: The nature of the problem is hard to understand.
examples.zh: 這個問題的本質很難理解。

examples.en: Many animals live in nature.
examples.zh: 許多動物生活在大自然中。

explains: This is the world of plants, animals, land, and weather. People may walk outside to enjoy it. It can also mean the basic way something is.
Use this word for the living world around us. Forests and rivers are part of it. The word can also describe someone’s character.
This word names the physical world not made by people. It includes trees and animals. It can also mean the main quality of a thing.

examples.en: Do you live near the MRT station?
examples.zh: 你住在捷運站附近嗎？

examples.en: There is a convenient grocery store near our school gate.
examples.zh: 我們學校校門口附近有一家方便的雜貨店。

examples.en: Winter vacation is drawing near as January approaches.
examples.zh: 隨著一月份臨近，寒假也越來越近了。

explains: It means at a short distance from something. A school may be close to a park. Children can walk between the two places in a few minutes.
Use this word for a place that is not far away. A person may sit beside a friend. The space between them is small.
This word can also describe a time that will arrive soon. A birthday may be only two days away. As a verb, it means to get closer to a place, time, or goal.

examples.en: He wore a warm scarf around his neck.
examples.zh: 他在脖子上圍了一條暖和的圍巾。

examples.en: The giraffe has a very long neck.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿的脖子非常長。

examples.en: She turned her neck to see the bird.
examples.zh: 她轉動脖子看那隻鳥。

explains: This is the part between the head and shoulders. It helps turn and hold up the head. A scarf may be wrapped around it.
People bend this body part to look down. It connects the head to the rest of the body. A collar sits around it.
This word names a narrow body part. It carries the head. Some animals have a long one.

examples.en: You need to practice speaking English every day.
examples.zh: 你需要每天練習開口說英語。

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難見真情。

examples.en: We need three more chairs for the guests in the living room.
examples.zh: 我們客廳裡還需要三張椅子給客人坐。

explains: It means something is required or wanted. A person may ask for water after running. As a noun, it can name an important requirement.
Use this word when someone must have something. Food and rest are basic requirements. A person may ask for help.
This word tells that something is necessary. It can describe a want or a duty. As a noun, it names something important to have.

examples.en: The fisherman threw his net into the water.
examples.zh: 漁夫把網撒進水裡。

examples.en: The soccer ball hit the net.
examples.zh: 足球打中了球網。

examples.en: They netted several fish before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前他們捕到了幾條魚。

explains: This is a mesh used to catch fish or hold a ball. It has many small openings. As a verb, it means catching an animal with such a tool.
People throw this woven tool into water to catch fish. A sports goal may have one behind it. The verb describes catching with it.
This word names a mesh made from string or rope. It can stop a ball or catch food. As an action, it means catching with a mesh tool.

examples.en: I have never been to Kenting National Park.
examples.zh: 我從來沒有去過墾丁國家公園。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough the path.
examples.zh: 無論前方的道路多麼艱難，絕不要放棄夢想。

examples.en: He promised that he would never be late for morning assembly again.
examples.zh: 他保證絕不會再於早會時遲到了。

explains: It means not at any time. A person may say they do not do something on any day. It is stronger than sometimes.
Use this word for something that does not happen at all. It can describe a promise to avoid an action. The sentence becomes negative.
This word tells that an event does not take place at any time. It may describe a habit someone does not have. It can also warn someone strongly.

examples.en: I bought a new pair of sneakers yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天買了一雙新球鞋。

examples.en: We welcome three new students to our class this semester.
examples.zh: 我們這學期迎來了三位轉入班上的新同學。

examples.en: The company introduced a brand new smartphone model with advanced cameras.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了一款配備先進相機的全新智慧型手機。

explains: This describes something made or bought recently. A child might have a toy from the shop today. It has not been used for long.
This can describe a person who has just joined a group. A child might arrive at a school for the first time. The class helps the child learn where everything is.
This can describe an idea or experience that is unfamiliar. A child might try a game for the first time. Learning its rules can take a little time.

examples.en: Good news travels fast.
examples.zh: 好消息傳千里。

examples.en: Did you hear the exciting news about our school orchestra winning the trophy?
examples.zh: 你有聽說我們學校管弦樂團榮獲獎盃的振奮消息嗎？

examples.en: No news is good news when waiting anxiously for medical results.
examples.zh: 焦急等待體檢結果時，沒有消息就是好消息。

explains: This is information about recent events. People may hear it on television or read it online. It can be local or from far away.
A reporter may share this information with the public. It can tell about weather, sports, or government. People often read it each day.
This word names reports about things that happened. It can be spoken, written, or shown on a screen. A person may share one important story.

examples.en: Dad reads the morning newspaper while having breakfast.
examples.zh: 爸爸邊吃早餐邊看早報。

examples.en: Local newspapers reported the opening of the new high-tech library.
examples.zh: 地方報紙報導了這座全新高科技圖書館的盛大開幕。

examples.en: Many people now read digital news rather than print newspapers.
examples.zh: 現今許多人閱讀數位新聞勝過紙本報紙。

examples.en: Grandpa enjoys reading the morning newspaper while sipping hot tea.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡邊喝熱茶邊閱讀早報。

examples.en: Delivering the early morning newspaper was his first teenage part-time job.
examples.zh: 沿街派送清晨早報是他青少年時期的第一份打工兼職。

examples.en: You can read digital editions of the daily newspaper on your mobile tablet.
examples.zh: 你可以在平板電腦上輕鬆閱讀當日日報的電子數位版。

explains: This is a printed set of pages with stories and information. It comes out each day or week. People read it to learn about events.
A reader may buy this at a shop or have it brought to the door. It has articles and pictures. It is made from large sheets folded together.
This word names a paper publication with reports and notices. It may include sports and weather. People can read it with breakfast.

examples.en: Who is next in line?
examples.zh: 排在下一位的是誰？

examples.en: We will visit Grandma next Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們下星期日要去看奶奶。

examples.en: The next bus arrives in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 下一班公車十分鐘後抵達。

explains: It means the one that comes right after this one. A person may stand in line for their turn. It can also refer to the nearest future time.
Use this word for the item that follows the present one. A calendar may show a meeting on the following day. It can tell who acts after someone.
This word points to the following person or event. It can mean the closest time that comes ahead. A person may be waiting for that turn.

examples.en: She is a nice person who helps everyone.
examples.zh: 她是一位會幫助大家的好人。

examples.en: We had a nice time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海灘度過了愉快的時光。

examples.en: That was a nice thing to say.
examples.zh: 那句話說得真好。

explains: It describes someone who is pleasant and kind. A helpful stranger may have this quality. It can also mean enjoyable or attractive.
Use this word for a person who treats others well. A warm day may feel pleasant. People may say it to praise a thoughtful action.
This word tells that something feels pleasant. It can describe a kind person or a lovely place. It may also mean polite.

examples.en: Don't stay up late at night.
examples.zh: 晚上不要熬夜。

examples.en: The stars look exceptionally bright in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中的星星看起來格外明亮。

examples.en: Good night, have sweet dreams!
examples.zh: 晚安，祝你有個好夢！

explains: This is the dark part of the day after evening. People usually sleep then. Stars may be visible in the sky.
The sun is below the horizon during this time. A person may turn on a light to read. Some animals are active then.
This word names the time from sunset to sunrise. It can be quiet or busy. People often rest during it.

examples.en: No, I do not want more tea.
examples.zh: 不了，我不想再喝茶了。

examples.en: She said nope and smiled.
examples.zh: 她說不，然後笑了。

examples.en: The answer is no.
examples.zh: 答案是否定的。

explains: This is a short reply that refuses or disagrees. It can answer a question about permission. The tone may sound firm or gentle.
Use this response when someone does not agree. It may also say that something is absent. A person can say it politely.
This word is a negative answer. It can refuse an offer or deny a fact. A head shake may go with it.

examples.en: Nobody was home when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我們抵達時，家裡沒有人。

examples.en: Nobody knows the answer yet.
examples.zh: 目前還沒有人知道答案。

examples.en: There was nobody on the empty bus.
examples.zh: 空公車上沒有人。

explains: It refers to not one person. A room may be empty when no person is there. The word can also name a person with little importance.
Use this pronoun for an empty group of people. It can say that no person arrived. In an insult, it may describe someone treated as unimportant.
This word points to an absence of people. It can be used when a place is empty. A person should not use it to hurt others.

examples.en: Traffic noise outside kept me awake last night.
examples.zh: 外面的車輛噪音讓我昨晚睡不著。

examples.en: Please refrain from making loud noise while studying in the quiet reading room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的閱覽室內讀書時請勿發出吵鬧的噪音。

examples.en: The car began making an alarming metallic noise whenever braking.
examples.zh: 這輛汽車每當煞車時就開始發出一種令人不安的金屬異音。

examples.en: Modern CMOS sensors deliver ultra-clean high-ISO images with remarkably low noise.
examples.zh: 現代背照式 CMOS 感光元件在高 ISO 弱光環境下依然能呈現出極其純淨、超低雜訊的畫質。

examples.en: Heavy digital noise can obscure subtle starry textures in night sky photographs.
examples.zh: 畫面中過多的彩色與亮度數位雜訊，可能會遮蔽夜空星景照片中微弱暗淡的繁星細節。

examples.en: AI-powered software tools can effectively remove luminance noise without sacrificing sharpness.
examples.zh: 搭載 AI 深度演算法的專業修圖降噪工具，能在完全不損失畫面銳利度的前提下消除雜訊。

examples.en: Acoustic double-pane glass and active noise cancellation create a serene library-quiet cabin ride.
examples.zh: 搭配雙層隔音夾膠玻璃與主動降噪技術（ANC），為全車乘客營造出宛如圖書館般極致靜謐的乘坐空間。

examples.en: High-speed tire noise and wind buffeting are muffled by thick sound-absorbing foam inside door panels.
examples.zh: 高速行駛時惱人的輪胎滾動胎噪與 A 柱風切聲，全數被車門門板內密閉填充的高密度吸音棉隔絕消弭。

examples.en: City apartments facing busy elevated highways require soundproof double glazing to filter street noise.
examples.zh: 緊鄰市中心高架橋第一排景觀大樓住宅，普遍全面換裝隔音氣密窗，以徹底過濾掉窗外車水馬龍的噪音。

examples.en: The hall meets the ultra-stringent NC-15 ambient noise criterion, where even a pin drop can be heard.
examples.zh: 音樂廳達成極端嚴苛的 NC-15「超靜音背景噪音標準」（Ambient Noise），全場靜謐到一根針掉地都清晰可辨。

examples.en: Construction noise from the metro expansion outside our window made concentrating on study very difficult.
examples.zh: 窗外捷運延伸工程傳來的沉重打樁營造噪音，讓坐在書桌前準備升學考試的學子難以靜心專注。

examples.en: Signal processing filters eliminate background electronic noise from delicate satellite radio recordings.
examples.zh: 數位訊號處理濾波器能有效過濾消除微弱人造衛星無線電訊號接收中夾雜的各類微小電子雜訊背景噪音。

entries.definition: 噪音；聲響；影像雜訊；噪點；NVH 車室隔音降噪工程；達成 NC-15 極致靜謐環境極低背景噪音標準
explains: This is a sound, especially one that is unwanted. Traffic may make it hard to hear. A machine can produce it.
People may hear this sound in a busy place. It may be loud or distracting. A quiet room has very little of it.
This word names sounds that may bother people. A radio or road can make them. It can also mean a signal problem in a picture.

examples.en: The night market gets very lively and noisy at night.
examples.zh: 夜市在晚上變得非常熱鬧喧囂。

examples.en: It is difficult to concentrate in such a noisy coffee shop.
examples.zh: 在這麼吵鬧的咖啡廳裡很難集中注意力。

examples.en: Our neighbors threw a noisy party late into the night.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居舉辦了一場喧鬧的深夜派對。

examples.en: In today’s noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, hybrid quantum-classical algorithms mitigate hardware limits.
examples.zh: 在當前含雜訊中等規模量子時代，科學家運用量子與傳統混合演算法來克服硬體限制。

examples.en: Researchers in the NISQ era focus on heuristic algorithms that tolerate small physical error rates.
examples.zh: 處於中等規模含雜訊時代的科學家，全力深耕能從容容忍微小實體錯誤率的啟發式混合演算法。

examples.en: Hardware developers work relentlessly to transition from the noisy era into the fault-tolerant era.
examples.zh: 全球頂尖硬體研發團隊日以繼夜全力以赴，力求早日跨越雜訊桎梏、昂首邁入完全容錯的黃金新紀元。

entries.definition: 吵鬧的；喧鬧的；當前含雜訊中等規模量子時代 (NISQ) 的
explains: It describes a place with too many sounds. A busy classroom may feel this way. People may speak loudly there.
Use this word when sounds are strong or constant. A crowded street can have many voices. Ear covers may help someone rest.
This word tells that a place is full of sound. A machine may be this way when it runs. People may ask for quiet.

examples.en: The meeting starts at noon.
examples.zh: 會議中午開始。

examples.en: We eat lunch around noon.
examples.zh: 我們大約中午吃午餐。

examples.en: The sun was high at noon.
examples.zh: 中午時太陽高掛天空。

explains: This is twelve o’clock in the daytime. People may eat a meal then. It is the middle point between morning and evening.
Use this word for the hour when the sun is often high. A school day may pause then. The clock shows twelve.
This word names the middle of the daytime period. It comes after the morning. Many people take a break to eat then.

examples.en: Keelung is located in the north of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 基隆位於台灣北部。

examples.en: Migratory birds fly north when warm spring weather arrives.
examples.zh: 候鳥在溫暖春日來臨時往北飛翔。

examples.en: The compass needle always points steadily toward magnetic north.
examples.zh: 指南針的指針始終穩定指向地磁北方。

explains: This is one of the four main directions. It is opposite south. On many maps, it is shown at the top.
Face the direction where the sun rises. The direction to your left has this name. A compass can help you find it.
A map may show this direction with the letter N. An arrow often points that way. Checking the arrow helps you know how the map is turned.

examples.en: Dogs have a very sensitive nose.
examples.zh: 狗擁有非常靈敏的鼻子。

examples.en: I caught a cold and have a runny nose today.
examples.zh: 我感冒了，今天一直流鼻水。

examples.en: The sweet scent of jasmine tickled her nose.
examples.zh: 茉莉花的清甜香氣輕輕撲向她的鼻息。

explains: This is the part of the face used for smelling. Air moves through two small openings. It can also help someone breathe.
People use this body part to smell food and flowers. It sits between the eyes and mouth. A cold may make it run.
This word names a part of the face. It helps sense scents and take in air. A person may sneeze through it.

examples.en: I am not ready to leave.
examples.zh: 我還沒準備好離開。

examples.en: She did not see the sign.
examples.zh: 她沒有看到標誌。

examples.en: That answer is not correct.
examples.zh: 那個答案不正確。

explains: This small term makes a sentence negative. It changes an idea to the opposite. It often comes before an action word.
Use this small term when saying that something is false or fails to happen. It can change a positive statement. A short form with a verb is common.
This word tells that an action or idea is absent. It may come before a describing word. It helps make a sentence negative.

examples.en: The tasting card notes subtle flavor hints of dried apricot, lavender honey, and roasted almond.
examples.zh: 精品咖啡風味卡上詳盡標註著杏桃乾、薰衣草蜂蜜與烤杏仁的迷人風味調性。

examples.en: Experienced tasters distinguish subtle floral and fruit notes hidden behind initial chocolate aromas.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的感官品鑑師能輕易辨識出隱藏在第一道可可主調背後、極其幽微纖細的花香與熱帶果調。

examples.en: Each regional origin displays distinctive tasting notes influenced by processing methods and mountain elevation.
examples.zh: 每個不同國家產區的咖啡豆，在後製處理法與生長海拔的深刻烙印下，展現出截然不同的杯測風味調性。

entries.definition: 茉莉花、佛手柑與水蜜桃杯測風味調性；注意
explains: This is a short written message or reminder. It can also name a sound in music. As a verb, it means writing something down or noticing it.
A student may write this in a notebook. A tune is made from musical sounds with this name. The verb can mean paying attention to a detail.
This word names a brief message or record. It may also mean one sound in a song. As an action, it means writing down or observing something.

examples.en: Don't worry; there is nothing wrong with your computer.
examples.zh: 別擔心，你的電腦完全沒有任何問題。

examples.en: He claimed that nothing could change his determination to succeed.
examples.zh: 他聲稱沒有任何事物能動搖他成功的決心。

examples.en: There is nothing better than enjoying an icy treat on a blazing summer day.
examples.zh: 在酷熱炎夏沒有什麼比來上一份冰品更過癮的了。

explains: This refers to no thing at all. An empty box holds no objects. An empty plate holds no food.
A person may give this answer when asked what they did. It suggests that they did no activity worth mentioning. They may simply have rested all afternoon.
This can suggest that something has very little importance. A tiny mistake may hardly matter. A friend might use this idea to help someone feel less worried.

examples.en: Did you notice the bulletin board notice about tomorrow's schedule change?
examples.zh: 你有注意到公布欄上關於明天行程異動的通知嗎？

examples.en: I suddenly noticed a tiny scratch near the corner of my camera lens.
examples.zh: 我突然驚訝地注意到，我的單眼相機鏡頭邊角處有一道細微的淺淺刮痕。

examples.en: Employees must give at least two weeks' formal notice before resigning from their post.
examples.zh: 依照公司規定，員工在正式離職生效日前至少必須提前兩週遞交正式書面預告。

explains: It means seeing or hearing something and paying attention to it. A person may see a small mark. As a noun, it can be a written warning.
Use this word when someone becomes aware of a detail. A sign may tell people about a change. A person can see a new object in a room.
This verb means becoming aware of something. The noun may be a written message for the public. People may observe a small change.

examples.en: You should start preparing for the exam now.
examples.zh: 你現在就應該開始準備考試了。

examples.en: Right now, it is ten o'clock in the morning in Taipei.
examples.zh: 此時此刻，台北正是早上十點整。

examples.en: From now on, let's make an effort to speak only English in conversation club.
examples.zh: 從現在起，我們在會話社團裡要努力全程只說英語。

explains: It means at the present time. A person may be doing something at this moment. It can also show urgency.
Use this word for the time that is happening. A teacher may ask students to listen. It can introduce a change in a story.
This word points to the present. It can describe what is happening at this moment. People may use it to focus attention.

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
examples.zh: 能給我你的電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: Write the correct number in the blank space provided.
examples.zh: 在提供的空白處填入正確的數字。

examples.en: A large number of tourists visit Taipei 101 every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有大量遊客參觀台北 101。

explains: This is a value used in counting. Two and five are examples. Such values tell us how many objects there are.
A set of digits can identify a house or a phone. People use it to find the correct place or make a call. It acts like a label.
The verb describes giving items digits in a sequence. A teacher can mark the first question with 1. The next question gets 2.

examples.en: The hospital nurse took my temperature gently.
examples.zh: 醫院護理師溫柔地替我量體溫。

examples.en: Dedicated nurses provide compassionate care to patients in the ward.
examples.zh: 盡職盡責的護理師在病房裡給予病患悉心慈愛的照料。

examples.en: She studied nursing at university and passed her licensing exam.
examples.zh: 她在大學攻讀護理學，並通過了護理師執照考試。

examples.en: Dedicated nurses provide compassionate care around the clock.
examples.zh: 敬業的護理師提供全天候無微不至的照護。

examples.en: The school nurse treated the scraped knee of the crying student.
examples.zh: 學校保健護理師幫哭泣學生的擦傷膝蓋敷藥處理。

examples.en: She nursed her sick mother back to complete health through patience.
examples.zh: 她耐心地照料生病的母親直至其完全康復。

explains: This is a health worker who cares for sick people. They may help a doctor. As a verb, it can mean looking after someone.
People in this job check patients and give care. They may work in a clinic or hospital. The verb means providing care and comfort.
This word names a trained worker who helps patients. They may give medicine or check a person’s health. It can also mean caring for someone.

examples.en: Everything will be okay; just relax.
examples.zh: 一切都會沒事的，放輕鬆就好。

examples.en: Is it okay if I borrow your English dictionary for a few minutes?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的英語字典幾分鐘嗎？

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that the patient is doing okay after surgery.
examples.zh: 醫生確認病人在手術後狀況良好穩定。

explains: This short reply shows agreement or approval. It can mean that something is acceptable. People may use it in casual speech.
Use this expression to say that a plan is acceptable. It may answer a question about permission. It can also describe something in good condition.
This word group means all is well. It can agree with a suggestion. It may be used as an adjective or a reply.

examples.en: The train leaves at nine o’clock.
examples.zh: 火車九點出發。

examples.en: It is three o’clock now.
examples.zh: 現在是三點。

examples.en: Our class starts at eight o’clock.
examples.zh: 我們的課八點開始。

explains: This expression comes after a number to tell the hour. It means the time is exact to that hour. A clock may show three this way.
Use this short time word after a number. It tells that the number names an hour on the clock. It is often written with an apostrophe.
This word follows a clock number. It helps state an exact hour. People use it when giving the time.

examples.en: The lid of the box is blue.
examples.zh: 盒子的蓋子是藍色的。

examples.en: A cup of tea would be nice.
examples.zh: 來一杯茶會很不錯。

examples.en: She is a friend of my sister.
examples.zh: 她是我姊姊的朋友。

explains: This short preposition connects two nouns. It may show who owns something. It can tell what material an item uses.
Use this small word to link one thing with another. It can show a part that belongs to a whole. It may also introduce a source or cause.
This preposition can show a connection, amount, or material. It often appears between two nouns. The surrounding words tell the relationship.

examples.en: Please get off the bus at the next bus stop.
examples.zh: 請在下一站公車站下車。

examples.en: Take off your muddy hiking boots before walking onto the clean wooden floor.
examples.zh: 踏上乾淨的木質地板前請先脫下沾滿泥巴的登山靴。

examples.en: The plane took off smoothly into the clear blue morning sky.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩起飛，直入晴朗湛藍的晨空之中。

explains: It can mean moving away from a place. It may also mean that a device has stopped working. As an adjective, it can mean not working or not present.
Use this word when something is removed or separated. A light may stop shining. A person may take a day away from work.
This word can show that something is away or not active. It may describe a thing that has been removed. It can also mean a person is absent.

examples.en: Our head office is situated near the central metro station.
examples.zh: 我們的總辦公室位於中央捷運站附近。

examples.en: Many professionals work from home instead of commuting to the downtown office daily.
examples.zh: 許多專業人士選擇居家遠距辦公，而無需每日舟車勞頓通勤至市區辦公室。

examples.en: The doctor's private office is quiet, well-lit, and lined with medical journals.
examples.zh: 這位醫師的私人辦公診間清幽明亮，整齊陳列著各類權威醫學期刊。

explains: A room where people do desk work is found in a business building. Workers may meet there and use computers. Some public workers also help people in this place.
This place has desks, phones, and papers. A manager may work there each day. People visit it to ask for help with a service.
A business can have many rooms for its workers. People write plans, answer calls, and meet in this place. A local government may also have one.

examples.en: The officer helped the lost child find her parents.
examples.zh: 警察協助迷路的孩子找到父母。

examples.en: A police officer stopped the cars at the crossing.
examples.zh: 一名警察在路口指揮車輛停下。

examples.en: The officer spoke calmly to the worried crowd.
examples.zh: 那位警官冷靜地對擔心的人群說話。

explains: This person has a job in the police, army, or another public service. The role may include helping people and keeping order. A uniform can show the person’s job.
A person with this role may lead a team. The work can involve rules or public safety. The title often comes before a family name.
This worker has a special place in an organization. The person may carry out a public duty. Some people use the title when speaking politely.

examples.en: We often visit night markets on Saturday evenings.
examples.zh: 我們週六晚上常常逛夜市。

examples.en: How often do you practice speaking English with your classmates?
examples.zh: 你多久和同學練習一次英語會話？

examples.en: It often rains heavily in Taipei during summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 台北夏天午後常常下起傾盆大雨。

explains: It means something happens many times. A person may visit a place each week. This word tells that an event is common.
Use this word for an action done on many days. A student may read before bed. It means more than sometimes but less than always.
This word tells that an event happens again and again. It can describe a habit. It does not mean every single time.

examples.en: Penetrating tung oil cures inside wood pores, creating a durable satin finish without plastic film buildup.
examples.zh: 具備高滲透力的天然熟桐油深入木質毛孔固化，呈現出無塑料反光的絲絨霧面高級質感。

examples.en: Olive oil and sesame oil are staple healthy cooking ingredients across Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.
examples.zh: 特級初榨橄欖油與純黑麻油，分別是地中海料理與台灣傳統養生烹調中最重要的健康食用油脂。

examples.en: The maintenance technician checked the car's engine oil level using the dipstick before the road trip.
examples.zh: 在出發展開長途公路自駕旅行前，保養廠技師抽出機油尺仔細確認了汽車的引擎機油油量。

entries.definition: 熟桐油與天然植物護木油；油
explains: This liquid comes from plants or animals. People cook food with some kinds. Other kinds help machines move.
A thick liquid can help a pan stay smooth. It may also come from seeds or rocks. Some types are used in food, and some are used for engines.
People use this substance in cooking and making things. It can come from olives or other seeds. A car needs a special kind to help its parts move.

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its old historic temples.
examples.zh: 台南以其古老的歷史廟宇聞名。

examples.en: How old will your younger brother turn next month?
examples.zh: 你弟弟下個月將滿幾歲？

examples.en: She loves listening to old vinyl records from the nineteen eighties.
examples.zh: 她喜歡聽八零年代的老黑膠唱片。

explains: It describes something that has existed for a long time. It may also describe a person who has lived many years. The opposite idea is young or new.
Use this describing word for a thing that is not recent. A family may live in a home for many years. It can also describe someone late in life.
This word can tell that an item has been used for many years. It may describe a very long time in history. It can also mean no longer young.

examples.en: Place the computer on the desk.
examples.zh: 把電腦放在書桌上。

examples.en: There is a picture hanging on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上掛著一幅畫。

examples.en: What channel is the baseball game on tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚棒球比賽在第幾台播出？

explains: It can show that a thing rests above a surface. A cup may sit atop a table. It can also tell that a machine is working.
Use this small term to say something touches the top of a surface. A coat may hang there. It can also describe a light that shines.
This word can tell that an event is happening now. A computer may be working. It may also show contact with a surface.

examples.en: I have visited that small island once.
examples.zh: 我曾經去過那座小島一次。

examples.en: Once the bell rings, the children leave the room.
examples.zh: 鈴聲一響，孩子們就離開房間。

examples.en: She once lived near the train station.
examples.zh: 她以前住在火車站附近。

explains: It means one time in the past. A person may tell when they visited a place. It can also mean a single time.
Use this word for an event that happened at some past point. A child may try a food one time. It can also mean as soon as.
This word can describe a single occasion. It may point to something that happened before now. It can also begin a sentence about a condition.

examples.en: Online shopping has become very convenient in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣線上購物已經變得非常方便。

examples.en: Many students take online courses to learn programming languages.
examples.zh: 許多學生透過線上課程學習程式語言。

examples.en: Is customer service available online twenty-four hours a day?
examples.zh: 客服人員有提供全天候二十四小時線上服務嗎？

examples.en: Students can take interactive English quizzes online anytime.
examples.zh: 學生們隨時都可以在線上進行互動式英語測驗。

examples.en: The hotel booking system is currently down, but it will come back online shortly.
examples.zh: 飯店訂房系統目前正在維護，但很快就會重新恢復連線上線。

examples.en: Online fraud has become increasingly sophisticated, requiring enhanced consumer vigilance.
examples.zh: 線上網路詐騙手法日益精巧複雜，需要消費者提高防範警覺。

entries.definition: 線上的；在線上；連網；連線地
explains: It describes a computer or phone connected to the web. People can read news and watch videos this way. They may also talk with friends.
A person can use a network to shop from home. Classes may happen through a screen. This word describes that kind of connection.
This word tells that a device can reach the web. People send messages and find facts there. A shop can sell things through a site.

examples.en: There is only one piece of chocolate cake left.
examples.zh: 只剩下最後一塊巧克力蛋糕了。

examples.en: He is the only student in our class who speaks four fluent languages.
examples.zh: 他是我們班上唯一一位能流利說四種語言的學生。

examples.en: Not only did she complete the marathon, but she also beat her personal best.
examples.zh: 她不僅跑完了馬拉松全程，甚至還打破了自己的個人最佳紀錄。

explains: It means one and no more. A person may choose one color. It can also describe something special or without a match.
Use this word when just one thing is allowed or present. It can point to the single person who did something. It may also mean nothing but.
This word limits a choice to one thing. A child may have this as a favorite toy. It can also mean no one else.

examples.en: The supermarket is open 24 hours a day.
examples.zh: 這家超市一天 24 小時營業。

examples.en: Please open the front window to let fresh air circulate.
examples.zh: 請打開前窗讓新鮮空氣流通。

examples.en: The new library branch will open to the public next Monday.
examples.zh: 新的圖書館分館將於下週一對公眾開放。

explains: It can mean moving a door so people can enter. A shop may welcome customers. It can also describe a person who is willing to listen to ideas.
Use this word when a door is not shut. A store may let people come inside. It can also mean ready for use.
This word can describe a clear path or an available choice. A lid may be moved aside. A school or shop may let visitors enter.

examples.en: Would you like green tea or black tea?
examples.zh: 你想要喝綠茶還是紅茶？

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the morning school bus!
examples.zh: 快一點，否則我們要錯過晨間校車了！

examples.en: You can submit your homework in person or send it by email.
examples.zh: 你可以親自繳交作業，或是透過電子郵件寄送。

explains: This joins two possible choices. A person may choose between tea and water. The small joining word separates the options.
This can introduce another way of saying something. A speaker may give a second name for an object. Both names refer to the same thing.
This can connect an action with a warning. One choice is leaving now. The consequence of waiting is missing the bus.

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky orange and gold.
examples.zh: 夕陽把天空染成了橘金雙色。

examples.en: Eating an orange provides your body with rich vitamin C.
examples.zh: 吃一顆柳橙能為身體提供豐富的維生素 C。

examples.en: Road construction workers wear bright orange safety vests.
examples.zh: 道路施工人員穿著鮮橘色的反光安全背心。

explains: This fruit has a round shape and a bright skin. People peel it before eating. Its taste is sweet and a little sharp.
It is a color between red and yellow. A fruit with this color has the same name. People may drink its juice at breakfast.
This word can name a round fruit or its color. The fruit has sections inside. Its juice is often served cold.

examples.en: Are you ready to order your lunch now?
examples.zh: 請問你現在準備好要點午餐了嗎？

examples.en: Please arrange all historical documents in chronological order.
examples.zh: 請依照時間先後順序整齊排列所有歷史文獻檔案。

examples.en: The police officer issued a strict order commanding spectators to remain behind barricades.
examples.zh: 警官下達了嚴格指令，命令圍觀群眾留在防護欄後方。

explains: It can mean putting things in a line by the way they come. A waiter may also bring food someone asked for. It may be a rule from a person in charge.
Use this word for asking a shop to send something. A list may show the way things should go. A leader can tell a team what to do.
This word can describe the way items are arranged. It can also mean a request for food. A person in charge may give one to a group.

examples.en: Are there any other questions about the grammar topic?
examples.zh: 關於這個文法主題還有其他任何問題嗎？

examples.en: We should listen respectfully to the opinions of other classmates.
examples.zh: 我們應該尊重並傾聽其他同學所表達的意見。

examples.en: On the other hand, online learning provides unparalleled schedule flexibility.
examples.zh: 另一方面，線上學習提供了無可比擬的時間彈性。

explains: It means a person or thing that is not this one. A child may choose one color, then a different color. It can also describe what is left.
Use this word for an extra choice in a group. One shoe may be here, while its mate is somewhere else. It can point to people who are not in the group being discussed.
This word means a separate person or thing. A student may use a different page. It can also talk about people in a wider group.

examples.en: The cat ran out of the house.
examples.zh: 貓跑出了房子。

examples.en: The bread was sold out before noon.
examples.zh: 麵包在中午前就賣完了。

examples.en: We went out to play after school.
examples.zh: 我們放學後出去玩。

explains: It can mean away from the inside of a place. A child may walk through a door to the street. It can also mean finished or no longer available.
Use this word when someone leaves a room. A light may stop shining. It can also describe a team that has been removed from a game.
This word may show movement from inside to the open air. A food item can be gone from a shop. It can also tell that a fire is no longer burning.

examples.en: It is raining heavily outside; don't go out.
examples.zh: 外面正下著傾盆大雨，別出門。

examples.en: Please wait outside the doctor's office until your number is called.
examples.zh: 請在診間外面等候叫號。

examples.en: The crisp outer crust of freshly baked French bread is delicious.
examples.zh: 現烤法國麵包酥脆的外層表皮非常美味。

explains: It means in a place that is not inside. Children may play in the yard. It can also describe the part of a building that faces the street.
Use this word for a place beyond a room or building. A person may wait in fresh air. It can describe the outer side of an object.
This word points to the area beyond a door. A table may stand in the yard. It may also describe the surface that people can see.

examples.en: The rainbow arched gracefully over the tall green trees.
examples.zh: 彩虹優美地高掛在翠綠大樹上方。

examples.en: The long examination period is finally over, and summer vacation has begun!
examples.zh: 漫長的考試週終於結束了，暑假正式展開囉！

examples.en: More than five thousand runners crossed over the scenic coastal bridge.
examples.zh: 超過五千名長跑跑者跨越了這座壯觀的跨海大橋。

explains: It can mean higher than something. A lamp hangs above a table. It may also show that one thing crosses a line or covers a surface.
Use this word for a time that has ended. A game may be finished. It can also mean more than a number or amount.
This word can describe movement across a wall or road. A blanket may cover a bed. It may also tell that an event is finished.

examples.en: I made my own lunch today.
examples.zh: 我今天自己做了午餐。

examples.en: The dog has its own bed by the door.
examples.zh: 狗在門邊有自己的床。

examples.en: She owns a small shop near the school.
examples.zh: 她在學校附近有一家小店。

explains: It means belonging to one person. A child may have a room for personal use. It can also mean doing something without help.
Use this word for something a person has. A student may finish a task alone. It can also mean to say that an idea is true.
This word tells that something belongs to the speaker. A family may live in its personal home. It can also describe acting by oneself.

examples.en: Pack your bags the night before your school trip.
examples.zh: 在學校校外教學的前一晚把行李打包好。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack comfortable walking shoes and sunscreen.
examples.zh: 別忘了把舒適的步行鞋和防曬乳打包進行李。

examples.en: A pack of stray dogs wandered quietly along the river embankment.
examples.zh: 一群流浪狗沿著河堤安靜地漫步。

explains: It means putting clothes and other things into a bag for a trip. A group of dogs can also be called this. It may name a set of items wrapped together.
Use this word when getting ready to travel. A student may put books into a school bag. It can also mean placing many things close together.
This word can describe a group of animals. It can also mean preparing a suitcase for travel. A store may sell a set of items together.

examples.en: The postman delivered a heavy online shopping package.
examples.zh: 郵差送來了一個沉甸甸的網購包裹。

examples.en: The hotel offers a weekend spa package including dinner and massage.
examples.zh: 飯店推出了包含晚餐與按摩的週末水療套裝行程。

examples.en: Handle this delicate glass package with extra care.
examples.zh: 搬運這件易碎玻璃包裹時要格外小心。

explains: A shop may send an item inside a box. The box and its contents can have this name. It can also mean a set of services sold together.
This is something wrapped or boxed for sending. A person may wait for it to arrive. A computer plan may include several tools in one set.
A delivery may bring this to a home. It can hold a gift or books. The word can also describe a group of things offered as one deal.

examples.en: Turn to page fifty-five of the storybook.
examples.zh: 翻到故事書的第五十五頁。

examples.en: The web page failed to load properly due to a weak internet connection.
examples.zh: 由於網路連線不穩，該網頁無法正常載入。

examples.en: She bookmarked the final page before turning off the reading lamp.
examples.zh: 在關掉床頭閱讀燈前，她在最後一頁夾上了書籤。

explains: A book has a flat sheet with words on it. A reader turns to one to continue. A person on a loudspeaker may use this word to ask someone to come.
This is one side of a sheet in a book. A child may read several before bed. A worker can use a loudspeaker to call a person.
A web site can show a screen with facts and pictures. A printed book has many of these. Someone may also be called through a speaker.

examples.en: They painted the kitchen yellow.
examples.zh: 他們把廚房漆成黃色。

examples.en: My brother paints pictures of birds.
examples.zh: 我哥哥畫鳥的圖畫。

examples.en: The paint on the fence is still wet.
examples.zh: 柵欄上的油漆還是濕的。

explains: It means putting color onto a wall or picture. An artist may use a brush. It can also name the colored liquid used for this work.
Use this word for making a picture with colored liquid. A family may cover a room wall with a new shade. The word can also mean a picture made this way.
A person can make a scene with a brush and colors. A house may get a fresh wall covering. The material comes in a can.

examples.en: Pair your smartwatch with your health app.
examples.zh: 將您的智慧手錶與健康 App 進行配對。

examples.en: She bought a stylish pair of black leather boots for winter.
examples.zh: 她為冬天買了一雙時髦亮麗的黑色真皮靴。

examples.en: The teacher asked students to pair up for the conversational role-play.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們兩人一組進行會話角色扮演練習。

explains: Two things that belong together can be called this. A person may buy two gloves that look alike. It can also mean joining two people or things.
Use this word for two matching items. Shoes are often sold together. It can also describe a couple working as a team.
This word means two that go together. A person may match a sock with its mate. As an action, it can mean bringing two things together.

examples.en: These black pants fit me very well.
examples.zh: 這條黑長褲我穿起來非常合身。

examples.en: He rolled up his pants while walking along the beach.
examples.zh: 沿著海灘漫步時，他捲起了長褲褲管。

examples.en: You need to iron your dress pants before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮開始前，你需要先熨燙你的西裝長褲。

explains: These are clothes that cover both legs. People wear them over underwear. They may be made from cloth or denim.
A person puts one leg in each opening. The garment can be short or long. It often has pockets at the front.
This clothing has two leg sections. Many people wear it with a shirt. It can be made from soft cloth or strong denim.

examples.en: Do you have a blank piece of paper for me?
examples.zh: 你有一張空白紙可以給我嗎？

examples.en: Please recycle waste paper to save trees and protect our planet.
examples.zh: 請回收廢紙以保護樹木與珍惜地球資源。

examples.en: The university professor published an influential academic research paper.
examples.zh: 那位大學教授發表了一篇具有影響力的學術研究論文。

explains: A thin sheet made from trees can be used for writing. A student may draw or do homework on it. It can also mean a school test or a set of news.
