examples.en: He wore a thin coat in the rain.
examples.zh: 他下雨時穿了一件薄外套。

examples.en: Cut the apple into thin slices.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成薄片。

explains: It means having little distance from one side to another. Paper may be light and narrow. A person may wear a light coat in warm weather.
A board can have little depth. A hair may be narrow. This word is the opposite of thick.
This describing word can mean narrow or low in weight. A slice of bread may be very fine. A person may have a light body.

examples.en: That thing is very heavy.
examples.zh: 那個東西很重。

examples.en: I need one more thing from the shop.
examples.zh: 我還需要商店裡的一樣東西。

examples.en: The strange thing made us laugh.
examples.zh: 那件奇怪的事讓我們笑了。

explains: It means an object, idea, or item. A person may have one in a bag. The word can refer to almost anything.
A child may point at an object and ask what it is. This general word can name an item. It can also mean an event or matter.
Use this word when an exact name is not known. A bag may hold an unknown item. It can also mean an idea.

examples.en: I think English is interesting and useful.
examples.zh: 我認為英文很有趣也很實用。

examples.en: Take some time to think carefully before making a major decision.
examples.zh: 在做重大決定之前，花點時間深思熟慮。

examples.en: I think so too; that seems like the most practical solution.
examples.zh: 我也這麼認為，這似乎是最切實可行的方案。

explains: It means using the mind to form an idea. A person may consider a question. It can also mean having an opinion.
A student may use the mind to solve a puzzle. A person can also believe something is true. This verb describes what goes on in the mind.
This action happens in the mind. A person may form an idea about a friend. It can also mean planning.

examples.en: Our apartment is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓在三樓。

examples.en: Tuesday is the third day of the work week.
examples.zh: 星期二是工作週的第三天。

examples.en: One third of the students voted in favor of the new proposal.
examples.zh: 三分之一的學生投票贊成這項新提案。

explains: This position comes after second and before fourth. Two children stand ahead of a child in line. That child holds this position.
This can mean one of three equal parts. A cake can be cut into three matching pieces. Each piece is one such share.
This describes item number three in an ordered group. March holds this place among the months. A building may also have a floor with this position.

examples.en: This is my new book.
examples.zh: 這是我的新書。

examples.en: I like this blue shirt.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這件藍色襯衫。

examples.en: This apple is very sweet.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果很甜。

explains: It points to one person or object near a speaker. A child may hold a toy while talking. The word often comes before a noun.
A person can point to a nearby item. It may introduce an example. It is used for one thing close by.
A small word refers to an object close at hand. A speaker may use it before giving details. It can also introduce a person.

examples.en: Those birds are flying south.
examples.zh: 那些鳥正往南飛。

examples.en: I remember those happy days.
examples.zh: 我記得那些快樂的日子。

examples.en: Those shoes belong to my brother.
examples.zh: 那些鞋子是我哥哥的。

explains: It points to more than one person or object far away. A speaker may point at birds across a field. The word comes before a noun.
A person may talk about faraway objects on a shelf. It refers to things over there. It is used for a group.
This word refers to a group that is not nearby. A child may point at stars. It comes before a plural noun.

examples.en: The climb was exhausting; the mountain view was stunning, though.
examples.zh: 爬山過程很累人；不過山頂的風景真是絕美無比。

examples.en: Even though he had never visited Taipei before, he navigated the MRT with ease.
examples.zh: 即便他在此之前從未造訪過台北，他依然能毫不費力地輕鬆搭乘捷運趴趴走。

examples.en: I haven't heard from him in weeks; I am sure he is doing well, though.
examples.zh: 雖然我已經好幾個禮拜沒收到他的音訊了；不過我深信他一定過得很好。

explains: It means even if something is true. A person may go outside despite light rain. It can also mean however.
A speaker may use this word when adding a contrast. A child may keep trying despite a hard task. It often begins a sentence.
This word joins two ideas that do not fully agree. A person may smile despite feeling tired. It can mean even if.

examples.en: Over five thousand runners joined the marathon.
examples.zh: 超過五千名跑者參加了馬拉松。

examples.en: This historic temple has stood for more than a thousand years.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古廟已經屹立了一千多年。

examples.en: Thousands of migratory birds visit the wetlands every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天都有數千隻候鳥造訪這片濕地。

explains: It means ten groups of one hundred. A town may have this many people. It can also mean a very large amount.
A number of this size is ten times one hundred. A book may have many pages, but far fewer. Its plural form can describe a huge amount.
This number comes after nine hundred ninety-nine. A person may count this many stars in a story. It is a large amount.

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.
examples.zh: 我吞嚥時喉嚨會痛。

examples.en: The singer cleared her throat.
examples.zh: 歌手清了清喉嚨。

examples.en: He had a sore throat yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天喉嚨痛。

explains: Food and air pass through this body part. A person may feel pain there when sick. It is between the mouth and chest.
A doctor may look inside this part of the body. A singer uses it to make sounds. A scarf can keep it warm.
This passage carries food down toward the stomach. It can feel dry or painful. A person may clear it before speaking.

examples.en: The train speeds through the long Hsuehshan Tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的雪山隧道。

examples.en: Sunshine filtered gently through the green leaves of the ancient banyan tree.
examples.zh: 陽光透過古老榕樹的翠綠樹葉柔和地灑落下來。

examples.en: We worked tirelessly through the night to prepare all the presentation slides.
examples.zh: 我們通宵達旦地工作，連夜準備所有的簡報投影片。

examples.en: The train sped through the long mountain tunnel into Yilan.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的山脈隧道駛入宜蘭。

examples.en: Sunlight filtered softly through the bamboo leaves onto the stone trail.
examples.zh: 金黃色的晨曦陽光穿透層層竹葉縫隙，溫柔灑落在青石健行步道上。

examples.en: He achieved academic success through sheer perseverance and daily dedication.
examples.zh: 他完全是憑藉著堅定不移的過人毅力與日復一日的苦讀，取得了學業成就。

entries.definition: 穿過；透過；自始至終；通過；憑藉
explains: It means from one side to another. A person may walk inside a door and come out elsewhere. It can also mean during a whole period.
A tunnel carries cars beneath a hill. A needle can pass inside cloth. A person may learn by practice over time.
This word describes movement inside or across something. Light can pass across glass. A person may look across an opening.

examples.en: Throw the baseball straight into the catcher's glove.
examples.zh: 把棒球筆直投進捕手的手套中。

examples.en: Please don't throw litter on the street; place it in recycling bins.
examples.zh: 請不要在街上亂丟垃圾，請放入資源回收桶。

examples.en: The playful dog loves running to fetch balls when you throw them.
examples.zh: 當你把球丟出去時，愛玩的狗狗非常喜歡跑去把球撿回來。

explains: It means sending something through the air with the hand. A child may toss a ball. It can also mean removing something away.
A person can send a paper plane across a room. A player may toss a ball to a friend. The word may also mean having a party.
This action moves an object by using the arm. A baseball player does it toward a teammate. It can also mean confusing someone.

examples.en: Do you have your train ticket ready?
examples.zh: 你的火車票準備好了嗎？

examples.en: Concert tickets sold out within two minutes of going on sale.
examples.zh: 演唱會門票開賣兩分鐘之內便全數售罄。

examples.en: Scan the QR code on your mobile ticket at the automatic turnstile gate.
examples.zh: 在自動驗票閘門上感應掃描手機電子票券上的 QR 碼。

explains: People show this paper or card before entering a place. A bus rider may buy one. It may also let someone see a movie.
A small paper gives permission to travel. A person may keep it in a wallet. A gate worker checks it before entry.
This item may have a seat number. A passenger needs one for a trip. A theater may sell one at its door.

examples.en: Please tidy your room before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前請整理你的房間。

examples.en: The desk looks tidy now.
examples.zh: 書桌現在看起來很整齊。

examples.en: She keeps her books in a tidy row.
examples.zh: 她把書整齊地排成一列。

explains: It means neat and in order. A child may put toys away. A room can look clean after work.
A person may arrange books on a shelf. A bedroom can have no mess. This word describes things kept in order.
This word means clean and well arranged. A desk may have no clutter. A person can make a room neat.

examples.en: The exciting volleyball match ended in a 2-2 tie.
examples.zh: 這場精彩的排球賽最終以二比二打成平手。

examples.en: He wore a crisp white dress shirt with a handsome silk tie.
examples.zh: 他身穿筆挺白襯衫並繫著一條帥氣的真絲領帶。

examples.en: Remember to tie your shoelaces tightly before heading out for a run.
examples.zh: 出門跑步前記得把鞋帶繫緊。

explains: Two people may fasten cloth around a neck. A person can make a bow from a ribbon. The word can also mean a game with the same score.
A boy may wear one with a shirt. A person can connect shoelaces with a knot. A match can finish with equal scores.
This word can mean a strip of cloth worn at the neck. It can also describe joining two ends. A close result may have no winner.

examples.en: Tigers have orange fur with black stripes.
examples.zh: 老虎有著帶黑條紋的橘色毛皮。

examples.en: Bengal tigers are known for their strength and solitary lifestyle.
examples.zh: 孟加拉虎以其力量和獨居習性而聞名。

examples.en: That strict warning turned out to be nothing more than a paper tiger.
examples.zh: 那個嚴格的警告結果只不過是一隻紙老虎。

explains: This large wild cat has dark stripes on orange fur. It lives in parts of Asia. It hunts other animals for food.
A powerful cat may live in a forest. Each one has a different stripe pattern. It can swim well.
This animal is the largest kind of cat. It has sharp teeth and strong legs. A young one is called a cub.

examples.en: What time is it now?
examples.zh: 現在幾點了？

examples.en: We had a great time at the amusement park.
examples.zh: 我們在遊樂園玩得非常開心。

examples.en: Please make sure you arrive on time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會請務必準時抵達。

explains: It means minutes, hours, days, or years. A clock helps people know it. A person may wait for a bus.
A day has twenty-four hours. A person may use a calendar to count it. The word can also mean a good moment.
This measure tells how long something lasts. A watch tracks it. People may spend it with friends.

examples.en: In the US, it is customary to leave a 15% tip.
examples.zh: 在美國，留下 15% 的小費是當地的慣例。

examples.en: Here is a helpful tip to improve your daily English listening skills.
examples.zh: 這裡有一個改善你日常英語聽力技巧的實用秘訣。

examples.en: The waiter smiled gratefully when we gave him a generous tip.
examples.zh: 當我們給了豐厚的小費時，服務生感激地微笑致意。

examples.en: Viewers can tip their favorite indie musicians directly via the virtual tip jar.
examples.zh: 觀看線上演出的熱情粉絲可透過虛擬小費箱直接線上打賞抖內支持獨立創作歌手。

examples.en: In many countries, it is customary to tip restaurant waiters between 15% and 20%.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，用餐後給餐廳服務生 15% 至 20% 的小費是一項慣例。

examples.en: The experienced photographer gave us a helpful tip on shooting in low light.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的攝影師給了我們一個在微光環境下拍攝的實用技巧秘訣。

entries.definition: 小費；秘訣；給小費；打賞贊助；抖內；實用秘訣
explains: The end of a tool may be called this. A person may give helpful advice. It can also mean leaving a small extra amount.
A pencil has a sharp end. A cook may add a little salt. A person can offer a clue to help someone.
This word can mean a small piece at an end. It can also mean advice or a small amount of money left for a waiter. A small clue may help someone solve a puzzle.

examples.en: I feel tired after a long day of classes.
examples.zh: 上了一整天的課我感到很疲累。

examples.en: After hours of continuous typing, my eyes felt dry and tired.
examples.zh: 連續打字數小時後，我的眼睛感到乾澀疲倦。

examples.en: She was tired of eating convenience store lunchboxes every single day.
examples.zh: 她厭倦了每天都吃便利商店的微波便當。

explains: It means needing sleep or rest. A person may yawn after a long day. A child may feel this before bed.
A worker may feel low in energy after many hours. A soft bed can help. This word describes someone who needs rest.
A person who did not sleep well may feel this. A long walk can make legs feel heavy. Rest can help.

examples.en: I want to go home now.
examples.zh: 我現在想回家。

examples.en: Give the letter to your teacher.
examples.zh: 把信交給你的老師。

examples.en: We walked to the park together.
examples.zh: 我們一起走到公園。

explains: This particle comes before a verb and names an action or goal. A person may hope for food. It can point toward a place.
A short word can join a verb and an idea. A child may hope for a gift. It can also show direction.
A speaker may place it before an action word. A person can head toward a place. It can also show who receives something.

examples.en: What day is it today?
examples.zh: 今天是星期幾？

examples.en: Today is my classmate's fourteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我同班同學的十四歲生日。

examples.en: I have a lot of things to accomplish today.
examples.zh: 我今天有很多事情需要完成。

explains: It means the current day. A calendar shows its date. A person may do homework before bedtime.
People wake up and begin a new day. The word can mean at this time. A store may be open now.
This word names the day happening now. A person may ask what date it is. It can also mean in modern times.

examples.en: I stubbed my toe on the chair.
examples.zh: 我的腳趾撞到椅子。

examples.en: The baby curled her toes.
examples.zh: 嬰兒蜷起腳趾。

examples.en: He hurt his big toe while running.
examples.zh: 他跑步時大腳趾受傷了。

explains: A small part at the end of a foot helps with balance. A person has five on each foot. Shoes cover them.
A child may wiggle one after taking off a sock. This body part can help push a ball. It is smaller than a finger.
Each foot has several small digits. They help people stand and walk. A nail grows at the end.

examples.en: We worked together on the project.
examples.zh: 我們一起完成這個專案。

examples.en: The children sang together at school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校一起唱歌。

examples.en: Put the two books together on the shelf.
examples.zh: 把這兩本書一起放在架子上。

explains: It means with another person or group. Friends may eat a meal at one table. Families can travel in one car.
A team works toward one goal. People may walk beside each other. This word describes being in one place at the same time.
It means joined in one group. A child may play beside a friend. People can do an activity as a team.

examples.en: Press the dual-flush button to save water after using the toilet.
examples.zh: 使用完馬桶後按下兩段式節水沖水按鈕。

examples.en: Clean the ceramic toilet bowl with a disinfectant brush regularly.
examples.zh: 定期使用消毒清潔刷清洗陶瓷馬桶內壁。

examples.en: The restaurant restroom provides clean toilet seat sanitizing wipes.
examples.zh: 餐廳洗手間貼心備有乾淨的馬桶坐墊消毒擦拭巾。

explains: This is the bowl people use when passing waste from the body. It is usually in a bathroom. Most kinds use water to carry waste away.
This fixture often has a seat and a lid. People sit on the seat to use it. Afterward, they flush and wash their hands.
In some places this word can also mean the room containing the fixture. A traveler may ask where that room is. A sign helps them find it.

examples.en: Cherry tomatoes grown in Chiayi are very sweet.
examples.zh: 嘉義種植的玉女小番茄非常香甜。

examples.en: Slice fresh red tomatoes to add inside the turkey sandwich.
examples.zh: 切幾片新鮮紅番茄加入火雞三明治中。

examples.en: Tomato scrambled eggs is a beloved comfort dish in Taiwanese households.
examples.zh: 番茄炒蛋是深受台灣家庭喜愛的家常暖心料理。

explains: This red fruit is used in salads and sauces. It grows on a plant. A person can slice it for a sandwich.
A round food item may be red or yellow. It has seeds inside. People use it in soup or pasta sauce.
A cook may chop this fruit for a salad. It grows on a vine. Some people call it a vegetable in cooking.

examples.en: We will have an English quiz tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天有英文小考。

examples.en: Tomorrow will be sunny and warm according to the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 根據天氣預報，明天將是晴朗溫暖的好天氣。

examples.en: See you at the library tomorrow afternoon!
examples.zh: 明天下午圖書館見！

explains: It means the day after today. A person may make plans for the next day. The word can also mean in the future.
A child may ask what will happen the next day. A calendar can show it. It is one day after now.
This word points to the next day. A person may finish homework then. The future can begin very soon.

examples.en: We will have dinner together tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚要一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: Tonight is cool and clear.
examples.zh: 今晚天氣涼爽晴朗。

examples.en: I need to finish this book tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚需要讀完這本書。

explains: It means during the evening of the current day. A person may eat dinner then. The sky is dark at that time.
People may watch a movie after sunset. A child may get ready for bed. This word names the evening happening now.
A family may meet for dinner this evening. The word can also be used as a friendly greeting after dark. It refers to the current date.

examples.en: This jacket is too small for me.
examples.zh: 這件夾克對我來說太小了。

examples.en: I am going to the night market tonight; do you want to come too?
examples.zh: 我今晚要去逛夜市，你也想一起來嗎？

examples.en: Don't worry too much about minor mistakes in your first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿中微小的錯誤不必太過擔憂。

explains: It means more than is needed. A person may drink an extra cup of milk. It can also show agreement.
A bag may be heavier than a child can carry. This word can mean also. A person may say yes using it.
It can mean an amount greater than needed. A child may have an extra cookie. It can also describe something done very much.

examples.en: A hammer is a useful tool.
examples.zh: 榔頭是很好用的工具。

examples.en: The cook chose a sharp tool to cut the fruit.
examples.zh: 廚師選了一把鋒利的工具來切水果。

examples.en: A garden tool can help remove weeds.
examples.zh: 園藝工具可以幫忙拔除雜草。

explains: It is an object that helps people do a task. A hammer can drive a nail. A spoon helps with food.
A worker may carry an item for fixing a car. A kitchen has items for cutting and stirring. The object makes work easier.
This word means a device used for a job. A rake helps clean leaves. A computer program can do a task as well.

examples.en: The dentist checked my tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫檢查了我的牙齒。

examples.en: Brush each tooth before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前把每顆牙齒都刷乾淨。

examples.en: A loose tooth fell out while he ate.
examples.zh: 他吃東西時一顆鬆動的牙齒掉了。

explains: Hard white parts in a mouth help cut and chew food. A dentist checks them. A baby grows its first ones.
A person brushes these twice a day. They help break food into small bits. An adult may have thirty-two.
A smile can show these white parts. A dentist can fix one that hurts. They are held in the jaw.

examples.en: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 我們在中午抵達了山頂。

examples.en: She ranked at the very top of her graduating high school class.
examples.zh: 她在高中畢業班中名列前茅、榮登榜首。

examples.en: Put the heavy storage boxes at the bottom and lighter ones on top.
examples.zh: 把沉重的收納箱放在底部，較輕的放在頂層。

explains: It means the highest part of something. A hat may sit there. A mountain can reach high above the land.
A cup may be filled up to its edge. A person can stand at the highest point of a hill. The word can also mean a lid.
This word can name the upper part of a box. A cap may cover it. A person who is best may be at the highest level.

examples.en: Our topic today is ocean animals.
examples.zh: 我們今天的主題是海洋動物。

examples.en: The teacher chose a new topic for class.
examples.zh: 老師為課堂選了一個新主題。

examples.en: They talked about the topic after lunch.
examples.zh: 他們午餐後討論了這個主題。

explains: A person may talk about one area in a class. A book can cover animals or space. People may ask a question about it.
This word means a theme or area of discussion. A teacher may choose one for a lesson. Friends can change what they talk about.
A story may focus on one idea. A student may write about it. It can be something people discuss.

examples.en: The total cost is ten dollars.
examples.zh: 總費用是十美元。

examples.en: Add the scores to find the total.
examples.zh: 把分數加起來找出總和。

examples.en: The total number of guests was twenty.
examples.zh: 賓客總數是二十人。

explains: It means the full amount after adding parts. A bill may show a final cost. A person can add points from a game.
A score can be found by counting all points. A store receipt shows how much was paid. This word means the whole sum.
This amount includes every part. A teacher may count all student answers. It can also mean the number of people in a group.

examples.en: Please do not touch the art exhibits in the museum.
examples.zh: 在博物館內請勿觸摸藝術展品。

examples.en: Modern smartphones operate via smooth glass touch screens.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機透過滑順的玻璃觸控螢幕進行操作。

examples.en: Her sincere thank-you speech deeply touched everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她真摯誠懇的致謝感言深深打動了在場的每個人。

explains: It means placing a hand or finger on something. A person may feel a soft cloth. It can also mean having an effect on someone.
A child may reach for a warm cup. A doctor may check a patient. The word can also mean a small amount of feeling.
This action uses the hand to feel an object. A person may gently tap a shoulder. It can also mean affecting someone’s feelings.

examples.en: Dry your hands with a clean towel.
examples.zh: 用乾淨的毛巾把手擦乾。

examples.en: Hang the wet bath towel outside in the sun to dry.
examples.zh: 把濕浴巾掛在外面曬太陽晾乾。

examples.en: Bring an extra beach towel when you visit the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 去游泳池時多帶一條海灘毛巾。

explains: People dry their bodies with this soft cloth after bathing. It can soak up water. A beach bag may hold one.
A person may wrap one around wet hair. It is made from cloth. A kitchen may have a smaller one for dishes.
This fabric item helps dry hands and body. It may hang near a sink. A swimmer can carry one to the pool.

examples.en: My town has a new library.
examples.zh: 我的城鎮有一間新圖書館。

examples.en: The small town is near the river.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在河流附近。

examples.en: We drove through the town on our way home.
examples.zh: 我們回家途中開車經過這個城鎮。

explains: A place with many homes and shops is smaller than a large city. People may know their neighbors. A main street can go through it.
This community may have a school and a library. People live there and go to work. It can be found near farms.
A small city-like place may have streets and houses. A bus can bring people there. A local government may serve its residents.

examples.en: The floor was covered with colorful toys.
examples.zh: 地板上擺滿了形形色色的玩具。

examples.en: Please tidy up your toys and put them into the storage box.
examples.zh: 請把你的玩具整理好並收進收納箱中。

examples.en: Wooden educational toys help foster young children's creativity.
examples.zh: 木製益智玩具能幫助培養幼童的創造力。

explains: A child may play with this object for fun. It can be a ball, doll, or small car. A store sells many kinds.
This plaything may be made from wood or plastic. A child may share it with a friend. It can help a child imagine stories.
A young child often enjoys this object. It can make sounds or move. A box can hold several playthings.

examples.en: Traffic was heavy near the school.
examples.zh: 學校附近車流很大。

examples.en: The traffic light turned green.
examples.zh: 交通號誌轉為綠燈。

examples.en: We waited in traffic for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我們在車陣中等了十分鐘。

explains: Cars, buses, and bikes move along roads. Too many can make travel slow. A light can help control it.
Drivers must follow signs and lights. A busy road may have many vehicles. People should look both ways before crossing.
This word means movement of vehicles and people along streets. A police officer may guide cars. A jam can form at busy times.

examples.en: The train from Taipei to Kaohsiung is very fast.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的火車非常快。

examples.en: We need to train hard to win the championship.
examples.zh: 我們需要努力訓練才能贏得冠軍。

examples.en: Be sure to arrive at the train platform five minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 務必在發車前五分鐘抵達火車月台。

examples.en: The mechanical gear train multiplies rotation speed from the slow mainspring to the fast escape wheel.
examples.zh: 機械「走時齒輪輪系」（Gear Train），將緩慢旋轉的發條盒轉速逐級放大並傳送至高速跳動的擒縱輪。

examples.en: Commuters boarded the sleek electric high-speed train to travel between Taipei and Kaohsiung in ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 趕著上班洽公的商務通勤旅客陸續登上流線型的台灣高鐵列車，短短九十分鐘即可往返台北與高雄。

examples.en: The professional soccer team traveled to the sports academy to train for the continental cup.
examples.zh: 職業足球隊全員飛抵封閉式高原運動基地，展開為期一個月的魔鬼體能集訓以備戰即將開踢的亞洲盃。

entries.definition: 火車；列車；訓練；傳遞發條動力至擒縱結構之四輪機械走時輪系
explains: A long vehicle moves on tracks. People ride it between cities. It may carry goods too.
A station is where passengers get on. The vehicle has many cars joined together. It can travel quickly across land.
People may take this vehicle to work. It follows metal rails. A driver controls it from the front.

examples.en: The doctor began treatment right away.
examples.zh: 醫生立刻開始治療。

examples.en: Her treatment helped the sore knee.
examples.zh: 她的治療改善了膝蓋痠痛。

examples.en: The treatment lasted for two weeks.
examples.zh: 治療持續了兩週。

explains: It means caring for someone who is ill. A doctor may give medicine. It can also mean handling a subject in a certain way.
A nurse may help a sick person get better. A clinic offers care. The word can also mean how someone acts toward another person.
This word can mean medical care. A hospital gives help for injuries. It may also mean handling a topic in speech or writing.

examples.en: Banyan trees provide great shade on sunny days.
examples.zh: 榕樹在出太陽的日子提供良好的遮蔭。

examples.en: Planting green trees helps absorb carbon dioxide and cools our cities.
examples.zh: 種植綠樹有助於吸收二氧化碳並為我們的城市降溫。

examples.en: Birds build protective nests among the thick branches of the oak tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在橡樹茂密的枝枒間築起遮風避雨的巢穴。

explains: A tall living plant has a trunk, branches, and leaves. Birds may make a nest in it. It can give shade.
A forest has many of these plants. A person may climb one as a child. Its roots take in water from soil.
This plant can live for many years. Its branches grow above the ground. It may produce fruit or nuts.

examples.en: Have a safe trip back home!
examples.zh: 祝你返家旅途平安！

examples.en: We went on an unforgettable road trip along the scenic East Coast.
examples.zh: 我們沿著風景優美的東海岸展開了一趟難忘的公路旅行。

examples.en: Watch your step so you don't trip over the tree roots on the trail.
examples.zh: 腳步小心，別在步道上被樹根絆倒了。

explains: It means going away from home and coming back. A family may take one during school break. A person can travel by car or plane.
A person may go to a new place for fun. A bag holds clothes for the stay. The word can also mean a fall or stumble.
This journey may last one day or longer. People often plan it in advance. It can be for work or rest.

examples.en: Ask the teacher for help if you get into trouble.
examples.zh: 如果遇到麻煩，請向老師求助。

examples.en: She had trouble falling asleep because of the loud thunderstorm outside.
examples.zh: 因為外面的雷雨交加，她翻來覆去難以入睡。

examples.en: I am sorry to trouble you, but could you tell me the way to the subway?
examples.zh: 不好意思麻煩你，請問你可以告訴我前往捷運站的路嗎？

explains: It means a difficult situation. A broken bike can create one. A person may ask for help.
A math question may be hard to solve. A family can talk about a concern. The word can also mean difficulty.
This word names something that needs attention. A child may face a challenge at school. Friends can help find an answer.

examples.en: The truck carried wood to the store.
examples.zh: 卡車把木材運到商店。

examples.en: A large truck stopped beside the road.
examples.zh: 一輛大卡車停在路邊。

examples.en: My uncle drives a delivery truck.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開送貨卡車。

explains: A large vehicle carries heavy goods. It may deliver boxes to stores. Its back can be open or covered.
A driver uses this vehicle to move furniture. It has a strong engine and large wheels. A delivery company may own many.
This road vehicle is larger than a car. It can carry wood, food, or machines. A person may rent one for a move.

examples.en: I will try to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 我會試著解開這個謎題。

examples.en: Try the soup before adding salt.
examples.zh: 加鹽之前先嚐嚐湯。

examples.en: She tried her best in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比賽中盡了全力。

explains: It means making an effort. A child may make an effort to tie a shoe. The action can also mean tasting a small amount.
A person may work hard on a puzzle. A cook can taste soup before serving. This word means making an effort even if success is not certain.
This action means making an attempt. A child may make an effort to jump high. It can also mean testing a food or idea.

examples.en: I bought a cotton T-shirt at the night market.
examples.zh: 我在夜市買了一件純棉 T 恤。

examples.en: He likes wearing a plain graphic T-shirt with jeans.
examples.zh: 他喜歡穿素色圖案 T 恤搭配牛仔褲。

examples.en: Our class designed a custom T-shirt for sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班為運動會設計了專屬的班服 T 恤。

explains: This clothing covers the upper body and has short sleeves. It often has a picture or words on it. People wear it with pants.
A cotton shirt may have a round neck. A person can wear it for sports. It may have a team name printed on the front.
This casual garment has sleeves and a body. It is easy to wash. People may wear one on a warm day.

examples.en: It is your turn to speak now.
examples.zh: 現在輪到你發言了。

examples.en: Please turn right at the intersection after the bridge.
examples.zh: 過橋後請在十字路口右轉。

examples.en: Caterpillars turn into beautiful butterflies through metamorphosis.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲透過完全變態轉變為美麗的蝴蝶。

explains: It means moving around a center point. A person may change direction at a corner. It can also mean an opportunity in a game.
A wheel moves in a circle. A driver may go left at an intersection. A player may wait for a chance to act.
This action changes direction. A key can move in a lock. A game may give each person a chance.

examples.en: I have been to Paris twice.
examples.zh: 我去過巴黎兩次。

examples.en: She called her friend twice yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天打了兩次電話給朋友。

examples.en: Twice a week, we visit Grandma.
examples.zh: 我們每週去看奶奶兩次。

explains: It means two times. A person may brush teeth in the morning and evening. The word can also mean once more.
A child may visit a place on two occasions. A cook can stir a pot again. It describes a count of two.
This word means on two occasions. A person may call a friend again. It can describe a doubled amount.

examples.en: She can type very fast without looking at the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她打字非常快，不用看鍵盤。

examples.en: What type of cuisine do you prefer for tonight's dinner?
examples.zh: 今晚的晚餐你偏好哪種類型的料理？

examples.en: Please type your full name and email address in the registration form.
examples.zh: 請在報名表中鍵入你的全名與電子信箱。

explains: It means one kind of something. A store may sell many kinds of fruit. A person can also write or press words on a keyboard.
An animal belongs to a group with shared features. A person may enter words using keys. This word can mean a category.
This word describes a group or category. A letter can be made with a keyboard. A person may choose a kind of food.

examples.en: Uncle David lives in Taichung and owns a bakery.
examples.zh: 大衛叔叔住在台中並經營一家麵包店。

examples.en: My uncle taught me how to fish by the scenic riverside when I was young.
examples.zh: 在我年幼時，我的舅舅教我如何在風景秀麗的河畔釣魚。

examples.en: Everyone in the family enjoys listening to Uncle John's humorous travel tales.
examples.zh: 家族裡的每個人都非常喜歡聽約翰叔叔講述他幽默風趣的旅行軼事。

explains: A parent’s brother is this family member. He may visit on holidays. A child may call him by a family title.
A boy has a mother’s or father’s brother in his family. This adult may help care for a child. He can be married or single.
This word names a male relative. A child may visit him at home. He is a brother of a parent.

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 貓咪正在桌子底下睡覺。

examples.en: We stood under the big tree to avoid the sudden rain.
examples.zh: 我們站在大樹下躲避突如其來的陣雨。

examples.en: Keep everything under control during the experiment.
examples.zh: 實驗過程中要讓一切保持受控。

explains: It means below something. A cat may hide beneath a bed. A person can wear a shirt beneath a coat.
A book may be lower than a table. A child can crawl beneath a blanket. This word describes a lower position.
This word means in a lower place. A fish may swim below a boat. A person can put shoes beneath a bench.

examples.en: Do you understand what the teacher explained?
examples.zh: 你明白老師剛剛解釋的內容了嗎？

examples.en: Practice speaking English regularly so you can make yourself understood clearly.
examples.zh: 經常練習說英語，這樣你才能讓別人清楚理解你的意思。

examples.en: True empathy means striving to understand someone else's feelings.
examples.zh: 真正的同理心意味著努力設身處地去理解他人的感受。

explains: It means knowing what words or ideas mean. A child may learn a rule. A person can grasp a hard lesson.
A student may know why an answer is correct. A friend can follow what another person says. The word can mean realizing an idea.
This action means learning the meaning of something. A teacher may explain a new word. A person can grasp a problem.

examples.en: The students wore a blue uniform.
examples.zh: 學生們穿著藍色制服。

examples.en: His school uniform has a white shirt.
examples.zh: 他的校服有一件白襯衫。

examples.en: The nurse put on her uniform before work.
examples.zh: 護士上班前穿上制服。

explains: People who do the same job may wear matching clothes. A school may require one for each student. It can show membership in a group.
A team wears matching clothing. A nurse may have special work clothes. The word can mean making things alike.
This clothing shows a person’s group or job. Students may put it on each day. It often has the same color and design for all.

examples.en: We chatted happily at the cafe until midnight.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡廳愉快地聊天直到午夜。

examples.en: You cannot open the sealed examination booklet until the bell rings.
examples.zh: 在鐘聲響起之前，嚴禁拆開密封的試卷題本。

examples.en: Until now, scientists continue discovering new underwater marine species.
examples.zh: 時至今日，科學家們依然在持續發現全新的海底生物物種。

examples.en: Study hard until you achieve complete mastery of the grammar rules.
examples.zh: 努力用功讀書，直到你完全掌握文法規則為止。

examples.en: We waited under the arcade awning until the heavy thunderstorm finally stopped.
examples.zh: 我們靜靜站在騎樓遮雨棚下耐心避雨，直到窗外滂沱的大雷雨終於漸漸止歇。

examples.en: The night market stalls stay bustling with cheerful customers until two in the morning.
examples.zh: 這處知名觀光夜市的熱門小吃攤位熱鬧滾滾，熱絡氣氛一直持續到凌晨兩點為止。

explains: This word marks the time when an action or state ends. A shop may stay open all evening and close at ten. Ten is the ending time.
You can use this word to show how long someone waits. A child may wait while a parent finishes work. The wait ends when the work is done.
With a negative statement, this word can show that something happens no earlier than a certain time. A bus may arrive at noon rather than in the morning. The passengers must wait that long.

examples.en: Look up at the bright twinkling stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 抬頭仰望夜空中閃爍的明亮星星。

examples.en: The students stood up politely to greet the visiting guest professor.
examples.zh: 學生們彬彬有禮地起立向蒞臨參訪的客座教授問好。

examples.en: Wake up early to catch the crisp morning air and exercise in the park.
examples.zh: 早早起床呼吸清晨清新的空氣並在公園裡做運動。

explains: It means toward a higher place. A person may stand after sitting. A bird can fly into the air.
A child may climb a hill. A person can lift a hand above the head. It can also mean awake.
This word can show a move to a higher position. A flag may be raised. It can also mean finished or complete.

examples.en: We use a spoon to eat soup.
examples.zh: 我們用湯匙喝湯。

examples.en: She uses a map to find the park.
examples.zh: 她用地圖找公園。

examples.en: They used clean water for the plants.
examples.zh: 他們用乾淨的水澆植物。

explains: It means doing something with an object or idea. A person may handle a hammer at work. The word can also mean consuming food or drink.
A cook may handle a spoon. A student can apply a new skill. It may also mean treating someone in a certain way.
This action means applying a tool or method. A person may handle a phone. It can also mean taking a medicine.

examples.en: A flashlight is useful at night.
examples.zh: 手電筒在晚上很有用。

examples.en: This guide is useful for new students.
examples.zh: 這本指南對新生很有幫助。

examples.en: A warm coat is useful in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天一件暖和的外套很好用。

explains: It means helpful for a task. A map can guide a traveler. A warm coat helps in winter.
A tool that works well can save time. A clear list may help a person remember. This word describes something that gives help.
This word means good for a purpose. A bag with pockets can help carry items. A friend may give helpful advice.

examples.en: I usually take the bus to school on weekdays.
examples.zh: 我平日通常搭公車上學。

examples.en: What do you usually eat for breakfast before going to work?
examples.zh: 上班前你早餐通常吃什麼？

examples.en: We usually spend Sunday afternoons reading books at home.
examples.zh: 我們週日下午通常待在家裡看書。

explains: It means in most cases. A child may eat breakfast each morning. The word can describe a habit.
A person may take the bus on many days. It happens often but not every time. This word shows what happens in a usual way.
This word describes what happens most of the time. A shop may open early each day. A person can describe a regular habit.

examples.en: We ate a green vegetable with dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了一種綠色蔬菜。

examples.en: Carrot is my favorite vegetable.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔是我最喜歡的蔬菜。

examples.en: The farmer grows many kinds of vegetables.
examples.zh: 農夫種植許多種類的蔬菜。

explains: A plant grown for food may have leaves or roots. Carrots and peas are examples. People may cook them for dinner.
This food comes from a plant. A cook may chop it into soup. It can be fresh, frozen, or dried.
A farmer grows these plants in a field. People eat many kinds. Some are green, while others grow beneath soil.

examples.en: She is a very polite and hardworking student.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常禮貌且用功的學生。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your thoughtful birthday present.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你貼心準備的生日禮物。

examples.en: This is the very book that my teacher recommended last semester.
examples.zh: 這本正是我的老師上學期極力推薦的那本書。

explains: It means to a great degree. A person may feel happy about a gift. The word can make an idea stronger.
A cold day may make people wear coats. A person can feel tired after work. This word adds strength to a description.
This word means greatly or truly. A child may enjoy a fun game. It can come before a describing word.

examples.en: The children watched a short video.
examples.zh: 孩子們看了一段短片。

examples.en: She made a video of the school concert.
examples.zh: 她拍了一段學校音樂會的影片。

examples.en: This video shows how to bake bread.
examples.zh: 這段影片示範如何烤麵包。

explains: A recording shows moving pictures with sound. A person may watch one on a phone. It can teach or entertain.
A short clip can show an event. A teacher may play one in class. It is stored on a computer or camera.
People watch this kind of recording on a screen. It may have music or speech. A phone can make one.

examples.en: The violin soloist performed beautifully on stage.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家在舞台上演奏得非常優美。

examples.en: A good violin produces a warm, rich, and expressive tone.
examples.zh: 一把優質的小提琴能發出溫暖、渾厚且富有表現力的音色。

examples.en: She tuned her violin carefully before the orchestral rehearsal began.
examples.zh: 在管弦樂團彩排開始前，她仔細地為小提琴調音。

examples.en: The violin soloist played with incredible passion and precision.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家以無比的熱情與精準度進行演奏。

examples.en: An authentic Stradivarius violin can sell for millions of dollars at auction.
examples.zh: 真正的史特拉第瓦里古董名琴在拍賣會上能拍出數百萬美元天價。

examples.en: Rosin your violin bow thoroughly before practicing classical etudes.
examples.zh: 在練習古典練習曲前，請用松香仔細擦拭你的小提琴琴弓。

explains: A wooden instrument has four strings and is played with a bow. A musician holds it near the neck. It can make high sounds.
A player moves a bow across its strings. It is often used in an orchestra. The instrument is made from wood.
This instrument can play classical music. A person holds it under the chin. A bow helps make sound.

examples.en: Many foreign tourists visit the National Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 許多外國遊客參觀國立故宮博物院。

examples.en: We visit our grandparents in the countryside every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 每年農曆新年我們都會去鄉下探望祖父母。

examples.en: Doctors visit hospitalized patients in the wards every morning.
examples.zh: 醫生每天早晨都會到病房巡視探視住院病患。

explains: It means going to see a person or place. A child may go to a friend’s home. The word can also mean spending time with a doctor.
A person may travel to a museum. A family can go see a grandparent. The action can be for work or fun.
This action means going somewhere for a short time. A student may go see a teacher. It can also mean asking a doctor for help.

examples.en: A visitor asked for directions.
examples.zh: 一位訪客問路。

examples.en: The museum welcomes every visitor.
examples.zh: 博物館歡迎每一位訪客。

examples.en: The visitor left a note for the family.
examples.zh: 訪客留了一張紙條給那個家庭。

explains: A person who comes to a place for a short time is a guest. A museum may welcome many each day. A host can help them.
A traveler may come into a town for a day. A family can welcome this person at home. The person does not live there.
This word means a guest in a place. A guide may help one learn about a city. A hotel worker can answer questions.

examples.en: The singer has a sweet and melodious voice.
examples.zh: 這位歌手擁有一副甜美悅耳的好歌喉。

examples.en: Please lower your voice because patients in the ward are resting.
examples.zh: 病房裡的病患正在休息，請壓低你的說話音量。

examples.en: Citizens have every right to raise their voice against unfair community policies.
examples.zh: 公民完全有權利發出聲音反對不合理的社區政策。

explains: It is the sound made when a person speaks or sings. A phone call carries it. It can be high or low.
A person uses this sound to talk. A singer may have a strong one. It comes from the throat.
This sound helps people share words. A child may recognize a parent by it. It can be loud, soft, high, or low.

examples.en: Please wait here until your number is called.
examples.zh: 請在這裡等候直到叫到你的號碼。

examples.en: I cannot wait to see my best friend after summer vacation.
examples.zh: 暑假結束後我迫不及待想見到最好的朋友。

examples.en: We waited patiently in line for the popular bakery to open.
examples.zh: 我們耐心地排隊等待這家人氣麵包店開門。

explains: It means staying in one place until something happens. A person may remain at a bus stop. The word can also mean a period of delay.
A child may remain near the door. A friend may arrive later. This word can mean expecting someone or something.
This action means not leaving yet. A person may remain in a line. It can also mean putting something off.

examples.en: I usually wake up at 6:30 in the morning.
examples.zh: 我通常早上六點半醒來。

examples.en: Please wake me up if my alarm doesn't ring.
examples.zh: 如果我的鬧鐘沒響，請叫醒我。

examples.en: The loud thunder woke the baby up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲在半夜驚醒了嬰兒。

explains: It means opening the eyes after sleep. A person may get out of bed in the morning. An alarm can help.
A child may become awake when the sun comes up. A sound may make a person stop sleeping. The action can happen naturally or with help.
This action ends a period of sleep. A parent may call a child in the morning. A loud clock can cause it.

examples.en: I like to walk my dog in the park.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在公園裡溜狗散步。

examples.en: It is healthy to take a twenty-minute walk after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後散步二十分鐘對身體很有益處。

examples.en: We decided to walk to the museum instead of taking the bus.
examples.zh: 我們決定走路去博物館而不是搭公車。

explains: It means moving on foot at a regular pace. A person may go around a park. The word can also mean guiding a dog outside.
A child may go along a path with a friend. People use their legs for this action. It is slower than running.
This action moves a person from place to place using the feet. A family may do it after dinner. A dog needs it each day.

examples.en: There is a world map on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上有一張世界地圖。

examples.en: Don't draw or write on the classroom wall.
examples.zh: 請勿在教室牆壁上塗鴉或寫字。

examples.en: They painted the bedroom wall light blue.
examples.zh: 他們把臥室的牆壁漆成了淺藍色。

explains: A building may have a flat side around a room. People hang pictures on it. A fence can mark a yard.
A brick structure can keep wind out. A person may lean against one. A room has several flat surfaces around it.
This part of a house stands upright. It may hold a window or door. A ball can bounce off it.

examples.en: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要點一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: Do you want to join our study group this semester?
examples.zh: 這學期你想加入我們的讀書小組嗎？

examples.en: The charity provides warm coats to families in want during winter.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構在冬季為貧困家庭提供保暖大衣。

explains: It means wishing for something. A child may ask for a new bike. The word can also mean needing an item.
A person may hope for a day off. A shopper can ask for a bag. It describes a wish or desire.
This word tells that someone hopes to have something. A child may ask for a snack. It can also mean choosing a result.

examples.en: Spring brings warm sunshine and blooming flowers.
examples.zh: 春天帶來溫暖的陽光和綻放的花朵。

examples.en: She gave her guests a warm and enthusiastic welcome.
examples.zh: 她對客人給予了溫馨熱誠的歡迎。

examples.en: Remember to warm up your muscles before running the sprint.
examples.zh: 短跑衝刺前記得先把肌肉熱身開來。

explains: It means having a pleasant amount of heat. A blanket can keep a person comfortable. Soup may be served this way.
A sunny room may feel comfortable. A coat helps keep the body from getting cold. The word can also describe a kind welcome.
This word means not cold. A cup of tea may have gentle heat. A friendly smile can make a guest feel welcome.

examples.en: My dad bought me a digital watch.
examples.zh: 我爸爸買給我一隻數位手錶。

examples.en: Do you want to watch a movie with us tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想和我們一起看電影嗎？

examples.en: Watch out for cars when you cross the street!
examples.zh: 過馬路時要注意來車！

explains: A person looks at a clock to know the hour. They may also see a show on a screen. The word can mean keeping guard.
A child may look at birds in a tree. A person can see a movie at home. The word also names a small clock worn on a wrist.
This action uses the eyes for a period. A person may keep guard at night. It can also mean following a game.

examples.en: Remember to drink plenty of water every day.
examples.zh: 記得每天多喝水。

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants on the balcony.
examples.zh: 別忘了給陽台上的植物澆水。

examples.en: Can I have a glass of cold water, please?
examples.zh: 請問能給我一杯冰水嗎？

explains: It is a clear liquid people drink. Rivers and lakes hold it. Rain falls from clouds.
A person may drink this after running. A bath can be filled with it. Plants need it to grow.
This liquid has no color or smell. It comes from a tap. A person can freeze it into ice.

examples.en: Massive colliding black holes send catastrophic ripples of gravitational waves vibrating across the cosmos.
examples.zh: 雙黑洞劇烈碰撞合併，向浩瀚宇宙釋放出震撼時空結構的「重力波時空漣漪」（Gravitational Waves）。

examples.en: Surfers paddled furiously to catch the gigantic rolling wave crashing onto the sandy coastline.
examples.zh: 衝浪愛好者拼命划水追浪，試圖征服那道轟然拍擊在金色沙灘上的壯麗翻騰海浪。

examples.en: The government announced a supportive wave of renewable energy subsidies for rural solar cooperatives.
examples.zh: 政府農政部門宣布推出新一波針對農村太陽能發電合作社的專案綠能補貼支持措施。

entries.definition: 穿越時空傳播之引力波重力波；波浪
explains: A moving line of water travels across a lake or sea. It can rise and fall. A hand can also move from side to side to greet someone.
People may see this motion on the ocean. A flag can move in the wind. A person may lift a hand in greeting.
This word can mean a moving line of water. It can also mean moving a hand or arm. A radio can send signals through the air.

examples.en: This is a good way to learn new words.
examples.zh: 這是學習新單字的好方法。

examples.en: We found a quiet way through the forest.
examples.zh: 我們找到一條穿越森林的安靜小路。

examples.en: There is no easy way to solve this puzzle.
examples.zh: 沒有簡單的方法可以解開這個謎題。

explains: It means a path or route. A person may find one through a forest. It can also mean a method for doing something.
A road leads from one place to another. A person may choose a method for learning. The word can also mean how something happens.
This word can describe a direction or method. A traveler may look for a route. It can also mean a style or manner.

examples.en: We take the MRT to school every day.
examples.zh: 我們每天搭捷運上學。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末打算去野餐。

examples.en: We should protect the environment together.
examples.zh: 我們應該一起保護環境。

examples.en: We prepared all the party decorations ourselves.
examples.zh: 我們自己動手準備了所有派對布置。

examples.en: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at the beach music festival last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六在海灘音樂節上玩得非常盡興開心。

examples.en: We must rely on ourselves to solve complex mathematical challenges.
examples.zh: 我們必須依靠自己的力量來解開複雜的數學難題。

explains: This pronoun refers to the speaker and at least one other person. It can be the subject of a sentence. Related forms can show ownership or receive an action.
A group that includes the speaker can be named by this pronoun. It replaces several names. Other forms act as objects or show possession.
This word points to a group that includes the person speaking. It may come before an action. Different forms can mean belonging to that group.

examples.en: I felt weak after recovering from the flu.
examples.zh: 流行性感冒痊癒後我感到身體有些虛弱。

examples.en: The wooden bridge is too weak to support heavy vehicles.
examples.zh: 這座木橋結構太脆弱，無法承載重型車輛。

examples.en: Math has always been my weakest subject in school.
examples.zh: 數學一直是我在學校裡最薄弱的科目。

explains: It means having little strength. A sick person may feel this way. A thin rope may break easily.
A small light may be hard to see. A person may need rest after illness. The word can describe something not powerful.
This word means not strong. A gentle wind may barely move a leaf. A person may need help lifting a box.

examples.en: Students must wear uniforms to school.
examples.zh: 學生上學必須穿制服。

examples.en: She always wears glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 她在用電腦時總是戴著眼鏡。

examples.en: What are you planning to wear to the birthday party?
examples.zh: 你打算穿什麼去參加生日派對？

explains: It means having clothes on the body. A person may put on a coat in winter. The word can also mean having a certain look.
A child puts on shoes before going outside. A ring can stay on a finger. Clothing may become old after much use.
This action covers the body in clothing. A person may put on a hat. The word can also describe carrying a smile.

examples.en: The weather is pleasant in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的天氣很宜人。

examples.en: Check the weather forecast before going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 去山區健行前請務必查看天氣預報。

examples.en: Hot and humid weather is typical during summer in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 炎熱潮濕的天氣是台灣夏天的典型特徵。

explains: It describes the air outside, including sun, rain, or wind. People may check a report before travel. A storm can change it quickly.
A cold day or a warm day is described by this word. Clouds and rain are part of it. A forecast tells what may happen outside.
People look outside to learn if it is sunny or rainy. This word describes those conditions. It can change from day to day.

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
examples.zh: 一個星期有七天。

examples.en: We are taking final exams next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週要參加期末考。

examples.en: I go to swimming class twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每週上兩次游泳課。

explains: Seven days make one of these periods. A calendar shows its dates. A person may work for five days and rest after.
This period has seven days. Monday and Tuesday are two of them. A month contains several.
A school schedule may repeat after seven days. People count time by these periods. One has seven mornings.

examples.en: Have a great weekend with your friends!
examples.zh: 和朋友度過一個愉快的週末吧！

examples.en: What are your plans for the upcoming three-day weekend?
examples.zh: 你對即將到來的連續三天週末有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We spent the entire weekend hiking in Yangmingshan National Park.
examples.zh: 我們整個週末都在陽明山國家公園健行。

explains: Saturday and Sunday are often part of these days. Many people do not go to work then. Families may take a trip.
This time comes after Friday. It often gives people a break from school or work. Friends may meet for fun.
A person may sleep later during these two days. Shops may be busy. People often visit family during this time.

examples.en: You are always welcome to visit our school.
examples.zh: 隨時歡迎你來參觀我們的學校。

examples.en: The friendly host welcomed the foreign guests with fresh fruit juice.
examples.zh: 親切的主人用新鮮果汁熱情款待外國賓客。

examples.en: Warm spring sunshine was a welcome change after weeks of winter chills.
examples.zh: 經歷了數週的冬寒後，溫暖的春陽是令人欣喜的轉變。

explains: It means greeting a person kindly. A host may invite a guest inside. The word can also describe something accepted or allowed.
A friendly greeting can make a visitor feel at home. A new idea may be accepted by a group. This word can also mean gladly received.
A person may greet a guest at the door. An offer can be gladly accepted. The word can also mean allowed.

examples.en: She speaks English very well.
examples.zh: 她英文說得很好。

examples.en: I hope you are feeling well today.
examples.zh: 我希望你今天感覺很好。

examples.en: The farmer dug a well for fresh water.
examples.zh: 農夫挖了一口井來取乾淨的水。

explains: It can mean healthy. A person may feel good after resting. It can also mean in a good way.
A doctor may say a patient is healthy again. A student can do a task correctly. The word may also name a deep hole for water.
This word may describe a person who is not ill. It can also mean something was done in a good way. A farm may have a deep water hole.

examples.en: The sun sets in the west over the ocean.
examples.zh: 太陽在西方海面上緩緩落下。

examples.en: Taiwan's major high-speed rail line runs along the flat west coast plain.
examples.zh: 台灣的高鐵主幹線沿著平坦的西海岸平原運行。

examples.en: We drove west toward the coastal scenic highway to catch the twilight.
examples.zh: 我們開車一路向西前往濱海景觀公路追逐餘暉。

explains: It is a direction on a map. It is opposite east. The sun sets toward this side.
A compass can point to this direction. It is found on the left side of many maps. A person may travel toward it.
This word names one of four main directions. A country may lie in this part of a region. A sunset occurs in this direction.

examples.en: The grass was wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨後草地是濕的。

examples.en: His wet shoes dried by the door.
examples.zh: 他的濕鞋子在門邊晾乾了。

examples.en: We got wet while swimming in the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖裡游泳時全身都濕了。

explains: It means covered in water or another liquid. Rain can make clothes this way. A sponge can become soaked.
A person may step in a puddle and get shoes soaked. A towel can dry a surface. The word can describe something not dry.
A dog may come inside after swimming with its fur soaked. Rain can leave a road shiny. This describing word means damp.

examples.en: What would you like to eat for dinner?
examples.zh: 你晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: What time does the next northbound high-speed train depart?
examples.zh: 下一班北上高鐵什麼時候發車？

examples.en: What a wonderful performance by the school orchestra!
examples.zh: 學校管弦樂團的演出真是太精彩了！

explains: It is used to ask about a thing or fact. A person may ask for a name. The word begins many questions.
A teacher may ask for information using this question word. It can refer to an object or an idea. A reply gives an answer.
This word helps ask for details. A child may use it when curious. It can ask about a thing, action, or fact.

examples.en: When does the English class start?
examples.zh: 英文課什麼時候開始？

examples.en: Call me immediately when you arrive safely at the station.
examples.zh: 當你平安抵達車站時，請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: I remember the exact moment when we won our first trophy.
examples.zh: 我清楚記得我們贏得第一座獎盃的那一瞬間。

explains: It asks about a time. A person may ask for a birthday date. It can also connect two events.
This question word asks at what time an event happens. A clock can help find an answer. It may link a past event to another.
A person can use this word for a day or hour. It may begin a question. It also connects events happening at the same time.

examples.en: Where can I buy an EasyCard?
examples.zh: 我可以在哪裡買到悠遊卡？

examples.en: Where did you leave your bicycle after school yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天放學後你把腳踏車停在哪裡了？

examples.en: Home is where the heart finds true peace and comfort.
examples.zh: 家是心靈尋得真正平靜與撫慰的所在。

explains: It asks about a place. A traveler may ask for a station. A map can help answer.
This question word asks in what place something is. A person may use it when looking for a home. It can also begin a sentence about a place.
A child may ask for a location using this word. A map can give an answer. It may refer to a town, room, or country.

examples.en: Let me know whether you can attend the farewell party tonight.
examples.zh: 請讓我知道你今晚是否能夠出席歡送派對。

examples.en: Whether it rains or shines, the annual marathon race will take place as scheduled.
examples.zh: 無論當天天候是艷陽高照還是刮風下雨，一年一度的馬拉松大賽都將如期舉行。

examples.en: He couldn't decide whether to study computer engineering or fine arts at university.
examples.zh: 他一時之間難以抉擇，上大學後究竟該專攻電腦資訊工程還是純藝術創作。

explains: It asks if one of two things is true. A person may ask if a friend can come. The answer may be yes or no.
This word introduces a choice or doubt. A teacher may ask if homework is finished. It can mean no matter which option is true.
A person can use this word before two possible outcomes. A question may ask if something happened. It can also mean regardless of the answer.

examples.en: Which dessert do you prefer, cake or ice cream?
examples.zh: 蛋糕和冰淇淋，你比較喜歡哪一個甜點？

examples.en: Which platform does our train to Hualien leave from?
examples.zh: 我們去花蓮的火車在第幾月台發車？

examples.en: Tell me which of these two books you enjoyed reading more.
examples.zh: 告訴我這兩本書中你比較喜歡閱讀哪一本。

explains: It asks a person to choose from a group. A child may point at one toy. The answer names one choice.
This word refers to a specific person or object in a group. A question may ask for one item. It can also join two ideas.
A speaker may use it when asking about a choice. A list can have many things. The reply identifies one of them.

examples.en: Listen to pleasant music while doing your homework.
examples.zh: 寫作業時可以聽些悅耳的音樂。

examples.en: Some people prefer waking up early, while others work best late at night.
examples.zh: 有些人偏好早起工作，然而其他人則在深夜時效率最高。

examples.en: Let's sit on the park bench and rest our legs for a little while.
examples.zh: 我們在公園長椅上坐一下，稍微讓雙腿休息一會兒吧。

examples.en: Listen to English audio while commuting on the MRT every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上搭乘捷運通勤時聽英文廣播。

examples.en: While my sister loves spicy hot pot, I prefer mild herbal chicken soup.
examples.zh: 然而我姐姐極度嗜吃麻辣火鍋，我個人卻偏好清甜甘醇的溫和藥膳雞湯。

examples.en: Sit down and rest a while on the park bench after your long jog.
examples.zh: 跑完漫長的一大圈晨跑之後，不妨在公園的木質長凳上坐下來稍微歇息片刻。

entries.definition: 當…之時；一段時間；當…的時候；然而
explains: It means during a period of time. A child may read as a parent cooks. It can also show contrast.
A person may listen to music during homework. Two actions can happen at once. The word can also mean although.
This word can connect two events happening at the same time. It can also introduce an opposing idea. A person may wait for a short period.

examples.en: White snow covered the mountain top.
examples.zh: 白雪覆蓋了山頂。

examples.en: Please write your answers on a blank sheet of white paper.
examples.zh: 請將答案寫在一張空白的白紙上。

examples.en: The doctor wore a clean white lab coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿著一件乾淨的白長袍。

explains: This color is like fresh snow or milk. A sheet of paper may have this shade. It is the opposite of black.
A cloud can look this color in sunlight. A rabbit may have fur of this shade. It can also describe a pale face.
This word names a light color. People may use it for walls or clothing. It is often linked with purity.

examples.en: Who is that smiling lady in the picture?
examples.zh: 照片中那位微笑的女士是誰？

examples.en: Who won first prize in the national English speech contest?
examples.zh: 誰在全國英語演講比賽中獲得了第一名？

examples.en: Do you know who invented the world wide web?
examples.zh: 你知道是誰發明了全球資訊網嗎？

explains: It asks about a person. A speaker may ask for a name. The answer can point to a man or woman.
This question word asks which person did something. A teacher may use it to ask for a helper. It can also connect parts of a sentence.
A child may use this word when looking for a friend. It asks about a person’s identity. It may begin a question.

examples.en: Whose bag is on the chair?
examples.zh: 椅子上的包包是誰的？

examples.en: I know whose coat this is.
examples.zh: 我知道這是誰的外套。

examples.en: Whose turn is next?
examples.zh: 下一個輪到誰？

explains: It asks who owns something. A person may ask about a bag. The answer names its owner.
This question word asks about ownership. A child may ask which person has a toy. It can also connect ideas in a sentence.
A speaker may use this word before a noun to ask about its owner. It can point to a person. It appears in questions.

examples.en: Why are you late for school today?
examples.zh: 你今天為什麼上學遲到？

examples.en: The teacher patiently explained why regular review improves exam scores.
examples.zh: 老師耐心地解釋了為何定期複習能提升考試成績。

examples.en: Why not join our cycling club and make new friends?
examples.zh: 何不加入我們的單車社團結交新朋友呢？

explains: It asks for a reason. A person may ask for an explanation. The answer may begin with because.
This question word asks for a cause. A child may ask for an explanation about a rule. A reply can give a reason.
A person uses this word to ask what caused something. It can begin a question. The answer explains a reason.

examples.en: The river is wide near the bridge.
examples.zh: 河流在橋附近很寬。

examples.en: She opened the wide gate.
examples.zh: 她打開寬大的門。

examples.en: The table is too wide for this room.
examples.zh: 這張桌子對這個房間來說太寬了。

explains: It means having a large distance from left to right. A river can be hard to cross. A road may have many lanes.
A door can have a large opening from side to side. A smile may stretch across a face. The word describes a great width.
This word means broad. A table may have a large surface. It can describe something that covers a lot from one side to another.

examples.en: His wife works at a hospital.
examples.zh: 他的妻子在醫院工作。

examples.en: The farmer and his wife live near the hill.
examples.zh: 農夫和他的妻子住在山坡附近。

examples.en: My uncle brought his wife to dinner.
examples.zh: 我叔叔帶他的妻子來吃晚餐。

explains: A married man may call this woman his partner. They can share a home. The word describes a family relationship.
A person may marry a woman and live as a family. She may be a mother. This word names her relation to her partner.
This word refers to a woman in a marriage. A family may have children. The couple can share a life together.

examples.en: The train will arrive in five minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在五分鐘內抵達。

examples.en: She showed remarkable iron will in overcoming the sports injury.
examples.zh: 她展現了鋼鐵般的堅強意志戰勝了運動傷害。

examples.en: Technology will continue to reshape how people learn and collaborate globally.
examples.zh: 科技將繼續重塑全球人類學習與協同合作的方式。

explains: It can show that something happens in the future. A person may make a promise. It can also mean determination.
This helping verb can talk about a future action. It can also show a promise or a decision made at the moment of speaking. A person may use it when offering to carry a bag.
This word may mean shall or is going to. A person can make a firm choice. A legal paper can say who gets belongings after death.

examples.en: Our school baseball team won the championship game.
examples.zh: 我們學校的棒球隊贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Hard work and consistent practice will help you win competitions.
examples.zh: 勤奮努力與持續不懈的練習將助你在比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She felt overjoyed to win first prize in the national contest.
examples.zh: 在全國大賽中榮獲首獎讓她感到欣喜若狂。

explains: It means coming first in a contest. A team may get a medal. A person can receive a prize.
A runner may reach the end before others. A game has one side that does better. This word can also mean getting something by effort.
This action means being the best in a contest. A player may score more points. A person can gain a prize or honor.

examples.en: A strong wind blew my hat away.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹走了我的帽子。

examples.en: A refreshing cool wind blew in from the sea.
examples.zh: 一陣清涼爽朗的微風從海面上吹拂而來。

examples.en: Wind turbines generate renewable energy along the western coast.
examples.zh: 風力發電機在西部海岸生產再生能源。

explains: Moving air can make leaves shake. A person may feel it outside. It can be soft or very strong.
A storm may bring fast-moving air. A flag can move because of it. The word also means twisting something around a center.
Air travels across the land. It may cool a warm day. A person can twist a clock key to make it work.

examples.en: Open the window to let fresh air in.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

examples.en: The cat is sitting quietly by the living room window.
examples.zh: 貓咪安靜地坐在客廳窗戶旁。

examples.en: Raindrops are tapping gently against the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 雨滴輕輕敲打著臥室的窗戶。

examples.en: The planetary launch window opens every twenty-six months when Earth and Mars align favorably in orbit.
examples.zh: 當地球與火星在公轉軌道上運行至最佳相對位置時，每二十六個月才會開啟一次寶貴的發射窗口。

examples.en: Missing the tight launch window forces flight planners to postpone interplanetary missions by two full years.
examples.zh: 萬一因天氣或技術故障錯過這短短兩週的發射窗口，整個火星探測計畫將被迫整整延宕兩年之久。

examples.en: Propulsion engineers calculated an optimal departure window to take full advantage of orbital alignment.
examples.zh: 火箭軌道工程師精算出能量消耗最低的最佳出發窗口，以極致利用兩顆行星公轉軌道的幾何交會紅利。

entries.definition: 窗戶；每二十六個月開啟一次的地火發射窗口
explains: A clear opening in a wall lets light enter. People can look outside through it. Curtains may cover it.
A house has glass panels that can open. A bird may sit on its outer ledge. A person may close it during a storm.
This part of a room lets people see outdoors. It may have curtains or blinds. A frame holds its glass.

examples.en: It is wise to save money for later.
examples.zh: 先存錢以備將來是明智的。

examples.en: The wise old woman gave good advice.
examples.zh: 那位睿智的老太太給了很好的建議。

examples.en: He made a wise choice.
examples.zh: 他做了一個明智的選擇。

explains: It means having good judgment. An older person may give helpful advice. A careful choice can show this quality.
A person who learns from experience may have this quality. It can describe a thoughtful choice. The opposite is foolish.
This word describes someone who thinks carefully. A leader may make a good choice. A kind answer can show sound judgment.

examples.en: We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
examples.zh: 我們祝你聖誕快樂、新年如意！

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a special birthday wish.
examples.zh: 閉上眼睛，許下一個特別的生日願望。

examples.en: Send my warmest best wishes to your family members.
examples.zh: 代我向你的家人致上最誠摯溫馨的祝福。

examples.en: Make a wish before blowing out the birthday candles.
examples.zh: 吹熄生日蠟燭前許個願吧。

examples.en: I wish you the best of luck on your college entrance exam!
examples.zh: 祝你在大學聯考中一切好運順利！

examples.en: Send our warm wishes to your parents when you visit home.
examples.zh: 你回家探親時代我們向你的雙親致上溫馨的祝福。

explains: It means hoping for something good. A child may hope for a pet. It can also mean a kind greeting for a birthday.
A person may hope a friend feels better. A candle can be blown out after making one. The word can also be a desire.
This feeling is a hope for the future. People may express one on a holiday. A person can want something to happen.

examples.en: I like drinking hot pearl milk tea with less sugar.
examples.zh: 我喜歡喝微糖的熱珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: She loves spending her weekend afternoons cooking dinner with close friends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末午後和親密摯友一起動手煮晚餐。

examples.en: Write your signature with a black ballpoint pen on the official form.
examples.zh: 請在正式表格上使用黑色原子筆簽上你的名字。

explains: It means together or alongside. A person may walk beside a friend. It can also mean using an object.
A meal may include rice and beans. A person can hold a cup in one hand. The word can mean having something at the same time.
This short preposition can show company. A child may go to school beside a parent. It can also describe a tool used for an action.

examples.en: Never go hiking in remote mountains without a guide.
examples.zh: 絕不要在沒有嚮導的情況下深入荒山健行。

examples.en: Without a doubt, hard work and dedication yield meaningful rewards.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，辛勤耕耘與全心投入必能收穫豐碩回報。

examples.en: Plants cannot survive without sunlight, carbon dioxide, and adequate water.
examples.zh: 沒有陽光、二氧化碳與充足的水分，植物便無法生存。

examples.en: Never enter a construction zone without wearing a safety helmet.
examples.zh: 未佩戴安全帽切勿進入施工工地區域。

examples.en: We navigated the winding mountain backroads successfully without a GPS map.
examples.zh: 在沒有衛星定位導航的情況下，我們憑著路標成功穿過了蜿蜒的深山小徑。

examples.en: She completed the demanding half-marathon course without stopping to rest once.
examples.zh: 她跑完了極具挑戰性的半程馬拉松賽事，全程連一次停下來休息都沒有。

explains: It means lacking something. A person may go outside and have no coat. A meal may have no salt.
A room may have no windows. A person can do a task lacking help. The word shows that something is missing.
This word tells that an item is not present. A person may travel lacking a bag. It can also mean unless.

examples.en: That woman is wearing a beautiful dress.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿著一件漂亮的洋裝。

examples.en: A kind woman returned the lost wallet to the police station.
examples.zh: 一位好心的女士將遺失的皮夾送到警察局。

examples.en: She is a successful businesswoman in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她是台北一位成功的女性企業家。

explains: An adult female person has this meaning. She may be a mother or sister. The word can describe a grown person.
A girl becomes an adult. This word names an adult female. People may use it in forms or stories.
This person is no longer a child. She may have a job or family. The word refers to an adult female human.

examples.en: We had a wonderful family vacation in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們在台東度過了一個精彩美好的家庭假期。

examples.en: The violinist played a truly wonderful musical piece that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 那位小提琴家演奏了一首極其美妙、深深打動聽眾的樂章。

examples.en: What a wonderful surprise to bump into an old classmate on the train!
examples.zh: 在火車上巧遇老同學真是個令人驚喜的美好緣分！

explains: It means very good and pleasing. A day with friends may feel this way. A gift can make a person happy.
A beautiful view may bring joy. A person may have a lovely time. This word describes something excellent.
This word means marvelous or very pleasing. A kind act may make someone feel happy. A song can sound lovely.

examples.en: Please write one word on each line.
examples.zh: 請在每一行寫一個單字。

examples.en: The word “apple” has five letters.
examples.zh: 「apple」這個單字有五個字母。

examples.en: She learned a new word today.
examples.zh: 她今天學了一個新單字。

explains: A group of letters with meaning is part of a sentence. A person may look one up in a book. Speech uses many of them.
A language has many units with meaning. A child can learn how to spell one. Several can form a sentence.
This small piece of language can name an object or action. A dictionary explains it. People use many while speaking.

examples.en: My father works at a tech company in Hsinchu.
examples.zh: 我父親在新竹的一家科技公司上班。

examples.en: Hard work and persistence will eventually pay off.
examples.zh: 辛勤工作與持之以恆終將換來回報。

examples.en: That medication worked wonders and cured my headache.
examples.zh: 那種藥效神奇，治好了我的頭痛。

explains: People do this to earn money. A person may do a task at an office. A machine can also function.
A job takes effort and time. A person may make art as a job. The word can mean a task or a place of employment.
This activity may help people earn a living. A machine can run properly. A person may make a painting or book as a result.

examples.en: The factory workers are taking a lunch break.
examples.zh: 工廠工人們正在吃午休便當。

examples.en: Construction workers wear yellow protective helmets on building sites.
examples.zh: 建築工人在工地現場佩戴黃色安全帽。

examples.en: Diligent office workers gathered to brainstorm new promotional campaigns.
examples.zh: 勤奮的上班族聚在一起集思廣益構思新的促銷方案。

explains: A person who has a job may build, clean, or teach. A factory can have many. The word describes someone who does labor.
This person earns money by doing a task. A cook may prepare food. A person can also volunteer.
A person in a job has this name. Some build houses, and others care for people. The word can describe many kinds of labor.

examples.en: People around the world enjoy music.
examples.zh: 世界各地的人都喜歡音樂。

examples.en: The world looks beautiful from space.
examples.zh: 從太空看地球很美。

examples.en: They traveled around the world by boat.
examples.zh: 他們搭船環遊世界。

explains: It means Earth and all people, places, and life. A map may show many countries. People live on this planet.
A large group of people across Earth can be described this way. It may also mean a setting or area of life. A person can travel around it.
This word names the planet where humans live. It can mean all countries together. A person may see its beauty in nature.

examples.en: Do not worry about the small mistake.
examples.zh: 不要為小錯誤擔心。

examples.en: She worries when her son is late.
examples.zh: 兒子遲到時她會擔心。

examples.en: His worry kept him awake at night.
examples.zh: 他的擔憂讓他夜裡睡不著。

explains: It means feeling uneasy about a problem. A person may be afraid of a test. Talking can help.
A parent may feel uneasy when a child is late. A difficult thought can cause stress. The word can also mean causing concern.
This feeling may happen before an important event. A friend may offer comfort. It can mean being troubled in mind.

examples.en: Please write down your email address.
examples.zh: 請寫下你的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: She writes in her personal diary every night before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 她每晚睡前都會在私人日記裡寫下記錄。

examples.en: He decided to write a thank-you letter to his former tutor.
examples.zh: 他決定寫一封感謝信給他以前的家教老師。

explains: It means making letters or words on paper. A child may do homework. A person can use a keyboard.
A person may put an idea in a letter. A student can make a story. The action uses a pen or computer.
This action records language. A child may put their name on a page. A person can send a message by email.

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a fiction writer.
examples.zh: 她夢想成為一名小說作家。

examples.en: The famous travel writer published a bestselling book about hiking trails.
examples.zh: 著名旅遊作家出版了一本關於健行步道的暢銷著作。

examples.en: A skilled writer uses clear, concise, and vivid language to connect with readers.
examples.zh: 熟練的寫作者運用清晰、簡練且生動的文字與讀者產生共鳴。

explains: A person who creates books, stories, or articles has this job. They may work at home. Their name appears on a book.
This person makes stories with language. A newspaper may have many. They can write facts or make up events.
A book may be made by this person. They choose ideas and put them on a page. Their work can entertain or teach.

examples.en: What is wrong with your bicycle tire?
examples.zh: 你的腳拔車輪胎怎麼了？

examples.en: It is wrong to blame innocent others for your own mistakes.
examples.zh: 將自己的過錯歸咎推卸給無辜的他人是不對的。

examples.en: If anything goes wrong during system testing, alert the technician immediately.
examples.zh: 如果在系統測試期間發生任何差錯，請立即通知技術人員。

explains: This describes something that is not correct. A student may write five when the answer is six. The answer needs to be changed.
This can describe a choice that does not fit your purpose. You may take a bus that goes away from your school. You need a different bus to get there.
This can describe an action that is unfair or harmful. Taking another person's belongings without asking is an example. People may use this word to say the action should not happen.

examples.en: The children are playing tag in the front yard.
examples.zh: 小朋友們正在前院玩捉迷藏。

examples.en: Grandpa enjoys planting fragrant flowering bushes in the spacious yard.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在寬敞的院子裡種植散發清香的花木。

examples.en: The fabric merchant measured five yards of fine silk cloth.
examples.zh: 布料商量取了五碼的上等絲綢布料。

examples.en: Smart terminal operating software organizes the container yard to minimize unnecessary box reshuffling.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業系統對貨櫃堆場進行動態空間最佳化，將不必要的翻櫃次數降至最低。

examples.en: Semi-trucks lined up outside the terminal gates waiting to drop off exports in the container yard.
examples.zh: 長途拖車在碼頭大門外排成一條長龍，依序等待進入管制堆場卸放即將報關出口的重櫃。

examples.en: Floodlights illuminate the sprawling container yard, enabling non-stop overnight cargo transfers.
examples.zh: 高空大功率投光燈將廣袤無邊的貨櫃堆場照耀得如白晝，保障通宵達旦的裝卸作業安全運作。

entries.definition: 庭院；院子；碼（長度）；貨櫃堆場智慧堆疊與翻櫃最小化；場地
explains: A grassy area beside a home may have flowers. Children can run there. The word can also mean three feet in length.
A fence may surround this outdoor area. A family may keep a garden there. One unit of this length equals thirty-six inches.
This open space may be behind a house. A dog can play there. The word also names a measure of length.

examples.en: Happy New Year to everyone!
examples.zh: 祝大家新年快樂！

examples.en: I will turn sixteen years old this year.
examples.zh: 我今年就要滿十六歲了。

examples.en: Our family travels abroad once a year.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年出國旅遊一次。

explains: Twelve months make this period. A birthday comes once during it. People use a calendar to count it.
This length of time begins in January. It has four seasons in many places. A person may say how old they are by counting them.
A calendar shows all days in this period. It lasts about three hundred sixty-five days. People celebrate its beginning.

examples.en: School buses in the US are bright yellow.
examples.zh: 美國的校車是亮黃色的。

examples.en: Sunflowers turned their yellow faces towards the warm sun.
examples.zh: 向日葵把黃色的花盤朝向溫暖的太陽。

examples.en: She highlighted the important keywords with a yellow marker.
examples.zh: 她用黃色螢光筆畫出重要關鍵字。

explains: This color is like a ripe lemon. A school bus may have this bright shade. It is made by mixing red and green light.
A banana can be this color before it turns brown. Sunflowers may have petals of this shade. It is a bright color.
This word names a warm color. It can be pale or bright. A warning sign may use it.

examples.en: She said yes to the invitation.
examples.zh: 她答應了邀請。

examples.en: The answer is yes.
examples.zh: 答案是肯定的。

examples.en: He nodded yes when I asked.
examples.zh: 我詢問時他點頭表示同意。

explains: It is a word used to agree. A person may answer a question this way. It can also show permission.
A child may say it after a parent asks a question. It means the answer is positive. A person can use it to accept an offer.
This short reply means agreement. A person may use it when asked if they are ready. It can also mean correct.

examples.en: I visited my grandparents yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去探望我的祖父母。

examples.en: Did you watch the baseball game on TV yesterday?
examples.zh: 你昨天有看電視上的棒球比賽嗎？

examples.en: Yesterday was the hottest day of this week.
examples.zh: 昨天是這星期最炎熱的一天。

explains: It means the day before today. A person may remember what happened then. A calendar shows it as a past date.
A child may talk about the previous day. It is one day before now. The word can refer to a recent past.
This word names the day that has ended before today. People may discuss a meeting from that day. It is a past time.

examples.en: Have you finished your English composition yet?
examples.zh: 你的英文作文已經寫完了嗎？

examples.en: We haven't decided our holiday travel destination yet.
examples.zh: 我們尚未決定假期的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The young athlete was tired yet determined to cross the marathon finish line.
examples.zh: 這位年輕運動員身心疲憊，然而依然下定決心衝過馬拉松終點線。

explains: It means up to now, often in a negative sentence. A person may not finish a task. It can also mean even now.
