A child may not have eaten lunch at this time. The word can mean until now. It can also show contrast.
This word may mean something has not happened so far. A person can ask if a bus has arrived. It can also mean nevertheless.

examples.en: Nice to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你。

examples.en: Where did you buy that beautiful notebook?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那本漂亮的筆記本的？

examples.en: You can join our study group anytime.
examples.zh: 你隨時都可以加入我們的讀書會。

examples.en: Help yourself to some fresh fruits and hot tea.
examples.zh: 請自便享用一些新鮮水果和熱茶。

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your unique capabilities.
examples.zh: 請始終相信你自己以及你獨一無二的才能。

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself when you fell off the skateboard?
examples.zh: 你從滑板上摔下來時有傷到自己嗎？

examples.en: Make yourselves comfortable, dear guests.
examples.zh: 親愛的客人們，請各位隨意放輕鬆。

examples.en: Did you all enjoy yourselves at the amusement park today?
examples.zh: 你們大家今天在主題遊樂園玩得盡興開懷嗎？

examples.en: Please introduce yourselves briefly before we start the collaborative workshop.
examples.zh: 在我們展開合作工作坊之前，請大家簡短自我介紹。

entries.definition: 你；你們；你自己；你們自己
explains: This pronoun refers to the person being spoken to. It can be one person or a group. Related forms show ownership or receive an action.
A speaker may use this word while talking directly to a friend. It can replace a name. Other forms can point to something owned by that person.
This word points at a listener. It may be used as a subject or object. Different forms show belonging or refer back to the listener.

examples.en: Many young people enjoy playing online games.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡玩線上遊戲。

examples.en: When I was young, I spent summer holidays catching cicadas in the orchard.
examples.zh: 當我年幼時，整個暑假都在果園裡抓蟬玩耍。

examples.en: The young artist won an award for her creative landscape paintings.
examples.zh: 這位年輕藝術家以其富創意的風景畫作榮獲獎項。

explains: It means not old. A baby is at the beginning of life. A person may still be growing.
A child has not lived many years. A puppy is not fully grown. This word describes someone early in life.
This describing word means new in age. A person may have little experience. A tree can also be newly planted.

examples.en: The score was zero after the first half.
examples.zh: 上半場結束時比分是零比零。

examples.en: Zero is less than one.
examples.zh: 零比一小。

examples.en: The temperature fell to zero last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到零度。

explains: This number represents no amount. An empty basket has this many apples. It comes just before one when counting upward.
This digit is written as a closed oval. Its place can change the value of another digit. For example, 10 is larger than 1.
On the Celsius scale, this value is the usual freezing point of water. Colder readings have a minus sign. Warmer readings are above this point.

examples.en: Children love visiting the giant pandas at Taipei Zoo.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡去台北市立動物園看大貓熊。

examples.en: Modern zoos prioritize animal welfare, habitat conservation, and public education.
examples.zh: 現代化動物園優先重視動物福祉、棲地保育與大眾教育。

examples.en: We spent an enjoyable Saturday afternoon exploring the open-air safari zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在戶外野生動物園度過了一個愉快的週六下午。

explains: People can see many animals here. Some live in water, and some live on land. Families may visit it on a day off.
This place has cages or open areas for animals. A keeper brings food. Children can learn about wildlife there.
A city may have this place for animal care. Visitors can watch lions, birds, and bears. It can help protect rare animals.

examples.en: His absence made the class feel quiet.
examples.zh: 他的缺席讓班上氣氛很安靜。

examples.en: The absence of rain hurt the crops.
examples.zh: 缺少雨水傷害了農作物。

examples.en: She noticed his absence from the meeting.
examples.zh: 她注意到他沒有出席會議。

explains: It means not being present. A teacher may mark a student who is away. The word can also mean a lack of something.
A missing item is not there. A person may notice a gap in a group. The word can describe a lack.
This word names a state of being away. A family may feel sad while a loved one is away. It can also mean something is missing.

examples.en: Why were you absent from English class yesterday morning?
examples.zh: 你昨天早上英文課為什麼缺席沒來？

examples.en: He had an absent look on his face while lost in deep thought.
examples.zh: 他陷入沉思時臉上帶著若有所思、心不在焉的神情。

examples.en: Students who are absent more than three times cannot take the final exam.
examples.zh: 曠課缺席超過三次以上的學生將不得參加期末考試。

explains: It means not at a place. A student may be away from class. A chair may be empty.
A worker may not come to the office. The person is away for a day. This word describes not being present.
This word tells that someone is missing from a place. A person may be away due to illness. A room can be empty.

examples.en: She gladly accepted the invitation to the birthday party.
examples.zh: 她欣然接受了參加生日派對的邀請。

examples.en: The university accepted his application for the master's degree program.
examples.zh: 這所大學錄取了他攻讀碩士學位學程的入學申請。

examples.en: Learning to accept constructive criticism helps you grow professionally.
examples.zh: 學會接納建設性的批評能幫助你在職場上不斷成長。

explains: It means saying yes to an offer or idea. A person may agree to a gift. The action can also mean taking something willingly.
A friend may agree with a plan. A person can take a job offer. The word may mean allowing something to happen.
This action means receiving or agreeing. A child may take an apology. A group can allow a new member to join.

examples.en: Drive defensively to prevent serious road accidents.
examples.zh: 採取防衛性駕駛以預防嚴重的交通事故。

examples.en: I spilled hot coffee over my keyboard completely by accident.
examples.zh: 我純屬意外不小心把熱咖啡潑灑在鍵盤上。

examples.en: Emergency medics responded swiftly to the factory accident.
examples.zh: 緊急救護人員對工廠發生的意外事件迅速做出了處置。

explains: It is an event that happens by chance and may cause harm. A car can hit another car. Someone may get hurt.
A fall on a wet floor can be this kind of event. It was not planned. A doctor may help a person afterward.
This word means a sudden event that was not meant to happen. It may break an object. A person may need help.

examples.en: Enter your username to log in to your student account.
examples.zh: 輸入你的使用者名稱以登入學生帳號。

examples.en: She opened a joint savings account with her husband.
examples.zh: 她和先生開立了一個聯名儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Eyewitness accounts helped the police solve the crime.
examples.zh: 目擊者的陳述說明幫助警方偵破了這起案件。

explains: It can mean a place where a person keeps money in a bank. It can also mean a username and password online. A story of events has the same name.
A person may open one at a bank. A website may ask someone to sign in. The word can also mean a report of what happened.
This word can mean a record kept by a bank. It may also mean a user profile on a site. A person can give an explanation of an event.

examples.en: Active aging encourages retirees to participate in community clubs, travel, and practice lifelong learning.
examples.zh: 活躍老化理念鼓勵銀髮退休族走出家門參與社團、結伴旅遊，活出精采豐富的第二人生。

examples.en: Regular swimming and cycling help middle-aged adults maintain an active and energetic lifestyle.
examples.zh: 養成規律游泳與騎單車的好習慣，有助於中年族群長期維持活力充沛的積極生活型態。

examples.en: She plays an active role in local neighborhood watch meetings to improve pedestrian sidewalk safety.
examples.zh: 她積極主動參與社區守望相助會報，建言改善社區周遭人行步道的各項通行安全。

entries.definition: 樂齡活躍老化的；積極活躍的
explains: It means moving and doing things. A child may run outside. A machine can also be working.
A person who joins many events is lively. A group may be busy. This word can describe something in use.
This word means lively or busy. A person may take part in sports. A machine that works is not idle.

examples.en: Astronauts rehearsed emergency drills for seven-hour extravehicular activity (EVA) spacewalks.
examples.zh: 太空人針對長達七個小時的艙外活動漫步，在水槽中進行了上百次模擬演練。

examples.en: Stepping out through the hatch during extravehicular activity requires double-checking every suit seal.
examples.zh: 跨出氣閘艙門執行艙外活動漫步前，兩位太空人必須相互進行上百道嚴格的防護衣氣密雙重覆核。

examples.en: Autonomous robotic assistants accompany explorers during surface planetary activity to carry heavy geology drills.
examples.zh: 自主型伴隨輪式機器人在探險隊員執行地表科考活動時如影隨形，主動扛起沉重的重型地質鑽探機具。

entries.definition: 太空人走出氣閘之艙外漫步活動 (EVA)；活動
explains: It is something people do for learning or fun. A class may make a paper craft. A game can be one.
A person may join a group walk. Students can do a science task. The word means an event or action.
This word names an event people take part in. A teacher may give one in class. It can be fun or work.

examples.en: The actual cost was higher than we thought.
examples.zh: 實際費用比我們想的高。

examples.en: Is that the actual story?
examples.zh: 那是真實的故事嗎？

examples.en: The actual time is written on the ticket.
examples.zh: 票上寫著正確的時間。

explains: It means true and not imagined. A real event actually happened. The word can also mean current.
A person may ask for the true fact. A story can be based on life. It can mean genuine.
This word describes something that exists. A fact is not made up. It can also mean exact or current.

examples.en: Two plus three is addition.
examples.zh: 二加三是加法。

examples.en: The addition of milk made the soup creamy.
examples.zh: 加入牛奶後湯變得滑順。

examples.en: They built an addition to the house.
examples.zh: 他們為房子增建了一個部分。

explains: It means putting numbers together to find a sum. Two and two make four. It can also mean something added.
A student may add two amounts. A new part may be joined to a house. This word can describe the act or result.
This word means adding one thing to another. A cook may put an extra item in a recipe. In math, the result is a sum.

examples.en: Write the recipient's shipping address clearly in English.
examples.zh: 用英文將收件人的收件地址書寫清楚。

examples.en: The mayor delivered a powerful keynote address at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上發表了震撼有力的專題致詞演說。

examples.en: We need to work together to address environmental pollution issues.
examples.zh: 我們需要齊心協力來應對並解決環境污染問題。

explains: A home has a place where mail is sent. A person may also speak to a group formally. The word can be used as an action when talking to someone.
A letter shows where a person lives. A speaker may give a speech to an audience. A person can also talk about a problem.
This can mean the location of a house. It can also mean a formal speech. As a verb, it means speaking directly to someone.

examples.en: The school admitted three new students.
examples.zh: 學校收了三名新生。

examples.en: He admitted that he broke the cup.
examples.zh: 他承認自己打破了杯子。

examples.en: The club will admit new members in May.
examples.zh: 俱樂部五月會接納新會員。

explains: It means saying that something is true. A person may say they made a mistake. A school may let a student join.
A person can say honestly that they made a mistake. A club may also allow someone to become a member. Both ideas can be expressed with this verb.
This action means allowing someone in. It can also mean telling the truth about something. A person may do it after being asked.

examples.en: In Taiwan, an eighteen-year-old is considered a legal adult.
examples.zh: 在台灣，年滿十八歲即被視為法定成年人。

examples.en: Adult admission tickets to the art museum cost three hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 參觀這座美術館的成人全票費用為三百元。

examples.en: With adulthood comes greater freedom as well as serious responsibilities.
examples.zh: 成年伴隨著更大的自由，同時也肩負著重大的責任。

explains: A person who is fully grown has this age status. They can vote in many places. The word can also describe something for grown people.
This person is no longer a child. They may live on their own. A movie can be made for this age group.
This word names a grown person. The person can make many choices legally. A child becomes one after many years.

examples.en: The team made great advances this year.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍今年有很大的進步。

examples.en: They paid an advance before the work began.
examples.zh: 工作開始前他們先付了一筆預付款。

examples.en: The army advanced toward the bridge.
examples.zh: 軍隊朝橋的方向前進。

explains: It means moving forward. A student may go ahead in a lesson. The word can also mean money paid before a sale.
A team may make progress. A person can move toward a goal. A buyer may pay some money early.
This word means progress or movement ahead. A company may pay money before work is done. As a verb, it means making progress.

examples.en: My teacher gave me good advice.
examples.zh: 老師給了我很好的建議。

examples.en: She asked her mother for advice.
examples.zh: 她向媽媽請教。

examples.en: His advice helped me choose a book.
examples.zh: 他的建議幫我選了一本書。

explains: It is a helpful idea about what someone should do. A friend may give guidance. A doctor may suggest rest.
A person may ask for help making a choice. A teacher can offer a useful idea. The word means guidance.
This word names a suggestion meant to help. A family member may offer one. It can help someone make a decision.

examples.en: The newspaper reported a public affair.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了一件公共事件。

examples.en: Their love affair became a movie.
examples.zh: 他們的戀情被拍成了一部電影。

examples.en: The family discussed a private affair.
examples.zh: 那家人討論了一件私事。

explains: It can mean a matter or event. A person may discuss family concerns. It can also mean a romantic relationship.
A news story may describe a public event. A person can have a private concern. The word may also name a love relationship.
This word means an event or subject people discuss. It may refer to a personal concern. It can also mean a secret romance.

examples.en: The cold weather affected the plants.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣影響了植物。

examples.en: Her kind words affected him deeply.
examples.zh: 她親切的話深深影響了他。

examples.en: The medicine may affect your sleep.
examples.zh: 這種藥可能會影響你的睡眠。

explains: It means making a change in someone or something. A kind word can change a mood. Heat can change ice into water.
A person’s choice may have an effect. A story can change how someone feels. The word means having an effect.
This action causes a change. A loud sound may disturb a baby. The result can be good or bad.

examples.en: Lean your umbrella against the shoe cabinet near the door.
examples.zh: 把你的雨傘靠在門口的鞋櫃旁。

examples.en: Citizens voted overwhelmingly against the proposal to tear down the historic library.
examples.zh: 全體市民以壓倒性票數投票，強烈反對拆除這座具有百年歷史的古蹟圖書館。

examples.en: Wearing a sturdy waterproof jacket provides great protection against bitter winter winds.
examples.zh: 穿上一件厚實硬挺的防水防風機能外套，能為你提供抵禦冬日寒風的絕佳防護。

explains: It means in opposition to something. A player may lean on a wall. A person can protect a home from rain.
A team can play an opponent. A picture may rest on a surface. This word can show protection from harm.
This word can mean opposite or touching. A person may stand beside a wall for support. A shield protects someone from danger.

examples.en: The runner was ahead of the others.
examples.zh: 那位跑者領先其他人。

examples.en: We arrived ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我們提早到了。

examples.en: Think ahead before you make a choice.
examples.zh: 做選擇前先想想未來。

explains: It means in front or at a later stage. A person may arrive before others. A child may look toward the future.
A runner can move in front of a group. A student may finish a task early. This word can mean a point in the future.
This word describes a position in front. It can also mean earlier than expected. A person may plan for what comes next.

examples.en: The nurse gave aid to the injured boy.
examples.zh: 護士幫助了受傷的男孩。

examples.en: This map is a great aid on trips.
examples.zh: 這張地圖在旅行時很有幫助。

examples.en: They sent food aid after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後他們送來糧食援助。

explains: It means help. A rescue worker may give support. A tool can make a task easier.
A person may help a neighbor carry a box. Money can be given to a family in need. The word can mean support.
This word names help given to someone. A friend may offer it during a hard time. It can also mean a tool that helps.

examples.en: The archer aimed at the target.
examples.zh: 弓箭手瞄準了目標。

examples.en: Her aim is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的目標是成為醫生。

examples.en: The camera aimed toward the stage.
examples.zh: 相機朝向舞台。

explains: It means pointing at a goal. A person may point a camera at a bird. The word can also mean a purpose.
A player may try to send a ball into a net. A person can set a goal for the year. This word means a purpose or direction.
This word describes a goal someone hopes to reach. An archer points an arrow at a mark. The action can mean pointing toward something.

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
examples.zh: 飛機安全降落在機場。

examples.en: A small aircraft flew over the island.
examples.zh: 一架小型飛機飛過島嶼。

examples.en: The aircraft can carry twenty people.
examples.zh: 這架飛機可以搭載二十人。

explains: A flying machine carries people or goods. It can travel high above land. A pilot controls it.
This vehicle flies through the sky. A cargo version carries boxes. Passengers may use one for a long trip.
A large machine can travel through air. It has wings and engines. A pilot guides it from a cockpit.

examples.en: The alarm rang at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 鬧鐘早上六點響起。

examples.en: Smoke set off the fire alarm.
examples.zh: 煙霧觸發了火災警報器。

examples.en: She set an alarm before bed.
examples.zh: 她睡前設定了鬧鐘。

explains: A loud sound can warn people of danger. A clock may make one in the morning. A person may feel worried by a sudden sound.
A fire can trigger a warning signal. A phone may make a loud sound at a set time. The word can mean a warning.
This device tells people to wake up or pay attention. It may ring loudly. A person may set one before bed.

examples.en: The band released a new album.
examples.zh: 樂團發行了一張新專輯。

examples.en: She keeps family photos in an album.
examples.zh: 她把家庭照片放在相簿裡。

examples.en: I listened to the whole album.
examples.zh: 我聽完整張專輯。

explains: A book holds photos or music in one collection. A singer may release one. A person can keep family pictures inside it.
A photo book can show memories from a trip. A music collection may have many songs. The word can also mean a computer file for pictures.
This collection may hold photos or songs. A person may look at family memories. A music artist can make one for fans.

examples.en: The twins look alike.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎看起來很像。

examples.en: The two houses are alike in color.
examples.zh: 這兩棟房子的顏色相似。

examples.en: Their ideas are very much alike.
examples.zh: 他們的想法非常相似。

explains: It means similar to another person or thing. Two coats may look the same. The word can also mean having a shared view.
A pair of twins may look very much like each other. Two houses may have a similar design. This word describes a close match.
This word means nearly the same. A person may have ideas like a friend’s. Two objects can share a look.

examples.en: The fish is still alive.
examples.zh: 那條魚還活著。

examples.en: The plant stayed alive through winter.
examples.zh: 那株植物熬過冬天仍然活著。

examples.en: She felt alive after the long swim.
examples.zh: 長泳之後她感覺精神充沛。

explains: It means not dead. A plant can grow and change. A person may feel full of energy.
An animal that breathes and moves is living. A person can feel excited. The word can describe a creature with life.
This word describes a person or animal that lives. A green plant may keep growing. Someone may feel energetic and happy.

examples.en: He lives alone in a small house.
examples.zh: 他獨自住在一間小房子裡。

examples.en: The child was alone in the room.
examples.zh: 那個孩子獨自在房間裡。

examples.en: She likes to walk alone in the morning.
examples.zh: 她喜歡早上獨自散步。

explains: It means being by oneself. A person may live without roommates. A quiet walk can happen with no one else.
A child may sit apart from a group. The person has no company. This word can also mean only one.
This word describes a person who is not with others. A house may have one person in it. It can mean single.

examples.en: Please read the poem aloud.
examples.zh: 請把這首詩大聲念出來。

examples.en: The child laughed aloud at the joke.
examples.zh: 那個孩子聽了笑話大聲笑出來。

examples.en: She called aloud for help.
examples.zh: 她大聲呼救。

explains: It means speaking so others can hear. A child may read a story to a class. A person can call across a room.
This means using your voice so other people can hear the words. A student may read a poem to the class. The voice can be quiet or loud, as long as it can be heard.
This action uses the voice at a clear volume. A teacher may call names. A person can speak so a group hears.

examples.en: Altogether, we collected fifty books.
examples.zh: 我們總共收集了五十本書。

examples.en: The room was altogether too dark.
examples.zh: 這個房間實在太暗了。

examples.en: They worked altogether as one team.
examples.zh: 他們全體一起合作。

explains: It means all together or in total. A group may finish a task as one. It can also mean completely.
A person may add all parts. Friends can agree as a group. The word can mean wholly or entirely.
This word means the full amount. A team may act as one group. It can also mean completely.

examples.en: Bubble tea is hugely popular among international exchange students.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶在國際交換學生群體中極受歡迎。

examples.en: We strolled happily among ancient red cypress trees in the Alishan forest.
examples.zh: 我們漫步在阿里山神木林間，穿梭矗立在數千年紅檜巨木群之中。

examples.en: The generous lottery winner divided his fortune equally among five local charities.
examples.zh: 慷慨的大樂透得主將大部分中獎彩金平均分配捐贈給五家在地慈善機構。

explains: It means in the middle of a group. A child may stand near friends. The word can also mean surrounded by.
A flower may grow inside a field of grass. A person can live in a large group. This word describes being in a larger set.
This word means in the company of many. A bird may hide in trees. One item can be found inside a group.

examples.en: The total amount of water is two liters.
examples.zh: 水的總量是兩公升。

examples.en: We need a small amount of flour.
examples.zh: 我們需要少量麵粉。

examples.en: The amount on the bill is correct.
examples.zh: 帳單上的金額正確。

explains: It means how much there is. A cup can hold a certain number of liters. The word can also mean a sum of money.
A person may measure flour for a cake. A bill shows the money owed. This word names a quantity.
This word describes a quantity or total. A bottle may hold a certain volume. It can also mean a sum.

examples.en: The ancient temple is over two thousand years old.
examples.zh: 這座古老寺廟有兩千多年歷史。

examples.en: They found an ancient coin in the field.
examples.zh: 他們在田裡找到一枚古錢幣。

examples.en: Ancient stories are taught in class.
examples.zh: 課堂上會教古代故事。

explains: It means very old, from a long time ago. A stone building may have stood for hundreds of years. Historians study old objects.
A city may have a past from many centuries ago. A person can see old tools in a museum. This word means from early history.
This word describes something from a very long time ago. It may refer to old people or objects. An old temple can have this quality.

examples.en: His anger faded after he took a walk.
examples.zh: 散步後他的怒氣消退了。

examples.en: She spoke with anger in her voice.
examples.zh: 她說話時語氣帶著怒氣。

examples.en: He felt anger when the game was canceled.
examples.zh: 比賽取消時他感到生氣。

explains: It is a strong feeling of being upset. A person may feel it after unfair treatment. Calm breathing can help.
A child may feel mad after losing a game. A kind reply can reduce this feeling. The word means strong displeasure.
This emotion may happen during a fight. A person can feel hot and tense. It is better to speak calmly.

examples.en: The two roads meet at a sharp angle.
examples.zh: 兩條道路以一個尖角交會。

examples.en: Take a photo from a low angle.
examples.zh: 從低角度拍一張照片。

examples.en: The roof has a gentle angle.
examples.zh: 屋頂有一個平緩的斜角。

explains: Two straight arms meet at a shared point. The amount of turn from one arm to the other has this name. A wider opening gives a larger amount of turn.
The corner of a square measures ninety degrees. It makes a square corner. Four such turns bring you back to your starting direction.
The word can also describe the direction from which something is viewed. A photographer may move to one side before taking a picture. The new position shows the scene differently.

examples.en: She twisted her ankle while running.
examples.zh: 她跑步時扭傷腳踝。

examples.en: He wore a bracelet around his ankle.
examples.zh: 他在腳踝上戴了一條手鍊。

examples.en: The doctor checked my sore ankle.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查我痠痛的腳踝。

explains: It is the joint between the foot and leg. A person may twist it while running. Shoes cover it.
This body part moves as a person walks. A sock can cover it. A doctor may check it after a fall.
A foot joins the lower leg here. A person may wear a bracelet around it. It can hurt after a sprain.

examples.en: Call me anytime after school.
examples.zh: 放學後隨時打給我。

examples.en: You can visit anytime this week.
examples.zh: 你這週任何時候都可以來。

examples.en: Anytime is a good time for tea.
examples.zh: 任何時候都適合喝茶。

explains: It means at any time. A person may call for help day or night. The word can also mean whenever.
A child may visit a friend at any hour. It can describe a time without limits. A person can use it in a question.
This word means whenever a time comes. A shop may be open at any hour. It can also mean at all times.

examples.en: Anyway, we can try again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 無論如何，我們明天可以再試一次。

examples.en: I was tired, but I went anyway.
examples.zh: 我很累，但還是去了。

examples.en: Anyway, what happened next?
examples.zh: 無論如何，接下來發生了什麼？

explains: It means in any case. A person may finish a task despite a problem. The word can also mean regardless.
A child may go outside even if it rains. The result does not change. This word can show that a choice remains.
This word means regardless of what happened. A person may try again. It can also move a conversation forward.

examples.en: I cannot find my house keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 我在任何地方都找不到我的家門鑰匙。

examples.en: With reliable internet, digital nomads can work from anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 有了穩定的網路，數位遊民可以在世界任何角落工作。

examples.en: You can park your shared bicycle anywhere inside the designated green zones.
examples.zh: 你可以將共享單車停放在指定綠色區域內的任何地點。

explains: It means at a place that is not named. A person may search for a quiet location. The exact spot is unknown.
A traveler may go to any place. A map can show many locations. This word does not say where exactly.
This word means in any location. A child may hide in one of many places. It can also describe movement to an unknown spot.

examples.en: The ape climbed high into the tree.
examples.zh: 猿爬到樹的高處。

examples.en: An ape used a stick to get food.
examples.zh: 一隻猿用棍子取得食物。

examples.en: The young ape stayed near its mother.
examples.zh: 那隻年幼的猿待在媽媽身邊。

explains: This animal belongs to the same group as gorillas and chimpanzees. It has no tail. Its hands can hold objects.
Many animals in this group can climb trees. Their arms help them move between branches. They can learn and solve simple problems.
The verb can mean copying another person’s actions. A child may copy a teacher’s walk. The copying may be done to make people laugh.

examples.en: Her appearance changed after the haircut.
examples.zh: 剪髮後她的外表改變了。

examples.en: The house has a modern appearance.
examples.zh: 這棟房子外觀很現代。

examples.en: His calm appearance hid his fear.
examples.zh: 他平靜的外表掩飾了恐懼。

explains: It means how someone or something looks. A person may change clothes before a photo. The word can also mean seeming to be.
A person’s face gives a first look. A building may have a neat outside. This word can describe what seems true.
This word names the way something looks. A person may make a good first impression. It can also mean seeming to happen.

examples.en: A long walk gave me an appetite.
examples.zh: 走了很久讓我有了食慾。

examples.en: The soup made her appetite better.
examples.zh: 這碗湯讓她胃口變好了。

examples.en: He has a healthy appetite.
examples.zh: 他的食慾很好。

explains: It is a desire to eat. A person may feel it before lunch. A tasty smell can make it stronger.
A hungry child may ask for food. A meal can satisfy this feeling. The word means wanting to eat.
This feeling makes a person look for food. A long walk may increase it. Soup or fruit can help.

examples.en: He decided to apply for the overseas software engineer position.
examples.zh: 他決定應徵這份海外軟體工程師的工作職缺。

examples.en: Apply theoretical classroom knowledge to practical everyday engineering problems.
examples.zh: 將課堂上學得的各項抽象理論知識，靈活應用於解決日常工程實務難題之中。

examples.en: Apply sunscreen lotion evenly across exposed skin thirty minutes before swimming.
examples.zh: 在下水游泳嬉戲的三十分鐘前，先將防曬乳均勻塗抹在曝露於陽光下的肌膚上。

explains: It means asking for a job or a place in a school. A person may send a form. It can also mean putting a cream on skin.
A student may ask to join a program. A worker may ask for a new job. The word can also mean using a rule.
This action means making a formal request. A person can also spread lotion on a hand. It may mean putting an idea into practice.

examples.en: I truly appreciate your patient help with my English essay.
examples.zh: 我由衷感激你對我英語作文所提供的耐心指導。

examples.en: Taking art history lessons taught me how to appreciate classical oil paintings.
examples.zh: 研修藝術史課程教會了我如何細細品味並欣賞古典西洋油畫之美。

examples.en: Real estate properties in convenient transit hubs appreciate steadily over time.
examples.zh: 坐落於交通便利樞紐核心地段的優質不動產，其市場價值隨時間穩步升值。

explains: It means feeling thankful. A person may value a kind gift. It can also mean enjoying art or music.
A friend may be grateful for help. A person can enjoy a beautiful song. The word means valuing something.
This word tells that someone feels thankful. A listener may enjoy a song. A person can value a kind act.

examples.en: The train approached the station slowly.
examples.zh: 火車慢慢接近車站。

examples.en: She approached the teacher after class.
examples.zh: 下課後她走近老師。

examples.en: We need a new approach to this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要一種解決這個問題的新方法。

explains: It means coming closer to a place. A person may walk toward a door. It can also mean a way of handling a problem.
A bus may come nearer to a stop. A person can ask someone for help. The word can describe a method.
This action means moving nearer. A student may come closer to a teacher. It can also mean trying a new method.

examples.en: Don't argue over trivial matters with your siblings.
examples.zh: 不要為了微不足道的小事和兄弟姊妹起爭執。

examples.en: The defense attorney argued convincingly that the evidence had been contaminated.
examples.zh: 辯護律師在法庭上提出強而有力的論證，主張關鍵證物早已遭到不當汙染。

examples.en: Economists argue whether raising interest rates will cool inflation without hurting growth.
examples.zh: 經濟學家針對調高基準利率能否在不扼殺經濟動能的前提下抑制通膨爭論不休。

examples.en: The two friends quickly made up after a brief argument.
examples.zh: 兩位好友在短暫的爭執後很快就和好如初了。

examples.en: She constructed a compelling logical argument supporting green infrastructure investment.
examples.zh: 她建構出條理分明、極具說服力的邏輯論據，強力支持擴大投資綠色基礎建設。

examples.en: Engaging in angry personal arguments on social media forums wastes valuable mental energy.
examples.zh: 在社群媒體論壇上與陌生網友捲入情緒化的人身攻擊爭論，純屬浪費精神心力。

entries.definition: 爭吵；口角；爭辯；爭論；論點；辯論
explains: It means giving reasons for an idea. Two friends may disagree loudly. A person can explain a point.
A student may give reasons for an answer. People can have a disagreement. The word can also name a reason used to support an idea.
This action means speaking about different views. A person may try to prove a point. A loud disagreement can happen between friends.

examples.en: The army marched through the town.
examples.zh: 軍隊行經城鎮。

examples.en: He joined the army at eighteen.
examples.zh: 他十八歲時加入軍隊。

examples.en: The army helped after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水後軍隊提供了協助。

explains: A country’s armed forces have people trained to protect it. They may wear uniforms. They can help during a war or disaster.
This group of soldiers protects a nation. Members may train together. They can also bring help after a storm.
A large group of trained fighters can defend a country. They follow orders from leaders. Some work with vehicles or aircraft.

examples.en: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
examples.zh: 請把椅子排成一個圓圈。

examples.en: They arranged a meeting for Monday.
examples.zh: 他們安排星期一開會。

examples.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把花插在花瓶裡。

explains: It means putting things in order. A person may prepare chairs for a meeting. The word can also mean a plan between people.
A worker may place items neatly. Friends can agree on a date to meet. This word can mean an organized plan.
This action means putting things in a chosen order. A person may sort books on a shelf. It can also mean making plans for a meeting or trip.

examples.en: We will meet our visiting foreign friends at the arrival hall.
examples.zh: 我們將在機場入境接機大廳迎接來訪的外國友人。

examples.en: The flight arrival was delayed by poor weather conditions.
examples.zh: 航班抵達時間因惡劣天候狀況而有所延誤。

examples.en: On arrival at the hotel, guest luggage was taken directly to their suites.
examples.zh: 抵達飯店時，客人的行李被直接送往了他們的套房。

explains: It means coming to a place. A train may reach a station. A traveler can come home after a trip.
A person may reach a town after a long drive. A guest can come to a party. The word names the act of getting there.
This word means reaching a destination. An airplane may land at an airport. A family may greet a guest at home.

examples.en: The arrow pointed toward the exit.
examples.zh: 箭頭指向出口。

examples.en: He shot an arrow at the target.
examples.zh: 他朝目標射了一支箭。

examples.en: Follow the arrow on the map.
examples.zh: 沿著地圖上的箭頭走。

explains: A small mark with a point shows a direction. A person may draw one on a map. It can also be shot from a bow.
A sign may have a mark that shows where to go. A hunter can send this pointed object through the air. It has a sharp head and a long shaft.
This pointed object can be made of wood or metal. A bow sends it toward a target. A road sign may use a symbol that points.

examples.en: I read an article about birds.
examples.zh: 我讀了一篇關於鳥類的文章。

examples.en: The article explains how rain forms.
examples.zh: 這篇文章說明雨是如何形成的。

examples.en: She wrote an article for the school paper.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫了一篇文章。

explains: A group of words in a newspaper may give facts about an event. A book has chapters. The word can also mean one item in a group.
A newspaper may have a story about a game. A book has sections with names. This word can also mean one item in a list.
This word means one part of a newspaper or a legal paper. It may give information. A book can have many parts of this kind.

examples.en: The artist painted a picture of the sea.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家畫了一幅海景。

examples.en: A local artist played music in the park.
examples.zh: 一位當地藝術家在公園演奏音樂。

examples.en: The artist signed her work.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家在作品上簽名。

explains: A person who makes paintings, music, or other creative things has this role. A gallery may show their work. They may use many tools.
This person creates pictures or music. A concert may feature one. Their work can be sold or shared.
A person who makes art has this name. They may draw, paint, or perform music. A museum may show their work.

examples.en: The baby was asleep in the crib.
examples.zh: 嬰兒在嬰兒床裡睡著了。

examples.en: He fell asleep during the movie.
examples.zh: 他看電影時睡著了。

examples.en: The house was quiet while everyone was asleep.
examples.zh: 大家都睡著時房子很安靜。

explains: It means sleeping. A child may be quiet in bed. A person can close their eyes after a long day.
A baby may be in this state at night. A tired person may lie down. A loud sound can wake them.
This word describes a person who is not awake. They may be dreaming. Rest helps the body.

examples.en: She made an attempt to climb the hill.
examples.zh: 她試著爬上小山。

examples.en: His first attempt was not successful.
examples.zh: 他的第一次嘗試沒有成功。

examples.en: They attempted to fix the broken chair.
examples.zh: 他們試著修理壞掉的椅子。

explains: It means making an effort to do something. A student may try a hard puzzle. The result is not always good.
A person may make an effort at a new skill. A cook can test a recipe. This word can also mean a test or effort.
This action means trying to reach a goal. A player may make a shot. A person can try more than once.

examples.en: Many students attend the morning class.
examples.zh: 許多學生上早上的課。

examples.en: She attends church every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她每週日都去教堂。

examples.en: The doctor will attend to the patient soon.
examples.zh: 醫生很快會照料病人。

explains: It means going to a place or event. A child may go to class each day. A person can be at a meeting.
Students go to school to learn. A guest may go to a wedding. The word can also mean paying careful attention.
This action means being present at an event. A person may go to a class. It can also mean caring for a need.

examples.en: Training your attention span like a muscle builds resistance against impulsive social media scrolling.
examples.zh: 像鍛鍊肌肉般耐心鍛鍊自己的注意力，能築起強大防線，不再無意識滑動手機社群。

examples.en: The flight attendant politely asked passengers to give their undivided attention to the emergency safety briefing.
examples.zh: 空服員親切且禮貌地廣播提醒所有機上旅客，請全神貫注聆聽起飛前的客艙安全逃生示範與說明。

examples.en: She paid meticulous attention to every single detail when drafting the international joint venture contract.
examples.zh: 在親自起草這份跨國合資企業法律契約時，她對合約條文中的每一個文字細節都傾注了一絲不苟的專注。

entries.definition: 專注不移的選擇性注意力廣度
explains: It means looking or listening carefully. A teacher may ask for quiet. A child may watch a story.
A loud sound can make people look up. A student may listen to directions. The word can also mean care or notice.
This word means careful focus. A person may look at a sign. A teacher may ask a class to listen.

examples.en: The famous author signed copies of her new book at the Taipei Book Fair.
examples.zh: 知名作家在台北國際書展上親切為讀者簽署新書。

examples.en: Who is the author of this insightful editorial on semiconductor manufacturing?
examples.zh: 究竟是哪位專欄作家撰寫了這篇針對半導體晶片製造業極具見地的社論文章？

examples.en: Over her forty-year literary career, the author produced twenty acclaimed novels.
examples.zh: 在長達四十載的文學生涯中，該知名作家累計創作了二十餘部備受讚譽的長篇小說。

explains: A person who creates a book or story has this job. Their name may appear on its cover. They choose what to write.
This person makes stories, poems, or facts in books. A newspaper may have one. They may work alone.
A book has a creator with this title. The person puts ideas into writing. Their work can teach or entertain.

examples.en: The room is available after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後這個房間可以使用。

examples.en: Tickets are still available online.
examples.zh: 網路上還買得到票。

examples.en: Is the teacher available now?
examples.zh: 老師現在有空嗎？

explains: It means ready for use. A seat may be empty for a guest. A doctor may have an opening.
A room can be free for a new person. A shop may have an item to buy. The word means ready or free.
This word describes a thing that can be used now. A worker may have time. A seat may not be taken.

examples.en: The average score was eighty points.
examples.zh: 平均分數是八十分。

examples.en: On average, the bus comes every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 平均來說，公車每十分鐘來一班。

examples.en: Her height is close to the class average.
examples.zh: 她的身高接近班級平均值。

explains: One common meaning is a value found by adding numbers and dividing by how many there are. It gives a single summary of the group. Math classes often use this calculation.
Three children collect two, four, and six stones. Together they have twelve stones. Sharing them equally gives each child four.
The adjective can mean ordinary or typical. An ordinary-sized room is neither very big nor very small. The word often compares something with what is usual.

examples.en: Try to avoid the wet floor.
examples.zh: 盡量避開濕滑的地板。

examples.en: He avoids eating too much candy.
examples.zh: 他避免吃太多糖果。

examples.en: We left early to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我們提早離開以避開車潮。

explains: It means staying away from something. A person may not eat a food that causes illness. A driver can keep away from danger.
A child may stay clear of a hot stove. A person can choose not to talk about a hard topic. This action helps prevent trouble.
This word means keeping clear of a person or thing. A hiker may go around a deep hole. A person may not do something harmful.

examples.en: The ergonomic 50-liter backpack transfers heavy tent and food loads comfortably onto the hiker’s hip belt.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的五十公升專業登山大背包，能將帳篷與糧食重量穩穩轉移至腰帶支撐。

examples.en: Many university students plan to backpack across Taiwan’s scenic mountain ranges this summer.
examples.zh: 許多大學生計劃今年暑假背起大背包，徒步縱走台灣壯闊的百岳山脈。

examples.en: Inspect all buckle stitching and zipper seams before loading your heavy mountain backpack.
examples.zh: 在打包重裝登山大背包前，請務必逐一檢查所有扣具車縫線與拉鍊接縫。

entries.definition: 輕量化 50 公升專業登山重裝大背包
explains: A student carries books in this bag on their back. It has shoulder straps. It can hold lunch too.
A hiker may pack food and clothes in this bag. It rests on the back. Two straps go over the shoulders.
This bag is made for carrying books or gear. A child can take it to school. A traveler may bring it on a walk.

examples.en: The car rolled backward down the hill.
examples.zh: 車子往後滑下山坡。

examples.en: She took a backward step.
examples.zh: 她往後退了一步。

examples.en: He looked backward over his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他越過肩膀向後看。

explains: It means toward the back. A person may step away from a door. A car can move in reverse.
A child may look behind them. A truck can move in the opposite direction. The word can also mean in the past.
This word describes movement away from the front. A person may walk toward a place they came from. It can mean earlier.

examples.en: The child walked backwards toward the door.
examples.zh: 孩子倒退著走向門口。

examples.en: He leaned backward in his chair.
examples.zh: 他向後靠在椅子上。

examples.en: The truck moved backward slowly.
examples.zh: 卡車慢慢地向後移動。

explains: It means toward the back or in reverse. A person may take a step away. A car may move in this direction.
A child can lean toward the rear. A vehicle may go in reverse. This word can describe looking to the past.
This word means moving toward the back. A person may walk in reverse. It can also describe something done earlier.

examples.en: Tai Tzu-ying is a world-famous badminton player.
examples.zh: 戴資穎是世界著名的羽球選手。

examples.en: We reserved a court to play doubles badminton after school.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了場地準備放學後去打羽球雙打。

examples.en: A fast-moving badminton shuttlecock requires lightning-quick reflexes.
examples.zh: 疾速飛行的羽毛球需要閃電般的敏捷反應。

examples.en: Badminton is one of the most popular sports in Taiwanese schools.
examples.zh: 羽球是台灣校園中最受歡迎的運動項目之一。

examples.en: Playing badminton improves your agility, stamina, and eye-hand coordination.
examples.zh: 打羽毛球能提升你的敏捷度、體力以及手眼協調能力。

examples.en: We joined the neighborhood badminton club to play doubles every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們加入了社區羽球社，固定在每週日早上打雙打。

examples.en: Badminton is beloved across Taiwan, popularized by world-class champions.
examples.zh: 在戴資穎與李洋、王齊麟等世界頂級國手的帶動下，羽球已成為台灣全民運動。

examples.en: Friends often rent indoor courts on Friday evenings to play friendly games of badminton.
examples.zh: 三五好友經常在週五晚上租下室內球場，打幾場輕鬆愉快的羽球友誼賽。

examples.en: Advanced badminton requires tremendous wrist flexibility, quick footwork, and tactical smashes.
examples.zh: 高階羽球競技需要極強的手腕爆發力、靈活多變的步伐以及精準犀利的殺球。

explains: Two players use rackets to hit a light object over a high net. The game is often played indoors. A match can be fast.
A court has lines and a net for this sport. Players hit a small feathered item. A point ends when it touches the floor.
People play this game with rackets. The object moves quickly through the air. A player can compete alone or with a partner.

examples.en: We baked fresh chocolate chip cookies on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們在週日烘烤了新鮮巧克力豆餅乾。

examples.en: The bakery bakes several hundred loaves of artisan bread every morning.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊每天清晨烘烤數百條歐式手作麵包。

examples.en: Bake the apple pie at two hundred degrees Celsius for forty minutes.
examples.zh: 將蘋果派放入攝氏兩百度的烤箱中烘烤四十分鐘。

explains: It means cooking food in an oven. A person may make bread or cookies. Heat makes the food cook.
A family can prepare a cake at home. An oven gives steady heat. The word can also mean becoming hot in the sun.
A cook may put dough into an oven. Bread becomes brown as it cooks. A person can make many foods this way.

examples.en: The bakery around the corner bakes fresh bread every hour.
examples.zh: 街角轉彎處的麵包店每小時出爐新鮮麵包。

examples.en: Walking past the bakery, we were greeted by the wonderful smell of baked goods.
examples.zh: 經過麵包店時，撲鼻而來的烘焙香氣迎面而來。

examples.en: She ordered a customized chocolate birthday cake from the local bakery.
examples.zh: 她向當地的麵包店訂做了一個客製化的巧克力生日蛋糕。

examples.en: A warm aroma of vanilla drifts from the neighborhood artisanal bakery every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，巷弄街角的手作獨立烘焙坊總是飄散出溫暖迷人的香草與現烤麵包香。

examples.en: She stopped by the local bakery to pick up a fresh loaf of sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 她順道走進社區麵包店，買了一條新鮮出爐的手作酸種麵包。

examples.en: The family-owned bakery has been serving delicious pastries to the community for three decades.
examples.zh: 這家家族經營的傳統烘焙坊已經為社區鄰里供應美味烘焙甜點長達三十年。

entries.definition: 麵包店；烘焙坊；麵包烘焙坊；手作麵包店
explains: People buy fresh bread and cakes here. A worker makes food in an oven. Sweet smells may fill the room.
A small food shop may sell pies and cookies. The baker starts work early. Customers can buy bread.
This place sells baked food. A person may get a cake for a birthday. Bread is often made there each day.

examples.en: Check your account balance on the mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 在行動網銀 App 上查詢您的帳戶餘額。

examples.en: Gymnasts need excellent physical coordination and sense of balance.
examples.zh: 體操運動員需要極佳的肢體協調能力與平衡感。

examples.en: Try to maintain a healthy balance between work and family life.
examples.zh: 努力在工作與家庭生活之間保持健康的平衡。

examples.en: Check your real-time bank balance before making large online purchases.
examples.zh: 在進行大額線上購物前，請先查詢確認您的銀行帳戶即時餘額。

examples.en: Yoga and meditation help modern professionals strike a healthy work-life balance.
examples.zh: 瑜珈與靜坐冥想有助於現代上班族在忙碌工作中取得身心生活平衡。

examples.en: The gymnast maintained flawless balance on the narrow wooden beam.
examples.zh: 體操選手在狹窄的木製平衡木上展現了完美無瑕的極致平衡感。

examples.en: Standing on one foot for thirty seconds daily significantly improves static balance and prevents accidental trips.
examples.zh: 每天扶著椅背練習單腳站立三十秒，能顯著增強下肢平衡感，有效預防日常走路絆倒。

examples.en: Maintaining a healthy balance between demanding professional goals and quiet personal life reduces chronic burnout.
examples.zh: 在繁重的職場追求與沉靜的個人生活之間保持良好平衡，能有效減輕慢性過勞倦怠。

examples.en: Check your online banking mobile app regularly to verify your updated checking account balance.
examples.zh: 定期開啟網路銀行手機應用程式進行查看，以隨時核對你活期帳戶內的最新存款餘額。

examples.en: The free-sprung balance wheel oscillates four times per second, dictating the watch’s relentless tempo.
examples.zh: 無卡度「可調慣性擺輪」（Balance Wheel），每秒精準來回擺動四次，精確主宰著手錶的走時節奏。

examples.en: Modern professionals strive to maintain a healthy emotional balance between demanding careers and family time.
examples.zh: 當代職場菁英莫不竭盡所能，在緊湊高壓的事業追求與溫馨的家庭天倫時光之間維持健康的心靈平衡。

examples.en: The gymnast maintained steady balance on one foot while poised atop the narrow wooden beam.
examples.zh: 體操選手在狹窄的木製平衡木端點以單腳優雅獨立，展現出令人嘆為觀止的極致身體平衡感。

entries.definition: 帳戶餘額；平衡；結餘；核心平衡感防跌協調能力；可調慣性擺輪 (每小時振動 28,800 次)
explains: It means staying steady and not falling. A person may stand on one foot. A scale compares weight.
A tightrope walker needs to stay steady. A person can share work equally. The word can also mean a fair amount.
This word describes a steady position. A child may ride a bike while learning. It can also mean an equal amount on each side.

examples.en: There are several potted plants on the balcony.
examples.zh: 陽台上有好幾盆盆栽。

examples.en: We enjoyed watching the evening sunset while sipping tea on the balcony.
examples.zh: 我們坐在陽台邊喝茶邊欣賞傍晚的日落美景。

examples.en: Hang the wet laundry on the breezy balcony to dry naturally.
examples.zh: 把洗好的濕衣服晾在通風良好的陽台上自然風乾。

examples.en: We hung our freshly washed laundry to dry on the breezy balcony.
examples.zh: 我們將剛洗好的衣物晾在通風涼爽的陽台上。

examples.en: She grows potted herbs and cherry tomatoes on her sunlit apartment balcony.
examples.zh: 她在陽光充沛的公寓陽台上栽種盆栽香草與聖女小番茄。

examples.en: Step out onto the balcony to enjoy the magnificent mountain view.
examples.zh: 步出陽台，盡情飽覽眼前雄偉壯闊的青山美景。

examples.en: The sunny apartment balcony was transformed into a lush edible micro-farm.
examples.zh: 陽光普照的公寓小陽台被巧手改造成一座高產豐收、能自採番茄草莓的綠意可食地景微農場。

examples.en: She enjoys drinking freshly brewed morning coffee out on her plant-filled balcony.
examples.zh: 她最喜歡在清晨端著一杯剛手沖好的黑咖啡，悠閒坐在綠意盎然的小陽台上享受晨光。

examples.en: Install hanging rail planters to maximize vertical growing space along your narrow balcony.
examples.zh: 在狹長窄小的陽台欄杆上加裝懸掛式花架掛盆，能極致拓展垂直立體維度的種植綠化空間。

examples.en: Perched high up in the second-tier balcony, theatergoers enjoy panoramic birds-eye views of complex formations.
examples.zh: 坐在劇院二樓高層的眺望包廂座席（Balcony），能以絕佳鳥瞰全景視角俯瞰台上壯觀的舞者走位隊形。

examples.en: She stepped out onto the apartment balcony to sip a fresh cup of oolong tea and enjoy the morning breeze.
examples.zh: 清晨破曉時分，她輕輕推開落地窗步上公寓景觀陽台，手捧一杯現泡熱阿里山高山茶迎著舒爽晨風品味。

examples.en: Romeo famously serenaded Juliet while she stood gazing downward from her romantic Italian balcony.
examples.zh: 在莎士比亞筆下舉世聞名的浪漫名場景中，羅密歐在月光下深情仰望站在義大利古典雕花陽台上的茱麗葉。

entries.definition: 陽台；露台；公寓陽台；劇院二三樓眺望包廂座席

examples.en: The balloon floated above the birthday table.
examples.zh: 氣球飄在生日餐桌上方。

examples.en: She tied a red balloon to the chair.
examples.zh: 她把紅氣球綁在椅子上。

examples.en: The balloon popped when it touched a branch.
examples.zh: 氣球碰到樹枝時爆掉了。

examples.en: The long spruce bass bar glued inside the top plate beneath the G-string amplifies rich lower registers.
examples.zh: 黏貼於 G 弦下方共鳴面板內側的長形雲杉「低音梁」（Bass Bar），極大增強了深沉豐滿的低音共鳴。

examples.en: The neighborhood espresso bar serves steaming cups of aromatic cappuccino alongside fresh croissants.
examples.zh: 街角轉彎處的義式濃縮咖啡吧，清晨供應著熱氣騰騰的香濃卡布奇諾與剛出爐的酥脆可頌麵包。

examples.en: Athletes must grasp the horizontal bar firmly while performing gymnastics balance routines.
examples.zh: 體操國手在進行高難度單槓體操自選動作時，手掌必須抹滿碳酸鎂粉並牢牢握緊堅韌的金屬橫槓。

examples.en: Storing hydrogen gas at 700 bar compresses sufficient energy into a compact onboard passenger car tank.
examples.zh: 在「七百巴極高壓」（700 Bar）下儲存氫氣，能將充沛能量壓縮進體積精巧的乘用車底盤儲氫罐中。

examples.en: The barista calibrated the espresso machine pump to maintain exactly nine bars of extraction pressure.
examples.zh: 專業咖啡師細心校準義式濃縮咖啡機內部旋轉泵浦，精確維持九個大氣壓的黃金萃取水壓。

examples.en: After finishing a grueling work week, coworkers gathered at the neighborhood tapas bar to unwind.
examples.zh: 在度過緊湊繁重的工作週後，同仁相約在街角西班牙餐酒館小酌相聚，痛快卸下一身疲憊。

entries.definition: 黏貼於面板下方增強低頻共鳴之低音梁；條；七百巴 (700 bar / 70 MPa) 車載極高充填壓力單位；巴

examples.en: Barbecuing is a popular tradition during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋節烤肉是台灣盛行的傳統。

examples.en: We set up the barbecue grill in the backyard and grilled sausages.
examples.zh: 我們在後院架起烤肉架並烤了香腸。

examples.en: The savory barbecue sauce adds rich flavor to the grilled meat.
examples.zh: 風味濃郁的烤肉醬為烤肉增添了豐富滋味。

examples.en: Having a street-side barbecue with friends has become a Taiwanese Moon Festival tradition.
examples.zh: 與好友在街邊戶外烤肉已成為台灣獨特的中秋習俗。

examples.en: We grilled sweet corn, juicy sausages, and marinated chicken wings on the barbecue grill.
examples.zh: 我們在烤肉架上碳烤甜玉米、多汁香腸以及醃漬入味的美味雞翅。

examples.en: The smoky aroma of evening street barbecues wafted throughout the whole neighborhood alley.
examples.zh: 街坊鄰里傍晚烤肉飄出的陣陣炭烤香氣，瀰漫在整條溫馨小巷弄中。

examples.en: She hit her head but did not hurt her brain.
examples.zh: 她撞到頭，但沒有傷到大腦。

examples.zh: 他簡短地談了這趟旅行。

This word means lasting for a short time. A report may have only a few pages. A person may give a quick summary.

examples.en: She had a brilliant idea.
examples.zh: 她有一個絕妙的主意。

examples.en: The brilliant stars filled the sky.
examples.zh: 明亮的星星布滿天空。

examples.en: He is a brilliant young scientist.
examples.zh: 他是一位傑出的年輕科學家。

This word means outstanding or full of light. A child may show a clever answer. The night sky can look bright.

examples.zh: 這條寬闊的河流很難渡過。

examples.en: She has a broad smile.
examples.zh: 她露出燦爛的笑容。

examples.zh: 她在照鏡子前先梳理了長髮。

examples.zh: 台北 101 是東亞地區指標性的摩天大樓。

examples.en: The historic red-brick building was converted into an artistic community cafe.
examples.zh: 這棟歷史悠久的紅磚建築被改造成了一間充滿文藝氣息的社區咖啡館。

explains: A small round bread roll is often eaten for breakfast. It may have a sweet filling. A person can cut it in half.
A baker may make this soft bread. It can contain cinnamon or fruit. People may eat it with butter.
This little bread can be sweet. It is shaped like a small roll. A person may have it with tea.

examples.zh: 沉重的負擔讓他走得很慢。

examples.en: She shared the burden with her family.
examples.zh: 她和家人分擔了重擔。

examples.en: Caring for the baby was a joyful burden.
examples.zh: 照顧嬰兒是個甜蜜的負擔。

A heavy bag may feel hard to lift. A family can share a difficult task. This word can mean a responsibility.

examples.en: The soup burned my tongue.
examples.zh: 湯燙傷了我的舌頭。

examples.en: He burned the old letters in the fire.
examples.zh: 他在火裡燒掉了舊信件。

A candle may do this when its wick is lit. Hot soup can hurt skin. The word can describe a mark from heat.
This action uses fire or heat. Wood can turn to ash. A person may feel a painful mark on the skin.

examples.zh: 氣球砰一聲爆開了。

examples.en: The children burst into laughter.
examples.zh: 孩子們突然大笑起來。

examples.en: A pipe burst during the cold night.
examples.zh: 寒冷的夜裡有一根管子爆裂了。

explains: It means breaking open suddenly. A balloon may make a loud sound. A person can begin crying.
A bag can open after being too full. Bubbles may pop. The word can also mean a sudden start.

examples.en: The businessman met with his clients.

examples.en: A businessman opened a new store.
examples.zh: 一位商人開了一間新店。

examples.en: The businessman worked late every night.
examples.zh: 那位商人每晚工作到很晚。

explains: A man who owns or manages a company has this job. He may meet with customers. The word can describe a male person in business.
This person may sell goods or services. He can hire workers. A small shop may belong to him.
A man may run a store or company. He may make deals. The job involves earning money by selling things.

examples.en: Stir-fried cabbage with garlic is a classic home-cooked dish.
examples.zh: 蒜炒高麗菜是一道經典的家常菜。

examples.zh: 梨山出產的高山高麗菜以其清脆鮮甜聞名。

examples.zh: 將新鮮高麗菜切成細絲以製作爽口的自製涼拌捲心菜。

examples.en: Fermenting shredded cabbage with salt and spices produces traditional probiotic-rich sauerkraut.
examples.zh: 將細切甘藍高麗菜絲加入海鹽與天然香料封罐慢速自然乳酸發酵，能做出富含活性益生菌的德式酸菜。

examples.zh: 國王住在一座石造城堡裡。

examples.zh: 我們參觀了山丘上的古堡。

examples.en: The castle had a tall tower.
examples.zh: 城堡有一座高塔。

examples.zh: 是什麼造成了那個巨響？

explains: A tiny part of a body is called this. It can also hold power in a phone. The word may mean a small room in a jail.

examples.zh: 把緞帶剪成五公分長的小段。

examples.en: She cleaned the chalk from the board.
examples.zh: 她把板子上的粉筆字擦掉。

explains: A soft white stone leaves marks on a dark board. A teacher may write with it. It can be broken into small sticks.
Students may draw on a playground with this white material. It is used in classrooms. A cloth can wipe its marks away.

examples.en: The puzzle was a fun challenge.
examples.zh: 這個謎題是個有趣的挑戰。

examples.en: She challenged her brother to a race.
examples.zh: 她向哥哥挑戰賽跑。

examples.en: The team faced a difficult challenge.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍面臨一項艱難挑戰。

explains: It is a hard task that tests someone. A puzzle may be difficult. A person can try to solve it.
A team may face a difficult game. The word can also mean asking someone to do something hard. A hard task takes effort.
This word names a task that needs effort. A person may accept it. It can help people learn.

examples.en: Switch the TV channel to watch the live baseball tournament.
examples.zh: 切換電視頻道以觀賞現場直播的棒球錦標賽。

examples.zh: 台灣海峽是國際上極為繁重繁忙的海運船舶航運海峽通道。

examples.en: Companies establish formal feedback channels to hear from valued customers.
examples.zh: 企業紛紛建立正式的溝通反饋管道，以傾聽重要顧客的心聲。

explains: A TV station sends programs on this. A narrow path of water between lands has the same name. The word can also mean a way to send something.

This word can mean a TV station or a water passage. A narrow sea route may connect two larger bodies. It can also mean a way to reach people.

examples.en: We read one chapter before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前我們讀了一章。

examples.en: The book has twelve chapters.
examples.zh: 這本書有十二章。

examples.en: Chapter three tells about the journey.
examples.zh: 第三章講述了這趟旅程。

explains: A book may be divided into named parts. A person can read one each night. It may contain many pages.
A long story has sections that help organize it. A reader may stop at the end of one. A textbook may have many.

examples.en: Totoro is a beloved animated character created by Hayao Miyazaki.
examples.zh: 龍貓是宮崎駿所創造的深受喜愛的動畫角色。

examples.en: Overcoming adversity builds resilience and strengthens one's moral character.
examples.zh: 克服逆境能鍛鍊人的心理韌性並磨礪品格。

examples.en: Learning to write traditional Chinese characters requires careful stroke order discipline.
examples.zh: 學習書寫繁體漢字需要嚴謹遵守筆畫順序的自律規範。

explains: A person in a story has this role. It can also mean someone’s nature. A written mark in Chinese writing has this name.
A book may have a kind person or a villain. A person can have a brave nature. A single written symbol may carry meaning.
This word can mean a story person. It may describe someone’s nature. It can also name a letter or symbol.

examples.en: It takes one hour to charge this phone fully.
examples.zh: 這支手機充滿電需要一個小時。

examples.en: The hotel does not charge any extra fees for wireless internet access.
examples.zh: 該飯店對無線網路使用不收取任何額外費用。

examples.en: The police officer charged the reckless driver with speeding through red lights.
examples.zh: 員警對這名闖紅燈超速的魯莽駕駛提出控告。

explains: It means putting power into a battery. A store may ask money for a service. A police officer can say someone broke a rule.
A phone needs this action when its battery is low. A shop can ask a fee. The word can also mean accusing someone of a crime.
This word has several meanings. It can mean adding power to a battery. It can also mean asking for money or making an accusation.

examples.en: The sales chart shows rapid revenue growth over the past six months.
examples.zh: 銷售圖表顯示過去六個月以來營業額呈現快速成長。

examples.en: Navigators charted a safe maritime route around dangerous rocky shoals.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的遠洋航海領航員在精密海圖上繪製出一條繞開暗礁淺灘的平安航線。

examples.en: The catchy Taiwanese pop song remained at the top of the music charts for eight weeks.
examples.zh: 這首旋律洗腦的台灣本土流行金曲連續八週蟬聯各大數位音樂排行榜冠軍寶座。

explains: A drawing or table can show facts. A ship worker may use a map of the sea. A person can make one with data.
A line graph is one kind of this. A sailor may follow one across the ocean. A teacher can draw one for a lesson.
This visual tool helps people understand facts. It may use lines or bars. A map can help guide a boat.

examples.en: The dog chased the ball across the yard.
examples.zh: 狗追著球跑過庭院。

examples.en: The police chased the thief through the street.
examples.zh: 警察在街上追捕小偷。

examples.en: She chased her dream of becoming a singer.
examples.zh: 她追尋成為歌手的夢想。

explains: It means running after someone or something. A dog may follow a ball. A person may try to catch a bus.
A child may follow a friend in a game. A police officer can look for a person. The action can also mean pursuing a goal.
This action means trying to catch up. A cat may follow a mouse. A person can pursue a dream.

examples.en: Cheating during examinations results in immediate zero marks and disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 考試作弊將導致該科零分並遭受校規懲處。

examples.en: Some athletes use banned substances to cheat in competitive tournaments.
examples.zh: 部分運動員使用違禁藥物在競爭賽事中弄虛作假不法作弊。

examples.en: He felt cheated after discovering the luxury handbag was a counterfeit replica.
examples.zh: 在發現那個名牌精品包只是仿冒贗品後，他深感遭到欺騙。

explains: It means using unfair methods to win. A student may look at another person’s answers. It can also mean tricking someone.
A player may break the rules in a game. A person can tell a lie for gain. The word can name someone who deceives others.
This action is unfair. A child may copy homework. A person may trick a friend.

examples.en: The audience cheered loudly for the winning team.
examples.zh: 觀眾為獲勝的隊伍大聲歡呼喝采。

examples.en: Her thoughtful words helped cheer me up after a hard day.
examples.zh: 在她貼心的安慰下，我度過辛勞一天後心情好轉了。

examples.en: Cheerleaders waved bright pom-poms to encourage the runners.
examples.zh: 啦啦隊員揮舞著鮮艷的彩球為跑者加油打氣。

explains: This action means shouting to show support or joy. A crowd may make a loud sound at a game. The verb can also mean making someone feel happier.
People may call out loudly for a team. A person can support a friend. This word can mean giving hope.
This action shows support. Fans may clap and call at a match. A friend can say something kind.

examples.en: The lab used a chemical to clean the glass.
examples.zh: 實驗室使用一種化學物質清潔玻璃。

examples.en: Some chemicals can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 有些化學物質可能很危險。

examples.en: The plant makes a natural chemical.
examples.zh: 這種植物會產生天然化學物質。

explains: A material used in a lab may change when mixed. Some cleaners have it. A scientist studies how materials react.
A substance can be found in soap or medicine. Some can be harmful. A person should read safety labels.
This word describes a substance used in science. It may be solid, liquid, or gas. Many products are made from such materials.

examples.en: The children played chess after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後下西洋棋。

examples.en: She won the chess game in ten moves.
examples.zh: 她下了十步就贏了棋局。

examples.en: He studies chess with his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他和祖父一起學西洋棋。

explains: Two players move black and white pieces on a board. The goal is to trap the other king. A game can take a long time.
This board game uses a king, queen, and smaller pieces. Players think ahead. It is played around the world.
A person must plan each move in this game. The board has sixty-four squares. One player uses black pieces and one uses white.

examples.en: The chief spoke to the whole team.
examples.zh: 主管對整個團隊說話。

examples.en: She is the chief of the fire station.
examples.zh: 她是消防局主管。

examples.en: The chief reason was bad weather.
examples.zh: 主要原因是天氣不好。

explains: It means the main person in a group. A school may have one teacher in charge. The word can also mean first or most important.
A team may have a top leader. A city may have a main officer. This word describes someone at the top.
This word means the person with the highest role. A company may have one leader. It can also mean most important.

examples.en: My childhood was full of happy memories.
examples.zh: 我的童年充滿快樂回憶。

examples.en: He spent his childhood near the sea.
examples.zh: 他在海邊度過童年。

examples.en: The book tells about her childhood.
examples.zh: 這本書講述她的童年。

explains: It is the time when a person is a child. Games and school may fill those years. Memories can stay for a long time.
A person may remember family life from early years. Children learn many things during this period. It comes before adult life.
This word means the years before adulthood. A person may look back on them. It can include play, school, and growing.

examples.en: His childish joke made the class laugh.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的笑話讓全班大笑。

examples.en: Stop acting childish and share the toy.
examples.zh: 別再幼稚了，把玩具分享出來。

examples.en: She made a childish face at her brother.
examples.zh: 她對哥哥做了個孩子氣的表情。

explains: It means acting like a young child in a bad way. A person may complain over a small issue. The word can sound unkind.
An adult may behave in a silly way. A person can refuse to share. This word describes behavior that seems too young.
This word can describe an immature action. A person may throw a fit. It is often used as a criticism.

examples.en: The bowl is made of china.
examples.zh: 這個碗是瓷器做的。

examples.en: She collects fine china cups.
examples.zh: 她收藏精美的瓷杯。

examples.en: The china plate broke on the floor.
examples.zh: 瓷盤掉在地上摔破了。

explains: It is a hard white dish material. People make cups and bowls from it. It can break if dropped.
A tea cup may be made from this smooth material. It is heated in a kiln. A person may collect fine dishes.
This material can be used for plates and vases. It often has a shiny finish. It may be painted with patterns.

examples.en: Taiwanese people use chopsticks to eat noodles.
examples.zh: 台灣人用筷子吃麵。

examples.en: Can you hold chopsticks properly when eating rice?
examples.zh: 你吃米飯時能拿好筷子嗎？

examples.en: Using reusable chopsticks helps protect the environment.
examples.zh: 使用環保筷有助於保護環境。

explains: These are two thin sticks used for eating. A person holds both in one hand. Moving their tips together helps lift food.
These eating tools are common in many Asian countries. They may be made from wood or metal. A pair can lift noodles from a bowl.
One stick usually stays fairly still in the hand. The other moves toward it. Food is held between the two tips.

examples.en: File a medical insurance claim along with doctor diagnosis receipts.
examples.zh: 檢附醫師診斷證明書與收據以向保險公司申請醫療險理賠。

examples.en: The passenger made a compensation claim after the airline misplaced her suitcase.
examples.zh: 航空公司不慎遺失旅客行李箱後，乘客正式提出了行李遺失損害賠償申訴。

examples.en: The politician claimed that his tax reform would stimulate domestic manufacturing.
examples.zh: 這位政治人物公開聲稱其減稅改革措施將能有效提振本土製造業景氣。

examples.en: Proceed directly to baggage claim after clearing immigration and passport checks.
examples.zh: 在順利通過移民署證照查驗證件後，請依照動線指標前往行李提領大廳提領行李。

examples.en: She filed an official insurance claim after her suitcase was accidentally misplaced.
examples.zh: 在發現自己的託運行李箱不幸遭到航空公司誤送遺失後，她立即向保險公司提出理賠申報。

examples.en: Passengers can claim reimbursement for travel meals if flight delays exceed six hours.
examples.zh: 若因航空公司調度因素導致班機延誤超過六小時以上，旅客有權要求餐飲住宿交通費用補償。

explains: It means saying something is true. A person may ask for money after a loss. The word can also mean a request for property.

examples.zh: 她穿了一件經典黑洋裝。

examples.en: The book became a modern classic.

examples.zh: 不同於傳統電腦只能將位元非 0 即 1 地循序處理，量子系統能同時探索兩者。

examples.zh: 即便動用當前全球運算速度最快的傳統超級電腦，也需要耗費數萬年才能暴力破解現代密碼公鑰。

examples.en: Hybrid computing combines classical CPU pipelines with quantum acceleration chips.
examples.zh: 混合式運算架構巧妙將傳統 CPU 資料流水線與專用量子加速晶片深度整合，截長補短。

examples.zh: 艾咪是我最喜歡的同班同學。

examples.zh: 那個聰明的女孩很快解開謎題。

examples.en: That was a clever way to save time.
examples.zh: 那是節省時間的巧妙方法。

examples.en: The clever fox escaped from the trap.
examples.zh: 那隻聰明的狐狸逃離了陷阱。

examples.zh: 只需輕輕一點，你的訂單就能成功送出。

examples.zh: 點擊藍色按鈕以確認您的飛機劃位選擇。

examples.en: The key turned in the lock with a satisfying click.
examples.zh: 鑰匙在鎖孔中轉動，發出了一聲令人安心的喀噠聲。

examples.en: As soon as they met, their personalities just clicked right away.
examples.zh: 他們倆一見面，彼此的個性立刻一拍即合、非常投緣。

explains: A mouse makes this sound when pressed. A person can choose a button on a screen. It may mean a short sharp noise.
A small sound may come from a door latch. A computer user may press a key. The word can mean selecting something on a screen.
This action picks an item on a computer. A switch may make a small sound. A link can be chosen by pressing a mouse button.

examples.en: Southern Taiwan enjoys a warm, sunny tropical climate year-round.
examples.zh: 南台灣全年享有溫暖晴朗的熱帶氣候。

examples.en: The Mediterranean climate is known for dry summers and mild winters.
examples.zh: 地中海型氣候以夏季乾燥與冬季溫和而著稱。

examples.en: Scientists are closely studying how global climate affects agriculture.
examples.zh: 科學家正密切研究全球氣候如何對農業產生影響。

explains: It describes the usual weather of a place over many years. A hot region has one kind. A cold area has another.
A country near the equator may be warm. A northern region may have long winters. This word names long-term weather patterns.
This word means the normal weather in an area. Scientists study temperature and rain. It can affect plants and animals.

examples.en: The table was covered with a blue cloth.
examples.zh: 桌上鋪著一塊藍布。

examples.en: She wiped the window with a soft cloth.
examples.zh: 她用軟布擦窗戶。

examples.en: This cloth is made of cotton.
examples.zh: 這塊布是棉製的。

explains: A piece of material can cover a table. It may be used for cleaning. A shirt can be made from it.

This material is used to make clothes or curtains. It can be soft or rough. A person may wipe a table using it.

examples.en: Warm clothing helps in winter.
examples.zh: 保暖衣物在冬天很有幫助。

examples.en: The store sells clothing for children.
examples.zh: 這家店販售兒童服裝。

examples.en: Pack enough clothing for the trip.
examples.zh: 帶足夠的衣物去旅行。

This word means things worn on the body. A store may sell many styles. A coat is one example.

examples.en: It is cloudy today, but it won't rain.
examples.zh: 今天多雲，但不會下雨。

examples.en: The weather was cool and cloudy during our mountain hike.
examples.zh: 我們登山健行期間的天氣涼爽且多雲。

examples.en: Photography is often softer and more flattering on cloudy days.
examples.zh: 在陰天拍照時光線通常更加柔和、呈現效果更佳。

explains: It means the sky has many clouds. The sun may be hard to see. Rain may come later.
A gray sky can cover a town. A person may carry an umbrella. This word describes a day with clouds.
Clouds fill much of the sky. The day may look dark. The weather report can use this describing word.

examples.en: Coal was used to heat the old house.
examples.zh: 煤曾用來為這棟老房子供暖。

examples.en: The train burned coal for fuel.
examples.zh: 這列火車燒煤作為燃料。

examples.en: Miners found coal deep underground.
examples.zh: 礦工在地底深處找到煤。

explains: A black rock can burn and make heat. A train once used it as fuel. It comes from underground.
This dark material is dug from the earth. A fire can burn it. It helped power old factories.
A mine may produce this fuel. It is made from old plants. Burning it can make smoke.

examples.en: The small town sits on the coast.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮位於海岸邊。

examples.zh: 日落時我們沿著海岸散步。

examples.en: The coast was rocky and cold.
examples.zh: 海岸多岩石又寒冷。

This word means the land next to a sea. A beach may be there. Ships can travel along it.

examples.en: A cockroach ran under the fridge.
examples.zh: 一隻蟑螂跑到冰箱底下。

examples.en: She saw a roach in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她在廚房看到一隻蟑螂。

examples.en: The roach hid behind the cabinet.
examples.zh: 那隻蟑螂躲在櫥櫃後面。

explains: A small brown insect may live in a kitchen. It has long feelers and can move fast. People try to keep it away from food.

examples.zh: 在冰鎮冷藏定型好的經典提拉米蘇表面均勻篩上一層厚厚的頂級無糖純黑可可粉。

examples.en: A mug of steaming hot cocoa topped with fluffy marshmallows warms cold winter evenings.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜裡，手捧一杯頂部漂浮著軟綿棉花糖的熱可可，能帶來無比療癒的溫暖暖意。

examples.zh: 切勿將自己個人的學習步調與身旁同儕盲目攀比，保持節奏即可。

examples.en: Practice speaking daily so you feel confident during the interview.
examples.zh: 每天多加練習口語，面試時就能充滿自信。

examples.en: The star basketball player felt confident stepping up to shoot the winning free throw.
examples.zh: 明星主力籃球員充滿信心地站上罰球線，準備投出絕殺致勝的關鍵關鍵罰球。

examples.en: She walked onto the performance stage with a calm, poised, and confident posture.
examples.zh: 她邁著優雅從容且充滿強大自信的堅定步伐，緩緩走上萬眾矚目的表演舞台。

examples.en: Wearing clothes that fit comfortably makes you radiate calm, confident energy.
examples.zh: 穿著剪裁合身舒服、真正契合個人身型的衣服，能讓您在任何場合皆散發出沉穩自信的光芒。

examples.en: She felt completely confident walking into the presentation in her sharp navy suit.
examples.zh: 身著一襲剪裁銳利的深藍色西裝套裝踏入演講簡報會場，讓她內心感到篤定且充滿自信。

examples.en: A genuine warm smile is the most powerful accessory for a truly confident appearance.
examples.zh: 一抹發自內心真誠溫暖的自信微笑，是任何華麗裝扮中最能展現從容大器氣場的無敵配件。

entries.definition: 有信心的；自信的；自信從容的

examples.en: Open communication helps resolve family conflicts peacefully.
examples.zh: 坦誠溝通有助於和平化解家庭內部的分歧衝突。

examples.en: Congratulations! You passed the test.
examples.zh: 恭喜你通過考試。

examples.en: Walking barefoot through damp paddy mud restores a healing emotional connection with Mother Nature.

examples.en: The newly opened high-speed rail branch provides a seamless direct transit connection to the international airport.
examples.zh: 新近通車啟用的高鐵聯外延伸支線，為旅客提供通往國際機場航廈無縫轉乘的便捷交通接駁連線。

examples.en: Scientists discovered a fascinating biochemical connection between gut microbiome balance and brain mood regulation.
examples.zh: 醫學科學家驚喜證實了腸道益生菌微生態菌相平衡與大腦情緒調控中樞之間，存在著不可思議的腦腸軸雙向連結。

examples.en: Beyond transporting passengers, high-speed rail weaves an enduring connection of hearts, memories, and shared futures.
examples.zh: 除了運送千萬旅客，高速鐵路更拉近了城鄉時空距離，編織出凝聚全島情感與繁榮的「永恆美好連結」（Connection）。

examples.en: The international flight landed on schedule, allowing travelers ample time to catch their connecting flight.
examples.zh: 跨洋國際長途班機準點降落國際機場，讓轉機旅客有充裕從容的時間搭上前往下一座城市的銜接班機。

examples.en: A strong emotional connection between parents and children builds resilience against adolescent peer pressure.
examples.zh: 父母與孩子之間建立起深厚穩固的親情信任連結，能賦予青少年強大的心靈韌性以抵禦同儕盲從壓力。

examples.en: Language creates lasting human connections that turn strangers across the globe into lifelong brothers and sisters.
examples.zh: 語言能締造出跨越國界的「真摯人際連結」（Connections），將千里之外的陌生人化為一生的摯友。

examples.en: Attending overseas academic conferences enabled her to build valuable professional connections.

examples.en: High-speed broadband connections allow remote professionals to collaborate seamlessly from any location.
examples.zh: 高速穩定的寬頻網路連線，使遠距工作者無論身處世界何地都能順暢無阻地展開跨國協作。

examples.zh: 雙方仔細審閱並共同簽署了合約。
