examples.zh: 專業法務顧問在雙方正式落款簽署前，逐條審查了該商業店面租賃契約的每一個法條細節。

examples.en: Metals expand slightly when heated and contract when exposed to freezing cold temperatures.
examples.zh: 大多數金屬物質在受熱時會微幅膨脹，而一旦暴露於極度嚴寒的低溫中則會產生冷縮現象。

entries.definition: 合約；契約；收縮；契作合約；契約耕作；簽約；各國探勘團隊簽署之深海礦產十五年探勘合約
explains: A legal paper records an agreement. A worker may agree to build a house. It can also mean becoming smaller.
Two people may sign a paper about a job. A company can hire a person for a set time. A muscle may get shorter.
This written agreement explains duties. People may sign before work begins. As a verb, it can mean getting an illness.

examples.en: Automatic train control constantly monitors train separation to maintain safe braking distance buffers.
examples.zh: 「自動列車控制系統」（Automatic Train Control ATC），隨時計算前後列車間距以維繫絕對安全煞車防線。

examples.en: The experienced captain maintained calm command and full control of the ship during the typhoon storm.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深船長在遭遇強颱狂浪襲擊的危急關頭，沉著冷靜指揮並精準掌控全船各項航行操舵。

examples.en: Strict environmental regulations aim to control harmful carbon emission levels from heavy industrial plants.
examples.zh: 國家制定極嚴苛的空污環保法令法規，旨在鐵腕嚴密管控石化鋼鐵等重工業重污染排放源的碳排總量。

entries.definition: 數位自動列車控制系統 (防止超速與追撞事故)；控制
explains: It means having power over a machine or situation. A driver can use a wheel. A person may manage their feelings.
A teacher may guide a class. A remote can change a TV. This word can mean directing or managing.
This word means guiding an action. A driver may steer a car. A person may keep a situation in order.

examples.en: We had a long conversation about school.
examples.zh: 我們聊了很久學校的事。

examples.en: The conversation was friendly and fun.
examples.zh: 這段談話友善又有趣。

examples.en: He started a conversation with his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他和鄰居開始交談。

explains: Two people share ideas by speaking. Friends may do this at lunch. The word can mean a friendly talk.
A family may speak about a trip. A person can ask questions. This kind of talk can last a long time.
This word names an exchange of ideas. People may talk about work or fun. A phone call can include one.

examples.en: Sweet corn soup is popular with kids and adults alike.
examples.zh: 甜玉米濃湯深受大人小孩喜愛。

examples.en: Grilled corn brushed with savory barbecue sauce smells heavenly.
examples.zh: 塗上鹹香烤肉醬的烤玉米聞起來令人垂涎。

examples.en: Farmers cultivate fields of yellow corn throughout the fertile valley.
examples.zh: 農民在肥沃的山谷各處種植了大片黃金玉米田。

explains: This tall plant has yellow kernels. People cook and eat them. A farm may grow it in a field.
A person may eat this food on the cob. It can be ground into flour. Animals may eat its seeds.
This crop grows on long stalks. The seeds can be yellow or white. A cook may add them to soup.

examples.en: They drove through the countryside after lunch.
examples.zh: 他們午餐後開車穿過鄉間。

examples.en: The countryside is quiet at night.
examples.zh: 鄉間夜晚很安靜。

examples.en: She grew up in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她在鄉下長大。

explains: It means land outside cities and towns. Farms and fields are often found there. People may live in small villages.
A person may drive past fields and forests. The area is quiet and has fewer buildings. This word describes country land.
This place has farms, hills, and small homes. It is far from busy city streets. People may enjoy its quiet.

examples.en: The newly married couple traveled to Japan for honeymoon.
examples.zh: 這對新婚夫婦去日本度蜜月。

examples.en: We plan to stay in Taitung for a couple of days to relax by the ocean.
examples.zh: 我們打算在台東待上幾天，在海邊放鬆享受愜意時光。

examples.en: An elderly couple walked hand in hand along the peaceful park pathway.
examples.zh: 一對年邁的恩愛夫妻手牽著手漫步在幽靜的公園小徑上。

explains: Two people or things can form this number. A married pair may share a home. It can also mean a few.
A man and woman may be a pair. A person can join two objects together. The word can also mean a small number.
This word means two that belong together. It may describe a husband and wife. As an action, it means connecting two things.

examples.en: It takes courage to admit your mistakes and make things right.
examples.zh: 勇於承認自身錯誤並設法彌補需要莫大的勇氣。

examples.en: She found the courage to speak publicly in front of hundreds of international delegates.
examples.zh: 她鼓起非凡的勇氣，從容自若地站上數百位國際各國代表面前公開發表演講。

examples.en: True courage is not the total absence of fear, but taking action in spite of it.
examples.zh: 真正的勇氣絕非毫無恐懼害怕，而是在內心深感敬畏的情況下依然昂首前行。

examples.en: Standing up against injustice demands immense moral courage in the face of public disapproval.
examples.zh: 在眾人盲從退縮的艱難時刻挺身捍衛公平正義，需要內心具備無比強大的「道德勇氣」（Moral Courage）。

examples.en: Firefighters displayed breathtaking physical courage as they charged into the burning warehouse to rescue victims.
examples.zh: 消防隊員在面對滾滾濃煙與熊熊烈火的危急關頭，展現出令人肅然起敬的無畏肉體勇氣，毅然衝入火場搜救受困民眾。

examples.en: Admitting your own mistakes openly to your team takes emotional maturity and genuine personal courage.
examples.zh: 勇於在團隊同仁面前坦然承認自己的決策失誤與盲點，需要極高的心智成熟度與令人信服的個人真誠勇氣。

examples.en: Venturing into the deep celestial wilderness demands immense technical ingenuity and collective human courage.
examples.zh: 勇敢航向深邃無垠的星海荒野，需要全人類無窮的科學智慧與世代相傳的「探索勇氣」（Courage）。

examples.en: It takes moral courage to stand up against unfair workplace practices and advocate for vulnerable colleagues.
examples.zh: 在面對職場不合理的不公不義與權勢壓迫時，敢於挺身而出為弱勢同仁仗義執言，需要極大的道德勇氣。

examples.en: The injured firefighter showed tremendous courage by carrying the child through the smoke-filled stairwell.
examples.zh: 負傷的打火弟兄展現出令人動容的無畏勇氣，在濃煙瀰漫的炙熱樓梯間奮勇背負著幼童脫離火海。

entries.definition: 勇氣；膽量；勇於捍衛正義的道德勇氣；勇於航向深邃宇宙未知荒野之無畏勇氣與探索精神
explains: It means being brave when something feels scary. A person may speak up for a friend. A firefighter can enter a dangerous place.
A child may try a hard task despite fear. A hero may protect others. This word names bravery.
This feeling helps people face danger. A person may tell the truth even when afraid. It can help someone do what is right.

examples.en: We booked a wooden badminton court for two hours.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了兩個小時的木地板羽球場。

examples.en: The tennis players stepped onto the clay court under bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 網球選手們在燦爛陽光下步入了紅土球場。

examples.en: The suspect appeared before the district court judge this morning.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人今天上午在地區法院法官面前出庭應訊。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved peacefully inside the district court.
examples.zh: 這起糾紛在地方法院法庭內獲得了和平調解。

examples.en: Students booked an indoor basketball court for their weekend tournament.
examples.zh: 學生們預約了一處室內籃球場，作為舉辦週末班際盃球賽的場地。

examples.en: Witnesses must swear to speak the truth before giving testimony in court.
examples.zh: 證人在法庭上作證之前，必須莊嚴宣誓所言皆為毫無虛假的事實真相。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved through judicial settlement inside the Taipei District Court.
examples.zh: 該起民事爭議最終在台北地方法院法庭內透過司法和解圓滿落幕。

examples.en: The witness swore an oath on the Bible to tell nothing but the truth in open court.
examples.zh: 出庭證人在法官面前將手輕按於聖經上莊嚴宣誓，保證在公開法庭上所陳述之證言絕無虛言。

examples.en: After playing tennis on the clay court, the athletes rested at the clubhouse.
examples.zh: 在紅土球場上揮汗如雨打完一場激烈的網球單打比賽後，運動員們紛紛移步至俱樂部會館內放鬆休息。

entries.definition: 球場（網球、籃球）；法庭；法院；球場
explains: A judge works in this place. A lawyer may speak there. It can also mean an area for sports.
A tennis match happens on a marked area. A legal case may be heard in a building. People may watch a game or trial there.
This word can name a place where legal cases are heard. It can also be an outdoor area for basketball or tennis. A judge may sit in a room there.

examples.en: The cowboy rode his horse across the ranch.
examples.zh: 牛仔騎馬穿過牧場。

examples.en: A cowboy wore a wide hat.
examples.zh: 牛仔戴著一頂寬帽子。

examples.en: The cowboy helped move the cattle.
examples.zh: 牛仔幫忙趕牛群。

explains: A man who rides a horse on a ranch may have this job. He may care for cattle. A hat often appears in stories about him.
This person works with horses and cows. A ranch may hire him. He may ride across open land.
A western story may have this horse rider. He can move a herd of cattle. Boots and a hat are common clothes.

examples.en: She drew a flower with a red crayon.
examples.zh: 她用紅色蠟筆畫了一朵花。

examples.en: The child colored the picture with crayons.
examples.zh: 孩子用蠟筆替圖畫上色。

examples.en: My crayon broke in half.
examples.zh: 我的蠟筆斷成兩半。

explains: A child draws with this colored stick. It leaves wax on paper. Many colors can be kept in a box.
A teacher may give each student a box of these. They are used to color pictures. A paper wrapper covers each one.
This art item is made of wax and color. A child can use it to draw. It is softer than a pencil.

examples.en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
examples.zh: 你想在咖啡裡加奶油嗎？

examples.en: The cream cake was soft and sweet.
examples.zh: 奶油蛋糕柔軟又香甜。

examples.en: She put cream on the cut.
examples.zh: 她在傷口上塗了乳膏。

explains: This is the thick, fatty part of milk. It can rise to the top before milk is mixed. Cooks add it to sauces and soups.
This dairy food can be whipped until light and fluffy. People put it on cakes or fruit. It often tastes rich and smooth.
This can also mean a thick product spread on skin. It may keep skin soft. Some kinds contain medicine for a skin problem.

examples.en: The children created a new game.
examples.zh: 孩子們創造了一種新遊戲。

examples.en: She creates beautiful paintings.
examples.zh: 她創作美麗的畫作。

examples.en: We created a plan for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們為旅行制定了計畫。

explains: It means making something new. A person may make a story. An artist can make a picture.
A builder may make a house. A cook can make a new dish. This action brings an idea into life.
This word means bringing something into being. A team can make a new plan. A person may make a piece of art.

examples.en: Taiwan is globally recognized for its remarkably low crime rate.
examples.zh: 台灣以其極低的犯罪率在國際上享有極佳治安美譽。

examples.en: Installing security cameras along alleyways helps deter burglary and street crime.
examples.zh: 在巷弄周邊裝設監控攝影機有助於震懾竊盜與各類街頭犯罪行為。

examples.en: Financial cyber crime has become a serious threat requiring specialized digital forensics.
examples.zh: 金融網路犯罪日益猖獗，已成為亟需專業數位鑑識技術打擊的嚴重威脅。

explains: An action that breaks a law is this. A police officer may investigate it. A court can decide what happened.
Taking something that belongs to another person is against the law. A person may be punished. This word means an illegal act.
A law may say an action is illegal. The police may look for the person who did it. A judge may hear the case.

examples.en: The country faced a serious crisis.
examples.zh: 這個國家面臨嚴重危機。

examples.en: The crisis ended after the storm passed.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後危機解除了。

examples.en: They worked together during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危機期間他們一起合作。

explains: It is a time of great trouble or danger. A family may need help after a fire. Leaders may act quickly.
A country may face a serious problem. Hospitals can be busy during one. People work together to help.
This word describes a hard moment that needs quick action. A storm may cause one. A team can plan how to respond.

examples.en: A crow sat on the fence.
examples.zh: 一隻烏鴉停在柵欄上。

examples.en: The crow flew over the field.
examples.zh: 烏鴉飛過田野。

examples.en: We heard a crow calling in the tree.
examples.zh: 我們聽見樹上的烏鴉在叫。

explains: A large black bird makes a loud call. It is common on farms and in stories. It can have shiny feathers.
This bird may sit on a fence. It makes a sound in the morning. It can eat seeds and insects.
A black bird with a strong beak may live near fields. It can fly in a group. People may hear its loud call.

examples.en: A large crowd gathered to watch the live concert.
examples.zh: 一大群民眾聚集觀賞現場演唱會。

examples.en: Festive holiday crowds poured into the bustling department stores for sales.
examples.zh: 洋溢節慶歡樂的人潮湧入熱鬧的百貨公司搶購特賣商品。

examples.en: Avoid walking alone into chaotic and uncontrolled street crowds.
examples.zh: 避免隻身走入混亂且缺乏管制的街頭人群之中。

explains: Many people in one place form this group. It may gather to watch a game. A person can move into it.
A street may be full of people. A group may gather near a stage. This word can also mean moving close together.
This word means a large group of people. A person may move through it carefully. It can form at a busy event.

examples.en: Tainan has a rich historical and cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 台南擁有豐富深厚的歷史與文化底蘊。

examples.en: Studying overseas helps students bridge delicate cultural differences with ease.
examples.zh: 赴海外留學有助於學生輕鬆跨越細微微妙的文化差異。

examples.en: The cultural center holds monthly exhibitions featuring contemporary local artists.
examples.zh: 文化中心每月都會舉辦展覽，展示當代本土藝術家的精彩傑作。

explains: It relates to the arts, beliefs, and ways of life of a group. A festival may share music and food. People may learn about another nation.
A dance or meal can show a group’s traditions. Museums may teach about history. This word describes those human ways.
This word describes something linked to customs and art. A city may have many traditions. A book can explore how people live.

examples.en: Night markets are an essential part of Taiwanese culinary culture.
examples.zh: 夜市是台灣飲食文化中不可或缺的重要一環。

examples.en: Reading foreign literature introduces you to unique ways of life and culture.
examples.zh: 閱讀外國文學作品能引領你認識獨特的生活型態與多元文化。

examples.en: Corporate culture at this tech firm emphasizes teamwork and open communication.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司的企業文化十分強調團隊協作與開放暢通的溝通。

explains: It means the arts, customs, and beliefs of a group. People may share food and music. It can also mean good manners.
A society has stories, clothes, and celebrations. A person can learn about another group. This word describes shared ways of life.
People pass traditions from parents to children. A museum may show old art. This word can also describe a person’s learning and manners.

examples.en: The doctor found a cure for the infection.
examples.zh: 醫生找到了感染症的治療方法。

examples.en: Rest helped cure his cold.
examples.zh: 休息幫助他治好了感冒。

examples.en: There is no easy cure for this illness.
examples.zh: 這種疾病沒有簡單的治療方法。

explains: It means making an illness go away. Medicine may help a person feel better. Rest can help too.
A doctor may give care for a sick person. Some treatments help a wound close. The word can also mean a solution.
This action makes a sickness or problem better. A medicine may help. A person may recover after rest.

examples.en: The curious child opened the box.
examples.zh: 好奇的孩子打開了盒子。

examples.en: I am curious about the old house.
examples.zh: 我很好奇那棟老房子。

examples.en: She asked a curious question.
examples.zh: 她問了一個令人好奇的問題。

explains: It means wanting to learn more. A child may ask many questions. A cat may look at a new box.
A person may wonder about a sound. Someone who likes learning has this quality. It can describe a strong desire to know.
This word describes someone who wants to find out. A student may ask how a machine works. A new place may draw attention.

examples.en: Skilled scuba divers ride strong ocean currents during thrilling deep drift dives.
examples.zh: 經驗老道的高階水肺潛水員在澎湖七美海域順著強勁洋流前進，享受御風而行般的「放流潛水」。

examples.en: Always deploy an orange surface marker buoy before ascending in an unpredictable tidal current.
examples.zh: 在變幻莫測的潮汐強流中準備上升水面時，第一件事務必先打起顯眼亮橘色的水面浮標（SMB）。

examples.en: Rip currents can pull unwary swimmers away from the beach at speeds surpassing Olympic athletes.
examples.zh: 海邊無聲無息的離岸流（裂流）能在數秒內將戲水遊客迅速拖往外海，其流速甚至超越奧運游泳健將。

explains: It means happening now. A river may flow in one direction. Electricity can move through a wire.
A newspaper may report the latest facts. Water can flow in a stream. This word can mean the present or a flow.
This word describes something happening at this time. It can also name moving water or air. A river may have a strong flow.

examples.en: Open the curtains to let the warm sunlight in.
examples.zh: 拉開窗簾讓溫暖的陽光照進來。

examples.en: Heavy blackout curtains block out blinding morning glare effectively.
examples.zh: 厚實的遮光窗簾能有效阻擋早晨刺眼的陽光。

examples.en: The stage curtain rose slowly as the orchestra began the overture.
examples.zh: 隨著管弦樂團奏響序曲，舞台大幕緩緩升起。

examples.en: Deploying a dual-layer bubble curtain creates acoustic shielding that protects endangered dolphins from noise.
examples.zh: 在打樁點四周環繞佈設雙層氣泡幕，形成微氣泡隔音牆保護珍稀白海豚免受噪音干擾。

examples.en: High-output air compressors pump millions of tiny air bubbles through perforated hoses to form the curtain.
examples.zh: 甲板上的大功率空壓機透過海底穿孔微孔軟管，每分鐘泵入數百萬個細密微氣泡以築起降噪氣幕簾。

examples.en: Sonar measurements proved that the bubble curtain reduced underwater impact noise levels by over fifteen decibels.
examples.zh: 水下聲納監測數據鐵證，雙層氣泡幕技術成功將水下打樁的衝擊聲壓級大幅消減了超過十五分貝。

examples.en: Motorized acoustic wool curtains deploy from hidden ceiling pockets to adjust reverberation for amplified jazz concerts.
examples.zh: 隱藏式「電動羊毛吸音布幕」（Acoustic Curtains），在舉辦爵士與流行電聲音樂會時迅速展開以縮短殘響。

examples.en: She drew the thick velvet curtains shut to block out bright morning streetlights and sleep in late.
examples.zh: 她隨手拉緊厚實遮光的天鵝絨窗簾以完全隔絕清晨刺眼的街燈與晨曦，安心享受週末難得的補眠時光。

examples.en: The stage crew waited backstage for the heavy red velvet theater curtains to part before the play commenced.
examples.zh: 舞台後台全體工作人員屏息待命，靜候沉重華麗的大紅天鵝絨戲劇布幕徐徐拉開，宣告年度大戲正式開演。

entries.definition: 窗簾；幕簾；雙層氣泡幕阻隔打樁水下噪音 (護鯨)；隱藏於木格柵後方之電動可伸縮調音吸音布幕
explains: A piece of cloth can cover a window. A theater has one that opens before a show. It can give privacy.
A person may pull it across a window. Heavy fabric can block light. A stage has one that hides actors.
This cloth hangs in front of glass. It may be opened in the morning. A theater uses a large one.

examples.en: Eating round tangyuan during Dongzhi (Winter Solstice) is an ancient custom.
examples.zh: 冬至吃象徵圓滿的湯圓是一項古老的民俗。

examples.en: International travelers should respect local social customs when visiting temples.
examples.zh: 跨國旅行者在造訪寺廟宮觀時應當尊重當地的民俗習慣。

examples.en: Giving newlyweds pairs of chopsticks is an auspicious wedding custom.
examples.zh: 贈送成雙成對的筷子給新人是寓意早生貴子的吉祥婚俗。

explains: It is a usual way people do something. A family may have a special meal on holidays. Different places have different traditions.
A group may follow a long-held practice. A store may make clothes for one person. This word can mean a personal habit.
People may keep a tradition for many years. A person may have a regular habit. A business can make goods for one buyer.

examples.en: Convenience stores treat every customer with courtesy.
examples.zh: 便利商店對待每位顧客都彬彬有禮。

examples.en: Understanding customer feedback is crucial for improving product quality.
examples.zh: 深入理解顧客的反饋意見對於改善並提升產品質量至關重要。

examples.en: Loyal customers enjoy special VIP privileges and seasonal member discounts.
examples.zh: 忠實顧客享有專屬的貴賓尊榮禮遇與當季會員特惠折扣。

explains: A person who buys goods from a store has this role. A worker may help them. They may pay at a counter.
A shop welcomes people who buy things. A person may ask for help finding an item. The shop wants this person to return.
This person pays for goods or services. A restaurant may bring food to them. A business may try to help them.

examples.en: Streamlining manufacturing cycle times allows urgent wafer lots to ship to customers weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 不斷優化縮短晶圓生產製造週期（Cycle Time），讓急件晶圓能比原定交期提前數週空運交付給客戶。

examples.en: The four seasons follow a predictable annual cycle governed by Earth's tilted axial rotation.
examples.zh: 春夏秋冬四季在地球傾斜地軸圍繞太陽公轉規律下周而復始運轉，構築出井然有序的大自然年度生命循環。

examples.en: Economists warn that the current macroeconomic business cycle is entering a prolonged cooling period.
examples.zh: 國際宏觀經濟學家提出前瞻預警，指出當前全球總體經濟商業週期正在跨入長達數季的通膨降溫與放緩階段。

examples.en: The Organic Rankine Cycle evaporates an organic liquid with a boiling point much lower than water.
examples.zh: 「有機朗肯循環」（Organic Rankine Cycle ORC），利用沸點遠低於水的環保有機工質在低溫下蒸發發電。

examples.en: The natural water cycle involves evaporation from oceans, cloud condensation, and rainfall return to rivers.
examples.zh: 大自然奧妙的水循環系統涵蓋了海水受熱蒸發上升、雲層凝結致雨以及雨水匯入河流奔流入海的永恆循環。

examples.en: Fitness enthusiasts cycle along dedicated riverside bike paths early every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 自行車運動愛好者每逢週六清晨便會整裝出發，沿著規劃完善的水岸專用自行車道迎風暢快騎乘腳踏車。

examples.en: The Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle integrates AI algorithms to optimize microbial pathways iteratively.
examples.zh: 「DBTL 迭代閉環」（DBTL Cycle），結合 AI 大數據模型，以極快速度持續最佳化微生物代謝途徑。

examples.en: Agricultural communities organize planting and harvesting around the predictable annual seasonal weather cycle.
examples.zh: 傳統農業聚落依循大自然周而復始、規律運行的年度節氣週期，安排播種與豐收各項農事。

examples.en: He decided to cycle to work along the riverside bike path every morning to stay healthy and active.
examples.zh: 為了維持強健體魄，他決定每個工作日早晨皆沿著風景優美的河濱自行車道騎單車通勤上班。

entries.definition: 晶圓製造三至四個月生產週期；循環；ORC 有機朗肯雙循環低沸點工質發電循環；設計-建造-測試-學習 (DBTL 合成生物學迭代閉環)；週期
explains: A bike has wheels that move around again and again. A year has seasons in a repeating pattern. The word can mean riding a bicycle.

examples.zh: 兩位市長候選人進行了電視現場直播的政見辯論。

examples.zh: 我們學校的高中英語辯論校隊奪得了區域錦標賽冠軍金盃。

examples.en: Lawmakers debated the healthcare funding bill for three consecutive days.
examples.zh: 立法委員針對全民健保預算改革法案連續激辯討論了整整三天。

examples.en: Try to pay off credit card debts as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 盡可能快速清償信用卡卡債。

examples.zh: 近幾十年來該國的國家債務持續攀升。

examples.zh: 他對拯救他性命的醫生心懷無比深沉的感恩之情。

examples.en: Pay off high-interest credit card debt first to achieve financial freedom.
examples.zh: 先清償高利息的信用卡卡債，才能逐步邁向財務自由。

examples.en: The student worked part-time at a campus cafe to clear her college tuition debt.
examples.zh: 這名大學生利用課餘時間在校園咖啡館打工，以儘早還清大學就學貸款。

examples.en: Our country has an immense national debt that requires careful fiscal planning.
examples.zh: 國家背負著龐大的公共債務，需要政府當局審慎制定財政健全計畫。

explains: Money that a person owes is this. A bank may lend money for a home. The borrower must pay it back.

examples.en: Getting enough exercise is a healthy life decision.
examples.zh: 保持充足運動是一項有益健康的生活決定。

examples.en: Making a major career decision requires weighing pros and cons thoroughly.
examples.zh: 做出重大的職涯抉擇需要周詳權衡各項利弊得失。

examples.en: We respect your thoughtful decision to pursue further studies overseas.
examples.zh: 我們由衷尊重你前往海外深造進修的深思熟慮決定。

examples.en: Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS) cross-reference patient lab trends to suggest antibiotic adjustments.
examples.zh: 臨床決策輔助系統（CDSS）即時比對病患血液發炎指數趨勢，主動向主治醫師提出最適抗生素劑量調整建議。

examples.en: After months of soul-searching, she made the courageous decision to resign and pursue her startup dream.
examples.zh: 歷經數月的深思熟慮與內心掙扎，她終於鼓起莫大勇氣做出了人生重大決定：辭去高薪外商主管職位投入創業夢想。

examples.en: The referee's controversial penalty kick decision in the final minute sparked intense outrage in the stadium.
examples.zh: 主裁判在終場補時最後一分鐘所做出的極具爭議的十二碼十二碼罰球判決決定，引爆了全場球迷震耳欲聾的抗議怒吼。

entries.definition: 決定；決策；臨床決策輔助警示系統 (CDSS)
explains: This is a choice made after thinking about different options. A person may pick a meal from a menu. They have now chosen what to eat.
A group may need to agree on what to do next. Members can discuss several plans and vote. Their final choice guides their actions.
A judge can give a final answer about a case. People listen to what the judge has chosen. This result may affect what happens next.

examples.en: A deer ran across the road.
examples.zh: 一隻鹿跑過道路。

examples.en: The deer ate leaves near the tree.

examples.en: We saw a deer in the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林裡看到一隻鹿。

This animal can run quickly. It eats leaves and grass. People may see one near a road.
A female of this kind may care for a fawn. A male can grow antlers. It is often shy around people.

examples.en: The water is twenty degrees warm.
examples.zh: 水溫是二十度。

examples.en: She has a degree in biology.
examples.zh: 她有生物學學位。

examples.en: Turn the handle ninety degrees.
examples.zh: 把把手轉九十度。

examples.en: The flight departure was delayed by two hours due to heavy fog.
examples.zh: 由於濃霧，該航班起飛時間延誤了兩小時。

examples.en: Don't delay in seeking medical advice if symptoms persist.
examples.zh: 若症狀持續未消，請勿拖延就醫諮詢。

examples.en: Technical difficulties caused an unexpected delay in the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 技術故障導致現場直播節目發生了意料之外的延遲。

examples.en: Typhoon winds caused a three-hour departure delay for all international evening flights.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風強陣風導致今晚所有從桃園機場起飛的國際航班全面面臨三小時以上的航班延誤。

examples.en: The unexpected technical delay meant we had to spend an extra night in Frankfurt.
examples.zh: 突如其來的機械故障延誤，意味著我們不得不由航空公司安排在法蘭克福過境旅館多待一宿。

examples.en: Heavy morning commuter traffic caused an unavoidable delay for our airport bus.
examples.zh: 早晨上班尖峰時段國道主線車流嚴重回堵壅塞，導致我們搭乘的機場接駁巴士遭遇不可避免的延遲。

examples.en: A rhythmic stereo ping-pong delay bounces shimmering echo repeats seamlessly between left and right ears.
examples.zh: 富節奏感的立體聲乒乓延遲效果，讓清亮空靈的迴音在聽者左右耳之間流暢交替彈跳穿梭。

examples.en: Torrential mudslides caused an unexpected four-hour train delay along the eastern railway corridor.
examples.zh: 豪雨引發的突發土石流落石意外，導致東部幹線鐵路各級列車發生了長達四小時的非預期誤點延誤。

examples.en: Do not delay seeing a qualified doctor if you notice persistent unexplained chest pain or dizziness.
examples.zh: 倘若你察覺自己出現持續不明原因的胸悶胸痛或陣發性眩暈，千萬切莫拖延拖拖拉拉，務必及早就醫。

examples.en: A forty-minute round-trip light communication delay makes real-time joysticking from Earth physically impossible.
examples.zh: 由於光速傳播需要整整四十分鐘的「來回通訊延遲」（Communication Delay），地球工程師完全無法即時搖桿操控。

examples.en: Severe runway thunderstorms caused a four-hour flight departure delay at the international airport.
examples.zh: 機場上空突如其來的雷雨胞冰雹強降雨，造成該國際樞紐機場所有國際線班機平均出現四小時的起飛延誤。

examples.en: Do not delay seeing a certified cardiologist if you experience sudden tightness or pain across your chest.
examples.zh: 假若您在日常活動中感到胸口有任何突發性的壓迫感或悶痛，請立刻就醫檢查心臟專科，切莫有絲毫延誤拖延。

entries.definition: 延誤；延期；耽擱；班機延誤；立體聲左右延遲迴音效果；延遲；光速來回傳播數十分鐘之深太空訊號傳輸延遲

examples.zh: 凡購物滿一千元即可享有免費宅配到府服務。

examples.en: The mother had a smooth and safe delivery at the regional hospital.
examples.zh: 這位母親在地區醫院順利平安分娩生下小寶寶。

examples.en: There is little doubt that renewable solar energy will power our future.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，再生太陽能將驅動我們的未來世界。

examples.en: Criminal convictions require the state to prove every single element of the crime beyond a reasonable doubt.
examples.zh: 刑事法院判決有罪的最高門檻，必須將涉案事實舉證至毫無合理懷疑的境地。

examples.en: If the defense creates reasonable doubt regarding the murder weapon, jurors must vote to acquit.
examples.zh: 辯護律師若能在法庭上針對作案兇器的同一性成功建立合理懷疑，陪審團即依法必須做出無罪裁決。

examples.en: The judge reminded the citizen jury that speculation cannot substitute for proof beyond reasonable doubt.
examples.zh: 審判長鄭重告誡全體國民法官，任何主觀臆測或推論皆絕對無法取代毫無合理懷疑的嚴格法定舉證門檻。

entries.definition: 懷疑；不確定；排除合理懷疑之嚴格刑事舉證門檻
explains: It means not being sure. A person may wonder if a story is true. A question may remain.
A student may feel unsure about an answer. A person can question a fact. This word means uncertainty.

examples.en: A white dove flew over the church.

examples.zh: 僅花了幾秒鐘就下載完了手機更新。

examples.en: The song has received over a million digital downloads.
examples.zh: 這首歌已獲得超過百萬次的數位下載次數。

A student can get a picture from a website. The file moves to a phone or computer. The action may take a few seconds.
This action brings a file to a device. A person may get an app. A connection to the internet is needed.

examples.en: The children ran downstairs to dinner.

This kind of story has actors and a plot. It can be shown on TV or stage. It often has serious feelings.

examples.zh: 畫畫能幫助我放鬆。

examples.zh: 醫生給他一種止痛藥。

examples.zh: 有些藥物可能很危險。

examples.en: The drug helped her sleep.
examples.zh: 這種藥幫助她入睡。

examples.zh: 她買了一台新的吹風機。

examples.zh: 延誤是因為大雨。

examples.zh: 這把鈍刀切不開麵包。

examples.zh: 他的鉛筆尖很鈍。

This word can mean boring. A pencil may have a flat point. A person may feel tired by a repeated task.

examples.en: It is every citizen's duty to protect public safety.
examples.zh: 維護公共安全是每位公民的職責。

examples.en: The security guard was on duty throughout the night.
examples.zh: 保全人員整晚都在值班執勤。

examples.zh: 奢侈品的進口關稅最近有所調升。

examples.en: Imported luxury electronics are subject to customs duty and value-added tax.
examples.zh: 進口的高價精品電子產品須依規定繳納海關關稅與營業稅。

examples.en: It is every responsible citizen's fundamental civic duty to vote in general elections.
examples.zh: 積極參與各項大選投票是每位克盡己責的現代公民最核心基本的公民義務。

examples.en: A dedicated nurse was on duty in the intensive care unit throughout the midnight shift.
examples.zh: 一名盡忠職守的專責護理師在整個大夜班輪值期間全程守護加護病房病患。

explains: It means something a person must do. A student may have a job at home. A worker may have a responsibility.

examples.en: An eagle flew high above the trees.
examples.zh: 一隻老鷹飛得比樹高。

examples.zh: 老鷹在河裡抓到一條魚。

examples.en: We saw an eagle near the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們在山附近看到一隻老鷹。

examples.zh: 他因努力工作而獲獎。

examples.en: They earn enough to buy food.
examples.zh: 他們賺的錢足夠買食物。

examples.zh: 她戴著銀耳環參加派對。

examples.zh: 這對耳環是媽媽送的禮物。

examples.en: He bought a pair of gold earrings.
examples.zh: 他買了一對金耳環。

examples.en: We practice earthquake drills at school every semester.
examples.zh: 我們每學期都在學校進行地震防災演練。

examples.en: Modern architectural engineering incorporates shock absorbers against strong earthquakes.
examples.zh: 現代建築工程融入了能抵禦強烈地震的減震與隔震系統。

examples.en: Drop, cover, and hold on are the essential safety rules during an earthquake.
examples.zh: 「趴下、掩護、穩住」是遭遇地震時至關重要的避難原則。

This event can make objects fall from shelves. People may feel the floor move. It can happen without warning.

examples.zh: 他們住在城市的東部。

examples.en: An eastern wind brought cool air.
examples.zh: 東風帶來了涼爽的空氣。

examples.zh: 桌子的邊緣很光滑。

examples.en: She stood at the edge of the pool.
examples.zh: 她站在池塘邊。

examples.en: The knife has a sharp edge.
examples.zh: 這把刀有鋒利的刀刃。

examples.zh: 我買了這本書的最新版。

examples.en: The first edition is very old.
examples.zh: 第一版非常老了。

This word means one published version. A reader may buy the latest copy. It can include new information.

examples.en: Hands-on marine education inspires thousands of visiting schoolchildren to stop using single-use plastic straws.
examples.zh: 寓教於樂的生動「海洋環境教育」（Education），啟發了無數來訪學童自發性在生活中拒用一次性塑膠吸管。

examples.zh: 持續擴大投資普及且優質的公共國民教育資源，能為偏鄉與弱勢家庭學童鋪就翻轉階級的堅實階梯。

examples.en: The foundation conducts financial literacy education workshops for young adults entering the workforce.
examples.zh: 該公益基金會每季定期為即將步入職場的社會新鮮人開辦實用的個人理財與防詐騙教育生活工作坊。

entries.definition: 親身觀察活體生物之第一線海洋保育教育

examples.zh: 她是兩姊妹中年紀較大的。

examples.zh: 一位長者對村民說話。

This word means older. A person may have more experience. It can also be a title for a community leader.

examples.zh: 音樂擁有喚起人類內心深層情感的強大力量。

examples.zh: 在離別歡送宴上，她極力克制自己翻湧起伏的情緒以防落淚。

examples.zh: 感到幸福且備受重視的員工往往更具生產力、創新力與團隊忠誠度。

examples.zh: 佔據全宇宙總能量七成的「暗能量」（Dark Energy），如同一種無所不在的反引力，推動宇宙加速膨脹。

examples.zh: 全面轉型發展潔淨太陽能與離岸風力能源，能有效大幅降低國家對進口化石燃料的過度依賴。

explains: It is the power needed to move or work. Food gives the body strength. A battery stores it.

examples.en: The mechanic checked the car engine thoroughly.
examples.zh: 技師徹底檢查了汽車引擎。

examples.zh: 在平交道等候時請將發動機熄火。

examples.zh: 散發幽藍光芒的氙氣離子引擎，利用太陽能電力提供持續數年不絕的微小穩定推力。

examples.zh: 多具霍爾效應離子推進引擎依序輪流點火，穩健牽引著重達數十噸的無人小行星攔截探測飛船。

examples.en: Operating the high-efficiency ion engine requires only a few grams of inert noble gas per day.
examples.zh: 運轉這具效率驚人的超高比沖離子發動機，每天僅僅需要耗費幾公克惰性無毒的純氙氣氣體。

examples.en: The 300kW fuel cell engine powers forty-ton semi-trucks easily up steep mountain highways.
examples.zh: 搭載三百千瓦大功率「燃料電池動力引擎」（Engine），能輕鬆驅動四十公噸聯結車平穩攀爬陡峭山路。

examples.en: The certified mechanic repaired the automobile engine after diagnosing a cracked cylinder head gasket.

examples.en: Technological innovation serves as the primary engine driving economic productivity and job growth nationwide.

examples.en: Environmental DNA (eDNA) sampling detects elusive freshwater species from a single liter of river water.
examples.zh: 「環境 DNA 採樣技術」（eDNA），僅需過濾一公升溪水即可精準偵測出極端隱密的珍稀水生動物。

examples.en: Strict environmental regulations prevent chemical factories from discharging wastewater into mountain streams.
examples.zh: 嚴格的環境保護法規嚴格杜絕化學工廠向清澈的高山溪流違規排放任何工業廢水。

examples.en: Educating hikers about environmental ethics helps preserve pristine alpine trails from trash accumulation.
examples.zh: 向登山愛好者推廣無痕山林環境倫理，有助於保護原始高山步道免於垃圾髒亂侵擾。

examples.en: Children especially love splashing around in shallow water during hot summer afternoons.

entries.definition: 深度不受干擾的極致專注力；聚焦
explains: It means looking at one thing carefully. A camera can make a clear picture. A person can pay close attention.
A student may look closely at a task. A lens can make an image clear. The word can mean a main point.
This word means giving full attention. A person may look at one place. A camera needs a clear image.

examples.en: A thick fog covered the road.
examples.zh: 濃霧籠罩了道路。

examples.en: The fog lifted after sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出後霧散了。

examples.en: We could not see the boat through the fog.
examples.zh: 我們看不見霧中的船。

A road can become hard to see across. Drivers may turn on lights. This word describes a gray cloud close to land.
Water in the air can make a soft gray cover. It may hide hills. A person should drive carefully.

examples.en: The folk music came from the mountains.
examples.zh: 民謠來自山區。

examples.en: The folk danced at the festival.
examples.zh: 民眾在節慶中跳舞。

examples.en: A folk tale tells an old story.
examples.zh: 民間故事講述古老的故事。

explains: This word can mean people in a casual way. A speaker may use it when talking to a group of neighbors. It can also refer to people in a certain area or community.
A family may be called this in an informal way. A person can ask how everyone is doing. It means a group of people.
This word refers to people or relatives. It sounds friendly and casual. A child may use it when talking about parents.

examples.en: The following day was sunny.
examples.zh: 隔天是晴天。

examples.en: Read the following pages for homework.
examples.zh: 閱讀接下來幾頁作為作業。

examples.en: The following students won prizes.
examples.zh: 以下學生獲得了獎品。

A person may read the next pages. Fans who support a singer can have this name. It describes what comes after.
This word points to something coming later. A group may follow a leader. A set of instructions can come next.

examples.en: It was foolish to run across the road.
examples.zh: 跑過馬路是愚蠢的。

examples.en: He made a foolish mistake.
examples.zh: 他犯了一個愚蠢的錯誤。

examples.en: The foolish plan did not work.
examples.zh: 這個不明智的計畫行不通。

explains: It means not wise. A person may make a bad choice. The word can sound unkind.
A silly act may be called this. A person can learn after making a mistake. It means lacking good sense.
This word describes a poor choice. A person may act without thinking. It can hurt someone’s feelings when used as an insult.

examples.en: The children played football after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後踢足球。

examples.en: He watched a football game on TV.
examples.zh: 他在電視上看足球比賽。

examples.en: The football rolled into the yard.
examples.zh: 足球滾進了院子。

explains: This sport is played by two teams with a ball. In many countries, players mostly kick a round ball. They try to send it into the other team’s net.
In the American version, players use an oval ball. They can carry it or pass it to teammates. Moving it into the other team’s end zone scores points.
This can also name the ball used in the sport. Its shape depends on the kind of game. Players practice with it before a match.

examples.en: The force of the wind broke a branch.
examples.zh: 風的力量折斷了一根樹枝。

examples.en: The police used force to open the door.
examples.zh: 警方用力打開了門。

examples.en: A magnet has a strong pulling force.
examples.zh: 磁鐵有很強的吸引力。

explains: It means strength or control. A storm can push trees. A leader may have the ability to make choices.

This word means strong influence or ability. A team may push a door open. A leader may have control over a group.

examples.en: Alishan is famous for its ancient cypress forest.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其古老的紅檜森林聞名。

examples.en: Walking through the quiet forest fills your lungs with fresh air.
examples.zh: 漫步在寧靜的森林裡讓你的肺部吸飽新鮮空氣。

examples.en: The Amazon rainforest is vital for global oxygen production.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜雨林對全球氧氣生成至關重要。

examples.en: Alishan is renowned for its ancient sacred cypress forest trees.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其古老壯麗的神木檜木巨木森林聞名天下。

examples.en: Taking deep breaths in a pine forest fills your lungs with restorative phytoncides.
examples.zh: 在松樹森林中深呼吸，能讓雙肺吸滿具有療癒身心功效的芬多精。

examples.en: Reforestation projects plant millions of saplings to revive degraded forest lands.
examples.zh: 造林計畫種下了數百萬株健壯幼苗，致力於讓退化貧瘠的林地重現生機。

explains: A large area has many trees. Animals may live there. People can walk on paths.

A group of trees grows in this place. It may be home to deer and foxes. People should protect it.

examples.en: To forgive others is to free yourself from bitterness.
examples.zh: 原諒他人就是將自己從怨恨中解脫出來。

examples.en: Can you ever forgive me for forgetting your birthday anniversary?
examples.zh: 我竟然粗心大意忘記了你的生日紀念日，你還能原諒寬恕我嗎？

examples.en: She chose to forgive her former rival and move forward with peace of mind.
examples.zh: 她選擇大度原諒過往的競爭對手，卸下心防並平靜坦然地迎向嶄新未來。

explains: It means no longer being angry about a mistake. A friend may say sorry. A person can accept an apology.

This word means pardoning someone. A person may not hold anger. It can bring peace after a problem.

examples.zh: 請填寫這份表格。

examples.zh: 天冷時水會形成冰。

examples.en: The clouds formed a long line.
examples.zh: 雲形成了一條長線。

The verb means making or developing something. Children can make a circle by standing together. Clouds can also develop in the sky.

examples.zh: 他穿正式服裝參加婚禮。

examples.en: The school held a formal meeting.
examples.zh: 學校舉行了一場正式會議。

examples.en: She wrote a formal letter to the mayor.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封正式信給市長。

This word means proper and serious. A person may wear a suit. A school event can have a set style.

examples.zh: 以前的老師來拜訪我們班。

examples.zh: 這裡曾是國王的住所。

examples.en: My former job was in a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我以前的工作是在餐廳。

examples.zh: 軍隊在黎明時向前進。

examples.zh: 她走上前領獎。

examples.zh: 他們在城鎮創辦了一所新學校。

examples.zh: 一隻狐狸跑過雪地。

examples.zh: 狐狸有一條濃密的紅尾巴。

examples.zh: 我們在森林附近看到一隻狐狸。

examples.en: Freedom of the press is vital for a transparent government.
examples.zh: 新聞媒體自由對於監督政府與透明施政至關重要。

examples.en: Freedom of speech allows diverse voices and perspectives to flourish safely.
examples.zh: 言論自由能保障社會上多元相異的聲音與觀點得以安全蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Many immigrants came to this new land in search of economic and religious freedom.
examples.zh: 許多移民不遠千里遷徙來到這片新土地，尋求經濟發展與宗教信仰的自由。

examples.zh: 語言流利賦予你無拘無束的「智識與探索自由」（Freedom），讓你能自由涉獵任何學問、暢遊任何國度。

examples.en: Having financial and geographic freedom allows remote entrepreneurs to live and work worldwide.
examples.zh: 享有財務自主與地理空間的無拘自由，讓數位遊民創業家能夠在世界任何角落自在生活與辦公。

examples.zh: 言論自由與多元蓬勃的文藝創作自由，是民主自由繁榮社會無可動搖的重要基石。

examples.en: True friendship lasts through the years.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼歷久彌新。

examples.zh: 距離與歲月無法磨滅真正友誼之間深厚堅固的羈絆。

examples.en: We exchanged handwritten postcards to cultivate and cherish our international friendship.
examples.zh: 我們互相寄送手寫明信片，以維繫並珍惜這份跨越國界的深厚友誼。

examples.en: The fries were hot and crispy.
examples.zh: 薯條又熱又脆。

examples.en: She shared her fries with her brother.
examples.zh: 她和弟弟分享薯條。

This food is made from potato sticks. They are cooked until golden. A paper bag may hold them.

examples.zh: 我們買了客廳家具。

examples.zh: 我們需要更深入地研究這個問題。

examples.zh: 嚴謹的增益調校確保人聲音軌維持在安全動態範圍內，既無底噪又絕不爆音過載。

examples.en: The international export market showed a noticeable gain in revenue over the previous financial year.
examples.zh: 該企業海外國際外銷市場在上一個財政年度中，展現出令人欣喜的營收實質增長。

examples.zh: 遺留在山區營地的廚餘果皮垃圾會引來台灣黑熊覓食，進而破壞野生動物天然覓食習性。

examples.en: Volunteers hauled twenty kilograms of historical trail garbage down from the high alpine ridge.
examples.zh: 淨山志工們合力從高海拔稜線上，將重達二十公斤的歷史人為垃圾全數背運下山清理。

examples.en: The gardener planted roses in the yard.
examples.zh: 園丁在庭院裡種了玫瑰。

examples.zh: 蒜末能為熱炒增添濃郁風味。

examples.zh: 在將蒜頭加入醃料之前先將兩瓣大蒜壓碎。

examples.zh: 一般規則很容易記住。

examples.en: The generous donor contributed funds to build rural school libraries.

examples.zh: 每當班上學童有一丁點的微小進步，她從來都不吝於給予最熱情大方的讚美。

examples.zh: 她用溫柔的聲音說話。

examples.en: Apply a small drop of super glue to fix the broken mug handle.
examples.zh: 滴一小滴快乾膠以修復破損的馬克杯把手。

examples.en: Reversible hot hide glue allows centuries-old violins to be opened for delicate interior restorations without wood damage.
examples.zh: 具備可逆性的古法「熱動物皮膠」（Hide Glue），讓數百年的古琴能無損開蓋進行精細的內部修復。

examples.en: Elementary school students used non-toxic glue sticks to assemble paper holiday greeting cards.
examples.zh: 國小美術課上的小朋友們開心地手拿無毒固體膠棒，剪剪貼貼親手製作溫馨的立體聖誕賀卡。

examples.en: Unlike modern epoxy, natural hide glue dries glass-hard and never dampens acoustic vibrations.
examples.zh: 與現代人工環氧樹脂膠不同，天然動物皮膠乾涸後質地堅硬如玻璃，絕不會吸收或衰減樂器聲波振動。

entries.definition: 膠水；黏貼；古法熱動物皮膠 (可無損拆卸修復之天然膠水)
explains: It is a sticky liquid used to join paper or wood. A person may use it for crafts. It becomes hard when dry.
A child may join two pieces of paper with this. A bottle can hold it. It can be clear or white.
This substance helps things stick together. A worker may use it on a broken chair. It can come in a tube.

examples.en: Set clear study goals at the beginning of each semester.
examples.zh: 每個學期初設定明確的讀書目標。

examples.en: The star soccer forward scored an astonishing goal in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 明星足球前鋒在最後幾秒攻進了一記驚艷全場的關鍵進球。

examples.en: Breaking down long-term dreams into smaller milestones makes goals achievable.
examples.zh: 將遠大夢想拆解為各個階段性小目標會使目標更容易達成。

explains: It means something a person hopes to do. A team may try to score one. A soccer net has this name.
A student may set one for the year. A player kicks a ball toward it. It can mean a purpose or result.
This word can mean a target. A person may work hard to reach one. In sports, a ball may go into a net.

examples.en: Mountain goats can climb extremely steep rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 野山羊能夠攀爬非常陡峭的岩壁。

examples.en: Fresh goat milk and goat cheese are nutrient-rich dairy options.
examples.zh: 新鮮羊奶與羊乳酪是營養豐富的乳製品選擇。

examples.en: The lively baby goat leaped playfully around the farm enclosure.
examples.zh: 活潑的小山羊在農場圍欄周圍歡快地蹦蹦跳跳。

explains: A farm animal has horns and a beard. It eats grass and leaves. Its young is called a kid.
This animal can climb rocky hills. It may give milk. A person may keep one on a farm.
A male or female farm animal has a short tail. It eats plants. Some people make cheese from its milk.

examples.en: The ring is made of gold.
examples.zh: 這枚戒指是金製的。

examples.en: She found a gold coin in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花園裡找到一枚金幣。

examples.en: The medal was bright gold.
examples.zh: 這面獎牌是亮金色的。

explains: A shiny yellow metal is used for jewelry. It does not rust easily. People may give rings made from it.
This metal is valuable. A person may wear it around a neck. Coins can be made from it.
A bright yellow color has this name. A medal may be made from this metal. People dig it from the ground.

examples.en: The golden leaves fell in autumn.
examples.zh: 金黃色的葉子在秋天落下。

examples.en: He won a golden medal.
examples.zh: 他贏得一面金牌。

examples.en: It was a golden chance to learn.
examples.zh: 這是學習的絕佳機會。

explains: It describes a color like yellow metal. A ripe wheat field may look this way. It can also mean excellent.
A prize may have this bright color. A person may have a very good opportunity. The word can describe something special.
This word means yellow and shiny. A medal for first place may look this way. It can also mean very good.

examples.en: A goose swam across the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻鵝游過池塘。

examples.en: The goose laid an egg.
examples.zh: 那隻鵝下了一顆蛋。

examples.en: We saw a goose near the farm.
examples.zh: 我們在農場附近看到一隻鵝。

explains: This is a large water bird with a long neck. Its feathers may be white, gray, brown, or a mix of colors. Its young is called a gosling.
This water bird may live on a farm. It has webbed feet. A group can make a loud honking sound.
A person may roast this bird for a holiday meal. It has feathers and a broad bill. It can fly.

examples.en: The mayor governs the city.
examples.zh: 市長治理這座城市。

examples.en: A king governed the land long ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前一位國王統治這片土地。

examples.en: People choose leaders to govern them.
examples.zh: 人們選擇領導者來治理他們。

explains: It means leading a place or group. A leader may make laws. The word can also mean controlling behavior.
A country’s leaders may make decisions. A person may guide a team. This action means leading or directing.
This word means ruling or directing. A city can be led by a mayor. Rules can guide how people act.

examples.en: The government introduced subsidies to encourage electric scooter purchases.
examples.zh: 政府推出補助方案以鼓勵民眾換購電動機車。

examples.en: Citizens expect the government to maintain public safety and economic growth.
examples.zh: 國民殷切期盼政府能全力維護社會公共安全並促進經濟繁榮發展。

examples.en: Local government agencies work around the clock during severe typhoons.
examples.zh: 地方政府各防救災機關在強烈颱風侵襲期間日以繼夜全力值勤應變。

explains: The leaders of a country make laws and provide services. People may vote for them. They work in offices.
A country has leaders who make choices for many people. They may run schools and roads. Citizens pay taxes.
This group manages a nation or city. It can create rules. People may elect some of its leaders.

examples.en: The gradual change took several weeks.
examples.zh: 這項逐漸的改變花了好幾週。

examples.en: Her health showed gradual improvement.
examples.zh: 她的健康逐漸改善。

examples.en: The gradual slope was easy to climb.
examples.zh: 這段平緩的斜坡很容易爬。

explains: It means happening little by little. A child may learn a skill over time. A change can be slow.
A plant grows bit by bit. A person may feel better after rest. This word means taking place in steps.
This word describes a slow change. A person may get stronger over many weeks. It does not happen all at once.

examples.en: Ancient proverbs remind us to cherish every single precious grain of rice.
examples.zh: 「誰知盤中飧，粒粒皆辛苦」，古老農耕智慧時刻提醒著我們應當常懷感恩、珍惜每一粒珍貴米糧。

examples.en: Nutritionists advise incorporating whole grains like brown rice and rolled oats into your diet.
examples.zh: 權威營養學專家極力建議在日常三餐中多方攝取糙米、黑米與大燕麥等未精緻全穀雜糧穀物。

examples.en: Take his dramatic courtroom exaggerations with a grain of salt because he likes attention.
examples.zh: 對於他在法庭上過度戲劇化且誇大其詞的說法請抱持懷疑態度（半信半疑），因為他向來愛博眼球。

examples.en: Applying transparent oil brings out the swirling golden grain and natural character of solid walnut.
examples.zh: 塗刷上一層清澈護木油，能將胡桃木天然交織的如流水般優美年輪木紋完美顯透。

examples.en: Always sand parallel to the wood grain to avoid leaving visible cross-scratches on the surface.
examples.zh: 進行砂磨作業時務必順著木材紋理平行打磨，以避免在木頭表面留下難以消除的橫向刮痕。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread contains all parts of the natural grain, providing abundant dietary fiber and nutrients.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包保留了天然穀物顆粒的所有部分，能為人體提供豐富的膳食纖維與微量營養。

examples.en: Luthiers look for straight, evenly spaced annual grain lines with zero runout across the soundboard.
examples.zh: 製琴師精挑細選緊密筆直、間距均勻且完全無偏斜的天然「年輪木紋」（Grain）來打造面板。

examples.en: Golden fields of wheat grain swayed gently beneath summer sunshine across the rolling plains.
examples.zh: 盛夏燦爛金黃的陽光灑滿連綿起伏的平原，無邊無際的成熟小麥麥浪隨風泛起金色漣漪。

examples.en: Sanding along the natural wood grain prevents unsightly scratches from ruining the tabletop finish.
examples.zh: 順著木材天然生長的纖維木紋方向進行細緻砂磨，能徹底防止粗暴刮痕破壞桌面平整漆面。

entries.definition: 糧食穀物；一粒米；微量；原木天然年輪木紋；紋理；密集筆直對稱之面板年輪木紋；穀物
explains: A farmer grows this plant for food. It can be wheat, rice, or corn. Small pieces may be called kernels.
People grind it to make flour. A bowl of rice is one kind. A person can see a small speck on a table.
This word can mean a food plant. It can also be one tiny piece. Wood has lines that show its texture.

examples.en: The apple weighs about one hundred grams.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果大約重一百公克。

examples.en: Add ten grams of sugar.
examples.zh: 加入十公克的糖。

examples.en: The letter weighed less than a gram.
examples.zh: 這封信不到一公克重。

explains: A small unit is used to measure weight. A paper clip may weigh one. A short form is written after a number.
A recipe may need a certain weight of flour. One is a very small amount. A scale can measure it.
This metric measure is one thousandth of a kilogram. A person may use it for food. A small candy may weigh several.

examples.en: They stayed in a grand hotel.
examples.zh: 他們住在一間豪華飯店。

examples.en: The parade was a grand event.
examples.zh: 遊行是一場盛大的活動。

examples.en: She has grand plans for the future.
examples.zh: 她對未來有宏大的計畫。

explains: It means large and impressive. A person may live in a large old home. The word can also mean very good.
A party may have a lot of food and guests. A person can feel joy about a success. This word describes something large or fine.
This word means large, impressive, or important. A hotel may have a large entrance. A person may feel proud of a great achievement.

examples.en: Kyoho grapes grown in Changhua are juicy and sweet.
examples.zh: 彰化種植的巨峰葡萄多汁又香甜。

examples.en: Wash the whole bunch of purple grapes thoroughly with clean water.
examples.zh: 用清水把整串紫葡萄徹底清洗乾淨。

examples.en: Dried grapes are known as raisins and make tasty snacks.
examples.zh: 曬乾的葡萄被稱為葡萄乾，是美味的零食小點心。

explains: A small round fruit grows in bunches on a vine. It may be green or purple. People can make juice from it.
A person may eat this sweet fruit fresh. Raisins are dried ones. A farm may grow it in rows.
This fruit has a thin skin and seeds. It can be used to make juice. A bunch may hang from a plant.

examples.en: The shop clerk greeted every customer with a smile.
examples.zh: 店員面帶微笑向每一位顧客打招呼。

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails excitedly to greet their owners coming home.
examples.zh: 狗狗興奮地搖尾巴迎接回家的主人。

examples.en: In many cultures, bowing is a traditional way to greet elders politely.
examples.zh: 在許多文化中，鞠躬是向長輩禮貌致意的傳統方式。

explains: It means saying hello to someone. A person may smile and wave. A host can meet a visitor at the door.
A teacher may say hello to a class. A person can meet a friend warmly. This action shows kindness.
This word means meeting someone in a friendly way. A person may wave. A shop worker can say hello to a buyer.

examples.en: Language learning sparks profound personal growth, expanding both your intellect and emotional maturity.
examples.zh: 語言學習能激發深刻的「個人內在成長」（Personal Growth），讓你的智識維度與情感成熟度全面昇華。

examples.en: Stepping outside your comfort zone is the single most reliable catalyst for career growth.
examples.zh: 勇敢踏出舒適圈去擁抱未知挑戰，是推動個人職涯實現飛躍式突破成長最可靠的催化劑。

examples.en: Economic analysts forecast steady long-term growth across renewable technology sectors.
examples.zh: 經濟分析專家預測，在各項綠能與再生科技領域中，將迎來持續而穩健的長期市場成長。

entries.definition: 不斷突破自我、實現心智蛻變之個人內在成長；成長
explains: It means getting bigger or better. A child grows taller each year. A plant makes new leaves.
A business may become larger. A person can learn new skills. This word means increase or progress.
This word describes change over time. A town may have more homes. A person may become stronger.

examples.en: The guard stood by the door.
examples.zh: 警衛站在門邊。

examples.en: A dog guards the house at night.
examples.zh: 狗晚上守著房子。

examples.en: The guard checked our tickets.
examples.zh: 警衛檢查了我們的票。

explains: A person who protects a place has this job. They may stand by a door. A dog can protect a home.
A worker may watch a building at night. The person helps keep others safe. This word can mean protection.
This person may protect a museum or bank. A parent can protect a child. The word also means watching carefully.

examples.en: Taiwanese guava sprinkled with plum powder is tasty.
examples.zh: 台灣芭樂灑上梅子粉非常美味。

examples.en: Crunchy guava is packed with more vitamin C than most citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 爽脆的芭樂富含比多數柑橘類水果更高的維生素 C。

examples.en: She sliced a fresh guava and packed it in her lunchbox.
examples.zh: 她切了一顆新鮮芭樂並裝進便當盒中。

examples.en: Crisp Yanchao Pearl guavas sprinkled with sweet plum powder make a refreshing snack.
examples.zh: 來自高雄燕巢泥火山沃土培育出的鮮脆珍珠芭樂切片後撒上一層酸甜梅子粉，滋味無比生津。

examples.en: Fresh guava boasts an exceptionally high concentration of vitamin C compared to citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 新鮮芭樂中所蘊含的天然維生素 C 含量冠絕群雄，其濃度遠遠超越了傳統的柑橘與檸檬。

examples.en: Night market vendors display pyramids of freshly sliced guava seasoned with licorice and salt.
examples.zh: 台灣各大夜市現切水果攤位前，總陳列著一座座撒上甘草鹽、水潤脆口的新鮮芭樂切片金字塔。

entries.definition: 芭樂；番石榴；珍珠芭樂；芭樂 (Guava)
explains: A tropical fruit has green or yellow skin. Its inside may be pink or white. It has many small seeds.
A person may eat this fruit with salt. It grows on a small tree. The juice can be sweet.
This fruit is often round. A cook may make juice or jam from it. Its smell is strong and sweet.

examples.en: We prepared a warm welcome for our dinner guests.
examples.zh: 我們為晚餐賓客準備了熱情的款待。

examples.en: The luxury resort offers complimentary breakfast and fruit bowls to hotel guests.
examples.zh: 這家豪華度假飯店為飯店住客提供免費精緻早餐與迎賓水果盤。

examples.en: A world-famous author appeared as the special guest speaker at the literary seminar.
examples.zh: 一位舉世聞名的作家作為特別受邀貴賓出席了這場文學研討會。

explains: A person invited to a home or event is this. The host may offer food. A hotel may have many.
A friend may come to stay for a night. The person is invited. A party can have many of them.
This word means a visitor who is invited. A host may greet the person. They may be given a seat and food.

examples.en: The friendly local guide showed us around Tainan.
examples.zh: 親切的在地導遊帶領我們遊覽台南。

examples.en: Follow this step-by-step user guide to install the software correctly.
examples.zh: 請依照這份逐步操作指南來正確安裝軟體。

examples.en: A mentor can guide young professionals toward achieving their career goals.
examples.zh: 一位良師能指引年輕職場新鮮人邁向實現職業目標。

examples.en: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) transport heavy containers quietly between the quay and storage yards.
examples.zh: 全電動無人自動導引搬運車，安靜無聲穿梭於碼頭與堆場之間。

examples.en: Buried transponders and magnetic floor markers guide driverless transport vehicles along harbor tracks.
examples.zh: 預先埋設於地面下的射頻發報晶片與磁性感應標記，引導無人搬運車沿著專屬安全路線行駛。

examples.en: The port management software guides crane operators to pick the exact container scheduled for export.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業軟體自動引導起重機吊具，分秒不差鎖定並吊取排定出口的目標貨櫃。

examples.en: Custom synthetic single guide RNA navigates the editing complex directly to the mutated disease gene.
examples.zh: 客製化人工「單一導航 RNA」（Guide RNA sgRNA），能精準引導剪刀複合體降落至突變致病基因位點。

examples.en: An experienced local mountain guide escorted the hiking group across the treacherous glacier pass.
examples.zh: 一位經驗豐富的在地高山嚮導，安全護送整支登山隊伍順利穿越險象環生的冰川隘口。

examples.en: Parents should guide young children toward healthy digital habits rather than imposing outright bans.
examples.zh: 為人父母應循循善誘引導年幼子女養成健康的數位使用習慣，而非一味採取全面禁止手段。

entries.definition: 導遊；指南；引導；5G 智慧無人搬運自動導引車 (AGV)；引導剪刀精準結合二十個鹼基之單一導航 RNA
explains: This can be a person who shows visitors around a place. They explain what the visitors are looking at. They may also answer questions.
A book can give advice about a place or activity. It may include maps and useful facts. Readers use it to help them decide what to do.
The verb means to lead someone or help them find the way. A teacher may help a student through a hard task. Clear steps make the work easier.

examples.en: The hunter carried a gun.
examples.zh: 獵人帶著一把槍。

examples.en: The police officer put away his gun.
examples.zh: 警察收起了他的槍。

examples.en: Never point a gun at another person.
examples.zh: 絕不要把槍指向別人。

explains: A weapon can send a bullet through the air. A police officer may carry one. People must handle it safely.
This object can be dangerous. A trained person may use it for protection. It can make a loud sound.
A soldier may carry this weapon. It has a handle and a barrel. Safety rules are important.

examples.en: School basketball finals will be played inside the main gymnasium.
examples.zh: 全校籃球決賽將在主體育館內進行。

examples.en: The multi-purpose gymnasium accommodates both volleyball and badminton matches.
examples.zh: 這座多功能體育館可容納排球與羽毛球比賽進行。

examples.en: Rain forced the annual athletic sports meet into the indoor gymnasium.
examples.zh: 降雨迫使年度體育運動大會移師至室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: The school gym is open for basketball practice.
examples.zh: 學校體育館開放進行籃球練習。

examples.en: Many working professionals go to the gym to work out after office hours.
examples.zh: 許多上班族下班後會到健身房健身鍛鍊。

examples.en: The school graduation ceremony took place in the air-conditioned indoor gym.
examples.zh: 學校畢業典禮在附設空調的室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: Students play dodgeball inside the school gym on rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天時學生在學校體育館內玩躲避球。

examples.en: He hits the fitness gym three times a week to lift weights and stay healthy.
examples.zh: 他每週去三次健身房重訓以保持身體健康。

examples.en: The membership fee for this 24-hour gym includes access to the sauna.
examples.zh: 這間二十四小時健身房的會費包含了三溫暖設施的使用權。

examples.en: Many office workers hit the local gym after work to lift weights and destress.
examples.zh: 許多上班族下班後習慣前往社區連鎖健身房重訓流汗、釋放整天的工作壓力。

examples.en: She signed up for an annual gym membership to access the swimming pool and sauna.
examples.zh: 她報名了一年的健身房會員，以便隨時使用游泳池和桑拿設施。

examples.en: The new gym downtown is equipped with top-of-the-line strength machines and free weights.
examples.zh: 市中心新開的健身房配備了最頂級的重量訓練器材和自由重量區。

entries.definition: 體育館；健身房；健身俱樂部
explains: Students play sports in a large indoor room. People lift weights at a health club. The short form is common.
A school may have a room with courts and exercise gear. A person can train there. The short name has one syllable.
This place is used for exercise or sports. It may have basketball hoops. People may go there to get fit.

examples.en: I got a short haircut yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天剪了短髮。

examples.en: She likes her new haircut.
examples.zh: 她喜歡自己的新髮型。

examples.en: His haircut looks neat.
examples.zh: 他的髮型看起來很整齊。

explains: A person goes to a shop to have hair cut. The style may be short or long. A barber or stylist can do it.
Someone may ask for a trim before a party. The hair is shorter afterward. A mirror helps show the result.
This word means the style made by cutting hair. A person may change it each season. A barber can help.

examples.en: The school hall was full of students.
examples.zh: 學校大廳裡擠滿了學生。

examples.en: We met in the town hall.
examples.zh: 我們在市政廳見面。

examples.en: A long hall connects the rooms.
examples.zh: 一條長走廊連接著各個房間。

explains: A large room can be used for meetings. People may enter a school building through it. It may connect other rooms.
A hotel may have a room for parties. A person can walk along a corridor into it. The room may be very large.
This place can be a passage or a large room. A school may hold a concert there. Many doors may open from it.

examples.en: He ordered a beef burger and french fries.
examples.zh: 他點了一份牛肉漢堡和薯條。

examples.en: Homemade hamburgers taste much healthier when made with fresh lean meat.
examples.zh: 用新鮮瘦肉自製的漢堡吃起來健康得多。

examples.en: Our school festival had a popular food stall selling mini hamburgers.
examples.zh: 我們學校園遊會有一個販賣迷你漢堡的人氣攤位。

explains: A round bun holds meat, lettuce, and sauce. People often eat one with fries. A restaurant may sell it.
A cook may grill a meat patty. The food is placed inside bread. It can have cheese and tomato.
