examples.en: Keep your ID cards and cash securely inside your pocket wallet.
examples.zh: 將證件與現金安全放在口袋皮夾裡。

examples.en: I realized with panic that I had left my leather wallet in the taxi.
examples.zh: 我驚慌地意識到自己把真皮皮夾忘在計程車上了。

examples.en: His wallet was stolen by a pickpocket while waiting in the crowded subway station.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的捷運站等車時，他的皮夾被扒手扒走了。

examples.en: Store your credit cards and discount coupons inside a secure mobile digital wallet app.
examples.zh: 將多張信用卡、會員集點卡與電子折價券妥善綁定於高度加密的手機電子支付錢包 App 中。

examples.en: He left his bulky leather wallet at home, knowing he could pay for dinner using his phone.
examples.zh: 他出門時直接將厚重的真皮實體皮夾留在家中，因為只要有一台充飽電的手機便足以搞定一整天吃喝玩樂。

examples.en: Multi-signature crypto wallets require confirmation from two or more private keys before authorizing transfers.
examples.zh: 具備高防護規格的多重簽名加密貨幣錢包，在正式核准任何一筆轉帳前均需經過兩把以上私鑰確認授權。

entries.definition: 皮夾；錢包；電子支付錢包；皮夾錢包 (E-Wallet)
explains: A small folding case holds money, cards, or identification. People keep it in a pocket or bag. It should be closed securely.
A person may use a card from this case to pay at a store. They should protect private numbers. Lost items should be reported to an adult.
Some cases have a clear pocket for a picture. Others have spaces for coins. Keeping it organized makes important things easier to find.

examples.en: The museum displayed letters written by families during the war.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了戰爭期間家庭寫下的信件。

examples.en: The story describes how two friends stayed hopeful during war.
examples.zh: 故事描述兩位朋友如何在戰亂中保持希望。

examples.en: Many people worked for peace after the war ended.
examples.zh: 戰爭結束後，許多人努力促進和平。

explains: A serious fight between countries or large groups can cause great harm. People may lose homes and loved ones. Peaceful solutions are safer.
History books describe conflicts from long ago. Students learn how decisions affected ordinary families. Remembering the past can help people seek peace.
During conflict, helpers bring food and medical care to people in need. Communities can support one another. Everyone deserves safety.

examples.en: Always wash your hands before eating.
examples.zh: 吃東西前務必洗手。

examples.en: Remember to wash your school uniform on the weekend.
examples.zh: 記得週末把你的學校制服洗乾淨。

examples.en: Waves washed gently over the sandy beach as the tide came in.
examples.zh: 隨著潮水上漲，海浪輕柔地拍打著沙灘。

examples.en: Traditional landscape scrolls apply subtle layers of ink wash to evoke mist-shrouded mountain valleys.
examples.zh: 傳統水墨文人畫以多層淡墨渲染水墨暈染技法（Ink Wash），營造出江南山水雲霧繚繞、空靈縹緲的悠遠意境。

examples.en: The watercolorist applied a pale blue wash across the damp paper to depict an overcast winter sky.
examples.zh: 水彩畫家在微濕的水彩紙表面迅速刷過一層清透的天藍水色淡彩渲染，生動捕捉冬日陰鬱灰濛的天空。

examples.en: Strong ocean waves wash over the coastal breakwater every time a typhoon grazes the island.
examples.zh: 每當強颱外圍環流掠過沿海地區，洶湧暴戾的滔天巨浪便狠狠拍打並洗刷著防波堤消波塊。

examples.en: Applying an acrylic shade wash across sculpted muscles flows into recesses, instantly creating dramatic depth.
examples.zh: 在雕刻出的肌肉紋理上刷上一層陰影漬洗液，墨水沉入凹縫中瞬間創造出強烈立體感。

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands with antibacterial soap and warm water before handling fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 在廚房動手處理生鮮蔬果與食材之前，切記務必用抑菌洗手乳與溫水將雙手徹底沖洗洗乾淨。

examples.en: The ocean tide leaves a gentle wash of white foam across the sandy shoreline at sunset.
examples.zh: 傍晚落日餘暉下，拍岸的海水退潮時在金黃平緩的沙灘邊緣留下一道道如蕾絲般細膩溫柔的白色浪花浪沫。

entries.definition: 清洗；洗滌；水墨暈染；淡彩渲染；陰影漬洗墨水 (沉積凹槽陰影)
explains: Water and soap remove dirt from hands, clothes, or dishes. People should clean their hands before eating. Rinsing clears away the bubbles.
A person may clean their body in a shower or bath. Warm water can feel relaxing. A towel helps them dry afterward.
Rain can clean dust from leaves and windows. A gentle stream of water carries dirt away. Some items need careful cleaning by hand.

examples.en: Please do not waste water while brushing your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙時請不要浪費水。

examples.en: The factory sends less waste to the landfill this year.
examples.zh: 這家工廠今年送往垃圾掩埋場的廢棄物更少了。

examples.en: We wasted an hour looking for the missing key.
examples.zh: 我們花了一小時找遺失的鑰匙，白白浪費了時間。

explains: Things that are no longer needed may be thrown away. Food scraps can sometimes become compost. Recycling keeps useful materials in use.
Using more than needed can be wasteful. Turning off lights when leaving saves electricity. Planning meals can prevent extra food from spoiling.
Time or effort can be lost by doing something carelessly. A clear plan helps people use their time well. Small choices can make a difference.

examples.en: A cold slice of watermelon is refreshing on a hot summer day.
examples.zh: 在炎熱夏日來片冰涼西瓜令人透心涼。

examples.en: Fresh watermelon juice is thirst-quenching after outdoor sports.
examples.zh: 運動後喝杯現打西瓜汁非常解渴。

examples.en: Seedless watermelons are especially popular among young children.
examples.zh: 無籽西瓜在小孩子之間特別受歡迎。

explains: This large fruit has green skin and juicy red flesh. Many kinds have black seeds. It tastes refreshing on a hot day.
People cut it into slices for a picnic. A whole fruit can be heavy. Keep the pieces cold before serving.
The plant grows along the ground with long vines. Farmers pick the fruit when it is ripe. Bees help its flowers grow.

examples.en: True wealth encompasses great physical health, loving relationships, and financial peace.
examples.zh: 真正的財富涵蓋了強健的體魄、充滿愛的家庭關係與內心平靜。

examples.en: Taiwan possesses an astonishing wealth of unique alpine biodiversity.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有令人驚嘆且極其珍貴的高山生物多樣性自然資源財富。

examples.en: Philanthropists emphasize that the purposeful redistribution of accumulated wealth uplifts society.
examples.zh: 慈善先驅再三強調，將畢生累積的財富妥善回饋再分配能真正造福社會。

examples.en: True lasting wealth encompasses good health, joyful relationships, and financial peace.
examples.zh: 真正長久的人生財富不僅止於銀行存摺數字，更包含了強健的體魄、和睦的人際與內心的平靜。

examples.en: The ancient island nation possessed immense agricultural wealth and mineral deposits.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古老島國境內擁有無比豐饒的農業穀倉資源與儲量龐大的珍貴地下礦產。

examples.en: The senior mentor shared a wealth of practical experience with the rookie programmers.
examples.zh: 資深技術總監毫無保留地將自己數十年來積累的豐富實戰開發除錯經驗，傳授給新進工程師。

explains: Having a lot of money or valuable property is one kind of being rich. People may use it to buy homes. They may also help others.
A person can also know many useful things. Reading and asking questions help them learn. Sharing what they know can benefit friends.
Riches do not always make people happy. Kind relationships and good health matter too. Everyone can find joy in different ways.

examples.en: The wedding will take place in the garden next Saturday.
examples.zh: 婚禮將於下星期六在花園舉行。

examples.en: We bought a small gift for the wedding couple.
examples.zh: 我們為新人買了一份小禮物。

examples.en: My cousin's wedding had music, flowers, and a big cake.
examples.zh: 我表親的婚禮有音樂、花朵和一個大蛋糕。

explains: A ceremony celebrates two people getting married. Friends and family may attend. The couple can exchange promises in front of them.
People often wear special clothes and share a meal afterward. Flowers and music can make the day festive. Guests may bring a gift.
Plans include choosing a place and sending invitations. Everyone should know the time. A careful schedule helps the event run smoothly.

examples.en: I practice piano every weekday after school.
examples.zh: 我每個平日放學後都練習鋼琴。

examples.en: The library opens later on weekends than on weekdays.
examples.zh: 圖書館在平日比週末晚一點開門。

examples.en: Dad takes the bus to work on each weekday.
examples.zh: 爸爸每個平日都搭公車上班。

explains: A day from Monday through Friday is part of the usual work or school week. Many people follow a regular schedule then. Many people follow a regular schedule then.
Some shops open early on these days. Children may have classes. Families often plan busy tasks around their routines.
The weekend is different for many workers. They may rest or visit friends. A calendar shows which day comes next.

examples.en: Please weigh the apples before putting them in the bag.
examples.zh: 請先秤蘋果的重量，再把它們放進袋子裡。

examples.en: The suitcase weighed too much for the small shelf.
examples.zh: 這個行李箱太重，放在小架子上不太安全。

examples.en: Mia weighed both choices before choosing a school club.
examples.zh: 米亞仔細衡量兩個選擇後，才決定參加哪個學校社團。

explains: A scale shows how heavy or light something is. A person can place a bag on it. The number appears on the display.
A cook may measure flour before baking. The right amount helps the recipe turn out well. A kitchen scale can be useful.
People may think carefully about choices before deciding. They consider good and bad points. Taking time can lead to a better plan.

examples.en: The weight of the pumpkin surprised everyone at the fair.
examples.zh: 南瓜的重量讓園遊會上的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Please check the weight printed on the package.
examples.zh: 請查看包裝上印的重量。

examples.en: This backpack's weight feels lighter after we remove the books.
examples.zh: 拿掉書本後，這個背包感覺輕了一些。

explains: This tells how heavy something is. A scale can measure it. A feather has less of it than a brick.
People may lift objects during exercise. A light object is easier to raise. Proper form helps prevent injuries.
The amount can affect how well a bridge or shelf holds something. Builders choose strong materials. They check the design carefully.

examples.en: The western sky turned orange as the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽下山時，西邊的天空變成橘色。

examples.en: We visited a western town known for its old railway.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座以舊鐵路聞名的西部城鎮。

examples.en: A western wind brought cool air to the farm.
examples.zh: 一陣西風為農場帶來涼爽的空氣。

explains: A place lies toward the direction where the sun sets. Maps often show west on the left. Travelers use a compass to find it.
This adjective can describe stories, music, or customs from countries in the West. Different regions have their own history and traditions. Their customs can be different from place to place.
People may call the left side of a map the west side. A town can be in the part facing the sunset of a country. Signs help visitors.

examples.en: A whale surfaced near the boat and sprayed water from its blowhole.
examples.zh: 一頭鯨魚在船附近浮出水面，從噴氣孔噴出水柱。

examples.en: The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth.
examples.zh: 藍鯨是地球上體型最大的動物。

examples.en: We saw a whale's tail disappear beneath the waves.
examples.zh: 我們看見鯨魚的尾巴消失在浪花下。

explains: This huge sea mammal breathes air through a blowhole. It comes to the ocean surface. Some kinds sing to one another.
A large body helps it swim through deep water. Its tail moves up and down. Many kinds eat tiny sea animals.
People should watch these animals from a safe distance. Boats must follow local rules. Protecting ocean life helps the whole environment.

examples.en: Whatever challenge you face, remember to do your best.
examples.zh: 無論面臨什麼挑戰，請記得全力以赴。

examples.en: You can order whatever drink you want from the tea shop menu; it’s my treat today!
examples.zh: 這家手搖茶飲菜單上的任何品項你儘管隨便點，今天這頓全由我來買單請客！

examples.en: Whatever happens during tomorrow's championship finals, be proud of your hard work.
examples.zh: 明天的總冠軍決賽無論最終勝負結果如何，都請為自己長久以來的刻苦付出感到驕傲。

explains: This word can refer to any thing or choice in a group. A child may pick any color they like. The choice is open.
It can introduce something that happens no matter what else is true. Friends can stay kind in every situation. Their care does not change.
People sometimes use it to show they do not care about a choice. A polite reply sounds kinder. Clear words help avoid hurt feelings.

examples.en: A bicycle has two wheels, while a car has four.
examples.zh: 腳踏車有兩個車輪，而汽車有四個。

examples.en: The front wheel of the cart squeaked loudly as it turned.
examples.zh: 手推車的前輪在轉彎時發出刺耳的吱吱聲。

examples.en: He took the wheel and drove us through the heavy thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 他握住方向盤，載著我們穿過了猛烈的雷陣雨。

explains: A round part turns around an axle and helps a vehicle move. Bicycles and cars have several. A tire covers its outer edge.
People guide a bicycle by holding its front handle. Turning it changes direction. A firm grip helps riders stay balanced.
A round spinning part can help move a cart or machine. It reduces effort. Early inventions made carrying heavy loads easier.

examples.en: Feel free to reach out whenever you encounter English questions.
examples.zh: 每當遇到英文疑問時，隨時歡迎向我請教。

examples.en: Whenever I smell fresh roasted coffee beans, I think of peaceful weekend mornings.
examples.zh: 每當我聞到空氣中飄散的現磨烘焙咖啡香氣時，總會不自覺聯想到恬靜的週末晨光。

examples.en: You are warmly welcome to visit our cozy community bakery whenever you are in town.
examples.zh: 無論何時只要你來到我們小鎮，我們都無比竭誠歡迎你造訪這間溫馨的社區麵包坊。

explains: This connecting word means at any time that something happens. A child can call home if plans change. The family will answer when possible.
It can show repeated events. The dog barks each time the doorbell rings. Visitors know it has noticed them.
A person may act at the moment a condition is true. Wash hands each time they become dirty. Clean hands help prevent germs from spreading.

examples.en: You can easily find convenience stores wherever you go in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣無論走到哪裡，都能輕易找到便利商店。

examples.en: True friends will stand by you and support you wherever life's journey takes you.
examples.zh: 無論人生旅途的風雨將你帶往何方，真正的摯友永遠都會堅定站在身旁支持著你。

examples.en: Keep your portable passport and wallet secure wherever you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 前往海外各地自助旅行時，無論置身何處，務必隨時妥善保管好護照證件與隨身皮夾。

explains: This word means in any place that a person or thing may be. A bird carries a seed to a new spot. Plants can grow there.
It can connect an action with every place it happens. A helper may offer kindness in any town. Small acts can make people feel welcome.
The word can introduce a place without naming it. Children can sit in any safe seat. They should leave the path clear.

examples.en: She whispered the answer softly into my ear.
examples.zh: 她輕聲在我耳邊低語告訴我答案。

examples.en: The students whispered quietly in the back row during the quiet study hour.
examples.zh: 自習課時學生們在後排輕聲低語說著悄悄話。

examples.en: The pine trees seemed to whisper in the gentle autumn evening breeze.
examples.zh: 松樹彷彿在秋日傍晚的徐徐微風中輕聲絮語。

explains: A person speaks very quietly so nearby listeners can hear. Someone may do this in a library. Quiet voices help others read.
A soft voice can share a secret or gentle message. The listener moves closer. Both people should respect privacy.
Air can make a faint sound through leaves. People may describe that sound with this word. It is much quieter than a shout.

examples.en: Whoever finishes the reading first can start writing the reflection.
examples.zh: 無論是誰先讀完文章，都可以先開始撰寫心得。

examples.en: Whoever left their umbrella in the conference room can retrieve it at the front desk.
examples.zh: 無論是誰把深藍色折疊雨傘遺留在會議室裡，都可隨時前往一樓總服務台認領。

examples.en: The generous scholarship is open to whoever demonstrates academic excellence and leadership.
examples.zh: 這筆優厚的全額獎學金，向所有展現卓越學術研究潛力與領袖特質的學子全面開放。

explains: This pronoun means any person who does a certain thing. Any child who finishes first can choose a book. Everyone gets a turn.
It can refer to an unknown person. Someone may have left a lunch bag. The owner can ask the class about it.
A sentence can use it for a person no matter which one. Any helper who is free can carry a box. The job gets done sooner.

examples.en: The whole family came to watch the school play.
examples.zh: 全家人都來看學校演出。

examples.en: I read the whole story before choosing a favorite character.
examples.zh: 我讀完整個故事後才選出最喜歡的角色。

examples.en: She saved the whole apple for her little brother.
examples.zh: 她把整顆蘋果留給弟弟。

explains: All of something is included, with no part missing. A child may eat an entire apple. The core and seeds are usually left.
An object can be complete and unbroken. A puzzle has every piece. The picture is ready to display.
A group can be considered together as one. The class worked on a garden. Each student helped the larger team.

examples.en: Whom did you invite to the picnic?
examples.zh: 你邀請了誰去野餐？

examples.en: To whom should I give this blue folder?
examples.zh: 我應該把這個藍色資料夾交給誰？

examples.en: The student whom we met at the library is in my class.
examples.zh: 我們在圖書館遇見的那位學生和我同班。

explains: This formal pronoun refers to a person receiving an action. A teacher asks which child the note is for. The answer names that person.
Writers sometimes use it after a preposition. A letter can be addressed to a friend. The sentence sounds more formal than everyday speech.
Many speakers choose a simpler form in conversation. Careful writing may follow grammar rules more closely. Reading examples helps learners understand its use.

examples.en: The width of the doorway is enough for the large box.
examples.zh: 門口的寬度足以讓大箱子通過。

examples.en: We measured the width of the garden path with a tape.
examples.zh: 我們用捲尺量了花園小徑的寬度。

examples.en: The river's width changed after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，河面的寬度改變了。

explains: The distance from one side to the other is measured this way. A ruler can check a desk. A tape measure works for larger objects.
A road can be narrow or broad from edge to edge. Drivers stay inside the marked lanes. The size affects how many cars fit.
A piece of cloth has a measurement across it. Tailors check before cutting. Careful measuring helps clothing fit well.

examples.en: We saw a wild fox near the edge of the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林邊緣看到一隻野生狐狸。

examples.en: Wild flowers grew beside the narrow country road.
examples.zh: 野花長在狹窄鄉間道路旁。

examples.en: The crowd went wild when the home team scored.
examples.zh: 主隊得分時，觀眾興奮地歡呼起來。

explains: An animal lives freely in nature rather than as a pet. Deer may run through a forest. They find food on their own.
Plants can grow without people planting or caring for them. Flowers bloom beside a country road. Bees visit them for nectar.
The word can describe a very excited or uncontrolled feeling. Fans cheer loudly at a game. People should still respect others nearby.

examples.en: Nina is willing to share her markers with the group.
examples.zh: 妮娜願意和大家分享她的彩色筆。

examples.en: The coach was willing to explain the rules again.
examples.zh: 教練願意再解釋一次規則。

examples.en: Are you willing to try a new vegetable tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚願意試試一種新的蔬菜嗎？

explains: A person agrees and is ready to do something. A child may help set the table. They start without being forced.
Someone may be open to trying a new activity. A friend offers a puzzle. The other person gives it a try.
People can offer help because they choose to. A neighbor carries groceries upstairs. Kind choices build friendship.

examples.en: Hsinchu is known as the windy city.
examples.zh: 新竹被稱為風城。

examples.en: It is too windy today to go sailing on the lake.
examples.zh: 今天風太大了，不適合在湖面上泛舟。

examples.en: The windy weather made flying a kite easy and fun.
examples.zh: 起風的天氣讓放風箏變得輕鬆又有趣。

explains: Strong moving air blows outside. Trees bend and leaves fly along the street. A jacket can keep someone warm.
A day with much moving air may be hard for flying a kite. The string pulls strongly. Hold it safely with an adult nearby.
Weather reports describe how much air is moving. Secure light objects in the yard. They could blow away.

examples.en: The adults served red wine with dinner.
examples.zh: 大人們晚餐時搭配紅酒。

examples.en: The sauce contains a little wine for flavor.
examples.zh: 醬汁裡加了一點葡萄酒提味。

examples.en: A bottle of white wine stood on the table at the celebration.
examples.zh: 慶祝活動的桌上放著一瓶白葡萄酒。

explains: An adult drink is made from fermented grapes. It can be red, white, or another shade. Children should not drink alcoholic beverages.
People may serve it at a meal for grown-ups. Bottles are kept sealed. Local rules set an age for buying it.
Some cooking recipes use a small amount for flavor. Heat changes the dish as it cooks. Ask an adult before handling it.

examples.en: The bird hurt its wing and could not fly far.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥傷了翅膀，飛不了多遠。

examples.en: A small plane lifted its left wing above the trees.
examples.zh: 一架小飛機的左機翼升過了樹梢。

examples.en: The children's wing of the hospital has bright wall pictures.
examples.zh: 醫院的兒童區有色彩鮮豔的牆面圖畫。

explains: A bird uses this body part to fly and keep balance. Feathers cover it. Moving it up and down pushes air.
An airplane has a part with the same name on each side. These parts help lift it into the sky. Pilots check them carefully.
A building may have a side section extending from the main part. A hospital can have one area for children. Signs guide visitors.

examples.en: The lamp stopped working because a wire came loose.
examples.zh: 電線鬆脫，所以燈不亮了。

examples.en: She shaped the soft wire into a small star.
examples.zh: 她把柔軟的金屬線彎成一顆小星星。

examples.en: A strong wire holds the garden gate closed.
examples.zh: 一條堅固的金屬線把花園門固定關好。

explains: A thin length of metal carries electricity or connects objects. It may be covered with plastic. Never touch a loose one.
A piece of metal can be twisted into a shape. Artists make small decorations from it. Pliers help bend it safely.
Some fences use several strands to mark a boundary. Gates let people enter. Adults should handle sharp ends carefully.

examples.en: You can reach the night market within a ten-minute walk.
examples.zh: 步行十分鐘之內即可抵達夜市。

examples.en: All submitted homework assignments must be turned in within the designated deadline.
examples.zh: 所有課堂作業與期末專案報告，皆必須嚴格在規定的繳交截止期限之內繳齊。

examples.en: Peaceful happiness comes from cultivating inner contentment within your own mind.
examples.zh: 真正的內心寧靜與平靜喜樂，來自於在自己的心靈深處耕耘知足與感恩。

explains: This preposition means inside a place or limit. A child must stay inside the playground fence. The teacher can see everyone.
A time limit can show how soon something should happen. Finish the page in ten minutes. The timer helps keep track.
It can describe something inside a group. A team has different skills among its players. Each person contributes something helpful.

examples.en: A gray wolf crossed the snowy trail at dawn.
examples.zh: 一頭灰狼在黎明時穿過積雪的小徑。

examples.en: The wolf's thick fur helps it stay warm in winter.
examples.zh: 狼厚厚的毛皮能幫助牠在冬天保暖。

examples.en: We read a story about a wolf who guarded the forest.
examples.zh: 我們讀了一則關於守護森林的狼的故事。

explains: This wild animal looks a little like a large dog. It lives in a group called a pack. It hunts other animals for food.
These animals communicate with sounds and body movements. Their thick fur keeps them warm. People should watch from far away.
A story may portray this animal as scary or clever. Real animals need wild places to live. They help keep nature balanced.

examples.en: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我想知道明天的天氣會是如何。

examples.en: Taroko Gorge is recognized as a magnificent natural wonder of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷被公認為台灣壯麗絕倫的大自然奇蹟。

examples.en: It is no wonder she won the speech championship; she practiced diligently every day.
examples.zh: 難怪她會奪得演講冠軍，她每天都無比勤勉地練習。

examples.en: Gazing through giant observatories fills human hearts with overwhelming awe, humility, and poetic wonder.
examples.zh: 透過巨型天文台望遠鏡仰望無垠銀河，讓每個人心中油然而生無比的敬畏、謙遜與由衷的讚嘆驚奇。

examples.en: The ancient pyramids of Giza have stood as an architectural wonder of the world for millennia.
examples.zh: 巍然屹立於埃及沙漠邊緣的吉薩大金字塔，歷經數千年歲月洗禮依然是世界公認的建築奇蹟。

examples.en: Children look at falling snow with wide-eyed wonder, rushing outside to build their first snowmen.
examples.zh: 小朋友們睜大好奇純真的雙眼驚喜地望著漫天飛舞的初雪，迫不及待地衝到院子裡堆起可愛的雪人。

examples.en: Gazing at high-resolution deep field images of baby galaxies fills the human soul with boundless wonder.
examples.zh: 當凝視著深空望遠鏡拍下百億光年外的原始星系深空影像時，人類的心靈深處被無窮無盡的驚嘆與敬畏所包圍。

examples.en: Childhood wonder about twinkling night stars inspired her to dedicate her life to astrophysics.
examples.zh: 童年仰望夜空中璀璨繁星所萌生的純真驚嘆與好奇，激勵了她毅然將畢生精力奉獻給天體物理學研究。

examples.en: Standing under a pitch-black desert sky admiring the glowing Milky Way evokes deep, timeless wonder.
examples.zh: 佇立在萬籟俱寂的高山荒漠夜空下凝望波瀾壯闊的銀河光帶，心中湧現出跨越古今、歷久彌新的崇高驚嘆。

examples.en: Gazing upward at schools of shimmering silver sardines fills every visitor's heart with childlike wonder.
examples.zh: 仰望漫天盤旋、閃爍銀色粼粼波光的沙丁魚風暴，每個人的心中都充滿了最純真的「驚嘆與敬畏」（Wonder）。

examples.en: We can only wonder what deep space secrets the next generation of space observatories will uncover.
examples.zh: 我們由衷好奇與遐想，人類下一代更為先進的深空天文望遠鏡將會揭開哪些深藏宇宙的終極奧秘。

examples.en: Traveling through remote snow-covered peaks revived his dormant sense of poetic wonder.
examples.zh: 隻身徒步穿越白雪皚皚的偏遠高山峻嶺，重新喚醒了他內心深處長年被塵封的詩意驚嘆與感動。

examples.en: Gazing at ancient craters floating against the black void evokes overwhelming wonder and humility.
examples.zh: 凝望著古老隕石坑靜靜懸浮在深邃漆黑的虛空之中，令人心靈油然生起對造化的「無盡驚奇」（Wonder）。

examples.en: The young child stared wide-eyed with pure wonder as a magnificent monarch butterfly emerged from its cocoon.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子瞪大清澈的雙眼，滿懷純真的無盡驚奇，屏息凝視著一隻金黃華麗的帝王斑蝶破繭化蝶展翅飛舞。

examples.en: Exploring the ancient stone temples hidden deep within the jungle filled travelers with awe and wonder.
examples.zh: 深入原始熱帶雨林深處，親眼瞻仰掩映在藤蔓苔蘚間的古老千仞石造神廟建築，旅人的心靈被滿滿的震撼與驚嘆填滿。

entries.definition: 想知道；感到驚奇；奇蹟；仰望浩瀚夜空星辰之無比讚嘆驚奇；凝望深空千億星系由衷生起之無窮驚嘆；仰望漫天游魚由衷生起之純真驚嘆與震撼；凝望懸浮在漆黑宇宙中原始小行星之浩瀚驚奇；驚奇
explains: A person may feel curious and ask a question in their mind. A child looks at the stars. They want to know how far away they are.
Something amazing can fill people with surprise. A rainbow appears after rain. Everyone stops to look at its colors.
A small object that seems special may be called a marvel. A handmade toy can delight a child. Careful work makes it unique.

examples.en: The table is made of wood from a local tree.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用當地樹木的木材製成的。

examples.en: We walked through the woods and listened to birds.
examples.zh: 我們穿過樹林，聆聽鳥鳴。

examples.en: A table made of wood can last for many years with care.
examples.zh: 細心保養的木桌可以使用很多年。

explains: Hard material from a tree trunk is used to make furniture or paper. A carpenter can cut it into boards. Different kinds have different colors.
A group of trees growing close together can form a small forest. Birds build nests there. People walk along marked paths.
The material needs protection from rain and insects. Paint or varnish can help. Builders choose the right kind for each job.

examples.en: We built a wooden birdhouse for the garden.
examples.zh: 我們為花園做了一個木製鳥屋。

examples.en: The old wooden bridge creaked when we crossed it.
examples.zh: 我們走過那座老木橋時，它發出吱呀聲。

examples.en: The puppet moved in a wooden way until Mia loosened its strings.
examples.zh: 木偶一開始動作僵硬，直到米亞放鬆了牽線。

explains: Something made from a tree's hard material can be strong and useful. A chair or table may have this construction. It needs care to last.
A toy figure carved by hand can be made this way. Paint adds bright colors. Children should play gently to avoid breaking it.
A person may seem stiff and unnatural in movement. Practicing can help them relax. Friendly encouragement makes it easier.

examples.en: A thick wool sweater keeps you warm during chilly winter days.
examples.zh: 厚實的羊毛毛衣能在寒冷冬日為你保暖。

examples.en: Australian merino wool is famous for its exceptional softness.
examples.zh: 澳洲美麗諾羊毛以出眾極致的柔軟觸感聞名。

examples.en: Hand wash wool garments in cool water to prevent shrinking.
examples.zh: 用冷水手洗毛料衣物以防止縮水變形。

examples.en: Ultra-fine Merino wool thermals provide lightweight, odor-resistant mountain warmth.
examples.zh: 超細極致柔軟的美麗諾羊毛（Merino Wool）排汗保暖底衫能為高山百岳登山提供無負擔溫暖。

examples.en: Natural wool retains body heat effectively even when damp from mountain mist.
examples.zh: 天然羊毛即使在被高山晨霧浸濕的情況下，依然能發揮卓越的鎖溫保暖效果。

examples.en: He wrapped up in a heavy wool overcoat before heading out into the winter blizzard.
examples.zh: 在踏入冬日風雪之前，他裹緊了身上厚實保暖的羊毛長版大衣。

entries.definition: 羊毛；毛料的；美麗諾羊毛 (Merino)
explains: Soft curly hair from sheep is spun into yarn or fabric. Warm hats and sweaters can be made from it. Some people wear it in cold weather.
The fibers can hold warmth well. A blanket made from them feels cozy. Follow the washing label to prevent shrinking.
Other animals also grow similar soft coats. People clean and spin the fibers. The finished cloth may have different textures.

examples.en: Complete exercise A and B in your workbook.
examples.zh: 完成習作本上的練習題 A 和 B。

examples.en: Our math teacher checks our workbook homework every morning.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師每天早晨都會批改習作本作業。

examples.en: Practicing exercises in the grammar workbook boosts test scores.
examples.zh: 在文法習作本上多做練習能有效提升考試成績。

explains: A school book contains exercises for learners to complete. They write answers in it. Teachers may use it during lessons.
Pages can have puzzles, questions, or spaces for drawing. Finishing one page gives practice. Checking answers helps students learn.
A clean book is easier to use later. Write your name inside the cover. Keep it in a backpack between classes.

examples.en: A worm appeared on the path after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後，一條蚯蚓出現在小徑上。

examples.en: The robin found a worm in the soft garden soil.
examples.zh: 知更鳥在鬆軟的花園土裡找到一條蚯蚓。

examples.en: We watched a caterpillar worm its way between the leaves.
examples.zh: 我們看著毛毛蟲在葉片間慢慢鑽行。

explains: A small soft animal has a long body and no legs. It lives in soil or wet places. Birds may eat it.
Gardeners turn the earth and find these animals. They help break down dead leaves. That can make the soil healthier.
The verb can mean making one's way forward slowly. A person may move through a crowded room. They should be polite and careful.

examples.en: The second puzzle was worse than the first one for me.
examples.zh: 對我來說，第二個謎題比第一個更難。

examples.en: The weather grew worse before the game began.
examples.zh: 比賽開始前，天氣變得更糟。

examples.en: My cough felt worse, so Mom called the doctor.
examples.zh: 我的咳嗽加重了，所以媽媽打電話給醫生。

explains: One thing is not as good as another, or a problem has become more serious. A small cut may hurt more later. Tell an adult if it does.
A person can compare two choices and find one less helpful. This route takes more time. The shorter path is easier.
Health can change, so people should ask for help when they feel unwell. Rest may be needed. A grown-up can decide what to do.

examples.en: That was the worst storm our town had seen in years.
examples.zh: 那是我們鎮多年來遇到最嚴重的一場暴風雨。

examples.en: The worst part of the hike was the steep muddy hill.
examples.zh: 健行中最辛苦的部分是那段陡峭泥濘的山坡。

examples.en: I picked the worst seat because I could not see the screen.
examples.zh: 我選到最差的位置，因為看不見螢幕。

explains: This describes the least good choice or most difficult part in a group. A storm can bring its strongest rain at one time. People stay indoors.
A person may call a very unpleasant experience the hardest one. Friends can listen and offer comfort. Difficult days eventually pass.
When comparing several options, one may be less helpful than all the rest. Looking at each choice carefully can help. Good advice can guide a fair choice.

examples.en: This old comic book is worth twenty dollars.
examples.zh: 這本舊漫畫值二十美元。

examples.en: The long walk was worth it because we saw a waterfall.
examples.zh: 這趟長途步行很值得，因為我們看到了瀑布。

examples.en: The museum visit is worth the price of admission.
examples.zh: 這趟博物館參觀值得門票的價格。

explains: An object can have a certain value or price. A rare book may cost a lot. A seller can explain its condition.
An action may be useful or bring a good result. Practicing a new song takes time. The effort can make the music sound lovely.
People may decide something deserves the time or money it takes. A family compares choices. They choose what matters most to them.

examples.en: The nurse covered the small wound with a clean bandage.
examples.zh: 護理師用乾淨的繃帶包住小傷口。

examples.en: A thorn left a wound on the gardener's hand.
examples.zh: 荊棘在園丁的手上留下了一道傷口。

examples.en: The kitten's wound began to heal after the vet cleaned it.
examples.zh: 獸醫清理小貓的傷口後，傷處開始癒合。

explains: A cut or other injury can happen when skin or body tissue is damaged. A clean bandage may cover it. Tell an adult if it hurts.
A verb can mean causing harm with a sharp object or weapon. Such actions are dangerous. People should seek help and keep away from weapons.
Some injuries need care from a health worker. Keep the area clean. Follow a trusted adult's advice.

examples.en: Grandma baked a yam with a little cinnamon.
examples.zh: 奶奶烤了一條山藥，並加了少許肉桂。

examples.en: We bought fresh yams at the farmers' market.
examples.zh: 我們在農夫市集買了新鮮的山藥。

examples.en: He mashed the yam until it was soft and smooth.
examples.zh: 他把山藥搗成柔軟滑順的泥。

explains: This starchy root vegetable grows underground. People cook it before eating. It can be baked, boiled, or mashed.
The outside skin may be brown or rough. Inside, the flesh can have different colors. Farmers grow many kinds in warm places.
A cooked piece can be served with dinner. It provides energy. Wash it before preparing the meal.

examples.en: The youth hostel in Hualien is clean, safe, and cheap.
examples.zh: 花蓮這家青年旅館乾淨、安全又便宜。

examples.en: In his youth, my grandfather was an energetic track athlete.
examples.zh: 我的祖父在年輕時代是一位精力充沛的田徑運動員。

examples.en: Civic volunteer programs empower the youth to make meaningful social impacts.
examples.zh: 民間志工計畫賦能青年，使他們為社會帶來實質的正面影響。

explains: The time when someone is young is part of their life. People learn many new things during those years. Friends and family can offer guidance.
Young people in a town may join clubs or play sports. They bring energy and ideas. Adults can listen to their views.
A person may keep a youthful spirit as they grow older. Curiosity helps people continue learning. Kindness matters at every age.

examples.en: A zebra walked across the grassy plain with its group.
examples.zh: 一頭斑馬和同伴一起走過草原。

examples.en: The zebra's stripes help it stand out in the herd.
examples.zh: 斑馬的條紋讓牠在獸群中特別醒目。

examples.en: We saw a young zebra beside its mother at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻小斑馬待在媽媽身旁。

explains: This African animal has black and white stripes. It looks a little like a horse. It eats grass on open plains.
Each animal has a stripe pattern that is different. A group may stay together for safety. They watch for danger nearby.
People can see this animal in a wildlife park. Caretakers provide food and space. Visitors should follow the park's rules.

examples.en: The captain welcomed everyone aboard the boat.
examples.zh: 船長歡迎大家登船。

examples.en: We climbed aboard the train just before the doors closed.
examples.zh: 車門關上前，我們及時上了火車。

examples.en: All passengers are aboard, so the plane can depart.
examples.zh: 所有乘客都已登機，因此飛機可以起飛了。

explains: Being on a ship, train, or plane can be described with this word. Passengers find their seats. The vehicle then begins its trip.
A person may welcome guests onto a boat. Crew members check that everyone is safe. They follow instructions before moving.
The word often appears in travel announcements. Staff may ask people to get on before a certain time. Listen for clear directions.

examples.en: A handwritten note is acceptable for this homework task.
examples.zh: 這項作業可以接受手寫答案。

examples.en: The library says a quiet voice is acceptable in the reading room.
examples.zh: 圖書館表示在閱覽室裡輕聲說話是可以的。

examples.en: These shoes are acceptable for the school uniform.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋符合學校制服的規定。

explains: Something meets the rules or is good enough for a purpose. A clean shirt is suitable for school. The teacher explains the dress code.
A choice may be allowed even if it is not perfect. A simple answer can still meet the task. Careful work is always helpful.
People can agree on what is fair. A clear rule helps everyone know what to expect. Different places may have different standards.

examples.en: The clock gives an accurate time after we reset it.
examples.zh: 我們重新設定後，時鐘顯示的時間很準確。

examples.en: Please make an accurate drawing of the classroom map.
examples.zh: 請畫一張準確的教室地圖。

examples.en: The weather report was accurate about the afternoon rain.
examples.zh: 天氣預報準確預測了下午會下雨。

explains: Information or a measurement is correct and has very few mistakes. A careful map shows where roads are. Travelers can follow it.
A student checks each answer before turning in a test. Careful work helps the result match the facts. Rushing can cause errors.
Tools need proper settings to give good measurements. A ruler should begin at zero. Check it before measuring an object.

examples.en: My legs ache after the long hike up the hill.
examples.zh: 爬完那座山的長途健行後，我的腿很痠痛。

examples.en: She had a dull ache in her shoulder after carrying the box.
examples.zh: 搬完箱子後，她的肩膀隱隱作痛。

examples.en: His tooth began to ache while he ate the cold ice cream.
examples.zh: 他吃冰淇淋時，牙齒開始疼痛。

explains: A steady pain may stay in one part of the body. A sore tooth can make chewing hard. Tell an adult if it continues.
Muscles may hurt after a long walk or exercise. Rest can help them feel better. Gentle movement may also be useful.
The verb describes feeling this kind of pain. A person's head may hurt after a noisy day. Drinking water and resting can help.

examples.en: Mastering seven thousand carefully curated words is an extraordinary academic and personal achievement.
examples.zh: 完整精熟這七千個精心挑選的實用單字，是一項無比非凡、值得銘記一生的「卓越個人成就」（Achievement）。

examples.en: Winning the prestigious international design award was the crowning achievement of her creative career.
examples.zh: 斬獲享有盛譽的國際頂尖設計大獎，成為她長年創意設計生涯中最璀璨奪目的巔峰榮耀成就。

examples.en: Setting incremental micro-goals creates a continuous sense of accomplishment and genuine achievement.
examples.zh: 為自己設定按部就班的微型階段目標，能在前行路上持續收穫踏實的成就感與由衷的自信。

entries.definition: 完成 7,000 字全套挑戰之耀眼卓越學習成就；成就
explains: A person reaches a goal after effort and practice. Learning to play a song takes time. Each try helps build ability.
Completing a difficult task can make someone proud. A student may finish a science project. Family members can celebrate together.
Goals can be small or large. Reading every day is one helpful aim. Steady work brings progress.

examples.en: We need additional chairs for the visitors.
examples.zh: 我們還需要幾張椅子給訪客。

examples.en: The book has additional pictures at the end.
examples.zh: 這本書最後還有額外的圖片。

examples.en: Please bring an additional towel for the swimming lesson.
examples.zh: 游泳課請多帶一條毛巾。

explains: More of something can be added to what is already there. A student may need another sheet of paper. The teacher brings some.
Extra information can help explain a topic. A map key shows what symbols mean. Readers can understand the picture better.
A person may ask for another serving after dinner. There should be enough food for everyone. Sharing is thoughtful.

examples.en: I admire my sister because she helps younger students.
examples.zh: 我敬佩姊姊，因為她會幫助年紀較小的學生。

examples.en: We stopped to admire the bright flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們停下來欣賞花園裡鮮豔的花朵。

examples.en: The coach admired the team's effort during practice.
examples.zh: 教練欣賞球隊在練習時付出的努力。

explains: A person can feel respect for someone else's actions or qualities. A child may look up to a helpful teacher. They learn from that example.
People may enjoy looking at something beautiful. They stand quietly before a painting. Colors and shapes catch their eyes.
A friend can praise another person's hard work. Kind words show appreciation. Everyone likes to know their effort matters.

examples.en: The advanced reading group finished a longer story.
examples.zh: 進階閱讀小組讀完了一篇較長的故事。

examples.en: Her advanced drawing skills let her paint tiny details.
examples.zh: 她高超的繪畫技巧讓她能畫出細小的細節。

examples.en: The hikers advanced slowly through the thick forest.
examples.zh: 健行者緩慢地前進，穿過茂密的森林。

explains: A class or skill may be for people who already know the basics. Students solve harder problems. They build on earlier learning.
A device can be more developed than an older model. It may do extra tasks. Users read instructions before trying new features.
The word can also mean moved forward. A line of hikers went farther along the trail. They stopped when it became dark.

examples.en: Researchers chase practical quantum advantage by simulating industrial battery electrolytes accurately.
examples.zh: 頂尖研究團隊全力追尋實用商業量子優勢，精準模擬下一代固態鋰電池電解液。

examples.en: Demonstrating quantum advantage requires solving a economically significant challenge faster and cheaper.
examples.zh: 驗證實用量子優勢的先決條件，在於必須比傳統超級電腦更快、更廉價地解決具備龐大經濟價值的難題。

examples.en: Automotive giants partner with quantum startups to discover lightweight structural composites with quantum advantage.
examples.zh: 全球汽車製造巨擘紛紛攜手前沿量子新創公司，企圖藉由量子優勢算力開發超輕量航太複合材料。

entries.definition: 實用商業量子算力優勢 (化學材料開發)
explains: Something helpful gives a person a better chance to do well. A clear map helps travelers find the station. Preparation can make a task easier.
A team may have a strength that helps it compete. Fast runners can move quickly. Each player contributes a different ability.
A good result can come from planning ahead. Packing water before a hike keeps people prepared. Small choices can help.

examples.en: Learning English is a thrilling adventure that rewards your courage with boundless opportunities.
examples.zh: 學習英語是一場充滿驚喜的「壯麗人生冒險」（Adventure），它用無窮無盡的嶄新機遇回饋你的無畏勇氣。

examples.en: Backpacking across South America without a strict schedule was the greatest adventure of his youth.
examples.zh: 年輕時背起背包在沒有固定行程的情況下橫跨南美洲，是他青春歲月中最波瀾壯闊的冒險旅程。

examples.en: Every new book you open invites you to adventure through unexplored realms of human imagination.
examples.zh: 每當你翻開一本好書，就如同展開了一場穿梭於人類無窮想像力世界的全新奇幻冒險。

entries.definition: 踏上這場收穫滿滿、充滿驚喜之語言冒險旅程；冒險
explains: An exciting experience may include new places or challenges. A family can hike through a forest. They discover things along the path.
Stories often follow a character who travels and solves problems. Readers wonder what will happen. Each page brings a new event.
People should prepare for outdoor activities. Bring water and tell someone where you are going. Safety makes the outing more enjoyable.

examples.en: Companies advertise their newest gadgets on YouTube and Instagram.
examples.zh: 各家公司在 YouTube 與 Instagram 上為最新科技新品打廣告。

examples.en: The bakery will advertise its grand opening discount in the local paper.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊將在地方報刊與社群上限時刊登盛大開幕特惠折扣廣告。

examples.en: Organic food brands frequently advertise their farm-to-table natural ingredients.
examples.zh: 有機天然食品品牌經常大力宣傳其產地直送、無添加的新鮮食材特色。

examples.en: An eye-catching digital advertisement displayed on the building screen.
examples.zh: 大樓外牆巨型螢幕上播放著引人注目的數位廣告。

examples.en: Skipping YouTube video advertisements is a premium membership feature.
examples.zh: 免等待直接略過 YouTube 影片片頭插入廣告是付費會員的專屬功能。

examples.en: Classified advertisements in the back of the newspaper list apartments for rent.
examples.zh: 報紙後頁刊登的分類小廣告羅列了各區套房與公寓出租的最新資訊。

entries.definition: 刊登廣告；宣傳；打廣告；廣告（簡稱 ad）
explains: A message tells people about a product, service, or event. A poster may show a new book. It gives details about where to find it.
Companies share these messages on signs, websites, or television. Clear facts help customers make choices. People should think carefully before buying.
The short noun can also mean a brief promotional message. It may appear between programs. Some messages try to persuade viewers.

examples.en: I advise you to wear a helmet when riding your bike.
examples.zh: 我建議你騎腳踏車時戴上安全帽。

examples.en: The librarian advised us to return the books by Friday.
examples.zh: 圖書館員提醒我們星期五前還書。

examples.en: My coach advises me to stretch before each game.
examples.zh: 教練建議我每場比賽前都要伸展。

explains: A person can offer helpful ideas about what someone should do. A teacher may suggest a way to study. The learner can decide what works.
A doctor or other expert may explain safe choices. Ask questions when directions are unclear. Trusted adults can help children understand.
Advice should be kind and useful. A friend may recommend taking a break. Listening is a good first step.

examples.en: Meet with your thesis advisor regularly to discuss experimental methodologies.
examples.zh: 定期與您的論文指導教授會面以討論實驗研究方法論。

examples.en: The foreign policy advisor briefed the president prior to the international summit.
examples.zh: 在跨國高峰會召開之前，外交政策資深顧問向總統進行了全面的機密簡報。

examples.en: A trusted financial advisor helps families plan retirement and minimize tax liabilities.
examples.zh: 值得信賴的專業理財顧問協助廣大家庭規劃退休金並合法達到節稅效益。

entries.definition: 指導教授；學術導師；顧問
explains: A person gives information to help someone make a choice. A school worker may explain which classes to take. Students can ask questions.
An expert can guide people through a difficult plan. They listen first. Then they share useful options.
The helper does not choose for someone else. They explain facts and possible results. The final decision belongs to the person asking.

examples.en: As a college student, I cannot afford a luxury sports car.
examples.zh: 身為大學生，我買不起奢華的超級跑車。

examples.en: We can easily afford a weekend road trip to Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們完全負擔得起去墾丁度過週末公路之旅。

examples.en: With exam week approaching, we cannot afford to waste any study time.
examples.zh: 隨著考試週逼近，我們承擔不起浪費任何讀書時間。

explains: A person has enough money or time to do something. A family may save before buying a bicycle. Planning helps them decide.
An activity can fit within someone's schedule. A child may have time to read after chores. A calendar shows free hours.
People should compare costs before making a purchase. They can choose a less expensive option. Asking for help is sensible.

examples.en: We visited the art room and went to the library afterward.
examples.zh: 我們參觀美術教室，之後去了圖書館。

examples.en: The children washed their hands after the game and ate lunch afterwards.
examples.zh: 孩子們比賽後洗手，接著吃午餐。

examples.en: She called her grandmother afterward to share the good news.
examples.zh: 她之後打電話告訴祖母這個好消息。

explains: This adverb means at a later time, following an event. The class finished a game. Then students put away the equipment.
A person may rest following a long walk. They drink water first. Their body can recover gradually.
It helps show the order of events. People eat dinner and clean the table later. Clear timing makes a story easier to follow.

examples.en: Smart sensors and automation modernize traditional Taiwanese agriculture.
examples.zh: 智慧感測器與自動化設備讓傳統台灣農業邁向現代化。

examples.en: Sustainable agriculture preserves precious water resources and enhances soil fertility.
examples.zh: 永續農業有助於涵養珍貴水資源並顯著提升土壤整體肥力。

examples.en: Severe seasonal droughts pose an existential threat to domestic agriculture.
examples.zh: 嚴重的季節性乾旱對本國農業生產構成了生存層級的巨大威脅。

examples.en: High-tech smart agriculture integrates IoT sensors, cloud monitoring, and precision robotics.
examples.zh: 高科技智慧農業整合了物聯網感測器、雲端氣候監控與精密自走採收機器人。

examples.en: Sustainable agriculture practices help conserve precious groundwater reserves.
examples.zh: 推廣環境永續農法有助於涵養並守護珍貴的地下水資源庫。

examples.en: Agriculture remains the foundational backbone of many regional economies worldwide.
examples.zh: 農業自古以來始終是全球無數區域經濟最不可或缺的堅實基石。

entries.definition: 農業；農藝；農耕；農業科技；現代智慧農業
explains: Growing crops and raising animals for food are part of this work. Farmers plant seeds in fields. They care for soil and livestock.
Machines can help people prepare land and harvest crops. Workers watch the weather. Good planning supports healthy plants.
Food production connects farms to markets and families. Trucks carry fresh produce to stores. People choose what to cook.

examples.en: EVA Air and China Airlines are Taiwan's major airlines.
examples.zh: 長榮航空與中華航空是台灣的主要航空公司。

examples.en: Which airline offers the cheapest flights to London?
examples.zh: 哪一家航空公司提供飛往倫敦最便宜的航班？

examples.en: The budget airline charges extra fees for checked baggage.
examples.zh: 這家廉價航空公司對託運行李額外收取費用。

explains: A company carries passengers by airplane between cities or countries. Workers help people check in. Pilots fly the aircraft safely.
A traveler can compare routes and times before buying a ticket. Some trips include a stop. A map shows where each flight goes.
Cabin staff share safety instructions before takeoff. Passengers listen carefully. Their cooperation helps everyone travel safely.

examples.en: The cat slipped into the alley behind the bakery.
examples.zh: 貓溜進麵包店後方的小巷。

examples.en: We walked through a narrow alley to reach the market.
examples.zh: 我們穿過一條狹窄小巷前往市場。

examples.en: The alley was quiet after the shops closed.
examples.zh: 商店打烊後，小巷裡安靜了下來。

explains: A narrow passage runs between buildings or behind houses. People may walk through it to reach another street. Keep it clean and safe.
Some lanes have garages and back doors. A delivery worker may use this route. It is often quieter than the main road.
Children should play only where adults say it is safe. Cars may enter unexpectedly. Look both ways before crossing.

examples.en: She sprinkled sliced almonds over the warm oatmeal.
examples.zh: 她在熱燕麥粥上撒了切片杏仁。

examples.en: The almond tree bloomed with pale flowers in spring.
examples.zh: 杏樹在春天開滿淡色花朵。

examples.en: We packed a small bag of almonds for the hike.
examples.zh: 我們為健行準備了一小袋杏仁。

explains: This small nut grows inside a hard shell on a tree. People may eat it roasted or add it to food. It has a mild flavor.
The tree has pale blossoms in spring. Later, a fruit forms around the hard seed. Farmers gather the crop when ready.
Some people use ground nuts in baking. Others drink a plant-based milk made from them. Check food labels for allergies.

examples.en: A comes first in the English alphabet.
examples.zh: A 是英文字母表中的第一個字母。

examples.en: We sang the alphabet song during our first English lesson.
examples.zh: 我們在第一堂英文課唱了字母歌。

examples.en: The children arranged the cards in alphabet order.
examples.zh: 孩子們按照字母順序排列卡片。

explains: The set of letters in a language is learned in a certain order. Children sing a song to remember it. Books use these letters to form words.
A dictionary arranges words by their first letters. Knowing the order helps people find a word quickly. Each letter has a name and sound.
Some languages use different writing systems. People practice the symbols. Reading becomes easier with time.

examples.en: The magic show amazed the children with its floating hat.
examples.zh: 魔術表演中帽子漂浮起來，讓孩子們驚奇不已。

examples.en: To my amazement, the tiny seed grew into a tall sunflower.
examples.zh: 令我驚訝的是，那顆小種子長成了高大的向日葵。

examples.en: Her amazing drawing showed every feather on the bird.
examples.zh: 她令人驚嘆的畫作呈現了鳥身上的每一根羽毛。

explains: Something can surprise people greatly and make them feel wonder. A tiny seed grows into a tall tree. Children watch it change.
A person may feel impressed by an unusual skill. A musician plays a fast tune. The audience listens closely.
An unexpected sight can make someone pause. A rainbow appears across the sky. Friends point and smile.

examples.en: The ambassador welcomed the visitors to the city hall.
examples.zh: 大使在市政廳歡迎訪客。

examples.en: A young ambassador spoke about protecting the forest.
examples.zh: 一位青年代表談到保護森林的重要性。

examples.en: The ambassador met students from both countries.
examples.zh: 大使會見了來自兩國的學生。

explains: A person represents a country or group in another place. They meet leaders and share messages. Their work helps people communicate.
An organization may choose someone to speak for its members. The representative explains its goals. They answer questions from the public.
This role can include visiting events and building friendships. Polite conversation matters. Learning about other cultures is helpful.

examples.en: Her ambition is to design safe bridges for her town.
examples.zh: 她的志向是為家鄉設計安全的橋梁。

examples.en: He worked toward his ambition by practicing the violin daily.
examples.zh: 他每天練習小提琴，朝自己的志向努力。

examples.en: Their ambition inspired the whole class to plant a garden.
examples.zh: 他們的抱負激勵全班一起種植花園。

explains: A strong wish to reach a goal can guide someone's choices. A child may hope to become a pilot. Studying helps build the needed skills.
People can set a goal that takes many years. Breaking it into smaller steps makes progress easier to see. Friends can encourage one another.
Big dreams need patience and effort. A person may change plans along the way. Learning from mistakes can help them continue.

examples.en: The ambulance arrived quickly after the driver called for help.
examples.zh: 駕駛打電話求助後，救護車很快就到了。

examples.en: Cars moved aside when the ambulance sounded its siren.
examples.zh: 救護車鳴笛時，汽車紛紛靠邊讓路。

examples.en: A nurse rode in the ambulance with the injured cyclist.
examples.zh: 一位護理師搭乘救護車陪著受傷的腳踏車騎士。

explains: A special vehicle carries sick or hurt people to a hospital. Its lights and siren warn other drivers. People should make room for it.
Trained helpers ride inside and give care on the way. They bring useful equipment. Quick action can matter in an emergency.
A person should call local emergency services when someone needs urgent help. Give the correct location. Stay calm and follow directions.

examples.en: My big sister was an angel when she helped me find my lost shoe.
examples.zh: 姊姊幫我找到遺失的鞋子，真是我的天使。

examples.en: The story showed an angel watching over the sleeping village.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一位天使守護著沉睡的村莊。

examples.en: You are an angel for bringing us warm tea.
examples.zh: 你帶來熱茶，真是太貼心了。

explains: A kind or helpful person may be described this way. A neighbor brings soup when someone is sick. The family feels cared for.
In many stories and religions, a heavenly being protects or guides people. Pictures often show wings. Different beliefs describe such beings differently.
The word can be a warm nickname for someone very kind. A child may thank a friend for sharing. Kind actions make people smile.

examples.en: The principal announced that the school concert would begin at six.
examples.zh: 校長宣布學校音樂會將於六點開始。

examples.en: The announcement about the new library made the students cheer.
examples.zh: 新圖書館的消息讓學生們歡呼起來。

examples.en: Please announce your name before entering the game.
examples.zh: 進入遊戲前請先說出你的名字。

explains: A person tells people important news in a clear way. A teacher shares the date of a school trip. Everyone can write it down.
A public message may come over a speaker or appear on a sign. Travelers hear when a train will arrive. Clear words prevent confusion.
The noun can mean the news that has been shared. A family may tell friends about a new baby. People send good wishes.

examples.en: I felt anxious before speaking in front of the class.
examples.zh: 在全班面前說話前，我感到很焦慮。

examples.en: The anxious dog stayed close to its owner during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，焦慮的狗一直待在主人身邊。

examples.en: Maya was anxious to open the gift from her aunt.
examples.zh: 瑪雅迫不及待想打開阿姨送的禮物。

explains: Someone may feel worried about what will happen. A student waits for a test result. Taking slow breaths can help them stay calm.
A person may be eager for something to begin. Children wait excitedly for a birthday party. They ask when the guests will arrive.
Talking with a trusted person can ease worry. Making a small plan may help. Rest and healthy routines are useful too.

examples.en: The bus was late, but we arrived anyhow.
examples.zh: 公車雖然晚了，但我們還是到了。

examples.en: I was tired; anyhow, I finished the last page.
examples.zh: 我雖然累了，還是讀完最後一頁。

examples.en: We can get there anyhow, even if we need to walk.
examples.zh: 即使得走路，我們總能想辦法到那裡。

explains: This adverb can mean in any case or despite a problem. The rain started, but the family went on with their indoor game. They still had fun.
People may use it to return to a main idea after a pause. They mention a small detail. Then they continue their story.
In casual speech, it can mean by any method. A child tries different ways to open a box. They ask an adult if needed.

examples.en: Please keep the paint bottles apart so their colors do not mix.
examples.zh: 請把顏料瓶分開放，免得顏色混在一起。

examples.en: The twins sat apart during the quiet reading time.
examples.zh: 安靜閱讀時，雙胞胎分開坐著。

examples.en: They took the old radio apart to see how it worked.
examples.zh: 他們把舊收音機拆開，看看它如何運作。

explains: Two things are separated by some space. The chairs stood far from each other. People walked between them.
A person can take something to pieces. A mechanic removes the parts carefully. They can repair the machine more easily.
The phrase can mean except for or besides. A room was quiet except for a ticking clock. Everyone noticed the sound.

examples.en: He apologized sincerely for stepping on my new white sneakers.
examples.zh: 他為踩到我新買的白球鞋而真誠道歉。

examples.en: The airline apologized for the unexpected flight cancellation caused by storms.
examples.zh: 航空公司對天候暴風雨因素導致的臨時航班取消向所有旅客鄭重道歉。

examples.en: It takes mature character to realize your error and apologize without excuses.
examples.zh: 勇於正視自己的過失並毫不推諉託詞地誠懇認錯道歉，彰顯了一個人的成熟格局。

explains: A person says they are sorry after hurting someone or making a mistake. They can explain what happened. They should try to make things right.
Kind words are important, but actions matter too. A child may return a borrowed toy. Trust can grow again.
People can accept an apology when they are ready. Listening shows care. Both sides deserve respect.

examples.en: The defense lawyer decided to appeal the conviction to the High Court.
examples.zh: 辯護律師決定就一審判決向高等法院依法提起第二審上訴。

examples.en: The mayor made an urgent televised appeal asking citizens to stay indoors during the severe typhoon.
examples.zh: 市長在電視現場直播中發表了措辭懇切的緊急呼籲，強烈敦請全體市民在強烈颱風過境期間切勿出門。

examples.en: Minimalist interior design with natural wood elements holds timeless aesthetic appeal for young buyers.
examples.zh: 融入大量溫潤天然原木質感的現代極簡室內設計風格，對年輕世代首購族群具有歷久彌新的美學吸引力。

explains: A request may ask for help or support. A group seeks donations for a park. Neighbors decide whether they can contribute.
Something can seem attractive to a person's taste. A colorful game may interest a child. Different people enjoy different things.
In law, someone may ask a higher court to review a decision. A lawyer explains the reason. The process follows formal rules.

examples.en: Mom approved our plan to build a small garden box.
examples.zh: 媽媽同意了我們製作小型花圃箱的計畫。

examples.en: The coach approved the new practice schedule.
examples.zh: 教練核准了新的練習時間表。

examples.en: My teacher approved my book choice for the report.
examples.zh: 老師同意我選這本書來寫報告。

explains: A person in charge says that a plan is acceptable. A teacher checks a class project. The students can begin after permission is given.
A group may agree that an idea is good. Family members discuss a new pet. Everyone considers the work it needs.
People sometimes show that they like something with a nod or kind words. Support can encourage a friend. Honest feedback is useful.

examples.en: Grandma tied a striped apron around her waist before baking.
examples.zh: 奶奶烘焙前在腰間繫上條紋圍裙。

examples.en: The chef kept a spoon in the apron pocket.
examples.zh: 主廚把湯匙放在圍裙口袋裡。

examples.en: I wore an apron to keep paint off my shirt.
examples.zh: 我穿上圍裙，避免顏料弄髒襯衫。

explains: A cloth garment covers the front of a person's clothes while they cook or work. It may have pockets. Ties keep it in place.
Food splashes can stain fabric during baking. This cover is easy to remove and wash. Children can wear one during art time too.
Different jobs use special protective clothing. A painter may keep brushes in the pockets. A cook may dry hands on a clean towel instead.

examples.en: The guard was armed with a radio and flashlight, not a gun.
examples.zh: 警衛配備了無線電和手電筒，而不是槍。

examples.en: The armed vehicle stayed behind the safety barrier.
examples.zh: 那輛配備武器的車輛停在安全屏障後方。

examples.en: The hikers were armed with maps and plenty of water.
examples.zh: 健行者備有地圖和充足的水。

explains: A person has a tool or weapon ready to use. In dangerous situations, trained adults follow strict safety rules. Children should never touch weapons.
The word can describe a vehicle fitted with weapons. Such machines are connected with fighting. Peaceful communities work to prevent violence.
A person can also be equipped with useful knowledge. A student reads instructions before a science activity. Preparation helps them work safely.

examples.en: Police arrested the man after checking the security video.
examples.zh: 警方查看監視器畫面後逮捕了那名男子。

examples.en: The arrest was made calmly outside the store.
examples.zh: 逮捕行動在商店外平和地進行。

examples.en: The bus came to an arrest at the stop sign.
examples.zh: 公車在停止標誌前停了下來。

explains: Police may take a person into custody because they suspect a crime. The person has legal rights. Authorities follow set rules.
A sudden stop can be called this too. A driver presses the brake. The car stops safely at a line.
Only trained officers should take someone into custody. People should not interfere. They can call emergency services if someone needs help.

examples.en: A thin layer of ash covered the cold fireplace.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的灰燼覆蓋在冰冷的壁爐裡。

examples.en: The ash tree in our yard gives shade in summer.
examples.zh: 我們院子裡的梣樹在夏天提供樹蔭。

examples.en: Volcanic ash drifted over the empty road.
examples.zh: 火山灰飄落在空蕩蕩的道路上。

explains: Gray powder remains after wood or paper burns completely. A fireplace may need cleaning. Let it cool before anyone touches it.
A tree can grow in many places and has strong branches. Its leaves may turn yellow in fall. Birds can rest in its branches.
Volcanic material can cover the ground after an eruption. People follow safety instructions. Dust may affect the air.

examples.en: Please move aside so the cart can pass.
examples.zh: 請移到旁邊，讓推車通過。

examples.en: She set the blue folder aside until the meeting began.
examples.zh: 會議開始前，她先把藍色資料夾放到一旁。

examples.en: Aside from the rain, the picnic went very well.
examples.zh: 除了下雨之外，野餐進行得很順利。

explains: A person moves to one side to leave room. A child steps away from the doorway. Others can pass through.
The word can introduce a comment that is separate from the main point. Someone shares a small extra detail. Then they return to the story.
A person may save money for later. They put a few coins in a jar. Small amounts can add up.

examples.en: The probe executed a close Jupiter gravity assist, picking up orbital energy to slingshot outward to Saturn.
examples.zh: 探測器成功執行木星「重力助推飛掠」（Gravity Assist），藉由木星引力加速彈射飛向土星。

examples.en: The selfless point guard recorded fifteen brilliant assists that set up easy three-point shots for his teammates.
examples.zh: 這位球風無私的明星控球後衛單場送出十五次神妙助攻，頻頻為外線射手隊友創造大空檔三分出手機會。

examples.en: Public transit volunteers assist elderly wheelchair passengers boarding low-floor community shuttle buses.
examples.zh: 捷運志工熱心在月台協助推輪椅的行動不便長者與身障朋友，安全平穩地登上低底盤無障礙接駁公車。

entries.definition: 木星引力彈弓加速借力飛掠機動；協助
explains: A person helps someone do a task. A classmate carries books for a friend. Working together makes the job easier.
A machine can make a process simpler. A handle helps open a heavy door. People should use tools correctly.
Offering help can be kind, but it is polite to ask first. Someone may want to try alone. Respect their answer.

examples.en: The research assistant organized the laboratory equipment.
examples.zh: 研究助理整理了實驗室的設備。

examples.en: The polite shop assistant helped me find the right size denim jacket.
examples.zh: 那位親切有禮的店員協助我找到了合適尺碼的牛仔外套。

examples.en: College teaching assistants lead weekly discussion sessions for undergraduate students.
examples.zh: 大學助教每週帶領大學部學生進行深入的專題討論課程。

explains: A person helps another worker complete tasks. A classroom helper may hand out papers. The teacher remains responsible for the lesson.
A store worker may answer simple questions. They can show where an item is. Customers can ask for more help if needed.
Some devices have a helper program that follows spoken instructions. It can set a timer or answer a question. Check information carefully.

examples.en: Never assume; always ask questions to clarify facts.
examples.zh: 切勿妄加揣測；務必主動發問以釐清事實。

examples.en: I assumed the bookstore was open, but it was closed for inventory counts.
examples.zh: 我原本一廂情願以為書店有開門，沒想到今天正逢內部庫存盤點暫停營業。

examples.en: The newly elected director will assume full operational responsibility next Monday.
examples.zh: 新當選接任的營運長將於下週一正式承擔起全公司整體日常營運的管理重任。

explains: A person may believe something is true without checking. A child sees a wet road and thinks it rained. The sprinkler may have made it wet.
It can mean taking a duty or responsibility. A new leader starts planning meetings. They ask what the group needs.
Checking facts can prevent mistakes. People should ask questions before deciding. Listening to others may change their first idea.

examples.en: Tai Tzu-ying is a world-class badminton athlete from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 戴資穎是來自台灣的世界級羽球運動員。

examples.en: Professional athletes train several hours each day to stay in peak physical condition.
examples.zh: 職業運動員每天訓練數小時以維持在最佳體能狀態。

examples.en: Student athletes must balance demanding study schedules with varsity team practices.
examples.zh: 學生運動員必須在繁重的課業時程與校隊集訓之間取得平衡。

examples.en: Dedicated track athletes train tirelessly in rain and shine.
examples.zh: 專注自律的田徑運動員無論晴雨皆持之以恆投入高強度體能訓練。

examples.en: Professional athletes maintain strict nutritional diets and rigid sleep schedules.
examples.zh: 頂級職業運動員對個人日常營養攝取維持苛刻標準，並嚴格恪守規律作息。

examples.en: The injured athlete underwent intensive physical therapy to prepare for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 這名受傷的體育健兒積極投入密集的高階物理復健，期盼趕在奧運開幕前重返賽場。

examples.en: Dedicated national athletes train six hours daily to qualify for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 刻苦耐勞的國家培訓隊國手運動員每日苦練六小時，力拼取得前進奧運資格。

examples.en: Professional athletes must follow strict nutritional guidelines during competition season.
examples.zh: 職業運動員在激烈賽季期間必須恪守極為嚴格的運動營養飲食規範。

examples.en: He was named the high school's outstanding student athlete of the year.
examples.zh: 他榮獲該中學年度最佳品學兼優傑出學生運動員殊榮。

entries.definition: 運動員；選手；體育健兒；國手
explains: A person who trains and competes in sports is called this. They practice regularly. Rest and healthy food help the body recover.
Some compete alone, while others play on teams. Each activity needs different skills. Fair play matters for everyone.
Young players learn from coaches and teammates. They should warm up before exercise. Safety is more important than winning.

examples.en: The flight controller calculates real-time drone attitude to maintain stable hover during gusty coastal winds.
examples.zh: 飛行控制器即時解算無人機的「三維空間姿態」（Attitude），在強烈沿海陣風中依然穩如泰山。

examples.en: Maintaining a proactive and optimistic mental attitude is vital when navigating unexpected career challenges.
examples.zh: 在面對瞬息萬變的職場考驗與人生低潮時，維持積極正向、樂觀自持的心態是化解困境的關鍵鑰匙。

examples.en: The spacecraft executed thruster pulses to adjust its orbital attitude before deploying the scientific solar array.
examples.zh: 太空探測船在正式展開大型科學太陽能帆板電池翼之前，精準點火姿態推進器以校正微調飛行姿態。

entries.definition: 俯仰、滾轉與偏航三維空間載具即時姿態解算；態度
explains: A person's feelings or way of thinking about something can affect their actions. A hopeful child keeps trying. Encouragement helps them continue.
The position of the body can show a feeling. Standing tall may look confident. A slumped posture can seem tired.
Respectful behavior makes group work easier. Listening and sharing turns show care. A positive approach can help the whole class.

examples.en: Bright lights attract moths at night.
examples.zh: 明亮的燈光會吸引夜晚的飛蛾。

examples.en: The garden's sweet smell attracted many bees.
examples.zh: 花園的香氣吸引了許多蜜蜂。

examples.en: The museum attracts families with its hands-on science room.
examples.zh: 博物館的互動科學教室吸引了許多家庭。

explains: Something catches a person's attention or makes them interested. Bright flowers bring bees. A colorful poster invites people to look.
A magnet can pull certain metals toward it. Two magnets may push apart or come together. Try this with adult supervision.
People may invite visitors with a fun event. Music and games can make a fair lively. Clear signs help guests find it.

examples.en: The attractive garden drew visitors from the nearby street.
examples.zh: 這座迷人的花園吸引了附近街道的訪客。

examples.en: A clear, attractive poster helped families find the event.
examples.zh: 清楚又吸引人的海報幫助家庭找到活動地點。

examples.en: The old vase has an attractive blue pattern.
examples.zh: 這只古老花瓶有迷人的藍色圖案。

explains: Something looks pleasing or catches people's interest. A bright cover may make a book stand out. Readers want to open it.
A person can be appealing because of kind actions, not only appearance. Helping others is admirable. Good character matters.
A shop may arrange items neatly to make them inviting. Clear displays help customers see choices. Friendly service also makes a difference.

examples.en: The entire audience stood up and gave a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 全體觀眾紛紛起立報以熱烈掌聲。

examples.en: The podcast host tailors his content specifically for a young tech-savvy audience.
examples.zh: 這位播客節目主持人專為懂科技的年輕受眾群體量身打造內容。

examples.en: The foreign ambassador was granted a private audience with the president.
examples.zh: 這位外國特使獲得了與總統單獨親切會面接見的機會。

explains: People who watch a show or listen to a speaker form this group. They sit quietly in a theater. They clap at the end.
A program may be made for a certain set of viewers. A children's show uses simple stories. Its creators think about what young viewers enjoy.
Listeners can show respect by paying attention. Phones should be quiet during a performance. Everyone can enjoy the event together.

examples.en: The automatic doors opened when we walked toward the store.
examples.zh: 我們走向商店時，自動門打開了。

examples.en: An automatic timer turns the garden lights off at ten.
examples.zh: 自動計時器會在十點關掉花園燈。

examples.en: The car has an automatic system that warns the driver about low fuel.
examples.zh: 這輛車有一套自動系統，會在燃料不足時提醒駕駛。

explains: A machine can work by itself after someone sets it up. A door may open when a sensor detects a person. It then closes safely.
A process may happen without a person controlling each step. A timer turns lights on at night. Check that the settings are correct.
This kind of action saves effort but still needs care. People read directions before using new equipment. Safety rules remain important.

examples.en: The automobile stopped at the red light near the school.
examples.zh: 汽車在學校附近的紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: Dad's auto needs new tires before the long trip.
examples.zh: 爸爸的車在長途旅行前需要換新輪胎。

examples.en: An electric automobile can travel without using gasoline.
examples.zh: 電動汽車不必使用汽油就能行駛。

explains: A road vehicle with four wheels carries people from place to place. A driver steers it. Passengers wear seat belts for safety.
Families may use this vehicle for a long trip. They check the fuel and tires first. A map helps them choose a route.
Some models use electricity instead of gasoline. Others use a motor that burns fuel. All drivers must follow road rules.

examples.en: We walked along the tree-lined avenue to the library.
examples.zh: 我們沿著兩旁種滿樹木的大道走到圖書館。

examples.en: The parade moved down the main avenue in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 遊行隊伍下午沿著主要大道前進。

examples.en: Reading gave her an avenue for learning about other places.
examples.zh: 閱讀為她提供了認識其他地方的途徑。

explains: A wide city street may have trees or tall buildings along it. People walk on the sidewalks. Cars follow traffic signs.
The word can also mean a way to reach a goal. A new idea gives a team another path to solve a problem. Team members consider each route.
Street names help visitors find addresses. A map shows where each road goes. Cross at marked places for safety.

examples.en: I was awake before the alarm rang this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上鬧鐘響之前我就醒著了。

examples.en: The loud thunder kept the baby awake all night.
examples.zh: 雷聲太大，讓寶寶整晚都醒著。

examples.en: She awoke early to watch the sunrise from the hill.
examples.zh: 她一早醒來，從山丘上看日出。

explains: A person is not sleeping and can notice what is happening. The baby became alert when the door opened. A quiet voice helped him settle.
Someone may get up before sunrise. Birds begin singing outside. The house slowly comes to life.
A person can wake another by making a gentle sound. Knocking softly is polite. Let people rest when they need sleep.

examples.en: The first birdsong began to awaken the campers at dawn.
examples.zh: 第一聲鳥鳴開始在黎明時喚醒露營的人。

examples.en: A cool breeze awakened him from his afternoon nap.
examples.zh: 一陣涼風吹醒了正在午睡的他。

examples.en: The museum visit awakened her interest in ancient history.
examples.zh: 參觀博物館喚起了她對古代歷史的興趣。

explains: To stop sleeping, a person opens their eyes and becomes alert. Morning light can enter the room. A gentle alarm may help.
A sound or event can cause a person to wake. A bird sings near the window. Someone stirs and sits up.
The word can also mean bringing a feeling or idea into someone's mind. A story may create curiosity. A question can start new thinking.

examples.en: The school gave an award to the winning science team.
examples.zh: 學校頒獎給贏得比賽的科學隊。

examples.en: Maya won an award for her helpful work at the library.
examples.zh: 瑪雅因在圖書館熱心幫忙而獲獎。

examples.en: The judges awarded first place to the youngest painter.
examples.zh: 評審把第一名頒給年紀最小的畫家。

explains: A prize is given to recognize effort or achievement. A student may receive a medal for a science project. The school celebrates the work.
A group may give someone an honor for helping others. The person may thank their family. Their actions inspired the community.
The verb means giving a prize or honor. Judges compare entries fairly. They explain why one person was chosen.

examples.en: Be aware of the wet floor near the entrance.
examples.zh: 請留意入口附近的濕滑地板。

examples.en: She became aware that her friend needed help.
examples.zh: 她察覺朋友需要幫忙。

examples.en: The hikers were aware of the dark clouds above them.
examples.zh: 健行者注意到頭頂上的烏雲。

explains: A person knows that something exists or is happening. A driver notices a bicycle nearby. Paying attention helps everyone stay safe.
People may understand how their actions affect others. Speaking kindly can make a friend feel welcome. Listening shows care.
Learning new facts can help someone notice a problem. Students read signs around the school. They follow safety directions.

examples.en: The awful smell came from the old food in the bin.
examples.zh: 難聞的氣味來自垃圾桶裡的舊食物。

examples.en: I felt awful after staying awake all night.
examples.zh: 我整晚沒睡後覺得很不舒服。

examples.en: The team played an awful first half but improved later.
examples.zh: 球隊上半場打得很糟，但後來有進步。

explains: Something very unpleasant or upsetting can be described this way. A loud alarm may hurt people's ears. Turning it off helps everyone feel calm.
A person may feel very sick or uncomfortable. They should tell a caregiver. Rest and proper help may be needed.
The word can also describe something of very poor quality. A broken chair is unsafe. Someone should repair or replace it.

examples.en: The long awkward box would not fit through the doorway.
examples.zh: 那個又長又難搬的箱子無法通過門口。

examples.en: I felt awkward when I forgot my friend's name.
examples.zh: 我忘記朋友的名字時感到很尷尬。

examples.en: He made an awkward turn with the large shopping cart.
examples.zh: 他推著大型購物車轉彎時有些笨拙。

explains: A movement can feel clumsy or uncomfortable. A person may bump into a chair in a crowded room. Moving slowly helps.
A situation may feel hard to manage. Two friends disagree about a game. A calm conversation can help them decide.
A shape may be difficult to hold or use. A bulky box does not fit easily in a small bag. Choose a suitable container.

examples.en: The mountain made a beautiful background for our family photo.
examples.zh: 山景成了我們全家福的美麗背景。

examples.en: Her background in art helped her design the poster.
examples.zh: 她的藝術背景幫助她設計海報。

examples.en: Soft music played in the background while we ate.
examples.zh: 我們用餐時，背景播放著輕柔的音樂。

explains: The part behind the main subject in a picture is called this. A blue sky can sit behind a bird. It makes the bird easy to see.
A person's past experiences and family history are also included. These details shape what they know. Everyone has a different story.
A soft sound may play while people work or talk. It stays quiet so it does not interrupt. Gentle music can create a mood.

examples.en: Dad cooked bacon with eggs for Sunday breakfast.
examples.zh: 爸爸星期日早餐煎了培根和雞蛋。

examples.en: A piece of crispy bacon fell beside my plate.
examples.zh: 一片酥脆的培根掉在我的盤子旁。

examples.en: The sandwich had lettuce, tomato, and bacon inside.
examples.zh: 三明治裡夾了生菜、番茄和培根。

explains: Thin strips of salty meat are often cooked in a pan until crisp. People may eat them with eggs. The hot pan needs an adult.
Some kinds come from a pig. Other products use different ingredients. Check the package if someone avoids certain foods.
The cooked strips can add a smoky taste to a sandwich. Let them cool before eating. A napkin can soak up extra grease.

examples.en: Bacteria can grow quickly on food left out in warm weather.
examples.zh: 食物在溫暖的環境中放太久，細菌可能快速繁殖。

examples.en: Good bacteria in the soil help plants get nutrients.
examples.zh: 土壤中的有益細菌能幫助植物取得養分。

examples.en: The scientist looked at bacteria through a microscope.
examples.zh: 科學家透過顯微鏡觀察細菌。

explains: Tiny living things are too small to see without a microscope. Some can make people sick. Others help the body or nature.
People wash hands to remove germs from their skin. Soap and water are useful. Cleaning food areas also helps prevent illness.
Some kinds help turn milk into yogurt. Different kinds do different jobs. Scientists study them carefully.

examples.en: The team played badly before practicing together.
examples.zh: 球隊在一起練習前表現得很差。

examples.en: The roof was badly damaged by the strong wind.
examples.zh: 屋頂被強風吹得嚴重受損。

examples.en: I wanted badly to see my cousins during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間我非常想見到我的表親們。

explains: This adverb can describe doing something poorly or with many mistakes. A team may play without practice. They learn what to improve.
It can show that something is seriously damaged or needed. A roof leaks after a storm. The family needs a repair soon.
The word can also describe how much someone wants something. A child may strongly hope to see a friend. They ask when the visit will happen.

examples.en: Our baggage arrived on the airport belt after the flight.
examples.zh: 我們的行李在航班抵達後出現在機場輸送帶上。

examples.en: Please keep your baggage beside you on the train.
examples.zh: 請把行李放在火車上身邊。

examples.en: The airline lost one piece of baggage during the trip.
examples.zh: 航空公司在旅途中弄丟了一件行李。

explains: Suitcases and bags carried on a trip are called this. Travelers place them in a storage area. They keep important items close.
An airport worker may move bags from a plane to a belt. People check labels to find their own. Keep the claim tag safe.
Rules can limit how many bags someone brings. Packing carefully saves space. Do not leave personal items unattended.

examples.en: Dad put a small worm on the hook as bait.
examples.zh: 爸爸把一條小蚯蚓掛在魚鉤上當魚餌。

examples.en: The fisherman baited his hook beside the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 漁夫在安靜的湖邊把魚餌掛上魚鉤。

examples.en: A sweet smell can bait insects into a safe garden trap.
examples.zh: 甜甜的氣味可以引誘昆蟲進入安全的花園陷阱。

explains: Food or another lure is used to attract an animal, often while fishing. A worm may go on a hook. Handle hooks with an adult.
The verb means to tempt someone with something appealing. A bright toy can catch a child's attention. People should make honest promises.
Some traps use a smell to draw pests toward them. Follow safety directions. Keep such materials away from children and pets.

examples.en: The panda munched on fresh bamboo shoots.
examples.zh: 熊貓咀嚼著新鮮的竹筍。

examples.en: A bamboo fence surrounded the small garden.
examples.zh: 一道竹籬笆圍住了小花園。

examples.en: We used a bamboo pole to support the tomato plant.
examples.zh: 我們用一根竹竿支撐番茄植株。

explains: A tall grass has strong hollow stems and grows quickly. People make furniture or tools from it. Pandas eat its leaves and shoots.
The stems have sections joined by hard rings. They are light but sturdy. Gardeners can grow the plant in warm places.
Some products use this plant instead of plastic. Reusable cups and toothbrush handles may be made from it. Choose items that last.

examples.en: The metal lid hit the floor with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 金屬鍋蓋掉到地上，發出很大的聲響。

examples.en: The fireworks banged in the sky after dark.
examples.zh: 天黑後，煙火在空中砰砰作響。

examples.en: Leo banged on the door when he forgot his key.
examples.zh: 里奧忘了帶鑰匙時，用力敲門。
