explains: A sudden loud noise may come from a dropped pan or a firework. People may jump when they hear it. Check that everyone is safe.
A verb can mean hitting something hard. A ball strikes a wall with a loud sound. Play safely away from windows.
The word can also describe closing something with a noise. A door may slam in the wind. Hold it gently to avoid startling others.

examples.en: The banker helped Mom open a savings account.
examples.zh: 銀行職員協助媽媽開立儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: A banker explained the loan papers in simple words.
examples.zh: 銀行家用簡單的話解釋貸款文件。

examples.en: The banker checked the numbers before approving the payment.
examples.zh: 銀行職員核對數字後才核准付款。

explains: A person works with money at a bank. They may help customers open accounts. They explain how to keep money safe.
Some people in this job review loans and payments. They check information carefully. Clear records help prevent mistakes.
Customers can ask questions about services. They should never share passwords with strangers. Protecting private details is important.

examples.en: The bare branches stretched across the pale winter sky.
examples.zh: 光禿禿的樹枝伸展在淡色冬日天空中。

examples.en: Her bare feet sank into the soft sand.
examples.zh: 她赤裸的雙腳陷進柔軟的沙裡。

examples.en: The workers bared the old wall beneath the loose paint.
examples.zh: 工人清除鬆脫的油漆，露出底下的舊牆。

explains: A surface has nothing covering it. A tree may have no leaves in winter. Its branches are easy to see.
A person may show a part of the body by removing a glove or shoe. Keep warm clothes on in cold weather. Feet need protection on rough ground.
The verb can mean uncovering something. Workers clear soil from an old stone. They do it carefully to avoid damage.

examples.en: The kitten could barely reach the top step.
examples.zh: 小貓幾乎搆不到最上面的階梯。

examples.en: We had barely enough time to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 我們的時間剛好夠趕上公車。

examples.en: I could barely hear the music over the rain.
examples.zh: 雨聲太大，我幾乎聽不見音樂。

explains: This adverb means only just or by a very small amount. A child can almost reach a shelf. They may need help.
A person may have very little of something. The jar has only a few drops left. Someone can refill it.
It can show that something almost did not happen. A runner crossed the line just in time. The race was close.

examples.en: The farmer stored dry hay inside the red barn.
examples.zh: 農夫把乾草存放在紅色穀倉裡。

examples.en: A horse rested in the barn during the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷雨期間，一匹馬在穀倉裡休息。

examples.en: We saw an old barn beside the country road.
examples.zh: 我們在鄉間道路旁看到一座老穀倉。

explains: A large farm building stores hay, tools, or animals. Farmers keep doors wide enough for equipment. The inside should stay dry.
Horses and cows may rest inside during bad weather. They need fresh water and clean bedding. Workers check on them often.
The building may have a loft near the roof. Hay is stored there. A ladder helps people reach it safely.

examples.en: Twin mainspring barrels coupled in series deliver eight days of constant torque to the gear train.
examples.zh: 串聯配置的「雙發條盒」（Barrels），為整個齒輪輪系源源不絕供應長達八天的恆定動力輸出。

examples.en: Oak barrels stored in subterranean cellars impart rich vanilla and tannin notes to maturing wines.
examples.zh: 靜置在陰涼地下酒窖裡的法國橡木桶，在漫長陳年歲月中賦予佳釀豐富的香草芳香與圓潤單寧。

examples.en: The oil exporter loaded hundreds of thousands of barrels of crude petroleum onto the massive tanker.
examples.zh: 國際原油出口港將數十萬桶重質原油全數灌裝注入停靠在碼頭的超大型遠洋油輪油艙中。

entries.definition: 雙發條盒系統 (提供八天長效動力儲存)；桶
explains: A large round container has curved sides and a flat top and bottom. It can hold water, oil, or food. Some are made of wood.
Workers roll it along the ground when it is too heavy to lift. A strong lid keeps the contents inside. A hand truck can make moving it easier.
A wooden version of this container may hold wine for many years. A metal version may collect rainwater. Both have enough space to hold a large amount.

examples.en: We keep the old holiday decorations in the basement.
examples.zh: 我們把舊的節慶裝飾品放在地下室。

examples.en: The basement stayed cool during the hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎熱的下午，地下室裡仍然很涼爽。

examples.en: Dad turned the basement into a small music room.
examples.zh: 爸爸把地下室改成一間小音樂室。

explains: A room or floor below the main level of a house is used for storage or activities. Stairs lead down to it. Families may use it as a quiet workspace.
Some families keep tools or boxes there. Good lighting helps people see. Keep exits clear in case of an emergency.
A finished room may become a play or laundry area. It can feel cool in summer. Check for moisture after heavy rain.

examples.en: The fishing boats returned to the bay before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前，漁船回到了海灣。

examples.en: We watched seals swimming across the quiet bay.
examples.zh: 我們看著海豹游過平靜的海灣。

examples.en: The garage has a service bay for each car.
examples.zh: 車庫裡每輛車都有一個維修區。

explains: Part of the sea curves into the land and is partly surrounded by it. Boats can rest in calmer water. Fish may live nearby.
A town beside this curved inlet may have a harbor. People watch boats come and go. The shore can be rocky or sandy.
The word can name an area in a building too. A garage may have separate spaces for cars. Signs show which one to use.

examples.en: Paiwan glazed glass beads embody ancestral blessings, with unique patterns representing warriors and noble status.
examples.zh: 排灣族七彩琉璃珠蘊含著祖靈神聖祝福，每種色彩圖騰各自象徵著守護勇士、尊榮貴族與純潔愛情。

examples.en: The bride wore heirloom necklaces strung with rare multicolored beads denoting noble chieftain bloodlines.
examples.zh: 排灣頭目婚禮上的部落新娘佩戴著數串祖傳的彩虹琉璃珠長項鍊，彰顯其無可取代的尊榮頭目世襲血統。

examples.en: Contemporary indigenous jewelers craft wearable modern bracelets featuring miniature hand-fired beads.
examples.zh: 當代原住民珠寶文創設計師將傳統手工火烤微型琉璃珠重新編排，打造出符合現代日常穿搭的時尚手鍊。

explains: A small round piece with a hole can be strung on a thread. People make necklaces or bracelets with colorful ones. They come in many shapes and sizes.
Some are made of glass, wood, or plastic. A shiny one catches the light. Keep tiny pieces away from young children.
The verb means forming drops of liquid on a surface. Water gathers on a cold glass. The drops slowly run down.

examples.en: Heavy reinforced steel beams support the weight of the upper floors.
examples.zh: 沉重的耐震鋼樑穩穩支撐著上層樓地板的全部重量。

examples.en: A single flashlight beam pierced through the pitch-black darkness of the cavern.
examples.zh: 一道耀眼的手電筒光束劃破了幽深溶洞中伸手不見五指的漆黑死寂。

examples.en: She couldn't help but beam with pride as her daughter walked up to receive the diploma.
examples.zh: 看著女兒落落大方步上講台領取畢業證書，她臉上不禁綻放出無比驕傲自豪的笑容。

examples.en: Master carpenters carved auspicious bats and peonies across the solid Hinoki cypress main beam.
examples.zh: 大木作傳統匠師在整根台灣特選檜木大樑上，精雕細琢出象徵福氣的祥蝠與富貴牡丹。

examples.en: Tension steel cables were concealed inside the hollowed core of the historic beam to provide extra load capacity.
examples.zh: 隱藏在高空古樑內部的補強鋼索，在不破壞外觀的前提下提供了額外的結構承重力。

examples.en: Rain leaking through damaged roof tiles had caused superficial dry rot along the northern beam.
examples.zh: 屋瓦破裂滲入的雨水，曾導致朝北通樑表面產生了局部的乾腐病變。

entries.definition: 橫樑；大樑；光束；殿堂雕花大樑與通樑
explains: A long strong piece of wood or metal supports a roof or floor. Builders place it carefully. It carries weight across an open space.
A bright ray of light can come through a window. Dust floats in it. The room looks golden in the morning.
A person may smile broadly with happiness. Friends share good news. Their faces show joy.

examples.en: The lion is a powerful beast that lives in the grassland.
examples.zh: 獅子是一種生活在草原上的強大野獸。

examples.en: A gentle beast carried the farmer's supplies up the hill.
examples.zh: 一頭溫馴的牲畜把農夫的物資馱上山。

examples.en: The story tells of a brave child who outsmarted a beast.
examples.zh: 故事講述一個勇敢的孩子如何智勝野獸。

explains: A large wild animal may be called this. A lion hunts on open land. It has strong teeth and claws.
Old stories sometimes show a frightening creature with great strength. Heroes may face it. The tale can teach courage.
People should watch wild animals from a safe distance. Their behavior can be hard to predict. Protecting their home keeps them safer.

examples.en: A shiny beetle crawled across the garden stone.
examples.zh: 一隻有光澤的甲蟲爬過花園裡的石頭。

examples.en: The children watched a beetle climb a green stem.
examples.zh: 孩子們看著一隻甲蟲爬上綠色的莖。

examples.en: A tiny beetle hid beneath the fallen leaf.
examples.zh: 一隻小甲蟲躲在落葉底下。

explains: This insect has six legs and a hard shell over its wings. Many kinds live in gardens. They can be different colors and sizes.
Some crawl on leaves or under logs. Others fly at night. They help nature in different ways.
A child may watch one safely from a distance. Do not harm it. Return a log carefully if you look underneath.

examples.en: We sat resting beneath the shade of an old banyan tree.
examples.zh: 我們坐在老榕樹的樹蔭底下乘涼休息。

examples.en: A network of underground utility pipes runs beneath the city streets.
examples.zh: 繁複交錯的地下水電管線網絡深埋在都會區街道的正下方。

examples.en: Beneath her shy, quiet demeanor lies a fiercely determined competitive athlete.
examples.zh: 在她生性害羞靦腆的外表底下，其實藏著一顆堅毅無比的競賽好勝心。

explains: This preposition means directly under something. A cat hides under a chair. Its paws peek out below the seat.
A person can stand below an object. A sign hangs under the clock. Visitors look up to read it.
It can also mean lower in rank or amount. A score may be less than the required number. The team keeps practicing.

examples.en: Company benefits include free gym memberships, health checks, and snacks.
examples.zh: 公司的員工福利包含免費健身房會籍、定期健檢與零食無限供應。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise offers countless physical and mental health benefits.
examples.zh: 維持規律的有氧慢跑運動，能為人體身心靈帶來數不勝數的健康益處。

examples.en: The new mass transit line will greatly benefit residents living in suburban districts.
examples.zh: 全新捷運大眾運輸路網的盛大通車，將為廣大居住在郊區市鎮的居民帶來巨大便利。

explains: Something helpful can improve a person's life or make a task easier. Exercise keeps the body strong. Rest gives it time to recover.
A verb can mean receiving help from something. Plants get good results from sunlight and water. They grow healthier.
A group may provide useful services for its members. A reading club shares books. Everyone learns from one another.

examples.en: A red berry rolled off the plate and onto the table.
examples.zh: 一顆紅色漿果從盤子滾到了桌上。

examples.en: We picked a few berries for the breakfast pancakes.
examples.zh: 我們摘了幾顆漿果，準備搭配早餐鬆餅。

examples.en: The bush was covered with dark blue berries.
examples.zh: 灌木上結滿了深藍色的莓果。

explains: A small juicy fruit grows on a plant or bush. Many kinds are sweet. People add them to cereal or eat them fresh.
Some have seeds on the outside or inside. Birds may eat them. Pick only safe fruit with an adult's help.
A handful can add color to a snack. Wash the fruit before eating. Keep it cool so it stays fresh.

examples.en: Besides English, she speaks fluent French and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英語之外，她還能說流利的法語和日語。

examples.en: Besides that, we must factor in travel transportation expenses and meals.
examples.zh: 除此之外，我們還必須把交通差旅費與餐飲開銷納入考量。

examples.en: Who else is joining the weekend camping trip besides David and Jenny?
examples.zh: 除了大衛和珍妮之外，還有誰會參加週末的露營活動？

examples.en: Besides English, many Taiwanese students also learn Japanese or Korean.
examples.zh: 除了英語之外，許多台灣學生也學習日語或韓語。

examples.en: What hobbies do you enjoy on weekends besides playing computer video games?
examples.zh: 週末除了窩在家裡打電腦電玩以外，你平時還喜愛哪些休閒嗜好？

examples.en: I don't feel like going out tonight; besides, a storm is brewing outside.
examples.zh: 我今晚實在不太想出門吃宵夜；而且更何況外頭正颳風下雨呢。

explains: This word can mean in addition to something. A lunch includes a sandwich and fruit. Water is also packed.
It can introduce another reason or fact. A book is fun to read. It also teaches new words.
A preposition can mean other than or except for. Everyone came except one friend. The group waited for them.

examples.en: I bet our team will score before the game ends.
examples.zh: 我敢打賭，比賽結束前我們隊會得分。

examples.en: He placed a small bet on the horse race.
examples.zh: 他在賽馬比賽上下了一小筆賭注。

examples.en: We bet that the blue jar held more marbles.
examples.zh: 我們打賭藍色罐子裡的大理石彈珠比較多。

explains: A person may risk money or a prize on who will win. Games of chance can be harmful. Adults should follow local rules.
Friends can make a playful guess about a result. Someone thinks it will rain. They can check the forecast together.
The noun may mean a confident belief. A person is sure the team will score. They explain why they think so.

examples.en: Please bind the papers with a blue ribbon.
examples.zh: 請用藍色緞帶把這些紙綁在一起。

examples.en: The bookbinder bound the pages in a sturdy cover.
examples.zh: 裝訂師把書頁裝進堅固的封面裡。

examples.en: A narrow strip can bind the loose stems together.
examples.zh: 一條窄帶可以把鬆散的莖綁在一起。

explains: A string, tape, or cover can hold pages or objects together. A book has a strong cover. It keeps pages in order.
A promise or rule can make someone responsible for an action. People agree to follow it. Clear words explain what they accepted.
A bandage can wrap around an injured area. It should not be too tight. An adult can show how to apply it safely.

examples.en: Good medicine often tastes bitter.
examples.zh: 良藥往往苦口。

examples.en: Bitter melon is prized in Taiwanese home cooking for its cooling health benefits.
examples.zh: 苦瓜在台灣家常菜中因其清退火的養生功效而備受喜愛。

examples.en: The hikers endured bitter cold winds while ascending the mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 登山者在攀登稜線時忍受著刺骨的嚴寒風雪。

explains: A sharp unpleasant taste is found in some foods. Unsweetened cocoa can taste this way. A little sugar may soften it.
A person can feel angry or hurt after an unfair event. Talking calmly may help. Friends can listen and offer support.
Some medicines have a strong flavor that people dislike. Follow a caregiver's directions. Do not take medicine without permission.

examples.en: Press a clean tissue on the wound if it bleeds.
examples.zh: 如果傷口流血，請用乾淨面紙按壓。

examples.en: The scrape began to bleed slightly after he fell off the skateboard.
examples.zh: 他從滑板上摔下來後，擦傷處開始微微滲血。

examples.en: Tilt your head forward and pinch your nose gently if your nose bleeds.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻血，請將頭稍微前傾並輕捏鼻樑。

examples.en: Apply direct pressure on the cut if it continues to bleed.
examples.zh: 若傷口持續流血，請直接對傷口進行加壓。

examples.en: His gums tend to bleed whenever he brushes his teeth too aggressively.
examples.zh: 每當他刷牙太用力時，他的牙齦往往會出血。

examples.en: The wound stopped bleeding after the nurse applied a sterile gauze dressing.
examples.zh: 護理師敷上無菌紗布敷料後，傷口便停止了流血。

explains: Blood comes out when a cut or injury breaks the skin. Pressing a clean cloth can help. Tell an adult right away.
A nose may release blood after a bump or in dry air. Sit upright and ask for help. A caregiver can show what to do.
Color may run from wet paint or ink onto paper. Use a cover to protect the table. Let artwork dry carefully.

examples.en: Grandma asked the priest to bless the new house.
examples.zh: 奶奶請牧師為新房子祈福。

examples.en: We said a prayer to bless the meal before eating.
examples.zh: 我們用餐前祈禱，為這頓飯祝福。

examples.en: May good fortune bless your family this year.
examples.zh: 願今年好運眷顧你的家人。

explains: A person may ask for good things or protection for someone. Families sometimes say a short prayer. Beliefs differ around the world.
Someone may express gratitude for food or help. Kind words show appreciation. Sharing a meal can bring people together.
A priest or other religious leader may perform a special act. People follow their faith's customs. The event can be meaningful to them.

examples.en: The bloody cloth was placed in a sealed bag for washing.
examples.zh: 沾血的布被放進密封袋裡準備清洗。

examples.en: A bloody nose made him ask the teacher for a tissue.
examples.zh: 他流鼻血後向老師要了一張面紙。

examples.en: Some people use bloody as a strong word in casual speech.
examples.zh: 有些人在日常談話中會把 bloody 當作語氣強烈的詞。

explains: Something is covered with blood after an injury or event. A small cut may stain a cloth. An adult should help clean it safely.
This word can be used as a strong informal expression in some places. It may sound rude. Choose polite language at school.
A story scene may seem violent or frightening. Adults can help children pick books that feel comfortable. It is fine to stop reading.

examples.en: She wore a white blouse with a blue skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿著白色上衣和藍色裙子。

examples.en: The blouse has small buttons down the front.
examples.zh: 這件女用上衣前面有一排小鈕扣。

examples.en: I folded my clean blouse and put it in the drawer.
examples.zh: 我把乾淨的女用上衣摺好放進抽屜。

explains: A light shirt worn on the upper body may have buttons or a collar. People can pair it with a skirt or trousers. A collar may be folded neatly.
Different fabrics make clothing feel cool or warm. A cotton one is comfortable in hot weather. Choose a size that fits.
The garment can have short or long sleeves. Wash it according to the label. Hang it neatly to reduce wrinkles.

examples.en: The bold firefighter carried the puppy out of the smoky house.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防員把小狗從冒煙的房子裡抱出來。

examples.en: The poster used bold letters so drivers could read it.
examples.zh: 海報使用粗體字，讓駕駛看得清楚。

examples.en: It was a bold choice to sing alone at the school show.
examples.zh: 在學校表演中獨自唱歌是個大膽的選擇。

explains: A person may act bravely even when something feels scary. A child speaks up to stop unfair teasing. A friend supports them.
Letters or colors can look dark and strong. A large sign is easy to notice. Clear design helps people read it.
Someone can make a confident choice. They try a new activity in front of others. Practice helps them feel more comfortable.

examples.en: The police safely removed the old bomb from the field.
examples.zh: 警方安全地從田地移除了那枚舊炸彈。

examples.en: The movie bombed at the box office, so the theater stopped showing it.
examples.zh: 那部電影票房慘敗，因此戲院停止放映。

examples.en: A bomb squad checked the package before anyone touched it.
examples.zh: 拆彈小組在任何人碰觸包裹前先進行檢查。

explains: A dangerous explosive device can cause great harm. Only trained authorities should handle it. People must leave the area if told.
The word can describe a failure in casual speech. A show may not interest the crowd. Speakers should use kinder words.
Stories about war may include this weapon. Adults can explain the history safely. Peaceful choices protect people.

examples.en: The new bookcase holds all of our classroom stories.
examples.zh: 新的書櫃放得下我們教室裡所有的故事書。

examples.en: Dad secured the tall bookcase to the wall.
examples.zh: 爸爸把高書櫃固定在牆上。

examples.en: I put the science books on the lowest bookcase shelf.
examples.zh: 我把科學書放在書櫃最下面的層板上。

explains: A piece of furniture has shelves for storing books. It may stand against a wall. Secure it so it cannot tip over.
Families arrange stories and school materials inside it. Labels can help children find a book. Keep heavy items on lower shelves.
The furniture can be made from wood or metal. Some have doors to keep dust away. Measure the room before buying one.

examples.en: My rubber boot kept my foot dry in the puddle.
examples.zh: 我的橡膠雨靴讓腳在水窪裡保持乾燥。

examples.en: Please boot the computer before the lesson begins.
examples.zh: 請在課程開始前啟動電腦。

examples.en: We placed the suitcases in the car boot before leaving.
examples.zh: 出發前，我們把行李箱放進汽車後車廂。

explains: A sturdy shoe covers the ankle or more of the leg. People wear it in rain or snow. It can keep feet dry.
The verb can mean starting a computer. A person presses the power button. The screen loads programs.
Some vehicles have a storage space at the back. Travelers put bags there. Check that the door is closed before driving.

examples.en: The long lecture bored the students, so the teacher added a game.
examples.zh: 冗長的演講讓學生感到無聊，所以老師加入了一個遊戲。

examples.en: Dad used a drill to bore a hole in the board.
examples.zh: 爸爸用電鑽在木板上鑽了一個洞。

examples.en: She bore the heavy box with help from her brother.
examples.zh: 她在哥哥的協助下搬起了沉重的箱子。

explains: A person or activity can make someone feel uninterested. A long speech with no pictures may lose the listeners. A lively example helps.
A drill can make a round hole in wood or another material. Wear eye protection. An adult should guide the tool.
The past form of bear can mean carrying or enduring something. A person may carry a heavy load. Context shows which meaning fits.

examples.en: We went bowling with our cousins on Saturday.
examples.zh: 星期六我們和表親們一起去打保齡球。

examples.en: Bowling helped me practice aiming and taking turns.
examples.zh: 打保齡球幫助我練習瞄準和輪流。

examples.en: Our bowling game lasted about an hour.
examples.zh: 我們打保齡球大約打了一個小時。

explains: Players roll a heavy ball toward pins at the end of a lane. The goal is to knock down as many as possible. Shoes are often rented.
A turn lets someone roll two times. Scores are added. Friends cheer for every player.
The ball should stay in its lane. Wait until others finish before stepping forward. Follow the center's safety rules.

examples.en: Step on the brake pedal gently to bring the car to a halt.
examples.zh: 輕踩煞車踏板使車輛平穩停下。

examples.en: The bicycle brakes failed when he was going downhill.
examples.zh: 他的腳踏車煞車在下坡時失靈了。

examples.en: Drivers must brake quickly when an animal darts into the road.
examples.zh: 當動物突然衝到路上時，駕駛必須迅速踩煞車。

explains: A device slows or stops a bicycle or car. A driver presses a pedal. The vehicle should stop before a crosswalk.
The verb means making something slow down. A cyclist squeezes the handle gently. They leave room to stop safely.
Regular checks help keep the parts in good condition. If something makes a strange sound, tell an adult. Safe equipment matters.

examples.en: The old brass bell rang loudly in the school hall.
examples.zh: 那只舊黃銅鈴在學校大廳響亮地響起。

examples.en: She polished the brass handle until it shone.
examples.zh: 她把黃銅把手擦亮，直到它閃閃發光。

examples.en: The band played trumpets made of brass.
examples.zh: 樂隊演奏了黃銅製的小號。

explains: A yellow metal is made by mixing copper and zinc. It is used for instruments, handles, and decorations. It can shine when polished.
Some musical instruments are made from this material. Trumpets make bright sounds. Players clean them after practice.
The color can look gold-like. A door handle may be made this way. Gentle cleaning keeps it bright.

examples.en: The girl's bravery helped her rescue the kitten from the tree.
examples.zh: 女孩的勇敢幫助她從樹上救下小貓。

examples.en: The firefighters showed bravery during the mountain rescue.
examples.zh: 消防員在山區救援中展現了勇氣。

examples.en: It took bravery to tell the truth about the broken window.
examples.zh: 承認窗戶是自己打破的，需要很大的勇氣。

explains: Courage helps a person face something frightening or difficult. A child may tell an adult about bullying. Speaking up can protect others.
A firefighter enters danger to help people. Training prepares them. They work carefully as a team.
Being courageous does not mean having no fear. Someone may feel nervous but still do what is right. Friends can encourage them.

examples.en: The bird had a white breast and a dark gray back.
examples.zh: 這隻鳥胸前是白色，背部則是深灰色。

examples.en: The doctor checked his breast after the fall.
examples.zh: 跌倒後，醫生檢查了他的胸部。

examples.en: Mom baked chicken breast with herbs for dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽晚餐烤了香草雞胸肉。

explains: This is one of the soft areas on the front of a person’s chest. It contains tissue and small glands. In a mother, these glands can make milk to feed a baby.
A bird has a chest area with feathers. Some kinds show bright colors there. It can help people identify the species.
Some meat comes from the chest area of a chicken or turkey. It is often sold without bones or skin. Cooks may bake it, grill it, or slice it for sandwiches.

examples.en: Take a deep breath before you begin the swimming lesson.
examples.zh: 游泳課開始前先深呼吸。

examples.en: His breath made a little cloud in the cold air.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸在冷空氣中形成一小團白霧。

examples.en: The runner paused to catch her breath near the finish line.
examples.zh: 跑者在終點線附近停下來喘口氣。

explains: A person may pause after running. Air moves in and out of the lungs. Slow, steady air movement can help the body rest.
Cold air can look like a small cloud when someone exhales outdoors. This happens on chilly days. The cloud disappears quickly.
Fresh air can feel pleasant. Open a window when it is safe. Plants help keep outdoor air healthy.

examples.en: Remember to breathe slowly while you practice the song.
examples.zh: 練習歌曲時記得慢慢呼吸。

examples.en: The baby breathed softly while sleeping in the crib.
examples.zh: 寶寶在嬰兒床裡睡覺時輕柔地呼吸。

examples.en: We breathed fresh air near the pine trees.
examples.zh: 我們在松樹附近呼吸新鮮空氣。

explains: Air goes into the lungs and comes back out. This action keeps the body working. People may move air faster after exercise.
Smell can enter the nose with the air. Flowers may have a sweet scent. Some people avoid strong smells.
Slow, steady air movement can help someone relax. Sit comfortably and count quietly. Stop if the exercise feels uncomfortable.

examples.en: A cool breeze moved the curtains by the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣涼風吹動了敞開窗邊的窗簾。

examples.en: The children breezed through the easy puzzle together.
examples.zh: 孩子們一起輕鬆解開了那個簡單的謎題。

examples.en: She breezed into the room with a cheerful smile.
examples.zh: 她帶著愉快的笑容輕快地走進房間。

explains: A light wind moves gently through the air. It can cool people on a warm day. Leaves may flutter on a tree.
A person can move easily through a task. Good practice makes a familiar game feel simple. The player stays relaxed.
The verb can mean moving lightly through a place. A bird flies across the yard. It lands on a fence.

examples.en: Kiln-fired Minnan red bricks pave the temple courtyards, absorbing heavy summer rain puddles naturally.
examples.zh: 窯燒閩南清水紅磚鋪滿古廟前庭天井，吸水透氣且在大雨過後能迅速排乾積水。

examples.en: Traditional red bricks vary slightly in color and texture, giving the courtyard paving unique warmth.
examples.zh: 傳統手工柴燒紅磚色澤深淺溫潤、質地各具紋理，賦予老中庭鋪面無與倫比的人文溫度。

examples.en: Conservators sourced vintage recycled bricks from dismantled old houses to rebuild the damaged garden wall.
examples.zh: 修復團隊特地從拆除的閩南老宅中收購老舊回收磚，用以修補遭地震震損的花園照壁。

entries.definition: 閩南傳統紅磚 (薄磚尺二磚)；磚塊
explains: This is a hard block used to build walls. It is often made from clay that has been heated. Builders place many of these blocks in rows.
These building blocks may be red, brown, or another color. They can also cover a path. Even rows make a neat pattern.
A worker can build a wall by placing one row of small blocks above another. A wet mixture fills the spaces between them. The mixture becomes hard and holds the blocks together.

examples.en: The bride carried white flowers down the garden path.
examples.zh: 新娘手捧白色花束，沿著花園小徑走下去。

examples.en: The bride smiled as her family welcomed her at the hall.
examples.zh: 家人在大廳迎接新娘時，她露出了笑容。

examples.en: A friend helped the bride fasten her dress before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮前，一位朋友幫新娘扣好禮服。

explains: A woman getting married is often called this. She may wear a special dress. Friends and family celebrate with the couple.
People plan a ceremony and invite guests. Traditions differ from family to family. Kind wishes make the day joyful.
The person marrying her is called the groom. Both make promises. They may exchange rings or share a meal.

examples.en: The national emergency alert was broadcasted to all mobile phones.
examples.zh: 國家級防災警報已推播廣播至全體民眾手機。

examples.en: The radio station will broadcast the live championship game tonight.
examples.zh: 廣播電台今晚將即時現場實況轉播總冠軍爭霸戰。

examples.en: Satellite networks broadcast international news twenty-four hours a day.
examples.zh: 衛星電視網一天二十四小時不間斷播送即時國際新聞。

explains: A program is sent through radio, television, or the internet for many people to watch or hear. A news show shares current events. A clear signal helps homes receive the program.
The verb means sending sound or pictures to many listeners or viewers. A station may share a sports game. People tune in at home.
A live program happens as events take place. Hosts speak clearly. Viewers can follow along from different places.

examples.en: We had brunch at a small cafe after the morning walk.
examples.zh: 早晨散步後，我們在一間小咖啡館吃了早午餐。

examples.en: Sunday brunch included eggs, fruit, and warm bread.
examples.zh: 星期日的早午餐有雞蛋、水果和熱麵包。

examples.en: My cousins invited us to brunch at their home.
examples.zh: 表親們邀請我們到他們家吃早午餐。

explains: A meal eaten later in the morning combines breakfast and lunch. Families may enjoy eggs, fruit, or toast. It is often served on weekends.
People can meet friends over this meal. They talk while eating. A relaxed time makes the gathering pleasant.
Restaurants may offer a special menu around midday. Guests can choose sweet or savory dishes. A drink may come with the meal.

examples.en: A bubble floated over the fence and popped in the grass.
examples.zh: 一個泡泡飄過圍欄，在草地上破掉了。

examples.en: The soup began to bubble on the stove.
examples.zh: 湯在爐子上開始冒泡。

examples.en: We blew soap bubbles in the sunny garden.
examples.zh: 我們在陽光明媚的花園裡吹肥皂泡。

explains: A thin round pocket of air forms in soap, water, or another liquid. Children blow many with a wand. They float and then pop.
A verb can mean making liquid foam. Water makes foam as it boils. An adult should supervise cooking.
A rounded part may swell under the skin or paint. Do not poke it. Ask an adult what care is needed.

examples.en: The child filled a bucket with water for the garden plants.
examples.zh: 孩子裝了一桶水來澆花園植物。

examples.en: We carried a blue bucket of sand to the sandbox.
examples.zh: 我們提了一桶藍色的沙子到沙坑。

examples.en: Dad placed the mop inside the bucket after cleaning.
examples.zh: 清潔後，爸爸把拖把放進桶子裡。

explains: A container with a handle can carry water, sand, or tools. It is usually wide at the top. A lid may cover it.
Children fill one with sand at the beach. They build a tower. A small shovel helps shape it.
A worker may use it to move cleaning supplies. Keep heavy loads low. Carry carefully to prevent spills.

examples.en: A pink bud appeared at the end of the rose stem.
examples.zh: 玫瑰枝條末端冒出一個粉紅色花苞。

examples.en: The tree began to bud after several warm days.
examples.zh: 連續幾天暖和後，樹開始長出新芽。

examples.en: The closed bud opened into a yellow flower.
examples.zh: 緊閉的花苞綻放成一朵黃色花。

explains: A small closed flower grows before opening. It sits on a stem. Warm sunlight helps it bloom.
A young branch may also begin to grow on a plant. Gardeners watch for new growth in spring. Water helps the roots.
The verb means beginning to grow. Trees form new leaves as the weather warms. Bees visit when flowers open.

examples.en: Plan a monthly travel budget before heading to Japan.
examples.zh: 出發去日本前先規劃每月的旅遊預算。

examples.en: We managed to decorate the living room on a very tight budget.
examples.zh: 我們在非常有限緊湊的預算內完成了客廳的裝潢。

examples.en: The government allocated a substantial budget for public transportation.
examples.zh: 政府編列了大筆預算用於大眾交通建設。

examples.en: Create a realistic monthly living budget and track your daily spending.
examples.zh: 制定切實可行的每月生活預算並認真記錄每日開銷。

examples.en: The city council approved a multi-million dollar annual municipal budget.
examples.zh: 市議會正式投票通過了高達數百萬美元的年度市政建設財政預算案。

examples.en: We stayed at clean, budget-friendly hotels to keep our holiday costs manageable.
examples.zh: 我們刻意挑選乾淨又經濟實惠的平價飯店入住，以妥善控制度假總開銷。

entries.definition: 預算；編列預算；平價的；低價的
explains: A plan shows how much money is available and what it will pay for. A family may set aside money for food and bills. It helps a family plan its spending.
A project can have a spending limit. Workers compare prices before buying supplies. Careful planning helps them stay within it.
The verb means planning expenses. A club chooses how to use its funds. Members agree on what is most important.

examples.en: A buffalo grazed with its herd across the wide plain.
examples.zh: 一頭水牛和牛群一起在寬廣的平原上吃草。

examples.en: The buffalo's horns curved upward above its head.
examples.zh: 水牛的角在頭上向上彎曲。

examples.en: We saw a buffalo at the wildlife park.
examples.zh: 我們在野生動物園看到一頭水牛。

explains: A large, strong animal with horns may live on grasslands. It travels in a herd. Calves stay near adults for safety.
The name can refer to different related animals in different places. Some live in Africa or Asia. Others once roamed North America.
This animal eats grass and plants. People should observe it from a safe distance. It can run quickly when frightened.

examples.en: The hotel breakfast buffet serves both Taiwanese and Western dishes.
examples.zh: 飯店早餐自助吧供應中式與西式料理。

examples.en: We enjoyed an all-you-can-eat seafood buffet on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我們在週五晚上享用了海鮮吃到飽自助餐。

examples.en: Guests can choose from a wide selection of desserts at the buffet station.
examples.zh: 賓客可以在自助餐吧台挑選種類豐富的甜點。

explains: A meal has many dishes set out for guests to choose. People take a plate and serve themselves. They should leave enough for others.
A long table may hold salads, rice, and desserts. Each person picks what they like. A helper can explain the foods.
The word can also mean hitting repeatedly in strong wind or waves. A boat moves roughly. Passengers hold on safely.

examples.en: The flower bulb needs rich soil and plenty of sunlight.
examples.zh: 這顆花卉球莖需要肥沃的土壤和充足陽光。

examples.en: Dad replaced the light bulb in the hallway lamp.
examples.zh: 爸爸更換了走廊燈裡的燈泡。

examples.en: A small bulb began to grow beside the onion plant.
examples.zh: 洋蔥植株旁開始長出一個小球莖。

explains: A rounded part of a plant can grow underground and produce new shoots. An onion is one example. Gardeners plant some in autumn.
A glass or plastic object gives light when fitted into a lamp. It may need replacing when it stops working. Turn off power first.
The base connects it to a socket. Different shapes give different kinds of light. Choose one that fits the lamp.

examples.en: The bull stood quietly beside the fence in the field.
examples.zh: 公牛安靜地站在田地的圍欄旁。

examples.en: A bull elephant seal rested on the beach.
examples.zh: 一頭雄性象鼻海豹在海灘上休息。

examples.en: The farmer kept the bull in a separate pasture.
examples.zh: 農夫把公牛養在另一片牧場裡。

explains: An adult male cow has a strong body and may have horns. Farmers keep animals in secure fields. People should not go near it.
The word can also name a male elephant seal or whale. Such animals may be large. They live in groups or alone.
A person may use it in casual speech to mean something untrue. It can sound rude. Polite words are better at school.

examples.en: The police found a bullet casing near the closed road.
examples.zh: 警方在封閉道路附近找到一個彈殼。

examples.en: Add a bullet before each item in the shopping list.
examples.zh: 請在購物清單的每個項目前加上圓點。

examples.en: The book showed how a bullet can travel through the air.
examples.zh: 書中展示了子彈如何在空中飛行。

explains: A small piece of metal is fired from a gun. It can seriously hurt people. Never touch ammunition or weapons.
The word also describes a small printed mark at the start of a list. It helps readers see each point clearly. Short points make a list easy to scan.
People may see this term in news or books about history. Adults can explain it safely. Violence causes lasting harm.

examples.en: I bumped my knee on the low table.
examples.zh: 我的膝蓋撞到了矮桌。

examples.en: A small bump in the road shook the bicycle.
examples.zh: 路上的一個小凸起讓腳踏車晃了一下。

examples.en: We bumped into our teacher at the market.
examples.zh: 我們在市場偶然遇見老師。

explains: A raised place can appear on a surface or body. A small rise in a road makes a ride rough. Drivers slow down.
The verb means hitting something lightly by accident. Someone may touch a table in a narrow room. They say sorry and move carefully.
A person can meet someone unexpectedly. Friends run into each other at the store. They stop to talk.

examples.en: She picked a bunch of purple flowers for her mother.
examples.zh: 她為媽媽摘了一束紫色的花。

examples.en: A bunch of grapes sat in the bowl on the counter.
examples.zh: 一串葡萄放在流理台上的碗裡。

examples.en: A bunch of children gathered around the storyteller.
examples.zh: 一群孩子聚在說故事的人身旁。

explains: A group of similar things tied or held together can be called this. A cluster of grapes hangs from a stem. Each fruit is connected.
People can gather flowers into a handful. A ribbon keeps them together. The arrangement makes a nice gift.
It can also mean a group of people. Friends arrive at the park together. They decide what game to play.

examples.en: He carried a bundle of blankets to the guest room.
examples.zh: 他把一捆毯子搬到客房。

examples.en: The shop sold a bundle of pencils and notebooks together.
examples.zh: 商店把一組鉛筆和筆記本搭配販售。

examples.en: She bundled the dry branches with a piece of twine.
examples.zh: 她用一段細繩把乾樹枝捆在一起。

explains: Several things tied or wrapped together make one package. A person may carry sticks for a fire. A rope keeps them in place.
A collection of services or items can be sold together. A computer package may include programs. The buyer checks what is included.
The verb means wrapping or tying things into a group. Fold clothes neatly. Use string to hold them together.

examples.en: The dog likes to bury its bone in the garden.
examples.zh: 狗喜歡把骨頭埋在花園裡。

examples.en: We buried the seed in the soil and watered it.
examples.zh: 我們把種子埋進土裡並澆了水。

examples.en: He buried the old letter in a box of photographs.
examples.zh: 他把那封舊信埋在一盒照片裡。

explains: To put something under the ground and cover it with soil is to do this. Gardeners place seeds below the surface. They water the spot.
A pet's body may be placed in the earth after it dies. Families can remember it kindly. Follow local rules.
A person can hide an object under other things. A child covers a toy in sand. Friends search for it later.

examples.en: A small bird nested in the bush beside our porch.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥在我們門廊旁的灌木裡築巢。

examples.en: We planted a green bush near the garden gate.
examples.zh: 我們在花園門旁種了一株綠色灌木。

examples.en: The puppy hid behind the bush during the game.
examples.zh: 遊戲時，小狗躲在灌木後面。

explains: A low woody plant has many stems growing close together. Birds may build nests inside it. Gardeners trim it to shape.
The plant can make a natural border around a yard. Flowers or berries may grow on some kinds. Check before eating any fruit.
A person can hide behind thick plants. In games, players use them for cover. Be careful of insects and thorns.

examples.en: A bee buzzed around the yellow flowers.
examples.zh: 一隻蜜蜂在黃色花朵周圍嗡嗡飛。

examples.en: The old phone began to buzz on the desk.
examples.zh: 舊手機在桌上開始震動作響。

examples.en: The market buzzed with shoppers before the holiday.
examples.zh: 節日前，市場裡滿是熱鬧的購物人潮。

explains: A low continuous sound can come from a bee or electric device. People hear it nearby. Find the cause before touching anything.
The verb means making this kind of noise. A fly moves around the room. It lands on the window.
A place can feel full of excited activity. A fair has music and games. Visitors talk and laugh.

examples.en: The spacious wide-body aircraft cabin features dynamic circadian mood lighting.
examples.zh: 寬體雙走道大型客機的客艙內部配備了能隨日夜時間智慧調節情境色彩的舒壓情境燈光。

examples.en: We rented a rustic wooden cabin nestled among the tall pine trees in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們在連假期間包棟租下了一間隱身於高山參天松樹林間的溫馨質樸原木小木屋度假。

examples.en: The airplane cabin pressure is maintained comfortably at an equivalent altitude of 6,000 feet.
examples.zh: 現代民航客機在萬呎高空巡航時，機艙內部氣壓會始終自動恆定調節於人體舒適的六千英呎等效高度。

explains: A small simple house or room can stand in a forest or near a lake. Travelers may sleep there. It offers shelter from weather.
The front part of an airplane or ship holds the people who control it. They watch instruments. They follow safety steps.
A wooden shelter in the mountains may have beds and a stove. Visitors bring supplies. They leave the place clean.

examples.en: Use a durable braided charging cable to avoid fraying.
examples.zh: 使用耐用的編織充電傳輸線以防止磨損斷裂。

examples.en: Undersea fiber-optic cables carry massive amounts of international internet traffic.
examples.zh: 海底光纖電纜乘載著龐大巨量的國際網際網路傳輸量。

examples.en: The cable television network offers dozens of international news channels.
examples.zh: 有線電視網絡提供了數十個國際新聞頻道。

explains: A thick wire or group of wires carries electricity or information. A charger connects a device to power. Handle damaged parts carefully.
A strong rope made from metal strands can lift heavy objects. Workers inspect it before use. Safety rules protect everyone nearby.
A television service may send shows through a line or network. People choose programs on a screen. A steady connection helps.

examples.en: The campus cafeteria serves affordable and nutritious set lunches.
examples.zh: 校園學生餐廳供應平價且營養均衡的套餐午餐。

examples.en: We met up at the central cafeteria to grab a quick coffee between classes.
examples.zh: 我們下課空檔在中央學生餐廳碰面喝杯咖啡。

examples.en: Vegetarian and halal dietary options are clearly labeled in the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生餐廳內對素食與清真飲食選項皆有清楚標註。

explains: A dining room serves meals to many people, often at a school or workplace. Diners choose food from a counter. They carry a tray.
Staff prepare dishes and keep the room clean. People return used plates to a collection area. Everyone waits in an orderly line.
Students may eat lunch there with classmates. A balanced meal gives energy for afternoon lessons. Kind table manners help everyone enjoy it.

examples.en: The lush green campus is shaded by tall historic banyan trees.
examples.zh: 綠意盎然的校園內綠樹成蔭，遍植歷史悠久的古榕。

examples.en: Electric rental bikes are convenient for traveling across the large university campus.
examples.zh: 租賃電動腳踏車在遼闊的大學校園內穿梭代步非常便利。

examples.en: Safety emergency phones are positioned strategically throughout the college campus.
examples.zh: 緊急求救電話在大學校園各處皆設有妥善規劃的求助據點。

examples.en: National Taiwan University's main campus is lined with majestic royal palms.
examples.zh: 國立台灣大學校總區椰林大道兩側種植著高聳壯觀的大王椰子樹。

examples.en: Free high-speed Wi-Fi covers every corner of the university campus.
examples.zh: 免費的高速無線網路全面覆蓋了整座大學校園的每一個角落。

examples.en: Students love hanging out on the green lawn in the center of the campus.
examples.zh: 學生們課餘時間最喜歡聚在大學校園中央的綠油油大草坪上聊天休憩。

explains: The buildings and grounds of a school or college form one area. Students walk between classrooms and a library. Signs point the way.
A large place may include gardens, sports fields, and offices. Visitors can use a map. Stay on paths and respect quiet areas.
People who study or work there make a community. Clubs plan activities. Everyone shares responsibility for keeping it clean.

examples.en: The river carved a deep canyon through the red rock.
examples.zh: 河流在紅色岩層間切出一道深峽谷。

examples.en: We viewed the canyon from a safe lookout point.
examples.zh: 我們在安全的觀景點欣賞峽谷。

examples.en: A narrow trail led down into the canyon.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的小徑通往峽谷深處。

explains: A deep narrow valley has steep sides, often carved by a river over a long time. Layers of rock can be seen on its walls. Layers of rock record changes over time.
Visitors may hike along a marked trail to enjoy the view. They stay behind safety barriers. Loose stones can fall.
Some of these landforms are very wide and large. People should carry water on a walk. Follow park rules and signs.

examples.en: Maya is capable of finishing the puzzle by herself.
examples.zh: 瑪雅有能力獨自完成這個謎題。

examples.en: The small boat is capable of carrying four people.
examples.zh: 這艘小船可以載四個人。

examples.en: Our capable guide found the trail through the forest.
examples.zh: 我們能幹的導遊找到了穿越森林的小徑。

explains: A person has the ability to do a task. A child can tie their shoes alone. Practice helps improve the skill.
A tool or machine can perform a certain job. A small pump moves water. Read directions before using it.
People have different strengths. Someone may be good at solving puzzles. Another person may be helpful with younger children.

examples.en: The captain steered the boat into the quiet harbor.
examples.zh: 船長把船駛進安靜的港口。

examples.en: Our team captain thanked everyone after the final game.
examples.zh: 最後一場比賽後，我們的隊長向大家道謝。

examples.en: The airplane captain welcomed passengers before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飛機機長在起飛前歡迎乘客。

explains: A leader is in charge of a ship or airplane. They guide the crew. They check that everyone follows safety rules.
A sports team may choose one player to lead. That person encourages teammates. They speak with the referee when needed.
The leader helps make decisions during a trip or game. Experience can be useful. Listening to others is important too.

examples.en: Direct air capture (DAC) vacuum fans pull ambient air through chemical filters to extract CO2 directly.
examples.zh: 巨型直接空氣捕捉機組（DAC）利用渦輪風扇抽入環境空氣，透過化學吸附劑直接自大氣中濾出二氧化碳。

examples.en: The wildlife photographer spent hours camouflaged in the grass to capture the rare leopard on film.
examples.zh: 國家地理野生動物攝影師身披迷彩偽裝草服，在濕地草叢中耐著蚊蟲叮咬苦守數小時，只為捕捉到珍禽展翅的特寫。

examples.en: The police successfully carried out the capture of the armed fugitive without any civilian casualties.
examples.zh: 霹靂小組全副武裝拂曉出擊，以迅雷不及掩耳之勢成功生擒逮捕了持槍逃亡的重刑通緝犯，未造成任何無辜民眾受傷。

entries.definition: 巨型直接空氣碳捕捉設施 (DAC)；捕捉
explains: A camera records a picture or video of a moment. A photographer waits for good light. The image keeps a memory.
A person can catch an animal or object and keep it from moving away. Wildlife workers handle animals carefully. They release them when safe.
A team may win control of a ball during a game. Players move quickly. Fair rules guide the match.

examples.en: Learning good English is beneficial for your future career.
examples.zh: 學好英語對你未來的職業生涯大有助益。

examples.en: She made a bold career transition from finance to environmental conservation.
examples.zh: 她做出了一次大膽的職涯轉折，從金融界跨足投身生態環境保育。

examples.en: A mentor's guidance can open unexpected doors in your professional career.
examples.zh: 一位良師益友的引導能在你的專業職業生涯中開啟意想不到的機遇。

examples.en: She built a successful career in digital marketing and branding.
examples.zh: 她在數位行銷與品牌經營領域開創了成功的事業。

examples.en: Choosing a fulfilling career path requires reflecting on your core personal strengths.
examples.zh: 挑選一條能帶來成就感的職涯道路，需要深刻反思審視個人的核心優勢。

examples.en: Internships provide college graduates with a strong launching pad for their careers.
examples.zh: 實習經歷為剛踏出校門的大學畢業生提供了邁向未來璀璨職業生涯的堅實起跑點。

explains: A person's work over many years can follow a path. Someone may begin as a helper and later lead a team. Learning supports progress.
People choose jobs that match their interests and skills. A nurse cares for patients. A builder makes homes and roads.
A work path can change over time. Training may open new choices. Talking with trusted adults can help a young person explore.

examples.en: The carpenter built a small table for the classroom.
examples.zh: 木工師傅為教室製作了一張小桌子。

examples.en: A carpenter measured the boards before cutting them.
examples.zh: 木工師傅切割木板前先量好了尺寸。

examples.en: My uncle works as a carpenter and repairs old doors.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是木工師傅，會修理舊門。

explains: A worker builds or repairs things made from wood. They measure boards and cut them carefully. Tools help join pieces together.
This craft can make tables, doors, or houses. Safety glasses protect the eyes. Careful planning keeps the structure strong.
A person learning the job practices with simple projects. They follow instructions. Experience helps them work neatly.

examples.en: The red carpet felt soft beneath our feet.
examples.zh: 紅地毯在我們腳下感覺很柔軟。

examples.en: A carpet of yellow leaves covered the garden path.
examples.zh: 一層黃色落葉覆蓋了花園小徑。

examples.en: We vacuumed the carpet before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到達前，我們把地毯吸乾淨了。

explains: A thick fabric covers a floor and makes it feel softer. It can keep a room warm. Vacuuming removes dust and crumbs.
A patterned rug may cover part of a room. Children sit on it to play. Choose a color that fits the furniture.
A verb can mean covering an area completely. Fresh snow lies over a field. White flakes hide the grass beneath.

examples.en: Our reserved seats are in train carriage number six.
examples.zh: 我們的劃位座位在火車第六節車廂。

examples.en: Cinderella rode to the palace ball in a magical pumpkin carriage.
examples.zh: 灰姑娘搭乘神奇的南瓜馬車前往皇宮舞會。

examples.en: Passengers should maintain silence in the designated quiet carriage.
examples.zh: 乘客在專屬的靜音車廂內應當保持肅靜。

explains: A vehicle with wheels may be pulled by a horse. People rode in it long ago. Some are still used for tours.
A train can have separate sections for passengers. Each part has seats. Doors connect the parts together.
A baby's bed may rock gently from side to side. Parents place the child inside. Keep the wheels locked when still.

examples.en: Dad pushed the cart through the grocery store.
examples.zh: 爸爸推著購物車穿過雜貨店。

examples.en: The farmer loaded apples onto a wooden cart.
examples.zh: 農夫把蘋果裝上木製推車。

examples.en: I added a notebook to my online cart before checkout.
examples.zh: 結帳前，我把一本筆記本加入線上購物車。

explains: A small vehicle with wheels carries groceries or other items. Someone pushes it through a store. Keep it out of the way afterward.
A horse or another animal may pull this vehicle. It can carry farm goods. Strong wheels make it easier to move.
A computer shop may show a list of items someone plans to buy. The shopper checks the total before paying. A button removes items no longer needed.

examples.en: The period drama features a star-studded cast of veteran Taiwanese actors.
examples.zh: 這部時代旗艦大戲匯聚了眾多台灣實力派資深老戲骨組成的黃金陣容。

examples.en: The theatrical director will cast the leading roles after three intensive rounds of auditions.
examples.zh: 舞台劇導演將在歷經整整三輪高強度的嚴格試鏡選拔後，正式拍板決定領銜主演的演員陣容。

examples.en: The doctor put a plaster cast on the athlete's broken wrist to keep the bone immobilized.
examples.zh: 骨科主治醫師在這位運動員骨折的手腕上打上了厚重的固定石膏繃帶，以確保受傷骨骼完全靜止癒合。

examples.en: The orthopedist fitted a waterproof fiberglass cast to immobilize the broken arm.
examples.zh: 骨科名醫為病患裝上透氣防水的輕量化玻璃纖維石膏以牢牢固定骨折的手臂。

examples.en: Friends and classmates covered his white plaster leg cast with colorful signatures and well-wishes.
examples.zh: 熱情的同班同學與好友們紛紛拿出彩色奇異筆，在他腿上白色的石膏外殼上簽名並寫滿祝福。

examples.en: Keep your cast clean and completely dry to avoid irritating the healing skin underneath.
examples.zh: 請務必保持受傷部位固定的石膏內部清潔與乾爽透氣，以防石膏下悶熱引發皮膚濕疹發癢。

entries.definition: 演員陣容；選角；投擲；骨折石膏固定；模具
explains: Actors perform a story in a play or film. They learn their lines. Each person portrays a character.
A doctor may cover a broken arm or leg with a hard shell. This keeps the bones still while they heal. It stays on until the injury heals.
The verb can also mean throwing a fishing line or giving a shadow. A person moves their arm. The action depends on context.

examples.en: The picnic dress code is casual, so wear comfortable clothes.
examples.zh: 野餐的服裝規定很輕鬆，穿舒適的衣服就可以。

examples.en: We had a casual chat while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公車時，我們輕鬆地聊了一會兒。

examples.en: His casual shoes were perfect for walking around town.
examples.zh: 他的休閒鞋很適合在鎮上四處走走。

explains: Clothes for everyday wear are comfortable and not formal. A T-shirt and jeans may suit a picnic. A wedding needs dressier clothes.
A relaxed conversation feels friendly and easy. People can talk about a game. They still listen politely.
A person may behave in an informal way with friends. Different settings call for different manners. School rules should be followed.

examples.en: The cattle moved slowly across the green pasture.
examples.zh: 牛群慢慢地穿過綠色牧場。

examples.en: A farmer checked the cattle before sunrise.
examples.zh: 農夫在日出前查看了牛群。

examples.en: The cattle rested in the shade on a hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎熱的午後，牛群在樹蔭下休息。

explains: Large farm animals such as cows and bulls are kept for milk or meat. They graze in fields. Farmers provide water and shelter.
A group may move together across a pasture. Fences keep them safe. Workers check their health.
The animals need room to eat and rest. Clean barns help during cold weather. Treat farm animals kindly.

examples.en: The explorers carried lanterns into the dark cave.
examples.zh: 探險者提著燈籠走進黑暗的洞穴。

examples.en: A bat flew out of the cave at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時，一隻蝙蝠從洞穴裡飛了出來。

examples.en: We found a cool cave beside the hiking trail.
examples.zh: 我們在健行小徑旁發現一個涼爽的洞穴。

explains: A hollow space inside a hill or cliff can be formed by water over time. Some are dark and cool. People use lights to explore.
Bats or other animals may live inside. Visitors should not disturb them. Stay on marked paths.
A person can hide in such a space in a story. A rock opening may be small or very large. Never enter an unsafe place alone.

examples.en: Taiwan's baseball team became the world champion!
examples.zh: 台灣棒球隊成為了世界冠軍！

examples.en: He trained rigorously for months to defend his title as boxing champion.
examples.zh: 他嚴格訓練了數個月以捍衛自己的拳擊冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: The grand champion received a sparkling trophy and monetary reward.
examples.zh: 總冠軍獲得了一座閃亮的獎盃與豐厚的獎金。

examples.en: Our school basketball team became the city champion.
examples.zh: 我們學校的籃球隊奪得了全市冠軍。

examples.en: She was crowned the national chess champion after an undefeated season.
examples.zh: 她在整個賽季保持不敗後榮膺全國西洋棋冠軍。

examples.en: Martin Luther King Jr. was a fearless champion of civil rights and equality.
examples.zh: 馬丁·路德·金恩博士是民權與平權運動無畏的倡導捍衛者。

examples.en: The champion competition oolong fetched thousands of dollars per kilogram at the spring auction.
examples.zh: 在全縣產銷班春茶評鑑競賽中勇奪「特等獎」的冠軍茶，在拍賣會上創下一台斤數十萬元的驚人身價。

examples.en: The tennis champion hoisted the championship trophy aloft as flashbulbs lit up the center court.
examples.zh: 這位衛冕成功的世界網球球王在閃光燈閃爍耀眼的中央球場中央，興奮高舉起沉甸甸的大滿貫冠軍金杯。

examples.en: Civil rights attorneys champion the protection of marginalized migrant worker rights in court.
examples.zh: 人權公益律師群長年義無反顧挺身而出，在法庭上堅定捍衛與倡導外籍弱勢移工的各項基本勞動尊嚴與法律權益。

examples.en: By finishing what you started with total excellence, you have proven yourself a true learning champion.
examples.zh: 秉持著極致追求並堅持到底完成這項壯舉，你已經向自己證明了你就是真正的「學習大冠軍」（Champion）。

examples.en: The world boxing champion trained with relentless humility to defend his coveted title.
examples.zh: 這位世界級拳王帶著無比謙遜與自律的刻苦精神投入訓練，誓言衛冕這座眾人夢寐以求的金腰帶。

examples.en: Civic leaders must champion renewable energy policies to safeguard our planet’s ecological future.
examples.zh: 社會公民領袖應當身先士卒挺身倡導支持綠色再生能源政策，共同守護地球生生不息的生態未來。

entries.definition: 冠軍；優勝者；捍衛；產銷班優良特等獎冠軍茶；堅持到底、戰勝自我之真正語言學習冠軍
explains: A person or team wins a contest and is recognized as the best. They practice hard. Other players congratulate them.
Someone may support a cause or person strongly. A teacher stands up for fair treatment. Their actions encourage others.
A winner should be humble and respectful. Losing teams can learn and try again. Sportsmanship matters to everyone.

examples.en: The old village has a special charm in the spring.
examples.zh: 這座古老村莊在春天有一種特別的魅力。

examples.en: She wore a silver charm on her bracelet.
examples.zh: 她在手環上戴了一個銀色吊飾。

examples.en: The storyteller charmed the children with a funny tale.
examples.zh: 說故事的人用有趣的故事逗得孩子們很開心。

explains: A pleasing quality makes someone or something attractive. A friendly smile can make guests feel welcome. Kindness is memorable.
A small object may be worn on a bracelet for luck. It can have a special shape. People give one as a gift.
The verb can mean delighting someone. A funny story makes children laugh. A warm voice helps too.

examples.en: We had a quick chat while walking home from school.
examples.zh: 我們放學回家時快速聊了一下。

examples.en: The children chatted about their favorite cartoons at lunch.
examples.zh: 孩子們午餐時聊起最喜歡的卡通。

examples.en: I sent a chat message to my cousin about the party.
examples.zh: 我傳訊息給表親，告訴他派對的事。

explains: A friendly conversation is usually short and informal. Neighbors talk while watering plants. They share local news.
People can send brief messages through a phone or computer. Friends ask how each other is doing. They should be kind online.
Talking can help people get to know one another. Asking questions shows interest. Listening matters as much as speaking.

examples.en: A tear rolled down her cheek after the sad movie.
examples.zh: 看完悲傷的電影後，一滴淚水滑過她的臉頰。

examples.en: The little boy had a red mark on his cheek.
examples.zh: 小男孩的臉頰上有一道紅印。

examples.en: Grandma kissed my cheek before I left for school.
examples.zh: 我上學前，奶奶親了我的臉頰。

explains: This soft part of the face lies below the eye and beside the nose. People may blush there. A smile lifts it slightly.
A parent may kiss a child's face as a sign of love. Some animals have pouches inside this area to carry food. Chewing also helps break food into smaller pieces.
The inside surface helps move food while chewing. Teeth press food against it. A dentist checks the mouth during visits.

examples.en: Her cheerful laughter always brightens the classroom mood.
examples.zh: 她開朗清脆的笑聲總能點亮整間教室的氣氛。

examples.en: The barista greeted every sleepy morning commuter with a warm, cheerful hello.
examples.zh: 咖啡師總是帶著溫暖熱情的親切問候，迎接每一位睡眼惺忪的晨間通勤上班族。

examples.en: Bright yellow sunflowers painted on the cafe wall create a sunny, cheerful atmosphere.
examples.zh: 咖啡廳牆面上彩繪的明亮向日葵圖樣，營造出宛如燦爛陽光般的愉悅明朗氛圍。

entries.definition: 開朗的；興高采烈的；令人愉快的
explains: A person feels happy and shows it with a smile or bright voice. Their good mood can lift a room. Friends enjoy their company.
A place can look bright and pleasant. Yellow curtains make a kitchen feel sunny. Flowers add color.
Kind greetings help others feel welcome. People can share a joke. A little kindness can improve someone's day.

examples.en: Pickers select only deep burgundy red coffee cherries at peak sugar brix levels across steep slopes.
examples.zh: 採豆工在陡峭斜坡上，手眼並用僅採摘糖度達標、色澤如紅寶石般熟透的咖啡鮮果。

examples.en: Green, unripe coffee cherries must be sorted out immediately to avoid astringent woody defects in the cup.
examples.zh: 未成熟的青綠咖啡漿果必須在第一時間挑除剔除，以杜絕杯中出現令人不悅的生澀木質雜味。

examples.en: Floating fresh coffee cherries in deep water tanks separates hollow floaters from dense, ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 將剛採下的新鮮咖啡鮮果倒入深水水槽中進行浮水篩選，能輕易將乾癟漂浮果與沉底飽滿熟果分開。

entries.definition: 人工手採全紅成熟咖啡鮮果；櫻桃
explains: A small round fruit may be red or dark purple. It has a pit in the middle. People eat it fresh or baked in a pie.
The tree has blossoms in spring. Later, fruit grows on the branches. Birds may enjoy it too.
A bright red shade is named after this fruit. Artists use it in pictures. A little color can make a design stand out.

examples.en: The doctor listened to my chest with a stethoscope.
examples.zh: 醫生用聽診器聽我的胸腔。

examples.en: Grandma kept old letters in a wooden chest.
examples.zh: 奶奶把舊信件收在一個木箱裡。

examples.en: He wore a warm vest over his chest on the cold day.
examples.zh: 寒冷的那天，他在胸前穿了一件保暖背心。

explains: The front part of the body between the neck and stomach holds the heart and lungs. Ribs protect these organs. A doctor can listen to the heartbeat there.
A box with a lid can store clothes or toys. Families may keep old photos in one. It can be made of wood or metal.
A person's breathing changes with exercise. Slow down if the body feels tired. An adult can help decide what to do.

examples.en: A chill ran through me when the cold wind blew.
examples.zh: 冷風吹來時，我打了個寒顫。

examples.en: Chill the juice in the refrigerator before the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐前先把果汁放進冰箱冰涼。

examples.en: We chilled at home and listened to music after the hike.
examples.zh: 健行後我們在家放鬆聽音樂。

explains: A feeling of cold may make someone shiver. A light jacket helps on a cool evening. Warm soup can also feel comforting.
The verb means making food or a drink cold. Put juice in the refrigerator. Wait before serving it.
A person may relax and spend time quietly. Friends listen to music at home. Everyone enjoys a calm afternoon.

examples.en: It was chilly beside the lake after the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽下山後，湖邊有些冷。

examples.en: A chilly breeze moved through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣涼風吹過敞開的窗戶。

examples.en: We wore jackets on the chilly morning walk.
examples.zh: 我們在微冷的早晨散步時穿上了外套。

explains: The air feels a little cold, but not freezing. A sweater may be enough. The sun can still shine brightly.
A room can feel cool when windows are open. Close them if needed. Warm socks help keep feet cozy.
Weather may become colder in the evening. Bring an extra layer when going outside. Check the forecast before a trip.

examples.en: Mineral chimneys towering twenty meters high spew billowing black clouds of sulfide crystals.
examples.zh: 高達二十公尺的礦物「黑煙囪」（Chimney），向冰冷海水中源源不絕噴吐出滾滾硫化物結晶黑煙。

examples.en: Smoke drifted peacefully from the stone brick chimney of the rustic cottage during snowy December.
examples.zh: 在飄雪的十二月裡，白煙裊裊從鄉間農舍古樸石砌煙囪中緩緩飄散至天際。

examples.en: Factory inspections revealed heavy soot accumulation inside the industrial furnace exhaust chimney.
examples.zh: 工廠例行安全安檢顯示，這座大型工業冶煉爐的廢氣排煙煙囪內部沉積了厚厚一層煤灰。

entries.definition: 高達數十公尺噴湧黑煙之金屬硫化物黑煙囪；煙囪
explains: A tall pipe carries smoke from a fireplace out above a roof. It should be cleaned so smoke can escape safely. A cap can keep rain from entering.
Some homes have a brick structure for this purpose. Birds may build a nest nearby. Keep the area clear.
A person in a holiday story may climb down it. Real homes need a safe, open passage for smoke. It appears in some festive stories.

examples.en: He rested his chin on his hands while reading.
examples.zh: 他閱讀時把下巴靠在手上。

examples.en: The helmet strap fits under her chin.
examples.zh: 安全帽的帶子繫在她的下巴下方。

examples.en: A small dimple appeared on the baby's chin when she smiled.
examples.zh: 寶寶微笑時，下巴上出現一個小酒窩。

explains: The lower front part of the face sits below the mouth. A person may rest a hand there while thinking. It may have a dimple in the skin.
This part can move when someone talks or chews. A helmet strap may pass under it. Adjust the strap so it fits safely.
A small dimple can appear in the skin there. Faces look different. People have many unique features.

examples.en: A chip broke off the edge of the blue plate.
examples.zh: 藍色盤子的邊緣缺了一小角。

examples.en: We shared a bowl of potato chips during the movie.
examples.zh: 看電影時，我們分著吃了一碗洋芋片。

examples.en: The carpenter chipped away a little wood to smooth the corner.
examples.zh: 木工師傅削掉一點木頭，讓角落變得平滑。

explains: A small broken piece may come from a cup or stone. Handle sharp edges carefully. Tell an adult if something breaks.
A thin crispy snack is often made from potato or corn. People eat it with a dip. A small bowl can share it.
The verb means cutting or breaking away a small piece. A tool can remove bits of wood. Wear eye protection during such work.

examples.en: Chop the fresh green onions into fine pieces.
examples.zh: 將新鮮青蔥切成細末。

examples.en: He chopped firewood in the forest before winter arrived.
examples.zh: 他在寒冬來臨前在森林裡劈砍柴火。

examples.en: We ordered pan-seared pork chops with mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 我們點了香煎豬排佐馬鈴薯泥。

explains: A cook cuts food into pieces with a knife. An adult should teach safe handling. Keep fingers away from the blade.
A cutting motion can cut wood or another material. Workers use proper tools. They wear safety gear.
The verb can also mean stopping something suddenly. Rain may end a game. Players move to a safe place.

examples.en: A cigarette butt lay beside the sidewalk bin.
examples.zh: 人行道垃圾桶旁有一個菸蒂。

examples.en: The warning on the cigarette box explains health risks.
examples.zh: 香菸盒上的警告說明了健康風險。

examples.en: The store does not sell cigarettes to children.
examples.zh: 商店不會把香菸賣給兒童。

explains: A small paper tube contains dried tobacco that people burn and inhale. The smoke can seriously harm health. It is not safe for children.
Adults may use these products even though they can become dependent on them. Quitting can be difficult. Health workers can offer support.
Smoke affects people nearby too. It can make breathing uncomfortable. Public rules often limit where smoking is allowed.

examples.en: Let's go to the cinema to watch the newly released superhero film.
examples.zh: 我們去電影院看新上映的超級英雄電影吧。

examples.en: The historic movie cinema was renovated with plush leather seats and surround sound.
examples.zh: 這家歷史悠久的電影院改裝了豪華真皮座椅與環繞音響設備。

examples.en: French cinema has had a profound influence on global filmmaking history.
examples.zh: 法國電影藝術對全球電影製作歷史產生了深遠的影響。

explains: A large room shows movies on a wide screen. People sit in rows and watch together. They may buy snacks before the show.
A company that makes films can also be called this. Workers plan stories and record scenes. Many people help finish a production.
The building has different rooms for screenings. Tickets show where to sit. Arrive on time so others can enjoy the start.

examples.en: The circus arrived in town with colorful tents and music.
examples.zh: 馬戲團帶著色彩繽紛的帳篷和音樂來到鎮上。

examples.en: My favorite circus act was the juggler with bright balls.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的馬戲表演是拋接彩球的雜耍藝人。

examples.en: The children saw acrobats perform at the circus.
examples.zh: 孩子們在馬戲團看了特技表演。

explains: A traveling show may include acrobats, clowns, music, and trained animals. Performers practice difficult moves. Safety equipment protects them.
A large tent can hold a ring and seats for visitors. People watch from the audience. They clap after each act.
In casual speech, a noisy or messy place may be compared to this kind of show. Keeping things organized helps everyone. It is best to keep the path tidy.

examples.en: Senior citizens enjoy discounts on public transportation.
examples.zh: 年長市民享有搭乘大眾運輸的優惠票價。

examples.en: Responsible citizens recycle waste and actively keep their neighborhood clean.
examples.zh: 負責任的公民落實資源回收，並積極維護社區環境整潔。

examples.en: Every citizen has the democratic right and civic duty to cast their vote.
examples.zh: 每一位公民都享有行使民主投票權利與善盡公民義務。

examples.en: Thousands of nature lovers log wildlife encounters on citizen science mobile platforms daily.
examples.zh: 全台數萬名熱愛大自然的民眾，每天透過「公民科學」（Citizen Science）App 即時回報上傳野生動植物觀察紀錄。

examples.en: Trained citizen observers contribute high-quality observation reports to the nationwide bird atlas.
examples.zh: 接受過生態辨識培訓的熱心公民觀察員，為國家級鳥類繁殖地圖資料庫貢獻了無數珍貴紀錄。

examples.en: Engaging citizen volunteers in butterfly counts fosters widespread grassroots passion for biodiversity.
examples.zh: 積極引導社區公民志工參與每季的蝴蝶物種普查，能於基層社會點燃守護生物多樣性的熱情。

entries.definition: 公民；國民；市民；全民參與公民科學物種回報生態 App
explains: A person who legally belongs to a country has rights and duties there. They may vote when old enough. Laws protect the community.
People help their town by following rules and caring for shared places. Picking up litter keeps parks pleasant. Small acts matter.
A member of a community can speak up about local needs. Neighbors attend meetings. They work together to solve problems.

examples.en: The civil engineer designed a safer bridge for the town.
examples.zh: 土木工程師為鎮上設計了一座更安全的橋。

examples.en: They stayed civil during the disagreement and found a solution.
examples.zh: 他們在意見不合時仍保持禮貌，並找到了解決方法。

examples.en: The town held a civil meeting about the new park.
examples.zh: 鎮上舉行了一場關於新公園的公民會議。

explains: This adjective describes things related to ordinary people and their community. Roads and libraries serve the public. Residents share responsibility for them.
A polite conversation is polite even when people disagree. Each person listens. Calm words can help settle a problem.
A legal matter between people or groups may be handled in a court for disputes between people or groups. The process follows rules. A lawyer can explain it.

examples.en: The potter shaped the wet clay into a small bowl.
examples.zh: 陶藝家把濕黏土捏成一個小碗。

examples.en: We made clay animals during art class.
examples.zh: 我們在美術課做了黏土動物。

examples.en: The garden soil has a lot of clay in it.
examples.zh: 花園土壤裡含有很多黏土。

explains: Soft earth can be shaped when wet and becomes hard after heating. Artists form bowls or figures from it. A kiln makes them strong.
Children may roll and press this material during art class. It sticks together easily. Cover it so it does not dry out.
Some soil contains this fine substance. It holds water well. Gardeners may mix it with other earth to help plants.

examples.en: The cleaner wiped the tables after the lunch period.
examples.zh: 清潔人員在午餐時段後擦拭桌子。

examples.en: Use a safe cleaner to remove the paint from the tile.
examples.zh: 使用安全的清潔劑去除磁磚上的油漆。

examples.en: The air cleaner helped reduce dust in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 空氣清淨機有助於減少臥室裡的灰塵。

explains: A person whose job is to keep rooms and surfaces tidy may be called this. They sweep floors and empty bins. Their work helps others.
A liquid or powder removes dirt from an object. Follow the label carefully. Keep it away from children and food.
A device can remove dust from air or water. It has a filter. Change the filter when instructions say.

examples.en: The client asked the designer to make the room brighter.
examples.zh: 客戶請設計師把房間設計得更明亮。

examples.en: The lawyer met with her client to discuss the case.
examples.zh: 律師和委託人會面討論案件。

examples.en: Our client chose a blue cover for the new book.
examples.zh: 我們的客戶為新書選了藍色封面。

explains: A person who pays for professional help is called this. A designer may listen to what they need. They agree on a plan.
A lawyer or doctor works with people who ask for their services. Private details should be kept safe. Trust is important.
A business may have regular customers. Workers remember what each person prefers. Clear communication helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: There are several pediatric and dental clinics on this street.
examples.zh: 這條街上有好幾家小兒科與牙醫診所。

examples.en: She went to the walk-in clinic for a quick flu checkup.
examples.zh: 她去了免預約門診診所進行快速流感檢查。

examples.en: The community health clinic provides free vaccinations for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 社區衛生診所為年長者提供免費疫苗接種。

explains: A small health center lets people see a doctor or nurse. They can ask questions and get basic care. Some places need an appointment.
A specialized office may help with teeth, eyes, or another need. Staff keep records private. Patients follow instructions.
People go there when they feel unwell or need a checkup. Call emergency services for serious danger. Bring needed information.

examples.en: She used a metal clip to hold the papers together.
examples.zh: 她用金屬夾把文件夾在一起。

examples.en: We watched a short clip about sea turtles in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上看了一段關於海龜的短片。

examples.en: Please clip the loose thread from the sleeve.
examples.zh: 請把袖子上鬆脫的線剪掉。

explains: A small fastener holds papers, hair, or objects together. It can open and close. Keep tiny pieces away from babies.
A short part of a film or video shows one moment. A teacher may play it in class. It should fit the lesson.
A person can cut off a small piece with scissors. Trim carefully. Ask an adult before cutting something important.

examples.en: Hang your clean shirts inside the bedroom closet.
examples.zh: 把乾淨的襯衫掛進臥室衣櫥裡。

examples.en: She organized her closet by sorting clothes neatly by color.
examples.zh: 她依顏色整齊分類衣服來整理自己的衣櫃。

examples.en: Store spare quilts and winter coats in the upper hallway closet.
examples.zh: 把備用棉被與厚重冬衣收納在走廊上方的儲藏櫃中。

examples.en: The master bedroom includes an organized walk-in closet fitted with LED glass wardrobe systems.
examples.zh: 主臥室規劃了動線寬敞的獨立走入式步入式更衣室，配備高透光燻黑玻璃鋁框 LED 衣櫃。

examples.en: Hanging cedar hangers inside your clothes closet repels pests and adds a fresh woodland scent.
examples.zh: 在更衣室衣櫃中懸掛純天然雪松木衣架，能有效驅除蛀蟲並散發出宜人舒心的天然森林木質香調。

examples.en: She tucked extra winter duvets and seasonal suitcases onto the high top shelves of the hallway closet.
examples.zh: 她將厚重的冬季羽絨被與過季大行李箱，整齊妥善收納於玄關走廊大型儲藏室頂層高處層架上。

entries.definition: 衣櫥；壁櫥；衣帽間；儲藏室
explains: A small enclosed space with a door stores clothes, shoes, or supplies. Shelves make it easier to organize. Keep the floor clear.
People hang coats inside on a rail. A box can hold hats. Labels help everyone find things.
A built-in storage space can be part of a bedroom or hallway. Some have sliding doors. Open them carefully so nothing falls.

examples.en: The volunteers clothe children who need warm winter coats.
examples.zh: 志工為需要保暖冬季大衣的孩子提供衣物。

examples.en: Parents clothed the baby in a soft cotton shirt.
examples.zh: 父母替寶寶穿上柔軟的棉質上衣。

examples.en: The costumes clothe the dancers in bright colors.
examples.zh: 這些服裝讓舞者穿上鮮豔的色彩。

explains: To put garments on a person is to cover their body for warmth or modesty. Parents help young children get dressed. Choose weather-appropriate items.
A charity may provide garments to families in need. Donating clean items can help. Check what the group accepts.
People select different fabrics for different activities. A raincoat keeps water off. Sports garments let the body move freely.

examples.en: The clown made the children laugh with a silly dance.
examples.zh: 小丑用滑稽的舞蹈逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: A clown at the parade waved to everyone on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 遊行中的小丑向人行道上的每個人揮手。

examples.en: He clowned around with his friends after school.
examples.zh: 放學後，他和朋友們嬉鬧玩笑。

explains: A performer wears a funny costume and makeup to make people laugh. They may tell jokes or do silly tricks. Children often enjoy the show.
A person can act playfully in a group. Being funny is fine when it does not hurt anyone. Respect others' feelings.
Some stories show a sad character behind the painted smile. People can feel many emotions. Ask a friend how they are doing.

examples.en: The muddy shoe print was a clue in the garden mystery.
examples.zh: 沾著泥巴的鞋印是花園謎案的一條線索。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a clue to help solve the riddle.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一條線索，幫助解開謎語。

examples.en: A torn map provided the first clue about the hidden path.
examples.zh: 一張破損的地圖提供了尋找隱藏小徑的第一條線索。

explains: A small piece of information helps solve a mystery or problem. A footprint may show who walked through the garden. Look carefully.
A hint can guide a learner toward an answer without giving it away. Teachers ask questions. Students think through the steps.
Detectives collect facts before deciding what happened. Each detail can matter. They check that evidence is reliable.

examples.en: The coach encouraged players to stay focused during the final minutes.
examples.zh: 教練激勵球員在最後幾分鐘保持專注。

examples.en: We boarded a luxury air-conditioned coach for the day trip to Taichung.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘一輛豪華冷氣長途巴士前往台中一日遊。

examples.en: She coaches junior tennis players at the local sports complex every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末她在當地運動中心指導青少年網球選手。

explains: A person teaches players how to improve in a sport. They plan practice and encourage the team. Players listen and try their best.
A large bus carries many people between places. It may be used for a school trip. Passengers stay seated while it moves.
The verb means guiding someone as they learn. A music teacher gives advice. The learner practices and grows more confident.

examples.en: The cock crowed loudly before the sun came up.
examples.zh: 太陽升起前，公雞大聲啼叫。

examples.en: The farmer opened the water cock to fill the trough.
examples.zh: 農夫打開水龍頭，把水槽裝滿。

examples.en: A red-combed cock walked across the farmyard.
examples.zh: 一隻紅冠公雞走過農場庭院。

explains: An adult male chicken has a comb on its head and may crow at sunrise. It lives on a farm. Hens lay eggs.
A small valve or handle controls the flow of liquid or gas. Turn it carefully. Ask an adult before touching one.
This word has an informal rude meaning in some contexts. Choose a polite word instead. Context matters when reading.

examples.en: The adults ordered a fruit cocktail with dinner.
examples.zh: 大人們晚餐時點了一份水果雞尾酒。

examples.en: The chef served a shrimp cocktail before the main meal.
examples.zh: 主廚在主餐前端上了蝦雞尾酒。

examples.en: She mixed a nonalcoholic cocktail with orange juice and mint.
examples.zh: 她用柳橙汁和薄荷調了一杯無酒精雞尾酒。

explains: A mixed drink combines several ingredients. Some versions contain alcohol and are for adults only. Children can choose fruit juice instead.
A small piece of food served before a meal may be called this. It can include shrimp or fruit. Use a clean serving dish.
Recipes vary from place to place. A cook measures each ingredient. Some drinks have bright colors and decorations.

examples.en: A coconut fell from the palm tree into the sand.
examples.zh: 一顆椰子從棕櫚樹上掉進沙裡。

examples.en: She added shredded coconut to the cake batter.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕麵糊裡加入椰子絲。

examples.en: We drank coconut water after playing at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊玩耍後喝了椰子水。

explains: A large hard-shelled fruit grows on a palm tree. Inside is white flesh and clear liquid. A strong tool opens the shell safely.
The white part can be grated for cooking. The liquid is refreshing. Keep pieces covered in the refrigerator.
Palm trees grow in warm places near the sea. Their fruit falls when ripe. Watch out when standing beneath them.

examples.en: The rescued male cat was fitted with a lightweight solar-powered GPS telemetry collar before release.
examples.zh: 傷癒野放的公石虎佩戴上超輕量太陽能「衛星 GPS 追蹤頸圈」（Collar），展開野外適應監測。

examples.en: Modern tracking collars feature automatic drop-off mechanisms that release safely after one year.
examples.zh: 現代追蹤項圈配備智慧自動脫落機制，在運作一年後會自行解鎖脫落以保障動物安全。

examples.en: Veterinary staff loosened the growing cub's tracking collar to prevent neck constriction.
examples.zh: 獸醫師適時調鬆成長中幼獸的追蹤頸圈，以避免頸部因體型增長而受到壓迫不適。

entries.definition: 輕量化太陽能衛星 GPS 定位追蹤頸圈；項圈
explains: A band of fabric goes around the neck of a shirt or coat. It may have buttons. Smooth it so it lies flat.
A strap around a pet's neck can hold a name tag. It should fit comfortably. Check it often as the animal grows.
The upper edge of a bottle or pipe may have a ring-shaped part. It can help join pieces. A worker checks that it fits.

examples.en: Her collection of shells filled three glass jars.
examples.zh: 她收藏的貝殼裝滿了三個玻璃罐。

examples.en: The museum's collection includes old maps and paintings.
examples.zh: 博物館的館藏包括舊地圖和畫作。

examples.en: The school held a book collection for the community center.
examples.zh: 學校為社區中心舉辦了書籍募集活動。

explains: A group of things gathered because they share a purpose or type is called this. Someone may keep stamps. Each one can have a story.
A museum holds many objects for people to see. Staff organize them by topic. Labels explain where they came from.
The act of picking items up can also use this word. A recycling truck makes a regular round. People place bins outside.

examples.en: A colony of ants built a mound beside the garden path.
examples.zh: 一群螞蟻在花園小徑旁築起蟻丘。

examples.en: The penguin colony gathered on the cold shore.
examples.zh: 企鵝群聚集在寒冷的海岸上。

examples.en: The history class learned about the former colony and its people.
examples.zh: 歷史課學習了昔日殖民地及其人民的故事。

explains: A group of animals lives together in one place. Ants work in an organized nest. Each one has a job.
A country may control a distant land and settle people there. History books describe how this affected local communities. The people who lived there faced many changes.
Plants or tiny organisms can grow close together. Scientists study how they share space. Such a group changes as it grows.

examples.en: The colorful kite flew high above the beach.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的風箏在海灘上空高高飛翔。

examples.en: She wore a colorful scarf with red, green, and gold stripes.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條有紅、綠、金條紋的繽紛圍巾。

examples.en: The book tells a colorful story about a traveling circus.
examples.zh: 這本書講述了一個關於巡迴馬戲團的生動故事。

explains: Something has many bright colors or a strong mix of shades. A painted kite looks vivid in the sky. It catches people's eyes.
A story can be lively and full of interesting details. A traveler describes exciting places. Listeners imagine each scene.
Artists combine colors to express ideas. A bright picture can feel cheerful. Different choices create different moods.

examples.en: A stone column stood at the entrance to the old hall.
examples.zh: 一根石柱立在舊大廳入口。

examples.en: The article filled one column on the newspaper page.
examples.zh: 這篇文章佔了報紙版面的一欄。

examples.en: Write the numbers in a column before adding them.
examples.zh: 相加前，先把數字直排成一欄。

explains: A tall upright post can support a roof or building. Builders make sure it is strong. It stands from floor to ceiling.
A page of writing may be arranged in a narrow vertical section. Newspapers use several. Readers follow lines from top to bottom.
Numbers can be written one under another in a vertical line. This makes addition easier. Keep each digit in its place.

examples.en: A warm hug from Mom brought great comfort to the crying child.
examples.zh: 媽媽溫暖的擁抱為哭泣的孩童帶來了莫大的安慰。
