examples.en: Friends gathered around to comfort him after his pet dog passed away.
examples.zh: 愛犬不幸離世之後，好友們紛紛聚攏圍繞在他身邊溫柔地安慰撫平悲痛。

examples.en: The luxurious hotel room was designed for maximum relaxation and physical comfort.
examples.zh: 這間五星級奢華飯店客房的整體動線設計，旨在提供極致的放鬆與舒適享受。

examples.en: Traveling at 300 km/h is so steady that a coin balanced on its edge on the window sill will not fall over.
examples.zh: 在時速三百公里下行駛如此平穩，立在窗台上的五十元硬幣即使高速飛馳依然「平穩如常」（Comfort）屹立不倒。

examples.en: Grandparents derive immense emotional comfort from watching their grandchildren play happily together.
examples.zh: 看著活潑可愛的小孫子們在客廳客氣和睦地嬉戲玩耍，老祖父母內心感受到了無比溫暖的心靈慰藉。

examples.en: The long-haul flight features spacious reclining leather seats designed for maximum traveler comfort.
examples.zh: 跨洋長途國際航線全面配備可完全平躺的寬敞真皮商務艙座椅，為長途旅客提供極致的乘坐舒適體驗。

entries.definition: 安慰；慰藉；舒適；車廂平穩如履平地之極致旅客乘坐舒適度
explains: A feeling of ease can help someone feel calm. A warm blanket helps a child feel calm after a nightmare. A gentle voice helps too.
A soft chair or cushion makes sitting pleasant. People rest after a long day. A quiet room can feel peaceful.
Kind words support someone who is sad. Friends listen without judging. Caring actions show that the person is not alone.

examples.en: Put a comma between the city and the state in the address.
examples.zh: 地址中的城市名稱和州名之間要加逗號。

examples.en: I used a comma to separate the apples from the pears in my list.
examples.zh: 我用逗號把清單上的蘋果和梨子分開。

examples.en: The comma shows a short pause in the sentence.
examples.zh: 逗號表示句子中短暫的停頓。

explains: A small punctuation mark separates parts of a sentence or items in a list. It looks like a dot with a tail. Writers pause briefly when reading it.
Names and places may be divided by this mark. Clear punctuation helps readers understand. Teachers show where it belongs.
A sentence can change meaning when marks are missing. Read aloud to hear the pause. Check each list carefully.

examples.en: The committee planned a clean-up day for the park.
examples.zh: 委員會為公園規劃了一個清潔日。

examples.en: Each committee member shared one idea at the meeting.
examples.zh: 每位委員都在會議中分享了一個想法。

examples.en: The school committee chose a new library book.
examples.zh: 學校委員會選了一本新的圖書館藏書。

explains: A group of people meets to plan or decide something. Members share ideas. They may organize a school event.
Each person can take a different job. One writes notes. Another speaks for the group.
They discuss choices and try to agree. Listening helps meetings go well. A clear plan guides the next steps.

examples.en: We communicate with our cousins by video call every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期日都透過視訊和表親聯絡。

examples.en: The teacher communicated the new schedule to the class.
examples.zh: 老師把新的時間表告訴全班。

examples.en: Hand signals help the hikers communicate across the river.
examples.zh: 手勢幫助健行者隔著河互相傳達訊息。

explains: People share ideas or information by speaking, writing, or using signs. Clear words help others understand. Listening is part of the process.
Friends can send messages by phone. They can also draw a picture. Different ways help people express what they mean.
Animals send signals with sounds and movements. Birds call to one another. Their actions carry messages.

examples.en: In comparison with last year, student test scores improved noticeably.
examples.zh: 與去年相比，學生的考試成績有了顯著提升。

examples.en: A side-by-side spec comparison helps shoppers select the right smartphone.
examples.zh: 並列規格的詳細對照表，能協助精打細算的消費者選出最理想的智慧型手機。

examples.en: There is simply no comparison between fresh home-cooked soup and canned broth.
examples.zh: 現煮現燉的美味家常鮮湯與市售罐頭高湯相比，品質完全不可同日而語。

explains: Looking at two or more things can show how they are alike or different. A chart can list their sizes. Readers see the facts clearly.
People can place objects beside each other to notice details. Two leaves may have different shapes. Careful looking helps.
The result can show which choice fits a need. A family checks price and size. They choose what works best for them.

examples.en: Athletes from over fifty nations compete in the World Games.
examples.zh: 來自五十多個國家的運動員在世運會中同台競技。

examples.en: Local bookstores find it difficult to compete against giant e-commerce platforms.
examples.zh: 實體書店發現很難與龐大的電商巨頭平台相抗衡競爭。

examples.en: Siblings often compete for their parents' attention and praise.
examples.zh: 兄弟姊妹經常互相競爭以博取父母的關注與讚許。

explains: People try to win a game or contest by using their skills. They follow the rules. Good sports show respect to others.
Businesses may try to sell similar products. Customers choose what they like. Fair choices can help improve quality.
A student may challenge a personal record. Practice helps them improve. Doing their best matters more than beating everyone.

examples.en: The child complained that the soup was too hot.
examples.zh: 孩子抱怨湯太燙了。

examples.en: Several neighbors complained about the loud music late at night.
examples.zh: 幾位鄰居抱怨深夜音樂太吵。

examples.en: Mia complained to the store about the broken zipper.
examples.zh: 米亞向商店反映拉鍊壞掉的問題。

explains: A person says they are unhappy about a problem. They may tell a teacher that the room is too noisy. Calm words help.
Customers can explain when an item is broken. A worker may offer a repair or refund. Keep the receipt if possible.
It is helpful to describe what went wrong and what might fix it. Blaming others does not solve the issue. Listening matters.

examples.en: The manager listened to our complaint about the cold room.
examples.zh: 經理聆聽了我們對房間太冷的反映。

examples.en: She wrote a complaint about the damaged package.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封關於包裹受損的申訴信。

examples.en: The teacher received a complaint about the noisy hallway.
examples.zh: 老師收到一項關於走廊太吵的反映。

explains: A statement tells someone that a person is unhappy about something. A student may report a broken chair. Staff can look into it.
A customer can share a problem with a store. They explain what happened. A worker may offer help.
Listening politely shows respect. People can seek a fair answer. Clear details make the problem easier to understand.

examples.en: We bought tickets to attend the arena concert.
examples.zh: 我們買了小巨蛋演唱會的門票。

examples.en: The classical piano concert attracted thousands of music lovers.
examples.zh: 這場古典鋼琴音樂會吸引了數千名音樂愛好者。

examples.en: Fans sang along enthusiastically at the outdoor rock concert.
examples.zh: 歌迷們在戶外搖滾演唱會上熱情地跟著大合唱。

examples.en: Mayday held a massive outdoor stadium concert in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 五月天在高雄舉辦了一場大型戶外體育場演唱會。

examples.en: We bought front-row tickets to hear the world-famous cellist in concert.
examples.zh: 我們買了前排門票以親臨音樂會聆聽這位世界級大提琴家的演奏。

examples.en: The world powers took concerted diplomatic action to prevent war.
examples.zh: 各世界強權採取了一致協調的聯合外交行動以預防戰爭爆發。

explains: Musicians perform songs for people who come to listen. They may play in a hall or outdoors. Tickets show the time and place.
The audience sits or stands while music fills the space. People clap between songs. Follow the venue's rules.
Performers practice together before the show. Each person has a part. Working as a group helps the music sound strong.

examples.en: What conclusion did you draw from the laboratory experiment?
examples.zh: 你從這項實驗室實驗中得出了什麼結論？

examples.en: In conclusion, adopting eco-friendly daily habits safeguards our planet for children.
examples.zh: 總而言之，在日常生活中養成綠色環保好習慣，是在為子孫後代守護美麗地球。

examples.en: Do not jump to hasty conclusions before reviewing all empirical evidence objectively.
examples.zh: 在全面客觀審視所有實證數據證據之前，千萬切忌妄下過早且草率的結論。

explains: The final idea at the end of a talk or story is called this. It sums up the main points. Readers know the topic is finished.
A person can decide something after looking at facts. A wet umbrella suggests it rained. More clues can help confirm the idea.
Writers use a final paragraph to leave readers with one message. They may remind them what matters. Clear endings feel complete.

examples.en: The dog wore a soft recovery cone to prevent licking surgical stitches.
examples.zh: 狗狗在術後乖乖戴上柔軟舒適的防舔大聲公造型伊莉莎白頭套，以防舔咬腹部縫線。

examples.en: An inflatable protective collar is often more comfortable than a rigid plastic cone.
examples.zh: 充氣式防舔圈甜甜圈比起傳統堅硬的塑膠喇叭頭套而言，往往能讓毛孩感到更為舒適。

examples.en: He bumped into doorframes while getting used to walking around the house with his cone.
examples.zh: 狗狗剛戴上大喇叭頭套在家中四處走動時，還不太習慣轉彎而頻頻撞上兩側門框。

entries.definition: 伊莉莎白頸圈；防舔頭套 (Elizabeth Collar)
explains: A solid shape has a round base and a pointed top. An ice cream holder is shaped this way. It fits in one hand.
A traffic marker warns drivers to stay away from an area. Bright colors make it easy to see. Workers place it safely.
A pine tree grows hard seed cases with this shape. They hold seeds. Some open when they dry.

examples.en: Please confirm your visit by replying to the email.
examples.zh: 請回覆電子郵件確認你的來訪。

examples.en: The second test confirmed that the water was clean.
examples.zh: 第二次檢測證實水是乾淨的。

examples.en: Dad called to confirm our dinner reservation.
examples.zh: 爸爸打電話確認我們的晚餐訂位。

explains: A person checks that information or plans are correct. They call to make sure a meeting is still happening. Everyone knows the time.
A result can show that an earlier idea was right. A second test gives the same answer. Careful checking builds confidence.
A message may ask someone to say yes to a plan. Reply clearly. This helps others prepare.

examples.en: The similar maps confused us until we checked the labels.
examples.zh: 這些相似的地圖讓我們困惑，直到我們查看標籤。

examples.en: Please do not confuse the clean cups with the dirty ones.
examples.zh: 請不要把乾淨的杯子和髒杯子搞混。

examples.en: The tricky directions confused my brother at first.
examples.zh: 一開始，複雜的指示讓我弟弟不知所措。

explains: Something is hard to understand when details are mixed up. A long set of directions may cause trouble. Break it into small steps.
People may mistake one thing for another. Two bags look alike. Add a name tag to tell them apart.
A clear example can help someone understand. Ask a question if instructions are unclear. It is fine to need help.

examples.en: Connect your laptop to the classroom projector with an HDMI cable.
examples.zh: 用 HDMI 傳輸線將筆電連接至教室投影機。

examples.en: High-speed rail lines connect major western coastal cities across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高鐵路線將台灣西部各大主要沿海城市連成一氣。

examples.en: Social networking services help old friends stay connected across continents.
examples.zh: 社群網路服務幫助老朋友跨越大洲維持緊密聯繫。

explains: A wire or path joins two things so something can pass between them. A bridge links both sides of a river. People can cross.
Friends may build a relationship by talking and sharing activities. They learn about one another. Kindness makes it stronger.
A cable plugs a computer into power. Check that it fits. Ask an adult before handling electrical parts.

examples.en: The patient was conscious and able to answer the nurse's questions.
examples.zh: 病人保持清醒，能回答護理師的問題。

examples.en: He was conscious of the noise and closed the window.
examples.zh: 他注意到噪音，便把窗戶關上。

examples.en: She remained conscious during the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 漫長的公車旅途中，她一直保持清醒。

explains: A person is awake and can notice what is happening. They hear a sound and respond. A sleeping person may not answer right away.
Someone can be aware of their choices. They think about how actions affect others. Careful decisions show respect.
After a fall, an adult checks whether someone is alert. Get emergency help if they do not respond. Stay nearby safely.

examples.en: The garden needs considerable care during the dry summer.
examples.zh: 乾燥的夏季，花園需要相當多的照料。

examples.en: A considerable amount of snow covered the road overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之間，大量積雪覆蓋了道路。

examples.en: The repair took considerable time because the part was hard to find.
examples.zh: 由於零件難以找到，修理花了相當長的時間。

explains: A large amount or degree can be described this way. A heavy box takes much effort to lift. Ask someone to help.
A project may need a lot of time. Students begin early. A schedule keeps the work moving.
The word can show that something is important or noticeable. A long delay changes the plan. People let others know.

examples.en: The constant rain kept the soccer field muddy all week.
examples.zh: 連續不斷的雨讓足球場整週都很泥濘。

examples.en: A constant light shone above the doorway all night.
examples.zh: 門口上方的燈整晚都亮著。

examples.en: Her constant support helped me finish the big project.
examples.zh: 她持續不斷的支持幫助我完成了大型專題。

explains: Something stays the same or continues without stopping. A clock makes a steady ticking sound. It goes on all day.
A person may remain loyal or reliable over time. A friend offers help every week. Their support can be trusted.
In mathematics, a fixed number does not change. Students use it in a formula. The value stays the same each time.

examples.en: Asia is the largest continent on Earth.
examples.zh: 亞洲是地球上最大的洲。

examples.en: Our class colored each continent on the world map.
examples.zh: 我們班在世界地圖上為每一洲塗上顏色。

examples.en: Africa is a continent with many different climates and cultures.
examples.zh: 非洲是一個擁有多種氣候與文化的大洲。

explains: A very large area of land is surrounded by oceans or other major features. People study maps to learn its location. There are seven commonly named ones.
Different countries share one of these broad regions. People may speak many languages there. Geography connects their stories.
A child can point to each region on a globe. Oceans appear blue. Land shapes are easy to compare.

examples.en: The game controller needs new batteries.
examples.zh: 遊戲控制器需要換新電池。

examples.en: An air traffic controller guided the plane toward the runway.
examples.zh: 航管員引導航機飛向跑道。

examples.en: She used the remote controller to move the toy boat.
examples.zh: 她用遙控器操控玩具船。

explains: A device sends commands to a machine or game. Buttons help a player move a character. Keep it clean and dry.
A person may manage how an activity is done. They watch the process. They make sure rules are followed.
Air traffic workers guide planes from a safe room. They use screens and radios. Their work requires careful training.

examples.en: The rice cooker kept the meal warm until dinner.
examples.zh: 電鍋把飯菜保溫到晚餐時間。

examples.en: The cooker finished the soup while we set the table.
examples.zh: 我們擺餐具時，烹煮器具煮好了湯。

examples.en: A skilled cooker prepared lunch for the whole team.
examples.zh: 一位熟練的廚師為整個團隊準備了午餐。

explains: A machine heats food so people can prepare meals. It may use gas or electricity. Follow safety directions.
A person who prepares food can also have this job title. They plan dishes and use kitchen tools. Clean surfaces prevent germs.
A slow machine can cook a meal over several hours. Keep its lid closed while it works. An adult should handle hot parts.

examples.en: The costly repair took most of the shop's savings.
examples.zh: 這筆昂貴的修理費幾乎用掉了店裡所有積蓄。

examples.en: It was costly to replace every window after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後更換所有窗戶花費很高。

examples.en: The costly toy was too expensive for our family this month.
examples.zh: 這個昂貴的玩具這個月對我們家來說太貴了。

explains: Something takes a lot of money to buy or repair. A large new roof can be expensive. Families may save before paying.
A mistake may take much effort or money to fix. Planning carefully can help avoid trouble. Ask questions before agreeing.
People compare prices and quality before choosing. A less expensive item may still work well. Think about what is needed.

examples.en: This breathable shirt is made of 100% pure organic cotton.
examples.zh: 這件透氣襯衫是由 100% 純有機棉製成的。

examples.en: Taiwan farmers harvested organic cotton using modern sustainable methods.
examples.zh: 台灣農民採用現代永續方法採收有機棉花。

examples.en: Use a soft cotton pad to apply facial toner gently.
examples.zh: 使用柔軟的化妝棉輕柔塗抹臉部化妝水。

explains: A soft plant fiber is used to make clothing and towels. It feels comfortable against skin. Farmers grow it in warm regions.
A fluffy piece can clean a small area. Use it gently. Throw it away after use.
The fabric can absorb water. A shirt made from it is cool in summer. Follow the washing label.

examples.en: Wear a face mask if you have a cold and cough.
examples.zh: 如果你感冒咳嗽，請戴上口罩。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed herbal cough drops to soothe his dry throat.
examples.zh: 醫生開了草本止咳喉糖來舒緩他乾咳的喉嚨。

examples.en: Cover your mouth with your elbow whenever you cough or sneeze.
examples.zh: 咳嗽或打噴嚏時，請務必用手肘遮住口鼻。

examples.en: Cover your mouth and nose with your elbow when you cough.
examples.zh: 咳嗽時請用手肘遮住口鼻。

examples.en: The persistent dry cough kept him awake for several nights.
examples.zh: 持續不斷的乾咳讓他好幾晚都無法入眠。

examples.en: The doctor listened to her chest while she coughed deeply.
examples.zh: 當她深咳時，醫生用聽診器仔細聆聽她的胸腔呼吸音。

explains: A sudden burst of air comes from the lungs when the throat is irritated. Cover the mouth with an elbow. Wash hands afterward.
A person may have this symptom during a cold. Rest and fluids can help. Tell an adult if it continues or feels severe.
The verb means making this sound. Smoke or dust can cause irritation. Move away from the source and get fresh air.

examples.en: The teacher used countable objects like pencils for the math lesson.
examples.zh: 老師在數學課使用鉛筆等可數物品。

examples.en: A countable noun can have a plural form.
examples.zh: 可數名詞可以有複數形式。

examples.en: We put the countable beads into groups of ten.
examples.zh: 我們把可數的珠子分成每組十顆。

explains: Something can be counted one by one. Apples have separate pieces. People can say how many there are.
Grammar uses this adjective for nouns with singular and plural forms. One book and three books are examples. A number can go before them.
Some materials are measured rather than counted as separate pieces. Water is one example. Different words fit different kinds of things.

examples.en: Our county library lends books to every town nearby.
examples.zh: 我們這個郡的圖書館把書借給附近每個城鎮。

examples.en: The county fair opens on Friday with rides and farm animals.
examples.zh: 郡博覽會星期五開幕，有遊樂設施和農場動物。

examples.en: A county office helped us find the local recycling rules.
examples.zh: 郡政府辦公室幫我們找到當地回收規定。

explains: A region within a state or country may have its own local government. Maps show its borders. People live in towns and rural areas there.
Some places use this name for an administrative area. Offices provide services. Residents can find local information online.
A family may travel across several such regions on a road trip. Signs mark changes. A map helps them know where they are.

examples.en: A crab walked sideways across the wet sand.
examples.zh: 一隻螃蟹橫著走過潮濕的沙地。

examples.en: The crab hid beneath a rock when the wave came.
examples.zh: 海浪湧來時，螃蟹躲到岩石下。

examples.en: We saw a tiny crab in the tide pool.
examples.zh: 我們在潮池裡看到一隻小螃蟹。

explains: A sea animal has a hard shell and two claws. It walks sideways on many legs. It lives near shores or underwater.
Some people cook this animal for food. It should be handled carefully. Sharp claws can pinch fingers.
A small red crustacean may live in sand or rocks. Watch it from a distance. Return stones to their place.

examples.en: The baby slept quietly in the wooden cradle.
examples.zh: 寶寶在木製搖籃裡安靜地睡著。

examples.en: The old city is called the cradle of the region's music.
examples.zh: 這座古城被稱為該地區音樂的發源地。

examples.en: She cradled the injured bird in a soft towel.
examples.zh: 她用柔軟的毛巾輕輕捧著受傷的小鳥。

explains: A small bed gently rocks a baby to sleep. It has high sides to keep the child safe. An adult watches nearby.
The word can describe the place where an idea or culture first began. A town may be known for its early music traditions. Many artists learn about these beginnings.
A verb can mean holding something carefully in the arms. A person supports a kitten. Gentle hands keep it comfortable.

examples.en: The revolutionary rocket-powered sky crane lowered the heavy one-ton rover onto three wheels using nylon cords.
examples.zh: 革命性的反推火箭空中吊車系統，用高強度尼龍纜繩將重達一噸的探測車穩穩垂降至地面。

examples.en: Once touchdown sensors triggered, the sky crane severed the tether cables and flew away to crash safely.
examples.zh: 當探測車輪胎觸地感測器觸發的瞬間，空中吊車瞬間炸斷釋放尼龍繫繩，隨即加大反推推力全速飛離遠方墜毀。

examples.en: Employing a hovering sky crane eliminated the need for heavy, complex deployment ramps.
examples.zh: 採用空中懸停反推吊車著陸技術，徹底免除了探測器在著陸後需要額外配置笨重、易卡死釋放跳板的難題。

entries.definition: 火星火箭反推空中吊車降落系統；起重機
explains: A tall machine lifts heavy materials at a building site. Its long arm reaches high. Workers guide it carefully from below.
A large bird has long legs and a long neck. It may stand in shallow water. It catches fish with its bill.
The machine operator checks the load before lifting. People stay clear of the area. Safety signals guide each move.

examples.en: The browser crashed unexpectedly when I opened thirty tabs at once.
examples.zh: 當我一口氣打開三十個分頁時，瀏覽器突然當機閃退了。

examples.en: Thankfully, nobody was seriously injured in the minor highway car crash.
examples.zh: 萬幸的是，這起高速公路輕微車禍相撞事故無人重傷。

examples.en: Investors panicked when stock market prices took a dramatic crash.
examples.zh: 當股市行情發生戲劇性暴跌時，投資人陷入恐慌。

explains: A loud collision happens when vehicles or objects hit each other. People should move to a safe place. Call emergency services if anyone is hurt.
A computer can stop working suddenly. Save files often. Restarting may help, but ask for technical help if needed.
A company may lose a lot of money and close. Workers look for other jobs. Careful planning helps reduce risks.

examples.en: The baby began to crawl toward the colorful ball.
examples.zh: 寶寶開始爬向那顆彩色球。

examples.en: A small crab crawled over the wet rock.
examples.zh: 一隻小螃蟹爬過潮濕的岩石。

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the road after the parade.
examples.zh: 遊行結束後，路上的車潮緩慢前進。

explains: A baby moves on hands and knees before learning to walk. They explore the floor. Keep small objects out of reach.
A person or animal can move low and slowly through a narrow space. A kitten goes under a chair. It comes out again.
A vehicle may move very slowly in a line of traffic. Drivers leave room. Everyone waits patiently.

examples.en: The creative student designed a costume from recycled paper.
examples.zh: 這位有創意的學生用回收紙設計了一套服裝。

examples.en: Her creative idea turned the old box into a puppet theater.
examples.zh: 她的創意點子把舊紙箱變成了木偶劇院。

examples.en: The art club encourages creative ways to use color.
examples.zh: 美術社鼓勵大家用有創意的方式運用色彩。

explains: A person uses imagination to make new ideas or art. Children draw unusual animals. Each picture is different.
A fresh way of solving a problem can be helpful. A team finds another use for an empty box. Thinking flexibly can save time.
Music, stories, and building projects let people express themselves. Practice helps skills grow. Sharing work can inspire friends.

examples.en: Digital content creators build loyal global followings through storytelling.
examples.zh: 數位自媒體內容創作者透過富有溫度的故事分享，吸引了全球無數鐵粉追隨。

examples.en: She quit her corporate job to become a full-time video creator on YouTube.
examples.zh: 她辭去了公司的正職工作，成為全職的 YouTube 影片創作者。

examples.en: The platform introduced new features to help creators connect with their audience.
examples.zh: 該平台推出了新功能，以幫助創作者更緊密地與受眾建立連結。

entries.definition: 內容創作者；自媒體創作者；創造者
explains: A person makes something, such as a story, picture, or program. They choose the details. Their work can entertain or help others.
Someone who starts a plan may be called this. A student thinks of a new club. Friends help it grow.
People can make things in many ways. A baker prepares bread. An artist paints a scene.

examples.en: A tiny sea creature glowed beneath the dark water.
examples.zh: 一隻小小的海洋生物在黑暗的水下發光。

examples.en: The children imagined a friendly creature living under the bridge.
examples.zh: 孩子們想像橋下住著一個友善的生物。

examples.en: Every creature needs food, water, and a safe place to live.
examples.zh: 每種生物都需要食物、水和安全的居所。

explains: A living thing such as an animal is called this. A squirrel climbs a tree. Fish swim in a pond.
Stories may include imaginary beings with special powers. A writer describes how they look. Readers picture them in their minds.
Small living things need a safe place and food. People should treat animals kindly. Observe them without disturbing their home.

examples.en: You need at least 128 course credits to qualify for graduation.
examples.zh: 你需要修滿至少 128 個課程學分方具備畢業資格。

examples.en: Give credit where credit is due when working in cooperative teams.
examples.zh: 在團隊合作時，凡是有所貢獻者都應給予其應得的肯定與讚譽。

examples.en: Do you accept international credit cards for course registration fees?
examples.zh: 請問繳納課程註冊學費時接受國際信用卡刷卡嗎？

examples.en: You need to earn at least 128 academic credits to fulfill degree requirements.
examples.zh: 您需要修滿至少 128 個學分方能符合畢業學位要求。

examples.en: The project's success was largely due to her team's relentless effort, and she deserves full credit.
examples.zh: 該專案的圓滿成功主要歸功於她團隊的全力以赴，她理應獲得最大的讚許與肯定。

examples.en: Customers can choose to pay by credit card or mobile wallet at checkout.
examples.zh: 顧客在結帳時可自由選擇使用信用卡刷卡或行動支付錢包付款。

examples.en: One carbon credit represents the verified reduction or removal of one metric ton of CO2 equivalent.
examples.zh: 一單位標準「碳信用額度」（Carbon Credit 碳權），代表經嚴格核證已實質減除或封存一公噸二氧化碳當量。

examples.en: The bank evaluated the borrower's credit score before approving the thirty-year home mortgage loan.
examples.zh: 商業銀行房貸授信專員在核准該筆長達三十年的首購自住青年安心成家房貸前，仔細調閱申請人的聯徵信用評分。

examples.en: The visionary film director generously gave full creative credit to his talented visual effects crew.
examples.zh: 這位才華洋溢的電影名導在國際影展頒獎台上，將作品的巨大成功由衷歸功於背後才華橫溢的特效技術團隊。

entries.definition: 學分；信用；讚譽；大學學分；讚許；國際認證碳信用額度 (碳權)
explains: Praise or recognition is given to someone for good work. A team thanks the helper who planned the event. Their effort mattered.
A card or account lets people pay later rather than using cash at once. Adults check the bill and repay the amount. Keep account details private.
A school may record points for completed work. Students review their progress. Accurate records are helpful.

examples.en: The ship's crew prepared the boat before sunrise.
examples.zh: 船員們在日出前準備好船隻。

examples.en: A film crew set up lights before the actors arrived.
examples.zh: 演員抵達前，電影工作人員架好了燈光。

examples.en: The rescue crew searched the shore for the lost hiker.
examples.zh: 救援人員在岸邊搜尋迷路的健行者。

explains: A group of people work together on a ship, plane, or project. Each person has a job. Cooperation helps them finish safely.
A film team includes workers behind and in front of the camera. They plan scenes. Many roles help a movie come together.
A rowing team may move a boat together. They follow one leader's timing. Practice builds teamwork.

examples.en: A cricket chirped beside the porch on the warm evening.
examples.zh: 溫暖的夜晚，一隻蟋蟀在門廊旁鳴叫。

examples.en: We watched a cricket match on television with Grandpa.
examples.zh: 我們和爺爺一起在電視上看板球比賽。

examples.en: A green cricket jumped into the flower pot.
examples.zh: 一隻綠色蟋蟀跳進了花盆。

explains: A small jumping insect makes a steady chirping sound. It may hide in grass. Birds sometimes eat it.
A bat-and-ball game uses wickets and teams. Players take turns batting and fielding. Matches can last a long time.
The insect's sound may be heard on a warm night. It comes from rubbing body parts together. People can listen outdoors.

examples.en: The police captured the fleeing criminal within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 警方在二十四小時內成功將逃逸的罪犯緝捕歸案。

examples.en: Committing intentional fraud results in serious criminal charges and prison sentences.
examples.zh: 蓄意進行詐欺犯罪將面臨嚴厲的刑事罪名指控與實質有期徒刑。

examples.en: The convicted criminal was sentenced to community service by the presiding judge.
examples.zh: 審判長依法判處這名被定罪的犯人執行特定時數的社區勞動服務。

explains: A person who breaks the law may be called this. Police investigate what happened. Courts decide cases by following rules.
The adjective describes an action that breaks a law. Stealing another person's property is wrong. People should ask for help instead.
Most people follow laws to keep one another safe. Communities support fair systems. Everyone deserves respect.

examples.en: The roast pork belly skin is delightfully crispy while the meat remains tender.
examples.zh: 廣式脆皮燒肉的表皮被烤得金黃酥脆卡滋作響，而底下的肉質依然鮮嫩多汁。

examples.en: Everyone loves freshly fried potato chips that are thin, crispy, and lightly salted.
examples.zh: 大家都喜愛薄脆可口、鹹淡適中且剛出鍋的現炸香脆洋芋片。

examples.en: Dip the crispy spring roll into sweet and sour plum sauce for a burst of flavor.
examples.zh: 將炸得香脆可口的春捲沾上酸甜梅子醬，入口瞬間迸發豐富層次。

explains: Food cooked until it is dry and crunchy can feel this way. Toast makes a light sound when bitten. People enjoy the texture.
Fried vegetables may have a thin crunchy outside. Let hot food cool first. An adult should handle the pan.
A leaf can become dry and break easily. It makes a faint sound underfoot. Collect some for an art project.

examples.en: Crop the wide shot horizontally to create a panoramic cinematic aspect ratio.
examples.zh: 將原本的寬景照片進行水平二次構圖裁切，打造出極具視覺震撼力的 21:9 電影全景比例。

examples.en: Farmers in central Taiwan plant their seasonal rice crop during early spring.
examples.zh: 台灣中南部的稻農們每逢初春時節便開始引水插秧，種植當季第一期優質稻米作物。

examples.en: She had to crop out the distracting tourist from the edge of her scenic shot.
examples.zh: 她透過後製軟體將照片邊緣不小心入鏡走動的雜亂觀光客裁切掉，使畫面更加簡潔聚焦。

explains: Plants grown by farmers for food or materials are called this. Rice and corn are examples. Farmers care for fields through the season.
A good harvest gives people food to eat and sell. Weather affects how plants grow. Water and healthy earth are important.
The verb can mean cutting a picture's edges. A photographer removes extra space. The main subject becomes clearer.

examples.en: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在典禮中戴著金色王冠。

examples.en: A crown of stars shone above the mountain at night.
examples.zh: 夜裡，群星像王冠般在山上閃耀。

examples.en: The people crowned their new king in the great hall.
examples.zh: 人們在大廳為新國王加冕。

explains: A king or queen may wear a decorated headpiece during a ceremony. It can be made from metal and jewels. It shows their royal role.
The top of a person's head is also called this. Hair grows there. A hat can cover it.
The verb can mean placing a ruler in an official role. A public ceremony may include special clothing and music. The decorated headpiece is placed on the ruler’s head.

examples.en: It was cruel to leave the puppy outside in the cold rain.
examples.zh: 把小狗留在寒冷的雨中是很殘忍的。

examples.en: The cruel joke made the new student feel sad.
examples.zh: 那個刻薄的玩笑讓新同學感到難過。

examples.en: The story's cruel king punished people for small mistakes.
examples.zh: 故事中殘暴的國王因小錯懲罰人民。

explains: An action that causes pain on purpose is unkind. Teasing someone about a mistake can hurt. Choose gentle words instead.
A person may treat animals harshly. Pets need food, care, and shelter. Tell an adult if an animal is in danger.
Stories sometimes show an unkind ruler. Other characters try to protect people. Fairness and care make a community stronger.

examples.en: The cups are in the cupboard beside the sink.
examples.zh: 杯子放在水槽旁的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: Grandma stored the extra flour in a high cupboard.
examples.zh: 奶奶把多的麵粉收在高處的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: We found a small box of tea in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 我們在廚房櫥櫃裡找到一小盒茶。

explains: A cabinet with shelves stores dishes, food, or supplies. It may have doors. Keep heavy items on lower shelves.
A kitchen worker gets cups and plates from this storage place. Clean, dry dishes belong inside. Close the door afterward.
Some homes have built-in storage along the wall. Labels can organize items. Make sure nothing blocks the doorway.

examples.en: The dairy farm sends fresh milk to the nearby town.
examples.zh: 乳牛場把新鮮牛奶送到附近的城鎮。

examples.en: I put the yogurt back in the dairy case at the store.
examples.zh: 我把優格放回商店的乳製品冷藏櫃。

examples.en: This dairy product needs to stay cold after opening.
examples.zh: 這種乳製品開封後需要冷藏。

explains: A farm that keeps cows or goats can produce milk and cheese. Workers care for the animals. Clean equipment keeps food safe.
A store section sells milk, yogurt, butter, and similar foods. Keep them cold. Check the date before eating.
Some people cannot drink milk. They may choose other foods for calcium. Ask a health professional about nutrition needs.

examples.en: The dam holds water for the farms below the hill.
examples.zh: 水壩蓄水，供應山丘下方的農田。

examples.en: Workers built a small dam across the stream for the science project.
examples.zh: 工人為科學專題在溪流上築了一座小壩。

examples.en: The beavers dammed the stream with branches and mud.
examples.zh: 海狸用樹枝和泥土在溪流上築起小壩。

explains: A wall across a river holds back water and may create a reservoir. People use stored water for homes or farms. Engineers inspect the structure.
The verb means building such a barrier. Workers plan carefully. It can change the river's flow and affect wildlife.
A small animal may build a barrier from branches. It makes a pond. The water gives it a safe home.

examples.en: I dare to ask a question when I do not understand.
examples.zh: 不懂時，我敢於提出問題。

examples.en: She dared her brother to jump over the small puddle.
examples.zh: 她激弟弟跳過那個小水窪。

examples.en: How dare you take my notebook without asking?
examples.zh: 你怎麼敢不問一聲就拿走我的筆記本？

explains: A person has enough courage to do something risky or frightening. A child may speak before a crowd. Practice helps build confidence.
The word can challenge someone to do an action. Friends should choose safe games. Never pressure anyone into danger.
In questions, it can ask whether someone is brave enough. A student may ask if a friend will try a new slide. Respect the answer.

examples.en: Come here, darling, and let me see your drawing.
examples.zh: 親愛的，過來讓我看看你的畫。

examples.en: What a darling little puppy you found at the shelter!
examples.zh: 你在收容所找到的小狗真可愛！

examples.en: My darling niece sent me a handmade card.
examples.zh: 我親愛的姪女寄給我一張手作卡片。

explains: A person or thing someone loves very much may be called this. A grandparent uses it as a warm nickname. It sounds affectionate.
The word can describe something charming or lovely. A tiny puppy has a sweet face. People smile when they see it.
It is often used when speaking to someone close. Friends and family choose names that feel kind. Be sure the other person likes it.

examples.en: The runner won the fifty-meter dash at the school sports day.
examples.zh: 這位跑者在學校運動會贏得五十公尺短跑。

examples.en: A dash separates the two parts of this sentence.
examples.zh: 破折號把這個句子的兩個部分分開。

examples.en: She dashed across the yard to catch the rolling ball.
examples.zh: 她飛快地穿過院子去接滾動的球。

explains: A quick run over a short distance can be called this. The runner moves fast. They stop after reaching the finish line.
A long punctuation mark can separate parts of a sentence. It creates a strong pause. Writers use it for emphasis.
The verb can mean moving suddenly or quickly. A rabbit runs across the yard. It hides under a bush.

examples.en: Customer contact information is safely stored in an encrypted database.
examples.zh: 顧客聯絡資訊被安全妥善地儲存在加密資料庫中。

examples.en: The server administrator backed up the relational database before the system upgrade.
examples.zh: 伺服器管理員在系統升級前將關聯式資料庫進行了備份。

examples.en: Researchers queried the medical database to analyze disease prevalence across regions.
examples.zh: 研究人員查詢醫療資料庫以分析各區域的疾病盛行率。

explains: A computer stores organized information so people can search it. A library keeps book titles in one. Readers find what they need.
Rows and fields can hold names, dates, or numbers. Staff update records carefully. A backup prevents loss.
Only permitted people should view private records. Strong passwords protect them. Follow rules for safe handling.

examples.en: We left for the mountain before dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明前我們就出發前往山上。

examples.en: It dawned on me that I had left my lunch at home.
examples.zh: 我突然想到自己把午餐忘在家裡了。

examples.en: The sky turned pink at dawn over the quiet farm.
examples.zh: 安靜的農場上空，黎明時天空變成粉紅色。

explains: The first light appears in the sky before the sun rises. Birds begin to sing. People can see the day starting.
A verb can mean beginning to become clear. A student understands a hard idea after an example. The teacher explains it again.
Early morning can be peaceful and quiet. Farmers may begin work then. The air often feels cool.

examples.en: The dealer showed us three used bicycles in different sizes.
examples.zh: 車商向我們展示了三輛不同尺寸的二手腳踏車。

examples.en: A card dealer shuffled the deck before the game.
examples.zh: 發牌者在遊戲前洗了牌。

examples.en: The flower dealer wrapped the bouquet in green paper.
examples.zh: 花商用綠色包裝紙包好了花束。

explains: A person or business sells particular goods. A card shop worker may offer games. Customers can compare prices.
Someone who trades cars helps buyers choose a vehicle. They explain the features. Read all papers before signing.
A person may deal cards during a game. Each player gets a set. The person handing out cards follows the game's rules.

examples.en: The old bridge was built more than a decade ago.
examples.zh: 這座舊橋建於十多年以前。

examples.en: A decade passed before the town finished the new park.
examples.zh: 十年過去後，鎮上才完成新公園。

examples.en: Our family has lived in this house for a decade.
examples.zh: 我們家在這棟房子住了十年。

explains: A period of ten years is called this. A person may look back at school photos. They see how much has changed.
History books divide time into these long periods. Events are easier to organize. A timeline shows what happened.
People may set a goal for many years ahead. Small steps help them reach it. Plans can change along the way.

examples.en: We ate breakfast on the wooden deck outside the cabin.
examples.zh: 我們在小屋外的木平台上吃早餐。

examples.en: Please shuffle the deck before dealing the cards.
examples.zh: 發牌前請先洗牌。

examples.en: The sailors stood on the deck and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 水手們站在甲板上看日落。

explains: A flat outside area on a house gives people a place to sit. It may be made from boards. A railing keeps people safe.
A set of playing cards is shuffled before a game. Players take turns. Keep the cards clean and dry.
A ship has an open floor where people can walk. Crew members follow safety rules. Hold onto a rail in rough weather.

examples.en: We decorated the classroom with paper stars for the party.
examples.zh: 派對前，我們用紙星星布置了教室。

examples.en: She decorated the cake with berries and cream.
examples.zh: 她用莓果和奶油裝飾蛋糕。

examples.en: The children decorated the tree with handmade ornaments.
examples.zh: 孩子們用手作飾品裝飾聖誕樹。

explains: People add colors or objects to make a room or item look special. Paper stars brighten a classroom. They can be removed later.
A person may put flowers on a table for a party. Guests notice the careful arrangement. Simple touches make a place welcoming.
Artwork and lights can make a celebration feel festive. Choose items that are safe. Clean up afterward.

examples.en: We hope the noise will decrease after the construction ends.
examples.zh: 我們希望工程結束後噪音會減少。

examples.en: The temperature decreased when the sun went behind the clouds.
examples.zh: 太陽被雲遮住後，氣溫下降了。

examples.en: A decrease in litter made the park more pleasant.
examples.zh: 垃圾減少後，公園變得更舒適。

explains: An amount becomes smaller or lower. The water level falls after a dry week. Rain can fill the pond again.
A person can use less of something. Turning off lights saves electricity. Small changes can help the environment.
A number may go down over time. A chart shows the difference. Reading it helps people understand the pattern.

examples.en: Simple good deeds, like giving up your seat on the bus, brighten someone's day.
examples.zh: 舉手之勞的小小日常善行，例如在公車捷運上主動禮讓博愛座，能溫暖他人一整天。

examples.en: The homeowner kept the official property deed safely locked inside the fireproof safe.
examples.zh: 屋主將房屋土地產權所有權狀所有證明地契，妥善存放在防火保險箱中鎖好。

examples.en: He was recognized by the community association for heroic deeds during the river flood rescue.
examples.zh: 他因在溪水暴漲洪患救援行動中奮不顧身英勇救人的義舉，榮獲社區管委會公開表揚。

explains: An action someone takes can show what kind of person they are. Helping a neighbor carry bags is kind. Small acts matter.
A legal paper can show who owns land or a house. People keep it safe. Experts can explain difficult documents.
A good action may inspire others to help too. One person starts. Soon the whole group joins in.

examples.en: Workers deepened the garden pond so fish could swim safely.
examples.zh: 工人把花園池塘挖深，讓魚能安全游動。

examples.en: The sunset began to deepen into a rich red color.
examples.zh: 夕陽的顏色開始變得更濃，呈現深紅色。

examples.en: Their friendship deepened as they helped each other through hard times.
examples.zh: 他們在困難時彼此扶持，友誼因此加深。

explains: A hole or space becomes farther down from the surface. Workers dig carefully. They check for buried pipes first.
A color can become darker or richer. An artist adds another layer of paint. The picture gains more detail.
A friendship can grow stronger as people learn to trust one another. Spending time together helps. Kindness builds closeness.

examples.en: The dictionary definition includes a simple example.
examples.zh: 字典中的定義附有一個簡單例子。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write a definition for each new word.
examples.zh: 老師要我們為每個新單字寫下定義。

examples.en: The definition of the game rule was easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這條遊戲規則的解釋很容易懂。

explains: A sentence explains what a word or idea means. A dictionary gives this information. Examples help readers understand it.
Clear wording can separate one meaning from another. A word may be used in different ways. Context shows which one fits.
Students can write a short explanation in their own words. They use simple language. A good one is easy to remember.

examples.en: Taiwan is widely recognized as a vibrant and open democracy.
examples.zh: 台灣被國際普遍公認為充滿活力且開放的民主政體。

examples.en: Freedom of speech and an independent press are key pillars of democracy.
examples.zh: 言論自由與獨立自主的新聞媒體是維繫民主制度的核心支柱。

examples.en: Citizen participation in community forums strengthens grassroots democracy.
examples.zh: 廣大公民熱心參與社區公共論壇，能扎實深化基層草根民主。

explains: People choose leaders and help make decisions in this kind of government. Citizens vote when they are old enough. Laws protect their rights.
Groups can use the same idea when choosing a plan. Members share opinions. A fair vote lets each person take part.
A community needs respectful discussion. People may disagree. They can still listen and work together.

examples.en: Free and transparent voting is the cornerstone of democratic nations.
examples.zh: 自由且透明的投票是民主國家的核心基石。

examples.en: Peaceful transitions of power exemplify a mature democratic society.
examples.zh: 和平順利的政權轉移彰顯了一個成熟穩健的現代民主社會。

examples.en: Democratic decision-making inside student clubs encourages shared responsibility.
examples.zh: 學生社團內部採行民主決策模式，能激勵成員共同分擔責任。

explains: A system lets people share power and choose leaders. Citizens can vote. Rules protect everyone's voice.
A group can make choices by asking members what they think. Each person gets a fair chance. The result guides the plan.
The adjective describes ideas based on shared decision-making. People discuss choices openly. Respect helps the process work.

examples.en: He deposited ten thousand dollars into his savings account.
examples.zh: 他把一萬元存入了他的儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Tenants must pay a two-month rental deposit before moving in.
examples.zh: 房客在搬進去之前必須先支付兩個月的租金押金。

examples.en: Rich mineral deposits were discovered beneath the mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 山脊底下發現了豐富的礦物沉積礦藏。

examples.en: You can deposit cash into your account at any smart ATM.
examples.zh: 您可以在任何一台智慧型 ATM 自動存提款機存入現金。

examples.en: Tenants must pay a two-month rental deposit before moving into the apartment.
examples.zh: 房客在正式搬進公寓套房前，必須先繳納相當於兩個月房租的押金。

examples.en: River currents carried soil downstream to form thick silt deposits at the river mouth.
examples.zh: 湍急的河水將泥沙向下游沖刷，在出海口處沉積形成厚厚的淤泥沉積層。

examples.en: Locking money in a one-year fixed time deposit earns guaranteed interest returns.
examples.zh: 將資金鎖在一年度定期存單（定存）中，能享有保本保息、穩定安全的利息報酬。

examples.en: You must pay a two-month security deposit before signing the residential apartment lease.
examples.zh: 在正式簽署房屋租賃契約搬進新公寓之前，房客依約需預先支付相當於兩個月租金的押金。

examples.en: She visited the local bank branch to deposit her monthly bonus check into savings.
examples.zh: 她親自前往家附近的銀行分行櫃檯，將公司發放的當月業務激勵獎金支票存入儲蓄帳戶。

entries.definition: 存款；押金；沉積；存入；沉積物；定期存款；存入款項
explains: Money put into a bank account is called this. The account holder can add funds. A record shows the amount.
A person may pay part of a price before receiving an item or service. The rest is paid later. Keep the receipt.
The verb means placing something somewhere for safe keeping. A hiker puts a bag at the front desk. They collect it later.

examples.en: The graphic designer created an eye-catching poster.
examples.zh: 平面設計師設計了一張引人注目的海報。

examples.en: World-famous fashion designers unveiled their autumn clothing collections in Paris.
examples.zh: 享譽全球的頂尖時裝設計師在巴黎發表了秋冬新裝系列。

examples.en: User experience designers ensure mobile apps are intuitive and easy to navigate.
examples.zh: 使用者體驗設計師致力於確保手機應用程式直覺流暢且易於操作。

explains: A person plans how an object, room, or picture should look and work. They draw ideas first. Others may build the final version.
Clothing experts choose fabric and shapes. They think about comfort. Their sketches guide sewing.
A person may plan websites, toys, or buildings. They solve problems with useful ideas. Careful work helps things fit people's needs.

examples.en: A quiet seat is desirable for studying before a test.
examples.zh: 考試前讀書時，安靜的座位很理想。

examples.en: The desirable prize was a new bicycle.
examples.zh: 大家都想要的獎品是一輛新腳踏車。

examples.en: A desirable location for the picnic is near the shade.
examples.zh: 野餐的理想地點是靠近樹蔭的地方。

explains: Something is wanted because it has good qualities. A quiet room is helpful for reading. People may choose it over a noisy place.
A feature can make an item appealing. A warm coat is useful in winter. A bright color is easy to see.
Different people want different things. One person prefers a small home. Another likes more space. Their needs guide choices.

examples.en: Her desire to learn about space led her to the library.
examples.zh: 她渴望了解太空，因此去了圖書館。

examples.en: We desire a safe place where children can play.
examples.zh: 我們希望有一個安全的地方讓孩子玩耍。

examples.en: He desired to visit the old castle one day.
examples.zh: 他希望有一天能參觀那座古堡。

explains: A strong wish can guide what someone hopes to do. A child may want to learn piano. Practice helps them move toward that goal.
People can want an object or experience. A family hopes to visit the ocean. They save money for the trip.
The verb means wanting something strongly. A student hopes to do well. They study and ask questions.

examples.en: Tofu pudding with boba is a classic Taiwanese dessert.
examples.zh: 珍珠豆花是經典的台灣特色甜點。

examples.en: Save some room in your stomach for chocolate lava dessert.
examples.zh: 肚子留點空間享用巧克力熔岩甜點。

examples.en: We decided to share a bowl of mango shaved ice for dessert.
examples.zh: 我們決定飯後合吃一碗芒果雪花冰當作甜點。

examples.en: Warm taro ball sweet soup in ginger tea was the most satisfying dessert.
examples.zh: 一碗熱騰騰、淋上老薑黑糖汁的手工九份芋圓甜湯，是最令人心滿意足的餐後甜點。

examples.en: There is always a separate stomach reserved for rich chocolate cake and dessert.
examples.zh: 俗話說「甜點是裝在另一個胃裡的」，大家隨時都吃得下濃郁誘人的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: Fruit platters featuring sweet watermelon and wax apples were served as a complimentary dessert.
examples.zh: 盛滿甘甜花蓮西瓜與黑珍珠蓮霧的新鮮切盤水果切片，作為店家招待的飯後解膩甜品。

entries.definition: 甜點；飯後甜點；甜品點心
explains: A sweet food is often served after the main meal. Fruit, pudding, or cake can be choices. People may share a small portion.
A cook may bake treats for a celebration. Candles can go on top. Guests sing before eating the cake.
Some sweet dishes are cold, while others are warm. A scoop of ice cream melts quickly. Serve it right away.

examples.en: The fire destroyed the old shed behind the house.
examples.zh: 大火燒毀了房子後方的舊棚子。

examples.en: The storm may destroy weak branches in the garden.
examples.zh: 暴風雨可能會摧毀花園裡脆弱的樹枝。

examples.en: We should not destroy plants along the hiking trail.
examples.zh: 我們不應破壞健行步道旁的植物。

explains: To ruin something completely means making it unusable. A fire can damage a building. Helpers work to keep people safe.
Strong storms can break trees and roads. Communities repair what they can. People support neighbors after damage.
Careless actions can harm nature. Do not leave trash in a park. Everyone can help protect shared places.

examples.en: The sensor can detect smoke before it spreads.
examples.zh: 感應器能在煙霧擴散前偵測到它。

examples.en: I detected a faint smell of flowers near the gate.
examples.zh: 我在門附近聞到淡淡的花香。

examples.en: The test detects tiny amounts of sugar in the sample.
examples.zh: 這項測試能偵測樣本中的微量糖分。

explains: A person notices something that is hidden or hard to see. A dog can smell a tiny drop of food. Careful looking reveals clues.
Special tools find smoke or gas in a room. Alarms warn people. Leave the area if one sounds.
A scientist checks samples for signs of illness. They use careful methods. Results help doctors decide what to do.

examples.en: The teacher determined the winner by counting each team's points.
examples.zh: 老師透過計算各隊分數來決定贏家。

examples.en: We determined that the shorter path was safer.
examples.zh: 我們判定較短的小徑比較安全。

examples.en: A thermometer helps determine how warm the room is.
examples.zh: 溫度計有助於測定房間有多暖。

explains: A person finds out a fact by checking information. A map helps them learn the distance. A ruler can measure it too.
A choice may be settled after looking at the facts. The group checks the weather. Then they decide whether to play outside.
A person can make a firm choice about a plan. They consider what matters. Talking with others may help.

examples.en: The old story tells how the devil tried to trick the traveler.
examples.zh: 古老故事講述魔鬼如何試圖欺騙旅人。

examples.en: A red devil appeared as a character in the school play.
examples.zh: 學校戲劇裡出現了一個紅色魔鬼角色。

examples.en: The cartoon showed a tiny devil sitting on the character's shoulder.
examples.zh: 卡通描繪一個小魔鬼坐在角色的肩膀上。

explains: A harmful spirit appears in some religions and stories. Different beliefs describe it in different ways. It may represent evil or temptation.
A playful child may be called a little rascal in a joking way. Use a kind tone. Names should not hurt feelings.
Books sometimes show a battle between good and evil. Characters must make choices. Their actions affect others.

examples.en: The hallway was dim until Dad changed the light bulb.
examples.zh: 爸爸更換燈泡前，走廊裡很昏暗。

examples.en: Please dim the screen before bedtime.
examples.zh: 睡前請把螢幕調暗。

examples.en: The room grew dim as the sun went behind the hills.
examples.zh: 太陽落到山後時，房間漸漸暗了下來。

explains: A light is not bright and makes a room hard to see in. Turn on another lamp. Clear light helps prevent trips.
A person can make a lamp less bright. Use its control gently. Save energy by turning it off when leaving.
A memory or idea can slowly become unclear. Looking at pictures may help someone remember. Talking with family can bring back details.

examples.en: I found a dime beside the library steps.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館階梯旁找到一枚一角硬幣。

examples.en: The dime is worth ten cents in the United States.
examples.zh: 在美國，一角硬幣的面額是十分錢。

examples.en: She saved every dime in a jar for the school trip.
examples.zh: 她把每一枚一角硬幣都存進罐子裡，準備校外教學。

explains: A coin in the United States is worth ten cents. It is small and silver-colored. People keep coins in a purse or jar.
Several of these coins make up one dollar. Children can count them to practice math. A cash register gives change.
The coin has a picture on each side. Its edges have small grooves. Look closely to notice the details.

examples.en: We dined at a small restaurant by the harbor.
examples.zh: 我們在港邊的一間小餐廳用餐。

examples.en: The guests will dine in the garden if the weather is clear.
examples.zh: 如果天氣晴朗，賓客將在花園裡用餐。

examples.en: They dined with their grandparents on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 他們星期日晚上和祖父母一起吃飯。

explains: To eat a meal, especially in a formal place, is to do this. Guests sit at a table. Servers bring food.
Families may enjoy a special evening meal at a restaurant. They talk together. Good manners make the visit pleasant.
A person may eat an evening meal at a restaurant or at home. The verb often sounds more formal than simply saying someone eats. It usually refers to a meal rather than a quick snack.

examples.en: The dinosaur skeleton filled the center of the museum hall.
examples.zh: 恐龍骨架佔據了博物館大廳中央。

examples.en: My little brother knows the names of many dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 我弟弟知道許多恐龍的名稱。

examples.en: A dinosaur left three footprints in the soft mud.
examples.zh: 一隻恐龍在柔軟的泥地上留下三個腳印。

explains: A large reptile lived on Earth long before people. Fossils show what its bones looked like. Some kinds ate plants, while others hunted.
Scientists study old bones and footprints. They learn how these animals moved. Museums display models for visitors.
Different kinds had different sizes. Some were smaller than a person. Others were enormous.

examples.en: Dip the carrot sticks into the hummus before eating.
examples.zh: 吃之前把紅蘿蔔條沾進鷹嘴豆泥裡。

examples.en: He dipped his brush in blue paint.
examples.zh: 他把畫筆沾進藍色顏料裡。

examples.en: The sun dipped below the horizon at dusk.
examples.zh: 黃昏時，太陽落到地平線下。

explains: To put something briefly into liquid is to do this. A person lowers a spoon into soup. They lift it out again.
A thick sauce served with snacks can be called this. People can lower vegetables into it. Keep the bowl clean.
A brief decrease in level can use this noun. The temperature falls for a short time. It rises again later.

examples.en: The children dug in the dirt to plant bean seeds.
examples.zh: 孩子們在泥土裡挖洞種下豆子。

examples.en: A little dirt on the shoes washed off easily.
examples.zh: 鞋子上的一點泥土很容易就洗掉了。

examples.en: The dog rolled in the dirt beside the garden.
examples.zh: 狗在花園旁的泥土裡打滾。

explains: Loose soil covers the ground in a garden. Seeds grow in it. Water helps roots take hold.
Dust and grime can make a surface look unclean. A wet cloth wipes it away. Wash hands afterward.
A trail may become muddy after rain. Shoes track soil inside. A doormat helps keep floors tidy.

examples.en: Students get a 20% discount on train tickets.
examples.zh: 學生購買火車票享有八折優惠。

examples.en: The clothing boutique is offering an attractive clearance discount this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家服飾精品店本週末推出極具吸引力的出清折扣。

examples.en: Members can apply a special anniversary discount coupon at online checkout.
examples.zh: 會員在線上結帳時可以套用專屬的週年慶折扣優惠券。

examples.en: Students with valid IDs get a twenty percent discount.
examples.zh: 持有效學生證的學生可享有八折優惠。

examples.en: The store offers a five-dollar discount for bringing your own reusable cup.
examples.zh: 自備環保杯至店家消費可享有五元折扣優惠。

examples.en: Do not discount the importance of getting sufficient sleep every night.
examples.zh: 切勿低估每晚獲得充足睡眠的重要性。

explains: A lower price lets a customer pay less than usual. A store may mark items during a sale. Check the final cost.
The verb means reducing the price. A shop lowers the amount for a special event. Signs tell shoppers how long it lasts.
A person should compare quality and price before buying. A cheap item may not last. Choose what fits the need.

examples.en: Cheating on exams is dishonest and strictly forbidden.
examples.zh: 考試作弊是不誠實且被嚴格禁止的。

examples.en: Making dishonest claims in advertising harms brand reputation severely.
examples.zh: 在廣告中做出不實且欺騙性的宣稱會嚴重損害品牌商譽。

examples.en: People eventually lose respect for anyone who engages in dishonest practices.
examples.zh: 人們最終會對任何從事不誠實行徑的人失去敬重。

explains: A person does not tell the truth or acts unfairly. Taking someone else's money is wrong. Return it and admit the mistake.
An answer may be false on purpose. People lose trust when facts are hidden. Honesty helps friendships last.
A business should explain prices clearly. Customers deserve truthful information. Ask questions if something seems unclear.

examples.en: The computer saved my photos on a disk.
examples.zh: 電腦把我的照片存進一張磁碟。

examples.en: She placed the music disc in the player.
examples.zh: 她把音樂光碟放進播放機。

examples.en: A damaged disk would not open the saved files.
examples.zh: 受損的磁碟無法開啟已儲存的檔案。

explains: A flat round object can store computer files or music. It spins inside a device. Keep its surface free of scratches.
A wheel-shaped part in the body helps movement. It sits between bones in the back. Doctors can explain health concerns.
The two spellings are used for different objects and in different regions. Read the label. It shows what kind is meant.

examples.en: I dislike loud music when I am trying to read.
examples.zh: 我讀書時不喜歡太吵的音樂。

examples.en: She dislikes carrots but enjoys peas.
examples.zh: 她不喜歡紅蘿蔔，但喜歡豌豆。

examples.en: His dislike of cold weather makes him stay indoors in winter.
examples.zh: 他不喜歡寒冷天氣，所以冬天會待在室內。

explains: A person does not enjoy something or prefers not to have it. A child may avoid a loud game. They can choose another activity.
The noun can mean an unfriendly feeling about something. People may have different tastes. They can still be polite.
Someone may say what they do not enjoy. Honest words help others understand. Use a kind tone.

examples.en: Rainwater flowed through the ditch beside the road.
examples.zh: 雨水流過道路旁的排水溝。

examples.en: The farmer dug a ditch to guide water away from the garden.
examples.zh: 農夫挖了一條溝，把水引離花園。

examples.en: She ditched the broken umbrella and used her raincoat.
examples.zh: 她丟掉壞掉的雨傘，改穿雨衣。

explains: A narrow hole beside a road carries away rainwater. Grass may grow along its edge. Do not play near traffic.
People may throw away a plan or habit suddenly. A student stops a game to finish homework. Making a clear choice can help.
The verb can also mean digging a channel. Workers guide water away from a field. They use tools carefully.

examples.en: The swimmer took a careful dive into the deep end.
examples.zh: 游泳者小心地跳進深水區。

examples.en: The duck dove under the water to find food.
examples.zh: 鴨子潛入水中覓食。

examples.en: The eagle dived toward the river and caught a fish.
examples.zh: 老鷹俯衝向河面，抓到一條魚。

explains: A person jumps headfirst or feetfirst into water. Swimmers follow pool rules. Check the depth before entering.
An animal may plunge into water to catch food. A bird drops quickly from the sky. It returns to the air afterward.
The word can describe moving suddenly downward. A plane may descend quickly in a story. Pilots train for safe control.

examples.en: Sitting under the blazing sun made him feel dizzy.
examples.zh: 坐在烈日暴曬下讓他感到一陣頭暈。

examples.en: Standing up too abruptly from the sofa made her feel momentarily dizzy.
examples.zh: 從沙發上太猛然站起身讓她瞬間感到一陣暈眩。

examples.en: The amusement park roller coaster ride left the children dizzy and thrilled.
examples.zh: 遊樂園的雲霄飛車讓孩子們既頭暈目眩又興奮不已。

explains: A person may feel as if the room is spinning. They should sit down. Tell an adult if the feeling continues.
Turning around quickly can make someone feel unsteady. Stop and wait. A safe place to sit can help.
Being sick or tired can also affect balance. Drink water and rest. A caregiver can decide if more help is needed.

examples.en: The fishing boat returned to the dock before sunset.
examples.zh: 漁船在日落前回到碼頭。

examples.en: We walked along the wooden dock to watch the ducks.
examples.zh: 我們沿著木碼頭散步看鴨子。

examples.en: The captain docked the boat near the harbor office.
examples.zh: 船長把船停靠在港務辦公室附近。

explains: A platform by the water lets boats stop for loading or unloading. People tie the boat securely. Watch the edge carefully.
The verb means bringing a boat beside this platform. Passengers step off after it is tied. Crew members help them.
A computer station connects equipment and charges a device. Place it on the base. Check that the plug is safe.

examples.en: The critically endangered Taiwanese white dolphin population requires strict habitat conservation corridors.
examples.zh: 數量極為稀少瀕危的台灣特有亞種中華白海豚（媽祖魚），極度需要設立專屬棲地生態保育廊道。

examples.en: Tourists rejoiced as a pod of playful dolphins leapt synchronously out of the turquoise waves.
examples.zh: 當成群活潑結伴同行的野生海豚整齊劃一跳出湛藍碧綠的波浪時，賞鯨船上的遊客無不發出陣陣驚呼喝采。

examples.en: Acoustic monitoring networks detect dolphin clicks to alert nearby commercial ships to slow down.
examples.zh: 水下被動聲學監測系統一旦偵測到海豚發出的回聲定位高頻點擊聲，便會即刻警示周圍大型商船減速航行。

entries.definition: 白海豚（台灣媽祖魚）；海豚
explains: A smart sea mammal breathes air through a blowhole. It swims with a tail fin. Groups communicate with clicks and whistles.
People may see one jump above the water at a marine park or from a boat. Keep a respectful distance in the wild. Boats should not chase it.
This animal eats fish and squid. It uses sound to find food underwater. Ocean protection helps it survive.

examples.en: The donkey carried two baskets along the mountain path.
examples.zh: 驢子沿著山路馱著兩個籃子。

examples.en: A gray donkey brayed beside the red barn.
examples.zh: 一頭灰驢在紅色穀倉旁嘶叫。

examples.en: The farmer gave the donkey clean water after its long walk.
examples.zh: 農夫讓走了很久的驢子喝乾淨的水。

explains: A small farm animal has long ears and a braying call. It can carry supplies along rough paths. Treat it gently.
The animal looks like a small horse. Its hooves are strong. Farmers provide food, clean water, and shelter.
In stories, it may be stubborn or funny. Real animals have their own needs. People should care for them kindly.

examples.en: The nurse gave the patient a small dose of medicine.
examples.zh: 護理師給病人服用少量藥物。

examples.en: Read the label before taking each dose.
examples.zh: 每次服藥前都要閱讀標籤。

examples.en: The doctor dosed the medicine according to the child's weight.
examples.zh: 醫生依照孩子的體重給予適當藥量。

explains: A measured amount of medicine is taken at one time. Read the label. Ask an adult or health worker for help.
The verb can mean giving someone a set amount. A caregiver follows instructions exactly. Never share medicine with another person.
Taking too much can be dangerous. Use the right tool to measure liquid medicine. Store it safely away from children.

examples.en: It is doubtful that the outdoor game will continue in this storm.
examples.zh: 這場暴風雨中，戶外比賽很可能無法繼續。

examples.en: She felt doubtful about the answer until she checked her notes.
examples.zh: 她對答案不太確定，直到查閱筆記後才放心。

examples.en: The coach was doubtful that the field would dry by noon.
examples.zh: 教練不確定球場能否在中午前乾透。

explains: A person is not sure whether something is true or will happen. Dark clouds make the picnic plan uncertain. The family checks the forecast.
A result may seem unlikely. A team has little time left to score. Players continue trying.
Asking questions can clear up uncertainty. Look for reliable facts. A trusted adult can help explain.

examples.en: The bakery made a doughnut with pink icing and sprinkles.
examples.zh: 麵包店做了一個撒滿彩色糖粒的粉紅糖霜甜甜圈。

examples.en: He chose a chocolate doughnut for his birthday treat.
examples.zh: 他選了一個巧克力甜甜圈當生日點心。

examples.en: The warm doughnut smelled sweet as it came out of the oven.
examples.zh: 熱騰騰的甜甜圈出爐時聞起來香甜。

explains: A sweet fried cake often has a hole in the center. It may have sugar or icing on top. Eat it as a treat.
Bakers mix dough and cook it in hot oil. An adult handles the equipment. Different fillings add flavor.
Some are round without a hole. A shop may sell them with fruit or cream inside. Keep pastries covered.

examples.en: We took the train downtown to visit the art museum.
examples.zh: 我們搭火車到市中心參觀美術館。

examples.en: A downtown hotel stood across from the old theater.
examples.zh: 市中心的一家旅館位於老劇院對面。

examples.en: The downtown streets were busy during the holiday parade.
examples.zh: 假日遊行期間，市中心街道很熱鬧。

explains: The central business area of a town or city has many shops and offices. People may ride a bus to get there. Many workers go there each morning.
The adjective describes a place in this busy center. A hotel may stand near a theater. Streets can have heavy traffic.
Visitors can find restaurants and museums there. A map helps them choose a route. Walking is easier on marked sidewalks.

examples.en: A sleek streamlined silhouette achieves a record-breaking 0.21 aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd).
examples.zh: 流線型水滴美學車身輪廓創造出打破同級紀錄的 0.21 超低風阻係數（Cd），顯著降低高速電耗。

examples.en: Flush door handles retract automatically into the bodywork to eliminate parasitic aerodynamic drag.
examples.zh: 平整化隱藏式車門把手在車輛行駛起步時會自動縮回車體內，徹底消除多餘的迎風空氣阻力擾流。

examples.en: You can click and drag files across the desktop screen into the cloud storage folder.
examples.zh: 你只需輕按滑鼠左鍵點選檔案並直接拖曳過桌面，即可將所有重要文件快速歸檔至雲端硬碟資料夾。

explains: To pull something along a surface takes effort. A child moves a heavy box across the floor. Asking for help is safer.
A computer action can move an icon across the screen. Hold the button and shift it. Release at the right place.
A long, slow event may feel tiring. A meeting goes on for hours. Short breaks help people pay attention.

examples.en: A blue dragonfly hovered above the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻藍色蜻蜓在池塘上方盤旋。

examples.en: The dragonfly landed on a reed beside the water.
examples.zh: 蜻蜓停在水邊的一根蘆葦上。

examples.en: We watched a dragonfly dart across the sunny garden.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻蜻蜓飛快地掠過陽光明媚的花園。

explains: A flying insect has a long body and four clear wings. It often stays near ponds. It eats smaller insects.
Its large eyes help it see around itself. It can fly quickly and change direction. Watch it without catching it.
The wings may shine in sunlight. A garden pond can attract these insects. Keep water areas clean.

examples.en: Clean fallen hair from the shower floor drain regularly.
examples.zh: 定期清理淋浴間地板排水孔上的掉落毛髮。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall overwhelmed the municipal street storm drains.
examples.zh: 傾盆暴雨讓市區街道的雨水下水道排水系統不堪重負。

examples.en: Continuous stress and overwork will completely drain your physical energy.
examples.zh: 長期持續的壓力與超時過勞會徹底耗盡你的體力與精力。

explains: A pipe or hole carries extra water away from a sink or street. Keep it clear of leaves. Water can flow properly.
The verb means removing liquid from a container. Pour it slowly. Use a strainer to keep food from falling out.
A person may use up energy after a busy day. Rest and food help the body recover. Take breaks when needed.

examples.en: The dramatic sunset filled the sky with red and purple clouds.
examples.zh: 壯觀的日落讓天空布滿紅色和紫色的雲。

examples.en: Her dramatic reading made the story exciting for the class.
examples.zh: 她生動的朗讀讓全班覺得故事很精彩。

examples.en: The team made a dramatic comeback in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 球隊在最後幾分鐘上演了戲劇性的逆轉。

explains: Something is exciting or full of strong feeling. A sudden storm changes the sky quickly. People watch from indoors.
An actor makes a scene lively with voice and movement. The audience follows the story. Practice helps the performance feel real.
A big change can be noticeable. A plant grows much taller in a week. Keep a picture to see the difference.

examples.en: Solar-powered precision drip irrigation delivers water drop by drop directly to thirsty plant roots.
examples.zh: 結合太陽能的智慧微滴灌系統，將珍貴水資源一滴滴精準送達作物根系，節水七成。

examples.en: The plumber tightened the compression fitting beneath the kitchen sink to stop the annoying faucet drip.
examples.zh: 水電師傅拿起扳手迅速鎖緊了廚房流理台下方的防漏接頭，徹底解決了困擾已久的水龍頭滴水問題。

examples.en: Intravenous medication was administered to the hospital patient via a steady bedside medical drip.
examples.zh: 護理師透過床邊懸掛的醫療級靜脈輸液點滴，將抗生素藥劑以穩定規律的速度滴注輸入病患體內。

entries.definition: 太陽能智慧微滴灌省水灌溉；滴下
explains: A small drop of liquid falls slowly from a surface. A leaky faucet can make this sound. Tell an adult so it can be fixed.
The verb means letting drops fall one by one. Wet clothes hang over a sink. A towel catches the water.
Water may run down after rain. Roof edges release drops. A bucket can protect the floor.

examples.en: A life jacket can help prevent drowning during boat trips.
examples.zh: 搭船時穿救生衣有助於預防溺水。

examples.en: The rescue team saved the swimmer from drowning.
examples.zh: 救援隊救起了那名溺水的游泳者。

examples.en: The loud music drowned out our quiet conversation.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂蓋過了我們輕聲的談話。

explains: A person or animal can die after being unable to breathe underwater. Stay with an adult near pools or rivers. Follow water safety rules.
Strong water currents can be dangerous. Never enter floodwater. Call trained rescuers if someone is in trouble.
A person may be overwhelmed by too much work or noise in a figurative sense. Take a break. Ask for help.

examples.en: We bought bandages and soap at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我們在藥妝店買了繃帶和肥皂。

examples.en: The drugstore pharmacist explained how to use the thermometer.
examples.zh: 藥局藥師說明了溫度計的使用方法。

examples.en: A small drugstore opened near the bus station.
examples.zh: 公車站附近開了一家小藥局。

explains: A shop sells medicine and health supplies. A pharmacist can answer questions. Follow labels and ask an adult before taking anything.
The store may also have snacks, shampoo, and greeting cards. People can buy daily needs. Keep medicine away from children.
Some places use a different name for this kind of shop. Signs show where it is. Check opening hours before going.

examples.en: The drunk driver was stopped before anyone got hurt.
examples.zh: 那名酒醉駕駛在有人受傷前就被攔下了。

examples.en: The story showed a drunk sailor who could not walk straight.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一名喝醉的水手走路不穩。

examples.en: A drunk passenger rested while a friend called for a ride.
examples.zh: 一名喝醉的乘客休息時，朋友幫忙叫了車。

explains: A person who has consumed too much alcohol may lose balance or judgment. Adults should not drive. Children should get help from a trusted adult.
The word can describe an animal that has taken too much fermented fruit in a story. Such scenes are unusual. Animals need protection.
A person who drinks alcohol should stay with safe companions. They should not operate vehicles. Call emergency services if someone is in danger.

examples.en: The cartoon mouse gave a dumb look when the cheese disappeared.
examples.zh: 起司消失時，卡通老鼠露出一臉茫然。

examples.en: It was a dumb mistake to leave the lunch outside in the rain.
examples.zh: 把午餐忘在雨裡是個愚蠢的錯誤。

examples.en: Some people once used dumb to mean unable to speak, but that use can offend.
examples.zh: 過去有人用 dumb 表示無法說話，但這種用法可能冒犯他人。

explains: A person may be unable to speak or choose not to speak. Some people communicate with signs or devices. Treat everyone with respect.
This word can be rude when used to call someone unintelligent. Choose kinder language. People learn in different ways.
A quiet animal may make no sound. A toy may also have no voice. Context tells which meaning is meant.

examples.en: The town closed the old dump and opened a recycling center.
examples.zh: 鎮上關閉了舊垃圾場，並開設回收中心。

examples.en: Please do not dump your toys on the stairs.
examples.zh: 請不要把玩具亂丟在樓梯上。

examples.en: He dumped the sand from the pail into the sandbox.
examples.zh: 他把桶裡的沙倒進沙坑。

explains: A place where unwanted waste is left may be called this. People should use proper bins. Litter harms animals and nature.
The verb can mean dropping or putting something down carelessly. A person may empty a bag on the floor. They should clean up.
A computer user can remove files from a device. Check before deleting. Important work should be saved first.

examples.en: Steamed pork soup dumplings (Xiao Long Bao) burst with steaming hot juice.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的鼎泰豐經典小籠湯包皮薄餡多，輕輕咬破便流出滾燙濃郁的鮮美湯汁。

examples.en: The entire family gathers around the table on Lunar New Year's Eve to wrap festive dumplings.
examples.zh: 除夕夜全家老小圍坐在餐桌旁齊心包水餃，象徵招財進寶、迎春納福。

examples.en: Dip the boiled cabbage pork dumplings into black vinegar mixed with finely sliced ginger.
examples.zh: 將剛煮熟的高麗菜鮮肉水餃沾著調和薑絲的烏醋醬汁一同食用，滋味絕妙。

explains: A small ball or pocket of dough is filled with meat or vegetables. It can be boiled or steamed. People eat it with sauce.
Families may make these together for a holiday. Each person folds the edges. The shapes can vary.
A sweet version may contain fruit. Let hot filling cool before taking a bite. Share a plate with friends.

examples.en: A layer of dust covered the books on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 一層灰塵覆蓋了最上層架子上的書。

examples.en: She dusted the cake with powdered sugar.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕上撒了糖粉。

examples.en: Dust from the dry field blew across the road.
examples.zh: 乾燥田地的塵土吹過道路。

explains: Tiny dry bits settle on shelves and floors. A cloth can wipe them away. Open windows carefully to air out a room.
The verb means covering something with fine powder. A baker adds sugar to a cake. Use only a little.
Wind can carry dry earth through the air. People may wear a mask in a dusty place. Keep eyes protected.

examples.en: The eager puppy waited by the door for its walk.
examples.zh: 熱切期待的小狗在門邊等著散步。

examples.en: Mia was eager to show her painting to the class.
examples.zh: 米亞迫不及待想把畫作展示給全班看。

examples.en: The eager volunteers arrived early to plant trees.
examples.zh: 熱心的志工提早到場種樹。

explains: A person is excited and ready for something to happen. A child waits for a birthday party. They ask when guests will arrive.
Someone may be very willing to learn. A student raises a hand to answer. Curiosity helps them grow.
People can feel keen to join an activity. Friends prepare for a hike. They pack water and snacks.

examples.en: Angled geometry and textured surfaces eliminate flutter echo between opposing parallel side walls.
examples.zh: 傾斜的非平行牆面設計搭配立體幾何紋理，徹底消除了平行側牆之間發生的「顫動回音」（Flutter Echo）。

examples.en: The lost mountaineer shouted loudly into the vast canyon, listening for the faint returning echo of his voice.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客朝著空曠深邃的大峽谷大聲呼喊求救，屏息傾聽自己悠遠聲音在岩壁間傳回的微弱回聲。

examples.en: The prime minister’s impassioned speech seemed to echo the deep frustrations felt by working-class families.
examples.zh: 內閣總理發表的這場慷慨激昂施政演說，深刻呼應並共鳴了廣大基層勞工家庭長久以來的生計無奈。

entries.definition: 徹底消除平行牆面之顫動回音與空間駐波；回音
explains: A sound reflects off a wall or mountain and is heard again. People may call out in a cave. Their voices return to them.
The verb means repeating a sound in this way. A clap bounces around a hall. It fades slowly.
A person's words can be repeated by another speaker. This may show agreement. Listening carefully helps people understand.

examples.en: Please edit your story before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 請在交出故事前先修改。

examples.en: He edited the video to make the ending shorter.
examples.zh: 他剪輯影片，讓結尾更短。

examples.en: I edited my email to fix a spelling mistake.
examples.zh: 我修改電子郵件，修正了一個拼字錯誤。

explains: A person changes a piece of writing to make it clearer or correct mistakes. They check spelling and punctuation. A clean copy is easier to read.
A video maker can cut or arrange clips. They choose which scenes to keep. The final version tells a clear story.
A computer user may change a saved file. Save the new work. Keep a copy in case something goes wrong.

examples.en: The editor corrected a few spelling errors in my article.
examples.zh: 編輯修正了我文章中的幾個拼字錯誤。

examples.en: A newspaper editor chose the front-page story.
examples.zh: 報紙編輯選出了頭版故事。

examples.en: The editor added captions to the short film.
examples.zh: 剪輯師為短片加上字幕。

explains: A person checks writing and helps prepare it for readers. They correct mistakes. They may suggest clearer words.
A newspaper worker chooses which stories to print. They plan the pages. Deadlines help everyone finish on time.
A video worker may select scenes and put them in order. The story becomes easier to follow. Good sound is important too.

examples.en: The museum's programs educate children about local history.
examples.zh: 博物館的活動教導孩子認識地方歷史。

examples.en: Books educate us about animals from faraway places.
examples.zh: 書籍讓我們認識遠方的動物。

examples.en: The guide educated our group about the old bridge.
examples.zh: 導覽員讓我們了解這座舊橋的歷史。

explains: To teach someone facts or skills is to help them learn. A parent shows a child how to read a map. Practice helps.
Schools give lessons in many subjects. Teachers answer questions. Students learn from books and activities.
People can continue learning as adults. A class may teach cooking or computer skills. New knowledge can be useful.

examples.en: The educational game helped us practice spelling.
examples.zh: 這個教育遊戲幫助我們練習拼字。

examples.en: The zoo offers educational tours for school groups.
examples.zh: 動物園為學校團體提供教育導覽。

examples.en: We watched an educational video about ocean life.
examples.zh: 我們看了一部關於海洋生物的教育影片。

explains: Something helps people learn facts or skills. A museum trip can teach children about science. Hands-on activities make ideas clear.
A book may explain a subject with pictures and examples. Readers ask questions. Practice helps them remember.
Games can teach counting or teamwork. People have fun while learning. Choose activities that fit the learner's age.

examples.en: The efficient fan cools the room while using less electricity.
examples.zh: 這台省電的風扇能在耗電較少的情況下讓房間降溫。

examples.en: Our efficient plan helped us pack before the rain began.
examples.zh: 我們有效率的計畫幫助大家在下雨前收拾好。

examples.en: An efficient worker finished the careful task without wasting supplies.
examples.zh: 一位做事俐落的工作者沒有浪費材料就完成了細心的工作。

explains: A person or tool does a job well without wasting much time or effort. A sharp pencil makes drawing easier. Good planning helps too.
A machine may use less energy to finish a task. This can save money. Follow directions for best results.
A clear routine helps a group complete work smoothly. Everyone knows their part. Fewer steps can prevent mistakes.

examples.en: She bumped her elbow on the desk while reaching for a book.
examples.zh: 她伸手拿書時，手肘撞到了桌子。

examples.en: The pipe has an elbow beneath the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 廚房水槽下方的管子有一個彎頭。

examples.en: He gently elbowed the door open because his hands were full.
examples.zh: 他雙手拿滿東西，便輕輕用手肘把門推開。

explains: This joint connects the upper and lower parts of an arm. It bends when someone reaches. A sleeve covers it.
People may lean an arm on a table during a meal. Keep space for others. Good manners help everyone feel comfortable.
A pipe may have a curved piece that changes its direction. Plumbers fit the part carefully. It helps water flow around a corner.

examples.en: The elderly neighbor waved to us from her garden.
examples.zh: 年長的鄰居在花園裡向我們揮手。

examples.en: A bus seat was saved for the elderly passenger.
examples.zh: 公車上為年長乘客保留了一個座位。

examples.en: The center offers free classes for elderly residents.
examples.zh: 活動中心為年長居民提供免費課程。

explains: Older people may need more time or help with some daily tasks. They have many life experiences. Treat them with patience and respect.
A person in this age group may enjoy walking or meeting friends. Activities should suit their health. Family members can offer support.
Different people age in different ways. Some stay active for many years. Kind communities make places easier for everyone to use.

examples.en: Students will elect a class leader on Monday.
examples.zh: 學生們將在星期一選出班級幹部。

examples.en: The club members elected Maya as their new president.
examples.zh: 社團成員選出瑪雅擔任新會長。

examples.en: Voters elect local leaders to represent their community.
examples.zh: 選民選出地方領袖來代表社區。

explains: People choose someone for a position by voting. Members mark a paper or use a machine. The person with enough votes wins.
A group may choose a leader for a club. Everyone listens to ideas. A fair process gives members a voice.
In older writing, the word can mean choosing or deciding. Context explains which meaning fits. Read the whole sentence.

examples.en: The presidential election took place smoothly on Saturday.
examples.zh: 總統大選在週六平穩順利地完成舉行。

examples.en: Election campaigns filled city streets with colorful banners and broadcast trucks.
examples.zh: 選舉宣傳活動讓市區大街小巷掛滿了繽紛旗幟並穿梭著宣傳車。

examples.en: She volunteered as an election observer to ensure fair ballot counting.
examples.zh: 她自願擔任投開票所監票志工，以確保計票過程公正公開。

explains: People vote to choose leaders or decide an issue. They learn about the choices first. Rules make the process fair.
A school club may choose a president this way. Each member marks a vote. The group counts them carefully.
Taking part lets people help shape decisions. Citizens follow local rules. Results are shared with the public.

examples.en: The storm knocked out electricity across our street.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓我們整條街都停電了。

examples.en: Electricity powers the lights in the school gym.
examples.zh: 電力為學校體育館的燈供電。
