examples.en: The coach frowned at the muddy field.
examples.zh: 教練看著泥濘的球場皺起眉頭。

examples.en: He gave a little frown while thinking about the answer.
examples.zh: 他思考答案時微微皺眉。

explains: A person's eyebrows can move together and the mouth may turn down when they are unhappy or thinking hard. This face movement can show a feeling. It does not always mean anger.
When the puzzle seemed difficult, Jin wrinkled his forehead and looked closely at the pieces. He kept trying until he found a match. Then he smiled.
A smile often shows happiness. A face with lowered eyebrows can show worry or concentration. People express feelings in many ways.

examples.en: The missing puzzle piece began to frustrate the children.
examples.zh: 拼圖少了一片，開始讓孩子們感到沮喪。

examples.en: It frustrates me when the computer freezes during homework.
examples.zh: 寫作業時電腦當機讓我很煩。

examples.en: She did not want to frustrate her little brother.
examples.zh: 她不想讓弟弟感到挫折。

explains: A problem can make someone feel upset when their plan does not work. Taking a pause or trying a new way may help. Asking for support is also useful.
Nora could not fit the last puzzle piece. She took a short break and looked again from another side. It fit at once.
A simple task may feel easy, but repeated trouble can upset someone. A new approach can help. Patience gives people time to solve problems.

examples.en: He sighed with frustration when the game froze.
examples.zh: 遊戲當機時，他沮喪地嘆了口氣。

examples.en: Her frustration faded after she solved the puzzle.
examples.zh: 她解開拼圖後，沮喪感消失了。

examples.en: The long delay caused frustration among the travelers.
examples.zh: 漫長的延誤引起旅客們的不滿。

explains: A person may feel upset when something blocks their goal or does not work as expected. The feeling can grow after repeated problems. A break can help.
When the kite would not rise, Sam felt upset and wanted to quit. His sister helped untangle the string. Soon it flew above the trees.
Success can bring joy, while a setback may bring an uncomfortable feeling. People can name the feeling and ask for help. Trying again may work.

examples.en: Mentoring underprivileged students gives retired educators deep personal fulfillment.
examples.zh: 悉心指導偏鄉弱勢學童課業讓退休教師收穫了難以言喻的深層自我實現感。

examples.en: True happiness comes from pursuing meaningful goals that offer lasting fulfillment.
examples.zh: 真正的幸福源自於追尋能為人生帶來深邃持久滿足感與成就感的崇高目標。

examples.en: The prompt fulfillment of overseas customer orders is the logistics center's top priority.
examples.zh: 迅速且準確地履行交付海外客戶訂單，是該物流配送中心運作的首要任務。

examples.en: Robotic fulfillment centers process tens of thousands of online shopping parcels every hour.
examples.zh: 配備高度自動化機器人的大型電商物流履行中心（Fulfillment Center）每小時高效處理數萬件網購包裹。

examples.en: Fast order fulfillment has become a primary competitive battleground for modern e-commerce platforms.
examples.zh: 極速精準的訂單履行能力，已成為現代各大電商平台兵家必爭的核心競爭焦點。

examples.en: Outscoring warehouse fulfillment to a third-party partner allows boutique brands to focus on marketing.
examples.zh: 將倉儲理貨與包裝出貨外包給專業第三方物流履行業者，能讓新創設計品牌全力專注於產品行銷。

examples.en: Engaging in creative hobbies brings profound emotional fulfillment throughout one's golden retirement years.
examples.zh: 在悠閒的退休晚年歲月中投身繪畫與園藝等興趣愛好，能為心靈帶來深沉的圓滿與充實感。

examples.en: Dedicating personal time to mentoring underprivileged youth provided him with deep spiritual fulfillment.
examples.zh: 撥出寶貴的私人時間用心輔導弱勢偏鄉學童，為他的人生帶來了無比深刻的精神自我實現。

examples.en: Automated logistics centers ensure speedy order fulfillment within twelve hours of online checkout.
examples.zh: 智慧自動化物流調度中心確保所有線上電商訂單在顧客結帳後十二小時內迅速完成出貨配送。

entries.definition: 成就感；自我實現感；履行；電商倉儲物流履行；履行實現；圓滿無憾的金色黃金晚年；實現
explains: To do what was promised or needed is to complete a duty. A person can also reach a hope or goal. Careful steps help finish the task.
The class promised to collect books for the shelter. They gathered boxes from home and delivered them together. They were glad to keep their promise.
Starting a plan is only the first step. Finishing it means the duty has been completed. Reaching a personal hope may take time.

examples.en: The old phone is still functional even though it looks worn.
examples.zh: 這支舊手機雖然看起來磨損，仍然能正常使用。

examples.en: We need a functional desk with enough space for books.
examples.zh: 我們需要一張有足夠空間放書的實用書桌。

examples.en: The toy's wheels are not functional anymore.
examples.zh: 這個玩具的輪子已經不能正常轉動了。

explains: Something that works properly and serves a useful purpose is ready to use. It may be simple rather than decorative. The important part is that it does its job.
The new shelf had plain sides but held all the books without wobbling. The family used it every day. It fit neatly in the room.
A decorative object may look attractive but not be useful. A practical one helps complete a task. Some items can be both.

examples.en: Reading is a fundamental skill for learning at school.
examples.zh: 閱讀是在學校學習的基本技能。

examples.en: Trust is fundamental to a good friendship.
examples.zh: 信任是良好友誼的基礎。

examples.en: The lesson covered fundamental rules of safety.
examples.zh: 這堂課涵蓋了基本安全規則。

explains: A basic part is necessary for understanding a subject or doing a task. It supports more advanced ideas. Learning the simple parts first can help.
Before adding fractions, the class practiced counting and dividing objects into equal groups. Those early steps helped them solve harder problems. The teacher praised their effort.
A small extra detail may be useful but not required. A basic rule supports the rest of the work. Knowing it makes learning easier.

examples.en: Friends attended the funeral to support the family.
examples.zh: 朋友們參加葬禮，支持這個家庭。

examples.en: The funeral service included a song she loved.
examples.zh: 葬禮儀式中播放了一首她喜歡的歌。

examples.en: They sent flowers to the family before the funeral.
examples.zh: 葬禮前，他們送花給這個家庭。

explains: A gathering may be held after someone dies to remember their life and say goodbye. Family and friends can offer support. People observe different customs.
After the grandfather died, relatives met at a quiet service. They shared stories about his kindness and stayed together afterward. The family felt supported.
A birthday celebrates a life each year. A memorial gathering honors someone who has died. Both can bring people together.

examples.en: She was furious when someone broke her favorite toy.
examples.zh: 有人弄壞她最喜歡的玩具時，她氣壞了。

examples.en: The coach grew furious after the team ignored the safety rule.
examples.zh: 隊伍忽視安全規則後，教練勃然大怒。

examples.en: He was furious about the unfair decision.
examples.zh: 他對這個不公平的決定非常憤怒。

explains: Someone who feels extremely angry may have a strong reaction. Taking a breath before speaking can help them choose kind words. It is important not to hurt anyone.
When Max saw that his model plane was broken, he felt very angry. He stepped away and counted slowly before talking to his brother. They found out what had happened.
A little annoyance may pass quickly. A very strong angry feeling can be hard to manage. Trusted adults can help people calm down.

examples.en: They furnished the bedroom with a bed and two small tables.
examples.zh: 他們在臥室裡擺放了一張床和兩張小桌子。

examples.en: The company furnished the office with new chairs.
examples.zh: 公司為辦公室添置了新椅子。

examples.en: We furnished the room with simple, useful pieces.
examples.zh: 我們在房間裡擺放了簡單實用的家具。

explains: To put furniture or useful items into a room is to make it ready for people to use. A desk, bed, or chair may be added. The items should fit the space.
The family moved into an empty apartment. They brought a table, two chairs, and a lamp. The room was ready for dinner.
An empty room has little in it. Adding useful furniture makes it comfortable. Choosing the right size leaves room to move.

examples.en: The park is clean; furthermore, it has many shady trees.
examples.zh: 公園很乾淨；此外，還有許多遮蔭的大樹。

examples.en: She is kind and, furthermore, always ready to help.
examples.zh: 她很善良，而且總是樂於助人。

examples.en: The book is funny; furthermore, its pictures are beautiful.
examples.zh: 這本書很有趣；此外，插圖也很漂亮。

explains: This word adds another point to information already given. It helps connect two related ideas. The second point gives more detail or support.
The park has wide paths for bikes. It also has water fountains for visitors. Families enjoy spending the whole day there.
A new paragraph can introduce an added fact. This connecting word signals that more information is coming. Readers can follow the ideas more easily.

examples.en: Local artists display their paintings in this downtown art gallery.
examples.zh: 在地藝術家在這家市中心畫廊展出其畫作。

examples.en: She walked quietly through the photo gallery admiring the black-and-white portraits.
examples.zh: 她安靜地漫步穿過攝影藝廊，欣賞著黑白肖像照片。

examples.en: You can swipe left on your phone screen to view images in the picture gallery.
examples.zh: 您可以在手機螢幕上向左滑動以瀏覽圖片圖庫中的照片。

examples.en: Local indie painters display their latest watercolor works in Dihua Street galleries.
examples.zh: 本土獨立畫家在迪化街的特色藝廊展出最新的水彩畫作。

examples.en: We strolled through a charming seaside gallery featuring handcrafted glassware.
examples.zh: 我們愜意漫步穿梭於一家陳列手工吹製玻璃藝品的溫馨濱海藝廊。

examples.en: The online photo gallery displays high-resolution pictures of Taiwan's alpine peaks.
examples.zh: 這處線上數位圖片藝廊展示了台灣各大百岳壯麗山巒的高畫質攝影作品。

examples.en: Taipei Fine Arts Museum (TFAM) curates cutting-edge contemporary installations across spacious white cube galleries.
examples.zh: 台北市立美術館（北美館）在挑高寬敞的白盒子展廳中，常態策劃具前瞻性與思辨力的當代藝術展。

examples.en: Commercial art galleries near Daan Forest Park host opening receptions featuring emerging Taiwanese painters.
examples.zh: 坐落於大安森林公園周邊的商業畫廊，經常為台灣年輕新銳藝術家舉辦高雅溫馨的個展開幕茶會。

examples.en: The top gallery on the third floor showcases centuries of Chinese jade carvings under soft spotlights.
examples.zh: 位於三樓最深處的主題展覽廳，在柔和微弱的聚光燈下呈現數百年來鬼斧神工的古代宮廷玉雕傑作。

entries.definition: 美術館；畫廊；藝廊；美術館展廳；當代藝術畫廊；美術館展覽廳
explains: A room or building can show paintings, photographs, or other artworks for visitors to see. People walk around and look closely. Labels may explain who made each piece.
The art center displayed colorful pictures on white walls. A guide told visitors about the artists. The children chose their favorite painting.
A library holds books for people to read. A place for showing art lets people view pictures and objects. Both can teach visitors.

examples.en: Invisible infrared LED rings track your eye gaze so you can select icons simply by looking at them.
examples.zh: 隱形紅外線 LED 環即時追蹤使用者的「目光凝視方向」（Eye Gaze），只需注視圖示即可瞬間選取。

examples.en: The tourist stood quietly on the observation deck, directing her gaze across the shimmering harbor.
examples.zh: 觀光客靜靜站在觀景台上，將目光投向波光粼粼的港灣港景。

examples.en: Psychologists analyze mutual gaze patterns to understand infant emotional development.
examples.zh: 心理學家分析眼神凝視的雙向互動模式，藉此了解嬰幼兒的情感發展。

entries.definition: 微秒級眼球凝視方向紅外線追蹤感測；凝視
explains: To look steadily at something for a while can show interest or wonder. A person may do this when watching stars or a beautiful view. It is different from a quick glance.
At night, the family sat outside and looked at the bright moon. They stayed quiet and noticed tiny stars nearby. The children asked how far away they were.
A brief look lasts only a moment. A steady look continues for longer. People may look closely when something catches their attention.

examples.en: The hikers checked their gear before starting the trail.
examples.zh: 健行者出發走步道前檢查了裝備。

examples.en: The goalie put on protective gear before the game.
examples.zh: 守門員在比賽前穿上防護裝備。

examples.en: We packed our camping gear into the car.
examples.zh: 我們把露營裝備裝進車裡。

explains: Tools, clothing, or equipment needed for an activity can be called this. Hikers need boots and a map, while players need sports items. Good preparation keeps people safer.
Before the camping trip, Ana packed a raincoat, flashlight, and warm socks. She checked each item on a list. Her family was ready to leave.
Everyday clothing may not suit a special activity. Useful equipment helps people do a task. Different activities require different supplies.

examples.en: Gender equality is emphasized in Taiwanese schools.
examples.zh: 台灣學校非常重視性別平等。

examples.en: Traditional assumptions about gender roles have changed significantly over the decades.
examples.zh: 數十年來，關於性別角色的傳統假設已經發生了顯著轉變。

examples.en: Employment decisions must be made fairly regardless of gender or background.
examples.zh: 無論性別或背景為何，企業在招募決策時都必須秉持公正原則。

explains: People may describe their identity as a boy, girl, both, neither, or another way. Each person deserves respect. Asking politely can help someone feel understood.
A new student shared the name and pronouns they wanted classmates to use. The teacher thanked them and wrote the information down. Everyone practiced being respectful.
People have different identities and experiences. No one should be teased for describing who they are. Kind listening helps a group feel safe.

examples.en: A gene can affect the color of a flower.
examples.zh: 基因可能影響花朵的顏色。

examples.en: Scientists studied a gene linked to the plant's growth.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了一個與植物生長有關的基因。

examples.en: Some genes are passed from parents to children.
examples.zh: 有些基因會從父母傳給子女。

explains: Tiny instructions inside living things help pass features from parents to children. They can affect traits such as eye color or how a plant grows. Scientists study how these instructions work.
The class compared pictures of puppies from the same litter. They had different fur colors but shared many features. Their family history helped explain this.
A learned skill comes from practice. Some physical traits are passed through families. Many features are shaped by both inheritance and surroundings.

examples.en: Zero-emission power generation from ocean winds cleans our skies and slows global warming.
examples.zh: 來自海洋季風的純淨零碳綠能發電，還給孩子們蔚藍晴空並減緩全球暖化浩劫。

examples.en: On windy winter days, offshore wind generation supplies more than a quarter of the island’s midday electricity.
examples.zh: 在冬季風勁十足的日子裡，台灣海峽離岸風電瞬時發電量甚至能供應全台中午超過四分之一的用電需求。

examples.en: Phasing out polluting coal-fired generation brings immediate respiratory benefits to coastal communities.
examples.zh: 逐步汰除高污染燃煤電廠發電機組，為長期飽受煙囪空污所苦的沿海鄉親帶來立竿見影的呼吸健康改善。

entries.definition: 潔淨純淨零碳排綠色發電；世代
explains: A group of people born around the same time forms one age group. Parents and children are in different groups. The word can also mean producing power or ideas.
Grandma showed photos of her family when she was young. She compared them with pictures of her grandchildren today. Their clothes and games had changed.
A family tree can show grandparents, parents, and children. Each group belongs to a different age level. Context tells whether the word means age group or making something.

examples.en: We were deeply touched by the local villagers' warmth and generosity.
examples.zh: 我們被當地村民的熱情與大度慷慨深深打動。

examples.en: Acts of quiet generosity during the winter storm brought food to homeless citizens.
examples.zh: 寒流侵襲期間無私奉獻的善行義舉，為無家可歸的街友及時送上了熱騰騰的食物。

examples.en: Her endless generosity and willingness to share knowledge inspired all her younger peers.
examples.zh: 她樂善好施的慷慨胸懷與無私傳授實務經驗的熱忱，深深啟發了同儕後進。

explains: Willingness to share time, care, or belongings with others shows kindness. A gift does not need to be expensive. Helpful actions can make someone's day better.
When a new neighbor moved in, the family brought over a warm meal. They also offered to help unpack boxes. The neighbor felt welcome.
Keeping everything for yourself leaves little to share. A caring act can be small or large. Giving should come freely and safely.

examples.en: The young genius solved the puzzle in a few minutes.
examples.zh: 這位年輕天才幾分鐘內就解開了謎題。

examples.en: Her genius for music showed in every song she wrote.
examples.zh: 她在音樂方面的天賦展現在她創作的每首歌中。

examples.en: The inventor was called a genius for his clever design.
examples.zh: 這位發明家因巧妙的設計而被稱為天才。

explains: A person with an unusually great ability in one area may solve problems or create remarkable work. Talent can grow through practice. Everyone has different strengths.
A young musician could play difficult piano pieces after years of daily practice. She still asked her teacher for new lessons. Her skill continued to grow.
A quick learner may understand an idea fast. Exceptional skill can take effort and time. People should respect many kinds of ability.

examples.en: The shop sells genuine leather bags.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售真皮包包。

examples.en: Her genuine smile made the visitors feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她真誠的笑容讓訪客感到受歡迎。

examples.en: The museum confirmed that the signature was genuine.
examples.zh: 博物館確認這個簽名是真跡。

explains: Something real and not fake can be trusted to be what it claims. People may check its source or details. A true feeling comes from honesty.
At the market, the seller showed a label proving that the handmade scarf came from a local artist. The buyer liked its careful stitching. She took it home.
A copy may look like the original but is made later. Checking details can show what is real. Honest words help people trust one another.

examples.en: Wash your hands to remove germs before eating.
examples.zh: 吃東西前要洗手，去除手上的細菌。

examples.en: A germ can spread when people cough without covering their mouths.
examples.zh: 人們咳嗽時不遮住嘴巴，病菌可能因此傳播。

examples.en: The scientist looked at a germ through a microscope.
examples.zh: 科學家透過顯微鏡觀察一個微生物。

explains: A tiny living thing can be too small to see without a microscope. Some kinds can make people sick, so washing hands helps prevent spread. Not all tiny organisms are harmful.
Before lunch, the children washed their hands with soap and water. They scrubbed between their fingers and dried them. Their teacher explained why clean hands matter.
Dust is not alive, but some tiny organisms are. Some help nature, while others cause illness. Clean habits reduce the chance of spreading harmful ones.

examples.en: The gifted singer performed a difficult song.
examples.zh: 這位有天賦的歌手演唱了一首困難的歌曲。

examples.en: She is gifted at solving number puzzles.
examples.zh: 她很有解數字謎題的天分。

examples.en: A gifted young artist showed her paintings at the fair.
examples.zh: 一位有才華的年輕藝術家在園遊會展出畫作。

explains: Someone with a natural ability in a certain activity may learn it quickly. Practice can make that ability stronger. People can be talented in many different areas.
Owen could draw animals with lifelike details even when he was young. He practiced every week and took an art class. His pictures improved.
A new learner may need more time to build a skill. A naturally strong ability can make learning quicker. Effort still matters.

examples.en: A gigantic wave rolled toward the shore.
examples.zh: 一個巨浪朝岸邊翻湧而來。

examples.en: They saw a gigantic statue in the city square.
examples.zh: 他們在城市廣場看見一座巨大的雕像。

examples.en: The gigantic tree shaded the whole garden.
examples.zh: 那棵巨大的樹為整座花園遮蔭。

explains: Something far bigger than most things of its kind can seem enormous. Comparing it with a familiar object helps show its size. It may need a lot of space.
The pumpkin was so large that two children had to carry it together. It filled the wagon from side to side. Everyone wanted to see it.
A tiny seed fits in a hand. A very large object may take many people to move. Size can surprise us.

examples.en: The children began to giggle at the silly puppet.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到滑稽的布偶便咯咯笑起來。

examples.en: She giggled when her puppy chased its tail.
examples.zh: 小狗追著自己的尾巴跑時，她咯咯笑了。

examples.en: The friends tried not to giggle during the quiet lesson.
examples.zh: 朋友們上安靜的課時努力忍住不笑。

explains: A short light laugh often comes when someone finds something silly or funny. Friends may share this light laugh during a game. Quiet behavior is still needed in some places.
The teacher made a funny face while telling the story. The children covered their mouths and laughed softly. They tried not to interrupt the next part.
A loud laugh can fill a room. A small laugh is quieter and quick. People react differently to jokes.

examples.en: Hot ginger tea is great for warming up in winter.
examples.zh: 熱薑茶在冬天暖身效果極佳。

examples.en: Add a few slices of fresh ginger to balance seafood dishes.
examples.zh: 加入幾片新鮮薑絲以中和海鮮料理的寒涼與去腥。

examples.en: Ginger candies are often taken by travelers to relieve motion sickness.
examples.zh: 旅行者經常吃薑糖來緩解暈車或暈船的不適。

explains: A spicy root can be used to flavor food and drinks. It has a warm sharp taste. People often grate or slice it before cooking.
Dad added small pieces of the root to a pot of soup. The kitchen smelled warm and spicy. Everyone enjoyed the meal.
A sweet fruit has a different taste from this spicy plant part. Cooks use it in both savory dishes and sweets. A little can add strong flavor.

examples.en: I caught a glimpse of a fox near the trees.
examples.zh: 我瞥見樹木附近有一隻狐狸。

examples.en: She glimpsed the ocean through the train window.
examples.zh: 她從火車窗戶短暫看見海洋。

examples.en: The crowd got a glimpse of the singer as she left.
examples.zh: 歌手離開時，人群短暫看到了她。

explains: A quick short look gives only a brief view of something. It may happen while a person is moving past. They might not see every detail.
The bus passed the castle so quickly that Nora saw only its tall tower. She wanted to visit later and look around. Her father wrote down the name.
A long look lets someone notice many details. A short look lasts just a moment. The word often describes a brief sight.

examples.en: The teacher spun the globe to find South America.
examples.zh: 老師轉動地球儀來尋找南美洲。

examples.en: A globe shows the shape of the Earth.
examples.zh: 地球儀呈現了地球的形狀。

examples.en: She marked our country on the classroom globe.
examples.zh: 她在教室的地球儀上標出了我們的國家。

explains: A round model of Earth shows its oceans, lands, and countries. It can spin on a stand. Students use it to learn where places are.
The teacher turned the round map until the class could see the Pacific Ocean. They found their country and traced a route across the sea. The model helped them understand distance.
A flat map fits on a page but can change how shapes look. A round model shows the planet's shape. Both help people study places.

examples.en: We enjoyed a glorious sunset over the ocean.
examples.zh: 我們欣賞了海面上壯麗的夕陽。

examples.en: The team had a glorious victory in the final game.
examples.zh: 隊伍在最後一場比賽中取得了輝煌的勝利。

examples.en: It was a glorious day for a picnic in the park.
examples.zh: 那天非常適合在公園野餐。

explains: Something extremely beautiful or wonderful may make people feel joy and admiration. A sunny day or a great victory can have this quality. People use the word for special moments.
The family climbed to the hilltop just as the sun rose. The sky turned orange and pink over the valley. They stood quietly and watched.
An ordinary day may feel pleasant. A remarkable moment can seem especially wonderful. What feels special may differ for each person.

examples.en: The store received new goods from the factory.
examples.zh: 商店收到工廠送來的新商品。

examples.en: They packed their household goods into boxes before moving.
examples.zh: 搬家前，他們把家用品裝進箱子裡。

examples.en: The ship carried goods across the sea.
examples.zh: 船隻載運貨物渡過海洋。

explains: Things made or sold for people to use are items in a shop or business. Food, clothes, and toys are examples. Workers transport them from place to place.
The market had fresh fruit, warm bread, and handmade baskets. Shoppers chose what they needed. Vendors packed the items in bags.
A service is work done for someone, while a physical item can be carried away. Stores sell many kinds of useful things. Labels show prices.

examples.en: She wore a red gown to the award ceremony.
examples.zh: 她穿著紅色禮服參加頒獎典禮。

examples.en: The doctor gave him a hospital gown to wear.
examples.zh: 醫生給他一件病人服穿。

examples.en: The graduate walked across the stage in a black gown.
examples.zh: 畢業生穿著黑色長袍走過舞台。

explains: A long formal dress may be worn for a special event. A loose long garment can also be worn in a hospital or at a graduation. The situation tells which kind is meant.
For the school dance, Tessa chose a long blue dress. She wore comfortable shoes and brought a light jacket. Her friends admired the color.
A casual shirt is worn every day. A long formal garment is chosen for important occasions. Hospitals use a different kind to keep clothing clean.

examples.en: The dancer moved with grace across the stage.
examples.zh: 舞者優雅地在舞台上移動。

examples.en: She showed grace by forgiving her friend.
examples.zh: 她原諒朋友，展現了寬容。

examples.en: The swan glided across the lake with grace.
examples.zh: 天鵝優雅地滑過湖面。

explains: Smooth and controlled movement can look calm and pleasing. The word can also describe kindness shown to others. Context helps readers know which meaning fits.
The skater moved across the ice with steady steps and quiet turns. The audience watched her finish without rushing. Her performance looked lovely.
A clumsy movement may seem uneven. A controlled one flows easily. A kind action can also show care toward another person.

examples.en: The graceful dancer spun across the stage.
examples.zh: 優雅的舞者在舞台上旋轉。

examples.en: A graceful swan floated over the water.
examples.zh: 一隻優雅的天鵝浮在水面上。

examples.en: She made a graceful turn while skating.
examples.zh: 她溜冰時做了一個優美的轉身。

explains: A person or movement that is smooth and controlled may look pleasing. Dancers and athletes can move this way. Practice helps improve balance.
At the recital, Leah turned slowly and raised her arms in time with the music. She landed each step softly. The audience clapped.
A sudden movement may be awkward. A smooth one seems balanced and easy. Different activities need different kinds of control.

examples.en: The gracious host welcomed every guest at the door.
examples.zh: 親切有禮的主人在門口迎接每位客人。

examples.en: She gave a gracious thank-you after receiving the award.
examples.zh: 她領獎後親切地致謝。

examples.en: The queen was gracious to the visiting children.
examples.zh: 女王親切有禮地接待來訪的孩子。

explains: A person who is kind and polite makes others feel welcome. They may thank people and offer help. Good manners show respect.
At dinner, Mr. Wu greeted each guest and asked about their day. He offered them food and listened closely. Everyone felt comfortable.
A rude host may ignore visitors. A kind host pays attention and shares. Small acts make a meeting pleasant.

examples.en: We took many joyful photos in our caps and gowns at graduation.
examples.zh: 我們在畢業典禮上穿著學士袍開心地拍了許多合照。

examples.en: My grandparents flew across the country to attend my college graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母搭機橫跨國境專程前來參加我的大學畢業典禮。

examples.en: After graduation, he plans to backpack across South America for three months.
examples.zh: 畢業之後，他計畫前往南美洲進行為期三個月的背包自助旅行。

explains: A ceremony marks the completion of a school or study program. Students may wear special clothing and receive a certificate. Families often celebrate their hard work.
After finishing the final year, the students lined up in the gym. The principal called each name and gave them a paper. Their families took pictures.
The first day of school begins a learning journey. A ceremony at the end marks its completion. Both can be memorable events.

examples.en: We learned a new grammar rule in class today.
examples.zh: 我們今天在課堂上學了一條新的文法規則。

examples.en: Good grammar makes her writing easy to understand.
examples.zh: 良好的文法讓她的文章容易理解。

examples.en: The teacher corrected my grammar in the short story.
examples.zh: 老師更正了短篇故事中的文法。

explains: Rules show how words fit together to make clear sentences. They help readers understand who did what and when. Practice can make writing easier.
The teacher showed how changing a verb can tell whether an action happened before or now. Students rewrote sentences on the board. They checked them together.
A list of words gives vocabulary but not sentence order. Rules help arrange words clearly. Different languages use different patterns.

examples.en: The sentence is grammatical and easy to read.
examples.zh: 這個句子符合文法規則，而且容易閱讀。

examples.en: She checked that each line was grammatical before sharing her essay.
examples.zh: 分享文章前，她確認每一行都符合文法。

examples.en: The teacher showed us how to make a grammatical question.
examples.zh: 老師教我們如何造出符合文法的問句。

explains: A sentence that follows the rules for word order and form is correct according to those language rules. People may check spelling and endings too. Clear patterns help readers.
The student changed the verb so it matched the subject. Her sentence then followed the class rule. The teacher gave her a smile.
A sentence can have a good idea but still contain a language mistake. Careful review can fix it. Different languages have different rules.

examples.en: The line graph illustrates temperature changes throughout the four seasons.
examples.zh: 折線走勢圖說明了一年四季的氣溫變化。

examples.en: Plot your lab measurement data points on the coordinate graph carefully.
examples.zh: 請將你在物理實驗中親自量測到的各項數據點，工整標註繪製在坐標走勢圖上。

examples.en: The performance graph revealed a direct correlation between study hours and exam scores.
examples.zh: 學生課業表現走勢圖清晰揭示出，平時投入讀書的時數與期末成績呈現高度正相關。

explains: A picture made with lines or bars can show numbers and how they change. Labels tell what the numbers mean. It can make information easier to compare.
The class counted how many books each student read in a month. They drew bars of different heights for the totals. The tallest bar showed the most.
A list shows numbers in rows. A visual chart lets people see patterns quickly. Both can organize facts.

examples.en: I am deeply grateful for my parents' unwavering love and support.
examples.zh: 我對父母堅定不移的愛與支持深表感激。

examples.en: The lost hiker was immensely grateful to the rescue team for finding him.
examples.zh: 迷失深山的登山客獲救後，對搜救隊伍歷盡艱辛尋獲他表達了萬分感激。

examples.en: We are grateful for every sunny morning that allows us to ride our bicycles.
examples.zh: 我們由衷感恩每一個陽光明媚的清晨，讓我們能開心地騎乘自行車出遊。

explains: A person who feels thankful notices the help or kindness they received. They may say thank you or do something kind in return. The feeling can bring people closer.
When the neighbor brought soup during the snowstorm, Kim wrote her a thank-you note. She remembered how warm the meal felt. The neighbor smiled.
Taking a gift for granted may overlook someone's effort. Feeling thankful shows that the effort matters. People can feel thankful for small things too.

examples.en: Expressing daily gratitude leads to greater mental happiness.
examples.zh: 每天表達感恩之情能帶來更多的內心幸福感。

examples.en: He bowed deeply to express his sincere gratitude to his mentor.
examples.zh: 他向恩師深深一鞠躬，由衷表達內心難以言表的深切感謝之情。

examples.en: Keeping a nightly gratitude journal helps individuals focus on life's silver linings.
examples.zh: 每晚維持撰寫感恩日記的良好習慣，能引導人們專注於生活中的美好微光。

examples.en: Keeping a daily gratitude journal enhances happiness and life satisfaction.
examples.zh: 每天親筆寫下三件值得感恩的感恩日記能顯著提升幸福感與生活滿意度。

examples.en: The scholarship recipient expressed deep gratitude to all the generous benefactors.
examples.zh: 獎學金獲獎學子向所有慷慨解囊的善心資助者表達了由衷的感激之情。

examples.en: Fostering an atmosphere of gratitude within a company improves employee morale.
examples.zh: 在企業內部營造互相感謝感恩的工作氛圍能有效提振全體團隊士氣。

examples.en: Grateful patients wrote heartfelt thank-you cards to nursing staff upon discharge.
examples.zh: 康復出院的病患在辦理出院手續時親手向辛勞付出的第一線護理團隊致贈手寫感謝卡。

examples.en: Expressing sincere gratitude to healthcare frontline workers uplifts hospital morale tremendously.
examples.zh: 社會大眾由衷向默默堅守崗位的第一線醫護人員致上崇高謝意，能為全體醫護士氣帶來巨大溫暖。

examples.en: Keeping a daily gratitude journal can reshape mental outlook and boost emotional resilience.
examples.zh: 養成每天睡前在手帳本上記下三件微小幸運與感恩之事的習慣，能重塑正向心態並鍛鍊心理韌性。

examples.en: Holding a warm cup of tea fills our hearts with quiet gratitude for nature's bountiful gifts.
examples.zh: 雙手捧著這杯溫暖甘醇的茶湯，內心由衷升起對大自然陽光、雨露與茶師辛勤付出的深深感恩。

examples.en: He wrote a heartfelt letter of gratitude to the doctors and nurses who cared for his ailing father.
examples.zh: 他親筆寫下一封字字句句滿懷真摯謝意的感謝信，由衷致敬日夜悉心照料病危老父親的醫護團隊。

examples.en: Starting every morning by listing three things you are thankful for cultivates long-term happiness and emotional gratitude.
examples.zh: 養成每天清晨在手帳寫下三件值得感恩之事的晨間好習慣，能讓內心常保富足感恩，涵養長久的幸福感。

examples.en: Cultivating daily gratitude transforms ordinary moments into profound sources of joy and contentment.
examples.zh: 每天在心中涵養常懷「感恩之心」（Gratitude），能將看似平凡微小的日常片刻轉化為源源不絕的幸福與富足。

examples.en: The rescued mountaineers held a press conference to express profound gratitude to the brave search crews.
examples.zh: 歷劫歸來的受困登山客在康復出院之際特別召開記者會，由衷向冒險搜救的空勤總隊與高山搜救隊員表達由衷的深深謝意。

examples.en: A handwritten note of gratitude often means far more to a mentor than an expensive store-bought gift.
examples.zh: 一封發自肺腑、真情流露的手寫感謝信箋，對恩師而言往往遠比任何昂貴奢華的現成禮物更具千金難買的珍貴心意。

examples.en: Bowing our heads before meals instills heartfelt gratitude for the hardworking farmers and rich soil.
examples.zh: 每次開動前在心中默默祈願，對頂著烈日汗流浹背的農夫與孕育萬物的黑土涵養常存一份真摯感恩心。

examples.en: She penned a handwritten thank-you letter expressing profound gratitude to her former mentor.
examples.zh: 她在書桌前攤開信紙，一筆一畫寫下一封充滿溫度的親筆手寫信，向當年悉心提攜她的恩師表達無盡的由衷感激。

examples.en: Cultivating daily gratitude by listing three blessings each morning significantly boosts subjective happiness.
examples.zh: 養成每日感恩晨思的優良習慣，每天清晨寫下三件值得感恩慶幸的小美好，能顯著提升個人的主觀幸福感。

examples.en: We look back on this completed journey with deep joy, mutual respect, and heartfelt gratitude.
examples.zh: 回望這段走完全程的壯麗旅途，我們心中洋溢著對知識的敬畏、對彼此相伴的「由衷感恩」（Gratitude）。

examples.en: She expressed sincere gratitude to her parents and teachers during her commencement address.
examples.zh: 她在畢業典禮的致詞演說中，向長年默默支持的父母與恩師表達了無比真摯的感恩與謝意。

examples.en: Starting each morning by reflecting on three things you appreciate cultivates lasting inner gratitude.
examples.zh: 每天清晨以冥想三件心存感激的美好人事物開啟一天，能在心靈深處培植出持久安定的感恩力量。

entries.definition: 感恩；謝意；感恩之心；感恩之情；謝忱；感恩天地山林滋養的謝意；感恩惜福知足常樂的感恩之心；誰知盤中飧粒粒皆辛苦之感恩心；對一路相伴引導與學習恩賜之由衷感恩之情；感激
explains: A thankful feeling comes when someone notices a good thing or kind action. People can show it with words or deeds. Remembering small moments can help.
Each evening, Max told his family one good thing from the day. He thanked his sister for sharing a book. They began doing the same.
A complaint focuses on what went wrong. A thankful thought notices something helpful or kind. Both feelings can happen in one day.

examples.en: They placed flowers on the grave of their grandfather.
examples.zh: 他們在祖父的墓前放了鮮花。

examples.en: The doctor said the injury was not grave.
examples.zh: 醫生說傷勢並不嚴重。

examples.en: A stone marked the grave in the old cemetery.
examples.zh: 一塊石碑標示著老墓園中的墓地。

explains: A place in the ground where a person who died is buried may have a stone marker. The word can also mean very serious. Nearby words help identify the use.
The family visited the quiet cemetery and placed flowers beside a marker. They remembered stories about their grandfather. They stayed together for a while.
A light matter is not serious. A dangerous problem may need attention right away. A burial place is a different meaning of the word.

examples.en: The greasy pizza left oil on the napkin.
examples.zh: 油膩的披薩在餐巾上留下了油漬。

examples.en: Wash your hands after touching the greasy bike chain.
examples.zh: 摸過油膩的腳踏車鏈條後要洗手。

examples.en: The mechanic wiped the greasy tools clean.
examples.zh: 修車師傅把油膩的工具擦乾淨。

explains: A surface covered with oil or fat can feel slippery and look shiny. Food or machines may have this coating. Soap and warm water can help clean it.
The frying pan had a thin layer of oil after dinner. Dad washed it with soap and dried it. The handle felt clean again.
A dry surface has no oily coating. A slick one can be hard to hold. Care helps prevent spills.

examples.en: He sent greetings to his cousins in another country.
examples.zh: 他向另一個國家的表親們問候。

examples.en: A warm greeting made the new student feel welcome.
examples.zh: 親切的問候讓新同學感到受歡迎。

examples.en: The letter began with a friendly greeting.
examples.zh: 這封信以親切的問候語開頭。

explains: Friendly words or actions used when people meet show that someone notices them. A wave, smile, or hello can be used. Customs differ around the world.
When her aunt arrived, June waved and said hello at the door. Her aunt smiled and hugged her. They went inside together.
A goodbye is used when people leave. A welcome is used when they meet. Both can show care and politeness.

examples.en: She felt grief after her beloved cat died.
examples.zh: 心愛的貓過世後，她感到悲傷。

examples.en: The family supported one another through their grief.
examples.zh: 這家人互相扶持，一起度過悲傷。

examples.en: He wrote a poem to express his grief.
examples.zh: 他寫了一首詩來表達悲痛。

explains: Deep sadness can happen after someone loses a loved one or something important. People may feel it in different ways. Family and friends can offer care.
After the family dog died, the children missed seeing him by the door. They shared favorite memories and drew pictures of him. Their parents listened.
A small disappointment may pass quickly. A deep loss can take more time to understand. Talking with someone trusted may help.

examples.en: Players grind repeatable dungeon instances to collect rare upgrade materials.
examples.zh: 玩家們反覆刷副本地下城以收集用於突破武器上限所需的稀有升級素材。

examples.en: Starting a new company involves months of unglamorous daily grind behind closed doors.
examples.zh: 白手起家創立一家新公司，意味著必須在幕後默默承受數月甚至數年枯燥艱辛的苦幹打拼。

examples.en: Grind the roasted coffee beans into a medium-fine consistency for pour-over brewing.
examples.zh: 將新鮮烘焙好的咖啡豆研磨成中細顆粒均勻刻度，以備進行香醇細緻的手沖滴濾萃取。

explains: To crush something into smaller pieces or powder is to press and rub it. Cooks crush coffee beans before brewing a drink. A machine or tool can do the work.
The cook put peppercorns into a small mill and turned the handle. Fine pieces fell onto the soup. The fresh flavor filled the kitchen.
A whole bean is larger than powder. Crushing it makes tiny bits. Some tools work by rubbing pieces together.

examples.en: The shop guarantees the toy for one year.
examples.zh: 這家商店保證這個玩具一年內有保固。

examples.en: Hard work does not guarantee that every game will be won.
examples.zh: 努力不保證每場比賽都會獲勝。

examples.en: The label guarantees that the bottle will not leak.
examples.zh: 標籤保證這個瓶子不會漏水。

explains: A promise that something will happen or work gives people confidence. A company may promise to repair a product if it breaks. The exact terms should be read carefully.
The store promised to fix the lamp if it stopped working within a year. Dad kept the receipt in a safe place. The lamp worked well.
A guess is not a promise. A written promise explains what someone will do. People should understand its limits.

examples.en: Her guardian signed the form for the school trip.
examples.zh: 她的監護人替校外教學的表格簽名。

examples.en: The guardian waited outside the classroom after school.
examples.zh: 放學後，監護人在教室外等候。

examples.en: A trusted guardian helped him choose a safe home.
examples.zh: 一位可信任的監護人幫他選擇安全的住處。

explains: An adult who is responsible for a child's care and safety can make important decisions for them. This may be a parent or another trusted grown-up. The role includes support and protection.
When the school needed permission for a trip, it called the adult who cared for Nina. He read the form and signed it. Nina felt safe going with her class.
A teacher helps students learn at school. A caregiver looks after a child in daily life. One person may sometimes do both jobs.

examples.en: He felt guilt after taking his sister's snack without asking.
examples.zh: 他沒經過同意就拿了妹妹的點心，事後感到內疚。

examples.en: Her guilt led her to tell the truth about the broken vase.
examples.zh: 她因為內疚而說出花瓶打破的真相。

examples.en: The feeling of guilt faded after he apologized.
examples.zh: 他道歉後，內疚感漸漸消失。

explains: A person may feel bad inside after doing something they believe was wrong. This feeling can lead them to tell the truth and make things right. Everyone makes mistakes.
Maya broke her friend's pencil and felt bad about hiding it. She admitted what happened and offered a new one. Her friend accepted her apology.
Pride can follow a good choice. A troubled feeling may come after a harmful one. Learning from mistakes helps people choose better.

examples.en: The accused admitted mistakes and agreed to plead guilty in court.
examples.zh: 被告當庭坦承犯行並同意向法官認罪以爭取從輕量刑。

examples.en: The jury found the corporate executive guilty of insider stock trading and money laundering.
examples.zh: 陪審團一致裁定該名企業高階主管被控內線炒作股票與跨國洗錢罪名全部有罪成立。

examples.en: He felt terribly guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday dinner celebration.
examples.zh: 他因為忙於公事而完全遺忘了母親六十歲大壽的家庭慶生聚餐，內心感到無比自責與深切愧疚。

explains: Someone who has done something wrong may be responsible for it. A person may also feel bad about a mistake. The sentence reveals whether it is about a rule or a feeling.
The class found the missing marker under Sam's desk. He admitted that he had taken it without asking. He returned it to the art table.
An innocent person did not do the wrong action. A responsible person may need to admit what happened. Being honest can help repair trust.

examples.en: The ship sailed across the gulf to reach the island.
examples.zh: 船隻橫渡海灣前往島嶼。

examples.en: The gulf was calm under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 清晨陽光下，海灣風平浪靜。

examples.en: Many fish live in the warm waters of the gulf.
examples.zh: 許多魚生活在海灣溫暖的海水中。

explains: A large area of sea reaches into land and is partly surrounded by the coast. Ships may travel across it. Maps show its shape and nearby places.
The boat crossed a wide body of water bordered by land on three sides. The passengers saw fishing boats near the shore. They reached the harbor by evening.
A small pond is surrounded by land completely. A large sea area remains open on one side. Both can appear on a map.

examples.en: His habitual morning walk began before sunrise.
examples.zh: 他習慣在日出前開始晨間散步。

examples.en: She made a habitual stop at the bakery on Fridays.
examples.zh: 她習慣每週五到麵包店買東西。

examples.en: The habitual tapping of his pencil bothered the class.
examples.zh: 他習慣性地敲鉛筆，讓全班感到困擾。

explains: Something done regularly as part of a routine may happen almost automatically. A person may do it each morning. Good routines can make a day easier.
Every evening, Jo put her books in her bag before dinner. She did it without a reminder. In the morning, she was ready for school.
A one-time action happens only once. A repeated routine happens often. People can build helpful habits over time.

examples.en: The train came to a halt at the station.
examples.zh: 火車在車站停了下來。

examples.en: The teacher halted the game when someone fell.
examples.zh: 有人跌倒時，老師叫停了遊戲。

examples.en: A fallen tree brought traffic to a halt.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的樹讓交通停擺。

explains: To stop moving or make an activity end is to pause it. A driver may stop at a sign. A process can also be brought to an end.
The crossing guard raised a hand, and the cars stopped before the school path. The children crossed safely. Then traffic moved again.
Continuing means going on. Stopping means no further movement for a time. A clear signal can tell people when to pause.

examples.en: Her handwriting is neat and easy to read.
examples.zh: 她的字跡工整，容易閱讀。

examples.en: I recognized Dad's handwriting on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我認出信封上爸爸的筆跡。

examples.en: The student practiced handwriting in her notebook.
examples.zh: 學生在筆記本上練習寫字。

explains: Letters formed by hand on paper show how someone writes. Each person's marks may look different. Practice can make them clearer and easier to read.
The teacher asked Leo to write his name slowly on the card. He made each letter larger and left spaces between words. His friend could read it easily.
Typing uses keys to make letters appear on a screen. Writing by hand uses a pen or pencil. Both ways can share information.

examples.en: The family faced hardship after the flood damaged their home.
examples.zh: 洪水損壞家園後，這家人面臨困境。

examples.en: She overcame many hardships to finish school.
examples.zh: 她克服許多艱難困苦，完成了學業。

examples.en: The community helped its neighbors during a time of hardship.
examples.zh: 困難時期，社區幫助了鄰居。

explains: A difficult time can bring problems with money, health, or daily life. People may need help to get through it. Friends and communities can support them.
After the storm damaged the family's home, neighbors brought food and blankets. Workers helped repair the roof. The family slowly returned to normal life.
An easy time has few troubles. A hard period may test people's strength. Support can make it more manageable.

examples.en: Taiwan is a worldwide leader in PC and server hardware manufacturing.
examples.zh: 台灣在個人電腦與伺服器硬體製造領域領先全球。

examples.en: You should upgrade your computer hardware before playing graphic-intensive games.
examples.zh: 在玩高畫質遊戲之前，你應該先升級電腦硬體規格。

examples.en: The tech store sells both computer hardware and specialized repair tools.
examples.zh: 這家科技商店兼賣電腦硬體與專業維修工具。

explains: Tools, machines, or metal parts used to build or repair things can be called this. A store may sell screws, hammers, and hinges. Computers also have physical parts with this name.
Dad went to a shop to buy nails and a small screwdriver. He used them to fix the loose shelf. The children helped hold the board.
Software is a set of instructions on a computer. The physical pieces are things people can touch. A shop may sell supplies for home repairs.

examples.en: Living in mindful harmony with nature fills daily domestic life with enduring serenity.
examples.zh: 學會與大自然花草草木謙卑和諧共生，能讓平凡瑣碎的柴米油鹽居家生活常保寧靜與喜悅。

examples.en: The Japanese garden design achieves a breathtaking harmony between running water, stone, and flora.
examples.zh: 日式禪風庭園在清澈流水、拙樸青苔奇石與當令花草之間達成了令人屏息的極致和諧。

examples.en: Cultivating houseplants teaches us to slow down and live in gentle harmony with seasonal rhythms.
examples.zh: 在居家日常細心呵護觀葉植栽，教會了現代人放慢匆忙腳步、順應四季更迭從容和諧共生。

examples.en: A balanced tea arrangement creates aesthetic harmony between water, fire, pottery, and human hearts.
examples.zh: 一席典雅和諧的茶席佈置，在水、火、茶、器與品茗者的心靈之間營造出天人合一的和諧境界。

examples.en: Indigenous tribes historically lived in sustainable harmony with wild mountain rivers and sacred forests.
examples.zh: 原住民族祖先數千年來與腳下的大自然山林溪流敬虔共處，世世代代維繫著取之有度的永續生態和諧。

examples.en: The choir's four vocal sections blended in breathtaking four-part harmony during the solemn Christmas hymn.
examples.zh: 詩班男女四個聲部在演唱這首莊嚴神聖的耶誕頌歌時天衣無縫交融，綻放出令人屏息的四部合聲之美。

examples.en: Eastern philosophy emphasizes living in serene harmony with the rhythms and cycles of nature.
examples.zh: 東方道家與儒家哲學強調「天人合一」，引導人們順應大自然四季晨昏的運行節奏，活出安詳的和諧。

examples.en: The vocal ensemble rehearsed diligently to perfect their four-part harmonic chord progressions.
examples.zh: 人聲無伴奏合唱重唱團日以繼夜反覆練習，期盼將四個聲部交織的和弦進程磨礪至天衣無縫的純淨和聲之美。

examples.en: A sustainable community architecture design balances human convenience in gentle harmony with surrounding ecosystems.
examples.zh: 卓越的永續綠建築規劃，巧妙在當代便利生活機能與周遭自然山林水文生態之間取得了溫柔而平衡的和諧。

examples.en: Island communities flourish when they live in respectful harmony with oceanic tides and seasons.
examples.zh: 海島居民順應海洋潮汐起伏與季節洋流更替，在敬畏大自然的前提下活出和諧共生的生命智慧。

examples.en: The choir singers blended their melodic voices together in breathtaking four-part vocal harmony.
examples.zh: 合唱團團員將各自優美的嗓音完美融合在一起，展現出令人屏息動容的四部和聲天籟美感。

examples.en: Achieving work-life harmony requires setting clear boundaries between workplace duties and family evenings.
examples.zh: 實現工作與生活之間的平衡與和諧，需要在繁重職場職責與溫馨家庭時光之間設立清晰界線。

examples.en: Living in balance aligns thoughts, actions, and values in joyful, sustainable inner harmony.
examples.zh: 活在身心靈平衡之中，讓一個人的思想、言行與崇高價值觀在歡樂中達成圓融完美的內在和諧。

examples.en: The traditional village community lived in respectful ecological harmony with the surrounding cedar forest.
examples.zh: 這個傳統的原住民山林部落聚落，千百年來始終與周遭環抱的神木森林維持著謙卑共生的生態和諧。

examples.en: The violin, cello, and flute blended their melodies together in exquisite orchestral harmony.
examples.zh: 小提琴、大提琴與長笛在舞台上將各自的優美旋律交織共鳴，演繹出極具層次感的精妙交響和聲。

examples.en: Biophilic architecture seeks timeless harmony where the built environment feels like an organic extension of nature.
examples.zh: 親生物建築追求歷久彌新的天人合一與和諧共生，讓人工建築如同大自然孕育出的有機延伸。

examples.en: Traditional Asian pavilions were positioned to achieve visual harmony with surrounding mist-covered mountains.
examples.zh: 東方傳統樓閣水榭的坐落朝向，在選址上講究與周遭薄霧繚繞的千峰萬壑達到渾然天成的視覺和諧。

examples.en: Designing buildings in harmony with local wind patterns allows occupants to live without artificial air conditioning.
examples.zh: 順應在地季風流向規劃興建的綠色住宅，能讓居住者完全無需仰賴人造冷氣即可享受怡人微風與和諧。

examples.en: True civilization is measured by humanity’s ability to live in timeless harmony with the wild earth.
examples.zh: 人類文明進步與否的最高度量，在於我們是否懂得尊重生命並與大自然萬物「天人合一、和諧共生」（Harmony）。

examples.en: Traditional agricultural terraces blend in aesthetic harmony with surrounding hillside contours.
examples.zh: 原鄉傳統梯田的開闢與耕作，與周遭綿延的山巒起伏輪廓呈現出渾然天成的美學和諧。

examples.en: Promoting renewable energy in harmony with local landscapes prevents the destruction of fertile farmlands.
examples.zh: 推動綠色再生能源時兼顧與在地地景風貌和諧共存，能避免大型光電板過度侵蝕良田沃土。

examples.en: Great dishes achieve a transcendent harmony where acidity, sweetness, and rich fats balance one another.
examples.zh: 真正偉大的傳世名菜，在酸度、甜感、油脂與酥脆之間達到了無懈可擊的「感官和諧平衡」（Harmony）。

examples.en: The four vocalists sang four-part choral harmony that resonated through the Gothic cathedral arches.
examples.zh: 四位優秀聲樂家齊聲演唱四部合唱和聲，純淨和諧的天籟餘音繚繞在哥德式大教堂高聳石拱間。

examples.en: Environmental conservationists strive to live in peaceful harmony with indigenous forest ecosystems.
examples.zh: 自然生態保育志工竭盡心力，長年倡導人類文明與在地原始森林生態體系永續共處的和諧之道。

examples.en: The hall achieves a sublime harmony between organic sculptural curves and mathematical acoustic physics.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉殿堂在有機流線雕塑造型與嚴密數學聲學物理之間，達成了令人屏息的「完美和諧」（Harmony）。

examples.en: The four singers blended their distinct voices into breathtaking vocal harmony that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 四位聲樂家將各自獨具特色動人的聲線天衣無縫交融，編織出動人心弦的純淨四部和聲天籟。

examples.en: Traditional Asian philosophies encourage human beings to cultivate deep harmony with the surrounding natural environment.
examples.zh: 東方傳統哲學智慧歷久彌新，長年倡導人類心靈應與周遭大自然天地生息涵養深沉的和諧共生之道。

entries.definition: 和諧共生；融洽和睦；天人合一茶席和諧；和諧；與天地自然宇宙和諧共鳴；與浩瀚太平洋大自然共生共榮；身心靈各層面均衡和諧共鳴；建築與自然萬物共存天人合一境界；與島嶼萬物眾生天人合一永續共好境界；酸、甜、苦、鮮、脆、滑之極致感官和諧平衡；建築流線美學造型與純淨音響之完美和諧統一
explains: People living or working together peacefully can share ideas and respect one another. In music, notes that sound pleasing together also have this quality. Context tells the meaning.
The neighbors took turns caring for a shared garden. They talked about what to plant and listened to each other. The flowers grew well.
A loud argument creates tension. Peaceful teamwork lets people cooperate. In a song, several notes can blend in a pleasing way.

examples.en: The harsh sunlight made us look for shade.
examples.zh: 刺眼的陽光讓我們去找陰涼處。

examples.en: He apologized for his harsh words.
examples.zh: 他為自己嚴厲的話道歉。

examples.en: The plant survived the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 這株植物在嚴酷的冬天中存活下來。

explains: Something very rough, severe, or unpleasant can feel difficult to face. Weather, words, or light may have this quality. The situation helps identify the meaning.
The wind blew cold across the open field, and the rain stung the hikers' faces. They found shelter in a cabin. They waited until it passed.
A gentle breeze feels mild. A strong storm can be severe. Words can also hurt when they are unkind.

examples.en: In her haste, she left the homework on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 她匆忙之中把作業留在廚房桌上。

examples.en: There is no need for haste when crossing the bridge.
examples.zh: 過橋時不需要匆忙。

examples.en: He packed in haste and forgot his toothbrush.
examples.zh: 他匆忙收拾行李，忘了帶牙刷。

explains: Doing something too quickly because of limited time can cause mistakes. Slowing down to check details may help. A person should balance speed and care.
Mia packed her school bag in a rush and forgot her lunch. The next day, she made a list and checked each item. She reached class prepared.
A careful pace gives time to think. A rushed pace may finish sooner but miss details. Planning ahead can reduce pressure.

examples.en: The warm sun hastened the melting of the snow.
examples.zh: 溫暖的陽光加快了積雪融化。

examples.en: We hastened to the station to catch the train.
examples.zh: 我們趕往車站，想搭上火車。

examples.en: The teacher tried to hasten the cleanup by giving everyone a task.
examples.zh: 老師分派工作，試著加快清理速度。

explains: To make something happen sooner is to speed it up. A person can also walk faster to arrive earlier. Care is still important when moving quickly.
The class wanted to finish cleaning before the bell. Everyone picked up papers and stacked chairs carefully. They completed the job a few minutes early.
Moving slowly takes more time. Moving faster can bring an event sooner. Rushing without care can cause errors.

examples.en: The story shows how hatred can harm a whole village.
examples.zh: 這個故事展現了仇恨如何傷害整個村莊。

examples.en: She spoke against hatred and asked people to be kind.
examples.zh: 她反對仇恨，並呼籲大家友善待人。

examples.en: Hatred between the teams ended after they worked together.
examples.zh: 兩隊合作後，彼此的仇恨消失了。

explains: A very strong feeling of dislike toward someone or something can lead to anger and hurtful actions. People can choose to respond with respect instead. Support can help calm conflict.
Two classmates disagreed about a game, but their teacher helped them talk calmly. They listened and found a fair way to play. They became friends again.
A mild dislike is not as strong as deep anger. Kind choices can stop hurt from growing. People can ask a trusted adult for help.

examples.en: A hawk circled above the meadow looking for food.
examples.zh: 一隻鷹在草地上空盤旋尋找食物。

examples.en: The hawk landed on a branch near the river.
examples.zh: 那隻鷹停在河邊的一根樹枝上。

examples.en: We watched a hawk glide across the sky.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻鷹滑翔過天空。

explains: A bird of prey has strong feet and a hooked beak for catching small animals. It can fly high and watch the ground below. People should observe wild birds from a distance.
The bird circled above the field and then landed on a tall branch. It watched mice move through the grass. The children used binoculars to see it.
A small songbird eats seeds or insects. A hunting bird uses sharp claws to catch food. Different beaks and feet suit different needs.

examples.en: A helicopter landed on the hospital roof.
examples.zh: 一架直升機降落在醫院屋頂。

examples.en: The helicopter flew over the mountains to reach the village.
examples.zh: 直升機飛越山區前往村莊。

examples.en: We heard a helicopter circling above the field.
examples.zh: 我們聽見一架直升機在田野上空盤旋。

explains: An aircraft with large spinning blades above it can rise straight up and land in small spaces. It can also fly forward through the air. Pilots use it for travel and rescue.
A rescue team used an aircraft with a spinning top blade to reach a mountain path. It hovered above a safe landing place. The hikers climbed aboard.
An airplane needs a runway to take off and land. A rotor aircraft can rise from a small clear area. Both travel through the sky.

examples.en: A herd of cows rested under the trees.
examples.zh: 一群牛在樹下休息。

examples.en: The herd crossed the plain in search of water.
examples.zh: 獸群穿越平原尋找水源。

examples.en: A small herd of deer ran through the forest.
examples.zh: 一小群鹿跑過森林。

explains: A group of animals of the same kind may travel or feed together. Cows, elephants, and deer can form such groups. Staying together can help protect them.
The family saw a group of elephants crossing the grassland. The young ones walked safely between the adults. They moved toward a water hole.
One animal may travel alone. A group can find food or watch for danger together. Different animals form groups in different ways.

examples.en: After a brief hesitation, he raised his hand to answer.
examples.zh: 短暫猶豫後，他舉手回答。

examples.en: She accepted the invitation without hesitation.
examples.zh: 她毫不猶豫地接受了邀請。

examples.en: His hesitation showed that he was unsure about the plan.
examples.zh: 他的猶豫顯示他對這項計畫沒有把握。

explains: A short pause before acting can happen when someone feels unsure. They may need more time to decide. Asking a question can help them feel ready.
At the diving board, Sara stopped and looked at the water. Her coach reminded her to take her time and climb down if she wished. She chose to wait.
A quick action happens right away. A pause gives someone time to think. It is fine to wait when a choice feels uncertain.

examples.en: The bees returned to their hive after collecting nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂採集花蜜後回到蜂巢。

examples.en: A beekeeper checked the hive for honey.
examples.zh: 養蜂人檢查蜂箱裡的蜂蜜。

examples.en: We saw a hive hanging from a tree branch.
examples.zh: 我們看見一個蜂巢掛在樹枝上。

explains: A home for a group of bees can be a hollow place in a tree or a box cared for by beekeepers. Many bees live and work inside. They store honey there.
The beekeeper opened a wooden box carefully and checked the bees. He wore protective clothing and moved slowly. The children watched from a safe spot.
A nest may be made from twigs or grass. Bees build a home with wax cells for honey and young. Each type of animal has its own shelter.

examples.en: The bird returned to its homeland after a long migration.
examples.zh: 長途遷徙後，這隻鳥回到了牠的原居地。

examples.en: She missed her homeland while studying overseas.
examples.zh: 她在海外求學時想念自己的故鄉。

examples.en: The story describes a family returning to their homeland.
examples.zh: 這個故事描述一家人回到故鄉。

explains: The country or region where a person or group comes from can feel like home. People may have family, language, and memories there. Moving away does not erase those connections.
After living abroad for years, Lina visited the coastal town where she grew up. She recognized the market and heard familiar songs. Her relatives welcomed her.
A house is one home, while a whole place can be home to many people. People may care deeply about where their family began. Their stories can travel with them.

examples.en: They went to Hawaii for their honeymoon.
examples.zh: 他們去夏威夷度蜜月。

examples.en: The couple planned a quiet honeymoon in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻計畫在山區度過寧靜的蜜月。

examples.en: She showed us photos from her honeymoon.
examples.zh: 她給我們看蜜月旅行的照片。

explains: A newly married couple may take a special trip together after their wedding. They can relax and celebrate their new life. The destination may be near or far.
After the wedding, the couple spent a week by the sea. They walked along the beach and tried local food. They returned home with happy memories.
A family vacation may include many relatives. A special trip for newlyweds is usually just for the couple. Every pair chooses what they enjoy.

examples.en: Craft a compelling 5-second video hook to retain viewer attention instantly.
examples.zh: 精心打磨影片開頭前五秒最具懸念的吸睛開場鉤子，能牢牢抓住觀眾的眼球不滑走。

examples.en: The opening scene of the mystery novel served as an irresistible storytelling hook.
examples.zh: 這部懸疑小說的開場場景成了一個讓人欲罷不能的引人入勝開頭懸念。

examples.en: The song has a catchy musical hook that sticks in your head all day long.
examples.zh: 這首歌有一段極為洗腦的旋律副歌記憶點，讓人整天都在腦海中縈繞。

entries.definition: 吸睛開場；開頭鉤子；魚鉤
explains: A curved piece of metal or plastic can catch or hold something. A person may hang a coat or bag on it. The curved shape keeps the item in place.
Nina hung her raincoat on a small piece of metal beside the door. It stayed off the floor and dried by morning. She placed her boots underneath.
A straight peg may not hold a loop as well. A curved tool can catch a ring or line. These curved holders come in different sizes.

examples.en: Driving into the sunset along the East Coast scenic highway opens up a boundless new horizon.
examples.zh: 駕駛著純電車沿著花東壯麗的台十一線濱海公路迎風前行，在落日餘暉中迎向無垠遼闊的嶄新地平線。

examples.en: The golden morning sun peeked over the ocean horizon as fishing trawlers returned to Suao harbor.
examples.zh: 破曉時分，一輪金黃朝陽從太平洋無垠海平線緩緩升起，滿載而歸的遠洋漁船陸續駛入宜蘭蘇澳港。

examples.en: Breakthroughs in quantum computing and generative AI promise exciting new horizons for human scientific progress.
examples.zh: 量子運算技術與生成式人工智慧的連番革命性重大突破，為人類未來的跨領域科學探索開拓了無窮的全新視野。

examples.en: Standing at the ship’s bow, travelers gaze at cargo vessels sailing toward the distant golden horizon.
examples.zh: 佇立在輪船船頭甲板上，迎著徐徐海風，眺望著一艘艘遠洋巨輪悠然駛向遠方海天一色的金色海平線。

examples.en: After months of grueling medical treatments, full recovery is finally on the horizon for the brave patient.
examples.zh: 經歷了數個月艱辛煎熬的醫療療程後，這位勇敢的病患終於盼來了即將完全康復的曙光。

examples.en: Moving to a new country and learning another foreign language will broaden your personal horizons immensely.
examples.zh: 移居到嶄新的國度生活並學習另一門外語，將會極大地開拓你的個人視野與心胸境界。

examples.en: Quantum computing expands the scientific horizon, allowing researchers to explore fundamental atomic reality.
examples.zh: 量子運算極大拓展了全人類的科學探索視野，引領我們深入探索微觀宇宙最深層的真實本質。

examples.en: Beyond the immediate horizon of noisy devices lies the promised era of fault-tolerant molecular simulation.
examples.zh: 越過當前含雜訊硬體設備的眼前地平線，便是令人神往、具備完全容錯能力的分子精準模擬時代。

examples.en: Gazing toward the technological horizon, leaders recognize that quantum capability will define national power.
examples.zh: 遠眺未來的科技地平線，各國戰略領袖深刻洞察到：頂尖量子運算實力將直接定義未來的國家綜合國力。

examples.en: Nothing, not even light, can escape once crossing the gravitational event horizon of a black hole.
examples.zh: 任何物質甚至連光線，一旦跨越黑洞那道不可逆的「事件視界邊界」（Event Horizon），將永遠無法逃脫。

examples.en: Watching the golden sun sink below the ocean horizon filled the backpackers with profound wonder.
examples.zh: 坐在沙灘上凝望金黃色夕陽緩緩沉入廣闊的海平線，讓遠行的背包客心中充滿了無限感動。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence and quantum technology are rapidly expanding the horizon of modern science.
examples.zh: 人工智慧與量子運算技術的飛躍突破，正迅速拓展現代前沿科學研究的全新視野地平線。

examples.en: Precise positioning illuminates the path forward, unlocking a safe, connected, and boundless future horizon.
examples.zh: 高精度衛星定位為人類點亮了前行的道路，在智慧交通與無人載具的浩瀚天空中開拓出「璀璨安全的未來地平線」（Horizon）。

examples.en: The golden morning sun peeked above the eastern ocean horizon, painting the clouds in brilliant amber.
examples.zh: 溫暖璀璨的金黃晨曦從東方浩瀚的海平線上冉冉升起，將天邊朵朵雲彩暈染成如詩如畫的琥珀金輝。

examples.en: Traveling extensively across diverse continents broadens one’s cultural perspectives and intellectual horizon.
examples.zh: 背起行囊長年踏訪世界各大洲的不同文化與土地，能顯著拓寬一個人的國際視野格局與心靈思想地平線。

examples.en: Mastering English expands your career horizons, opening doors to top universities and global companies.
examples.zh: 精熟掌握英語為你開拓了「無限寬廣的職涯新視野」（Horizons），迎向世界頂尖大學與跨國企業舞台。

examples.en: We stood on the ocean cliff watching the morning sun rise slowly above the misty horizon.
examples.zh: 我們並肩站在海邊懸崖上，靜靜眺望著朝陽從薄霧籠罩的遠方海平線緩緩升起。

examples.en: Continuing education allows mid-career professionals to explore brand new intellectual horizons.
examples.zh: 積極參與在職進修教育，讓資深職場人士得以突破極限，探索全新的智識與專業新天地。

entries.definition: 駛向未來璀璨地平線；地平線；駛向金色夕陽的無垠海平線；拓展人類終極運算能力之壯麗地平線；光線與物質無法逃脫之黑洞事件視界；為全自動智慧載具開拓遼闊安全的嶄新地平線；開拓無限寬廣之個人職涯與求知新地平線
explains: The line where the sky seems to meet the land or sea is seen far away. It changes as a person moves. The Earth is round, so the line is only an appearance.
At sunset, the boat moved toward the far edge of the sea view. The orange sun seemed to touch the water. The children watched from shore.
Nearby objects look large, while distant ones seem small. The far line changes with a person's viewpoint. Mountains can hide it from view.

examples.en: The terrible news horrified the whole town.
examples.zh: 這個可怕的消息令全鎮的人震驚。

examples.en: The monster scene horrified the young viewers.
examples.zh: 怪物場景嚇壞了年幼的觀眾。

examples.en: The thought of losing her puppy horrified her.
examples.zh: 想到可能失去小狗，她就感到十分恐懼。

explains: Something extremely frightening or shocking can make a person feel great fear. People may react by gasping or turning away. Comfort from others can help.
The sudden crash in the movie made the children jump. Their parent paused the film and explained that it was pretend. They chose a gentler story.
A mild surprise may make someone curious. A terrible event can cause much stronger fear. People react differently and may need support.

examples.en: She used a garden hose to water the flowers.
examples.zh: 她用花園水管替花朵澆水。

examples.en: The firefighter connected the hose to the water truck.
examples.zh: 消防員把水管接到消防車上。

examples.en: Please roll up the hose after washing the car.
examples.zh: 洗完車後請把水管捲起來。

explains: A long hollow tube can carry water from a tap to a garden or another place. It bends so people can aim the flow. Turning off the water saves it.
Dad connected a tube to the outdoor tap and watered the flower beds. He moved the end from one row to the next. Then he shut off the tap.
A bucket carries a set amount of water. A tube can move water continuously while connected to a source. Different lengths suit different jobs.

examples.en: The household shared chores to keep the kitchen clean.
examples.zh: 這個家庭分擔家事，保持廚房整潔。

examples.en: We bought several household items for the new apartment.
examples.zh: 我們為新公寓買了幾件家用品。

examples.en: Each household received a calendar from the town.
examples.zh: 每戶人家都收到鎮上發的一本月曆。

explains: A group of people living together in one home can share meals, chores, and costs. The word can also describe items used in a home. Context tells the meaning.
The family made a list of jobs for the week. One person washed dishes while another swept the floor. Everyone helped keep the home tidy.
A neighbor may live nearby but not share the same home. People who live together often share some duties. Homes need many useful supplies.

examples.en: We did the housework together on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 星期六早上我們一起做家事。

examples.en: She finished her housework before going to the park.
examples.zh: 她做完家事後才去公園。

examples.en: The children help with housework by folding clean towels.
examples.zh: 孩子們幫忙摺乾淨的毛巾，分擔家事。

explains: Regular jobs done to keep a home clean and comfortable include washing dishes, sweeping, and laundry. Family members can share the tasks. A schedule helps everyone remember.
After breakfast, the children put their plates in the sink. Their father washed them while their mother wiped the table. They finished together.
A paid job may happen outside the home. Cleaning and caring tasks inside a home are also work. Sharing them can save time.

examples.en: Biomedical researchers dedicate their lives to solving intractable diseases, serving the health of all humanity.
examples.zh: 生物醫學研究者一生在實驗室默默燃燒青春攻克頑疾，終極目標只為守護並造福全人類的健康與福祉。

examples.en: Developing affordable universal vaccines is a shared moral responsibility owed to all humanity.
examples.zh: 研發價格平易近人、人人皆可負擔的廣效型萬用疫苗，是全球醫藥科學界對全體人類社會不可推卸的崇高道義責任。

examples.en: Advances in molecular genetics will alleviate immense suffering, opening brighter horizons for future humanity.
examples.zh: 分子遺傳學與精準基因修復技術的劃時代突破，將從根本上拔除人類遺傳疾病苦難，為全人類迎來破曉曙光。

examples.en: Combating climate change is the ultimate moral obligation of our generation to protect humanity’s shared home.
examples.zh: 挺身而出齊心抗擊氣候變遷，是我們這一代人守護全人類（Humanity）共同唯一地球家園的最崇高道德使命。

examples.en: Dedicated volunteer medical doctors travel into war-torn regions out of boundless compassion and love for humanity.
examples.zh: 無國界醫生組織的志工醫師無畏槍林彈雨奔赴戰火紛飛的難民前線，全憑內心深處對普世苦難同胞的悲憫與對全人類的大愛。

examples.en: The timeless poetry of ancient classics speaks deeply to the universal fears, longings, and joys common to all humanity.
examples.zh: 流傳千古的經典史詩詩篇跨越時空界限，深刻訴說著全人類共同擁有的對死亡的恐懼、對自由的渴望與靈魂深處的欣喜。

entries.definition: 造福全人類福祉；人道人性；守護全人類共同唯一的地球家園
explains: All people together share feelings, needs, and the ability to care for one another. The word can also mean kindness shown to others. Context tells which meaning is meant.
During the flood, neighbors from many streets brought food and dry clothes. They helped strangers as well as friends. Their caring actions gave people hope.
One person is part of a much larger group of people. Kind actions can show concern for others. Communities can help one another during hard times.

examples.en: Summer humidity in Taipei often exceeds eighty percent, feeling sticky.
examples.zh: 台北盆地炎夏相對濕度經常超過百分之八十，體感十分悶熱黏稠。

examples.en: Running a dehumidifier during the rainy season helps keep indoor relative humidity at a comfortable level.
examples.zh: 在梅雨連綿的潮濕季節開啟高效除濕機，能有效將室內相對濕度恆定維持在人體最舒適的區間。

examples.en: High tropical humidity accelerates sweat evaporation, making afternoon sports feel much more exhausting.
examples.zh: 亞熱帶夏季過高的環境空氣濕度會嚴重阻礙人體汗水蒸發散熱，使得戶外運動時倍感疲憊燥熱。

examples.en: Tropical rainforest plants flourish best when ambient indoor humidity stays above 65%.
examples.zh: 來自熱帶雨林的附生觀葉植物在環境相對濕度維持在百分之六十五以上時生長最為繁茂。

examples.en: Running a cool mist ultrasonic humidifier keeps delicate calathea leaf margins from crisping.
examples.zh: 在植物架旁開啟一台冷霧超音波加濕器，能有效防止嬌貴的竹芋葉片邊緣乾枯焦邊。

examples.en: Grouping potted plants closely together creates a microclimate with naturally elevated relative humidity.
examples.zh: 將多盆盆栽緊密聚集擺放在一起，能彼此蒸散水分形成相對濕度自然較高的局部微氣候。

examples.en: Museum galleries maintain 20°C temperature and 55% relative humidity to preserve ancient paper fibers.
examples.zh: 國家級展廳二十四小時維持攝氏二十度恆溫與百分之五十五恆濕，保護古老紙張宣紙纖維不脆化。

examples.en: Fluctuations in relative humidity cause wood panels to expand and warp, damaging delicate oil paintings.
examples.zh: 空氣中相對濕度的劇烈劇烈震盪起伏會導致油畫實木畫框膨脹翹曲，進而損及表面珍貴油彩。

examples.en: Taiwan's hot summer climate is characterized by stifling heat and constant high humidity.
examples.zh: 台灣典型海島夏日氣候的一大顯著特點，便是令人揮汗如雨的悶熱氣候與終日揮之不去的高濕度。

entries.definition: 濕度；相對濕度；潮濕；空氣相對濕度；展廳恆溫恆濕精密控濕
explains: The amount of water vapor in the air affects how damp or sticky the weather feels. A high amount can make a warm day uncomfortable. Weather reports may measure it.
After rain, the air felt warm and moist in the garden. The children drank water and rested in the shade. Their clothes felt damp.
Dry air contains little moisture. Damp air contains more. A weather report can help people know what to expect.

examples.en: The hurricane brought strong winds to the coast.
examples.zh: 颶風為海岸帶來強風。

examples.en: Families left the island before the hurricane arrived.
examples.zh: 颶風來臨前，家人們離開了島嶼。

examples.en: The town prepared emergency supplies for hurricane season.
examples.zh: 鎮上為颶風季準備了緊急物資。

explains: A very powerful storm forms over warm ocean water and brings strong winds and heavy rain. It can damage homes and trees. People should follow safety instructions.
The weather service warned the island about a large storm coming from the sea. Families packed supplies and moved away from the shore. They waited in a safe building.
A light rainstorm may pass quickly. A powerful ocean storm can last for days and cause great harm. Early warnings help people prepare.

examples.en: The teacher asked the class to hush before the story began.
examples.zh: 故事開始前，老師請全班安靜下來。

examples.en: A hush fell over the audience as the lights dimmed.
examples.zh: 燈光變暗時，觀眾席安靜了下來。

examples.en: She tried to hush the crying baby with a lullaby.
examples.zh: 她試著用搖籃曲讓哭泣的嬰兒安靜下來。

explains: To become quiet or make someone quiet can be done with a soft sound or gentle words. People may do this when a baby is sleeping. A calm voice can help.
The baby began to cry during the train ride. Her mother spoke softly and rocked her in a blanket. Soon the baby rested.
A loud shout draws attention. A quiet sound can calm people. At a library, everyone should keep their voices low.

examples.en: Green hydrogen produced from offshore wind electrolysis fuels zero-emission blast furnaces in steelmaking.
examples.zh: 利用外海離岸風電水電解製成的純「綠氫」（Green Hydrogen），能替代焦炭作為零碳煉鋼的革命性清潔燃料。

examples.en: Hydrogen fuel cell city buses emit only pure water vapor from exhaust pipes, keeping roads clean.
examples.zh: 投入商業營運的氫燃料電池都會市區公車，行駛時排氣管僅排出純淨水蒸氣，徹底告別黑煙柴油廢氣污染。

examples.en: Hydrogen is the lightest, most abundant chemical element scattered across the observable universe.
examples.zh: 氫是元素週期表中最輕的元素，也是浩瀚可觀測宇宙中分佈最廣、含量最為豐富的終極化學元素。

examples.en: Green hydrogen produced from offshore wind power produces zero carbon emissions when used in fuel cells.
examples.zh: 由離岸風電水解產出的「綠色氫能」（Green Hydrogen），在燃料電池中發電時達成真正的零碳排放。

examples.en: Stars like our sun generate light and heat by fusing hydrogen nuclei into helium in their deep cores.
examples.zh: 像太陽這樣的恆星在其深層核心，透過將氫原子核聚變融合成氦原子核，源源不絕釋放光與熱。

examples.en: Chemical engineering plants use hydrogen gas to synthesize fertilizers and refine clean transportation fuels.
examples.zh: 化工精煉廠廣泛使用純氫氣作為生產氮肥的基礎原料，並用於精煉高品質低硫交通燃料。

entries.definition: 水電解零碳純綠氫能源；氫；宇宙中最豐富且燃燒零碳排之終極乾淨綠色氫能
explains: A very light gas is found in water and many stars. It can join with other elements to make new substances. Scientists use careful methods to study it.
The class learned that water is made from two kinds of tiny particles. Their teacher used colored balls to show how they join. The model helped them understand.
Air contains several gases, and stars contain many hot materials. This gas is the lightest element. Models help show what cannot be seen.

examples.en: The twins wore identical blue jackets.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎穿著一模一樣的藍色外套。

examples.en: Each box had an identical label.
examples.zh: 每個盒子都有相同的標籤。

examples.en: The two paintings looked identical from across the room.
examples.zh: 從房間另一端看，這兩幅畫看起來一模一樣。

explains: Two things that are exactly alike match in every detail. Copies may look the same, while real objects can still have small differences. Careful checking helps compare them.
The children received the same red notebooks with matching covers and pages. They wrote their names inside to tell them apart. Each book looked exactly alike outside.
Similar things share some qualities. Exact matches have no visible differences. A small mark can make one item unique.

examples.en: AI pattern-matching software enables accurate individual identification based on unique spot arrangements.
examples.zh: AI 影像辨識演算法根據每隻石虎身上獨一無二的花紋斑點，實現了高準確度的「個體特徵辨識」（Identification）。

examples.en: DNA barcode analysis provides rapid species identification from microscopic fur fragments.
examples.zh: DNA 條形碼技術能透過微量脫落毛髮碎片，在實驗室中迅速完成物種鑑定。

examples.en: Tagging ears with numbered microchips facilitates long-term identification during recapture studies.
examples.zh: 在野生動物耳部標記微型耳標晶片，有助於研究團隊在後續重捕追蹤時進行長期個體確認。

entries.definition: 斑紋與耳背白斑個體特徵辨識
explains: Information or a card can show who someone is. A name and picture help others recognize the person. It may be needed when entering a place or traveling.
At the museum entrance, each student showed a school card with a name and photo. The worker checked it before letting them in. The class stayed together.
A ticket shows which event someone can attend. A card with a photo can show a person's identity. Different places may ask for different details.

examples.en: Field guides help birdwatchers identify native bird species accurately.
examples.zh: 圖鑑指南能幫助賞鳥者準確辨識本土鳥類品種。

examples.en: Can you identify the person who accidentally dropped this wallet in the hallway?
examples.zh: 你能指認辨識出究竟是誰不小心把這只黑色皮夾遺落在長廊走道上的嗎？

examples.en: Many young adolescents strongly identify with the heroic main character of the novel.
examples.zh: 許多年輕青少年對這部奇幻小說中經歷磨難的英勇主角產生了強烈的情感認同。

explains: To recognize who or what something is can be done by noticing its features. A label or clue may help. Careful looking prevents mistakes.
The bird guide showed a picture of a red-winged bird. The children compared its colors with the one on the fence. They found the right name.
Guessing may be wrong if details are missed. Looking closely at marks and shapes can help. People can use books or tools to check.

examples.en: Using everyday English idioms correctly makes your conversations sound vibrant, authentic, and natural.
examples.zh: 正確運用生活常見的「英美成語慣用語」（Idioms），能讓你的英語對話聽起來格外生動、道地與自然。

examples.en: Rather than translating word for word, she explained the underlying origin of the colorful idiom.
examples.zh: 她沒有生硬地逐字直譯，而是為大家深入淺出地解說了這個生動成語背後的由來與典故。

examples.en: Familiarity with common workplace idioms helps new employees integrate smoothly into multinational offices.
examples.zh: 熟悉常見的職場慣用語與習語，能幫助新進員工迅速融入跨國公司的團隊合作與交流。

entries.definition: 熟練運用道地英美生活成語與慣用語句；成語
explains: A phrase can have a meaning different from the exact meanings of its individual words. People who know the language understand the special meaning. Context gives clues.
When Dad said the test was a piece of cake, he meant it was easy. His daughter smiled because she knew he was not talking about dessert. The phrase made sense in context.
A direct sentence says exactly what its words mean. A figurative phrase uses a special meaning. Examples help learners understand it.

examples.en: The computer sat idle while everyone went to lunch.
examples.zh: 大家去吃午餐時，電腦閒置著。

examples.en: She kept her hands busy instead of sitting idle.
examples.zh: 她讓雙手忙著做事，沒有閒坐著。

examples.en: The engine idled quietly outside the station.
examples.zh: 引擎在車站外安靜地空轉。

explains: A machine or person that is not working or being used is inactive for a time. A motor may run without doing useful work. The sentence shows the intended use.
The bus waited with its engine running while the driver checked the route. It did not move until all passengers sat down. Then it pulled away.
Busy work keeps a person active. A resting moment can be helpful, while a machine may remain unused. Context tells which one is meant.

examples.en: The young singer is an idol to many music fans.
examples.zh: 這位年輕歌手是許多樂迷崇拜的偶像。

examples.en: He met his soccer idol after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽後，他見到了崇拜已久的足球偶像。

examples.en: Her idol inspired her to practice the piano.
examples.zh: 她崇拜的偶像啟發她練習鋼琴。

explains: A person greatly admired by fans may be looked up to for talent or success. People may collect pictures or attend performances. It is helpful to remember that everyone makes mistakes.
Mika loved a singer's songs and practiced them at home. She went to a concert and cheered with the crowd. The singer thanked the fans.
A role model can inspire someone through kind actions. A famous person may be admired for many reasons. People should still think for themselves.

examples.en: The lesson helped end our ignorance about local birds.
examples.zh: 這堂課幫助我們消除對當地鳥類的無知。

examples.en: His ignorance of the rules caused a small mistake.
examples.zh: 他不熟悉規則，因此犯了一個小錯。

examples.en: Reading can reduce ignorance about other cultures.
examples.zh: 閱讀能減少對其他文化的無知。

explains: Not knowing about a fact or subject means someone lacks information. Learning and asking questions can help. People should not be mocked for what they have not learned yet.
Before the lesson, Eli did not know why the moon seemed to change shape. He asked the teacher and watched a model. He understood more afterward.
Knowledge comes from learning and experience. A person may not know something until it is taught. Curiosity can help fill a gap.

examples.en: I was ignorant of the new rule until the teacher explained it.
examples.zh: 老師解釋之前，我並不知道這項新規則。

examples.en: He felt ignorant about gardening, so he asked his neighbor for advice.
examples.zh: 他對園藝不熟悉，因此向鄰居請教。

examples.en: The book helps readers who are ignorant of the topic.
examples.zh: 這本書能幫助不熟悉這個主題的讀者。

explains: Someone who has not learned a fact or subject does not know about it yet. This does not mean the person cannot learn. Kind explanations can help.
Nora had never seen snow and did not know how it felt. Her cousin showed her a picture and later took her to a snowy hill. She learned by experiencing it.
An expert knows a lot about one subject. A beginner may still be learning. Everyone starts without knowledge of something.

examples.en: The chart illustrates how the plant grows each week.
examples.zh: 這張圖表說明植物每週如何生長。

examples.en: She used a story to illustrate her point.
examples.zh: 她用一個故事來說明自己的觀點。

examples.en: The pictures illustrate each step in the recipe.
examples.zh: 圖片展示了食譜中的每個步驟。

explains: A drawing or example can help explain an idea. Pictures make details easier to see. A writer may also use a story to show how something works.
The teacher drew a circle around the sun and added arrows for its light. The picture helped students understand why plants need it. They copied the drawing.
Words describe an idea, while a picture can show it visually. A real example can make it clearer too. Different methods help different learners.

examples.en: The illustration showed a fox hiding under a tree.
examples.zh: 插圖畫出一隻狐狸躲在樹下。
