examples.en: Each instrument section within the orchestra responds precisely to the guest conductor's subtle baton cues.
examples.zh: 交響樂團內部的弦樂、木管、銅管與打擊樂各大聲部，無不全神貫注精準回應著客席指揮家的微小指揮棒動作。

entries.definition: 管弦樂團；交響樂團；劇院樂池交響樂團
explains: A large group of musicians plays instruments together under a leader. It may include strings, wind instruments, and drums. They practice to make the music fit.
At the school concert, the musicians sat in rows with violins, flutes, and a drum. Their leader raised a hand and the music began. Families listened.
A solo performer plays alone. A large group combines many instruments. Each player watches the leader and listens to others.

examples.en: Optimal north-south building orientation captures soft natural sunlight while avoiding harsh afternoon west sun.
examples.zh: 採用絕佳的南北向建築座向採光配置，能引進柔和明亮的自然天光，同時徹底避開惱人西曬高溫。

examples.en: University freshmen attended a three-day campus orientation to learn about library services and academic majors.
examples.zh: 全體大學大一新生參加了為期三天的精彩新生始業式新生訓練，熟悉各項圖書館借閱與雙主修選課規範。

examples.en: The compass app displays your precise geographic orientation along with elevation and coordinates.
examples.zh: 手機內建的智慧電子羅盤 App 能即時顯示登山者當前精確的地磁行進方位角，並同步標示海拔與 GPS 座標。

examples.en: Day care centers use large digital clocks and calendar boards to support seniors' reality orientation.
examples.zh: 日照中心在大廳懸掛醒目的超大字體電子時鐘與日曆，協助長輩維持清醒的人事時地定向感。

examples.en: The university organized a week-long orientation program to welcome incoming international exchange students.
examples.zh: 大學舉辦了為期一週的新生訓練說明會，熱情歡迎即將入學的國際交換學生。

examples.en: The architect considered the solar orientation of the building to maximize natural winter sunlight.
examples.zh: 建築師仔細考量了建築物的座向朝向，以在冬季充分汲取溫暖的自然日照。

entries.definition: 建築座向採光；方向定位；人事時地現實定向感訓練；方向
explains: A meeting can introduce a person to a new school, job, or place. It explains where things are and what rules to follow. Newcomers can ask questions.
On her first day at the camp, Jo joined a short meeting. Leaders showed her the dining hall and explained the schedule. She felt ready to begin.
A regular class teaches a subject. An introductory meeting helps people learn how a place works. Signs and maps can help too.

examples.en: Orphan drug policies provide tax credits and grant assistance for developing treatments for rare conditions.
examples.zh: 國家頒布罕見疾病孤兒藥（Orphan Drug）獎勵專案，提供租稅減免以鼓勵藥廠為極少數罕病病童開發用藥。

examples.en: The pharmaceutical company set up a dedicated foundation to provide free orphan medicines to indigent families.
examples.zh: 這家跨國製藥集團成立了專項罕病愛心公益基金會，長年免費為清寒低收入家庭提供昂貴的罕見疾病孤兒藥。

examples.en: Developing an orphan therapeutic agent requires specialized clinical trial designs suited for small patient cohorts.
examples.zh: 開發孤兒藥必須量身打造極具創新的適應性臨床試驗設計，才能在極端稀少的病患樣本數下精準完成統計驗證。

entries.definition: 罕見疾病孤兒藥的；孤兒
explains: A child whose parents have died may need care from relatives or other adults. People should speak kindly about their situation. Support can help them feel safe.
After the story's young character lost his parents, an aunt welcomed him into her home. She made sure he could stay in school. He made new friends there.
Some children live with parents, while others are cared for by guardians. Every child needs a safe home and caring adults. Communities can help families.

examples.en: Set your alarm clock, otherwise you might oversleep tomorrow.
examples.zh: 設定好你的鬧鐘，否則你明天可能會睡過頭。

examples.en: Wear a warm thermal jacket, otherwise you will catch a chill in the mountain wind.
examples.zh: 請務必穿上一件保暖發熱衣，否則在吹拂的深山陣陣冷風中你一定會著涼感冒。

examples.en: The soup was a little salty, but the dinner banquet was otherwise absolutely flawless.
examples.zh: 那道湯品口感稍微偏鹹了一點，但在其他所有方面，今晚的宴席堪稱無可挑剔。

entries.definition: 否則；要不然；在其他方面
explains: This word can show what may happen if something does not occur. It can also mean in a different way. The sentence around it reveals which meaning fits.
Bring a jacket, or you may feel cold later. The weather changed quickly in the afternoon. The children stayed warm.
One plan may work, but another choice can be different. A warning can tell what might happen without an action. Context guides the meaning.

examples.en: The outcome of the game surprised both teams.
examples.zh: 比賽結果讓兩隊都很驚訝。

examples.en: We waited to learn the outcome of the science contest.
examples.zh: 我們等待得知科學比賽的結果。

examples.en: The careful plan led to a successful outcome.
examples.zh: 周全的計畫帶來了成功的結果。

explains: The result at the end of an event or effort is what happened because of it. It may be good, bad, or unexpected. Looking at the steps can explain it.
The team practiced hard for the final game and won by one point. Their coach praised their teamwork. Everyone celebrated together.
A goal is what someone hopes will happen. The result is what actually happens. Plans can lead to different endings.

examples.en: She gave an outstanding performance at the school concert.
examples.zh: 她在校園音樂會上有出色的表現。

examples.en: The team did outstanding work on its model bridge.
examples.zh: 團隊在模型橋梁上做出了傑出的成果。

examples.en: Two library books are still outstanding and must be returned.
examples.zh: 還有兩本圖書館的書尚未歸還。

explains: Something much better than usual can attract special praise. The word can also mean something that has not yet been completed or paid. Nearby words make the meaning clear.
The young pianist played each piece with great care and expression. The audience gave her a long round of applause. The judge praised her performance.
Ordinary work may be good. Exceptional work can stand out from the rest. An unfinished bill is another use of the word.

examples.en: She drew an oval around the word she wanted to remember.
examples.zh: 她在想記住的單字周圍畫了一個橢圓形。

examples.en: The table has an oval top with six chairs.
examples.zh: 這張桌子有橢圓形桌面和六張椅子。

examples.en: A white oval marked the center of the field.
examples.zh: 一個白色橢圓標示了球場中央。

explains: A rounded shape is longer in one direction than across, like an egg. It has no corners. Plates and mirrors can be made in this form.
The child traced around an egg-shaped frame to draw a smooth outline. She colored it green and added small flowers. It had no sharp corners.
A circle has the same width in every direction. This rounded shape is longer from end to end. Both are curved forms.

examples.en: He wore an overcoat while walking through the snow.
examples.zh: 他在雪中散步時穿著一件大衣。

examples.en: Her overcoat had large wooden buttons.
examples.zh: 她的大衣上有大大的木製鈕扣。

examples.en: I hung my overcoat by the front door.
examples.zh: 我把大衣掛在前門旁。

explains: A long warm coat is worn over other clothes when the weather is cold. It may reach below the knees. Buttons or a belt help close it.
On a snowy morning, Liam put on a thick coat over his sweater. He fastened the buttons and wrapped a scarf around his neck. He stayed warm outside.
A light shirt may be worn indoors. A long outer layer protects someone from cold air. People choose different weights for different seasons.

examples.en: He can overcome his fear of swimming by taking lessons.
examples.zh: 他可以透過上課克服對游泳的恐懼。

examples.en: The team can overcome a slow start and win the game.
examples.zh: 隊伍可以克服開局不順並贏得比賽。

examples.en: She worked hard to overcome the reading challenge.
examples.zh: 她努力克服閱讀上的挑戰。

explains: To get past a problem or strong feeling is to manage it successfully. Practice and help from others can make the challenge easier. Progress may take time.
Mika was afraid to speak in front of the class. She practiced with a friend and took slow breaths. She gave her talk the next day.
A problem can block a person's way. Finding a solution helps them move forward. Asking for support is a strong step.

examples.en: I overlooked one spelling mistake in my essay.
examples.zh: 我忽略了文章中的一個拼字錯誤。

examples.en: The balcony overlooks the garden.
examples.zh: 陽台俯瞰著花園。

examples.en: Do not overlook the small print on the ticket.
examples.zh: 不要忽略票券上的小字。

explains: To fail to notice a detail can happen when someone is not paying attention. The word can also mean to have a view from above. Context helps explain which use fits.
Ben read the list quickly and missed the last item. His sister pointed to it, and he checked again. He added it to the bag.
A close look may reveal a small detail. A quick glance may miss it. A room with a view can look down on a place.

examples.en: We stayed overnight at our cousins' house.
examples.zh: 我們在表親家過了一夜。

examples.en: The overnight train arrived before sunrise.
examples.zh: 夜間行駛的火車在日出前抵達。

examples.en: The snow covered the field overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之間，雪覆蓋了田野。

explains: During the night or for one night describes something that happens while people sleep or lasts until morning. A trip may include a stay away from home. Context shows the use.
The class stayed at the camp for one night and returned after breakfast. They slept in cabins and shared stories. Everyone packed a sleeping bag.
A day trip ends before night. A longer visit may last through the night. Some changes can also happen very quickly.

examples.en: The rebels tried to overthrow the king.
examples.zh: 叛軍試圖推翻國王。

examples.en: The citizens helped overthrow the unfair government.
examples.zh: 市民協助推翻了不公平的政府。

examples.en: A plot to overthrow the ruler was discovered.
examples.zh: 一項推翻統治者的陰謀被發現了。

explains: To remove a ruler or government from power by force is to take its place. This can lead to conflict and major change. History books describe such events.
The story told how people joined together to remove the unfair ruler. They chose new leaders and wrote different rules. The country changed greatly.
A peaceful election changes leaders without force. A violent change can happen through fighting. Both can affect a nation.

examples.en: People need oxygen to breathe.
examples.zh: 人類需要氧氣才能呼吸。

examples.en: Plants release oxygen into the air during the day.
examples.zh: 植物白天會向空氣中釋放氧氣。

examples.en: The diver carried a tank of oxygen underwater.
examples.zh: 潛水員帶著一罐氧氣潛入水中。

explains: A gas in the air is needed by people and many animals to breathe. Plants also release it. It has no color or smell.
The children took deep breaths after running around the playground. Their bodies used a gas from the air to help make energy. They rested under a tree.
Air is a mixture of gases. One important gas helps living things breathe. Plants and animals use it in different ways.

examples.en: Maintain an even 5-minute-per-kilometer pace to avoid hitting the wall early.
examples.zh: 全程維持穩定的每公里五分速配速節奏，能有效避免在三十公里後提早撞牆。

examples.en: The anxious father began to pace nervously back and forth outside the maternity ward.
examples.zh: 焦慮不安的準爸爸在產房走廊外神經緊繃地來回焦急踱步。

examples.en: You need to pace yourself evenly throughout the multi-stage exam so you don't run out of energy.
examples.zh: 在這場跨越數個節次的漫長考試中，你必須妥善調節答題節奏與步調，以免提早力竭。

explains: The speed at which someone walks, runs, or works can be described this way. A person may go faster or slower. Choosing a steady speed can help them continue.
The hikers walked slowly up the steep hill. They stopped for water and kept a steady speed. Everyone reached the top together.
A sprint is very fast for a short time. A calm walk is slower. The right speed depends on the task.

examples.en: The monolithic viewing panel spans thirty meters wide, offering guests panoramic views of open ocean life.
examples.zh: 寬達三十公尺的一體成型「透明觀景大面板」（Panel），為遊客提供無死角的大洋生態全景視野。

examples.en: An expert panel of economists debated the monetary policy impacts on global trade.
examples.zh: 由資深經濟學家組成的專家論壇小組，深入辯論當前貨幣政策對跨國貿易帶來的深遠衝擊。

examples.en: Rooftop solar panels generate surplus green electricity that the homeowner sells back to the grid.
examples.zh: 屋頂上整齊鋪設的太陽能電池板產生充沛的綠色電力，讓屋主能將多餘電力回售給台電電網。

entries.definition: 厚達六十公分之超高抗壓透明大洋觀景窗；鑲板
explains: A flat section of a wall, door, or screen can be one part of a larger surface. A group of people chosen to judge or discuss something can also have this name. Context matters.
The art show asked three teachers to look at the drawings and choose a winner. They discussed each picture before deciding. The artists waited nearby.
A whole wall has many sections. A small group can also share opinions together. The sentence shows which use is intended.

examples.en: Dual supersonic parachutes deployed automatically at ten kilometers altitude, slowing the capsule gently.
examples.zh: 雙重「超音速減速降落傘」（Parachutes），在萬米高空準時自動展開，使返回艙平穩柔和著陸。

examples.en: The courageous skydiver felt an exhilarating adrenaline rush after his colorful nylon parachute opened overhead.
examples.zh: 勇敢的高空跳傘極限運動好手在頭頂五彩斑斕的尼龍降落傘迎風綻開的一瞬間，感受到了無比暢快的腎上腺素飆升。

examples.en: The executive was forced out with a generous golden parachute severance package worth millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 這位失勢下台的高階執行長雖然被迫去職，卻依合約領取了高達數百萬美元、令人咋舌的黃金降落傘離職金禮包。

entries.definition: 超音速引導傘與主減速傘在沙漠上空平穩開傘；降落傘
explains: A large cloth canopy opens in the air and slows a person or object falling from a height. Trained people use it with safety equipment. It can also help deliver supplies.
In the video, a rescue worker jumped from an aircraft and opened a wide cloth canopy. It slowed the fall toward a clear field. The worker landed safely.
A stone falls quickly through the air. A wide canopy catches air and slows movement. Safety training is necessary.

examples.en: Write one paragraph about your favorite season.
examples.zh: 請寫一段關於你最喜歡季節的文字。

examples.en: The first paragraph introduces the story's main character.
examples.zh: 第一段介紹了故事的主角。

examples.en: She left a blank line between each paragraph.
examples.zh: 她在每個段落之間空了一行。

explains: A group of sentences about one main idea forms a section of writing. It often begins on a new line. This organization helps readers follow the text.
In her report, May wrote one section about the river and another about the animals living there. Each section stayed focused on one topic. The report was easy to read.
A single sentence may not explain a full idea. A long piece can be divided into sections. Clear organization helps readers.

examples.en: We received a partial list of the books for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們收到了一份不完整的旅行書單。

examples.en: The repair was only partial, so the door still would not close.
examples.zh: 修理只完成了一部分，所以門仍然關不起來。

examples.en: She gave a partial answer and promised to check the rest.
examples.zh: 她回答了一部分，並答應查清其餘內容。

explains: Something that is not complete includes only part of a whole. A report may show some results but not all. The sentence helps explain what is missing.
The students had finished half of the poster when the bell rang. They packed their supplies and planned to continue tomorrow. Their work was not done yet.
A complete set has every piece. An incomplete one is missing some parts. People can finish it later.

examples.en: Everyone's participation helped make the concert successful.
examples.zh: 每個人的參與讓音樂會順利成功。

examples.en: The teacher encouraged participation from quiet students.
examples.zh: 老師鼓勵安靜的學生也參與其中。

examples.en: Her participation in the race surprised her friends.
examples.zh: 她參加比賽讓朋友們感到驚訝。

explains: Taking part in an activity means someone joins and contributes. They may speak, perform, or help with a task. Everyone can participate in different ways.
During the class garden project, Ben carried soil while Ana planted seeds. Each student had a job. Their shared effort filled the beds.
Watching from the side is not the same as joining in. A person who takes part can help shape what happens. Groups need many kinds of help.

examples.en: The university formed an academic partnership with TSMC.
examples.zh: 該大學與台積電建立了產學合作夥伴關係。

examples.en: A long-term business partnership must be built on mutual trust and shared values.
examples.zh: 長久穩固的商業合作夥伴關係，必須建立在彼此互信與共同價值觀之上。

examples.en: The airlines announced a code-share partnership to expand their international flight routes.
examples.zh: 兩家航空公司聯合宣布推展代碼共享夥伴合作，以全面拓寬國際航線版圖。

explains: Two or more people working together toward a goal can form a close working relationship. They share tasks and decisions. Trust helps the arrangement succeed.
The bakery and the farm worked together to make fresh bread with local wheat. Each business shared what it did best. Customers liked the result.
A single worker completes tasks alone. People in a shared effort can combine skills. Clear communication helps them work well.

examples.en: Passive house standards require ultra-low energy consumption by utilizing body heat and incoming sunshine.
examples.zh: 嚴格的德國被動房標準，僅利用人體散發的體溫與窗外陽光即可維持舒適室溫。

examples.en: The architect incorporated passive cooling strategies, including deep eaves and a central solar chimney.
examples.zh: 建築師導入了深邃出挑飛簷與中央太陽能拔熱通風塔等被動式節能冷房策略。

examples.en: Living in a certified passive home slashes annual heating and cooling bills by over eighty percent.
examples.zh: 居住在獲得德國官方認證的被動式節能住宅中，能讓每年冷暖氣電費開支暴減八成以上。

entries.definition: 德國被動房超低能耗節能標準的
explains: A person who waits without taking action is not actively involved. The word can also describe a sentence where the receiver of an action comes first. Context shows the meaning.
During the group activity, Max stayed quiet and did not choose a task. His friends asked what he wanted to do. He picked a job and joined in.
An active person takes part and acts. Someone who waits may let others make choices. In grammar, the sentence form has another use.

examples.en: We ate pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐我們吃了番茄醬義大利麵。

examples.en: The pasta needs five more minutes to cook.
examples.zh: 義大利麵還需要五分鐘才會煮熟。

examples.en: She added cheese to the bowl of pasta.
examples.zh: 她在那碗義大利麵裡加了起司。

explains: A food made from flour and water can be shaped into noodles, tubes, or other forms. It is often boiled and served with sauce. Different shapes hold sauce in different ways.
The children helped cook small spiral noodles for dinner. Their father added tomato sauce and grated cheese. Everyone filled a bowl.
Rice is a grain served in small pieces. Flour dough can be shaped into many kinds of noodles. Both foods are used in meals.

examples.en: The dog lifted its paw to greet its owner.
examples.zh: 狗狗抬起爪子迎接主人。

examples.en: A muddy paw print appeared on the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 廚房地板上出現了一個泥濘的爪印。

examples.en: The kitten rested one paw on the ball.
examples.zh: 小貓把一隻爪子放在球上。

explains: The foot of a cat, dog, or other animal with toes and soft pads can be called this. It helps the animal walk, climb, or hold things. Some have claws.
The puppy placed one soft foot on Maya's knee and looked up at her. She checked its toes for mud. The puppy wagged its tail.
A human hand has fingers, while an animal's foot may have pads and claws. Different animals use their feet in different ways. Some leave prints in mud.

examples.en: A peculiar sound came from the old clock.
examples.zh: 老鐘發出一種奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: The bird had a peculiar blue mark on its wing.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥的翅膀上有一塊奇特的藍色斑紋。

examples.en: She noticed a peculiar smell in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她注意到廚房裡有一股奇怪的味道。

explains: Something unusual or different from what people expect can seem strange. It may be interesting rather than bad. More details can explain why it stands out.
A bird in the garden made a sound like a squeaky toy. The children looked up and found a small bird in the tree. They listened again.
An ordinary sound is familiar. A strange one may catch someone's attention. People can ask questions to learn more.

examples.en: The child took a peep through the keyhole.
examples.zh: 孩子從鑰匙孔往裡偷看了一眼。

examples.en: We heard the chicks peep from inside the nest.
examples.zh: 我們聽見小鳥在鳥巢裡吱吱叫。

examples.en: She peeped around the corner to see who was there.
examples.zh: 她從轉角探頭看誰在那裡。

explains: To look quickly through a small opening is to take a brief secret look. A small bird's short call can also have this name. The sentence gives clues to the meaning.
The kitten peeked through the crack in the door to see the new room. It saw a toy and stepped inside. Its owner laughed softly.
A long look lets someone see many details. A short look through a gap shows only a little. Birds may make a small sound too.

examples.en: She peered through the fog to find the trail sign.
examples.zh: 她透過濃霧仔細看，尋找步道標誌。

examples.en: A student should treat every peer with kindness.
examples.zh: 學生應該友善對待每位同儕。

examples.en: He peered into the box to see what was inside.
examples.zh: 他仔細往盒子裡看，想知道裡面有什麼。

explains: To look closely or with difficulty can happen when something is far away or dim. A person may lean forward to see better. The word can also mean someone of the same age or level.
In the dark tent, Leo looked through a small opening to find his flashlight. He moved his head from side to side. At last he spotted it.
A quick glance may not show details. A careful look takes more attention. At school, a classmate is someone of similar age or level.

examples.en: The striker scored a goal from the penalty spot.
examples.zh: 前鋒在十二碼罰球點操刀破門得分。

examples.en: Late payment of property taxes incurs a steep monetary penalty.
examples.zh: 逾期繳納房屋地價稅將會面臨高額的金錢處罰滯納金。

examples.en: The hockey player spent two minutes in the penalty box for tripping an opponent.
examples.zh: 這位曲棍球選手因為絆倒對手而被判在受罰席受罰兩分鐘。

explains: A consequence given for breaking a rule can discourage unfair actions. In sports, a team may lose points or a player may sit out. Rules explain what happens.
A player touched the ball with a hand during the match. The referee stopped play and gave the other team a free kick. Everyone returned to position.
A reward follows good work. A consequence may follow breaking a rule. Fair rules apply to everyone.

examples.en: Half of the class, or fifty percent, chose the park.
examples.zh: 全班有一半，也就是百分之五十，選了公園。

examples.en: The store offered a ten percent discount on books.
examples.zh: 商店提供書籍九折優惠。

examples.en: Only a small percent of the seeds grew.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分種子發芽了。

explains: A part out of every hundred is described using this amount. People use it to compare scores, prices, or groups. A symbol often shows it in writing.
The class answered most questions correctly on a quiz. The teacher said their score was eighty out of every hundred. They were pleased.
A fraction shows parts of a whole. This way of counting always uses one hundred as the whole. It helps compare amounts.

examples.en: A large percentage of the class enjoys reading.
examples.zh: 班上很大比例的學生喜歡閱讀。

examples.en: The percentage of rainy days was low this month.
examples.zh: 這個月下雨天的比例很低。

examples.en: We calculated the percentage of students who chose each book.
examples.zh: 我們計算了選擇各本書的學生比例。

explains: A number showing how much out of one hundred gives a way to compare parts. It is useful for scores or survey answers. The total is treated as one hundred.
The class voted on a new game, and most students chose tag. The teacher turned the votes into a number out of one hundred. Everyone could compare the results.
A raw count shows how many people answered. A share out of one hundred makes groups easier to compare. Both can describe a survey.

examples.en: French pastry chefs pursue aesthetic perfection, ensuring every chocolate curl sits at a precise angle.
examples.zh: 法式頂級甜點大師一生執著追求極致完美，確保每一片巧克力裝飾羽毛皆以分毫不差的優雅角度擺放。

examples.en: Achieving crusty sourdough perfection requires dialing in dough temperature, room humidity, and steam volume.
examples.zh: 想要烤出外脆內潤的完美極致酸種麵包，必須嚴格校準麵團出缸溫度、室內濕度與烤箱蒸氣量。

examples.en: Striving for perfection means discarding any batch that fails to meet stringent quality standards.
examples.zh: 對極致完美的偏執追求，意味著只要任何一爐出爐成色未達嚴格標準，烘焙大師寧可忍痛整批銷毀。

examples.en: The kitchen brigade labors under intense pressure, united in a relentless quest for gastronomic perfection.
examples.zh: 廚房內全體廚師在高壓節奏下緊密協同，全心全意投入對「極致美食完美境界」（Perfection）的永恆追尋。

examples.en: The virtuoso pianist practiced twenty hours weekly, striving for technical perfection in every cadence.
examples.zh: 這位享譽國際的鋼琴巨匠每週苦練琴藝二十個小時以上，在每一個樂句終止式中苛求分毫不差的技術精準度。

examples.en: Demanding absolute perfection from inexperienced apprentices can stifle motivation and provoke anxiety.
examples.zh: 對初出茅廬的新手學徒強求百分之百的無瑕完美，往往容易扼殺其學習主動性並引發過度焦慮。

entries.definition: 追求毫米級分毫不差的極致完美境界；對溫度、秒數與調味分毫未差之極致完美執念
explains: A state with no mistakes or flaws is complete and exact. People may work hard to reach it, but small errors are normal. Learning often matters more than being flawless.
The student practiced the song many times, but one note sounded different during the show. She smiled and kept playing. The audience enjoyed it.
A rough first try may have errors. A polished result has fewer. It is helpful to keep improving without expecting every task to be flawless.

examples.en: She wore a light perfume that smelled like flowers.
examples.zh: 她擦了一點帶有花香的淡香水。

examples.en: The perfume bottle stood beside the mirror.
examples.zh: 香水瓶放在鏡子旁。

examples.en: A strong perfume filled the small room.
examples.zh: 濃烈的香水味充滿了小房間。

explains: A scented liquid or spray can add a pleasant smell to skin or clothing. People use only a small amount. Some scents come from flowers, while others are made in a lab.
Before the party, Aunt May dabbed a tiny bit of floral scent on her wrist. The room smelled like roses. She closed the bottle tightly.
Soap can clean without adding a strong scent. A scented product is chosen for its smell. Some people prefer no added fragrance.

examples.en: The marker left a permanent line on the white shirt.
examples.zh: 麥克筆在白襯衫上留下了永久的線條。

examples.en: She found a permanent job at the library.
examples.zh: 她在圖書館找到一份長期工作。

examples.en: The bridge made a permanent path across the river.
examples.zh: 這座橋在河上建成了一條永久通道。

explains: Something that lasts for a long time and is not meant to change is lasting. A mark may stay, or a job may continue. Context helps show the meaning.
The town painted a lasting sign on the wall near the park entrance. It showed visitors where to find the trail. Rain did not wash it away.
A temporary note can be removed soon. A lasting change is meant to stay. Some things can still change over time.

examples.en: Effective speech requires clear reasoning and gentle persuasion.
examples.zh: 成功的演說需要清晰的邏輯與溫和有力的說服技巧。

examples.en: It took hours of patient persuasion to get him to see a dental specialist.
examples.zh: 經過家人長達數小時好說歹說的耐心勸說，他才終於答應預約拔除智齒。

examples.en: Debaters must master rhetorical techniques to sharpen their powers of persuasion.
examples.zh: 優秀的辯論選手必須熟練掌握各項修辭技法，以全面砥礪自身的論辯說服力。

examples.en: The manager used logical persuasion backed by financial data to win approval.
examples.zh: 專案經理運用詳實嚴謹的財務數據與理性說服力，成功爭取到了董事會通過。

examples.en: Effective marketing blends emotional appeal with rational persuasion.
examples.zh: 高效的行銷將情感共鳴與理性說服融為一體。

examples.en: After much gentle persuasion, grandfather agreed to visit the health clinic.
examples.zh: 經過大家再三溫和的勸說後，祖父終於同意前往健康診所檢查身體。

explains: Giving reasons or examples can help someone agree with an idea. A person may explain benefits and answer questions. The listener still decides what to believe.
Nora wanted the group to choose a book for reading time. She explained why its mystery story was exciting. Her classmates agreed to try it.
A command tells someone what to do. A reasoned talk tries to change a person's mind. Honest facts make a case stronger.

examples.en: Her persuasive speech convinced the class to plant a garden.
examples.zh: 她有說服力的演說讓全班決定種一座花園。

examples.en: He wrote a persuasive letter asking for safer bike paths.
examples.zh: 他寫了一封有說服力的信，要求設置更安全的自行車道。

examples.en: The advertisement used persuasive words to sell the toy.
examples.zh: 這則廣告用有說服力的文字推銷玩具。

explains: A message with strong reasons can make people more likely to agree. It may include facts, examples, or a clear appeal. Listeners should still think carefully.
The student wanted the school to add more recycling bins. She showed how much paper the class used and suggested where bins could go. The principal listened.
A weak reason may not change anyone's mind. A clear argument can show why an idea may work. People can ask questions before deciding.

examples.en: He was pessimistic about the team's chances of winning.
examples.zh: 他對隊伍獲勝的機會很悲觀。

examples.en: Her pessimistic view made the group worry about the trip.
examples.zh: 她悲觀的看法讓小組擔心這趟旅行。

examples.en: The pessimistic forecast predicted more rain.
examples.zh: 悲觀的預測認為雨還會下得更多。

explains: A person expecting bad results may focus on what could go wrong. This view can make it hard to feel hopeful. Looking at facts can offer a more balanced picture.
Before the class trip, Leo worried that it would rain and the bus would break down. His friend checked the forecast and packed an umbrella. They still looked forward to going.
An optimistic view expects good possibilities. A worried view expects trouble. Both should consider what the facts show.

examples.en: The garden pest chewed holes in the lettuce leaves.
examples.zh: 花園害蟲在萵苣葉上咬出了洞。

examples.en: Ants became a pest when they entered the picnic basket.
examples.zh: 螞蟻跑進野餐籃後，就成了麻煩。

examples.en: The farmer found a safe way to control the pest.
examples.zh: 農夫找到安全的方法來控制害蟲。

explains: An animal or insect that causes trouble by damaging plants or bothering people can be called this. Gardeners may use safe ways to protect crops. Not every small creature is harmful.
Tiny insects ate holes in the cabbage leaves. The gardener covered the plants with a net instead of spraying them. The vegetables grew well.
A helpful insect may pollinate flowers. A harmful one can damage food or plants. People can learn which kind they see.

examples.en: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon caused by light and water.
examples.zh: 彩虹是由光和水造成的自然現象。

examples.en: The scientists studied the strange weather phenomenon.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了這種奇特的氣象現象。

examples.en: The northern lights are a beautiful phenomenon in the sky.
examples.zh: 極光是天空中美麗的現象。

explains: An event or fact that can be observed is something people may study. It can happen in nature or in society. Scientists look for patterns and causes.
The class watched a rainbow appear after the rain. Their teacher explained how light and water made the colors. They drew what they saw.
A guess is not an observed event. Something people can see or measure gives them evidence. Careful study can explain why it happens.

examples.en: The philosopher wrote about fairness and friendship.
examples.zh: 這位哲學家撰寫了關於公平和友誼的文章。

examples.en: A young philosopher asked why people follow rules.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的思想家問人們為什麼要遵守規則。

examples.en: The book describes a famous philosopher from ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 這本書介紹了一位古希臘的著名哲學家。

explains: A thinker who asks deep questions about life, fairness, and knowledge may be called this. They use careful reasoning to explore ideas. People have done this for thousands of years.
The teacher asked the class whether it is always fair to follow a rule. Students shared examples and listened to each other. They thought carefully about the question.
A scientist may study how nature works through experiments. A thinker may explore big questions using reasoning. Both can ask questions about the world.

examples.en: They had a philosophical discussion about what makes a good friend.
examples.zh: 他們進行了一場關於何謂好朋友的哲學討論。

examples.en: The book raises philosophical questions about truth.
examples.zh: 這本書提出了關於真理的哲學問題。

examples.en: His philosophical ideas made the students think deeply.
examples.zh: 他的哲學想法讓學生深入思考。

explains: Questions about what is true, fair, or meaningful are connected with deep thinking. A discussion may explore ideas rather than give a simple answer. People can have different views.
The group talked about whether a promise should always be kept. They gave examples and listened to each other's reasons. The question had no easy answer.
A practical question may ask how to build a chair. A deep idea question may ask what makes a choice fair. Both can be useful.

examples.en: Studying philosophy trains students to question unexamined assumptions and seek fundamental truths.
examples.zh: 修讀哲學能訓練青年學子勇於質疑未經檢驗的成見假設，並執著探尋事物背後的根本真理。

examples.en: Her personal business philosophy centers on honesty, customer satisfaction, and employee well-being.
examples.zh: 她個人的創業經營哲學始終圍繞著誠實守信、顧客第一以及細心呵護員工身心健康的三大核心。

examples.en: Eastern philosophy encourages inner stillness, humility, and mindful alignment with nature's flow.
examples.zh: 東方哲學崇尚內心靜謐定力、虛懷若谷的謙遜，以及順應天地大自然生生不息的運行律動。

entries.definition: 哲學；人生處世哲學；思辨
explains: The study of big questions about life, knowledge, and right and wrong uses careful thinking. People discuss ideas and give reasons. Different thinkers may reach different answers.
The class talked about whether it is fair to share every toy equally. Students explained their views and listened to others. They learned to think about fairness.
A science experiment tests how nature works. Deep questions may ask what is good or true. Both kinds of study can help people understand.

examples.en: Landscape photography requires patience to capture the perfect natural light.
examples.zh: 風景攝影需要耐心等待以捕捉最完美的自然光線。

examples.en: She took up street photography as a creative hobby to document city life.
examples.zh: 她將街頭攝影作為記錄城市生活的創意興趣嗜好。

examples.en: Drone aerial photography provides breathtaking bird's-eye views of Taiwan's coastlines.
examples.zh: 空拍無人機空拍攝影為台灣沿海海岸線提供了壯麗的鳥瞰全景。

examples.en: Street photography captures unposed, candid human moments in historic alleys.
examples.zh: 街頭紀實攝影旨在老城巷弄中捕捉最真實自然、毫無擺拍痕跡的人情日常瞬間。

examples.en: She took up landscape photography as a creative hobby to connect with nature.
examples.zh: 她將大自然風景攝影當作一門激發創意的嗜好，藉此走出戶外親近自然。

examples.en: Digital photography has made experimenting with lighting and angles much easier.
examples.zh: 數位攝影技術的普及，讓攝影師在嘗試各種打光配置與刁鑽取景角度時更加隨心所欲。

entries.definition: 攝影；攝影術；攝影藝術；照相
explains: Making pictures with a camera captures people, places, or events. A photographer chooses where to stand and when to take the picture. Light affects how it looks.
At the park, Ava waited until a butterfly landed on a flower. She held her camera still and took a picture. The bright wings showed clearly.
A painting is made by adding color by hand. A camera records light from a real scene. Both can create beautiful images.

examples.en: The children need physical activity every day.
examples.zh: 孩子每天都需要身體活動。

examples.en: The physical book felt heavy in her backpack.
examples.zh: 實體書放在她的背包裡感覺很重。

examples.en: He had a physical checkup before joining the team.
examples.zh: 加入隊伍前，他接受了身體檢查。

explains: Things connected with the body or real objects can be described this way. Exercise uses the body, while a solid object can be touched. Context makes the meaning clear.
After sitting for an hour, the children stood up and stretched their arms. They felt ready to run outside. Moving helped their bodies wake up.
A thought cannot be held in the hand. A real object has shape and takes up space. The word can also describe body movement.

examples.en: Consult a licensed physician if your symptoms persist.
examples.zh: 如果症狀持續未消，請諮詢合格的執業醫師。

examples.en: Dr. Chang is a well-respected family physician in our town.
examples.zh: 張醫師是我們鎮上備受尊敬的家庭醫學科醫師。

examples.en: The attending physician discussed the test results with the patient's family.
examples.zh: 主治醫師向病患家屬詳細說明了檢驗結果。

examples.en: The attending physician reviewed the laboratory blood panel with the patient.
examples.zh: 內科主治醫師耐心地向病患逐一解釋各項血液檢驗數值與肝腎功能報告。

examples.en: You should consult a licensed physician before starting any extreme exercise program.
examples.zh: 在開展任何高強度的極限體能訓練之前，建議先諮詢專業合格執業醫師的評估建議。

examples.en: The experienced physician listened patiently to the elderly patient describe her symptoms.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的資深醫師神態溫和，極有耐心地聆聽年邁阿嬤娓娓道來她身體的種種不適。

entries.definition: 醫師；內科醫生；內科主治醫師
explains: A doctor trained to care for people's health can check symptoms and suggest treatment. Patients should explain how they feel. A trusted adult can help children get care.
When Lina had a sore throat, her father took her to see a doctor. The doctor listened to her breathing and asked questions. She gave advice for resting.
A nurse helps with care, and a doctor can diagnose health problems. Both work to support patients. People should ask a grown-up about health concerns.

examples.en: The physicist explained how magnets pull on metal.
examples.zh: 物理學家解釋了磁鐵如何吸引金屬。

examples.en: A young physicist tested how light bends through glass.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的物理學家測試光線如何穿過玻璃時彎曲。

examples.en: The physicist used math to study the moving object.
examples.zh: 物理學家用數學研究這個移動中的物體。

explains: A scientist who studies matter, energy, motion, and forces tries to explain how the physical world works. They use experiments and math. Their findings can lead to new tools.
A researcher dropped balls of different sizes from the same height and measured how long they fell. She recorded the results carefully. Her class used them to discuss motion.
A biologist studies living things. Another kind of scientist studies forces and energy. All scientists ask questions and check evidence.

examples.en: Physics helps explain why a ball rolls down a hill.
examples.zh: 物理學有助於解釋球為什麼會滾下山坡。

examples.en: We learned about light and sound in physics class.
examples.zh: 我們在物理課上學習了光和聲音。

examples.en: The physics experiment tested how magnets attract metal.
examples.zh: 這項物理實驗測試磁鐵如何吸引金屬。

explains: A branch of science studies matter, energy, motion, and forces. It helps explain why objects fall or how light travels. Experiments and measurements support ideas.
The students rolled a ball down a ramp and timed how long it took. They changed the ramp's height and compared results. They saw how motion changed.
Biology focuses on living things. Another science asks how the nonliving world works. Both use observations and tests.

examples.en: He added a pickle to his sandwich.
examples.zh: 他在三明治裡加了一片醃黃瓜。

examples.en: The jar contains pickles made from garden cucumbers.
examples.zh: 罐子裡裝著用花園小黃瓜做的醃菜。

examples.en: We were in a pickle when we lost the map.
examples.zh: 我們弄丟地圖時陷入了困境。

explains: A cucumber or other food can be kept in a salty or sour liquid so it lasts longer and tastes tangy. The word can also mean a difficult situation. Context shows the meaning.
Grandpa placed cucumber slices in a jar with vinegar and spices. He closed the lid and stored it in the fridge. They ate them with sandwiches later.
Fresh vegetables may spoil after some time. Preserving them in a special liquid can keep them longer. A tough problem is another meaning.

examples.en: The pioneer built the first school in the new town.
examples.zh: 這位拓荒者在新城鎮建了第一所學校。

examples.en: She was a pioneer in using solar power for homes.
examples.zh: 她是將太陽能用於住宅的先驅。

examples.en: The pioneers crossed the mountains in covered wagons.
examples.zh: 拓荒者們乘坐有篷馬車翻越山脈。

explains: A person who is among the first to explore or develop something can open a path for others. Their work may be difficult because little has been done before. Later people can build on it.
The early explorers traveled across a wide plain and made a small settlement. They built homes and a school. More families came later.
A follower uses a path already made. Someone who begins a new way may face uncertainty. Their choices can change the future.

examples.en: Water was plentiful after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水源充足。

examples.en: The forest has plentiful food for birds in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天時，森林裡有充足食物給鳥兒。

examples.en: Apples were plentiful at the market this week.
examples.zh: 這週市場上的蘋果很多。

explains: A large amount of something means there is more than enough for many people. A garden may have many ripe tomatoes. The amount can change with time.
The apple tree produced so much fruit that the family filled several baskets. They shared some with neighbors. There was plenty left for pies.
A small supply may run out quickly. A large supply can meet many needs. Careful sharing helps everyone.

examples.en: The movie has an unpredictable plot twist at the very end.
examples.zh: 這部電影在最後結尾處出現了出人意料的情節大反轉。

examples.en: Conspirators formed a secret plot to overthrow the corrupt ruler.
examples.zh: 密謀者秘密策劃了一場推翻腐敗統治者的政變陰謀。

examples.en: They bought a small plot of farmland to grow organic sweet potatoes.
examples.zh: 他們買了一小塊農地來栽種有機甜地瓜。

explains: The events that happen in a story and how they connect make up its main plan. A piece of land for growing plants can also have this name. Context tells which meaning fits.
The book began with a lost dog, then showed a child searching the town, and ended with a happy reunion. The events formed a clear story. The class enjoyed it.
A character is a person in a story. The connected events explain what happens. A garden space is another use of the word.

examples.en: She packed a plum in her lunch box.
examples.zh: 她在午餐盒裡放了一顆李子。

examples.en: The ripe plum fell from the tree.
examples.zh: 成熟的李子從樹上掉了下來。

examples.en: He cut a plum into small pieces for the salad.
examples.zh: 他把李子切成小塊放進沙拉裡。

explains: A small round fruit has smooth skin and a sweet or slightly sour center with a hard pit. It can be purple, red, or yellow. People eat it fresh or cooked.
The tree was full of ripe purple fruit in late summer. Mia washed one and bit into its soft flesh. She put the hard pit in the compost.
An apple has many tiny seeds, while this fruit has one large pit. Both can be sweet and juicy. Different varieties have different colors.

examples.en: Call a certified plumber immediately to inspect the burst water pipe.
examples.zh: 立即打電話請合格的水電工來檢查破裂的水管。

examples.en: The experienced plumber used an auger snake to unclog the bathtub drain.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的水電技工使用通管條疏通了浴缸的排水管道。

examples.en: The plumber charged a reasonable fee for replacing the leaking toilet valve.
examples.zh: 水電師傅更換漏水的馬桶進水閥僅收取了合理的工本費。

explains: A skilled worker installs and repairs pipes that carry water through buildings. They may fix a leaking sink or blocked drain. Tools help them find and solve problems.
Water dripped under the kitchen sink, so the family called a repair worker. He tightened a pipe and checked for more leaks. The floor stayed dry.
An electrician works with wires and power. Another tradesperson works with pipes and drains. Both help keep buildings working.

examples.en: The bright berries were poisonous, so no one ate them.
examples.zh: 那些鮮豔的莓果有毒，所以沒有人吃。

examples.en: Some mushrooms are poisonous to people.
examples.zh: 有些蘑菇對人有毒。

examples.en: The snake's poisonous bite could make someone very sick.
examples.zh: 這條蛇的毒咬可能讓人病得很嚴重。

explains: Something that can harm or kill if eaten, touched, or breathed in is dangerous. Some plants and animals have harmful substances. People should not touch unknown things.
The park sign warned visitors not to eat berries from wild bushes. A guide explained that some could make people very sick. The children stayed on the path.
A safe food nourishes the body. A harmful substance can cause serious illness. Asking an adult before touching unknown items is wise.

examples.en: French polish applied in hundreds of micro-thin coats creates a mirror shine with zero acoustic damping.
examples.zh: 以純手工布包反覆推上數百層超薄蟲膠的「法式拋光」（French Polish），創造如鏡光澤且對音色零阻尼。

examples.en: She bought specialized cream to polish scuffed leather dress shoes before the corporate interview.
examples.zh: 在前往參加重要外商主管職位面試前，他特地買來優質鞋油將微有磨損的真皮皮鞋擦得晶亮如新。

examples.en: The jeweler cleaned the heirloom sterling silver brooch to restore its brilliant metallic polish.
examples.zh: 珠寶工匠使用超音波洗銀水與拋光布細心擦拭傳家純銀胸針，瞬間使其重現熠熠生輝的耀眼銀白金屬光澤。

examples.en: Black polish on the tourbillon bridge reflects light purely: appearing pitch black from one angle and white from another.
examples.zh: 陀飛輪夾板上的「黑色鏡面拋光」（Black Polish），在特定角度下漆黑如夜，在另一角度則耀眼如鏡。

examples.en: Routine application of wax polish protects the cherrywood dining table against water ring stains.
examples.zh: 定期在實木櫻桃木餐桌表面均勻塗抹天然蜂蠟保護拋光蠟，能長效預防熱水杯留下頑固的水痕白印。

examples.en: The candidate rehearsed her campaign speech repeatedly to give her performance an impressive professional polish.
examples.zh: 候選人在電視辯論會登場前反覆對著鏡子練習演講肢體動作，使其整場公開發表的台風展現出高度專業洗鍊感。

entries.definition: 純手工羊毛布包反覆推拭蟲膠法式拋光；磨光；鋅板手工研磨之黑色鏡面拋光 (Spéculaire)；擦亮
explains: To rub a surface until it becomes smooth or shiny is to clean and improve it. The word can also mean to improve a skill or make writing clearer. The sentence gives clues.
Dad rubbed the silver bowl with a soft cloth until it shone. He put it back on the shelf. The family used it for a celebration.
A rough surface may look dull. Rubbing can make it smooth and bright. A person can also refine a piece of work.

examples.en: The singer's popularity grew after the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會後，這位歌手的人氣上升了。

examples.en: The popularity of the new game surprised its makers.
examples.zh: 這款新遊戲的人氣讓製作者感到驚訝。

examples.en: Her popularity at school came from her kindness.
examples.zh: 她在學校受歡迎是因為她很友善。

explains: Being liked by many people or chosen often can make someone or something well known. A song may be played widely, or a person may have many friends. Preferences can change.
The new game became popular because it was easy to learn and fun to play together. Children brought it to school. More friends joined each day.
A private hobby may be known by only a few people. A widely liked activity attracts many. What people enjoy can change over time.

examples.en: She packed a portable charger for the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 她為長途公車行程帶了一個可攜式充電器。

examples.en: The portable radio works with batteries.
examples.zh: 這台攜帶式收音機使用電池。

examples.en: We bought a portable table for camping.
examples.zh: 我們買了一張露營用的可攜式桌子。

explains: Something small or light enough to carry from place to place is easy to move. A radio or lamp may be designed this way. The word describes how convenient it is to carry.
The family brought a small speaker to the picnic. They carried it in a bag and played music on the grass. It ran on batteries.
A large machine is difficult to move. A compact item can travel with someone. Size and weight matter.

examples.en: The actor portrayed a brave explorer in the play.
examples.zh: 演員在戲劇中飾演一位勇敢的探險家。

examples.en: The painting portrays a quiet village by the sea.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一座海邊寧靜的村莊。

examples.en: The book portrays the friendship between two children.
examples.zh: 這本書描寫兩個孩子之間的友誼。

explains: To show a person or idea in a picture, story, or performance is to represent it. An actor can play a character. An artist may show a scene in a painting.
The play showed a brave child helping a lost traveler. An actor spoke the child's lines and moved across the stage. The audience followed the story.
A photograph records a real moment. A painting may present a scene in a chosen way. Both can show people and ideas.

examples.en: The child possesses a remarkable talent for music.
examples.zh: 這個孩子擁有非凡的音樂天賦。

examples.en: They possess a small cabin near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們在湖邊有一間小木屋。

examples.en: She possesses the patience to teach young children.
examples.zh: 她有耐心教導年幼的孩子。

explains: To own something or have a quality means it belongs to someone or is part of them. A person can own a bicycle or have a useful skill. Context shows the meaning.
Nora had a red bicycle that she kept in the shed. She locked it after every ride. It belonged to her.
Borrowing an item means using it for a while before returning it. Owning it means it is yours. People can also have qualities like patience.

examples.en: The old camera was her most treasured possession.
examples.zh: 那台舊相機是她最珍愛的財物。

examples.en: Please keep your possessions together during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期間請把自己的物品放在一起。

examples.en: The team took possession of the ball after the other side missed.
examples.zh: 對方失誤後，隊伍取得了球權。

explains: An object that belongs to someone is something they own. A person may keep special items safe. The word can also describe the state of owning something.
After the game, Max found a water bottle and asked whose it was. His friend recognized it and took it home. It belonged to her.
A borrowed object must be returned. Something owned by a person is theirs. People should respect others' belongings.

examples.en: The postage for the large package was more than expected.
examples.zh: 這個大包裹的郵資比預期的多。

examples.en: Please add enough postage to the envelope.
examples.zh: 請在信封上貼足郵資。

examples.en: The seller included postage in the price of the book.
examples.zh: 賣家把郵資包含在書的價格裡。

explains: The fee paid to send a letter or package through the mail covers its delivery. The amount may depend on its size and destination. A stamp can show that it has been paid.
Mia weighed her parcel at the post office and paid the amount needed to send it overseas. She stuck stamps on the corner. The clerk placed it in a bag.
A message sent online may not need a stamp. A paper letter needs payment before it travels. The fee depends on where it goes.

examples.en: Dedicated daily practice unlocks the boundless hidden potential resting dormant within every human mind.
examples.zh: 堅持每日專注不懈的精進修練，能徹底喚醒並解鎖潛藏在每個人大腦深處沉睡的無限潛能。

examples.en: The experienced high school basketball coach recognized the young player’s extraordinary athletic potential.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的高中籃球總教練眼光獨到，一眼便看出了這位年輕高一新秀驚人的運動爆發潛力。

examples.en: Engineers evaluate the energy generation potential of geothermal vents along the volcanic mountain range.
examples.zh: 地質工程師深入勘測並精確評估大屯火山群周邊地熱噴氣孔開發深層地熱發電的巨大能源潛能。

examples.en: Situated on the Pacific Ring of Fire, Taiwan possesses immense untapped geothermal potential in its mountain valleys.
examples.zh: 坐落於環太平洋火山地震帶上的台灣，在各大山脈與平原地下蘊藏著數十吉瓦未開發的「豐沛地熱潛能」（Potential）。

examples.en: Mentors recognized the young engineer's extraordinary intellectual potential and recommended her for promotion.
examples.zh: 資深導師敏銳洞察到這位青年工程師出類拔萃的研發潛能，毫不猶豫向總經理推薦破格拔擢升遷。

examples.en: Solar panels installed on public buildings tap into the sunny island's huge photovoltaic potential.
examples.zh: 在全台公有建築屋頂全面鋪設太陽能板，充分善用這座陽光普照海島巨大的光電發電發展潛能。

entries.definition: 徹底解鎖大腦無限心智潛能；台灣大屯火山與宜蘭數十 GW 豐沛地熱潛能；潛力
explains: A person or thing may have a chance to grow, improve, or become something in the future. Practice can help turn ability into success. It does not guarantee a result.
The young player was quick and listened carefully to the coach. With more practice, she could become a strong teammate. She enjoyed learning.
A finished result has already happened. A possibility may happen later. Effort and circumstances can affect what comes next.

examples.en: Please give a precise time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 請提供會議的確切時間。

examples.en: The precise measurement showed that the table was one meter long.
examples.zh: 精確測量顯示桌子長一公尺。

examples.en: Her directions were precise and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她的指示明確而容易遵循。

explains: An exact detail gives a clear amount, place, or time without being vague. Measuring carefully can improve accuracy. Clear directions often use exact words.
The teacher told the class to meet at the north gate at 8:15. Everyone knew the place and time. No one had to guess.
A rough guess may be close but not exact. A careful measurement gives a clearer result. The amount of detail depends on the task.

examples.en: Meteorologists predict a sunny and pleasant weekend ahead.
examples.zh: 氣象學家預測即將迎來一個晴朗舒適的週末。

examples.en: It is nearly impossible to predict the exact moment an earthquake will occur.
examples.zh: 想要百分之百精準預測強烈地震究竟會在何年何月何秒爆發，幾乎是不可能的。

examples.en: Economists predict that artificial intelligence will create entirely new job categories.
examples.zh: 經濟學家樂觀預測，生成式人工智慧的興起將會催生出前所未見的全新就業類別。

explains: To say what may happen later is to make a guess based on clues. Weather reports use observations to do this. New facts can change the expectation.
Dark clouds gathered above the field, so the coach thought rain might start soon. The team moved practice indoors. The rain began a few minutes later.
A past event already happened. A future one is not known for sure. Clues can help someone make a careful guess.

examples.en: The weather prediction for tomorrow is scattered afternoon showers.
examples.zh: 明天的天氣預測為午後零星短暫陣雨。

examples.en: His confident prediction that our school basketball team would win turned out true.
examples.zh: 他先前信心滿滿預測我們學校籃球隊必能問鼎奪冠，事後證明果然成真。

examples.en: Climate modeling predictions help coastal communities build effective seawalls in advance.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷電腦模型預測數據，協助沿海城鎮居民得以及早構築堅固防浪海堤。

explains: A statement about what may happen later is based on clues or experience. It may be right or wrong. People can check the result afterward.
The weather report said the day would be sunny, so the family planned a picnic. Clouds arrived later, and they moved under a shelter. The guess was not exact.
A fact can be checked now. A future result is uncertain. Careful clues can make a guess more informed.

examples.en: She read a book about pregnancy and caring for a newborn.
examples.zh: 她讀了一本關於懷孕和照顧新生兒的書。

examples.en: The doctor answered questions about her pregnancy.
examples.zh: 醫生回答了關於她懷孕的問題。

examples.en: Her pregnancy was carefully monitored by the clinic.
examples.zh: 診所仔細照護並監測她的孕期狀況。

explains: The time when a baby grows inside a person's body before birth is a major part of human reproduction. A health professional can provide care and information. Families may prepare for a new child.
A family member visited a clinic for regular checkups while expecting a baby. The doctor answered questions and checked the baby's growth. Everyone looked forward to meeting the child.
After a baby is born, it needs care outside the body. Before birth, it grows inside. Doctors can help keep parent and baby healthy.

examples.en: The pregnant woman rested while her family prepared dinner.
examples.zh: 懷孕的婦女休息時，家人準備了晚餐。

examples.en: Her sister is pregnant and expects a baby in June.
examples.zh: 她的姊姊懷孕了，預計六月生寶寶。

examples.en: The pregnant cat looked for a quiet place to rest.
examples.zh: 懷孕的母貓尋找安靜的地方休息。

explains: A person carrying a baby inside their body before birth is expecting a child. They may visit a doctor for care. The family can prepare for the baby's arrival.
The expecting parent went to a checkup and listened to the baby's heartbeat. Their partner came along and asked questions. They felt excited about the future.
A newborn has already been born. Before birth, a baby grows inside the parent. Regular health care can support both.

examples.en: She delivered an impressive slide presentation.
examples.zh: 她進行了一場令人印象深刻的投影片簡報。

examples.en: I feel a bit nervous whenever I have to give a presentation.
examples.zh: 每當我必須做簡報時，我都感到有點緊張。

examples.en: The sales presentation convinced the client to invest.
examples.zh: 這場業務簡報說服了客戶進行投資。

examples.en: Her slide presentation on sustainable green tech impressed the audience.
examples.zh: 她關於綠色永續科技的投影片簡報給全場聽眾留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The student practiced her oral presentation five times in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 這位同學在鏡子前反覆認真模擬練習了整整五遍，為自己的口頭報告做足了準備。

examples.en: The CEO delivered a keynote product presentation that captured global media headlines.
examples.zh: 執行長在年度全球新品發表會上發表了主旨演說，強勢佔據了各大國際媒體頭版頭條。

examples.en: Delivering an engaging slide presentation persuaded venture capital investors to fund the startup.
examples.zh: 登台發表了一場邏輯嚴密、生動吸睛的商務簡報，成功打動創投評審並順利敲定千萬元天使投資。

examples.en: Rehearsing the product presentation several times ensures smooth transitions between different speakers.
examples.zh: 登台前與團隊夥伴反覆實地彩排新產品簡報，能確保不同講者在交替串場時流暢無縫。

examples.en: Clear data visualizations make technical engineering presentations easy for non-expert clients to digest.
examples.zh: 運用清晰直觀的數據圖表視覺化呈現，能讓生硬的技術工程簡報即便是非本科外行客戶也能秒懂。

examples.en: Dramatic presentation featuring chilled dry ice fog turns the seafood course into an ethereal seascape.
examples.zh: 伴隨乾冰白霧繚繞的「戲劇性擺盤藝術」（Presentation），將原本的海鮮料理化為一座如夢似幻的神秘海岸。

examples.en: The marketing director delivered an articulate multimedia presentation to the board of directors.
examples.zh: 行銷總監在董事會全體董事面前，條理分明地進行了一場圖文並茂的年度策略多媒體簡報。

examples.en: Clean and orderly presentation of retail merchandise significantly improves overall boutique sales.
examples.zh: 精品店商品陳列得井然有序且視覺典雅，能顯著提升進店貴賓的整體消費意願與銷售業績。

entries.definition: 簡報；發表會；呈現；陳述；商務簡報力；演說；煙霧繚繞如現代雕塑般之戲劇性餐點擺盤藝術
explains: A talk or display shares information with an audience. The speaker may use pictures, objects, or notes. Planning helps listeners understand the main points.
The students showed their solar system model to the class. Each person explained one planet and pointed to it. Their classmates asked questions.
A private note is read by one person. A talk is shared with a group. Both can present information in different ways.

examples.en: Vacuum packaging extends fresh food preservation without using chemicals.
examples.zh: 真空包裝技術能在不添加防腐劑的前提下有效延長生鮮食品保鮮期。

examples.en: The historical society works tirelessly for the preservation of Japanese-era wooden buildings.
examples.zh: 歷史文史工作協會不知疲倦地全力奔走，致力於守護日治時期珍貴木造建築的修復保存。

examples.en: Cryogenic freezers enable the long-term preservation of rare seed germplasms.
examples.zh: 超低溫冷凍科技實現了珍貴農作物原始種子與基因資源長達數百年的長久妥善保存。

examples.en: Environmental treaties prioritize the long-term preservation of untouched benthic wilderness zones.
examples.zh: 國際海洋公約將這片原始無污染海域的「生態完整性長期保存」（Preservation），列為最高優先事項。

examples.en: The national archives employ specialized conservationists dedicated to the preservation of fragile ancient scrolls.
examples.zh: 國家檔案管理局延攬專業文物修復大師，全心投入館藏脆弱泛黃古籍手卷的長久維護保存與修復。

examples.en: Pickling vegetables in vinegar and sea salt has been a traditional method of food preservation for centuries.
examples.zh: 將新鮮現摘蔬菜浸泡於醋汁與海鹽中醃漬熟成，是人類數百年來流傳至今的古老智慧食品保存法。

entries.definition: 保存；保鮮；維護；守護地球最後處女地之深海生態完整性保存
explains: Protecting something so it stays in good condition for a long time is important for nature, buildings, and food. Careful steps can prevent damage. People may work together to protect it.
The town repaired the old stone bridge instead of tearing it down. Workers cleaned the surface and fixed loose stones. Visitors could still cross safely.
Discarding an old item loses it. Careful protection can keep it for the future. Different things need different care.

examples.en: We preserve old photographs in a dry box.
examples.zh: 我們把舊照片保存在乾燥的盒子裡。

examples.en: The park works to preserve the forest for future visitors.
examples.zh: 公園致力於保護森林，留給未來的訪客。

examples.en: Salt can preserve food for a longer time.
examples.zh: 鹽可以讓食物保存更久。

explains: To keep something safe and in good condition can help it last. People may protect a forest or store food carefully. The method depends on what needs care.
The family put berries in a sealed jar and stored it in a cool place. They planned to use them during winter. The fruit stayed fresh longer.
Using something up changes or removes it. Protecting it keeps it available for later. Careful storage helps.

examples.en: Hand washing is an important part of infection prevention.
examples.zh: 洗手是預防感染的重要一環。

examples.en: The town planted trees for flood prevention.
examples.zh: 鎮上種樹以預防洪水。

examples.en: Prevention can help keep small problems from growing.
examples.zh: 預防有助於避免小問題擴大。

explains: Taking steps beforehand to stop a problem from happening is a way to protect people or things. Washing hands can reduce the spread of illness. Planning may lower risks.
The class wore helmets before riding scooters. Their teacher explained how the gear could protect them. They checked the straps first.
Repairing damage happens after a problem. Taking care beforehand can stop some trouble. Safety rules help people prepare.

examples.en: Prime editing functions like a search-and-replace word processor, enabling insertions and deletions.
examples.zh: 「先導編輯技術」（Prime Editing），如同文字處理軟體的搜尋與取代功能，能隨心所欲插入與置換任意基因。

examples.en: Downtown commercial storefronts occupy prime real estate locations with continuous foot traffic.
examples.zh: 位於市中心熱鬧商圈的臨街黃金店面佔據絕佳地段，終日享有源源不絕的往來逛街人潮。

examples.en: Painters prime unfinished drywall with sealer to ensure topcoat paint adheres smoothly and evenly.
examples.zh: 油漆師傅在毛坯石膏板牆面上均勻滾塗底漆封孔劑，確保面漆塗刷時能平整服貼不脫落。

entries.definition: 先導編輯技術 (如文書軟體搜尋取代任意基因字元)；主要
explains: The most important or best part can be called this. It may also describe an early stage or number with special math properties. Nearby words show the meaning.
The team saved its strongest player for the final round. She scored two points and helped them win. Her role was very important.
A minor detail matters less than the main one. A key part stands out. In math, the word has a separate meaning.

examples.en: The museum showed a primitive tool made from stone.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一件用石頭製成的原始工具。

examples.en: They used a primitive method to build the small shelter.
examples.zh: 他們用簡單原始的方法搭建小棚屋。

examples.en: The story describes a primitive village long ago.
examples.zh: 故事描述了很久以前的一座原始村落。

explains: Something from an early stage of human history may use simple tools and methods. The word can also describe a basic form. It should be used carefully because it may sound disrespectful.
The museum displayed an early stone tool used by people long ago. A guide explained how it might have helped cut food. Visitors looked closely.
A modern machine has many advanced parts. An early tool may be simple. People in the past had knowledge and skills too.

examples.en: Customer safety and satisfaction remain our top corporate priority.
examples.zh: 顧客的安全與滿意度始終是我們企業最首要的優先考量。

examples.en: Rescuing stranded residents took absolute priority following the mountain landslide.
examples.zh: 在高山土石流坍方事故發生後，緊急搜救受困居民具有壓倒一切的最高優先絕對級別。

examples.en: Make getting eight hours of sleep a non-negotiable priority in your daily lifestyle.
examples.zh: 將每晚睡足八小時的高品質睡眠，列為個人日常健康生活中絕不可輕易妥協的第一優先。

explains: Something that matters most should be handled before less important tasks. People may choose what to do first when time is short. A list can help organize work.
Before leaving for the trip, the family packed medicine and water first. They added toys after the important items. The bags were ready on time.
A small extra task can wait. A key need should come first. People may value different tasks most.

examples.en: Drone surveillance near residential windows is an unlawful invasion of privacy.
examples.zh: 在住宅私人窗戶旁進行無人機偷拍窺探屬於違法的嚴重侵犯個人隱私權行徑。

examples.en: Please draw the curtains to give our family complete privacy during dinner.
examples.zh: 請拉上窗簾，讓我們一家人在用餐時享有充分的私人隱私空間。

examples.en: Tech platforms face mounting scrutiny over how they handle user data privacy.
examples.zh: 科技平台在如何處理使用者數據隱私方面正面臨日益嚴厲的檢視。

examples.en: Strict hospital data encryption safeguards patient medical privacy and confidential diagnostic records.
examples.zh: 醫院資訊中心建置嚴密的醫療級資料加密防護，滴水不漏捍衛全體就醫病患的個人病歷隱私（Privacy）。

examples.en: Installing thick blackout curtains on street-facing windows ensures complete evening household privacy.
examples.zh: 在正對熱鬧街道的臥室窗戶上安裝遮光率百分之百的厚實隔音窗簾，為全家人營造出完全不被打擾的居家隱私。

examples.en: Consumer privacy regulations grant individuals the legal right to request complete deletion of their personal profiles.
examples.zh: 歐盟個人資料保護規則嚴格賦予所有公民神聖的法定權利，能依法要求任何網路平台徹底刪除其所有個人數位足跡。

entries.definition: 個人隱私；隱私權；病患個人隱私與電子病歷資安防護
explains: A person may want some personal space or information kept from others. Respecting this helps people feel safe. Asking before sharing a photo is thoughtful.
Before posting a group picture, Ava asked her friends if they were comfortable with it. One friend preferred not to be shown. Ava chose another photo.
A public announcement is meant for many people. Personal details may be private. Careful choices protect trust.

examples.en: Restrict root administrator privileges to prevent accidental system changes.
examples.zh: 嚴格限制 Root 最高管理者特權帳號的使用，以防系統設定遭受誤改。

examples.en: It is a great privilege to deliver the keynote speech at this global summit.
examples.zh: 能在本次全球高峰會上發表主題演講是一項極大的榮幸。

examples.en: Malware often attempts privilege escalation to gain control over the operating system.
examples.zh: 惡意軟體通常會企圖進行權限提升，以取得對作業系統的全面控制權。

entries.definition: 特權；系統最高權限；榮幸
explains: A special right or opportunity may be given to someone. It can also mean being lucky to have something valuable. People should use such chances responsibly.
The class captain had the chance to choose the first book for reading time. She asked her classmates what they liked. Everyone enjoyed the choice.
A basic need belongs to everyone. A special opportunity may be available only to some. People can share chances when possible.

examples.en: Follow the procedure to wash your hands correctly.
examples.zh: 請依照步驟正確洗手。

examples.en: The doctor explained the procedure before the checkup.
examples.zh: 檢查前，醫生說明了流程。

examples.en: Our class practiced the fire drill procedure.
examples.zh: 我們班練習了消防演習的程序。

explains: A set of steps explains how to do a task in the right order. Following them can help keep work safe and organized. Instructions may include tools and checks.
Before the experiment, students put on glasses and gathered the cups. They followed each step on the sheet. Their teacher watched carefully.
A single action is only one step. A complete method may have many actions in order. Reading instructions helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: After the bell, students may proceed to the gym.
examples.zh: 鐘響後，學生可以前往體育館。

examples.en: Please proceed with the next step in the recipe.
examples.zh: 請繼續食譜中的下一個步驟。

examples.en: The hikers proceeded carefully along the rocky path.
examples.zh: 健行者沿著多石的小路小心前進。

explains: To continue with the next step is to move forward with an activity. A person may wait until it is safe to begin. Instructions show what comes next.
The hikers waited until the rain slowed before continuing along the trail. They checked their map and walked together. The path became clearer.
Stopping pauses an activity. Continuing means moving on. A signal can tell people when to begin again.

examples.en: The group had a productive meeting and finished its plan.
examples.zh: 小組開了一場有效率的會議，並完成了計畫。

examples.en: She had a productive morning of reading and writing.
examples.zh: 她度過了一個讀寫充實的早晨。

examples.en: The productive garden provided vegetables for the family.
examples.zh: 這座豐收的花園為家庭提供蔬菜。

explains: A person or activity that gets useful work done makes good progress. A focused plan can help people use time well. Breaks can support steady effort.
The class spent the morning sorting books and labeling shelves. By lunch, every book had a place. They felt proud of their work.
A busy day is not always useful if little gets finished. A focused one can complete important tasks. Planning helps people choose what matters.

examples.en: Teaching is a highly respected profession in society.
examples.zh: 教書在社會上是一項備受尊重的專門職業。

examples.en: Doctors and nurses belong to the honorable healthcare medical profession.
examples.zh: 醫師與護理師皆隸屬於崇高神聖的醫療衛生專業從業人員。

examples.en: He is an architect by profession, designing modern sustainable buildings.
examples.zh: 他本職是一名建築師，致力於設計現代綠色永續綠建築。

examples.en: Teaching is a highly respected profession in society.
examples.zh: 教書在社會上是一項深受尊重的崇高專門職業。

examples.en: Entering the medical profession demands years of rigorous study and clinical training.
examples.zh: 投身神聖的醫療專門領域，需要歷經數年刻苦專注的專業修習與臨床養成訓練。

examples.en: Certified public accountants uphold the highest standards of ethics in their profession.
examples.zh: 國家執業會計師在各自的專業執業範疇中，始終恪守最嚴格的最高道德倫理準則。

entries.definition: 專業；專門職業；專門職業（如醫事、法律）
explains: A type of work that needs special training or knowledge can be someone's career. Doctors, teachers, and engineers are examples. People may study before entering one.
After years of school, Maya began working as a veterinarian. She used her training to care for animals. She enjoyed helping pets feel better.
A hobby is done for fun. A trained job is done as a career. People can choose different paths.

examples.en: The professional photographer took pictures at the wedding.
examples.zh: 專業攝影師在婚禮上拍照。

examples.en: She handled the disagreement in a professional way.
examples.zh: 她以專業的方式處理了這場爭執。

examples.en: He became a professional soccer player after college.
examples.zh: 大學畢業後，他成為職業足球員。

explains: A person with a trained job may be paid for skilled work. The word can also describe behavior that is respectful and responsible. Context shows which meaning is used.
The repair worker arrived on time, listened to the problem, and explained the cost clearly. The family trusted his work. He fixed the heater.
A beginner may still be learning a skill. An experienced worker may earn money from it. People should act respectfully in many settings.

examples.en: The farmers had a profitable season after a good harvest.
examples.zh: 收成良好後，農夫們度過了獲利的季節。

examples.en: Selling the handmade bags became profitable for the club.
examples.zh: 販售手作包包讓社團開始獲利。

examples.en: The shop hopes its new product will be profitable.
examples.zh: 商店希望新產品能帶來利潤。

explains: A business or activity that earns more money than it spends brings in a gain. Careful planning can help, but success is not certain. Costs should be counted.
The bakery sold enough bread to pay for flour, rent, and worker wages, with money left over. The owner saved some for new ovens. The shop did well.
A loss happens when costs are greater than earnings. A gain means more comes in than goes out. Records help show the difference.

examples.en: A prominent clock stood above the station entrance.
examples.zh: 車站入口上方有一座醒目的時鐘。

examples.en: She played a prominent role in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在校園戲劇中扮演重要角色。

examples.en: The prominent mountain could be seen from the village.
examples.zh: 從村子裡可以看見那座醒目的山。

explains: Something easy to notice because it stands out is clearly visible or important. A tall building may be seen from far away. The context helps show the use.
A bright red sign stood above the entrance to the market. People could spot it from the bus stop. It helped visitors find the door.
A hidden detail is hard to see. A noticeable feature catches the eye. A person may also be well known in a community.

examples.en: The promising young player scored twice in her first game.
examples.zh: 這位前途看好的年輕選手在首場比賽中進了兩球。

examples.en: The weather forecast gave a promising sign for our picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣預報對我們的野餐傳來好消息。

examples.en: His promising idea could help the class save paper.
examples.zh: 他有希望的點子可能幫助全班節省紙張。

explains: Something likely to succeed or improve may give people hope. A young learner can show signs of skill. More practice is still needed.
The new garden had healthy seedlings and plenty of sunlight. The children expected the plants to grow well. They kept watering them.
A poor sign may cause worry. A hopeful sign suggests things may go well. No result is certain until it happens.

examples.en: His dedication earned him a well-deserved promotion to senior manager.
examples.zh: 他的敬業專注為他贏得了實至名歸的資深經理晉升。

examples.en: Outstanding sales performance opened the door to rapid career promotions.
examples.zh: 拔尖過人的卓越銷售業績，為她在公司內部開啟了連連快速升遷的璀璨職涯大道。

examples.en: The cosmetic brand launched a limited-time buy-one-get-one promotion for Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 這家知名美妝保養品牌在母親節檔期祭出了震撼業界的限時買一送一促銷特惠活動。

examples.en: Exceptional sales performance earned her a well-deserved promotion to Regional Sales Director.
examples.zh: 憑藉一整年亮眼傲人的海外拓銷戰績，她實至名歸獲得公司拔擢晉升為大中華區業務總監。

examples.en: Retail stores launched a nationwide holiday discount promotion to attract weekend shoppers.
examples.zh: 連鎖大賣場在全台各實體門市同步推出強檔週年慶促銷特惠，吸引大批週末採購人潮排隊搶購。

examples.en: Taking initiative on difficult cross-departmental projects accelerates your readiness for promotion.
examples.zh: 主動請纓承擔繁複艱鉅的跨部門旗艦專案，是展現領導才幹並爭取職位晉升拔擢的最強捷徑。

entries.definition: 升遷；晉升；促銷推廣；升遷拔擢；職位晉升；促銷
explains: A worker may receive a higher job with more responsibility. The word can also mean advertising something to attract attention or sell it. Context tells the meaning.
After doing careful work for many years, Ana became the manager of the store. She now helped plan schedules and train new workers. Her team congratulated her.
A new employee may start with fewer duties. A higher position may bring more tasks. A shop may also use signs to advertise a sale.

examples.en: Mastering prompt engineering techniques helps professionals extract precise, structured answers from AI chatbots.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握提示詞工程（Prompt Engineering）技巧，能幫助專業工作者引導 AI 產出精準結構化的專業分析。

examples.en: A sudden spike in international oil prices prompted the airline to introduce fuel surcharges.
examples.zh: 國際原油期貨價格的瞬間暴漲，促使各大國際航空公司第一時間宣布加徵長程客運燃油附加費。

examples.en: The prompter whispered the actor's forgotten line from beneath the wooden floorboards just in time.
examples.zh: 躲在舞台台口提詞小隔間裡的提詞員，在男主角忘詞的驚險瞬間及時輕聲耳語提示了下一句台詞。

explains: This can describe something done quickly, without a long wait. A shop may send an answer on the same day. The customer gets help right away.
A small hint can help someone remember what to say. An actor may forget a line during practice. A helper quietly gives the first few words.
A question or short instruction can give you an idea for writing. A teacher might ask you to describe a secret garden. That starting point helps you begin a story.

examples.en: Listen to the pronunciation of this new word.
examples.zh: 聽聽這個新單字的發音。

examples.en: Our teacher helped us with the pronunciation of difficult names.
examples.zh: 老師幫助我們練習難念的人名發音。

examples.en: The dictionary gives the pronunciation beside each word.
examples.zh: 字典在每個單字旁標示發音。

explains: This means the way a word sounds when someone says it. The sounds must come in the right order. Some parts may be spoken more strongly than others.
Two words may look similar but sound different. Listening to a speaker can help you learn the difference. You can then practice saying each one aloud.
People from different places may say the same word in different ways. Their voices may make different vowel sounds. More than one way can be correct.

examples.en: The class liked her proposal for a reading corner.
examples.zh: 全班都喜歡她設置閱讀角的提案。

examples.en: He wrote a proposal for a new school club.
examples.zh: 他為新的學校社團寫了一份提案。

examples.en: She accepted his marriage proposal.
examples.zh: 她答應了他的求婚。

explains: This is a plan or idea offered for others to consider. It explains what someone wants to do. Other people can accept it or suggest changes.
A class wants to build a small garden. The children write down where it could go and what they would grow. They show the plan to their teacher.
The same noun can mean asking someone to marry you. One person asks whether the other wants to share a married life. The other person can choose how to answer.

examples.en: The little bakery began to prosper after it moved near the station.
examples.zh: 小麵包店搬到車站附近後，生意開始興隆。

examples.en: The town prospered as more visitors came to its market.
examples.zh: 隨著更多遊客造訪市集，這座城鎮繁榮起來。

examples.en: She hoped her new business would prosper.
examples.zh: 她希望自己的新事業能蓬勃發展。

explains: This means to do well and become more successful. A small shop may gain many customers over time. Its owners may earn enough to improve the business.
A village can do better when people find useful work. Families may have more money for food and homes. Good roads can help them sell what they make.
A person can grow and do well in a helpful setting. A new job may give someone a chance to learn. Support from others can help that person succeed.

examples.en: Decoupling economic growth from greenhouse emissions unlocks long-term clean prosperity for future generations.
examples.zh: 將經濟實質成長與溫室氣體排放徹底脫鉤，能為我們的下一代解鎖兼顧生態保育與財富積累的乾淨繁榮（Prosperity）。

examples.en: Decades of peace, innovation, and open trade brought unprecedented economic prosperity to the island.
examples.zh: 數十年來長治久安的和平環境、源源不絕的技術創新與高度自由的對外貿易，為這座美麗之島帶來了空前的經濟繁榮富庶。

examples.en: Traditional New Year greetings wish family and friends health, happiness, and abundant financial prosperity.
examples.zh: 農曆春節期間向親朋好友登門拜年時，彼此互道恭喜發財，誠摯祝福對方在新的一年身體康健、平安喜樂與事業大發繁榮。

examples.en: A thriving blue economy generates sustainable coastal prosperity while regenerating damaged ocean habitats.
examples.zh: 蓬勃發展的海洋藍色經濟，在修復受損海洋生態棲地的同時，為濱海漁村注入源源不絕的永續綠色繁榮。

examples.en: Peace, economic stability, and educational opportunities are essential pillars for long-term national prosperity.
examples.zh: 和平安定、經濟穩健發展以及普及平等的教育機會，是國家長治久安與長遠繁榮的基石。

examples.en: The bustling night market brings lively economic prosperity to small food vendors and artisans alike.
examples.zh: 熱鬧喧囂的觀光夜市為廣大小吃攤商與在地手工藝創作者帶來了蓬勃的生機與商業繁榮。

examples.en: Young farmers returning to rural hometowns spark vibrant economic revitalization and green community prosperity.
examples.zh: 青年返鄉投身友善精緻農業與地方創生，為傳統農村部落注入滿滿活力與永續共好的綠色繁榮。

examples.en: Investment in world-class digital infrastructure and public education laid the foundation for national prosperity.
examples.zh: 早期政府果斷投入重金興建世界級數位基礎設施與推動全民普及義務教育，奠定了國家長治久安的繁榮基石。

examples.en: The bustling morning market is full of smiling fruit vendors, reflecting widespread neighborhood prosperity.
examples.zh: 清晨人潮熙攘的傳統早市隨處可見笑容滿面的熱情蔬果小販，生動折射出社區民間安居樂業的富庶欣欣向榮。

examples.en: Free, unimpeded oceanic commerce generates shared prosperity and raises living standards worldwide.
examples.zh: 自由通暢的全球海上航運與國際貿易，促進了全球實體經濟的共同繁榮並提升了各國人民的生活水準。

examples.en: The bustling container terminal fueled decades of industrial boom and regional economic prosperity.
examples.zh: 繁忙蓬勃運轉的國際貨櫃碼頭，點燃了沿海城市數十年間的工業騰飛與區域經濟繁榮。

examples.en: Efficient port cities attract international investment, generating good jobs and communal prosperity.
examples.zh: 營運高效的國際自由貿易港市能吸引源源不絕的跨國資本投資，為在地鄉親創造優渥就業與富足繁榮。

examples.en: Embracing clean green technology fosters high-wage engineering jobs and long-term economic prosperity.
examples.zh: 擁抱潔淨綠能科技與循環經濟，帶動了高薪綠能工程聚落的崛起與國家經濟長遠的繁榮富強。

examples.en: Fishing towns transformed into bustling maritime logistics harbors, experiencing unprecedented economic prosperity.
examples.zh: 昔日沒落純樸的小漁港蛻變為國際級海事重裝物流運維母港，迎來了前所未有的地方經濟大繁榮。

examples.en: The green energy transition proves that environmental protection and national industrial prosperity can go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 這場綠能大轉型向世界雄辯證實，大自然環境保護與國家先進工業的永續繁榮完全可以並駕齊驅、相得益彰。

entries.definition: 兼顧生態與經濟的永續繁榮；兼顧保育之永續海洋藍色繁榮；青年返鄉生機盎然之農村永續繁榮；帶動全球實體經濟與人民生活繁榮富足；帶動高科技綠能產業永續繁榮富強
explains: This is a state of doing well, often with enough money and useful work. Businesses may be busy and growing. Many families may find it easier to meet their needs.
A town opens a busy market where farmers sell their food. Shops gain customers and offer more jobs. These changes can bring greater wealth to the area.
A place may have more wealth without everyone sharing it equally. Some families may still need help. The overall success of an area does not tell every person’s story.

examples.en: The prosperous town had busy shops and well-kept parks.
examples.zh: 這座富裕的城鎮有熱鬧的商店和維護良好的公園。

examples.en: Her grandparents built a prosperous business.
examples.zh: 她的祖父母建立了一家興隆的企業。

examples.en: The village became prosperous through its fruit trade.
examples.zh: 這座村莊因水果貿易而富裕起來。

explains: This describes a person or place doing well, often with plenty of money. A busy shop can earn a good income. Its owners may be able to expand it.
A town has many successful businesses and plenty of jobs. People can sell their goods and support their families. The town is doing well financially.
A family with a strong income may have a comfortable home. They can usually pay for the things they need. This describes their success with money.

examples.en: Drinking a whey protein shake within an hour aids rapid muscle repair.
examples.zh: 運動訓練後一小時內飲用一杯高純度乳清蛋白飲，有助於受損肌纖維迅速修復生長。

examples.en: Eggs, chicken breasts, and tofu are excellent dietary sources of complete protein.
examples.zh: 水煮蛋、去皮雞胸肉與優質嫩豆腐皆是日常飲食中極為出色的完全蛋白質來源。

examples.en: Athletes aiming for hypertrophy consume 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight.
examples.zh: 致力於肌肥大增肌的運動員通常每天攝取每公斤體重 1.6 到 2.2 克的充足蛋白質。

explains: This is a substance in food that the body needs to grow and repair itself. Beans, eggs, and fish contain it. It helps build muscles and many other body parts.
Food gives the body different kinds of useful substances. One kind provides building materials for cells. Both plant foods and animal foods can supply it.
