The body uses this substance for more than muscles. It also makes many tiny parts that help the body work. Eating different kinds of food provides a range of useful materials.

examples.en: The children protested when the club canceled their trip.
examples.zh: 社團取消旅行時，孩子們提出抗議。

examples.en: Neighbors held a peaceful protest to save the park.
examples.zh: 鄰居們舉行和平抗議，呼籲保留公園。

examples.en: She wrote a letter to protest the unfair rule.
examples.zh: 她寫信抗議這項不公平的規定。

explains: This means to show that you strongly disagree with something. You might speak, write, or hold up a sign. The aim is to make your objection heard.
Neighbors hear that their local park may close. They gather with signs asking for it to stay open. They want the people making the decision to listen.
The noun names an action or statement showing disagreement. It can come from one person or a large group. People may use it to ask for change.

examples.en: The story explores the psychological effects of being alone.
examples.zh: 這個故事探討獨處對心理的影響。

examples.en: The game tests memory and other psychological skills.
examples.zh: 這個遊戲測試記憶力和其他心理能力。

examples.en: The team studied the psychological reasons behind the choice.
examples.zh: 團隊研究了這個選擇背後的心理原因。

explains: This describes things related to the mind and feelings. It can concern how people think or react. It often focuses on what happens inside a person’s mind.
Two children face the same difficult puzzle. One feels excited while the other feels worried. A study of these reactions looks at mental and emotional differences.
A problem can affect someone’s thoughts even when there is no visible injury. A frightening event may leave a person feeling afraid. This word can describe that kind of effect.

examples.en: Clinical psychologists conduct tests to assess cognitive development.
examples.zh: 臨床心理師透過各項心理測驗來評估個案的認知發展狀況。

examples.en: Educational psychologists study how classroom environments influence student motivation.
examples.zh: 教育心理學家深入探討教室學習環境如何影響學生的學習動機。

examples.en: The forensic psychologist testified about the defendant's mental state in court.
examples.zh: 司法心理學家出庭就被告當時的精神心智狀態作證說明。

explains: This is someone trained to study the mind and behavior. The person learns how people think, feel, and act. Some do research while others help people with difficulties.
A researcher asks people to remember a list of pictures. The answers help show how memory works. Studying results like these can be part of this job.
Some people in this job meet with children or adults who need support. They listen and help people understand thoughts and feelings. Their work can take place in schools, clinics, or other settings.

examples.en: She studies psychology at university.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀心理學。

examples.en: Our psychology class discussed how memory works.
examples.zh: 我們的心理學課討論了記憶如何運作。

examples.en: He borrowed a book about the psychology of learning.
examples.zh: 他借了一本關於學習心理學的書。

explains: This is the study of the mind and behavior. It asks how people learn, remember, and feel. It also looks at why people act in certain ways.
A student may study how babies learn to notice faces. Another may ask why people forget names. Both questions concern the way the mind works.
Researchers in this field collect information carefully. They may ask questions, watch behavior, or run simple tasks. They compare results to learn about patterns in thought and action.

examples.en: The professor has over fifty scholarly publications in international journals.
examples.zh: 該教授在各大國際權威期刊上發表了五十餘篇學術研究論著。

examples.en: The date of the book's official publication was pushed back by two months.
examples.zh: 這本備受矚目的新書正式公開出版發行的日期被往後推遲了兩個月。

examples.en: Scientific publications require accurate documentation of all experimental data sources.
examples.zh: 科學研究發表成果要求必須對所有實驗數據的來源與出處進行精確記載。

entries.definition: 出版物；發表作品；學術發表
explains: This can mean making written work available for people to read. A book may go through editing and printing first. Readers can then buy or borrow it.
The noun can also name a printed or online work. A magazine with stories and pictures is one example. A newspaper is another.
A writer finishes an article and sends it to a magazine. An editor checks it before readers see it. The date when it becomes available is an important part of the process.

examples.en: The school fair received publicity in the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 學校園遊會獲得當地報紙的宣傳報導。

examples.en: The new book gained publicity after the writer visited our town.
examples.zh: 作家到訪我們鎮上後，新書獲得了關注。

examples.en: The team made posters to get publicity for the concert.
examples.zh: 團隊製作海報來宣傳音樂會。

explains: This means attention given to someone or something in public. News stories can bring this kind of attention. It can make many people hear about an event.
A small theater wants people to know about a new play. It shares posters and talks to a local newspaper. More people learn when the show will happen.
Public attention can be helpful or harmful. A kind act may lead to praise in the news. A serious mistake may also draw a lot of notice.

examples.en: The newspaper will publish her story on Friday.
examples.zh: 報紙將在星期五刊登她的故事。

examples.en: Our class published a book of poems.
examples.zh: 我們班出版了一本詩集。

examples.en: The museum publishes short articles on its website.
examples.zh: 博物館在網站上發表短篇文章。

explains: This means to make writing available for other people to read. It can appear in a book, newspaper, or online. The work may reach many readers.
A class collects poems and drawings into a small book. Copies are printed for families to read. The children’s work is now available beyond the classroom.
A website can share a new article with its readers. The writer may check the facts and spelling first. Then the article is put where others can see it.

examples.en: The publisher chose a bright cover for the picture book.
examples.zh: 出版商為這本圖畫書選了鮮豔的封面。

examples.en: She sent her story to a small publisher.
examples.zh: 她把故事寄給一家小型出版社。

examples.en: The publisher will print more copies next month.
examples.zh: 出版社下個月將加印更多本。

explains: This is a person or company that makes books or other writing available to readers. The work may be printed or digital. The business often works with writers and editors.
A writer sends a finished story to a book company. The company may help edit it and design a cover. It then arranges for copies to reach readers.
A company in this role may choose which books it wants to produce. It also helps people learn about those books. Some focus on stories while others make school materials.

examples.en: The dog pursued the rolling ball across the lawn.
examples.zh: 狗追著滾動的球跑過草坪。

examples.en: She moved to the city to pursue her dream of singing.
examples.zh: 她搬到城市追求唱歌的夢想。

examples.en: He wants to pursue his interest in science.
examples.zh: 他想繼續鑽研自己感興趣的科學。

explains: This means to follow someone or something, often while trying to catch it. A dog may run after a ball. A runner may follow another runner closely.
It can also mean working toward something you want. A child who loves music may spend years learning an instrument. The child continues toward a chosen goal.
People can continue an activity because it matters to them. Someone may study painting in free time. This verb can describe following that interest over time.

examples.en: The dog ran in pursuit of the ball.
examples.zh: 狗跑去追球。

examples.en: Her pursuit of knowledge led her to read many books.
examples.zh: 她對知識的追求促使她讀了許多書。

examples.en: Birdwatching is a peaceful pursuit.
examples.zh: 賞鳥是一項寧靜的休閒活動。

explains: This noun can mean the act of following someone to catch them. A chase through a field is one example. One person moves after another.
It can also mean the effort to reach a goal. A student may work hard to learn a new language. That long effort can be described with this noun.
An activity that someone enjoys can have this name too. Reading and gardening are possible examples. People may spend their free time on these interests.

examples.en: The brothers had a quarrel over the last cookie.
examples.zh: 兄弟倆為了最後一塊餅乾吵了起來。

examples.en: Please do not quarrel about who goes first.
examples.zh: 請不要為了誰先開始而爭吵。

examples.en: They ended their quarrel and started talking calmly.
examples.zh: 他們停止爭吵，開始平靜地交談。

explains: This is an angry disagreement between people. They may raise their voices or say unkind things. It often begins when they want different things.
Two children both want the same toy. They start arguing about whose turn comes first. Their disagreement becomes loud and upset.
The verb means to take part in this kind of argument. People might disagree about a plan or a broken promise. A calm talk can help them understand each other.

examples.en: Grandma sewed a quilt from colorful pieces of cloth.
examples.zh: 奶奶用彩色布片縫了一床拼布被。

examples.en: We spread the quilt across the bed.
examples.zh: 我們把被子鋪在床上。

examples.en: The blue quilt kept me warm all night.
examples.zh: 那床藍色被子讓我整晚都很暖和。

explains: This is a warm bed cover made from layers of cloth. Soft filling is held between the layers. Stitches keep the parts together.
Small pieces of colorful fabric can form the top of this cover. Someone sews the pieces into a pattern. The finished cover can be both useful and beautiful.
A family may save old pieces of fabric to make one. Each piece can remind them of a person or event. The warm cover may hold many memories.

examples.en: Please send an official price quotation for two thousand wireless headphones.
examples.zh: 請針對兩千副無線耳機提供一份正式的商業價格報價單。

examples.en: The sales executive prepared a comprehensive quotation detailing insurance, freight, and tax costs.
examples.zh: 業務經理準備了一份鉅細靡遺的完整報價單，清楚詳列了海運保險費、運費與各項關稅。

examples.en: Every formal project proposal should be accompanied by a competitive and itemized price quotation.
examples.zh: 每份正式的工程專案投標企劃書，都應當檢附一份具市場競爭力且分項清晰的正式價格報價單。

explains: This is a set of words taken exactly from another person’s speech or writing. The original wording stays the same. A writer should show where the words came from.
A student copies one sentence from a story into a report. Special marks show that the words belong to the story’s writer. The student adds the writer’s name.
The noun can also mean a stated price for doing a job. A worker may tell you how much a repair will cost. You can consider that price before choosing the work.

examples.en: Millimeter-wave radar detects distant approaching obstacles during rainstorms.
examples.zh: 毫米波雷達能在暴風雨濃霧等惡劣天候下精準探測遠方逼近的障礙物。

examples.en: Maritime navigation radar alerts ship captains to nearby fishing trawlers in dense sea fog.
examples.zh: 航海船舶專用導航雷達能在茫茫濃霧中第一時間向船長發出預警，精確提示周遭靠近的小型近海拖網漁船。

examples.en: The brilliant new indie video game flew under the radar until a famous gaming streamer recommended it.
examples.zh: 這款極具創意的獨立電玩小作起初完全未引起各界關注（低調不為人知），直到一位頂級遊戲實況主熱情推薦才一夕爆紅。

examples.en: Millimeter-wave radar penetrates heavy fog and torrential typhoons where cameras struggle.
examples.zh: 毫米波雷達具備強大的環境穿透力，即使在視線極差的濃霧與傾盆暴雨中依然能精準測距。

examples.en: Airport air traffic controllers watch green blips on the primary radar screen to guide approaching flights.
examples.zh: 國際機場塔台航管人員密切注視著主要雷達螢幕上的綠色光點信號，精確導引每一架進場降落班機。

examples.en: The promising young tech startup flew under the radar until it secured fifty million dollars in Series A funding.
examples.zh: 這家極具潛力的台灣年輕科技新創起初低調不起眼，直到完成五千萬美元 A 輪融資才一舉轟動業界。

entries.definition: 雷達；雷達偵測系統；毫米波雷達；雷達偵測
explains: This system uses radio waves to find objects and judge their distance. It sends out a signal and receives waves that bounce back. The returning signal provides information about what is nearby.
At an airport, workers need to know where planes are moving. A screen can show the position of aircraft. Signals sent through the air help provide that information.
This system can also help track rain and storms. Signals bounce back from drops of water. Weather workers use the information to see where rain is falling.

examples.en: The king shook with rage when he saw the empty treasure chest.
examples.zh: 國王看到空空的寶箱時，氣得發抖。

examples.en: The storm raged through the night.
examples.zh: 暴風雨肆虐了一整夜。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to calm her rage.
examples.zh: 她深呼吸，平息自己的怒氣。

explains: This means very strong anger. A person may feel unable to speak calmly. The feeling is much stronger than mild annoyance.
In a story, a king hears that someone has stolen his treasure. He shouts and stamps his feet. His actions show great anger.
As a verb, this can mean continuing with great force. A storm may strike an area for hours. A fire can also burn fiercely in this way.

examples.en: The island has heavy rainfall in summer.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼夏季雨量充沛。

examples.en: We measured the rainfall with a container in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們用花園裡的容器測量降雨量。

examples.en: Low rainfall left the fields dry this month.
examples.zh: 這個月降雨量少，田地變得乾燥。

explains: This is the amount of rain that falls in a place during a period of time. It can be measured with a special container. The result helps describe how wet a place has been.
Two towns may have very different amounts of rain in one month. One may have dry fields while the other has full ponds. Measurements help people compare them.
Farmers need to know how much water reaches their fields. Too little rain can leave plants dry. Very heavy rain can cover the ground with water.

examples.en: She added raisins to the bowl of cereal.
examples.zh: 她在那碗穀片裡加入葡萄乾。

examples.en: One raisin fell from the cookie onto the plate.
examples.zh: 一顆葡萄乾從餅乾上掉到盤子裡。

examples.en: The bread was filled with sweet raisins.
examples.zh: 麵包裡有滿滿的甜葡萄乾。

explains: This is a grape that has been dried. It becomes smaller and wrinkled as water leaves it. The taste is usually sweet.
A baker may add this small dried fruit to bread or cookies. It gives each bite little spots of sweetness. It can also be mixed into cereal.
These dried fruits may be brown, dark purple, or golden. They keep the shape of small soft lumps. Their color depends partly on how they are made.

examples.en: The painting was so realistic that the apple looked real.
examples.zh: 這幅畫非常逼真，蘋果看起來就像真的。

examples.en: We need a realistic plan for finishing the project.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個切實可行的計畫來完成專題。

examples.en: She set a realistic goal of reading one chapter a day.
examples.zh: 她訂下每天讀一章的可行目標。

explains: This describes something that seems close to real life. A drawing may show small details accurately. A story may describe events that could really happen.
A plan can also be sensible about what is possible. Building a huge castle in one afternoon is unlikely. Making a small model is a more practical goal.
A person with this view considers limits as well as hopes. The person thinks about available time and tools. That helps turn an idea into a workable plan.

examples.en: The rebel refused to obey the cruel king.
examples.zh: 那名反抗者拒絕服從殘暴的國王。

examples.en: The villagers rebelled against the ruler.
examples.zh: 村民起來反抗統治者。

examples.en: The story follows a young rebel who wants to change her town.
examples.zh: 這個故事描寫一名想改變家鄉的年輕反抗者。

explains: This is someone who fights against the people in charge. The person wants to resist their control. A group of such people may try to change who holds power.
A story may show villagers refusing to obey a cruel ruler. They join together and fight back. The noun can name someone in that group.
The verb means to resist authority or refuse to follow rules. A teenager may object strongly to family rules. The action can be peaceful or involve fighting.

examples.en: I can vividly recall our first English lesson together.
examples.zh: 我能清晰回想起我們一起上的第一堂英文課。

examples.en: As I recall, the neighborhood convenience store closes at midnight on weekdays.
examples.zh: 就我的記憶所及，街角那家巷弄超商在平日工作天通常是於午夜十二點打烊。

examples.en: The automobile company issued a voluntary safety recall for five thousand vehicles.
examples.zh: 這家知名汽車大廠主動針對存在潛在安全隱患的五千輛新車發布了自主召回令。

examples.en: Active recall testing strengthens neural memory pathways far more effectively than passive rereading.
examples.zh: 透過主動蓋住答案進行「主動回想提取」（Active Recall）自我測驗，比反覆被動看書記憶深固十倍。

examples.en: Closing your textbook and writing down core concepts from memory is a prime example of active recall.
examples.zh: 合上厚重的教科書，在一張白紙上全憑大腦回想並親手畫出核心架構心智圖，正是主動回想的經典示範。

examples.en: Practicing free recall before bedtime consolidates complex technical frameworks deep within your memory.
examples.zh: 每晚就寢前在腦海中安靜回想檢視今天所學的新單字與專有名詞，能藉由睡眠黃金期深層鞏固長期記憶。

entries.definition: 回想；召回；憶起；主動回想提取記憶
explains: This means to bring something back into your memory. You may try to remember a person’s name. A photograph can help you remember a past event.
A company may ask people to return a product with a serious fault. It might repair the item or replace it. This action can also have this name.
A person can be called back to a place or job. A team member away on a trip may be asked to return early. The verb can describe that request to come back.

examples.en: Inquire at the front desk reception for local sightseeing maps.
examples.zh: 可向櫃檯接待處詢問以索取當地觀光導覽地圖。

examples.en: The wedding reception was held in a magnificent hotel grand ballroom.
examples.zh: 婚禮婚宴在飯店宏偉的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

examples.en: Mobile phone signal reception is poor inside deep underground tunnels.
examples.zh: 在深邃的地下隧道內，手機訊號接收狀況很差。

explains: This can mean the way someone is welcomed. Guests may receive smiles and kind words when they arrive. That gives them a warm welcome.
The noun can also name a party held to welcome or celebrate someone. Guests may talk and share food. Such an event often follows a wedding.
At a hotel, this can name the front desk where guests get help. The staff may give out room keys and answer questions. Visitors often go there when they first arrive.

examples.en: Grandma shared her secret braised pork recipe with me.
examples.zh: 奶奶跟我分享了她私房滷肉的秘製食譜。

examples.en: Follow the online recipe step-by-step to bake fresh sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 依照線上食譜的步驟一步步烘烤新鮮酸種麵包。

examples.en: Driving while exhausted is a sure recipe for a serious traffic accident.
examples.zh: 疲勞駕駛無疑是引發重大車禍事故的危險因子。

explains: This is a set of instructions for making a food or drink. It lists what you need and how much to use. The steps tell you what to do in order.
A child wants to bake a cake with a parent. They check the amounts of flour, sugar, and eggs. Then they follow the steps for mixing and baking.
A good set of cooking instructions can include time and heat settings. It may also say how many people the food will serve. These details help a cook plan the meal.

examples.en: Automated license plate recognition allows ticketless entry into parking garages.
examples.zh: 自動化車牌辨識系統（LPR）讓車主享受免抽停車票卡、自動進出停車場的便利。

examples.en: The young researcher received international recognition for her breakthrough discovery in quantum computing.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的女科學家憑藉其在量子運算領域所取得的原創突破性科研成果，贏得了全球科學界的高度推崇與認可。

examples.en: Voice recognition software converts spoken lectures into written lecture notes with impressive accuracy.
examples.zh: 現代先進的語音辨識演算法能夠將學者在台上發表的學術演講錄音，以令人驚嘆的極高準確率實時轉化為文字速記。

explains: This can mean knowing who someone is or what something is. You may know a friend by their voice. A familiar face can also bring this feeling.
A person hears a song from long ago and smiles. The tune seems familiar even before the singer starts. The person knows they have heard it before.
The noun can also mean showing that someone’s work matters. A school may give a prize to a helpful student. Public thanks can show that the effort was noticed.

examples.en: Adequate bed rest and high-protein nutrition speed up post-surgery physical recovery.
examples.zh: 術後維持充分臥床休養並多補充優質蛋白質滴雞精能顯著加速身體元氣的康復痊癒。

examples.en: The young athlete made an astounding recovery and returned to the field ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 這位年輕運動員展現出超乎常人的頑強意志與驚人復原力，比預期更早重返綠茵球場馳騁。

examples.en: Physical therapy plays a pivotal role in accelerating functional recovery after knee replacement.
examples.zh: 術後積極配合專業物理治療師進行功能性復健操，是加速全膝人工關節置換後靈活康復的關鍵。

examples.en: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols help elderly patients walk comfortably on day one.
examples.zh: 導入「怡樂適術後加速康復療程」（ERAS），能幫助高齡長輩在手術當天即可舒適下床走動。

examples.en: The national airline celebrated a strong financial recovery as international business travel rebounded.
examples.zh: 隨著全球國際商務差旅市場強勁復甦反彈，國籍旗艦航空公司的客運營收迎來了令人振奮的獲利大復甦。

examples.en: Physical therapy and acupuncture significantly accelerated the injured basketball player's knee recovery.
examples.zh: 結合現代運動醫學物理治療與傳統中醫針灸通絡，顯著加速了這位受傷職籃射手十字韌帶術後的康復進度。

examples.en: Heat recovery ventilation (HRV) supplies fresh filtered outdoor air while recycling 90% of indoor coolness.
examples.zh: 全熱交換新風換氣機，在引進戶外過濾新鮮空氣的同時回收九成室內珍貴冷氣能量。

examples.en: Energy recovery ventilators balance indoor humidity levels, making rainy seasons far more comfortable.
examples.zh: 搭載焓值交換芯的能源回收換氣系統能平衡調節室內濕度，讓梅雨季節的居家生活更加乾爽宜人。

examples.en: Running a continuous recovery ventilation unit filters PM2.5 particles while conserving expensive air conditioning power.
examples.zh: 二十四小時運轉的全熱新風系統能徹底過濾戶外 PM2.5 懸浮微粒，同時為住戶省下昂貴的冷氣電費。

examples.en: The military recovery team arrived by helicopter within twenty minutes to secure the touchdown site.
examples.zh: 地面「搜救回收小組」（Recovery Team）搭乘直升機在二十分鐘內趕抵降落現場，完成封鎖與吊掛。

examples.en: The surgeon assured the family that the patient had made a complete, uncomplicated clinical recovery.
examples.zh: 主治外科醫師步出開刀房向焦急等候的家屬溫言寬慰，保證病患手術極其順利且已展開全面的術後康復。

examples.en: The national economy entered a sustained post-recession recovery fueled by consumer confidence and robust exports.
examples.zh: 在消費者實質購買力復甦與強勁外貿出口帶動下，總體經濟正式走出低谷衰退，邁入穩健持久的繁榮復甦期。

entries.definition: 康復；痊癒；復原；術後加速康復療程 (ERAS)；全熱交換新風換氣系統 (90% 熱回收)；猶他州沙漠荒野迅速搜索與返回艙吊掛回收作業；回收
explains: This means getting better after an illness or injury. A person may slowly regain strength. The time needed can differ from person to person.
The noun can also mean getting back something that was lost or taken. A family may find a missing bag. Bringing the bag back is a successful result.
A place or business can return to a better state after trouble. Shops may open again after a large flood. Work and daily life slowly begin to return.

examples.en: The park offers space for sports and recreation.
examples.zh: 公園提供運動和休閒活動的空間。

examples.en: Swimming is her favorite form of recreation.
examples.zh: 游泳是她最喜歡的休閒活動。

examples.en: The town built a recreation center near the school.
examples.zh: 鎮上在學校附近興建了一座休閒活動中心。

explains: This means activities people do for fun during free time. Playing a game or walking in a park can be examples. These activities give people a break from work.
A family finishes its weekly chores and goes to a lake. They spend the afternoon boating and playing outside. They are enjoying their time together.
This kind of activity can be active or quiet. Some people enjoy football while others enjoy painting. The main purpose is enjoyment and a pleasant break.

examples.en: Remember to wash and recycle plastic bottles and aluminum cans.
examples.zh: 記得將塑膠瓶與鋁箔罐清洗乾淨後進行資源回收。

examples.en: Many clothing brands now recycle plastic waste into eco-friendly fabrics.
examples.zh: 許多服裝品牌現在將塑膠廢棄物回收再製為環保機能布料。

examples.en: The city provides dedicated bins to recycle clean paper, cardboard, and metals.
examples.zh: 市府設置專用回收桶，以回收乾淨紙類、厚紙板與金屬製品。

explains: This means to process used materials so they can become useful again. Old paper can be made into new paper products. The material is collected and changed for another use.
People may sort empty cans, bottles, and paper into separate bins. Different materials need different kinds of processing. Local collection rules show which items can be accepted.
Using the same jar again is one way to avoid waste. Turning its glass into new products is a different process. This verb usually describes that second kind of use.

examples.en: AI noise reduction software eliminates background air conditioner hum flawlessly.
examples.zh: 結合 AI 演算法的智慧降噪處理軟體能將背景中惱人的冷氣運轉低頻嗡嗡聲完美消除。

examples.en: The store announced a 30% price reduction on all consumer electronics this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店家宣布本週末全館消費性電子產品全面降價三成優惠。

examples.en: A significant reduction in carbon emissions is essential to fighting climate change.
examples.zh: 大幅減少碳排放量對於對抗全球氣候變遷至關重要。

explains: This means making something smaller in amount, size, or number. A price may go down from ten dollars to eight. The drop is one example.
A class uses fewer sheets of paper after printing on both sides. The amount of paper needed becomes smaller. The change saves materials.
The noun can name the amount by which something drops. A shop may take five dollars off a price. People can compare the old and new amounts to find the difference.

examples.en: Please refer to the map on the next page.
examples.zh: 請參考下一頁的地圖。

examples.en: The teacher referred to our science project during the meeting.
examples.zh: 老師在會議中提到了我們的科學專題。

examples.en: The librarian referred me to a book about birds.
examples.zh: 圖書館員指引我查閱一本關於鳥類的書。

explains: This can mean to mention or speak about someone or something. A teacher may bring up a book during a lesson. The teacher is pointing to that book in words.
It can also mean to look at a source for help. A student may check a map to find a river. The map provides the information needed.
A person can direct someone to another place or person for help. A librarian may send a reader to a specialist. This verb can describe that action.

examples.en: Keep this map for future reference.
examples.zh: 留著這張地圖，以便日後參考。

examples.en: The article includes a reference to an old poem.
examples.zh: 這篇文章提到了一首古詩。

examples.en: She listed three books as references for her report.
examples.zh: 她在報告中列了三本書作為參考資料。

explains: This can mean a mention of something in speech or writing. A story may include a brief mention of an old song. The writer is pointing readers toward that song.
The noun can also name a source used to find information. A dictionary can help someone check a word. A writer may list books used to prepare a report.
A person applying for a job may name someone who knows their work. That person can describe their skills and habits. The noun can name either that person or the supporting statement.

examples.en: The still lake reflected the mountains.
examples.zh: 平靜的湖面映出了群山。

examples.en: Bright surfaces reflect more light than dark ones.
examples.zh: 明亮的表面比深色的表面反射更多光線。

examples.en: She paused to reflect on what she had learned.
examples.zh: 她停下來，仔細思考自己學到了什麼。

explains: This means to send light back from a surface. A mirror does this when light reaches it. That is why you can see an image of your face.
A still pond can show the shape of trees beside it. Light bounces from the water toward your eyes. The water seems to hold a picture of the trees.
The verb can also mean to think carefully about something. After a busy day, a child may consider what went well. Taking time to think can help with future choices.

examples.en: The crystal-clear puddle created a flawless mirror reflection of Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 雨後地面清澈的水窪宛如一面天然明鏡，完美倒映出台北 101 大樓雄偉壯麗的倒影。

examples.en: Modern glass skyscrapers produce distorted, artistic reflections of surrounding clouds.
examples.zh: 現代玻璃帷幕摩天大樓的大面積鏡面，將漫天流雲折射出充滿抽象藝術感的扭曲倒影。

examples.en: She paused by the quiet pond, admiring the colorful autumn reflection of maples.
examples.zh: 她在靜謐的池畔駐足停留，靜靜欣賞湖面所映照出色彩斑斕的深秋紅楓倒影。

explains: This can mean an image seen in a mirror or a shiny surface. Light bounces back toward your eyes. You see a picture of what stands before the surface.
A child leans over a still pond and sees a face looking back. The image moves when the child moves. Ripples can break the picture into wavy shapes.
The noun can also mean careful thought about something. A quiet moment after a lesson may help a student consider new ideas. Looking back on an event can help someone learn from it.

examples.en: The school plans to reform its lunch system.
examples.zh: 學校計畫改革午餐供餐制度。

examples.en: The group called for reform of the outdated rules.
examples.zh: 這個團體呼籲改革過時的規則。

examples.en: The new policy was part of a wider reform.
examples.zh: 這項新政策是更廣泛改革的一部分。

explains: This means to change something in order to make it better. It often concerns rules or a system that people use. The aim is to fix problems in how things work.
A school finds that its lunch system makes children wait too long. It changes the order of service and opens another line. The changes are meant to improve the system.
The noun names changes made to improve a system or organization. The changes can be small or large. People often discuss the problems before deciding what to change.

examples.en: The refugee family found a safe place to stay.
examples.zh: 這個難民家庭找到了一個安全的住處。

examples.en: The school welcomed children from refugee families.
examples.zh: 學校歡迎來自難民家庭的孩子。

examples.en: Volunteers brought blankets to the refugees.
examples.zh: 志工把毯子送給難民。

explains: This is someone forced to leave their country because staying is unsafe. War or cruel treatment may drive the person away. The person seeks safety in another country.
A family leaves its home when fighting reaches the town. They cross a border and look for a safe place to stay. They may have to leave many belongings behind.
A person in this situation may need a new home and help learning a language. Children may need to join a different school. Kind neighbors can help them feel welcome.

examples.en: If the product is defective, you are entitled to a full refund.
examples.zh: 若產品有瑕疵，您有權獲得全額退款。

examples.en: The concert was cancelled, so ticket buyers were granted automatic refunds.
examples.zh: 演唱會取消了，因此購票者均獲得了全額自動退費。

examples.en: The store refunded the entire purchase price to my original credit card.
examples.zh: 店家將整筆購物款項退還到了我原本的信用卡中。

explains: This is money returned to someone who has already paid. A shop may give the money back after an item is returned. The exact amount depends on the situation.
A concert is canceled after people have bought tickets. The ticket seller sends their money back. That returned payment has this name.
The same word can be a verb meaning to pay money back. A seller may return all or part of a payment. The buyer then has the money again.

examples.en: Her polite refusal did not hurt his feelings.
examples.zh: 她婉轉的拒絕沒有傷害他的感受。

examples.en: His refusal to share the ball upset the team.
examples.zh: 他拒絕分享球，讓隊友很不高興。

examples.en: The letter explained the reason for the refusal.
examples.zh: 信中解釋了拒絕的原因。

explains: This is the act of saying no to a request or offer. Someone may decide not to do what they are asked. The answer can be firm or gentle.
A child is invited to join a game but does not want to play. The child politely says no. That response is an example of this noun.
A person can also show this decision through actions. Someone may shake their head or turn away an offered item. The action shows that they will not accept it.

examples.en: I have a question regarding tomorrow’s trip.
examples.zh: 關於明天的旅行，我有一個問題。

examples.en: The teacher sent a message regarding the new timetable.
examples.zh: 老師傳了一則關於新課表的訊息。

examples.en: Please read the notice regarding library hours.
examples.zh: 請閱讀關於圖書館開放時間的公告。

explains: This means about or on the subject of something. It often introduces the topic of a message. A letter may use it before naming the matter being discussed.
A teacher sends families a note about the next school trip. The note explains the time and meeting place. This word can link the note to its topic.
People often use this word in fairly formal writing. It helps make the subject clear. In everyday speech, a shorter word such as about may serve the same purpose.

examples.en: You can register for the art class on Monday.
examples.zh: 你可以在星期一報名美術課。

examples.en: The teacher checked the class register.
examples.zh: 老師查看了班級名冊。

examples.en: The thermometer registered thirty degrees.
examples.zh: 溫度計顯示三十度。

explains: This means to put a name or other information on an official list. A person may sign up for a class this way. The list shows who plans to attend.
The noun can name a list or record of people and things. A teacher may use one to check who is present. Names can be marked as people arrive.
The verb can also mean to show or record a measurement. A thermometer may show a change in temperature. An instrument records the amount so people can read it.

examples.en: Insert your IC health card into the self-service kiosk to complete clinic registration.
examples.zh: 將健保 IC 卡插入自助掛號繳費機中，數秒內即可快速完成門診報到與掛號手續。

examples.en: Patient registration requires verifying personal identification and insurance details.
examples.zh: 病患初次就醫掛號手續需要現場核對身分證明文件以及健保醫療卡等個人資料。

examples.en: The clinic's online registration opens every morning at seven o'clock for same-day visits.
examples.zh: 該名醫診所的線上預約掛號系統於每天清晨七點準時開放當日就診名額搶掛。

explains: This is the process of putting a name or details on an official list. People may complete a form to join a class. The information helps organizers know who will attend.
A family signs up a child for a summer camp. They give a name and contact details. Completing these steps makes a record of the child’s place.
The noun can also concern recording details about a vehicle or other item. A record links the item to important information. A number or document may show that the details have been recorded.

examples.en: This device regulates the flow of water.
examples.zh: 這個裝置調節水流。

examples.en: The town uses rules to regulate traffic near the school.
examples.zh: 鎮上利用規定管理學校附近的交通。

examples.en: The body helps regulate its own temperature.
examples.zh: 身體有助於調節自身的溫度。

explains: This means to control how something works or how much of it is allowed. Rules or careful adjustments can keep it within limits. The aim is often steady and safe operation.
A machine may keep a room at a chosen temperature. It turns the heat up or down as needed. These changes keep the room from becoming too hot or too cold.
An organization can set rules for an activity. The rules may limit when it happens or how it is done. This verb describes controlling the activity in that way.

examples.en: Deep diaphragmatic breathing aids in rapid emotional regulation during stress.
examples.zh: 腹式深呼吸放鬆法有助於在面臨龐大高壓時迅速達成自主情緒調節穩定。

examples.en: Good sleep hygiene plays a crucial role in the brain's hormonal regulation.
examples.zh: 良好的睡眠衛生習慣在人體大腦荷爾蒙調控中扮演著至關重要的角色。

examples.en: Strict safety regulations protect factory workers from hazardous machinery.
examples.zh: 嚴格的安全規章守則能保護工廠作業人員免於危險機具的傷害。

examples.en: Emotional self-regulation enables leaders to pause, reflect, and respond wisely rather than react impulsively.
examples.zh: 卓越的情緒自我調節能力，讓領導者在危機中冷靜深思並做出明智回應而非意氣用事。

examples.en: Government environmental authorities introduced a strict new regulation limiting industrial wastewater discharge.
examples.zh: 政府環保主管機關頒布了一項極為嚴格的法規管制新規定，嚴禁工廠未經處理排放工業廢水。

examples.en: Thermostatic valves ensure precise temperature regulation inside high-precision pharmaceutical storage refrigerators.
examples.zh: 恆溫溫控閥門確保高精度生技藥品冷藏儲存冰箱內部，能夠維持分毫不差的精準溫度調控。

examples.en: High-rate lithium battery banks deliver instantaneous frequency regulation, keeping the grid locked at 60 Hz.
examples.zh: 高倍率鋰電池儲能陣列提供毫秒級頻率調節輔助服務，將全台電力頻率精準鎖定在六十赫茲。

examples.en: Stringent grid code regulations require renewable developers to furnish ancillary grid stability services.
examples.zh: 國家電網併網法規嚴格明定，再生能源發電開發商必須配置相應比例的調頻與電壓穩定輔助系統。

examples.en: Rapid automatic frequency regulation counters micro-second imbalances between power generation and demand.
examples.zh: 極速全自動頻率調節機制，能在微秒尺度上化解即時發電端與負載端之間出現的細微供需失衡。

entries.definition: 情緒調節；調控；規則規章；覺察自省之情緒自我調節管理；毫秒級自動頻率調節輔助服務；規定
explains: This can mean an official rule about how an activity must be done. People are expected to follow it. It can set limits or require certain steps.
A swimming pool may have a rule about using the diving board. A sign explains what swimmers must do. The rule helps organize use of the space.
The noun can also mean the process of keeping something under control. A device may adjust the flow of water through a pipe. Careful control keeps the flow at the desired level.

examples.en: The writer received a rejection letter from the magazine.
examples.zh: 作家收到雜誌社的退稿信。

examples.en: The team was disappointed by the rejection of its plan.
examples.zh: 團隊對計畫遭到否決感到失望。

examples.en: She tried again after the first rejection.
examples.zh: 第一次遭到拒絕後，她又試了一次。

explains: This means not accepting someone or something that is offered. A plan may be considered and then turned down. The answer is no.
A writer sends a story to a magazine. The editor decides not to print it and sends a reply. The story has not been accepted this time.
A person may feel hurt when a group will not include them. The noun can describe that experience too. Being turned down does not mean the person has no value.

examples.en: She listens to quiet music for relaxation.
examples.zh: 她聽輕柔的音樂來放鬆。

examples.en: The garden is a peaceful place for relaxation.
examples.zh: 花園是個寧靜的放鬆場所。

examples.en: The holiday brought a welcome period of relaxation.
examples.zh: 這次假期帶來了一段令人愉快的休息時光。

explains: This is a calm state in which the body and mind can rest. A person may feel less tense or worried. Quiet time can bring this feeling.
After a busy day, someone sits in a comfortable chair and listens to soft music. The shoulders feel less tight. The person enjoys a peaceful break.
The noun can also mean making a rule less strict. A school may allow more choice about clothing for one day. The usual limits are loosened for that time.

examples.en: Please include only relevant details in your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告中只放入相關細節。

examples.en: She found a book with information relevant to her project.
examples.zh: 她找到一本含有與專題相關資訊的書。

examples.en: The teacher asked a question relevant to the story.
examples.zh: 老師問了一個與故事相關的問題。

explains: This describes something closely connected to the topic being discussed. It helps answer the question or solve the problem. Unrelated details do not give the same help.
A class is learning why plants need light. Information about how leaves use sunlight helps the lesson. A story about a bicycle does not fit that topic.
A useful answer includes details that matter to the question. When asked about a trip’s cost, the price of the ticket is important. The color of a traveler’s hat probably is not.

examples.en: The good news relieved her worries.
examples.zh: 這個好消息減輕了她的憂慮。

examples.en: A short rest helped relieve the tired feeling in his legs.
examples.zh: 短暫休息幫助減輕了他雙腿的疲憊感。

examples.en: Another worker arrived to relieve the guard.
examples.zh: 另一名工作人員前來接替警衛。

explains: This means to make pain, worry, or another difficulty less strong. A heavy bag feels easier to carry when someone takes part of the load. The burden becomes lighter.
A child worries that a lost dog will never return. A neighbor brings the dog home safely. The good news makes the child’s fear go away.
The verb can also mean taking over someone’s work so they can rest. One worker arrives to replace another at a desk. The first worker can then leave.

examples.en: She was reluctant to leave the warm house.
examples.zh: 她不太願意離開暖和的屋子。

examples.en: He gave a reluctant nod before joining the game.
examples.zh: 他勉強點了點頭，才加入遊戲。

examples.en: The child was reluctant to try the unfamiliar food.
examples.zh: 孩子不太願意嘗試陌生的食物。

explains: This describes someone who does not really want to do something. The person may hesitate before agreeing. They may act only after being encouraged.
A child wants to keep playing when it is time to go home. The child slowly puts away the toys. Leaving is something the child would rather avoid.
Someone may hold back because of worry or doubt. A shy student might feel unsure about speaking to a large group. The student is not eager to begin.

examples.en: Her kind remark made the new student smile.
examples.zh: 她友善的話讓新同學笑了。

examples.en: He remarked that the garden looked beautiful.
examples.zh: 他說這座花園看起來很美。

examples.en: The teacher made a brief remark about the drawing.
examples.zh: 老師對這幅畫做了簡短的評論。

explains: This noun means a short spoken or written comment. Someone may make an observation about the weather. The comment may be just one sentence.
A guest looks around a newly painted room and says that it looks bright. The host hears this brief opinion. The noun can name what the guest said.
As a verb, it means to say something you have noticed or thought. A person may point out that the sky has become dark. The comment draws attention to that detail.

examples.en: She made remarkable progress in reading this year.
examples.zh: 她今年在閱讀方面進步驚人。

examples.en: The tiny model had a remarkable amount of detail.
examples.zh: 這個小模型有令人驚嘆的豐富細節。

examples.en: It was a remarkable story of courage and kindness.
examples.zh: 這是一個關於勇氣與善良的非凡故事。

explains: This describes something unusual enough to deserve attention. It may be very impressive or surprising. People notice that it stands out.
A child builds a detailed model of a town from tiny scraps of paper. Every little window and street is carefully made. Visitors are amazed by the work.
A big improvement can also be described this way. A runner may make much more progress than anyone expected. The change is striking enough for people to talk about it.

examples.en: A new lamp was a simple remedy for the dark room.
examples.zh: 添一盞新燈是改善房間昏暗的簡單方法。

examples.en: The team worked to remedy the mistake.
examples.zh: 團隊努力補救這個錯誤。

examples.en: The book described an old herbal remedy.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了一種古老的草藥療法。

explains: This is something used to make a problem better or remove it. It may be a treatment for an illness. It can also be a solution to another kind of trouble.
A room is too dark for reading. Adding a lamp makes the words easier to see. The added light is a simple way to solve the problem.
As a verb, it means to fix a fault or improve a bad situation. A worker notices that a door will not close properly. Adjusting the loose hinge can correct the fault.

examples.en: I need to renew my library card.
examples.zh: 我需要辦理借書證續期。

examples.en: The club renewed its agreement with the community center.
examples.zh: 社團與社區中心續約了。

examples.en: The holiday renewed her interest in painting.
examples.zh: 這次假期重新喚起了她對繪畫的興趣。

explains: This means to make something valid or active for another period of time. A library may let a reader keep a book longer. The borrowing period starts again or is extended.
A person may return to an activity with fresh energy. A long rest can bring back interest in a project. The person begins working with new strength.
The verb can also describe making a promise or agreement again. Two groups may decide to continue working together. They confirm that they want the arrangement to go on.

examples.en: Spaced repetition scientifically schedules reviews right before the brain forgets new vocabulary.
examples.zh: 遵循大腦遺忘曲線設計的「間隔重複記憶法」（Spaced Repetition），在即將遺忘的黃金節點精準安排複習。

examples.en: Musical instrument mastery relies on deliberate physical repetition to build effortless muscle memory.
examples.zh: 任何古典樂器的登峰造極，皆高度仰賴數萬次帶有覺知的刻意練習重複，以化為行雲流水的肌肉記憶。

examples.en: Without active variation, mindless mechanical repetition leads to diminishing returns and boredom.
examples.zh: 若缺乏主動思考與情境變化，單純枯燥機械式的死記硬背只會讓大腦感到麻木，學習效益大幅遞減。

entries.definition: 間隔重複記憶法；重複練習
explains: This means doing or saying the same thing again. The action may happen once more or many times. Practice often includes this process.
A child says a new word several times while learning it. Each attempt gives another chance to remember the sounds. Hearing it again can also help.
A song may use the same line more than once. That repeated pattern makes the tune familiar. Too much of the same material, however, can make a long talk dull.

examples.en: The model is a small representation of the town.
examples.zh: 這個模型是城鎮的縮小呈現。

examples.en: The painting offers a bright representation of village life.
examples.zh: 這幅畫生動地呈現了鄉村生活。

examples.en: Students asked for representation on the school committee.
examples.zh: 學生要求在學校委員會中有代表參與。

explains: This can mean a picture, model, or description that stands for something else. A small model of a house is one example. It shows the shape of a real building.
A drawing of the sun may be a yellow circle with lines around it. The drawing is not the real star. It gives people a simple way to picture the idea.
The noun can also mean speaking or acting for other people. A student may attend a meeting for the whole class. The student shares the class’s views with the group.

examples.en: Delivering flawless project code on time builds a solid professional reputation.
examples.zh: 每次皆能準時交付高品質零瑕疵的專案程式碼能為您奠定扎實的業界好口碑。

examples.en: The restaurant suffered damage to its reputation after negative hygiene reviews.
examples.zh: 該餐廳在遭遇衛生負評後，其建立多年的品牌聲譽蒙受了打擊。

examples.en: A good reputation takes years to build but can be ruined in a single mistake.
examples.zh: 良好的聲譽需要多年積累才能建立，但一個嚴重的過失就可能毀於一旦。

explains: This is what people generally think about a person, place, or business. It comes from what they have seen or heard. It may be good or bad.
A baker always sells fresh bread and treats customers kindly. People tell their friends that the shop is reliable. The shop becomes known for its good work.
An opinion shared by many people can change over time. Repeated mistakes may damage trust. Honest and helpful actions can help rebuild it.

examples.en: The firefighters rescued the family from the burning house.
examples.zh: 消防員從失火的房屋中救出了那家人。

examples.en: The rescue took several hours.
examples.zh: 這場救援花了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Volunteers helped rescue animals after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，志工幫忙救援動物。

explains: This means to save someone from danger or a difficult situation. A person may be trapped and need help getting out. Helpers bring the person to safety.
A kitten is stuck in a deep drain. Trained helpers lift it out and return it to its owner. The animal is safe again.
The noun can name the act of saving someone. A team may work together during a flood. Boats and other equipment can help them reach people who need assistance.

examples.en: Scientists are conducting groundbreaking research on clean green energy.
examples.zh: 科學家們正在對乾淨綠色能源進行開創性研究。

examples.en: Carry out extensive market research before launching a new product line.
examples.zh: 在推出全新產品線之前，務必先進行廣泛深入的市場研究調查。

examples.en: The university library provides access to thousands of peer-reviewed research databases.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館提供了檢索數千個同儕審查學術研究資料庫的權限。

explains: This means careful study to learn more about a subject. A person asks questions and looks for evidence. The aim is to find reliable information.
A class wants to know which soil helps seeds grow best. The students plant seeds in different soils and record the results. Their observations help answer the question.
This work can also involve books, records, or interviews. A writer may study old letters to learn about a town. Checking several sources can help make the account accurate.

examples.en: The researcher recorded how quickly each plant grew.
examples.zh: 研究人員記錄了每株植物生長的速度。

examples.en: A researcher visited the village to study its history.
examples.zh: 一位研究人員到村莊研究當地歷史。

examples.en: The researchers compared their results.
examples.zh: 研究人員比較了各自的結果。

explains: This is someone who carefully studies a subject to learn more about it. The person asks questions and gathers information. Evidence helps them reach an answer.
A scientist watches birds to learn where they build nests. Notes are kept about each location. This kind of careful study is part of the person’s work.
Some people in this role work with old documents instead of living things. They might compare letters from the past. Their findings can help explain what happened long ago.

examples.en: The cloud resembled a sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 那朵雲看起來像一隻睡著的貓。

examples.en: She closely resembles her older sister.
examples.zh: 她長得很像姊姊。

examples.en: The leaves resemble tiny stars.
examples.zh: 這些葉子看起來像小星星。

explains: This means to look or seem like someone or something else. Two things may share a shape, color, or other feature. They do not have to be exactly the same.
A cloud has a long shape with two parts that look like ears. A child says it looks like a rabbit. The cloud reminds the child of that animal.
People in the same family may have similar eyes or smiles. A child can look a lot like a parent. This verb describes that similarity.

examples.en: I made a dinner reservation for four at the hot pot restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在火鍋店預約了四個人的晚餐訂位。

examples.en: You must confirm your table reservation at least one day before dining.
examples.zh: 您必須在用餐前至少一天確認您的訂位。

examples.en: The committee expressed strong reservations about the proposed budget cut.
examples.zh: 委員會對擬議中的預算削減表達了強烈保留態度。

examples.en: I made an online hotel reservation for two nights in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我在網路上預訂了墾丁兩晚的飯店住宿。

examples.en: Because the seafood restaurant is very popular, making a table reservation is mandatory.
examples.zh: 由於這家人氣海鮮餐廳極受歡迎，前來用餐必須提前事先訂位。

examples.en: You can modify or cancel your booking reservation without penalty up to forty-eight hours in advance.
examples.zh: 您在入住前四十八小時均可免費修改或取消飯店預約訂單。

entries.definition: 預約；訂位；訂房；預訂（房間、席位）
explains: This can mean an arrangement to keep a place or service ready for someone. A family may book a hotel room before a trip. The hotel holds the room for their arrival.
A restaurant may save a table for guests at a chosen time. The guests give their name when they arrive. The arrangement helps them plan their evening.
The noun can also mean a doubt or concern about a plan. Someone may like most of an idea but worry about its cost. That concern can make them hesitate.

examples.en: She decided to resign to pursue a master's degree in the UK.
examples.zh: 她決定辭職前往英國攻讀碩士學位。

examples.en: The government minister chose to resign to take full political responsibility.
examples.zh: 該名內閣部會首長為表示承擔全部政治責任，毅然決然主動請辭下台。

examples.en: After months of unresolved workplace disagreements, he chose to resign gracefully.
examples.zh: 經歷了數個月始終無法化解的職場理念歧異之後，他選擇體面優雅地遞出辭呈離職。

explains: This means to choose to leave a job or an official position. The person tells others they will no longer do that work. A letter may explain the decision.
A club leader has too little time for the role. The leader tells the members that someone else should take over. Leaving the role by choice is the action described.
In a board game such as chess, this can mean accepting that you have lost before the game ends. A player stops rather than making another move. The other player wins.

examples.en: He handed in his formal letter of resignation two weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 他提前兩週向上級遞交了正式的離職辭呈。

examples.en: The board of directors reluctantly accepted the founding CEO's resignation.
examples.zh: 公司董事會深思熟慮後，萬分不捨地依依接受了創始執行長提出的離職辭呈。

examples.en: News of the star director's sudden resignation surprised everyone in the tech community.
examples.zh: 這位明星技術長突然拋出震撼請辭辭職的消息，令整個科技創投圈深感錯愕震驚。

explains: This can mean the act of choosing to leave a job or position. A written notice may tell an employer about the decision. The person may name the day they plan to finish.
A team captain decides to step down because of other duties. The team receives a letter explaining the choice. They must choose someone new for the role.
The noun can also mean calmly accepting something unpleasant that seems impossible to change. A traveler learns that the last bus has left. With a sigh, the traveler accepts the long wait.

examples.en: Progressive resistance training strengthens skeletal bones and builds lean muscle.
examples.zh: 循序漸進的漸進式阻力訓練能有效強化骨質密度並刺激骨骼肌肌肉合成生長。

examples.en: Elastic bands create variable resistance that peaks at the top of each movement.
examples.zh: 彈力帶能產生變動阻力，在動作頂峰收縮時提供最大的阻抗力。

examples.en: Regular resistance exercise helps older adults preserve mobility and prevent muscle loss.
examples.zh: 規律進行阻力運動有助於年長者維持行動力並預防肌肉流失。

examples.en: Seated elastic band resistance exercises build thigh quadriceps without stressing aged knee joints.
examples.zh: 坐在椅子上進行的彈力帶阻力訓練，能在不磨損膝關節的前提下鍛鍊大腿股四頭肌。

examples.en: The union mounted strong political resistance against the proposed corporate pension cuts.
examples.zh: 工會發起了強烈且堅定的抗爭抵制，全力反對資方所提出的刪減員工退休金方案。

examples.en: High thermal resistance materials are installed inside walls to minimize summer air conditioning energy losses.
examples.zh: 建築牆體內部安裝了高熱阻隔熱材料，以最大限度減少夏季室內冷氣空調的能源損耗。

entries.definition: 阻力訓練；抵抗阻力；坐姿漸進式彈力帶阻力訓練；抵抗
explains: This means acting against something or refusing to accept it. People may oppose a plan they believe is unfair. Their objections make it harder for the plan to go ahead.
A heavy box is difficult to push across a rough floor. The surfaces press and rub against each other. That force opposes the movement.
The noun can also describe how much a material makes it difficult for electric current to pass. Some materials allow current through easily. Others greatly limit its flow.

examples.en: Export the master file in 4K resolution at sixty frames per second.
examples.zh: 請以 4K 超高解析度並搭配每秒六十幀（60 FPS）的極致流暢規格匯出母帶檔案。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times a week is a common goal.
examples.zh: 下定新年新希望並立志每週至少規律運動三次，是許多人最常見的新年決心。

examples.en: The United Nations General Assembly passed a historic resolution calling for peace.
examples.zh: 聯合國大會以壓倒性多數正式通過了一項呼籲和平與停止衝突的歷史性決議案。

examples.en: High 8K resolution eliminates visible print layer lines, producing flawless miniature facial expressions.
examples.zh: 高達 8K 的極致列印解析度，能徹底消除肉眼可見的層紋階梯，印出栩栩如生的精緻微表情。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times each week is a wonderful habit for personal health.
examples.zh: 在元旦清晨許下每週至少規律運動三次的新年新希望決心，是維持個人長久身心健康的絕佳好習慣。

examples.en: Peaceful diplomatic negotiations led to a prompt and amicable resolution of the cross-border trade dispute.
examples.zh: 經過多輪冷靜克制的外交斡旋協商，終於促成了這起跨國雙邊貿易摩擦爭端的迅速圓滿解決化解。

examples.en: High spatial resolution resolves individual star clusters inside merging colliding galaxies billions of light-years away.
examples.zh: 極致的「空間角解析度」（Resolution），能清晰分辨百億光年外相互碰撞星系內部的單獨星團結構。

examples.en: Modern 8K television screens offer breathtaking visual resolution that shows every grain of sand in landscapes.
examples.zh: 最新款 8K 超高畫質電視螢幕呈現令人屏息的細緻影像解析度，連風景畫面中的微小沙礫都歷歷在目。

examples.en: The United Nations General Assembly passed a unanimous resolution condemning maritime pollution.
examples.zh: 聯合國大會經過全體代表深入研商後，以壓倒性多數一致通過了譴責向公海傾倒污染物的正式決議。

entries.definition: 影片解析度；決心；解決；八微米超高列印解析度；解析度；毫角秒級極致超高空間角解析度
explains: This can mean a firm decision to do something. A person chooses a goal and intends to follow it. A new year is a common time for such promises.
The noun can also mean the settling of a problem or disagreement. Two friends may talk until they find an answer both accept. The conflict then comes to an end.
For pictures and screens, this word concerns how much detail an image can show. More tiny picture points can make small features clearer. This matters when viewing or printing an image.

examples.en: Both sides sat down calmly to resolve their differences.
examples.zh: 雙方心平氣和坐下來解決彼此的分歧。

examples.en: Customer service representatives worked patiently to resolve the complicated software issue.
examples.zh: 客服人員極具耐心地反覆排查測試，成功為使用者解決了複雜的軟體程式問題。

examples.en: She resolved to study English vocabulary for thirty minutes every single day this year.
examples.zh: 她下定堅定決心，今年無論如何每天一定要抽出整整三十分鐘專心背英語單字。

entries.definition: 解決（紛爭、難題）；下定決心
explains: This means to settle a problem or find an answer to it. People may discuss several ideas before agreeing. The difficulty is then dealt with.
Two classmates want to use the same computer. They agree to take turns for equal amounts of time. Their agreement settles the dispute.
The verb can also mean deciding firmly to do something. The noun names strong determination. A person may continue toward a goal even when progress is slow.

examples.en: She runs a respectable family business.
examples.zh: 她經營一家信譽良好的家族企業。

examples.en: The young runner finished with a respectable time.
examples.zh: 這位年輕跑者以相當不錯的成績完賽。

examples.en: They wanted to earn a respectable living through honest work.
examples.zh: 他們想靠誠實工作過上體面的生活。

explains: This describes someone or something generally considered decent and worthy of respect. Honest actions and good behavior can build that view. People may trust a person with this quality.
A family runs a shop fairly and treats customers well. Neighbors know that promises will be kept. The business earns a good standing in the community.
This word can also mean fairly good or large enough to be acceptable. A team may earn a solid score without winning first place. The result is still something to be pleased with.

examples.en: Students maintained a quiet and respectful silence during the lecture.
examples.zh: 學生在演講進行期間保持安靜且充滿敬意。

examples.en: Always use polite and respectful language when writing formal business emails.
examples.zh: 撰寫正式的商務商業往來電子郵件時，務必隨時使用客氣端莊的敬語措辭。

examples.en: Visitors bowed in a respectful manner when entering the historical ancestral shrine.
examples.zh: 參訪者在邁入歷史悠久的宗族祖祠時，皆莊重地微微躬身表達崇敬之禮。

explains: This describes behavior that shows care for someone’s feelings or position. A person listens politely and speaks thoughtfully. The person treats others as important.
A visitor waits while another person finishes speaking. Then the visitor asks a question in a calm voice. These actions show good manners and consideration.
People can disagree and still behave this way. They can explain their views without insults. Listening carefully shows that the other person deserves to be heard.

examples.en: You can restore all photos from your cloud account to the new phone.
examples.zh: 你可以將雲端帳戶中的所有照片完整還原至新手機上。

examples.en: The IT specialist managed to restore corrupted database files after the crash.
examples.zh: 資訊專員在當機事故後成功修復並還原了損毀的資料庫檔案。

examples.en: The community raised funds to restore the historic town hall.
examples.zh: 社區募集資金以修復重建這座歷史悠久的市政廳建築。

explains: This means to bring something back to an earlier or better condition. An old building may need careful repairs. The work can make it look much as it once did.
A storm cuts off power to a neighborhood. Workers fix the damaged lines. Electricity becomes available again.
The verb can also mean returning something that was lost or taken away. A museum may receive an object that had been missing. The item is put back in its proper place.

examples.en: Aviation liquid restrictions mandate all gels be packed in 100ml transparent bottles.
examples.zh: 民航安全法規嚴格規定，隨身攜帶之液體與凝膠乳液每瓶容量不得超過一百毫升。

examples.en: The city imposed traffic speed restrictions in school zones to protect crossing children.
examples.zh: 市政府在各國民小學校園周邊限速學區劃設嚴格的速限交通管制規定，以保護學童過馬路安全。

examples.en: Be aware of import restrictions regarding dried meats, fresh fruits, and dairy products.
examples.zh: 旅客入境前請務必熟記海關對肉乾零食、新鮮生果與乳製品等動植物產品的嚴格輸入限制。

entries.definition: 攜帶限制；管制規定；限制
explains: This is a rule or limit on what people can do. It may control an amount, a time, or an activity. People have less freedom within that limit.
A library allows each reader to borrow only five books at once. This limit helps keep books available for others. Readers must return some before taking more.
A limit may apply only in certain places or at certain times. A path may be closed while workers repair a bridge. The rule can be removed when the work is finished.

examples.en: The thick walls retain heat well.
examples.zh: 厚實的牆壁能很好地保留熱度。

examples.en: She retained a clear memory of the trip.
examples.zh: 她仍清楚記得那次旅行。

examples.en: Please retain your ticket until the journey ends.
examples.zh: 請保留車票直到旅程結束。

explains: This means to keep something instead of losing or giving it up. A person may hold on to an object or a right. The thing remains with them.
A student learns a new fact and remembers it weeks later. The information has stayed in the student’s memory. Regular practice can help it remain there.
A material can hold heat or water for a period of time. Thick cloth may help keep warmth close to the body. The verb can describe keeping that warmth in.

examples.en: My father plans to retire at sixty-five and take up gardening.
examples.zh: 我父親計畫在六十五歲退休並開始投入園藝愛好。

examples.en: The veteran baseball pitcher decided to retire after eighteen stellar seasons.
examples.zh: 在征戰賽場整整十八個戰功彪炳的輝煌賽季後，這位傳奇老將投手正式決定引退。

examples.en: Building an emergency nest egg enables individuals to retire comfortably with peace of mind.
examples.zh: 及早規劃存妥一筆充足的應急養老金，能讓每個人在晚年無憂無慮、體面舒適地退休。

explains: The verb often means to stop working at a job after many years. A person may do this later in life. More time can then be spent on family or other interests.
The noun names the time of life after leaving regular work. Someone may travel, garden, or help in the community. People choose different ways to spend this period.
The verb can also mean to stop taking part in an activity. An injured player may leave a match before it ends. An old machine can also be taken out of service.

examples.en: The hikers retreated when the path became unsafe.
examples.zh: 步道變得不安全時，登山客退了回去。

examples.en: The little cabin was a quiet retreat from city life.
examples.zh: 那間小木屋是遠離城市生活的寧靜休憩處。

examples.en: The army began its retreat before dawn.
examples.zh: 軍隊在黎明前開始撤退。

explains: This means to move back or away from danger or difficulty. A group may pull back when it cannot safely continue. Moving away creates more distance from the threat.
A cat approaches a barking dog and then steps backward. It moves behind a gate to feel safer. The action can be described with this verb.
The noun can also name a quiet place or a short stay away from daily pressures. People may go somewhere peaceful to rest and think. A small cabin can serve this purpose.

examples.en: Our family held a reunion at the old farmhouse.
examples.zh: 我們家在老農舍舉行了團聚活動。

examples.en: She met her former classmates at a school reunion.
examples.zh: 她在同學會上見到了以前的同學。

examples.en: The reunion of the lost dog and its owner made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 走失的狗與主人重逢，讓大家都笑了。

explains: This is a meeting of people who have been apart for some time. They come together again to share news and memories. The occasion may feel joyful or emotional.
Former classmates meet many years after leaving school. They talk about old lessons and teachers. They also learn what their friends are doing now.
A family may gather relatives who live in different towns. People travel to one place for a shared meal. Children may meet cousins they have not seen for years.

examples.en: The character wanted revenge after his friend betrayed him.
examples.zh: 那個角色被朋友背叛後想要報復。

examples.en: She decided to forgive him instead of seeking revenge.
examples.zh: 她決定原諒他，而不是尋求報復。

examples.en: The story shows how revenge can hurt both sides.
examples.zh: 這個故事展現了報復如何傷害雙方。

explains: This means hurting or upsetting someone because they hurt or upset you first. The aim is to make the other person suffer in return. It often grows from anger.
In a story, someone breaks a character’s favorite toy. The character wants to break something belonging to that person. That desire is an example of this feeling.
Trying to get even can keep a conflict going. One angry act may lead to another. A story may show a character deciding to end the cycle instead.

examples.en: Revise your vocabulary notes every evening before going to bed.
examples.zh: 每天晚上睡前把單字筆記重新溫習一遍。

examples.en: The editor asked the author to revise the final three chapters of the novel.
examples.zh: 責任編輯要求作者修改小說的最後三個章節。

examples.en: The economic agency revised its gross domestic product forecast upward.
examples.zh: 經濟評估主管機關將年度國內生產毛額預估值向上進行修正。

explains: This means to look over something and make changes to improve it. A writer may correct mistakes or make ideas clearer. The new version should work better.
A student reads a story draft and notices that the ending is confusing. The student changes a few sentences and adds a missing detail. The story becomes easier to follow.
In British English, this verb can mean studying material again before a test. A learner looks back at notes and practices questions. The aim is to remember and understand the subject.

examples.en: The teacher suggested a revision to my final paragraph.
examples.zh: 老師建議修改我的最後一段。

examples.en: This revision of the plan includes a larger playground.
examples.zh: 這份修訂後的計畫包含更大的遊樂場。

examples.en: He spent the evening doing revision for his exam.
examples.zh: 他晚上花時間複習，準備考試。

explains: This can mean a change made to improve or correct something. A report may need a clearer ending. An added sentence can be one such change.
The noun can also name a new version after changes have been made. A writer may send the updated text to an editor. The editor compares it with the earlier draft.
In British English, this can mean studying material again before an exam. Students may review notes and practice questions. This helps them prepare to use what they have learned.

examples.en: Spatial computing represents the next profound revolution in how humans create, communicate, and live.
examples.zh: 空間運算標誌著繼滑鼠與觸控螢幕之後，人類溝通、創造與生活的下一場「人機互動偉大革命」（Revolution）。

examples.en: The widespread adoption of smartphones triggered a digital communication revolution across every continent.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的普及在全球各大洲引發了一場翻天覆地的數位通訊與生活型態革命。

examples.en: Planetary astronomers calculate the exact period of the satellite's revolution around Jupiter.
examples.zh: 行星天文學家精密計算出這顆天然衛星繞行木星運轉的完整公轉週期。

examples.en: The bio-manufacturing revolution is transforming factories from chemical smokestacks into clean fermentation tanks.
examples.zh: 這場席捲全球的「生物製造偉大革命」（Revolution），正將傳統排煙化工廠轉型為純淨清新的生物發酵槽。

examples.en: The invention of the movable type printing press catalyzed an unprecedented intellectual and literacy revolution.
examples.zh: 活字印刷術的偉大發明，在歐洲歷史上催化了一場前所未有的知識普及傳播與全民識字率巨幅躍升革命。

examples.en: Astronomical calculations accurately predict the celestial moon’s orbital revolution around planet Earth.
examples.zh: 天文軌道物理數學計算，能極其精確地預測月球圍繞地球公轉軌道運行的完整天體運行週期。

entries.definition: 繼滑鼠與多點觸控後之第三次人機互動革命；第四次工業革命之綠色生物製造偉大浪潮；革命
explains: This can mean a major change in who holds political power. People may remove an old system of rule. A different system takes its place.
The noun can also describe a very large change in how people live or work. New inventions may transform whole industries. Daily life can become very different afterward.
It can also mean one complete turn around a point or path. A wheel can make a full turn. A moving object may then reach the position where that turn began.

examples.en: The new printing method was a revolutionary invention.
examples.zh: 這種新的印刷方法是一項革命性的發明。

examples.en: The book describes revolutionary ideas that changed the country.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了改變國家的革命思想。

examples.en: The museum displayed a letter written by a famous revolutionary.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一位著名革命者寫的信。

explains: This describes a change so large that it creates a very different way of doing things. An invention may transform work across the world. People no longer follow the old method.
The word can also describe actions or ideas connected with changing a system of government. A group may want to replace the old rulers. It seeks a major shift in power.
As a noun, this names someone working for that kind of political change. The person may organize others or spread new ideas. The goal is to replace an existing system.

examples.en: The owner offered a reward for the missing dog.
examples.zh: 主人懸賞尋找走失的狗。

examples.en: She rewarded the children with a picnic after their hard work.
examples.zh: 孩子們努力工作後，她以野餐作為獎勵。

examples.en: Seeing the finished garden was a reward for our effort.
examples.zh: 看見完工的花園，就是我們付出努力的回報。

explains: This is something good given in return for an action or effort. It may be money, a prize, or special time to enjoy an activity. It shows that the action was valued.
A person returns a lost bag to its owner. The owner offers a small gift as thanks. That gift is something the person receives for helping.
The good result can also be a feeling. A gardener may feel happy after seeing flowers grow. Enjoying that result can make the effort feel worthwhile.

examples.en: The words light and night rhyme.
examples.zh: light 和 night 這兩個字押韻。

examples.en: She wrote a short rhyme about her cat.
examples.zh: 她寫了一首關於自家貓咪的短押韻詩。

examples.en: Can you find a word that rhymes with tree?
examples.zh: 你能找一個和 tree 押韻的字嗎？

explains: This happens when words have matching ending sounds. Cat and hat are one pair. Writers often use such pairs in songs and poems.
A short verse may end its lines with similar sounds. Listeners can hear a pattern as the lines are read aloud. The pattern may make the verse easier to remember.
Matching sounds matter more than matching letters. Blue and shoe end alike when spoken. Love and move look similar but have different ending sounds.

examples.en: Clap your hands along with the lively rhythm of the music.
examples.zh: 跟隨音樂歡快的節奏一起拍拍手。

examples.en: Maintaining a steady daily sleep rhythm improves your mental focus.
examples.zh: 維持規律穩定的每日作息生理節奏有助於提升專注力。

examples.en: Latin dances are characterized by fast, energetic hip rhythms.
examples.zh: 拉丁舞的特色在於快速且充滿活力的臀部節奏律動。

explains: This is a pattern of sounds or movements over time. Some beats may be strong and others soft. The pattern helps music feel organized.
A child claps twice, pauses, and then claps twice again. The same timing continues for several rounds. Other children can copy the pattern.
Speech and poetry can have patterns of stressed and unstressed sounds. Dancers can also move in time with repeated beats. Listening to the timing helps them stay together.

examples.en: Solving clever riddles on Lantern Festival night is entertaining.
examples.zh: 在元宵節夜晚猜有趣的燈謎既益智又娛樂。

examples.en: The puzzle host gave contestants three subtle clues to solve the tricky riddle.
examples.zh: 猜謎活動主持人給了參賽選手三個巧妙提示來解開這道棘手的謎語。

examples.en: How the ancient builders moved those massive stone slabs remains an unsolved riddle.
examples.zh: 古代工匠究竟是如何搬運那些巨大石板的，至今仍是一個未解之謎。

explains: This is a puzzling question or description with a hidden answer. The clues may have more than one meaning. You have to think carefully to solve it.
A child asks what has hands but cannot clap. The answer is a clock. The trick comes from using a familiar word in a different way.
The noun can also mean something mysterious that is hard to explain. People may search for clues over time. Finding the answer removes the mystery.

examples.en: The robber demanded the traveler’s bag.
examples.zh: 搶匪要求旅人交出袋子。

examples.en: The police caught the robber near the station.
examples.zh: 警方在車站附近抓到了搶匪。

examples.en: The witness described the robber’s red jacket.
examples.zh: 目擊者描述了搶匪身上的紅色外套。

explains: This is someone who takes another person’s property by using force or threats. The person frightens or hurts someone to get what they want. It is a kind of stealing.
In a story, someone demands a traveler’s bag and threatens to hurt the traveler. The bag is taken against the owner’s wishes. The noun names the person taking it.
A thief may secretly take something without confronting anyone. This word usually suggests that force or a threat is involved. The surrounding story helps show what happened.

examples.en: The movie tells a touching romance set in 1980s Taipei.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了發生在 1980 年代台北的感人愛情故事。

examples.en: He still believes in the timeless romance of writing handwritten love letters.
examples.zh: 他依舊堅信親筆書寫紙本情書那份歷久彌新的浪漫情調。

examples.en: Backpacking through the Swiss Alps rekindled their romance and love for adventure.
examples.zh: 背包徒步穿越瑞士阿爾卑斯山重新點燃了他們的浪漫愛火與冒險熱情。

explains: This can mean a loving relationship between two people. They may enjoy being together and caring for one another. The feeling often involves attraction and affection.
A story about people falling in love can have this name. The characters may face problems before finding happiness together. Books and films often use this kind of plot.
The noun can also describe a sense of wonder or exciting beauty. Someone may feel this about distant travel or old sailing ships. The idea feels more magical than ordinary daily life.

examples.en: Check the GPS navigation for the fastest driving route.
examples.zh: 查閱 GPS 導航以獲取最快速的行車路線。

examples.en: The city added a new bus route serving remote suburban communities.
examples.zh: 市政府新增了一條服務偏遠郊區社區的公車路線。

examples.en: Hikers followed a well-marked mountain route up to the summit.
examples.zh: 登山客沿著標示清晰的登山路徑一路登上山頂。

explains: This is the way taken to get from one place to another. It can include roads, paths, or other sections of a journey. A map can show the whole course.
Two paths may lead to the same park. One goes past the school while the other follows a river. A traveler chooses which way to take.
The verb means to direct something along a chosen path. A delivery company sends packages through certain towns. The selected path helps them reach the correct address.

examples.en: The spilled juice ruined my drawing.
examples.zh: 打翻的果汁毀了我的畫。

examples.en: Heavy rain threatened to ruin the picnic.
examples.zh: 大雨眼看就要破壞這場野餐。

examples.en: We explored the ruins of an old castle.
examples.zh: 我們探索了一座古堡的遺跡。

explains: This means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used or enjoyed as before. Water may spoil a paper drawing. The picture loses the details the artist wanted.
A sudden storm can spoil plans for an outdoor picnic. The food may get wet and everyone has to leave. The enjoyable event no longer works as planned.
The noun can describe severe damage or the broken remains of an old building. Stone walls may stand where a castle once stood. These remains show what was there long ago.

examples.en: The school serves children in a rural area.
examples.zh: 這所學校為鄉村地區的孩子提供教育。

examples.en: We spent the weekend in a quiet rural village.
examples.zh: 我們在一座寧靜的鄉村度過週末。

examples.en: The bus connects several rural communities.
examples.zh: 這班公車連接幾個鄉村社區。

explains: This describes things connected with the countryside. Farms, fields, and small villages are common features. The setting is outside a large town or city.
A school stands beside fields and a narrow road. Some children travel from nearby farms. The school serves a country community.
Life in this setting may involve more open land and fewer nearby buildings. People may travel farther for some services. Different country areas still have different ways of life.

examples.en: The rusty gate made a loud noise when it opened.
examples.zh: 生鏽的門打開時發出很大的聲音。

examples.en: We found a rusty nail beside the shed.
examples.zh: 我們在小屋旁找到一根生鏽的釘子。

examples.en: My French is rusty because I have not used it for years.
examples.zh: 我多年沒用法文，已經生疏了。

explains: This describes iron or steel covered with a reddish-brown layer caused by air and water. The surface may look rough or flaky. The metal can become weaker over time.
An old bicycle is left outside in the rain for months. Brown patches form on some metal parts. Those parts no longer look smooth and shiny.
The word can also describe a skill that has become weaker through lack of practice. Someone may struggle to play a song they once knew well. Practice can help the skill return.

examples.en: She sacrificed her free afternoon to help her friend.
examples.zh: 她犧牲了下午的休閒時間來幫助朋友。

examples.en: His parents made many sacrifices so he could study.
examples.zh: 他的父母為了讓他讀書，付出了許多犧牲。

examples.en: The team’s success required time and sacrifice.
examples.zh: 團隊的成功需要時間與付出。

explains: This means giving up something valuable for a person, cause, or goal. The thing given up may be time, money, or comfort. Another need is treated as more important.
A student skips a favorite game to help a sick friend with missed lessons. The lost playtime matters to the student. Helping the friend is chosen instead.
The noun can name the thing given up or the act of giving it up. Parents may spend their free time caring for a child. The choice can involve effort or loss for someone else’s benefit.

examples.en: Formosat-5 is Taiwan's first domestically developed remote sensing satellite.
examples.zh: 福衛五號是全台灣第一顆由本土自主研發成功發射的遙測人造衛星。

examples.en: GPS receivers determine your exact geographic position by triangulating signals from four satellites.
examples.zh: 智慧手機的 GPS 定位晶片透過同時交叉比對接收四顆以上導航衛星訊號，精準鎖定您的地理位置。

examples.en: Natural satellites like the Moon orbit terrestrial planets due to gravitational attraction.
examples.zh: 如月球這般的天然衛星，在萬有引力牽引下億萬年如一日忠實繞行著各自行星母體運轉。

examples.en: Formosat-7 atmospheric satellites collect precise weather radar data to track severe typhoons.
examples.zh: 台灣自主研製的「福爾摩沙衛星七號」氣象衛星群，每日精準收集海量大氣資料以預測強颱動向。

examples.en: Emergency workers relied on satellite phones when mountain roads and cell towers were destroyed.
examples.zh: 當山區道路與行動基地台遭破壞時，緊急救難人員全仰賴衛星電話維持通訊。

examples.en: Modern farmers utilize satellite imagery to monitor soil moisture and crop health across vast fields.
examples.zh: 現代農民利用高解析度衛星空拍影像，監控廣大農田的土壤濕度與作物健康狀態。

entries.definition: 人造衛星；月球衛星；衛星城市；衛星通訊
explains: This is an object that travels around a larger body in space. It can be natural or made by people. Earth’s moon is a natural example.
People send machines into space to move around Earth. Some take pictures of clouds and storms. Others help carry messages or show locations.
The path around the larger body is called an orbit. Gravity helps keep the moving object on that path. It can go around many times without landing.

examples.en: She felt satisfaction after finishing the difficult puzzle.
examples.zh: 完成困難的拼圖後，她感到滿足。

examples.en: The gardener looked at the flowers with satisfaction.
examples.zh: 園丁滿足地看著那些花。

examples.en: The shop asked customers about their satisfaction with the service.
examples.zh: 商店詢問顧客對服務的滿意程度。

explains: This is a pleased feeling when something meets your needs or hopes. A job done well can bring it. You feel that the result is good.
A child finishes a difficult puzzle after many attempts. Looking at the complete picture brings a warm sense of success. The effort feels worthwhile.
A customer may be happy because a product works as promised. The service may also be friendly and helpful. Shops sometimes ask about this feeling to learn how well they are doing.

examples.en: There was scarcely enough room for one more chair.
examples.zh: 幾乎沒有足夠空間再放一張椅子。

examples.en: I could scarcely hear her quiet voice.
examples.zh: 她的聲音很輕，我幾乎聽不見。

examples.en: We had scarcely arrived when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我們剛到，天就開始下雨了。

explains: This means hardly or almost not. It shows that there is very little of something. A person may have almost no time left.
A room is so dark that you can only just see the door. The shape is barely visible. This word can describe how difficult it is to see.
The word can also show that one event happened just before another. Someone arrives home and the phone immediately rings. There was almost no gap between the two events.

examples.en: We stopped to admire the mountain scenery.
examples.zh: 我們停下來欣賞山景。

examples.en: The train journey offered beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 這趟火車旅程沿途風景優美。

examples.en: The students painted the scenery for the school play.
examples.zh: 學生們為學校戲劇繪製舞台布景。

explains: This means the natural features you can see in a place. Mountains, rivers, forests, and fields can all be part of it. People may enjoy looking at the whole view.
A train passes beside a lake and green hills. Travelers look out of the windows and take pictures. They admire the landscape along the journey.
The noun can also mean painted backgrounds and other large pieces used on a stage. These help show where a play takes place. A painted forest may make the stage look like woodland.

examples.en: The teacher scolded the students for shouting in the hall.
examples.zh: 老師責備學生在走廊大聲喊叫。
