examples.zh: 表演開始前，體育館裡很安靜。

explains: This is a large place for sports, shows, or other public events. Many people can sit and watch what happens. Workers help keep the area safe.
A contest may take place on a special floor or field. Players follow rules while fans cheer. The event brings people together.
The word can describe a place where people compete or show their skills. It may be indoors or outside. Signs guide visitors to seats.

examples.en: The music aroused strong feelings in the audience.
examples.zh: 音樂引起觀眾強烈的感受。

examples.en: Her question aroused the class’s curiosity.
examples.zh: 她的問題激發了全班的好奇心。

examples.en: The smell of cookies aroused happy memories.
examples.zh: 餅乾的香氣喚起了快樂的回憶。

explains: This means to cause a feeling or reaction to begin. A funny story can make people laugh. A loud bang may make them jump.
A question can make someone curious about a subject. Looking for an answer may lead to new learning. Good questions can start discussion.
A smell can bring back a memory. The scent of bread may remind someone of a family kitchen. Feelings can arise without warning.

examples.en: Advanced phased array antennas steer radio beams electronically without moving physical mechanical parts.
examples.zh: 先進的電子相位陣列天線，無需任何機械齒輪轉動即可利用電磁波束毫秒級精準追蹤衛星。

examples.en: The modern solar farm features a sprawling array of photovoltaic panels tilted toward the southern sky.
examples.zh: 這座現代化太陽能電廠設有一望無際整齊排列的太陽能光電陣列板，朝向南方天空傾斜蓄能。

examples.en: The computer programmer declared a multi-dimensional array to store weekly temperature logs efficiently.
examples.zh: 電腦軟體工程師宣告了一個多維陣列資料結構，以高效儲存與處理每週的氣溫變化記錄。

examples.en: Flexible 66kV inter-array cables link dozens of individual turbines to gather electricity across the wind farm.
examples.zh: 鋪設於海床底部的 66kV 風場內部陣列海纜，串聯各座風機匯集所發出的潔淨電力。

examples.en: The layout of the subsea cable array was optimized to minimize electrical impedance and trench length.
examples.zh: 整個水下陣列海纜走向經過電氣模擬拓撲最佳化，以大幅降低線路阻抗損耗並縮短開溝挖埋長度。

examples.en: Diverless underwater vehicles inspect the cable array to ensure no sections have been uncovered by currents.
examples.zh: 水下無人遙控潛水器（ROV）定期沿著海纜陣列巡檢，確保沒有任何電纜段落因強勁洋流沖刷而裸露。

entries.definition: 電子相位陣列波束成形天線；陣列；66kV 風場陣列內部海底電纜網；排列
explains: This is a group of items or people arranged in rows or patterns. A tray may hold a neat group of colored buttons. Each item has a place.
A list can show things in order. A shop may arrange its products by size or price. The clear layout helps customers compare them.
In electronics, a flat set of small parts can work together to send or receive signals. Engineers place the parts in a planned pattern. This design can guide a signal.

examples.en: The arrogant player refused to pass the ball.
examples.zh: 那位傲慢的球員拒絕傳球。

examples.en: His arrogant reply made his classmates feel small.
examples.zh: 他傲慢的回答讓同學感到自卑。

examples.en: She sounded arrogant when she bragged about every prize.
examples.zh: 她吹噓每一個獎項時，聽起來很自大。

explains: This describes someone who thinks they are better or more important than other people. They may brag and refuse to listen. Such behavior can hurt friendships.
A person may ignore other people’s ideas because they feel too proud. Teamwork requires everyone to share and listen. Respect helps a group succeed.
Confidence is helpful, but looking down on others is unkind. A person can be proud of hard work while still treating people fairly. Humility helps.

examples.en: She articulated her plan clearly to the group.
examples.zh: 她向小組清楚表達了自己的計畫。

examples.en: The speaker articulated each word slowly.
examples.zh: 演講者慢慢地把每個字說清楚。

examples.en: He tried to articulate why the game felt unfair.
examples.zh: 他試著清楚說明為什麼覺得遊戲不公平。

explains: This means to express thoughts clearly in speaking or writing. A student can explain an idea in an organized way. Listeners can follow the message.
A person may speak with clear words and careful pronunciation. Practicing aloud can make the message easier to understand. Pauses help too.
The word can describe joints that move freely. Some birds have body parts that bend in several places. This helps them move.

examples.en: The ass carried baskets along the mountain path.
examples.zh: 那頭驢沿著山路馱著籃子。

examples.en: An ass brayed beside the fence.
examples.zh: 一頭驢在圍籬旁嘶叫。

examples.en: The farmer gave the ass fresh hay.
examples.zh: 農夫給那頭驢新鮮乾草。

explains: This is a farm animal related to a horse. It has long ears and can carry loads. It often makes a loud braying sound.
The animal may walk along rocky paths and carry supplies. Its strong legs help it travel over rough ground. It eats plants and grass.
A young one may stay near its mother in a field. Farmers care for it with food and shelter. Gentle handling helps it feel safe.

examples.en: The report described an assault near the station.
examples.zh: 報告描述了車站附近的一起攻擊事件。

examples.en: The player received a penalty for assault during the match.
examples.zh: 那名球員在比賽中因攻擊行為受到處罰。

examples.en: The guards prevented an assault on the traveler.
examples.zh: 守衛阻止了對旅客的襲擊。

explains: This is a violent attack on a person. It is a serious crime and can cause harm. People should seek help from trusted authorities if someone is in danger.
In sports, the word can refer to a forceful attempt to reach an opponent. Rules help keep players safe. Officials stop unsafe play.
The verb can mean to attack someone or something. In a story, a character may be attacked by a group. The event can frighten them.

examples.en: She asserted that the team had followed the rules.
examples.zh: 她堅稱隊伍遵守了規則。

examples.en: He asserted his right to ask a question.
examples.zh: 他堅定地表明自己提問的權利。

examples.en: The report asserts that the bridge is safe.
examples.zh: 報告主張這座橋很安全。

explains: This means to state something firmly and clearly. A student may say that everyone deserves a fair turn. Calm words can make the point clear.
A person can stand up for their rights or beliefs. They should explain their reasons and listen to others. Respectful speech helps.
A speaker may claim that something is true. Evidence can support the claim. Checking facts helps people make good decisions.

examples.en: The engineering panel assessed technical feasibility before starting construction.
examples.zh: 工程專家小組在動工興建前全面評估了技術可行性。

examples.en: Insurance adjusters arrived promptly to assess vehicle damage following the highway collision.
examples.zh: 車禍理賠勘查專員第一時間趕赴車禍現場，嚴格評估國道追撞事故對車體造成的損壞。

examples.en: The university uses blind grading protocols to assess final research papers impartially.
examples.zh: 國立大學全面採行雙向匿名盲審評分規範，以求徹頭徹尾客觀公正地評定學期專題論文。

examples.en: Conduct a thorough risk assessment before entering emerging markets.
examples.zh: 在進軍新興市場前，請務必進行全方位的風險評估。

examples.en: Formative classroom assessments help teachers identify which grammar topics require review.
examples.zh: 課堂形成性隨堂評量能有效協助授課教師精準診斷，究竟哪些核心文法章節亟待補強複習。

examples.en: The environmental impact assessment concluded that the solar farm posed minimal eco-threats.
examples.zh: 該項環境影響評估審查報告最終裁定，這座大型太陽能發電廠對周邊生態衝擊極其微小。

examples.en: Conducting a whole-building life cycle assessment (LCA) quantifies carbon impacts from raw extraction to demolition.
examples.zh: 進行嚴謹的全生命週期碳評估，精準計算建材從開採、建造到拆除的總碳排。

examples.en: Environmental engineers run detailed software assessments to choose materials with lower global warming potential.
examples.zh: 環境工程師藉由精密評估模擬軟體反覆試算，挑選出全球暖化潛勢最低的優質環保節能建材。

examples.en: The municipal carbon assessment determined that mass timber reduced the stadium's total emissions by 35%.
examples.zh: 市政專案全生命週期碳評估報告證實，改用工程木構讓這座大型體育館的全生命週期總碳排大減三成五。

entries.definition: 評估；核定；評定；評量；鑑定；全建築生命週期碳足跡評估 (LCA)
explains: This means to examine something and judge its quality, amount, or value. A teacher may look at a student’s work and offer feedback. Clear standards help make the judgment fair.
A worker may check how much a project costs. The numbers help a group plan its budget. Careful records prevent errors.
A person may look at a situation and decide what should happen next. They gather facts before making a choice. Asking questions can help.

examples.en: The library is a valuable asset to the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 圖書館是社區很有價值的資產。

examples.en: Her patience is an asset when she teaches young children.
examples.zh: 她的耐心是教導幼童時的一大優點。

examples.en: The company listed its computers as assets.
examples.zh: 公司把電腦列為資產。

explains: This is something valuable or useful that a person or group owns. A bicycle can help someone get to school. A skill can also be useful.
A business may own tools, buildings, or money. These things help it do its work. Careful records show what it has.
A person’s kindness can be a valuable quality. Friends may depend on someone who listens and helps. Good qualities support a group.

examples.en: Check your facts to ensure your reasoning isn't based on false assumptions.
examples.zh: 核實事實以確保你的推論並非建立在錯誤的假設上。

examples.en: The economic forecast relied on the optimistic assumption that fuel prices would stabilize.
examples.zh: 這份經濟成長預測完全建立在一個樂觀的假設前提上，即國際油價將會回穩。

examples.en: It is a dangerous assumption to believe that walking alone in unlit alleys is always safe.
examples.zh: 盲目認為深夜獨自漫步在沒有路燈照明的昏暗僻靜小巷絕對安全，是危險的臆斷。

explains: This is an idea accepted as true without proof. A person may guess that a friend is busy because they have not replied. The guess may be wrong.
People sometimes make a guess before checking facts. Asking questions can help them learn what is really happening. It is good to stay open to new information.
A plan can rely on a certain belief about what will happen. If the belief changes, the plan may need to change too. Careful thinking helps.

examples.en: The magic trick astonished the children.
examples.zh: 魔術戲法讓孩子們驚訝不已。

examples.en: Her high score astonished her whole family.
examples.zh: 她的高分讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: We were astonished to see snow in April.
examples.zh: 我們驚訝地看到四月下雪。

explains: This means to surprise someone greatly. A sudden visit from a dear friend may make a person smile. They did not expect it.
A surprising result can make people stare or ask questions. They may need time to understand what happened. New facts can change their view.
A person may react with wonder after seeing something unusual. A bright comet in the night sky can amaze a family. They may remember it for years.

examples.en: High schools invest in quality rubber running tracks to promote track athletics.
examples.zh: 高中校園積極鋪設優質國際標準 PU 田徑跑道，全力推廣青少年田徑體育運動。

examples.en: She showed a natural talent for athletics from a very young age.
examples.zh: 她從很小的時候就展現出了在田徑與體育運動方面的過人天賦。

examples.en: The university athletic department allocates scholarships to support collegiate athletics.
examples.zh: 該大學體育室特別提撥專款獎學金，大力支持大專校院各項體育競賽。

explains: This is a group of sports that includes running, jumping, and throwing. People train their bodies to do these events. Competitions may take place on a track.
A school may offer these sports as an activity. Students practice skills such as long jumps and races. They learn to follow rules and encourage teammates.
Some events test how fast or far a person can move. Athletes prepare with practice and rest. Coaches help them train safely.

examples.en: Regular class attendance is factored into your final semester grade.
examples.zh: 平常課堂出席率會計入您的學期總成績。

examples.en: Overall attendance at the annual technology exhibition set a new record.
examples.zh: 年度科技博覽會的整體參觀出席人數創下了嶄新歷史紀錄。

examples.en: The teacher calls roll every morning to take daily student attendance.
examples.zh: 老師每天早晨點名以確實記錄學生的每日出勤狀況。

explains: This is the act or number of people who are present at a place or event. A teacher may mark who came to class. The record helps track participation.
A concert may have many people in the audience. Workers count visitors to learn how popular the event was. The number can help with planning.
A student who comes to school regularly has good participation. Families can tell the school when a student must stay home. Clear records help.

examples.en: We found an old toy in the attic.
examples.zh: 我們在閣樓裡找到一個舊玩具。

examples.en: The attic has a small window above the stairs.
examples.zh: 樓梯上方的閣樓有一扇小窗。

examples.en: Dad stores holiday decorations in the attic.
examples.zh: 爸爸把節慶裝飾品收在閣樓裡。

explains: This is the space just under the roof of a house. Families may store boxes there. A small window can let in light.
The room may have sloped ceilings because it is beneath the roof. People sometimes turn it into a bedroom or play area. Good stairs make it easier to reach.
Old decorations and family objects may be kept in this space. It can get dusty, so people clean it carefully. A sturdy floor is important.

examples.en: Consult with a qualified corporate attorney before signing international joint ventures.
examples.zh: 在簽署跨國合資企業合約前，請先諮詢合格專業的企業商務律師。

examples.en: The defense attorney delivered a passionate closing argument to convince the jurors.
examples.zh: 刑事辯護律師在法庭上發表了一段慷慨激昂、邏輯縝密的結案陳詞，極力說服全體陪審員相信被告。

examples.en: She granted her trusted elder brother full power of attorney to manage her financial assets.
examples.zh: 她在出國定居前正式簽署了法律授權書，全權委託深得她信賴的兄長作為法定代理人代為處分資產。

explains: This is a lawyer who can give legal help or represent someone. The person studies laws and court procedures. Clients can ask questions about their case.
A person may hire this professional to prepare papers or speak in court. The professional must follow legal rules. Clear facts help explain a case.
Some people have a legal representative who can make certain decisions for them. The role depends on the law and the person’s needs. The person must act in the client’s interest.

examples.en: The coach attributed the win to the team’s hard work.
examples.zh: 教練把勝利歸功於全隊的努力。

examples.en: The tag attributes the painting to a local artist.
examples.zh: 標籤把這幅畫的作者標示為一位當地藝術家。

examples.en: She attributes her good grades to regular study.
examples.zh: 她把好成績歸功於定期讀書。

explains: This means to say that a feature or quality belongs to a person or thing. A story may give a character great courage. The quality shapes how the character acts.
A person can say that a success happened because of practice. They give credit to the effort that helped. Others may have helped too.
A label can name the features of an object. A museum card may list its age and material. The details help visitors understand it.

examples.en: The old vase sold at an auction.
examples.zh: 那只舊花瓶在拍賣會上售出。

examples.en: They auctioned the bicycle to raise money for the club.
examples.zh: 他們拍賣腳踏車，為社團募款。

examples.en: Many people placed bids at the charity auction.
examples.zh: 許多人在慈善拍賣會上出價。

explains: This is a public sale where people offer different prices for an item. The person who offers the highest price may buy it. The sale has clear rules.
A rare painting or old object may be sold this way. Interested buyers can raise their offers. The seller chooses when to end the sale.
The word can also be a verb meaning to sell through this kind of event. An auctioneer calls out the prices. Buyers decide how much they will pay.

examples.en: The principal authorized the class to visit the museum.
examples.zh: 校長批准全班參觀博物館。

examples.en: Only a manager can authorize a refund.
examples.zh: 只有經理可以核准退款。

examples.en: Her parents authorized the school trip.
examples.zh: 她的父母同意了校外教學。

explains: This means to give official permission for an action. A parent may let a child join a school trip. The teacher checks the form.
A manager can allow a worker to use a room or tool. Clear rules explain what is permitted. Asking first shows respect.
A group may formally approve a plan. Members review it before agreeing. A written record can show the decision.

examples.en: Achieving financial autonomy frees individuals to pursue creative passions without monetary anxiety.
examples.zh: 達成財務自主與被動收入獨立（Financial Autonomy），能讓每個人無後顧之憂地全心追尋內心真正熱愛的夢想。

examples.en: Decentralized software teams enjoy high levels of project autonomy, allowing members to innovate freely.
examples.zh: 跨國遠距軟體開發小組享有極高度的專案執行自主權，讓每位工程師皆能在不受過度干預下自由揮灑創新創意。

examples.en: The remote territory fought for decades to achieve political autonomy and self-governance.
examples.zh: 這處偏遠島嶼地區的自治代表經過數十年和平抗爭與公民投票，終於爭取到了合憲的地方自治與決策權。

examples.en: Respecting seniors' autonomy means letting them choose their daily menus, clothing, and activity schedules.
examples.zh: 由衷尊重長輩的個人自主權，意味著鼓勵他們自行決定每日穿搭、餐點菜色與休閒活動。

examples.en: Students at progressive universities enjoy substantial academic autonomy to customize their course curricula.
examples.zh: 開明多元的大學學生享有高度的學術選課自主權，能自由規劃並客製化跨領域專題課程。

examples.en: Preserving personal autonomy in old age strengthens one's sense of self-worth and emotional well-being.
examples.zh: 在高齡歲月裡保有生活自主與掌控權，能極大地強化個人的自我價值認同與心理幸福感。

examples.en: Onboard edge AI autonomy enabled the spacecraft to identify safe hazard-free landing spots in real time.
examples.zh: 強大的機載「邊緣 AI 自主決策系統」（Autonomy），讓太空船能在數秒內自主辨識並降落在毫無障礙的安全平原。

examples.en: University students learn to manage their study schedules and finances with maturity, embracing personal autonomy.
examples.zh: 大學新鮮人學會成熟獨立自主地安排個人作息、讀書進度與生活開銷預算，欣然擁抱完全屬於自己的獨立自主性。

examples.en: Regional tribal councils preserve cultural autonomy to govern local community ancestral territories.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落議會依法享有管理部落傳統領域與自治事務的高度自治權，代代傳承尊嚴與文化命脈。

entries.definition: 財務掌控自主獨立權；自治權；保有自主選擇決定權；自立；擺脫地面控制延遲之探測器機載 AI 自主決策導航能力
explains: This is the freedom to make choices and manage one’s own actions. A student may choose which book to read for a project. Guidance can still be helpful.
A community may govern itself and make local decisions. Members discuss rules that affect everyone. Fair participation matters.
A machine that can make choices on its own may use sensors and computer instructions. People still design and check its behavior. Safety is important.

examples.en: Staring out of the submarine viewport into the pitch-black abyss fills human hearts with quiet awe.
examples.zh: 當透過潛水艇觀察窗凝視著窗外無邊無際的漆黑深淵時，每個人的心靈深處都被巨大的震撼與敬畏所填滿。

examples.en: The sheer scale and ancient stillness of the deep sea command respect and profound scientific awe.
examples.zh: 萬米深海那令人屏息的壯闊浩瀚與億萬年不變的永恆沉寂，喚起人類由衷的敬意與深刻的科學敬畏。

examples.en: Divers who witnessed giant bioluminescent siphonophores floated motionless in stunned awe.
examples.zh: 親眼目睹長達數十公尺、全身閃耀冷光的巨型管水母的潛水員們，無不在強烈震撼與由衷敬畏中屏息凝神。

examples.en: Floating quietly beside glowing hydrothermal chimneys fills scientists with profound, humbling awe.
examples.zh: 靜靜懸浮在散發微光的深海熱泉黑煙囪旁，科學家的心靈被大自然的浩瀚與神聖注入了深沉的「敬畏」（Awe）。

examples.en: Gazing at the Milky Way stretching across the pitch-black desert night sky filled the stargazers with awe.
examples.zh: 在伸手不見五指的沙漠暗夜中仰望橫跨天際的浩瀚銀河，觀星愛好者的內心油然而生純粹的震撼敬畏。

examples.en: The Olympic gymnast's flawless balance beam performance awed spectators and international judges alike.
examples.zh: 這位奧運女子體操選手在平衡木上無懈可擊的高難度完美落地，深深震撼了全場觀眾與國際裁判。

entries.definition: 凝望漆黑無垠深淵之極致震撼與敬畏；潛入深淵深處對大自然由衷生起之崇高敬畏；敬畏
explains: This is a feeling of wonder mixed with deep respect. A huge waterfall may make visitors stop and stare. They can feel small beside its power.
People may feel this when they see a starry sky or a tall mountain. The scene can seem grand and beautiful. Quiet observation can deepen the feeling.
A person may admire someone’s brave or kind action. Respect grows when people see something remarkable. They may talk about it afterward.

examples.en: The children played tag in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院玩捉迷藏。

examples.en: Mom planted tomatoes in the backyard.
examples.zh: 媽媽在後院種了番茄。

examples.en: Our dog likes to nap in the backyard.
examples.zh: 我們的狗喜歡在後院打盹。

explains: This is the open space behind a house. Families may grow flowers or play games there. A fence can mark its edge.
A small garden can have vegetables and fruit trees. People water the plants and pull weeds. Fresh food may come from the garden.
Children may play outside in this space. Adults can set rules to keep them safe. A ball and a patch of grass can provide hours of fun.

examples.en: Stamp your chosen candidate stamp clearly on the paper ballot.
examples.zh: 在紙本選票上清楚蓋上您所選候選人的圈選印章。

examples.en: The secret ballot ensures that no one can pressure how citizens vote.
examples.zh: 無記名秘密投票機制確保沒有任何人能脅迫影響公民的投票意向。

examples.en: Election workers carefully removed ballots from the sealed wooden ballot box.
examples.zh: 選務工作人員小心翼翼地將選票自封緘完整的票箱中逐張取出。

explains: This is a piece of paper or a choice used in an election. A voter marks one option in private. The collected papers help show what people chose.
People may use a secret process to choose a leader or decide an issue. Each person gets one chance to choose. Fair rules protect the process.
A group can count the choices after everyone has finished. The result tells which option received the most support. Observers can help make the count fair.

examples.en: The channel automated bot banned toxic users who violated community rules.
examples.zh: 頻道智慧管理機器人會自動對惡意違規侮辱他人的酸民帳號祭出永久封鎖禁言。

examples.en: The government placed a total ban on the sale of single-use plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府全面實施了禁止販售一次性塑膠提袋的法令禁令。

examples.en: He received a temporary chat ban for posting repetitive advertisements.
examples.zh: 他因為在聊天室中重複張貼廣告連結，而遭到了暫時禁言的懲罰。

explains: This is an official rule that does not allow something. A school may forbid running near the swimming pool. The rule helps prevent accidents.
A group may decide that an item cannot be brought into a place. Signs can explain what is not allowed. Visitors should follow the rule.
As a verb, it means to officially stop an action. A town may stop cars from using a damaged road. Clear notices help people choose another way.

examples.en: A red banner hung above the school entrance.
examples.zh: 學校入口上方掛著一面紅色橫幅。

examples.en: The website displayed a colorful banner for the festival.
examples.zh: 網站展示了色彩繽紛的節慶橫幅。

examples.en: The team carried a banner through the parade.
examples.zh: 隊伍帶著一面橫幅穿過遊行隊伍。

explains: This is a long piece of cloth with a picture or words on it. It may hang outside a building. People can see it from far away.
A website may show a wide picture at the top of a page. It can include the name of a group or event. The image catches a visitor’s attention.
A large sign may carry a message during a parade. Bright colors make the words easy to read. People can carry it above the crowd.

examples.en: The barren field had almost no green plants.
examples.zh: 貧瘠的田地幾乎沒有綠色植物。

examples.en: After the fire, the hillside looked barren.
examples.zh: 火災過後，山坡看起來一片荒蕪。

examples.en: The barren ground could not support many crops.
examples.zh: 那片貧瘠的土地無法養活許多作物。

explains: This describes land that is dry and has little plant life. Few trees may grow there. The soil may be too poor for crops.
A place without water or useful resources can be difficult to live in. Plants and animals may struggle. People need to find safe supplies.
The word can describe a person who cannot have children. This is a medical condition. A health professional can explain it with care and respect.

examples.en: The bakery made a batch of fresh rolls this morning.
examples.zh: 麵包店今天早上烤了一批新鮮餐包。

examples.en: We checked the first batch of forms for mistakes.
examples.zh: 我們檢查第一批表格有沒有錯誤。

examples.en: She baked one batch of cookies for the class.
examples.zh: 她烤了一批餅乾給全班吃。

explains: This is a group of items made or handled at one time. A baker may prepare many cookies together. They are cooked in the same round of work.
A set of letters or numbers can be processed together by a computer. The machine follows the same steps for each item. Grouping work can save time.
A short period of work may be followed by a rest. Workers complete one group of tasks before starting another. Planning helps keep the work organized.

examples.en: She accepted the award on behalf of her team.
examples.zh: 她代表隊伍接受了獎項。

examples.en: I am calling on behalf of my mother.
examples.zh: 我代表媽媽打電話。

examples.en: He collected the package on behalf of his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他代表鄰居領取包裹。

explains: This phrase means acting for another person or group. A student may speak for a team at a meeting. The team’s ideas are shared through that person.
A helper may pick up medicine for a family member. They carry out the task with permission. Clear instructions help them do it correctly.
A person can write a thank-you note for someone else. The note explains who asked for it. The writer should share the message honestly.

examples.en: The guests left their belongings in the coatroom.
examples.zh: 客人把個人物品留在衣帽間。

examples.en: Please keep your belongings close while traveling.
examples.zh: 旅行時請把個人物品放在身邊。

examples.en: She packed her belongings before moving to a new home.
examples.zh: 搬到新家前，她打包了個人物品。

explains: These are the personal things that someone owns. A traveler may pack clothes, books, and a toothbrush. Keeping them together helps prevent loss.
A person may carry small items in a bag. Labels can help identify who they belong to. It is polite to ask before touching them.
When someone moves, they sort their things into boxes. Some items can be donated or kept. A list helps track what is packed.

examples.en: The beloved teacher was remembered by many students.
examples.zh: 許多學生都記得那位深受喜愛的老師。

examples.en: Her beloved dog followed her everywhere.
examples.zh: 她心愛的狗總是跟在她身邊。

examples.en: The town held a party for its beloved coach.
examples.zh: 鎮上為深受喜愛的教練舉辦派對。

explains: This describes someone who is deeply loved. A grandparent may be very dear to a child. The child enjoys hearing family stories.
A person may have a special place in many people’s hearts. Friends remember their kindness. They can celebrate that person’s life.
A favorite object or place can be cherished for a long time. It may remind someone of happy moments. Careful keeping shows its value.

examples.en: Organic farmers release beneficial insects like ladybugs to consume harmful aphid colonies.
examples.zh: 有機果農在園區野放瓢蟲與草蛉等天敵益蟲，利用大自然食物鏈天然剋制惱人的蚜蟲害。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise delivers beneficial effects for cardiovascular health and longevity.
examples.zh: 每週規律進行有氧耐力運動，對促進心血管健康循環與延年益壽有著不可估量的有益助益。

examples.en: Gentle summer showers proved highly beneficial to newly sprouted corn seedlings.
examples.zh: 仲夏午後降下的一場及時甘霖微雨，對剛剛破土萌芽的鮮綠玉米幼苗帶來了極大的滋養。

explains: This describes something that helps or improves a situation. Eating fruit can be good for the body. A balanced diet supports health.
A change may help a community. Planting trees gives shade and homes to birds. People can enjoy the greener streets.
A habit can make learning easier. Reading every day helps a student meet new words. Small practice adds up over time.

examples.en: He betrayed his friend by revealing the secret.
examples.zh: 他洩露秘密，背叛了朋友。

examples.en: The soldier refused to betray the people he protected.
examples.zh: 那名士兵不肯背叛自己保護的人。

examples.en: She felt hurt when her teammate betrayed her trust.
examples.zh: 隊友辜負了她的信任，讓她很受傷。

explains: This means to be disloyal or to break someone’s trust. A friend may share a secret after promising not to. The other person can feel hurt.
A character in a story may turn against a trusted group. Their choice can surprise everyone. The story may show why they did it.
A person can break trust by lying or hiding important facts. Honest words can help repair a friendship. Making amends may take time.

examples.en: Beware of the wet floor near the door.
examples.zh: 小心門邊的濕滑地板。

examples.en: The guide told us to beware of loose stones.
examples.zh: 導遊提醒我們小心鬆動的石頭。

examples.en: Beware: the dog needs space while it eats.
examples.zh: 小心：狗吃東西時需要空間。

explains: This is a warning to stay careful around something risky. A sign may tell hikers to watch out for loose rocks. They should walk slowly.
People should pay attention when a situation seems unsafe. Asking an adult can help them decide what to do. Caution can prevent harm.
A wild animal may need space. Visitors should not feed or touch it. Signs can explain how to stay safe nearby.

examples.en: Readers should recognize political bias when consuming partisan news commentary.
examples.zh: 閱聽大眾在收看立場鮮明的政論節目時，應具備辨識黨派政治偏頗立場的能力。

examples.en: Confirmation bias leads individuals to only accept information that supports their views.
examples.zh: 確認偏誤會讓人們只願意接受那些印證自身既有觀點的資訊。

examples.en: The judge stepped down to avoid any perception of racial or personal bias.
examples.zh: 該法官主動迴避審判，以避免引發任何種族或個人偏見的質疑。

examples.en: Confirmation bias leads internet users to only read news articles matching their pre-existing beliefs.
examples.zh: 「確認偏誤」（Confirmation Bias）促使網友往往只熱衷點閱符合自身既定政治立場的文章，強化盲點。

examples.en: Judges take a solemn oath to preside over courtroom proceedings fairly without personal bias or prejudice.
examples.zh: 法官在就職時莊嚴宣誓，誓言在法庭審理案件過程中秉持客觀超然，絕不受個人任何主觀偏見左右。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence training datasets must be carefully audited to prevent algorithmic gender and racial bias.
examples.zh: 人工智慧訓練資料庫必須經過嚴密的獨立資安與倫理審查，以徹底消除演算法潛藏的性別與種族偏誤。

entries.definition: 偏見；偏頗立場；成見；認知偏誤；確認偏誤
explains: This is an unfair preference for one side or person. A judge should treat each team by the same rules. Fair choices help people trust the result.
A person may judge someone before learning the facts. Meeting and listening can correct a mistaken idea. Everyone deserves a fair chance.
A survey question can push people toward one answer. Neutral wording helps gather more honest opinions. Careful design makes results more useful.

examples.en: She made a bid for the last seat at the table.
examples.zh: 她為了餐桌旁最後一個座位出價。

examples.en: The company bid to build the new bridge.
examples.zh: 那家公司投標興建新橋。

examples.en: He bid ten dollars for the old book.
examples.zh: 他為那本舊書出價十美元。

explains: This is an offer of money for something that will be sold. A person may offer more than others for a painting. The seller can choose the highest offer.
A person may try to get a job or contract by promising to do the work for a price. The buyer compares offers. Clear terms help both sides.
The verb can mean to try to do something or make an offer. A child may try to help carry a box. The effort shows willingness.

examples.en: Biological pest control replaces chemical pesticides, preserving beneficial honeybee populations.
examples.zh: 採用天敵與性費洛蒙誘捕等生物防治法取代劇毒農藥，能保護辛勤授粉的野生蜜蜂族群。

examples.en: Students observed the intricate biological life cycle of silkworms in science class.
examples.zh: 國小自然科學課堂上，學童們透過放大鏡聚精會神觀察蠶寶寶神奇完整的生物生命週期變態。

examples.en: Biological washing powders contain active natural enzymes that break down stubborn protein stains.
examples.zh: 生物酵素洗衣精蘊含高活性天然蛋白酵素，能以溫和方式徹底分解衣物上的頑固血漬汗斑。

explains: This describes something connected with living things and how they grow. Plants, animals, and tiny germs are all alive. Scientists study their parts and actions.
Some small insects eat other insects that damage garden plants. This method uses one living thing to control another. Farmers may use it to protect their crops.
A person may learn about how living things are related. They can study cells, habitats, and inherited traits. Careful observation is useful.

examples.en: The bizarre hat made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 那頂奇怪的帽子讓大家笑了。

examples.en: We heard a bizarre noise from the old machine.
examples.zh: 我們聽到老機器發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: The story had a bizarre ending that surprised me.
examples.zh: 故事有個古怪的結局，讓我很驚訝。

explains: This describes something very strange or unusual. A fish with glowing spots may seem surprising. People may want to learn why it looks that way.
A story can include an event that is hard to explain. Readers may wonder whether it is real or make-believe. A surprising detail can make a tale exciting.
An unusual outfit may attract attention. People have different tastes in clothing. Kind comments are better than teasing.

examples.en: Blow three loud blasts on your emergency whistle to signal international distress.
examples.zh: 用力吹響隨身攜帶的高音救生哨發出「短吹三聲」長鳴，是全體搜救人員皆懂的國際求救信號。

examples.en: A sudden freezing blast of Arctic wind shook the alpine tents violently throughout the night.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的極地刺骨狂風呼嘯而過，整夜劇烈搖撼著高山露營營地上搭設的帳篷。

examples.en: Controlled dynamite blasts helped engineers carve the highway tunnel through solid granite mountains.
examples.zh: 精準定向的炸藥控制爆破工程，協助工程團隊在堅不可摧的堅硬花崗岩山體深處開鑿出公路隧道。

entries.definition: 哨子短促響亮的長鳴吹奏；爆炸
explains: This can mean a sudden loud explosion. A firework makes a bright flash and a loud sound in the sky. People should watch from a safe place.
A strong gust of air can make a loud noise as it passes. A door may shake when the wind hits it. The sound can startle people.
The verb can mean to make something explode or strike with great force. Stories may describe a sudden burst of light. Real explosives are dangerous.

examples.en: Rain blurred the writing on the paper.
examples.zh: 雨水模糊了紙上的字跡。

examples.en: The photo was a blur because the camera moved.
examples.zh: 相機移動，讓照片變得模糊。

examples.en: Tears blurred her view of the page.
examples.zh: 淚水模糊了她看書頁的視線。

explains: This means to make an image unclear or out of focus. Moving a camera too quickly can hide small details. Holding it still may help.
A person may find it hard to see clearly after rubbing their eyes. Resting can help their eyes feel better. They should tell an adult if it continues.
A line of ink can run when paper gets wet. The letters then become hard to read. Keeping the page dry protects the writing.

examples.en: She blushed when the class sang happy birthday to her.
examples.zh: 全班為她唱生日快樂歌時，她害羞得臉紅了。

examples.en: He blushed after making a small mistake.
examples.zh: 他犯了一個小錯後臉紅了。

examples.en: My cheeks blush in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 冷風吹來時，我的臉頰會泛紅。

explains: This means to turn red in the face, often because someone feels shy or embarrassed. A compliment may make a person feel warm. They might look down.
Strong heat or exercise can make cheeks turn red. A person should rest if they feel unwell. Drinking water can help after activity.
A ripe fruit may have a red outer skin. Color can show that it is ready to eat. People check fruit before choosing it.

examples.en: The bodyguard walked beside the singer.
examples.zh: 那名保鑣走在歌手身旁。

examples.en: A bodyguard checked the entrance before the event.
examples.zh: 活動開始前，保鑣檢查了入口。

examples.en: The actor thanked his bodyguard for staying nearby.
examples.zh: 演員感謝保鑣一直在附近保護他。

explains: This is a person whose job is to protect someone. A guard may walk beside a public figure in a crowd. The guard watches for danger.
A person with this job may check a doorway or travel route. Careful planning helps keep people safe. The worker follows clear rules.
Some stories include a protector who stays close to a king or hero. The character may be brave and alert. The role is to help prevent harm.

examples.en: Please tighten the bolt on the chair.
examples.zh: 請把椅子上的螺栓鎖緊。

examples.en: The gate has a bolt that slides into place.
examples.zh: 門閂可以滑進定位，固定大門。

examples.en: The rabbit bolted into its burrow when it heard a sound.
examples.zh: 兔子聽到聲音後，立刻衝進洞穴。

explains: This is a metal fastener with a rounded head and a threaded end. It can join pieces of wood or metal. A tool helps turn it tightly.
A small sliding bar can keep a door closed. Moving it across the frame secures the door. A person can pull it back to open the door.
The verb can mean to move away suddenly. A frightened horse may run from a loud noise. People should stay clear and calm.

examples.en: Tech employees rejoiced over generous year-end performance bonuses.
examples.zh: 科技業員工為領到豐厚的年終績效獎金而雀躍不已。

examples.en: The sales executive earned a lucrative quarterly commission bonus for breaking targets.
examples.zh: 業務經理因超額達成季度業績指標，領取了一筆極為豐厚可觀的季度分紅抽成獎金。

examples.en: As an added bonus, the boutique hotel offers all guests complimentary afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 作為一項令人驚喜的額外貼心款待，這家精品設計酒店為所有房客提供免費精緻下午茶。

explains: This is an extra reward added to what someone already receives. A worker may get extra pay for doing a good job. A game may give players an extra point.
A shop may include an additional item with a purchase. The gift can make the customer happy. It is separate from the main product.
A person can receive something extra for a special reason. A school may give a prize for excellent work. The reward encourages effort.

examples.en: The sound engineer operated a carbon-fiber boom mic just outside the camera frame.
examples.zh: 現場收音師熟練高舉超長碳纖維錄音吊桿麥克風，精準懸停於攝影機畫面邊緣上方收音。

examples.en: The boom operator must have exceptional shoulder strength to hold the microphone steady for long takes.
examples.zh: 吊桿麥克風操作員必須具備驚人的肩臂肌耐力，才能在長鏡頭一鏡到底時全程穩如泰山。

examples.en: Taiwan's semiconductor industry experienced an unprecedented global export boom in recent years.
examples.zh: 台灣高階半導體晶圓代工與先進封裝產業在近年迎來了前所未有的全球外銷出口繁榮大爆發。

examples.en: Streamlined train noses combined with entrance hoods completely eliminate loud tunnel sonic boom noise.
examples.zh: 流線型車頭設計搭配減壓洞門，徹底消除了列車高速穿出隧道時引發的「微氣壓波音爆」（Sonic Boom）。

examples.en: The seaside resort town experienced an unprecedented tourism boom after hosting the international surf festival.
examples.zh: 這座美麗的濱海度假小鎮在主辦國際衝浪節後，迎來了一場前所未有的觀光旅遊大繁榮。

examples.en: Fighter jets exceeding supersonic speed generate a thunderous sonic boom heard for miles around.
examples.zh: 超音速噴射戰鬥機在低空突破音障瞬間，會產生震耳欲聾的巨大音爆巨響，數英里外清晰可聞。

entries.definition: 錄音吊桿 (Boom Mic)；繁榮激增；列車高速衝入洞口產生之微氣壓波音爆消除；隆隆聲
explains: This can be a deep, loud sound. Thunder may make a low rumble during a storm. The sound can seem to shake windows.
It can describe a time when business or activity grows quickly. A town may get many new jobs. More people come to live and work there.
A long pole can hold a microphone above actors or speakers. A helper moves it quietly to capture sound. The pole stays outside the camera view.

examples.en: The kind note boosted her confidence.
examples.zh: 那張親切的便條增強了她的信心。

examples.en: The new road boosted business in the town.
examples.zh: 新道路促進了鎮上的商業活動。

examples.en: A short walk can boost your energy.
examples.zh: 散步一小段可以讓你恢復活力。

explains: This means to help something grow, rise, or become stronger. A good night’s sleep can help a tired person feel more energetic. Rest supports the body.
A coach may encourage a player after a mistake. Kind words can help the player try again. Practice can improve confidence.
A machine can push air or water with greater force. A fan moves air through a room. Adjusting its speed changes the amount.

examples.en: A lighted desktop spray booth with high-velocity exhaust fans evacuates toxic paint fumes safely outdoors.
examples.zh: 配備高風速排氣風扇與 LED 照明的桌上型噴漆箱，將有害漆霧安全抽出窗外。

examples.en: Visitors queued up outside the exhibition booth to try the new virtual reality gaming demo.
examples.zh: 參觀展覽的熱情民眾在科技大廠的展覽攤位前大排長龍，爭相搶先體驗最新發表的虛擬實境遊戲。

examples.en: She stepped into the soundproof recording booth to lay down voiceover tracks for the commercial.
examples.zh: 她緩步走進專業隔音錄音間配音室，在安靜無噪的環境中為即將上映的電視商業廣告錄製旁白。

entries.definition: 水簾抽風排氣模型噴漆箱
explains: This is a small enclosed space for one person or a few people. A worker may sit inside to sell tickets. A curtain or door gives privacy.
A fair may have a little stand where people play a game or buy snacks. Bright signs help visitors find it. Workers keep the area tidy. Workers keep the area tidy.
A phone call can take place in a soundproof space at a station. The closed walls make it easier to hear. People can talk privately.

examples.en: The long wait caused boredom for the children.
examples.zh: 漫長的等待讓孩子們感到無聊。

examples.en: She read a book to fight boredom on the bus.
examples.zh: 她在公車上看書來打發無聊時間。

examples.en: Boredom made him start drawing pictures.
examples.zh: 無聊時，他開始畫圖。

explains: This is the feeling of having nothing interesting to do. Waiting a long time without a game can feel dull. Finding a safe activity can help.
A person may feel restless during a repeated task. Taking a short break can refresh them. Changing the activity may make it more fun.
People can prevent this feeling by choosing a book, puzzle, or outdoor game. Sharing an activity with a friend can make time pass. They may enjoy it more together.

examples.en: The dog was bound to the tree with a soft lead.
examples.zh: 狗用柔軟的牽繩繫在樹旁。

examples.en: We are bound to see our cousins during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間，我們一定會見到表親。

examples.en: She felt bound by her promise to help.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己有義務履行幫忙的承諾。

explains: This describes something attached with a knot or fastener. A package can be tied with string. The knot keeps it closed.
It can describe a person who is sure to do something. Dark clouds may mean rain is likely to come. People can bring an umbrella.
A person may have a duty to do a task. A promise can make someone responsible for finishing it. Clear plans help.

examples.en: Setting clear personal boundaries prevents burnout from excessive commitments.
examples.zh: 學會劃定清晰堅定的人際心理界線，能防止因過度承攬過多請求而心力交瘁。

examples.en: Rivers often serve as the natural geographic boundary between neighboring countries.
examples.zh: 奔流的江河常常成為相鄰國境之間天然的地理界線。

examples.en: Healthy professional boundaries mean not answering non-urgent work emails past midnight.
examples.zh: 健全的職場邊界感意味著在午夜過後不再回覆非緊急的工作電子郵件。

examples.en: Spatial headsets dissolve the boundary between physical atoms and digital bits forever.
examples.zh: 空間運算頭戴設備，永遠消弭了「實體原子物理世界與數位位元世界之間的邊界」（Boundary）。

examples.en: Surveyors erected concrete boundary markers to clearly delineate the edge of the national park reserve.
examples.zh: 土地測量員設立混凝土界樁，以明確劃定國家自然公園保護區的外圍邊界線。

examples.en: Maintaining a healthy boundary between professional duty and family life is crucial for mental well-being.
examples.zh: 在職場工作職責與家庭私人生活之間維持健康的界線，對於心理健康至關重要。

entries.definition: 人際心理界線；邊界；徹底打破物理空間與數位資訊的隔閡邊界
explains: This is a line that marks where one area ends and another begins. A fence may show the edge of a garden. It helps people know where not to walk.
A map may draw a line between two towns or countries. The line helps travelers see which area they are in. It can also show where someone must follow different rules.
People may set personal limits about privacy or time. Others should respect those limits. Clear words can help explain them.

examples.en: The boxer trained carefully before the match.
examples.zh: 那位拳擊手在比賽前仔細訓練。

examples.en: A boxer dog wagged its tail at the park.
examples.zh: 一隻拳師犬在公園搖著尾巴。

examples.en: The young boxer practiced footwork with a coach.
examples.zh: 年輕拳擊手跟教練練習步法。

explains: This is an athlete who takes part in a sport where opponents punch with padded gloves. The athletes follow rules and wear protective gear. A referee watches closely.
Some dogs belong to a breed with a short muzzle and strong body. People care for them with exercise and attention. Each dog has its own personality.
The athlete practices footwork and defense. Training helps improve skill and fitness. Safety rules are important during a match.

examples.en: Constructive late-night talks achieved a historic diplomatic breakthrough.
examples.zh: 建設性的深夜閉門會談最終促成了一項極具里程碑意義的重大外交突破。

examples.en: Scientists announced a breakthrough in solar cell efficiency that lowers costs.
examples.zh: 科學家宣布了太陽能電池發電效率上的重大突破，大幅降低了成本。

examples.en: Perseverance is often required right before an engineer reaches an inventive breakthrough.
examples.zh: 在工程師達成發明上的關鍵重大突破之前，往往需要堅持不懈的毅力。

examples.en: The novel cancer drug was granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation by international drug regulators.
examples.zh: 該款針對罕見實體腫瘤的原創新藥，憑藉前所未見的顯著療效榮獲美國 FDA 頒發「突破性治療資格認定」。

examples.en: Scientists celebrated a major scientific breakthrough after synthesizing functional artificial chloroplasts.
examples.zh: 當科學家在實驗室中成功人工合成出具備完整光合作用機能的人工葉綠體時，全體研發同仁歡欣鼓舞熱烈慶祝。

examples.en: Continuous trial and error in the laboratory paved the way for this historic clinical breakthrough.
examples.zh: 在陰暗實驗室中經歷數千次失敗挫折與無悔嘗試，終於為這項改寫癌症治療史的歷史性臨床突破鋪平了道路。

examples.en: Achieving room-temperature quantum coherence would represent a Nobel Prize-worthy scientific breakthrough.
examples.zh: 一旦成功在常溫下實現長時間量子相干，將是足以斬獲諾貝爾獎、改寫人類文明的歷史性重大突破。

examples.en: The research consortium announced a technological breakthrough in suppressing phase noise inside silicon qubits.
examples.zh: 跨國前沿聯合研究團隊正式對外宣布，在抑制矽自旋量子位元相位雜訊上取得了突破性科技進展。

examples.en: Every engineering breakthrough in cryogenic microelectronics brings commercial quantum computing a step closer.
examples.zh: 極低溫微電子控制晶片的每一次工程重大突破，都讓通用型商業量子電腦的到來更向前邁進一大步。

examples.en: Granting breakthrough therapy designation expedited international regulatory review timelines.
examples.zh: 獲得官方授予「突破性療法資格認證」（Breakthrough Designation），大幅縮短了跨國新藥審查上市的漫長時程。

examples.en: Developing solid-state battery cells represents a monumental technological breakthrough for electric mobility.
examples.zh: 成功研發出全固態鋰電池技術，代表了全球電動車產業與綠色交通領域一場劃時代的重大技術突破。

examples.en: Archaeologists made a stunning breakthrough when they uncovered an undisturbed subterranean tomb chamber.
examples.zh: 考古學考察隊在古城遺址挖掘出一座未遭任何盜掘破壞的宏偉地下墓室，迎來了震驚考古界的重大突破。

examples.en: Nanometer optical manufacturing represents a pivotal breakthrough enabling lightweight smart glasses.
examples.zh: 奈米級光學微影技術的「歷史性重大突破」（Breakthrough），讓輕巧時尚的日常智慧眼鏡即將成為現實。

examples.en: Medical researchers hailed the discovery of this novel targeted antibody as a monumental cancer breakthrough.
examples.zh: 醫學研究人員讚譽這款新型標靶抗體的發現，是現代癌症治療史上的劃時代突破。

examples.en: After weeks of stalled bargaining, negotiators achieved a breakthrough in cross-strait trade talks.
examples.zh: 經過數週停滯不前的艱辛談判，雙方談判代表終於在跨國貿易協商中取得了關鍵突破。

examples.en: Developing climate-resilient synthetic crops marks a historic agricultural breakthrough for global food security.
examples.zh: 培育出抗極端氣候的合成生物農作物，標誌著捍衛全球糧食安全的一項「歷史性重大突破」（Breakthrough）。

examples.en: Medical oncologists cheered the landmark drug discovery as a revolutionary clinical cancer breakthrough.
examples.zh: 腫瘤臨床專科醫師齊聲熱烈讚譽這項劃時代的新藥研發成果，視其為人類對抗癌症史上的革命性突破。

examples.en: Diplomatic envoys achieved a long-awaited breakthrough during peace talks, signing a border disarmament pact.
examples.zh: 各國外交特使在和平談判桌上取得了眾所期盼的關鍵性外交突破，正式簽署了邊境非軍事化裁軍條約。

examples.en: Chip-scale atomic clocks represent a massive hardware breakthrough, fitting ultra-stable timekeeping onto a silicon die.
examples.zh: 「晶片級微型原子鐘」（Chip-Scale Atomic Clock）的重大突破，將原本大型儀器縮小至單一矽晶片上。

examples.en: The biomedical startup announced a major clinical breakthrough in non-invasive early Alzheimer's screening.
examples.zh: 這家生醫新創團隊正式對外宣布，在非侵入性早期阿茲海默症血液檢測領域取得了劃時代的臨床科研突破。

examples.en: After years of diplomatic deadlock, negotiators achieved a decisive breakthrough on carbon tariff standards.
examples.zh: 歷經多年的國際外交對峙與多輪艱難折衝，各國談判代表終於在跨國碳關稅認定標準上達成了決定性重大突破。

examples.en: Overcoming your fear of speaking represents a monumental cognitive breakthrough in your journey.
examples.zh: 克服開口恐懼並享受對話，是你在這趟英語旅程中迎來的「重大心智突破」（Breakthrough）。

examples.en: Scientists announced an unprecedented medical breakthrough that could cure several rare genetic disorders.
examples.zh: 科學家宣布了一項前所未有的醫學突破，有望治癒數種罕見的遺傳性疾病。

examples.en: Watching foreign movies without subtitles was an exhilarating linguistic breakthrough for her.
examples.zh: 能在不依賴字幕的情況下看懂外語原聲電影，對她而言是一次令人興奮的語言大突破。

entries.definition: 重大突破；轉機；重大進展；突破性治療資格認定；顛覆人類文明之物理科學重大突破；獲官方認可之癌症突破性療法資格；微型顯示器與全像光學波導歷史性重大突破；解決全球糧食與抗癌難題之生物學歷史性重大突破；晶片級微型銫原子鐘歷史性重大科技突破；突破；突破自我語言天花板之重大認知躍進
explains: This is an important new discovery or advance that solves a difficult problem. Scientists may find a better way to clean dirty water. The improvement can help many people.
A person may suddenly find a way to move past a hard obstacle. The new idea changes what they can do. Practice and teamwork can help.
In a story, a team may uncover a clue that changes the whole case. Their discovery points to a solution. The characters can make progress.

examples.en: Dad packed his papers in a briefcase.
examples.zh: 爸爸把文件裝進公事包。

examples.en: The lawyer carried a briefcase into the office.
examples.zh: 律師提著公事包走進辦公室。

examples.en: She set her briefcase beside the desk.
examples.zh: 她把公事包放在桌旁。

explains: This is a flat case with a handle used to carry papers or a computer. A worker may bring it to a meeting. It helps keep important items together.
A student can use this case to carry notebooks and pencils. Pockets help sort supplies. The handle makes it easy to hold.
The case may close with a clasp or zipper. Keeping it shut protects the contents. A label can help identify its owner.

examples.en: The Mao Gong Ding features a 500-character ritual inscription cast inside its ancient bronze bowl.
examples.zh: 西周晚期重器「毛公鼎」在青銅鼎腹內壁鑄刻了長達五百字的珍貴銘文，堪稱青銅器銘文之冠。

examples.en: Ritual bronze vessels were symbols of royal authority, sacrifice, and cosmic harmony in early dynasties.
examples.zh: 在商周早期王朝，祭祀青銅禮器代表著至高無上的王權象徵、祭天敬祖與天地宇宙的和諧秩序。

examples.en: Conservators removed thick green patina from the ritual bronze bell using delicate ultrasound tools.
examples.zh: 文物修復團隊運用高精密度超音波精密儀器，極其審慎地清除青銅編鐘表面有害的粉狀銅綠銹蝕。

entries.definition: 青銅禮器；青銅鼎；青銅製的
explains: This is a brown metal made by mixing copper with another metal, often tin. People used it long ago to make tools and statues. It is strong and durable.
A medal may have a brownish color like this metal. Athletes can win one for placing third. The award celebrates their effort.
Artists can use this metal to make a bell or sculpture. The object can last a long time. Its color may darken as it ages.

examples.en: I browsed the shelves for a book about space.
examples.zh: 我在書架間瀏覽太空主題的書。

examples.en: She browsed the website before ordering a gift.
examples.zh: 她在下單買禮物前瀏覽了網站。

examples.en: We browsed the market and found fresh peaches.
examples.zh: 我們逛遍市場，找到新鮮桃子。

explains: This means to look through items or pages without a fixed plan. A person may look at books in a shop until one catches their eye. They can take their time.
A person can visit pages on the internet to find information. Links lead to other places. They should check that sources are trustworthy.
A shopper may look over different products before deciding. Comparing prices and features can help. There is no need to hurry.

examples.en: He had a purple bruise on his arm after soccer.
examples.zh: 踢足球後，他手臂上有一塊紫色瘀青。

examples.en: The bruise faded after several days.
examples.zh: 幾天後，瘀青逐漸消退。

examples.en: She bruised her knee when she fell on the grass.
examples.zh: 她跌在草地上時撞傷了膝蓋。

explains: This is a dark mark under the skin after a bump. Small blood vessels may break, making the area change color. It usually fades over time.
A person may get a sore mark after falling or hitting a hard object. Resting the area may help. A trusted adult can check a serious injury.
The verb can mean to cause such a mark. A gentle bump may leave a colored spot. People should be careful during play.

examples.en: Cold bulk fermentation inside a 4°C refrigerator allows lactic acid bacteria to develop deep sourdough complexity.
examples.zh: 在四度低溫冰箱中進行長達二十四小時的冷藏主發酵，讓乳酸菌充分發酵出迷人風味。

examples.en: The baker watches for a fifty percent volume increase to judge when bulk fermentation is finished.
examples.zh: 烘焙師密切觀察麵團膨脹約五成體積的關鍵指標，以精準判斷初次主發酵是否圓滿成熟。

examples.en: Bubbles visible through clear plastic tubs indicate healthy gas production during bulk rise.
examples.zh: 從透明發酵保鮮盒側面觀察到密集的微小氣泡，代表麵團在初發階段產氣旺盛健康。

entries.definition: 24 小時低溫冷藏初次主發酵；體積
explains: This means a large amount or size. A large package may be difficult for one person to lift. Two people can carry it safely.
The main part of a crowd can move slowly through a doorway. People should avoid pushing. Wide exits make movement easier.
A shop may sell goods in large quantities rather than small packages. Buyers can share or store the extra items. Planning helps prevent waste.

examples.en: The bully apologized after the teacher spoke with him.
examples.zh: 老師和那名霸凌者談過後，他道了歉。

examples.en: Do not bully a younger student.
examples.zh: 不要欺負年紀較小的學生。

examples.en: A bully tried to scare the new child, but classmates helped.
examples.zh: 一名霸凌者試圖嚇唬新同學，但其他同學出面幫忙。

explains: This is a person who repeatedly frightens or hurts someone weaker. A student may tease or threaten a classmate again and again. The person being hurt should tell a trusted adult.
The verb means to frighten someone into doing something. Threats are not a kind way to solve a problem. Adults can help stop them.
Some dogs of a certain breed are called by this name. Each animal is different, so people should learn safe ways to approach dogs. Owners must act responsibly.

examples.en: She visited the travel bureau to ask about train tickets.
examples.zh: 她到旅行社詢問火車票的資訊。

examples.en: The writing bureau has several small drawers.
examples.zh: 那張有小抽屜的寫字桌可以收納文具。

examples.en: The bureau sent a notice about the new service.
examples.zh: 辦公機構寄出有關新服務的通知。

explains: This is an office or agency that provides a service. A travel office may help people plan a trip. Workers answer questions and keep records.
A desk with drawers for papers can have this name. Someone may use it to organize documents. Labels help keep each paper in the right place.
A government office may handle a certain kind of work. People visit it to get information or complete forms. Clear signs help visitors.

examples.en: The new form reduced bureaucracy at the school office.
examples.zh: 新表格減少了學校辦公室的繁瑣行政程序。

examples.en: They waited while the bureaucracy checked the request.
examples.zh: 他們等候行政機關審查這項申請。

examples.en: The club simplified its rules to avoid too much bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 社團簡化規則，避免過多行政程序。

explains: This is a system with many offices and rules for managing a large organization. People may need to fill in forms before a request is approved. Clear steps can help.
A large public service may have many workers with different jobs. Each office handles one part. The system can be slow if steps are unclear.
Rules and records can help an organization treat people fairly. Too many steps may make simple tasks take longer. Good design keeps the process understandable.

examples.en: The family held a burial beside the old church.
examples.zh: 家人在古老教堂旁舉行安葬儀式。

examples.en: Friends brought flowers to the burial.
examples.zh: 朋友們帶花參加安葬儀式。

examples.en: The burial ceremony gave the family time to remember him.
examples.zh: 安葬儀式讓家人有時間緬懷他。

explains: This is the act of placing a dead person in the ground or another resting place. Family and friends may gather to remember them. They can share kind stories.
A ceremony may follow the loss of a person. People can offer comfort to the family. Quiet respect is important.
Some communities have special customs for saying goodbye. Families may choose flowers, prayers, or music. Traditions can honor the person’s life.

examples.en: The butcher wrapped the meat in paper.
examples.zh: 肉販用紙包好肉品。

examples.en: The butcher prepared fresh cuts for the shop.
examples.zh: 肉販為商店準備新鮮肉塊。

examples.en: The butcher shop opened early on Saturday.
examples.zh: 肉舖星期六一大早就開門。

explains: This is a person who cuts and sells meat. They may prepare different pieces for customers. Clean tools and careful handling are important.
The verb can mean to cut up an animal for meat. This work requires special training and equipment. Food safety rules must be followed.
The word can also describe someone who buys and sells goods. A person may trade old tools at a market. The meaning depends on the situation.

examples.en: Submerging alginate droplets into a calcium bath triggers instant surface polymerization into a flexible skin.
examples.zh: 將海藻酸鈉滴液沉入「鈣離子水浴」（Calcium Bath），瞬間觸發表面交聯反應形成一層彈性薄膜。

examples.en: Nutritionists recommend fortified soy milk and dark leafy vegetables to maintain daily dietary calcium.
examples.zh: 營養學專家建議攝取高鈣強化豆漿與深綠色蔬菜，以補足每日所需飲食鈣質。

examples.en: Adequate calcium intake during teenage years helps build peak bone mineral density for adulthood.
examples.zh: 青少年時期維持充足的鈣質攝取，有助於成年後累積豐厚強健的骨質密度基石。

entries.definition: 氯化鈣水浴 (引發聚合物交聯凝膠化反應)；鈣
explains: This is a mineral element found in bones, teeth, and many foods. Milk and some vegetables contain it. People need it as part of a varied diet.
Doctors may measure this element in blood during a test. A health professional explains what the result means. One number alone does not tell the whole story.
The element is also used in some building materials. Chalk and limestone contain it. Rocks can hold many different minerals.

examples.en: Transiting the Panama Canal saves container freighters thousands of nautical miles around South America.
examples.zh: 穿越百年巴拿馬運河，為跨洋貨輪節省了繞道南美洲合恩角數千海里的航程與油耗。

examples.en: Grounding a giant megaship in the Suez Canal halted ten billion dollars in global trade every single day.
examples.zh: 超級巨輪長賜輪在蘇伊士運河意外擱淺卡死，曾造成全球每天高達上百億美元國際貿易瞬間停擺癱瘓。

examples.en: Expansion of the canal locks allows larger Neo-Panamax vessels to pass with heavier cargo loads.
examples.zh: 運河全新拓寬擴建水閘工程竣工後，允許吃水更深、載貨量更龐大的新巴拿馬型巨輪安全快速通航。

entries.definition: 蘇伊士運河與巴拿馬運河關鍵海運要衝
explains: This is a human-made waterway that boats can travel through. It may connect two rivers or seas. Locks can raise or lower a boat.
Some channels are built to carry water to farms. Gates control how much water flows. Farmers can use it for crops.
People can walk along the side and watch boats pass. Bridges cross over it at roads. It may be part of a city.

examples.en: Stretched linen canvas provides an archival, resilient surface for heavy oil paint layers.
examples.zh: 繃緊在實木內框上的頂級比利時亞麻油畫布，為多層厚塗油彩提供了抗氧化、不易脆化的專業載體。

examples.en: She packed her daily essentials inside a durable canvas backpack before catching the morning train.
examples.zh: 在搭乘清晨第一班區間車出發踏青前，她將雨傘、水壺等隨身必備物品妥善裝入厚實耐磨的帆布後背包。

examples.en: Campaign volunteers will canvas the local neighborhood this weekend to listen to community residents.
examples.zh: 青年志工團隊預計在本週末逐戶走訪基層社區鄰里，傾聽在地鄉親長輩對於老舊公寓都更工程的心聲。

examples.en: Spatial computing turns your entire physical room into an infinite, borderless productive canvas.
examples.zh: 空間運算將你的整個房間轉化為一塊無限延伸、毫無邊界的「三維工作畫布」（Canvas）。

examples.en: The oil painter primed a large stretched canvas with white gesso before beginning the landscape portrait.
examples.zh: 油畫家在開始繪製風景肖像畫前，先在大型繃布畫布上均勻塗抹白色底劑打底。

examples.en: Heavy water-resistant canvas tents shielded campers from fierce wind and pouring rain on the ridge.
examples.zh: 厚實防潑水的帆布帳篷在稜線上替露營登山客抵擋住了強勁的狂風與傾盆大雨。

entries.definition: 油畫布；帆布；擺脫實體螢幕限制之無限三維空間工作畫布；畫布
explains: This is a strong cloth used for painting or making bags. An artist stretches it over a frame before adding paint. Its rough surface holds the colors.
A heavy cloth can cover equipment or protect goods outdoors. It is made to last through regular use. Strong threads help it resist wear.
Artists can use this material to create a picture. They add colors and shapes with brushes. The finished work can hang on a wall.

examples.en: The robot has the capability to sort small blocks by color.
examples.zh: 機器人有能力依顏色分類小積木。

examples.en: Her capability to explain math helped the class.
examples.zh: 她解釋數學的能力幫助了全班。

examples.en: This camera has the capability to take clear pictures at night.
examples.zh: 這台相機能在夜間拍出清晰照片。

explains: This is the power or skill to do something. A student may learn to solve new kinds of puzzles. Practice builds skill over time.
A machine may be able to lift a certain weight. Its size and design set the limit. Workers read instructions before using it.
A person can do a task better after training. Asking questions and practicing can help. Different people have different strengths.

examples.en: Solid wood furniture acts as a permanent carbon vault, locking away atmospheric carbon for generations.
examples.zh: 原木實木家具宛如一座座堅固的固碳保險庫，將空氣中的碳元素永久鎖定在木質纖維中。

examples.en: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer delivers exceptional strength while drastically reducing bicycle frame weight.
examples.zh: 碳纖維複合增強材料在大幅減輕公路競速自行車車架重量的同時，提供了無與倫比的高剛性。

examples.en: Major corporations are investing in direct air capture facilities to remove industrial carbon from the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 國際跨國巨頭正大舉投資直接空氣捕捉新創設施，以期從大氣層中直接抽離工業二氧化碳。

explains: This is a chemical element found in living things and many materials. Plants take it from the air as they grow. It is part of many natural substances.
A pencil’s dark writing material contains this element. It leaves a mark on paper. Artists use it to draw lines and shade pictures.
Fuel made from ancient plants and animals contains this element. Burning such fuel releases gases into the air. Saving energy can reduce how much fuel people use.

examples.en: The carnival had colorful rides and games.
examples.zh: 園遊會有色彩繽紛的遊樂設施和遊戲。

examples.en: We watched a parade during the summer carnival.
examples.zh: 我們在夏季嘉年華會上觀看遊行。

examples.en: The school carnival raised money for new books.
examples.zh: 學校園遊會為新書募款。

explains: This is a lively public event with rides, games, music, or performances. Families may visit booths and try activities. Bright lights make it festive.
A town may hold this event each year to celebrate a season or tradition. Visitors can enjoy food and shows. Workers help keep the area safe.
People may dress in costumes and join a parade. Musicians and dancers move through the streets. The celebration can bring a community together.

examples.en: The adults visited a casino during their trip.
examples.zh: 大人們在旅行時去了賭場。

examples.en: The casino had card tables and bright lights.
examples.zh: 賭場裡有牌桌和明亮燈光。

examples.en: A casino worker explained the rules to the guests.
examples.zh: 賭場工作人員向客人解釋遊戲規則。

explains: This is a place where adults can play games for money. People may use cards, dice, or a wheel. The games have rules and prizes.
Visitors may find bright lights and many tables inside. Workers explain how games are played. Adults should follow the rules of the place.
Some people visit for entertainment while traveling. Games can also involve losing money. It is important to make careful choices.

examples.en: The cathedral bells rang across the town.
examples.zh: 大教堂的鐘聲響徹整座城鎮。

examples.en: We admired the tall windows inside the cathedral.
examples.zh: 我們欣賞大教堂裡高聳的窗戶。

examples.en: The old cathedral took many years to build.
examples.zh: 這座古老大教堂花了許多年才建成。

explains: This is a very large and important Christian church. It may have tall towers, stained-glass windows, and many seats. People may visit to pray or admire the design.
Builders may work for many years to complete a grand church. Stone arches and high ceilings can make the inside feel spacious. The building can be old.
A central church may serve a large area and hold special services. Visitors should speak quietly inside. Its art and history can attract people.

examples.en: Use caution when crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 穿越繁忙街道時請小心。

examples.en: The sign urged caution near the deep water.
examples.zh: 告示牌提醒大家在深水區附近要小心。

examples.en: She handled the glass bowl with caution.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地拿著玻璃碗。

explains: This means care taken to avoid danger or mistakes. A driver should slow down on a wet road. Careful actions help keep people safe.
A warning can tell people about a possible problem. A sign may ask visitors to watch their step near stairs. Reading signs matters.
People can act carefully around hot objects or sharp tools. An adult can show children how to use them safely. Good habits prevent injuries.

examples.en: The cautious hiker checked the path before stepping forward.
examples.zh: 謹慎的登山客先檢查小徑才往前走。

examples.en: Be cautious around a dog you do not know.
examples.zh: 接近不熟悉的狗時要小心。

examples.en: She was cautious when carrying the full cup.
examples.zh: 她小心地拿著裝滿水的杯子。

explains: This describes someone who thinks carefully before acting. A child may look both ways before crossing a street. Checking first can prevent harm.
A person may move slowly around a frightened animal. Giving it space helps everyone stay safe. Calm actions are important.
Someone can check a plan for mistakes before beginning. Reading the instructions twice may help. Careful preparation saves time.

examples.en: The celebrity waved to fans outside the theater.
examples.zh: 那位名人向劇院外的粉絲揮手。

examples.en: A famous celebrity visited our school.
examples.zh: 一位名人到我們學校參觀。

examples.en: The young celebrity signed books for her readers.
examples.zh: 那位年輕名人替讀者簽書。

explains: This is a person who is known by many people, often from acting, sports, or music. Fans may recognize the person from television or news. Many people follow their work.
A well-known person may attend a public event. People sometimes ask for a photo or signature. The person may need privacy too.
Someone can become known for helping a community or making an important discovery. News stories may share their work. Being well known does not mean everyone knows them personally.

examples.en: The family visited the cemetery on Sunday.
examples.zh: 家人星期天到墓園探望。

examples.en: A stone marker stood in the old cemetery.
examples.zh: 古老的墓園裡有一座石碑。

examples.en: They planted flowers near their grandparents’ graves in the cemetery.
examples.zh: 他們在墓園裡祖父母的墓旁種花。

explains: This is a place where people who have died are buried. Rows of markers may show their names and dates. Families sometimes visit to remember them.
The grounds may have trees, paths, and quiet spaces. Visitors should act respectfully. Workers care for the area.
A person can leave flowers or stand quietly near a loved one’s resting place. People may follow different customs. Kind support matters to grieving families.

examples.en: The opening ceremony of the sports games was spectacular.
examples.zh: 運動會的開幕典禮場面十分壯觀隆重。

examples.en: Our high school graduation ceremony will be held in the main gymnasium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們的高中畢業典禮將於明天在學校體育館主館隆重舉行。

examples.en: The traditional tea ceremony requires patience, calm posture, and precise focus.
examples.zh: 傳統茶道儀式講求沉著耐心、端正儀態以及高度專注的心境。

examples.en: The traditional Taiwanese tea ceremony emphasizes mindfulness, hospitality, and seasonal flower arrangements.
examples.zh: 台灣當代茶道茶藝注重靜心泡茶、以茶待客之道，並融合典雅的四季插花茶席美學。

examples.en: Graduating medical students took the Hippocratic Oath during a solemn commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 醫學院畢業生在莊嚴隆重的畢業典禮上，齊聲莊嚴宣讀希波克拉底誓詞。

examples.en: An elaborate ribbon-cutting ceremony marked the official opening of the new light rail transit line.
examples.zh: 地方首長與貴賓出席了隆重的剪綵典禮，正式宣告全新輕軌捷運路線通車營運。

entries.definition: 儀式；典禮；禮節；台灣茶藝茶道；典禮儀式
explains: This is a formal event held for a special reason. People may gather to celebrate, remember, or welcome someone. There may be music and speeches.
A school may hold a special event to honor students. Families watch as names are called. The event can mark an important achievement.
Some events follow traditions passed down over time. People may wear special clothes or say certain words. Customs can differ between communities.

examples.en: She spoke with certainty about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 她很確定地說出會議時間。

examples.en: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 不確定明天會不會下雨。

examples.en: He checked the label to know with certainty which box was his.
examples.zh: 他查看標籤，確定哪個箱子是他的。

explains: This is a strong feeling that something is true or will happen. A student may feel sure after checking the answer twice. Careful work can build confidence.
A fact can be known clearly when there is good evidence. A scientist records observations and checks results. More information can remove doubt.
People may not always know exactly what will happen next. They can make a plan while staying ready for changes. Asking questions can help.

examples.en: A valid SSL certificate ensures the website connection is encrypted and authentic.
examples.zh: 有效的 SSL 數位安全憑證能保證瀏覽器與網站之間的連線安全加密無虞。

examples.en: Browsers display a warning warning users if a website's security certificate is expired.
examples.zh: 如果網站的安全憑證過期，瀏覽器會向使用者顯示安全警告。

examples.en: She received a professional certificate after completing the data science course.
examples.zh: 她在完成資料科學課程後獲得了一張專業結業證書。

examples.en: Purchasing verified Taiwan Renewable Energy Certificates (T-RECs) documents compliance with ESG export rules.
examples.zh: 購買通過官方嚴格核發的台灣再生能源憑證，是跨國企業符合歐盟與國際 ESG 規範的有力鐵證。

examples.en: Each electronic REC certificate represents one thousand kilowatt-hours of clean green power generated.
examples.zh: 每一張電子綠電憑證（T-REC）皆代表一千度（1,000 kWh）真實發出並注入電網的綠色潔淨電力。

examples.en: Regulators audit green certificate registers to prevent fraudulent double-counting of renewable credits.
examples.zh: 國家能源主管機關嚴密稽核官方綠電憑證媒合平台資料庫，徹底杜絕任何重複申報與雙重計算弊端。

entries.definition: 數位安全憑證；證書；執照；台灣再生能源綠電憑證 (T-REC)
explains: This is an official paper or digital record that proves something. A school may give one after a student finishes a course. It carries important details.
A person may need a record to show that they passed a test or have permission. The document may include a name and date. Keep it safe.
A computer system may use a digital record to prove who sent a message. It helps users check identity. Security tools protect the information.

examples.en: The wind and rain created chaos in the garden.
examples.zh: 風雨讓花園一片混亂。

examples.en: There was chaos in the kitchen when the cake fell.
examples.zh: 蛋糕掉下來時，廚房裡亂成一團。

examples.en: There was chaos after the classroom door slammed shut.
examples.zh: 教室門砰然關上後，大家一陣混亂。

explains: This is a state of great confusion or disorder. Toys scattered across every room can make a house look this way. Sorting them can help.
A sudden emergency may make people unsure what to do. Clear directions can help everyone stay calm. Helpers can guide the group.
A busy room with many people talking at once may feel hard to manage. Taking turns speaking can improve order. Simple rules help.

examples.en: The travelers stopped at a chapel beside the road.
examples.zh: 旅客在路旁的小教堂停留。

examples.en: The hospital chapel was quiet in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 醫院的小禮拜堂下午很安靜。

examples.en: A small chapel stood near the village school.
examples.zh: 村莊學校附近有一座小教堂。

explains: This is a small building or room used for Christian worship. It may stand beside a hospital, school, or larger church. People can pray there quietly.
The room may have benches, a simple altar, and windows. Visitors should speak softly. Some places hold short services there.
A family may gather in a small worship space for a special service. The setting can feel calm. People follow the customs of their faith.

examples.en: The story characterizes the king as fair and kind.
examples.zh: 故事把國王描寫成公平又善良的人。

examples.en: Bright colors characterize the artist’s early paintings.
examples.zh: 鮮豔的色彩是這位藝術家早期畫作的特色。

examples.en: The report characterizes the bird by its long tail and curved beak.
examples.zh: 報告以長尾巴和彎曲鳥喙描述這種鳥。

explains: This means to describe the main qualities of a person or thing. A writer may show that a character is brave through actions. Readers learn what the person is like.
A person can describe a place by naming its colors, sounds, and shapes. Details help someone imagine it. Clear examples make the picture stronger.
A scientist may explain features shared by a group of animals. Careful observations support the description. The details help people compare them.

examples.en: The executive chef prepared a gourmet five-course meal.
examples.zh: 行政主廚精心準備了精緻的五道菜套餐。

examples.en: Master chefs blend traditional ingredients with innovative modern cooking techniques.
examples.zh: 頂級名廚將傳統在地食材與創新的現代料理廚藝手法融會貫通。

examples.en: The pastry chef crafted an exquisite multi-tiered wedding cake adorned with sugar flowers.
examples.zh: 西點主廚精心烘培了一座點綴著精緻糖花的多層奢華婚禮蛋糕。

explains: This is a person whose job is to prepare food in a kitchen. The person follows recipes and keeps the work area clean. Good timing helps meals come together.
A skilled kitchen worker may plan meals and choose fresh ingredients. The person tastes dishes as they cook. Careful work helps food taste good.
Some kitchen workers lead a team and organize its tasks. They make sure food is ready at the right time. Clean tools help keep meals safe.

examples.en: The indigenous children's choir sang heavenly tribal harmony melodies.
examples.zh: 原住民兒童合唱團演唱了如天籟般純淨動人的部落天籟和聲。

examples.en: Joining the church choir on Sundays brought joy and solace to her retirement years.
examples.zh: 週日主日加入教會詩班合唱團獻唱，為她的退休銀髮生活注入了無比喜樂與慰藉。

examples.en: The choir received a thunderous standing ovation at the international choral competition.
examples.zh: 該合唱團在世界合唱奧林匹克大賽中贏得了全場如雷貫耳的起立鼓掌致敬。

explains: This is a group of people who sing together. They may perform at a school, church, or concert hall. A leader helps them stay in time.
Members practice the same song so their voices blend. They may sing high or low notes. Listening to one another helps the group sound balanced.
A music teacher may direct the singers during a performance. The group follows the beat and watches for cues. Practice helps them begin and stop together.

examples.en: She played a bright chord on the piano.
examples.zh: 她在鋼琴上彈出明亮和弦。

examples.en: The guitarist changed to a different chord.
examples.zh: 吉他手換彈另一個和弦。

examples.en: A warm chord ended the song.
examples.zh: 溫暖的和弦為歌曲畫下句點。

explains: This is a group of musical notes played together. A guitar player can press several strings at once. The sound can support a song.
In music, notes can be arranged to sound pleasant or tense. Musicians practice changing from one group of notes to another. Their hands must move carefully.
A musical group of notes can help create a feeling in a song. It may sound joyful, calm, or sad. Listening closely helps people notice the effect.

examples.en: Taking out the trash is my weekly chore.
examples.zh: 倒垃圾是我每週的家務之一。

examples.en: He finished his chores before playing outside.
examples.zh: 他做完家事才到外面玩。

examples.en: Her chore was to feed the family’s cat.
examples.zh: 她的家務是餵家裡的貓。

explains: This is a small job that needs to be done regularly. A child may put toys away after playing. Finishing it helps keep the home tidy.
People may share simple jobs at home. One person sets the table while another washes vegetables. Working together saves time.
A list can remind someone what needs doing. Crossing off finished jobs feels good. A routine helps people remember.

examples.en: Regular health checkups help detect chronic conditions like high cholesterol early.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於及早發現高膽固醇等慢性健康問題。

examples.en: He struggled with chronic insomnia caused by prolonged career stress.
examples.zh: 長期沈重的工作職業壓力讓他常年深受慢性失眠之苦。

examples.en: Managing chronic back pain often requires a combination of therapy and exercise.
examples.zh: 妥善控制慢性的下背痛問題通常需要搭配物理治療與核心肌力鍛鍊。

entries.definition: 慢性的；長期的；積習難改的
explains: This describes a problem that lasts for a long time. A long-lasting cough may continue for weeks. A health professional can explain what to do.
A repeated habit can be hard to change. Practicing a new routine may help someone improve it. Support from others can be useful.
A condition that continues over time may need ongoing attention. People can keep notes about what they notice. A qualified professional can offer guidance.

examples.en: The chubby puppy rolled onto its back.
examples.zh: 那隻胖嘟嘟的小狗翻身躺下。

examples.en: A chubby squirrel carried an acorn up the tree.
examples.zh: 一隻圓滾滾的松鼠把橡實帶上樹。

examples.en: The baby had chubby cheeks and a bright smile.
examples.zh: 寶寶有著胖胖的臉頰和燦爛笑容。

explains: This describes someone or an animal with a round, soft body. A small puppy may look this way after a good meal. Its shape can seem cuddly.
A baby’s cheeks may be round and full. Families often find this look sweet. Every healthy body has a different shape.
A soft object can also be round and thick. A cushion may feel comfortable to hug. Shape and size can vary.

examples.en: Add a chunk of cheese to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一大塊起司。

examples.en: He cut the wood into a small chunk.
examples.zh: 他把木頭切成一小塊。

examples.en: A large chunk of ice floated past the boat.
examples.zh: 一大塊冰從船旁漂過。

explains: This is a thick piece or portion cut from a larger whole. A cook may add a piece of cheese to a dish. It gives a rich taste.
A broken rock may fall into several large pieces. Workers can move them one at a time. Smaller pieces are easier to carry.
A story may be divided into parts for reading. Each part can cover one event. A short part is easier to finish at once.

examples.en: Designing shallow quantum circuits minimizes runtime before thermal noise degrades the calculation.
examples.zh: 設計淺層量子邏輯電路，能在熱雜訊破壞運算前以最高速度完成演算法。

examples.en: Compiling the quantum circuit reorders operations to respect the physical topology of the chip.
examples.zh: 將高階量子電路編譯轉譯時，軟體會智慧重新排列閘順序以嚴格契合實體晶片的底層物理拓撲。

examples.en: The circuit depth measures how many sequential gate steps must be performed from start to finish.
examples.zh: 量子電路深度（Circuit Depth）是衡量演算法從頭到尾必須循序執行多少道邏輯閘步驟的核心指標。

examples.en: Synthetic gene regulatory circuits program cells to glow green only when they detect toxic heavy metals.
examples.zh: 「人工合成基因邏輯電路」（Gene Circuit），能編程細胞唯有在偵測到有毒重金屬時才發出綠色螢光。

examples.en: The electrician traced the short circuit back to a loose connection inside the junction box.
examples.zh: 水電技師循線追查短路故障源頭，最終定位在電線接線盒內部一處鬆脫的端子接頭。

examples.en: Formula One racers sped around the challenging coastal street circuit in Monaco under clear skies.
examples.zh: 一級方程式賽車好手在晴朗天候下，全速馳騁於摩納哥極具挑戰性的濱海街道賽道中。

entries.definition: 深度量子演算法執行邏輯電路；電路；人工合成基因調控邏輯電路 (邏輯閘開關)
explains: This is a path that electric current follows through connected parts. A battery can send power along wires to a small light. A closed path lets the light turn on.
A road or train route may form a loop that returns to its starting place. Travelers can follow signs around it. The route connects several stops.
The word can name a series of sports or racing events held in different places. Players travel from one event to the next. Scores may be compared.

examples.en: Please cite the book you used in your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告中引用你使用的書籍。

examples.en: The teacher cited a poem during the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上引用了一首詩。

examples.en: She cited two sources to support her idea.
examples.zh: 她引用兩個來源來支持自己的想法。

explains: This means to name a source or example as support for an idea. A student may mention a book when writing a report. The reader can find the information there.
A speaker can point to a fact that supports an answer. Giving the source helps others check it. Honest work credits where ideas came from.
Writers may name a person’s words or work. They should show who created it. This respects the original author.

examples.en: Active global citizenship requires understanding international issues and contributing to humanity's progress.
examples.zh: 踐行「世界公民素養」（Global Citizenship），要求我們關心氣候、和平與科技發展，為人類進步貢獻心力。

examples.en: Schools teach digital citizenship so students can evaluate online content with critical insight.
examples.zh: 現代學校積極傳授數位公民素養，讓學生在面對網路龐雜資訊時具備批判思考與辨別能力。

examples.en: After living abroad as a permanent resident for five years, she officially applied for citizenship.
examples.zh: 在海外以永久居民身分生活五年後，她正式向移民主管機關遞交了公民身份歸化申請。

entries.definition: 具備全球關懷與永續視野之世界公民素養；公民身份
explains: This is the legal membership and relationship a person has with a country. It can come with rights and duties. Laws explain how people gain it.
People may take part in their community by voting, helping neighbors, or learning local rules. These actions show care for the place where they live. They can also listen to others.
A person may belong to more than one culture or community. They can respect different traditions. Taking part helps people feel connected.

examples.en: The students joined a civic project to clean the park.
examples.zh: 學生參加了清理公園的社區活動。

examples.en: Voting is one way to take part in civic life.
examples.zh: 投票是參與公共生活的一種方式。

examples.en: The town held a civic celebration in the main square.
examples.zh: 鎮上在主要廣場舉辦社區慶典。

explains: This describes things related to a town, city, or its people. A local park is a shared place for neighbors. Residents can help care for it.
People may join projects that improve their community. They can clean a street or plant trees. Small efforts make public places nicer.
Rules and services can help a city work well. People can attend meetings and share ideas. Listening helps leaders understand what residents need.
