examples.en: Savoring fine tea clears the restless mind, bringing serene emotional clarity and insight.
examples.zh: 靜下心來細品一杯好茶，能洗滌平日紛擾雜亂的思緒，為內心帶來無比平靜澄澈的定力與智慧。

examples.en: The executive drafted the memo with admirable clarity, leaving no ambiguity regarding project milestones.
examples.zh: 這位營運長撰寫的專案備忘錄條理極為分明清晰，針對各階段關鍵里程碑與權責分工毫無模糊空間。

examples.en: The jeweler inspected the diamond's internal purity and optical clarity under a tenfold magnification loupe.
examples.zh: 珠寶鑑定大師手持十倍放大鏡，在專業光源下細細檢視這顆克拉鑽石內部的純淨度與透亮光學淨度。

examples.en: Rigorous philosophical inquiry cuts through emotional fog, bringing diamond-sharp clarity to difficult decisions.
examples.zh: 嚴密的哲學思辨能如利刃般切開迷惘的情緒迷霧，為人生的重大關鍵抉擇帶來如鑽石般澄澈明亮的定見（Clarity）。

examples.en: The CEO articulated the company’s five-year expansion roadmap with impressive strategic clarity.
examples.zh: 執行長在全體員工大會上條理分明、言簡意賅地闡述了企業未來五年的全球擴張戰略藍圖，思路極其清晰明確。

examples.en: A gemologist grades precious emeralds based on their vivid green saturation, cut symmetry, and internal clarity.
examples.zh: 國際珠寶鑑定大師依據濃郁正綠色飽和度、精準切割對稱比例以及寶石內部純淨無瑕的透亮淨度（Clarity）為頂級祖母綠評級。

examples.en: Exceptional acoustic clarity allows listeners to distinguish individual flute trills within a full orchestral fortissimo.
examples.zh: 極致的「聲學清晰度」（Clarity），讓聽眾即使在全樂團最強奏中，依然能清晰分辨長笛細膩的顫音。

examples.en: The crystal-clear mountain stream flowed with such clarity that swimming trout were easily visible.
examples.zh: 高山溪澗清洌甘甜，水質澄澈純淨到連在卵石間悠游穿梭的野生鱒魚都清晰可見。

examples.en: The economics professor explained complex monetary inflation theories with admirable simplicity and clarity.
examples.zh: 這位經濟學名教授以令人讚嘆的深入淺出與條理分明，清晰透徹地剖析了繁複的貨幣通膨理論。

entries.definition: 思緒清明澄澈；清晰度；思緒清明透徹；獨奏鋼琴微弱觸鍵之清脆晶瑩聲音清晰度；清晰
explains: This is the quality of being easy to see, hear, or understand. Large letters make a sign easier to read. Good lighting can help too.
A clear speaker uses simple words and an organized order. Listeners can follow the main idea. Examples make a message easier to grasp.
A picture may have sharp lines and distinct shapes. Viewers can notice small details. Careful focus improves the image.

examples.en: Review the liability limitation clause in the service agreement carefully.
examples.zh: 仔細審閱該服務提供協議書中關於損害賠償責任限制的合約條款。

examples.en: The contract includes an arbitration clause specifying that all disputes must be resolved in Taipei.
examples.zh: 該商業合約中特別增設了一道強制仲裁條款，載明雙方未來一切履約紛爭均須提交台北仲裁機構裁決。

examples.en: The employer inserted a non-compete clause that restricts departing staff from joining competitors for one year.
examples.zh: 資方在勞動合約中特別載入競業禁止條款，嚴格限制離職員工在離職後一年內不得投奔同業競品公司。

entries.definition: 合約條款；款項；文法子句
explains: This is a part of a sentence that contains a subject and a verb. It can be complete or depend on another part. Punctuation helps show how ideas connect.
A written agreement may have a section that states one rule. Each section helps explain what people have agreed to do. Reading carefully is important.
A sentence can contain several parts joined by words such as “because” or “when.” These parts add details. Good punctuation helps readers follow them.

examples.en: The toddler clung to her father’s hand.
examples.zh: 幼兒緊緊握住爸爸的手。

examples.en: Wet leaves clung to the window.
examples.zh: 濕葉子黏在窗戶上。

examples.en: The kitten clung to the blanket during the car ride.
examples.zh: 車程中，小貓緊緊抓著毛毯。

explains: This means to hold tightly to something. A child may hold a parent’s hand while crossing a busy street. The grip can help the child feel safe.
A wet shirt can stick to skin on a hot day. The fabric stays close until it dries. Loose clothing may feel cooler.
A person can stay close to a group or idea. Friends may remain together during a difficult time. Supporting one another can help.

examples.en: The clinical team checked the patient’s chart.
examples.zh: 臨床團隊檢查了病人的病歷。

examples.en: Students learned about clinical tests in health class.
examples.zh: 學生在健康課學習臨床檢查。

examples.en: The report described a clinical study with adult volunteers.
examples.zh: 報告描述一項由成年志願者參加的臨床研究。

explains: This describes something related to doctors, patients, or medical treatment. A nurse may use a careful method to check a person’s health. Clear records help the care team.
A medical study may test an idea with patients under close supervision. Researchers follow a plan and record results. Safety rules are important.
A clean, plain style can also be called this. A room with white walls and simple furniture may have that look. The design keeps attention on the work.

examples.en: The customizable 12-inch instrument cluster displays live 3D navigation maps between gauges.
examples.zh: 十二吋全數位虛擬液晶儀表板支援客製化切換模式，能在時速表之間直接全螢幕顯示立體導航地圖。

examples.en: Astronomers aimed the observatory telescope at the Pleiades star cluster glittering in the Taurus constellation.
examples.zh: 高山天文學家將大型望遠鏡精準對準在金牛座中閃耀如璀璨鑽石的七姊妹昴宿星團。

examples.en: High-tech hardware companies formed a collaborative industrial cluster around the Hsinchu Science Park.
examples.zh: 頂尖半導體與高科技零組件企業，在新竹科學園區周圍形成了舉世聞名且高度垂直整合的產業聚落。

examples.en: Hsinchu Science Park forms a tightly knit industrial cluster where suppliers, fabs, and designers collaborate.
examples.zh: 新竹科學園區（竹科）形成了全球最緊密高效的半導體產業聚落（Cluster），上下游協同合作極具效率。

examples.en: A dense cluster of ripe purple grapes hung gracefully from the wooden trellis in the vineyard.
examples.zh: 一串串熟透飽滿的紫黑甜美葡萄沉甸甸地懸掛在觀光果園的原木棚架下，在微風中散發著誘人果香。

examples.en: Epidemiologists worked urgently to trace the source of a sudden cluster of viral influenza cases at the boarding school.
examples.zh: 疾管署流行病學防疫專家火速進駐該私立寄宿中學，全力疫調追查這起突如其來的群聚性流感感染源頭。

entries.definition: 全數位液晶儀表板；星團；群；新竹科學園區半導體產業聚落
explains: This is a group of similar things close together. A group of stars may look like a bright patch in the night sky. A telescope helps people see it.
A group of buildings can form one area for a certain kind of work. The buildings may share roads and services. Workers travel between them.
Small fruits may grow close together on a stem. A gardener can pick them carefully. The grouped shape makes them easy to notice.

examples.en: The health lesson explained why cocaine is dangerous.
examples.zh: 健康課說明了古柯鹼為什麼危險。

examples.en: The police found cocaine hidden in the bag.
examples.zh: 警方在袋子裡發現藏匿的古柯鹼。

examples.en: The story described how cocaine harmed the character’s life.
examples.zh: 故事描述古柯鹼如何傷害角色的生活。

explains: This is a powerful illegal drug made from a plant. It can harm a person’s health and lead to serious problems. People should stay away from it.
The substance can change how the brain and body work. It is dangerous and against the law in many places. A person who needs help should speak to a trusted adult or health professional.
News stories may discuss this drug when explaining crime or health risks. Facts should be shared carefully. No one should try unknown substances.

examples.en: The family placed flowers on the coffin.
examples.zh: 家人在棺木上放了鮮花。

examples.en: The wooden coffin was carried to the cemetery.
examples.zh: 木製棺木被抬往墓園。

examples.en: The story described a coffin inside an ancient tomb.
examples.zh: 故事描述古墓中的一具棺木。

explains: This is a box used to hold a dead person’s body before burial. Families may choose one for a funeral. People treat it with respect.
The box may be made from wood or another material. It is placed in a grave or resting place. Customs differ among families.
A story about an old burial may mention this container. The scene can feel sad. Kind support matters when people grieve.

examples.en: Quality sleep enhances daytime cognitive speed, memory consolidation, and creative inspiration.
examples.zh: 優質充沛的睡眠能全方位提升白天的思維敏捷度、邏輯決策力、記憶力固化與創意靈感迸發。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise supports neuroplasticity, protecting against age-related cognitive decline.
examples.zh: 規律進行慢跑等有氧耐力運動能促進大腦神經可塑性，有效防範年長者出現不可逆的認知功能退化。

examples.en: The neuroscientist measured cognitive load during complex multi-tasking problem-solving sessions.
examples.zh: 腦神經科學家透過精密儀器即時監測受試者在執行繁複多工運算任務時，前額葉大腦皮層的認知負荷。

examples.en: Seniors solve math puzzles and play mahjong as fun cognitive exercises to keep their brains sharp.
examples.zh: 社區關懷據點長輩們一起打麻將與玩數獨，透過生動有趣的大腦認知訓練活化思緒。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise has been shown to slow down age-related cognitive decline significantly.
examples.zh: 研究顯示規律的有氧運動能顯著延緩隨年齡增長而出現的認知功能退化。

examples.en: The psychologist conducted standard tests to evaluate the patient's cognitive perception and memory recall.
examples.zh: 心理學家進行了標準化測驗，以評估病患的認知感知與記憶提取能力。

entries.definition: 大腦認知思維專注的；大腦認知功能刺激訓練的
explains: This describes thinking, learning, remembering, and understanding. A puzzle can help a child practice memory and problem-solving. Different tasks use different skills.
A person may use their mind to compare choices. Writing a list of good and bad points can help. Taking time can improve decisions.
Some activities use attention and memory. Reading, counting, and following steps all require thinking. Rest helps people focus.

examples.en: Her explanation was coherent and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她的解釋清楚連貫，容易理解。

examples.en: The report gave a coherent account of the event.
examples.zh: 報告連貫地敘述了這件事。

examples.en: He organized his notes into a coherent story.
examples.zh: 他把筆記整理成一個連貫的故事。

explains: This describes ideas that are clear and fit together logically. A story is easier to follow when events come in order. Clear links help the reader understand.
A speaker can share ideas in a way that makes sense. They explain one point before moving to the next. Examples can make the message clearer.
A group can create a plan that everyone understands. Members agree on the steps and their order. Clear planning prevents confusion.

examples.en: It was a coincidence that we wore the same color.
examples.zh: 我們剛好穿了同一種顏色，真巧。

examples.en: By coincidence, the twins chose the same book.
examples.zh: 碰巧，雙胞胎選了同一本書。

examples.en: What a coincidence! We both live on the same street.
examples.zh: 真巧！我們住在同一條街上。

explains: This is an event that happens by chance when two things occur at the same time. Two friends may meet unexpectedly at a store. Neither planned to be there.
People may notice that they have the same birthday as a new classmate. The match can feel surprising. It happened without planning.
A surprising match can make people smile. They may share the story with others. Not every unusual event has a special cause.

examples.en: Effective cross-cultural collaboration boosts creative innovation.
examples.zh: 高效的跨文化合作能激發出豐沛的創意思維與創新。

examples.en: The new electric scooter is the fruit of close collaboration between two tech firms.
examples.zh: 這款嶄新的智慧聯網電動機車，是兩大科技巨擘歷時兩年密切通力協作的璀璨結晶。

examples.en: Online document editing tools facilitate real-time collaboration among remote teams.
examples.zh: 線上即時共同編輯工具，為分散全球各地的跨國遠端團隊提供了無縫即時協作體驗。

examples.en: The sneaker brand launched a limited crossover collaboration with a famous anime.
examples.zh: 該人氣運動潮鞋品牌推出了與知名動漫超人氣 IP 的限量跨界聯名合作款。

examples.en: Effective team collaboration relies heavily on modern cloud communication tools.
examples.zh: 高效的團隊協同作業高度仰賴現代化的雲端協作溝通工具。

examples.en: The scientific breakthrough was the fruit of international collaboration across three continents.
examples.zh: 這項重大科學突破是橫跨三大洲的跨國合作所結出的豐碩果實。

examples.en: Cross-border holographic collaboration accelerates automotive design cycles by months.
examples.zh: 跨國團隊進行「全像遠距協同設計」（Collaboration），能將全新電動汽車的研發週期大幅縮短數個月。

examples.en: Effective inter-departmental collaboration between sales and engineering ensured on-time software delivery.
examples.zh: 業務部與研發部之間緊密有效的跨部門協作，確保了旗艦軟體產品如期上線交件。

examples.en: The famous university announced a research collaboration with local hospitals to fight rare diseases.
examples.zh: 這所頂尖名校宣布與在地多家醫院展開臨床研究合作，攜手對抗罕見疾病。

entries.definition: 合作；通力協作；跨界合作；協同作業；聯名；跨國工程師在同一虛擬晶片模型前協同設計
explains: This is the act of working together on a task. Two students may share ideas to make a poster. Each person can contribute a different skill.
People can join their efforts to solve a problem. One person may plan while another builds. Sharing ideas can improve the result.
A company may work with another group to create a product. Each side brings its own knowledge. Clear communication helps the partners succeed.

examples.en: The collective effort helped clean the entire beach.
examples.zh: 大家共同努力，清理了整片海灘。

examples.en: The club made a collective decision to plant trees.
examples.zh: 社團共同決定要種樹。

examples.en: The team’s collective strength helped them finish the race.
examples.zh: 全隊的力量幫助他們完成了比賽。

explains: This describes something shared by a whole group. A class may make one large drawing together. Each student adds a small part.
People can make a decision as a group. They listen to one another and choose a plan. Everyone shares the result.
A community may share a goal or responsibility. Members help in different ways. Working together can make the goal easier to reach.

examples.en: The collector showed us a book of rare stamps.
examples.zh: 收藏家給我們看一本珍稀郵票集。

examples.en: A coin collector found an old silver piece.
examples.zh: 一位錢幣收藏者找到一枚古老的銀幣。

examples.en: The art collector donated a painting to the museum.
examples.zh: 藝術收藏家把一幅畫捐給博物館。

explains: This is someone who gathers or saves a certain kind of object. A person may keep stamps from many countries. Each item can have a story.
A museum worker may gather old tools for an exhibit. The worker records where each one came from. Careful storage protects them.
A person who asks people to pay money they owe may also have this job title. The work should follow fair rules. Clear records matter.

examples.en: The museum displayed colonial maps from the past.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了過去的殖民地地圖。

examples.en: The book discussed colonial rule and its effects.
examples.zh: 這本書討論殖民統治及其影響。

examples.en: They studied a colonial building during the history trip.
examples.zh: 他們在歷史之旅中研究一棟殖民時期建築。

explains: This describes a time when one country controlled another land and its people. History books explain how this affected communities. People may study both sides of the past.
Buildings and language can show traces of an earlier ruling power. Historians look at records and objects. Careful study helps explain change.
People living under outside rule may have had fewer choices. Their stories are important to learn. Respectful discussion can help understand history.

examples.en: The renowned columnist writes weekly analyses on macroeconomic market trends.
examples.zh: 這位享譽盛名的財經專欄作家每週撰寫專欄深入剖析全球總體經濟脈動。

examples.en: Readers eagerly await the humorous life stories penned by the lifestyle columnist.
examples.zh: 廣大讀者每週都熱切期盼著那位生活專欄作家筆下風趣幽默的生活雜感。

examples.en: A syndicated columnist has their articles distributed to hundreds of newspapers.
examples.zh: 聯合報業專欄作家的文章會被分發授權給全美數百家報紙刊登。

explains: This is a writer who regularly shares opinions or ideas in a newspaper or magazine. The pieces may appear in a special section. Readers can follow the writer’s views.
A newspaper may ask this writer to explain a subject for its readers. The writer researches facts and gives a point of view. Clear examples help.
Readers may agree or disagree with the writer’s opinions. They can compare the arguments with other information. Thoughtful reading helps people decide.

examples.en: The soldiers trained for combat.
examples.zh: 士兵接受了戰鬥訓練。

examples.en: The town began a campaign to combat litter.
examples.zh: 鎮上開始推廣對抗垃圾的活動。

examples.en: The report described combat during the war.
examples.zh: 報告描述戰爭期間的戰鬥。

explains: This means a fight between armed groups or a strong effort against a problem. Soldiers may take part in a battle. People hope for peace.
A team can work hard to stop a disease or protect a forest. The effort may take many steps. Helpers share ideas and supplies.
As a verb, it can mean to fight or struggle against something. A group may oppose unfair treatment. Peaceful action can make a difference.

examples.en: The comedian made the audience laugh with a silly story.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員說了一個有趣的故事，逗得觀眾發笑。

examples.en: A famous comedian visited our school.
examples.zh: 一位知名喜劇演員造訪了我們學校。

examples.en: The comedian practiced her jokes before the show.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員在演出前練習笑話。

explains: This is a person who makes people laugh, often on stage or television. They may tell jokes or act out funny scenes. Audiences enjoy the performance.
A person in this job may use funny voices or costumes. Good timing helps the joke work. The performer should avoid hurting others.
Some performers use comedy to talk about everyday life. They notice surprising or silly details. People may laugh and think at the same time.

examples.en: The radio commentary described the final minutes of the game.
examples.zh: 電台的賽事解說描述了比賽最後幾分鐘的情況。

examples.en: Her commentary helped us understand the painting.
examples.zh: 她的評論幫助我們理解這幅畫。

examples.en: The teacher gave commentary on each group’s project.
examples.zh: 老師對每組的專題都給了講評。

explains: This is spoken or written explanation about an event. A sports announcer may describe each play as it happens. Listeners can follow the action.
A book may include notes that explain a writer’s ideas. The notes can help readers understand the subject. Clear examples are useful.
A news program may explain what happened during the day. The speaker can add facts and background. Viewers learn more about the event.

examples.en: The commentator described the race as the runners crossed the finish line.
examples.zh: 賽事評論員描述選手衝過終點線的情況。

examples.en: A commentator explained the election results on television.
examples.zh: 評論員在電視上說明選舉結果。

examples.en: The sports commentator praised both teams.
examples.zh: 體育評論員讚揚了兩支隊伍。

explains: This is a person who describes events as they happen. A sports worker may tell listeners what players are doing. The audience can imagine the game.
A person on television may explain a news event. They share details and background for viewers. Clear speech helps everyone follow.
A worker may talk about a parade or race over a loudspeaker. The listeners hear updates. The speaker should give accurate information.

examples.en: The real estate agency charged a standard legal buyer commission fee.
examples.zh: 房屋仲介公司依照主管機關法定規範向買賣雙方合理收取標準仲介服務費佣金。

examples.en: Sales representatives earn a base monthly salary plus a ten percent sales commission.
examples.zh: 業務代表每個月除了享有保障底薪外，還能領取按成交業績抽成一成的業務佣金。

examples.en: Be sure to clarify the exact broker commission rate before signing the exclusive agency agreement.
examples.zh: 在簽署專任委託買賣契約書之前，務必事先確認清楚買賣雙方實際應負擔的佣金趴數。

explains: This can be a group chosen to study a question or make a decision. Members meet and share ideas. They may report their findings.
It can also be money paid to someone who helps sell a product or arrange a deal. The amount may depend on the sale. Clear terms explain the payment.
A person may receive this payment for making a sale. The seller records the amount. Honest records help avoid confusion.

examples.en: Adopting a pet is a lifelong 15-year commitment of patient care, love, and unwavering responsibility.
examples.zh: 帶一隻毛小孩回家是一份長達十五年終生不離不棄的莊嚴承諾，需要全心全意的包容、愛與責任感。

examples.en: Before bringing a puppy home, consider whether your financial budget and daily schedule can sustain that commitment.
examples.zh: 在將幼犬迎進家門前，請務必再三深思自身的經濟預算與生活作息能否長期支撐這份沉甸甸的承諾。

examples.en: True pet guardianship means honoring your lifetime commitment even when animals grow old or require nursing care.
examples.zh: 真正的負責任飼主，意味著即便毛孩步入衰老殘疾或長期臥病需要照護，也絕不背棄當初相守一生的承諾。

examples.en: Transitioning away from fossil fuels is a solemn intergenerational commitment to our children's future.
examples.zh: 堅定告別高污染化石燃料，是當代人對後代子孫生存環境許下的最莊嚴世代承諾。

examples.en: Corporate leaders signed an ironclad sustainability commitment to power all factories with renewable energy.
examples.zh: 產業領袖簽署了堅定不移的永續行動承諾書，承諾在指定年限前將旗下所有生產基地改採百分之百綠能運作。

examples.en: Delivering on our net-zero commitment requires unyielding political determination and community collaboration.
examples.zh: 全面踐行二零五零淨零承諾，需要執政當局堅定不移的政治魄力以及全民社會上下一心的團結攜手。

entries.definition: 終生不離不棄的責任承諾；奉獻；守護後代子孫之堅定不移淨零承諾
explains: This is a promise to give time or effort to something. A student may practice an instrument every day. Regular work helps reach a goal.
A friend may promise to help someone move. Keeping the promise shows care. People can trust someone who follows through.
A person can choose to support a team or cause for a long time. The choice involves responsibility. Steady action shows dedication.

examples.en: Coffee is an important commodity in many countries.
examples.zh: 咖啡是許多國家的重要商品。

examples.en: The market price of this commodity changed this year.
examples.zh: 今年這項商品的市場價格有所變動。

examples.en: Farmers shipped the commodity to buyers overseas.
examples.zh: 農民把這種商品運送給海外買家。

explains: This is a product that people buy or sell, often in large amounts. Grain, oil, and metals are examples. Prices can change over time.
A farmer may grow a crop that is sold to many buyers. The crop travels from farms to markets. Quality can affect its price.
People may trade basic goods between places. Supply and demand can change what buyers pay. Fair rules help markets work.

examples.en: The class studied communism in a history lesson.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課研讀了共產主義。

examples.en: The book compared communism with other economic systems.
examples.zh: 這本書比較了共產主義與其他經濟制度。

examples.en: They discussed communism and its effects on society.
examples.zh: 他們討論了共產主義及其對社會的影響。

explains: This is a political and economic idea about sharing property and wealth across a society. Different countries have used different forms of it. Its history is complex.
People who study this idea examine how governments organize work and resources. They compare plans and outcomes. Careful reading helps explain the topic.
The word is often discussed in history or politics. People may have different opinions about it. A respectful discussion uses clear facts.

examples.en: The communist party held a public meeting in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中的共產黨舉行了一場公開會議。

examples.en: The book described a communist leader from the past.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了一位過去的共產主義領導人。

examples.en: He read about communist ideas in his history class.
examples.zh: 他在歷史課閱讀共產主義思想。

explains: This describes a person who supports a political and economic system based on shared ownership. People may have different reasons for supporting it. The word can also describe ideas linked to that system.
A history book may describe a leader or party with this belief. Readers can learn about the time and place. Reliable sources help explain events.
Political beliefs can shape how people think about work and resources. People should discuss them respectfully. Listening helps explain different views.

examples.en: I commute thirty minutes by MRT from New Taipei City to Taipei downtown.
examples.zh: 我每天搭乘捷運從新北市通勤三十分鐘至台北市中心。

examples.en: Listening to English podcasts turns an otherwise boring daily commute into study time.
examples.zh: 每天戴上耳機收聽英文播客節目，能將原本枯燥乏味的通勤路程轉化為充實學習時光。

examples.en: Traffic jams during the morning rush hour extended his car commute to over an hour.
examples.zh: 早晨上班尖峰時段慘烈的大塞車，讓他開車通勤的單程耗時一口氣拉長到一個多小時。

explains: This means to travel regularly between home and work or school. A person may ride a bus each morning. The trip can take a short or long time.
A traveler may use a train, bicycle, or car for the repeated journey. Planning the route can save time. Traffic can change how long it takes.
Some people travel between two places on a set schedule. They may leave early to arrive on time. A familiar route can become part of daily life.

examples.en: Thousands of busy commuters pass through Taipei Main Station every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨數以萬計忙碌的通勤族穿梭於台北車站大廳。

examples.en: Commuters tapped their EasyCards swiftly at the subway turnstile gates.
examples.zh: 步履匆匆的通勤族在捷運驗票閘門前俐落地輕觸感應悠遊卡，依序迅速進站。

examples.en: Rainy morning weather caused long lines of wet commuters waiting at city bus stops.
examples.zh: 陰雨綿綿的濕冷早晨，市區各主要公車站牌前排滿了撐著雨傘耐心候車的通勤人群。

explains: This is a person who travels regularly between home and work or school. The person may use a bus or train. The trip happens often.
A person may spend time traveling to a job each day. They can read or listen to music during the ride. Traffic may affect arrival time.
People on the same route may recognize one another. They often travel at similar times. Planning ahead can make the trip easier.

examples.en: Foldable multi-functional furniture is perfect for compact studio apartments.
examples.zh: 可摺疊多功能家具是空間緊湊小巧的獨立套房的最佳首選。

examples.en: The engineer designed a compact, lightweight lithium battery pack for drones.
examples.zh: 工程師為無人機研發出了一套體積緊湊小巧且重量極其輕盈的高效能鋰電池模組。

examples.en: She pulled a stylish mirrored makeup compact from her handbag to touch up her powder.
examples.zh: 她從隨身手提包中優雅拿出一只附帶精緻化妝鏡的隨身粉餅盒補妝撲粉。

entries.definition: 緊湊小巧的；小型的；粉餅
explains: This describes something small and arranged to use little space. A tiny camera can fit in a pocket. It is easy to carry.
A design can place many parts close together. The items still need to be easy to use. Careful planning helps.
The word can also name a small case of face powder. It may include a mirror and a soft applicator. Someone can carry it in a bag.

examples.en: The two paintings are comparable in size.
examples.zh: 這兩幅畫的大小相近，可以互相比較。

examples.en: Her score was comparable to the class average.
examples.zh: 她的分數和班級平均分相當。

examples.en: The new phone has features comparable to the older model.
examples.zh: 這支新手機有可媲美舊款的功能。

explains: This describes two things that can be compared because they share important features. Two books may tell similar kinds of stories. Readers can notice their differences too.
A person can compare the price and size of two bicycles. The information helps them choose. Clear facts make the choice easier.
Two tasks may require a similar amount of effort. People can compare them before making a plan. The details may not be exactly the same.

examples.en: Volunteers treat shelter animals with boundless warmth and tender compassion.
examples.zh: 志工們以無比溫暖的愛心與溫柔的慈悲心細心照護動物收容所裡的毛孩。

examples.en: Mother Teresa was globally renowned for her selfless compassion toward the destitute.
examples.zh: 德蕾莎修女以其對赤貧貧民無私奉獻的慈悲關懷而享譽全球。

examples.en: A truly humane society treats its most vulnerable members with dignity and compassion.
examples.zh: 一個真正仁慈的社會會以尊嚴與關懷來對待其最弱勢的成員。

examples.en: Boundless compassion prompts us to alleviate the suffering of all sentient living beings on Earth.
examples.zh: 廣大無私的慈悲心（Compassion），驅使著我們以溫柔的雙手撫慰世間所有生命承受的苦難與創痛。

examples.en: The dedicated social worker listened to the homeless veteran’s story with genuine warmth, dignity, and compassion.
examples.zh: 這位資深社工師以真誠溫暖、平等待人與深沉的慈悲同理心，耐心傾聽流浪街頭的榮民老伯伯訴說滄桑過往。

examples.en: Buddhist and Christian spiritual traditions share a foundational commitment to unconditional compassion and mercy.
examples.zh: 無論是東方佛家的普度眾生大悲願力，還是基督信仰中的神愛世人，皆在精神核心上崇尚無條件的慈悲、博愛與憐憫。

examples.en: True medical greatness blends cutting-edge scientific innovation with deep, heartfelt patient compassion.
examples.zh: 真正偉大的現代醫學，將頂尖尖端科學創新與床邊對病患無微不至的「同理與慈悲仁心」（Compassion）融為一體。

examples.en: The volunteer hospice worker sat beside the bed, holding the lonely patient’s hand with gentle compassion.
examples.zh: 安寧病房的愛心志工溫柔坐在病床旁，以滿懷慈悲同理的雙手緊緊握住孤單病患微顫的手心。

examples.en: Practicing empathy and compassion toward marginalized communities creates a kinder, more inclusive society.
examples.zh: 在日常生活中對弱勢族群抱持深切同理與慈悲關懷，方能攜手打造一個更加溫暖、包容而美好的文明社會。

entries.definition: 慈悲心；憐憫關懷；慈悲為懷廣大同情心；憐憫；臨床腫瘤醫師守護病患之無私同理慈悲心
explains: This is care for someone who is suffering or having a hard time. A friend may listen when another person feels upset. Kind support can help.
A person can notice another’s needs and offer help. They may bring food to a neighbor who is sick. Small actions matter.
People can show concern while respecting someone’s choices. Asking what help is wanted can be thoughtful. Listening is part of caring.

examples.en: Doctors applied for compassionate use approval to administer experimental medicine to critically ill patients.
examples.zh: 主治醫師緊急向衛福部專案申請「恩慈療法」（Compassionate Use），讓命在旦夕的重症病患使用試驗中新藥。

examples.en: The hospital's compassionate palliative care team ensures dying patients experience peace and dignity.
examples.zh: 該大型醫學中心的安寧緩和醫療團隊以無比溫柔的恩慈陪伴，確保末期病患在人生的最後一哩路享有尊嚴與安詳。

examples.en: The biotechnology firm granted compassionate access to their unapproved oncology drug free of charge.
examples.zh: 該生技新藥公司本著人道救死扶傷之崇高精神，無償免費提供處於臨床階段的未上市抗癌新藥供恩慈特案救治。

examples.en: True medical excellence combines cutting-edge AI technology with warm, compassionate bedside care.
examples.zh: 醫學殿堂的最高境界，在於將最頂尖的 AI 科技與視病猶親、充滿溫暖同理心（Compassionate）的床邊關懷完美結合。

examples.en: The compassionate hospice nurse held the dying patient's hand gently, offering quiet comfort during his final hours.
examples.zh: 充滿慈悲大愛的安寧病房護理師，溫柔握著走到生命終點臨終長輩乾枯的雙手，在最後時刻給予最平靜安詳的撫慰。

examples.en: Compassionate leaders listen actively to employee struggles and support their mental health during crises.
examples.zh: 具備仁愛同理心的卓越企業領袖，始終耐心傾聽同仁在工作與生活中的真實困境，並在家庭重大變故時給予最堅定的支持。

entries.definition: 恩慈療法特案核准的；富同情心的；仁心仁術視病猶親的
explains: This describes someone who cares about people in trouble. A teacher may listen patiently to a student who is worried. Support can help the student feel understood.
A person may show kindness by helping a neighbor carry groceries. They notice a need and offer assistance. A small favor can matter.
A caring response does not make fun of someone’s feelings. It gives them time to speak. Gentle words can comfort them.

examples.en: This USB-C charging cable is compatible with all modern smartphones.
examples.zh: 這條 Type-C 充電線與所有現代智慧型手機皆完全相容。

examples.en: The new software suite is fully compatible with older operating systems.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體套件與舊版作業系統完全相容。

examples.en: They make a great couple because their personalities and goals are highly compatible.
examples.zh: 他們是非常般配的情侶，因為性格與人生目標非常契合。

explains: This describes two things that can work or exist together. A plug must fit the outlet to work safely. Matching parts connect properly.
A program may run on a certain computer system. The maker lists which devices it supports. Checking the details helps users.
People can also be suited to work or live together. They share enough habits or interests to cooperate. Respect helps them get along.

examples.en: The rules compel everyone to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: 規定要求每個人都戴安全帽。

examples.en: Her kind words compelled him to say thank you.
examples.zh: 她善意的話讓他忍不住道謝。

examples.en: The deadline compelled the team to finish the poster today.
examples.zh: 截止期限迫使團隊今天完成海報。

explains: This means to force someone to do something or make it necessary. A rule may require students to wear safety goggles in a lab. The rule protects their eyes.
A strong feeling can make someone act quickly. A person may feel pushed to answer a question. They can pause and think first.
A deadline may make a team finish a task sooner. The group can divide the work and ask for help. Good planning reduces stress.

examples.en: The company compensated the worker for extra hours.
examples.zh: 公司補償了工人的加班費。

examples.en: The shop compensated us when the package arrived broken.
examples.zh: 包裹送達時已損壞，商店因此賠償我們。

examples.en: She tried to compensate for the mistake by correcting the report.
examples.zh: 她試著透過更正報告來彌補錯誤。

explains: This means to give someone money or another benefit for work or loss. A company may pay a worker for a job. The payment should match the agreement.
A person may receive money after an item is damaged. The amount can depend on the facts and rules. Keeping records can help explain what happened.
A person can make up for a mistake by fixing the problem. A sincere apology and helpful action may repair trust. People can discuss a fair solution.

examples.en: Travel insurance policies provide financial compensation for extended flight delays.
examples.zh: 出國前投保完整的海外旅遊不便險能針對因故延誤四小時以上的航班提供實質定額理賠。

examples.en: Passengers who were bumped from the overbooked flight received generous flight voucher compensation.
examples.zh: 因超賣機位而自願放棄當班座位的旅客，獲得了航空公司現場核發的優厚免費機票兌換券補償。

examples.en: Workers injured on the job are legally entitled to receive workers' disability compensation.
examples.zh: 依據勞工職業災害保險保障法，因公在工作場所受傷的勞工依法享有完整的工傷醫療與殘廢補償。

examples.en: The competitive total compensation package includes stock options, annual bonuses, and hybrid flexibility.
examples.zh: 這份極具市場競爭力的整體薪酬福利方案包含了公司股票選擇權、豐厚年終獎金與遠距彈性辦公。

examples.en: Workers injured on the job received financial compensation to cover medical bills and lost earnings.
examples.zh: 在工廠值勤時不幸遭受職業災害受傷的勞工，依法獲領全額醫療給付補助與原領薪資工傷補償金。

examples.en: Senior leadership reviewed regional compensation data to ensure employee wages keep pace with inflation.
examples.zh: 企業最高決策層定期調研同業市場薪酬報告，確保全體同仁的調薪幅度能實質跑贏通貨膨脹。

entries.definition: 班機延誤理賠補償金；報酬；整體薪酬福利套裝；補償金
explains: This is money or another benefit given for work or a loss. A worker may receive pay for completing a task. The amount depends on an agreement.
A person may be given money after something valuable is damaged. Rules explain how the amount is decided. Clear records can help.
The word can also mean something that makes up for a disadvantage. Extra time may help a student finish an assignment. A fair adjustment supports learning.

examples.en: The coach praised her competence on the field.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚她在球場上的能力。

examples.en: His competence with computers made him a good helper.
examples.zh: 他具備電腦專長，因此成為得力助手。

examples.en: The job requires competence in reading maps.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要具備閱讀地圖的能力。

explains: This is the ability to do a task well. A student can learn to solve math problems through practice. Each success builds skill.
A worker may show this ability by using tools safely. Training and experience help. Asking questions can improve performance.
A person can gain skill in speaking, drawing, or cooking. Feedback helps them learn. Regular practice can make a task easier.

examples.en: She is competent at fixing simple computer problems.
examples.zh: 她有能力修理簡單的電腦問題。

examples.en: The competent guide led us safely through the cave.
examples.zh: 稱職的導遊安全地帶我們穿過洞穴。

examples.en: He became competent in cooking after many lessons.
examples.zh: 上了許多課後，他熟練地學會烹飪。

explains: This describes someone who has enough skill to do a job well. A careful worker can follow directions and finish tasks. Practice builds ability.
A person may know how to use a tool safely. They can ask for training before starting. Knowing the steps helps avoid mistakes.
Someone with enough experience can help others learn. They explain each step clearly. Patience makes teaching easier.

examples.en: The complexity of the game made it fun to learn.
examples.zh: 遊戲的複雜性讓學習過程更有趣。

examples.en: We studied the complexity of the water system.
examples.zh: 我們研究了供水系統的複雜程度。

examples.en: The puzzle’s complexity surprised the students.
examples.zh: 謎題的複雜性令學生們驚訝。

explains: This is the state of having many parts or details. A puzzle with many pieces may take time to finish. Sorting by color can help.
A machine may have many connected parts that work together. Learning each part’s job can make it easier to understand. Diagrams help.
A difficult story may have several characters and events. Readers can take notes to follow what happens. Breaking it into sections can help.

examples.en: Every licensed fintech startup hires certified compliance officers to adhere to national banking laws.
examples.zh: 每一家獲准營運的金融科技新創皆聘請專業法遵專員，以嚴格確保各項創新商業模式全然合法合規。

examples.en: The auditor reviewed internal software logs to verify full compliance with European GDPR privacy rules.
examples.zh: 外部資安稽核專家逐一調閱內部系統連線日誌，嚴格審查公司是否全然符合歐盟 GDPR 嚴格的個資隱私規範。

examples.en: Failure to demonstrate environmental regulatory compliance can lead to hefty corporate environmental fines.
examples.zh: 若企業在生產製造過程中無法出具符合國家環保法規的合規排放證明，將面臨勒令停工與巨額環保裁罰。

examples.en: Smart pillboxes with flashing alarms improve patient medication compliance, preventing blood pressure spikes.
examples.zh: 具備定時聲光提醒的智慧藥盒大幅提升了慢性病患的「服藥遵從性」（Compliance），防止血壓忽高忽低。

examples.en: The semiconductor corporation underwent an exhaustive audit to ensure full regulatory environmental compliance.
examples.zh: 該大型半導體晶圓廠主動接受各項嚴苛的環評查核，確保全廠廢水排放與廢氣處理百分之百符合法規遵循標準。

examples.en: Patient compliance with daily physical therapy exercises directly determines the success of knee replacement surgery.
examples.zh: 病患在人工全膝關節置換術後能否持之以恆嚴格配合每日下肢肌力復健操，直接決定了術後行走功能的恢復成效。

examples.en: Audits verified full regulatory compliance with international clinical good practice standards.
examples.zh: 衛福部外部稽核員進行全面查核，確認臨床試驗百分之百符合國際法規「合規標準」（Compliance）。

examples.en: Ensuring strict environmental compliance saved the manufacturing plant from crippling regulatory fines.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵守各項環保排污合規標準，讓這座現代化工廠免於遭受環保稽查局巨額停工罰款的處分。

examples.en: The bank established an internal compliance department to guard against money laundering and fraud.
examples.zh: 該跨國商業銀行設立了專業獨立的法規遵循合規部門，日夜嚴密防範洗錢防制與金融舞弊交易。

entries.definition: 法令遵循審查 (法遵)；順從；慢病病患定時按時服藥遵從性；嚴格遵循國際藥品優良臨床試驗規範
explains: This is the act of following a rule, request, or instruction. A student may follow the teacher’s directions during a science activity. Careful steps help everyone.
A company may check that its work follows laws and safety rules. Clear records show what was done. Regular checks can find problems.
People may follow an agreement because they understand its purpose. Asking questions can clear up confusion. Shared understanding makes cooperation easier.

examples.en: Grand complication timepieces incorporate minute repeaters, perpetual calendars, and split-second chronographs.
examples.zh: 「大複雜功能腕錶」（Complication），在一枚小巧機芯中集結了三問報時、萬年曆與雙追針計時。

examples.en: Adding a dual-timezone GMT complication makes the sports watch an ideal companion for frequent business flyers.
examples.zh: 融入實用的雙時區 GMT 複雜功能，使這款奢華運動腕錶成為經常跨國出差商務人士的完美夥伴。

examples.en: The sudden medical complication prompted surgeons to modify their operative strategy immediately.
examples.zh: 手術過程中突發的急性醫療併發症，促使外科主治醫師立即果斷調整原有手術處置策略。

entries.definition: 大複雜功能機械腕錶 (三問、萬年曆、陀飛輪)
explains: This is an extra problem that happens along with a main problem. A cold may lead to a cough that makes someone feel worse. Rest and care may help.
A project can face an unexpected difficulty. A missing tool may delay the work. The team can make a new plan.
A machine may have an added feature that makes it more complicated. The user can read the guide to learn how it works. Clear instructions help.

examples.en: She gave her friend a compliment on the bright scarf.
examples.zh: 她稱讚朋友那條色彩鮮豔的圍巾。

examples.en: The coach complimented the team’s effort.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚了全隊的努力。

examples.en: I received a compliment about my drawing.
examples.zh: 我收到別人對我畫作的稱讚。

explains: This is a kind remark about someone or something. A friend may say that your drawing has lovely colors. The praise can make you smile.
A person can say something nice about another’s effort. Honest praise feels meaningful. It can encourage someone to keep practicing.
People may praise a helpful action. Saying thank you shows that they noticed. Kind words can brighten a day.

examples.en: Please comply with the library’s quiet rules.
examples.zh: 請遵守圖書館的安靜規定。

examples.en: The company complied with the safety requirements.
examples.zh: 公司遵守了安全要求。

examples.en: Drivers must comply with the posted speed limit.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須遵守張貼的速限。

explains: This means to do what a rule or request says. People may follow a sign that asks them to walk slowly. The rule helps protect everyone.
A worker may follow steps for using a machine. Reading directions first can prevent mistakes. Safety is important.
A person may agree to meet a promise or requirement. Keeping the agreement helps others trust them. Clear reminders can help.

examples.en: High-precision electronic components are assembled inside clean rooms.
examples.zh: 高精密電子零組件均在無塵室環境內進行組裝與封測。

examples.en: Trust and honest communication are vital components of any healthy working relationship.
examples.zh: 互相信任與誠懇透明的溝通，是維繫任何健康良好工作合作關係最不可或缺的基石。

examples.en: The automobile repair technician replaced a faulty mechanical component in the braking system.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師迅速拆卸並更換了煞車制動系統中出現疲勞受損的故障機械零組件。

explains: This is one part of a larger thing or system. A bicycle has wheels, pedals, and a frame. Each part helps it move.
A computer has parts that work together to process information. Each one has a different job. A broken part can affect the whole machine.
A recipe has several parts, such as flour, eggs, and water. Each ingredient helps make the finished food. Following the steps matters.

examples.en: Albert Einstein famously called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦曾讚譽「複利效應」（Compound Interest）是人類世界中的第八大奇蹟。

examples.en: Reinvesting your stock dividends harnesses the incredible long-term power of compound growth.
examples.zh: 長期將每期領到的股票現金股利全數滾入再投資，能徹底釋放指數投資驚人的時間複利威力。

examples.en: Compound annual growth rates measure an investment's smoothed return over multiple years.
examples.zh: 年化複合成長率（CAGR）能客觀平滑評估一項投資資產在歷經數年牛熊考驗後的真實實質回報。

examples.en: Compound movements recruit multiple muscle groups simultaneously for maximum efficiency.
examples.zh: 包含深蹲、硬舉與臥推在內的多關節複合動作能同時動員全身多組大肌群，燃脂效率極高。

examples.en: Prioritize heavy compound exercises at the beginning of your training session.
examples.zh: 建議在重訓一開始體力最充沛時，優先進行大重量的多關節複合動作。

examples.en: Exercises like pull-ups and squats are compound movements that burn more calories per set.
examples.zh: 像是引體向上與深蹲等複合動作，每組能燃燒消耗的熱量遠高於單關節孤立動作。

examples.en: Medicinal chemists synthesized a potent lead compound showing remarkable tumor-shrinking capabilities.
examples.zh: 藥物化學家成功人工合成出一種活性極強的先導化合物（Lead Compound），在試驗中展現驚人縮小腫瘤效果。

examples.en: Water is a chemical compound consisting of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 純淨的水是一種由兩個氫原子與一個氧原子透過化學鍵緊密鍵結而成的無機化合物。

examples.en: The novel antibacterial compound demonstrated strong bactericidal activity against drug-resistant superbugs.
examples.zh: 這種全新開發的人工合成抗菌先導化合物，在實驗中展現出強力撲殺多重抗藥性超級細菌的卓越活性。

examples.en: Strawberries and basil share common aromatic compounds, creating a natural harmony on the dessert plate.
examples.zh: 草莓與羅勒在化學分析上共享了關鍵的「揮發性芳香化合物」（Compounds），在甜點盤中譜出天作之合。

examples.en: Water is a simple chemical compound formed by two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 水是由兩個氫原子與一個氧原子以共價鍵緊密鍵合而成的一種最常見化學化合物。

examples.en: The foreign diplomatic staff resided inside a heavily guarded embassy compound downtown.
examples.zh: 外國使館全體外交工作人員，集中居住在市中心戒備森嚴的駐外使領館住宅園區內。

entries.definition: 複利的；複合的；複合物；多關節複合的；複合式的；候選先導化合物；食材內部共享之相同揮發性芳香化合物；化合物
explains: This describes something made of two or more different parts or substances. A cake may combine flour, eggs, and fruit. Each part adds something.
The word can name a substance made by joining elements. A science class may study how its parts behave. Safe lab rules are important.
A fenced area with buildings inside can also have this name. A gate controls who enters. The residents may share the space.

examples.en: I could not comprehend the long directions until the teacher explained them.
examples.zh: 老師解釋長篇指示後，我才理解內容。

examples.en: She comprehended the story after reading it twice.
examples.zh: 她讀了兩次才理解這個故事。

examples.en: The diagram helped us comprehend how the water system works.
examples.zh: 圖解幫我們理解供水系統如何運作。

explains: This means to understand an idea or message. A reader may study a sentence twice to grasp its meaning. Examples can make it clearer.
A person can learn how a machine works by watching each part. They ask questions and connect the steps. Patience helps build understanding.
A child may listen to directions and then repeat them in their own words. This shows they followed the message. Asking for help is okay.

examples.en: Deep listening comprehension allows you to appreciate subtle jokes and cultural nuances in movies.
examples.zh: 卓越的「聽力與閱讀理解力」（Comprehension），讓你能心領神會英美電影中的幽默笑點與文化隱喻。

examples.en: The standardized examination tests both rapid reading speed and nuanced reading comprehension.
examples.zh: 這項標準化測驗同時評量考生迅速掃描文章的速度，以及對深層語意的精確理解力。

examples.en: Practicing with authentic audio podcasts helps elevate your everyday speech comprehension.
examples.zh: 經常收聽道地的英文播客節目，能顯著提升你對日常生活快速談話的聽力理解度。

entries.definition: 深刻理解幽默、隱喻與弦外之音之聽讀理解力；理解
explains: This is the ability to understand what someone reads or hears. A student can answer questions about a story. The answers show what the student understood.
A person may understand words but miss the main idea. Taking notes can help connect details. Practice improves this skill.
Listening carefully can help someone follow spoken directions. Repeating the steps can check understanding. Clear speech helps listeners.

examples.en: The meal comprises rice, vegetables, and soup.
examples.zh: 這餐包含米飯、蔬菜和湯。

examples.en: The team comprises students from three classes.
examples.zh: 隊伍由三個班級的學生組成。

examples.en: The book comprises ten short chapters.
examples.zh: 這本書包含十個短篇章。

explains: This means to include several parts as members of a whole. A fruit salad may have apples, grapes, and bananas. Each fruit is part of the dish.
A team can have people with different skills. Together they make the whole group. Each person has a role.
A plan may list several tasks that make up a project. Checking each task helps the group know what remains. A clear list is useful.

examples.en: In team projects, finding a fair compromise is often necessary.
examples.zh: 在團隊合作中，尋求公平合理的折衷妥協往往是必要的。

examples.en: After hours of negotiations, management and labor finally agreed on a compromise.
examples.zh: 歷經數小時的艱辛協商談判，勞資雙方終於在各退一步的前提下達成了妥協。

examples.en: Never compromise on construction safety standards merely to speed up delivery deadlines.
examples.zh: 絕不能僅僅為了趕在交期日前搶工完工，就在建築施工安全標準上妥協退讓。

examples.en: Both sides compromised on payment timelines to finalize the partnership.
examples.zh: 雙方在付款分期時程上各自作出了合理折衷妥協，最終促成了策略結盟。

examples.en: Finding a fair compromise is often necessary when balancing budget and features.
examples.zh: 在平衡預算與功能需求時，尋求合理的折衷妥協通常是不可避免的。

examples.en: Never compromise user data security to rush a software release date.
examples.zh: 絕不能為了趕著軟體上線日期而犧牲或危及使用者的資料安全。

entries.definition: 妥協；折衷；讓步；折衷方案；危及
explains: This means to settle a disagreement by having each side give up part of what it wants. Friends may choose a game both enjoy. Sharing can solve the problem.
A middle choice can help people agree. Each person listens and suggests a fair change. The final plan may satisfy everyone somewhat.
The word can also mean to put something at risk. Sharing a password may threaten the safety of an account. Private information should be protected.

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory course for all university freshmen.
examples.zh: 大一英文是所有大學新鮮人的必修課程。

examples.en: Nine years of compulsory education is guaranteed by national law.
examples.zh: 國家法律保障國民享有九年義務強制的基礎教育。

examples.en: Wearing safety helmets on motorcycles is compulsory in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣騎乘機車強制規定必須佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory required subject for all incoming students.
examples.zh: 大一英文是全體大一新生必須共同修習的必修科目。

examples.en: Basic military training is compulsory for eligible male citizens in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，役男公民依法接受基礎軍事常規訓練是法定的義務義務。

examples.en: Wearing safety hard hats is compulsory at all construction worksites.
examples.zh: 在所有建築工地施工現場，所有人皆一律強制佩戴安全帽。

explains: This describes something that must be done because of a rule. Students may have to wear a safety helmet on a bike trip. The rule protects them.
A class can be required for every student in a program. Everyone takes it before choosing other lessons. The school sets the plan.
An official form may need to be completed. A person must provide the requested details. Reading instructions helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: She concealed the present under her bed.
examples.zh: 她把禮物藏在床底下。

examples.en: The bushes concealed the small bird from view.
examples.zh: 灌木叢遮住了那隻小鳥，讓人看不見。

examples.en: He tried to conceal his surprise at the news.
examples.zh: 他試圖掩飾自己聽到消息後的驚訝。

explains: This means to keep something out of sight. A child may put a birthday gift inside a closet. The surprise stays secret until the party.
A person may cover an object with a cloth. The object is not easy to see. The covering can protect it from dust.
A character in a story may keep a secret from friends. Later, the truth may come out. Honest conversation can solve problems.

examples.en: The team conceded that their opponents had played better.
examples.zh: 隊伍承認對手表現得更好。

examples.en: She conceded that she had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 她承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: He finally conceded the point after hearing the evidence.
examples.zh: 聽到證據後，他終於承認這個論點。

explains: This means to admit that something is true, especially after first disagreeing. A player may accept that the other team scored fairly. Honesty matters.
A person can agree that an idea is good after hearing reasons. Listening can change someone’s mind. Respectful discussion helps.
A person may admit that they made a mistake. Saying so can help fix the problem. Taking responsibility builds trust.

examples.en: The designer conceived a clever plan for the playground.
examples.zh: 設計師構思出遊樂場的巧妙計畫。

examples.en: She conceived the idea while walking home.
examples.zh: 她在回家路上想到這個點子。

examples.en: They conceived a new game for rainy days.
examples.zh: 他們想出一款雨天可玩的新遊戲。

explains: This means to form an idea in the mind. An artist may picture a new design before drawing it. Sketches can help develop the idea.
A person can imagine how a plan might work. They think through the steps and possible problems. Planning helps turn ideas into action.
Someone may create an idea for a story or invention. They can write it down before they forget. Sharing it may bring helpful feedback.

examples.en: Her conception of the story changed after the first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿完成後，她對故事的構想改變了。

examples.en: The project began with a simple conception of a garden classroom.
examples.zh: 這個計畫起初只是想打造一間簡單的花園教室。

examples.en: The book explains the artist’s conception of the city.
examples.zh: 這本書說明了藝術家對城市的構想。

explains: This is an idea or plan formed in someone’s mind. A child may imagine a new kind of treehouse. Drawing it can help explain the plan.
The beginning of a project may involve deciding what it should do. People share thoughts and choose a direction. Careful planning is useful.
People can have different ideas about how something works. They compare facts and examples. Discussion can improve understanding.

examples.en: The teacher condemned the cruel prank.
examples.zh: 老師譴責了那個殘酷的惡作劇。

examples.en: The group condemned the plan to damage the playground.
examples.zh: 這個團體譴責破壞遊樂場的計畫。

examples.en: The judge condemned the unsafe building practices.
examples.zh: 法官譴責了不安全的建築做法。

explains: This means to say that someone or something is very wrong. A class may speak against unfair treatment. They explain why it should stop.
A judge may officially state that a person’s action broke a rule. The decision follows careful review. Facts are important.
People can strongly criticize harmful behavior. They should focus on the action and use respectful words. Clear reasons help others understand.

examples.en: The school expects good conduct from every student.
examples.zh: 學校要求每位學生都有良好行為。

examples.en: She conducted the orchestra during the concert.
examples.zh: 她在音樂會上指揮管弦樂團。

examples.en: The researchers conducted a survey about reading habits.
examples.zh: 研究人員進行了一項閱讀習慣調查。

explains: This can mean the way a person behaves. A student who listens and shares shows good behavior. Families teach children how to act kindly.
The verb can mean to lead or manage an event. A teacher may guide a science experiment. Clear instructions help students.
A person can carry out a survey by asking the same questions. Careful records make the results more useful. The method should be fair.

examples.en: His confession surprised the whole family.
examples.zh: 他的坦白讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: She made a confession about breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 她坦承自己打破了花瓶。

examples.en: The letter contained a confession to the mistake.
examples.zh: 信中有一段對錯誤的坦白。

explains: This is a statement in which someone admits they did something wrong or tells a hidden truth. A person may admit taking a cookie without asking. Honesty can help repair trust.
In a story, a character may reveal a secret to a friend. The friend listens and asks questions. The truth can change their relationship.
People may share an honest admission with someone they trust. The listener should respond calmly. Taking responsibility is a useful first step.

examples.en: The confidential letter was kept in a locked drawer.
examples.zh: 這封機密信件被鎖在抽屜裡。

examples.en: Please keep this information confidential.
examples.zh: 請對這項資訊保密。

examples.en: They held a confidential meeting about the new plan.
examples.zh: 他們舉行了一場討論新計畫的保密會議。

explains: This describes information meant to be kept private. A doctor’s notes about a patient should not be shared with strangers. Privacy matters.
A person may share a secret with someone they trust. The listener should not repeat it without permission. Trust can be broken.
A private meeting may include personal details. Attendees should follow the rules for sharing information. Careful handling protects people.

examples.en: The fence confined the goats to one field.
examples.zh: 圍欄把山羊限制在一塊田地裡。

examples.en: The nurse confined the patient to bed for a short rest.
examples.zh: 護士讓病人短時間臥床休息。

examples.en: They confined the noisy work to daytime hours.
examples.zh: 他們把吵雜的工程限制在白天進行。

explains: This means to keep someone or something within a limited place or area. A fence can keep a pet inside a yard. A gate lets it enter or leave.
A rule may limit when or how something can happen. The limits can make an activity safer. People should understand the rules.
A person may stay indoors while resting from an illness. Family members can bring food and help. A health professional can advise them.

examples.en: The building conforms to the town’s safety rules.
examples.zh: 這棟建築符合鎮上的安全規定。

examples.en: The colors conform to the artist’s original design.
examples.zh: 顏色符合藝術家的原始設計。

examples.en: Each label must conform to the same format.
examples.zh: 每個標籤都必須符合相同格式。

explains: This means to follow a rule or match a pattern. Students may wear a uniform at school. Everyone follows the same clothing rule.
A shape can match another shape in size or form. A puzzle piece fits when its edges line up. Careful matching is needed.
A person may act like a group to fit in. It is also okay to be different while treating others kindly. Respect matters.

examples.en: She confronted her friend about the broken promise.
examples.zh: 她就朋友失信一事直接找他談。

examples.en: The team confronted a difficult challenge together.
examples.zh: 團隊一起面對一項艱難挑戰。

examples.en: He confronted the problem instead of ignoring it.
examples.zh: 他沒有忽視問題，而是正面處理。

explains: This means to face a difficult problem or speak directly to someone about it. A student may tell a classmate that a hurtful joke was unkind. Calm words can help.
A team can face a challenge by making a plan. Members share the work and ask for support. Small steps make it manageable.
A person may meet an unexpected situation bravely. They can gather facts before deciding what to do. Help is available.

examples.en: The confrontation ended after the coach spoke to both players.
examples.zh: 教練和兩名球員談過後，衝突便結束了。

examples.en: They avoided a confrontation by discussing the issue calmly.
examples.zh: 他們冷靜討論問題，避免了正面衝突。

examples.en: A confrontation between the neighbors began over a loud noise.
examples.zh: 鄰居間因噪音開始發生衝突。

explains: This is a direct meeting or argument between people who disagree. Voices may become upset. Calm discussion can prevent things from getting worse.
Two groups may meet to discuss a serious problem. A helper can make sure each side is heard. Clear rules support fairness.
A story may include a tense encounter between two characters. Their words show the conflict. They may later find a solution.

examples.en: She attended class for five consecutive days.
examples.zh: 她連續五天都有上課。

examples.en: The team won three consecutive games.
examples.zh: 隊伍連續贏了三場比賽。

examples.en: It rained on four consecutive mornings.
examples.zh: 連續四個早晨都下雨。

explains: This describes things that happen one after another without a break. A student may read for five days in a row. A calendar can show each day.
A team may win several games in a row. Fans celebrate the pattern. One later loss does not erase the effort.
A person may work several hours without stopping. Taking breaks can help them stay healthy. It is good to rest when needed.

examples.en: After extensive discussions, the board reached unanimous consensus on expansion.
examples.zh: 歷經深入詳實的評估討論，董事會就海外擴張計畫達成了全票通過的一致共識。

examples.en: Building consensus takes time, but it guarantees stronger commitment from everyone.
examples.zh: 凝聚團隊共識需要花費時間，但它能確保每個人都抱持更堅定的投入度。

examples.en: The scientific consensus is that greenhouse gas emissions contribute to global warming.
examples.zh: 科學界的普遍共識是溫室氣體排放造成了全球暖化。

examples.en: Building broad societal consensus on renewable energy requires patient dialogue across all sectors.
examples.zh: 在推動能源轉型等重大國家政策上凝聚廣泛的「社會共識」（Consensus），需要政府與民間展開耐心的長期對話。

examples.en: The scientific consensus is overwhelming: human activities are driving accelerated changes in the global climate.
examples.zh: 全球頂尖科學界已達成壓倒性的壓倒性科學共識：人類頻繁的化石燃料活動正是驅動全球氣候急遽變遷的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Reaching an amicable family consensus regarding holiday travel plans took several lively dinner discussions.
examples.zh: 全家人在餐桌上經過幾番熱烈愉快的討論後，終於就今年過年全家出遊行程達成了其樂融融的家庭共識。

entries.definition: 團隊共識；意見一致；跨黨派凝聚社會廣泛共識
explains: This is a shared decision or opinion reached by a group. Members discuss choices and try to find a plan most can accept. Listening helps.
A team may agree on which project to do after considering ideas. Everyone can support the chosen plan. The group moves forward together.
People may not share every detail of an idea but still agree on the main point. They can note remaining differences. Clear discussion is useful.

examples.en: Trial participants must sign informed consent forms after fully understanding all potential experimental risks.
examples.zh: 所有參與臨床試驗的受試者在充分了解各項試驗流程與潛在副作用風險後，必須親筆簽署知情同意書。

examples.en: Parents must provide written consent before minors can participate in pediatric clinical studies.
examples.zh: 在未成年兒童正式參與小兒科臨床試驗研究之前，其法定代理人父母親必須出具完整的書面知情同意書。

examples.en: The ethics committee verified that patients gave their consent freely without any financial coercion.
examples.zh: 醫學倫理審查委員會再三嚴格稽核，確認所有受試病患皆是在完全知情、毫無任何金錢脅迫下自主簽署同意。

examples.en: Doctors explained all potential risks before the volunteer signed the informed consent document.
examples.zh: 在受試者正式簽署「知情同意書」（Informed Consent）前，主治醫師巨細靡遺解釋所有潛在風險與替代療法。

examples.en: Parents must provide written parental consent before minor children can participate in overnight school camps.
examples.zh: 未成年學童在報名參加學校舉辦的隔宿露營活動前，必須取得法定代理人簽署的家長同意書。

examples.en: By mutual consent, both companies agreed to terminate the joint venture without seeking legal damages.
examples.zh: 經過雙方友好充分協商，兩家企業達成一致共識，同意平和終止合資合作協議且互不索賠賠償。

entries.definition: 受試者知情同意書；同意；病患受試者簽署完全知情同意書
explains: This means to agree to something after understanding what it involves. A student may say yes to joining a school activity. They can ask questions first.
A person should be free to say yes or no to a request. Clear information helps them decide. Their choice should be respected.
A group may need permission from members before taking an action. Everyone should understand the plan. People can change their minds when appropriate.

examples.en: Energy conservation in homes helps lower carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 居家節約能源有助於降低碳排放量。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation programs have revived the local Formosan sika deer population.
examples.zh: 野生動物保育計畫成功讓本土台灣梅花鹿族群得以復育繁衍。

examples.en: Turning off faucets while brushing teeth is an effortless daily water conservation habit.
examples.zh: 刷牙時隨手關緊水龍頭是毫不費力的日常節約用水好習慣。

examples.en: Water conservation habits like short showers help during dry spring seasons.
examples.zh: 養成縮減淋浴時間等節約用水好習慣能安度春季乾旱枯水期。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation groups work around the clock to protect green sea turtle nesting grounds.
examples.zh: 野生動植物保育民間團體日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心守護綠蠵龜在離島沙灘上的產卵棲地。

examples.en: The national park enforces strict environmental conservation regulations to keep the alpine forest pristine.
examples.zh: 國家公園依法嚴格執行各項自然環境資源保育法令規章，竭力維護這片高山冷溫帶原始林的純淨。

examples.en: Modern architectural conservation relies on non-destructive sonic testing to assess internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 現代建築文化資產科學保存，仰賴非破壞性超音波檢測評估古木柱內部的腐朽程度。

examples.en: International charters emphasize minimal intervention as a golden rule in architectural conservation.
examples.zh: 國際保存憲章一再強調最低限度干預，作為建築文化資產保存修復的黃金法則。

examples.en: The university established a graduate institute specializing in paper and mural painting conservation.
examples.zh: 這所大學創立了專門針對紙質古籍與壁畫修護的文化資產科學保存研究所。

entries.definition: 保育；節約；保存；環境保護；有形文化資產科學保存與修復
explains: This is the care and protection of nature, historic objects, or useful resources. A park worker may protect a forest and its animals. Visitors can help by following rules.
People can save water by turning off a tap while brushing their teeth. Small actions can add up. Careful use protects supplies.
A museum may carefully protect an old painting from light and dust. Experts use safe methods to keep it in good shape. Future visitors can see it.

examples.en: It was considerate of him to save me a seat.
examples.zh: 他替我留個位子，真是體貼。

examples.en: She left a note so her roommate would not worry, which was considerate.
examples.zh: 她留了張字條，讓室友不必擔心，真周到。

examples.en: The considerate driver stopped to let the family cross.
examples.zh: 體貼的駕駛停下來讓一家人先過馬路。

explains: This describes someone who thinks about other people’s comfort. A person may hold a door open for someone carrying bags. Small acts show care.
A thoughtful classmate may speak quietly while a friend is reading. Respecting others can make a shared place pleasant. People notice kindness.
Someone may offer a seat to a tired passenger. Looking around helps a person notice what others need. Helpful actions can make a difference.

examples.en: The court reviewed the constitutional question.
examples.zh: 法院審理了這項憲法問題。

examples.en: The class learned about constitutional rights.
examples.zh: 全班學習了憲法所保障的權利。

examples.en: The constitutional rules explain how the government works.
examples.zh: 憲法規則說明政府如何運作。

explains: This describes something related to the basic laws and structure of a country. A written set of rules may explain how leaders are chosen. People can study those rules.
A country’s main legal document may describe people’s rights. Courts and leaders must follow its rules. The document guides public life.
A change to the basic structure of government can affect many people. Careful discussion is important. Citizens may learn how decisions are made.

examples.en: The budget constraint limited our choices.
examples.zh: 預算限制了我們的選擇。

examples.en: Time was the main constraint during the project.
examples.zh: 時間是這項專題的主要限制。

examples.en: A low ceiling was a constraint for the tall bookshelf.
examples.zh: 低矮的天花板限制了書架的高度。

explains: This is a limit or difficulty that makes an action harder. A small budget may prevent a team from buying every supply. They can choose carefully.
A rule may restrict where a person can go. Signs explain what areas are safe. Following instructions can prevent trouble.
A lack of time can limit how much work gets done. Making a list helps people focus. They may ask for more time if needed.

examples.en: The doctor scheduled a consultation with the family.
examples.zh: 醫生安排了一次與家人的諮詢。

examples.en: We had a consultation about the garden design.
examples.zh: 我們討論了花園設計。

examples.en: She booked a short consultation with the school counselor.
examples.zh: 她和學校輔導員約了一次簡短諮詢。

explains: This is a meeting where someone asks for advice or information. A family may talk with a travel worker before a trip. They can ask about routes.
A person may meet a professional to discuss a question. The professional listens and explains possible next steps. Clear details help.
A group may talk together before choosing a plan. Everyone shares concerns and ideas. Listening can lead to a better decision.

examples.en: The report measured energy consumption in the school.
examples.zh: 報告測量了學校的能源消耗。

examples.en: Our household reduced water consumption this summer.
examples.zh: 我們家今年夏天減少了用水量。

examples.en: Food consumption increased during the festival.
examples.zh: 節慶期間食品消耗量增加。

explains: This is the act of using food, fuel, or other goods. A family may use electricity to light its home. Turning off unused lights can save it.
People eat food to get energy. Different meals provide different nutrients. Drinking water is also important.
A factory uses materials to make products. Careful use can reduce waste. Recycling can help save resources.

examples.en: The nurse explained that the illness was contagious.
examples.zh: 護理師解釋這種疾病具有傳染性。

examples.en: Some contagious diseases spread through close contact.
examples.zh: 有些傳染病會透過密切接觸傳播。

examples.en: Her laughter was contagious, and soon everyone smiled.
examples.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

explains: This describes an illness or germ that can pass from one person to another. Some germs spread when people are close together. Clean habits can lower the chance of passing them on.
A person who feels sick can rest and tell a trusted adult. Health workers explain what steps are helpful. People should be kind and avoid teasing.
The word can also describe a feeling or idea that spreads among a group. One person’s laughter may make others laugh too. The mood can pass quickly.

examples.en: The spill contaminated the pond.
examples.zh: 液體外洩污染了池塘。

examples.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food.
examples.zh: 手不乾淨可能會污染食物。

examples.en: The factory worked to prevent chemicals from contaminating the soil.
examples.zh: 工廠設法防止化學物質污染土壤。

explains: This means to make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful material. Oil spilled into a stream can hurt animals and plants. People should report pollution.
Food can become unsafe if raw meat touches ready-to-eat food. Keeping items separate helps protect meals. Clean hands matter.
A chemical leak may damage soil or water. Trained workers can clean it safely. People should stay away from the area.

examples.en: She contemplated the answer before raising her hand.
examples.zh: 她舉手前仔細思考了答案。

examples.en: We contemplated taking the train instead of driving.
examples.zh: 我們考慮搭火車，不開車。

examples.en: He sat by the window and contemplated the drawing.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗邊思索那幅畫。

explains: This means to think carefully about a choice or question. A student may sit quietly and consider which book to read. Taking time can help.
A person may imagine what could happen if they choose a certain plan. They think about benefits and problems. Advice can be useful.
Someone can think about a place they hope to visit. They may look at pictures and make a list. Planning turns an idea into a real trip.

examples.en: The museum shows contemporary art.
examples.zh: 博物館展示當代藝術。

examples.en: The two contemporary writers exchanged letters.
examples.zh: 那兩位同時代的作家交換過書信。

examples.en: She enjoys contemporary music from many countries.
examples.zh: 她喜歡來自許多國家的當代音樂。

explains: This describes something from the present time or the same period. A new song may use sounds popular today. Listeners can hear current styles.
Two writers who lived during the same years may have shared ideas. Their work can be compared. History gives context.
A person may wear clothes with a style that is popular now. Fashion can change over time. People can choose what feels comfortable.

examples.en: He spoke with contempt about the unfair rule.
examples.zh: 他用輕蔑的口吻談論那項不公平規則。

examples.en: The character treated the poor villagers with contempt.
examples.zh: 故事中的角色輕蔑地對待貧困村民。

examples.en: She showed contempt for bullying by standing up for the student.
examples.zh: 她挺身幫助那位學生，表達對霸凌行為的不屑。

explains: This is a strong feeling of disrespect or dislike for someone or something. A person may feel this after seeing unfair behavior. Calm discussion can help.
A character may look down on another person in a story. Their words show disrespect. The other character may feel hurt.
People can disagree without showing disrespect. Listening and using kind words helps keep a discussion fair. Everyone deserves dignity.

examples.en: The two runners contended for first place.
examples.zh: 兩位跑者爭奪第一名。

examples.en: She contends that the rule is unfair.
examples.zh: 她主張這條規則不公平。

examples.en: The teams will contend for the championship.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍將競逐冠軍。

explains: This means to compete or struggle for something. Two teams may try to win the same prize. Practice helps them do their best.
A person may state that something is true. They should give facts to support the claim. Others can check the evidence.
People can disagree about how to solve a problem. They may each argue for a different plan. Listening helps them understand each side.

examples.en: The continental climate brings cold winters to the inland town.
examples.zh: 內陸城鎮的冬天寒冷，呈現大陸型氣候。

examples.en: They crossed the continental landmass by train.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車橫越整個大陸。

examples.en: The hotel served a continental breakfast with fruit and bread.
examples.zh: 飯店提供包含水果與麵包的大陸式早餐。

explains: This describes something related to a large continuous area of land. A map may show a wide landmass with many countries. Oceans can separate it from others.
The climate of a large land area may differ from island weather. Inland places can have hotter summers and colder winters. This land can stretch across several countries.
A breakfast served in a style associated with Europe may include bread, cheese, and fruit. Hotels sometimes use this name for a light meal. It is usually a light meal.

examples.en: The general contractor finished the residential tower ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 總營造承包商提前於預定工期順利完成了住宅大樓的興建。

examples.en: The school board hired an electrical contractor to upgrade campus wiring.
examples.zh: 校務委員會聘請了一家合格的機電工程承包商，全面升級全校老舊管線設備。

examples.en: Independent contractors must manage their own tax filings and health insurance.
examples.zh: 獨立簽約外包承包商必須自主申報個人年度綜合所得稅與繳納全民健保保費。

examples.en: Hire an experienced licensed contractor to manage demolition and carpentry teams.
examples.zh: 聘請口碑良好、信譽可靠的專業裝潢統包工程工頭來統籌調度泥作與木工師傅班底。

examples.en: The independent contractor submitted a detailed itemized quote before breaking ground.
examples.zh: 統包工程承包商在正式動工開拆前，先提交了一份詳盡列出各工種單價的估價單。

examples.en: Regular on-site communication with your general contractor ensures construction stays on schedule.
examples.zh: 定期與統包工地主任進行面對面現場溝通核對，能確保各施工工期按照既定進度推進。

entries.definition: 承包商；營造廠商；裝潢統包工頭；工程承包商
explains: This is a person or company hired to complete a particular job. A builder may repair a roof for a family. The client agrees to the work and price.
A project manager may hire this worker to build a road or install new windows. The job has a clear plan. Workers follow safety rules.
This worker may bring special tools and skills to a project. The client checks the finished work. Clear communication helps prevent mistakes.

examples.en: There was a contradiction between his words and actions.
examples.zh: 他的言行互相矛盾。

examples.en: The report contained a contradiction about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 報告中對會議時間的描述前後矛盾。

examples.en: She noticed a contradiction in the two answers.
examples.zh: 她在兩個答案中發現了矛盾。

explains: This is a statement that conflicts with another statement. One person may say the door is open while another says it is shut. Both cannot be true at once.
A story may include details that do not fit together. Readers notice the mismatch. The writer can correct it.
A person’s actions may go against their words. Others may question which message is true. Consistency helps build trust.

examples.en: The controversial rule started a long discussion.
examples.zh: 這項引發爭議的規定開始了一場長時間討論。

examples.en: The film addressed a controversial subject.
examples.zh: 這部電影探討了一個具爭議性的主題。

examples.en: Her controversial idea received both support and criticism.
examples.zh: 她那個備受爭議的想法同時得到支持與批評。

explains: This describes a subject that causes people to disagree strongly. A new school rule may upset some families while others support it. People share different reasons.
A difficult topic can lead to public discussion. Speakers should use facts and listen to one another. Respectful debate is helpful.
A decision may receive both praise and criticism. Leaders can explain how they made it. Clear information helps people understand.

examples.en: The controversy about the new road continued for months.
examples.zh: 關於新道路的爭議持續了好幾個月。

examples.en: The book caused controversy in the town.
examples.zh: 這本書在鎮上引起了爭論。

examples.en: They discussed the controversy during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他們在會議中討論了這場爭議。

explains: This is a public disagreement about an issue. People may share different opinions in news reports or meetings. Facts can help clarify the matter.
A topic can cause strong debate among a community. Each side may explain its reasons. Listening helps people understand the disagreement.
A disagreement may continue for a long time. A fair discussion can help find common ground. Some differences may remain.

examples.en: The conversion of the garage into a studio took two weeks.
examples.zh: 把車庫改建成工作室花了兩週。

examples.en: We checked the conversion from miles to kilometers.
examples.zh: 我們檢查了英里轉換成公里的換算。

examples.en: The town planned a conversion of the old library into a museum.
examples.zh: 鎮上計畫把舊圖書館改建成博物館。

explains: This is a change from one form, use, or system to another. A room can be changed into a study area. Furniture and lights may be moved.
A measurement can be changed into a different unit. A chart can help show how the amounts match. Checking the math is useful.
A person may change their beliefs after learning new information. They can reflect and ask questions. People may change in different ways.

examples.en: The workers converted the old barn into a classroom.
examples.zh: 工人把舊穀倉改建成教室。

examples.en: She converted the recipe from cups to grams.
examples.zh: 她把食譜的杯數換算成公克。

examples.en: The program converts photos into smaller files.
examples.zh: 這個程式會把照片轉成較小的檔案。

explains: This means to change something into a different form or use. A caterpillar changes into a butterfly. The stages happen over time.
A person can change a recipe to make it fit a different meal. They may replace an ingredient. Careful amounts help the food turn out well.
A file can be changed into another digital type so a device can open it. The user chooses the right format. Saving a copy is helpful.

examples.en: The jury convicted the driver after hearing the evidence.
examples.zh: 陪審團聽取證據後，判定駕駛有罪。

examples.en: The court convicted him of stealing the bicycle.
examples.zh: 法院判定他偷竊腳踏車。

examples.en: She was convicted after the trial.
examples.zh: 審判後，她被判有罪。

explains: This means that a court officially decides a person committed a crime. The judge or jury listens to the evidence. Legal rules guide the decision.
A person may be found guilty after a fair trial. The result can lead to a penalty. The court explains its decision.
The verb can also mean to prove someone responsible for a wrongdoing. Facts and careful review are important. Everyone deserves a fair process.

examples.en: She has a strong conviction that everyone deserves a fair chance.
examples.zh: 她堅信每個人都應有公平的機會。

examples.en: The court recorded a conviction after the trial.
examples.zh: 法院在審判後記錄了定罪判決。

examples.en: His conviction about the team’s success never changed.
examples.zh: 他對球隊會成功的信念從未改變。

explains: This is a strong belief that someone holds. A person may believe that honesty is important. Their actions can show this belief.
A court’s decision that someone is guilty may also have this name. The decision follows a legal process. Evidence is considered.
A person may feel sure about what they believe. They can explain their reasons respectfully. Listening to others can also be useful.

examples.en: The event director coordinated with caterers, sound crews, and hosts.
examples.zh: 活動總監與外燴廠商、音響團隊及主持人密切協調。

examples.en: Rescue helicopters coordinated closely with ground troops during the search operation.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機在深山搜救行動中，與地面挺進的特搜部隊保持著極為緊密的空地協同。

examples.en: A color consultant helped coordinate the furniture colors with the living room walls.
examples.zh: 色彩搭配顧問專業指導，協助將家具軟件色調與客廳主牆壁紙完美整合搭配。

explains: This means to organize people or actions so they work well together. A teacher may plan times for different groups to use a room. Clear schedules help.
A person may move their hands and feet together smoothly. Dancing requires practice and timing. Music can guide the movement.
Groups can share information and plan who will do each task. Everyone knows their part. Good communication prevents missed steps.

examples.en: Always use royalty-free background music to avoid copyright strikes.
examples.zh: 務必使用免版稅背景音樂以避免觸犯版權警告。

examples.en: The author holds the international copyright to all her published novels.
examples.zh: 該作家對其名下出版的所有長篇小說享有國際著作權。

examples.en: Unauthorized distribution of movie torrents is a clear violation of copyright law.
examples.zh: 未經授權散布電影種子檔案是公然違反著作權法的侵權行為。

examples.en: All photos and articles on this blog are protected under copyright law.
examples.zh: 本部落格上刊載之所有攝影照片與專題文章皆受著作權法保護。

examples.en: The photographer registered copyright for her landscape photos to prevent unauthorized commercial usage.
examples.zh: 該攝影師為其拍攝的高山風景攝影作品登記註冊版權，以嚴防遭他人未經授權擅自商業盜用。

examples.en: Downloading movies from illegal streaming sites directly violates international copyright treaties.
examples.zh: 從非法盜版影音網站任意下載電影觀看，直接違反了國際著作權公約的嚴格規定。

examples.en: Receiving three copyright strikes will result in permanent channel termination.
examples.zh: 若頻道累計遭到權利人提出三次版權警告（Strike），將會面臨被官方永久停權封號。

examples.en: The author holds exclusive copyright over all text and illustrations in the novel.
examples.zh: 作者擁有該部小說中所有文字篇章與精美手繪插畫的獨家著作權保護。

examples.en: Never use background tracks without permission, or your video may face copyright claims.
examples.zh: 未經授權切勿擅自使用受版權保護的背景配樂，否則影片可能會面臨版權索賠。

examples.en: Legal scholars debate whether training large models on public websites constitutes copyright fair use.
examples.zh: 法律學者與法官深入辯論在大規模抓取公開網路文章與插畫訓練大模型時，是否構成著作權法上的「合理使用」。

examples.en: The novelist registered her best-selling fantasy manuscript with the federal copyright office.
examples.zh: 這位當紅奇幻小說作家在長篇手稿出版前夕，依法前往智慧財產局辦理了完整的著作權版權註冊登記。

examples.en: Unauthorized downloading or public broadcasting of commercial movies constitutes severe copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 任何未經授權在公開場所播映未授權商業院線電影或非法重製販售之行為，皆構成嚴重的著作權侵害刑事罪責。

entries.definition: 版權；著作權；取得版權；AI 訓練著作權保護；智慧財產權
explains: This is the legal right that protects a person’s original writing, music, art, or other creative work. It helps control how others copy or share it. Creators can use rules to protect their work.
A book, song, or picture may belong to its creator. People should ask permission before copying it. Giving credit is respectful.
Rules can allow limited use in certain situations. A teacher may explain how to use material fairly. Checking the rules helps avoid problems.

examples.en: Scientists extracted a fifty-foot sediment core to reconstruct prehistoric climate swings and ice age cycles.
examples.zh: 地質學家從海床鑽取了一根長達五十英尺的沉積物岩芯，藉此重構史前冰河時期的氣候變遷。

examples.en: Slicing the sediment core open revealed ash layers from volcanic super-eruptions millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 剖開深海沉積物岩芯，橫斷面清晰浮現出數百萬年前超級海底火山爆發遺留下來的灰白火山灰層。
