examples.en: Technicians carefully freeze and catalog each sediment core inside chilled research ship lockers.
examples.zh: 實驗室技術員細心將採集到的每節沉積物岩芯低溫冷凍並編號建檔，保存於研究船專用冰庫中。

examples.en: Push-core tubes plunged into the seabed extract stratified mud cores containing thousands of micro-fossils.
examples.zh: 垂直插入海床的「柱狀採樣管」（Core Tube），採集出完整分層的深海沉積泥芯，封存著萬年微化石。

examples.en: Honesty and transparency form the absolute core values of our corporate business ethics.
examples.zh: 誠信正直與公開透明，構成了我們整家企業商業道德準則中最不可妥協的核心價值觀。

examples.en: The pastry chef carefully scooped out the center core of the crisp apple before baking the tart.
examples.zh: 甜點名廚在烘烤經典法式蘋果派之前，手持專用去核器細心地將整顆脆甜蘋果的核心果核挖除。

entries.definition: 海底沉積物重力柱狀岩芯採樣管；核心；沉積物柱狀採樣管 (無擾動採集深海泥芯)
explains: This is the central or most important part of something. An apple has a firm middle that holds its seeds. A person can cut around it.
A group may focus on its main idea or purpose. Other details support that central point. Staying focused can help finish a task.
A long cylinder of earth or rock taken from the ground can be studied to learn about the past. Scientists examine its layers. Each layer gives clues.

examples.en: She attended a corporate meeting in the city.
examples.zh: 她在市區參加公司會議。

examples.en: The company announced a corporate policy for its workers.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了一項員工政策。

examples.en: He works in the corporate office downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市中心的公司辦公室工作。

explains: This describes something related to a business company. A company office may have meeting rooms and desks. Workers share information there.
A large business may set rules for its workers. The rules explain how people should act and do their jobs. Clear guidance helps.
A company may sell products or services to customers. Teams plan how to make and deliver them. Good service builds trust.

examples.en: The corporation opened a new office downtown.
examples.zh: 這家公司在市中心開設了新辦公室。

examples.en: A large corporation hired more workers this year.
examples.zh: 一家大型公司今年聘用了更多員工。

examples.en: The corporation makes toys for children.
examples.zh: 這家公司製造兒童玩具。

explains: This is a large business organization that may have many workers. It can sell goods or provide services. People may own shares in it.
A group of people can form this kind of organization to run a business. It follows laws and keeps official records. Leaders guide its work.
The organization may have offices in several places. Different teams handle money, products, and customer help. Good planning connects their work.

examples.en: Studies show a positive correlation between aerobic exercise and memory retention.
examples.zh: 多項研究顯示有氧運動與記憶力保持之間存在著正向相關性。

examples.en: Scientists emphasize that statistical correlation does not necessarily imply direct causation.
examples.zh: 科學界再三強調，統計學上的數據相關性並不必然等同於直接因果關係。

examples.en: Researchers discovered an inverse correlation between sleep deprivation and work productivity.
examples.zh: 研究人員敏銳地發現，睡眠剝奪程度與白天工作生產力之間存在著顯著負相關。

explains: This is a connection between two things that change together. When one number goes up, another may also rise. A chart can show the pattern.
A relationship does not always prove that one thing caused the other. People should check other facts. Careful study avoids wrong conclusions.
Researchers may compare weather and plant growth over time. They look for patterns in the records. More data can help.

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from the international summit in Geneva.
examples.zh: 駐外特派記者自日內瓦舉行的全球領袖高峰會現場發回即時連線報導。

examples.en: He worked as a seasoned war correspondent documenting humanitarian crises across the Middle East.
examples.zh: 他曾擔任資深戰地特派記者，記錄中東地區的人道主義危機。

examples.en: The network's financial correspondent analyzed the central bank's unexpected interest rate decision.
examples.zh: 該電視台的財經特派員深入分析了中央銀行出人意料的利率決策。

entries.definition: 特派記者；特派通訊員；駐外記者
explains: This is a reporter who sends news from a particular place. The person may work in another city or country. They share what is happening there.
A newspaper or radio station may send this reporter to cover a local event. The reporter talks with people and checks facts. Clear details help the audience.
The worker sends stories back to an editor. Photos and notes can support the report. Careful checking helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: Riverbank green corridors connect mountain forests to coastlines, allowing birds and butterflies to migrate safely.
examples.zh: 沿著大漢溪與淡水河畔整建的帶狀都市生態綠廊（Green Corridor），讓鳥類與蝴蝶能安全穿梭棲息。

examples.en: Hospital nurses rushed the emergency gurney quickly down the sterile hallway corridor toward surgery.
examples.zh: 急診醫護人員推著載有重傷病患的緊急急救推床，在寂靜潔淨的無菌醫院長廊走道上分秒必爭狂奔向手術室。

examples.en: The Taiwan High-Speed Rail forms an indispensable Western Taiwan economic and transportation corridor.
examples.zh: 縱貫南北的台灣高速鐵路路網，已構築起連結西半部各大都會區與科學園區不可或缺的黃金經濟運輸走廊。

examples.en: Constructing forested wildlife corridors connects isolated populations, enabling genetic exchange.
examples.zh: 興建綠化「野生動物生態廊道」（Corridor），能串聯被道路隔絕的孤立族群並促進基因健康交流。

examples.en: Aerial rope bridges serve as canopy corridors for arboreal monkeys crossing newly paved mountain highways.
examples.zh: 架設在高空的繩梯天橋為樹棲猴群提供了穿越新闢高山公路的樹冠層生態通道。

examples.en: Riverbank greenways act as essential ecological corridors linking fragmented urban parks together.
examples.zh: 河岸水岸綠帶是串聯破碎都市公園與郊野山林的重要生態廊道。

examples.en: The high-speed corridor acts as the economic spine of the country, linking science parks and tech hubs.
examples.zh: 高鐵「西部經濟走廊動脈」（Corridor），將各大科學園區與竹科、南科緊密串聯為繁榮的一體化經濟動脈。

examples.en: Hospital nurses walked quickly down the brightly lit corridor to attend to a ringing patient buzzer.
examples.zh: 綜合醫院值班護理師快步走過燈火通明的走廊通道，第一時間趕往病房處理病患呼叫鈴。

examples.en: Urban planners established a lush green ecological corridor allowing native deer to roam between forests.
examples.zh: 都會生態規劃師在城市外圍保留了一整條林木繁茂的綠色生態廊道，讓原生水鹿得以安全穿梭於兩片森林。

entries.definition: 都市生態綠廊；走廊；跨越國道之野生動物專用生態廊道；串聯一日生活圈之台灣西部經濟走廊大動脈
explains: This is a long passage connecting rooms or parts of a building. Students walk along it to reach classrooms. Doors open from the sides.
A long, open path may connect one outdoor area with another. Animals can travel along it. Plants and trees offer shelter.
A narrow route through a busy area can help people move between places. Signs can guide them. Keeping the route clear is helpful.

examples.en: The corrupt official took money from the town.
examples.zh: 貪污官員拿走了鎮上的錢。

examples.en: The food was corrupted by unsafe storage.
examples.zh: 食物因保存不當而腐敗了。

examples.en: The judge refused to support a corrupt deal.
examples.zh: 法官拒絕支持不正當的交易。

explains: This describes someone who uses power dishonestly for personal gain. A worker may take money that belongs to the group. Such behavior is wrong.
Food can become spoiled or unsafe when harmful material gets into it. Clean storage helps protect food. People should follow safety rules.
A computer file may be changed to hide the truth or cause problems. Strong safeguards can protect important information. Honest actions matter.

examples.en: The newspaper reported corruption in the city office.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了市府的貪污事件。

examples.en: The investigation uncovered corruption in the company.
examples.zh: 調查揭發了公司的貪腐。

examples.en: Citizens spoke out against corruption in government.
examples.zh: 市民公開反對政府貪污。

explains: This is dishonest behavior by someone who has power or responsibility. A leader may take money meant for a public project. People can report wrongdoing.
Rules and careful records can make it harder for people to cheat. A group can check how money is used. Fair systems matter.
A person may lose trust in a group after dishonest acts are revealed. Leaders can explain what happened and fix problems. Honesty helps rebuild trust.

examples.en: The school offered counsel to students who felt worried.
examples.zh: 學校為感到擔憂的學生提供諮詢。

examples.en: She sought legal counsel before signing the paper.
examples.zh: 簽署文件前，她先尋求法律諮詢。

examples.en: His counsel helped us choose a safe route.
examples.zh: 他的建議幫助我們選擇安全的路線。

explains: This can mean advice or guidance about a problem. A student may ask a teacher what to do about a hard assignment. Careful listening helps.
The word can also name a lawyer who gives legal advice. The person explains rules and represents a client. The work follows laws.
A trusted adult may guide a young person through a difficult choice. They can talk about possible results. The decision belongs to the person.

examples.en: The counselor helped me choose my next classes.
examples.zh: 輔導員幫我選擇下一學期的課程。

examples.en: A counselor listened to the child’s concerns.
examples.zh: 輔導員聆聽了孩子的煩惱。

examples.en: She made an appointment with a school counselor.
examples.zh: 她預約了學校輔導員。

explains: This is a person who helps others with personal, school, or work problems. A student may talk with one about choosing classes. The conversation can help.
The person listens and may suggest steps to try. They keep private details safe. Building trust takes time.
Some work in schools while others help families or groups. Their training helps them guide people. Asking for support is okay.

examples.en: The courteous visitor thanked the host for dinner.
examples.zh: 有禮的訪客感謝主人準備晚餐。

examples.en: He was courteous to the bus driver.
examples.zh: 他對公車司機很有禮貌。

examples.en: Please be courteous when asking a question.
examples.zh: 提問時請保持禮貌。

explains: This describes someone who is polite and shows respect. A person may say please and thank you when asking for help. Kind words matter.
Someone can behave well when visiting another person’s home. They listen, take turns, and follow the host’s rules. Respect makes guests welcome.
A polite person may speak calmly even when they disagree. They let others finish before replying. Good manners help conversations go smoothly.

examples.en: The presidential election received comprehensive 24/7 media coverage nationwide.
examples.zh: 總統大選在全台各大電視新聞台與網路媒體獲得了二十四小時全方位即時報導。

examples.en: Ensure your travel insurance policy provides adequate medical coverage abroad.
examples.zh: 出國前請確保你的旅遊平安險保單包含足夠的海外醫療理賠保障。

examples.en: Live television coverage brought the historic space mission directly into living rooms.
examples.zh: 電視現場直播報導將這項具歷史意義的太空探測任務直接呈現在大眾客廳中。

examples.en: Satellite broadband ensures 100% broadband coverage for remote Pacific fishing boats and mountain villages.
examples.zh: 低軌衛星寬頻為偏遠南太平洋遠洋漁船與崇山峻嶺間的原鄉部落，帶來百分之百無死角的通訊覆蓋。

examples.en: The mobile telecom operator expanded its 5G network coverage to include underground subway tunnels.
examples.zh: 行動電信業者大幅擴建 5G 基地台訊號涵蓋範圍，甚至延伸至地底捷運隧道各線路。

examples.en: Before traveling abroad, purchase travel insurance that provides comprehensive medical emergency coverage.
examples.zh: 在出國自助旅行前，務必購買提供完善海外突發疾病與緊急醫療全方位涵蓋的旅遊保險。

entries.definition: 新聞報導；媒體曝光；保險理賠範圍；全球極地偏鄉無死角通訊覆蓋
explains: This can mean the amount of news or attention given to an event. A newspaper may tell readers about a school concert. Photos can show what happened.
An insurance plan may explain which costs it will pay for. People read the details before choosing a plan. Clear terms matter.
A phone network may reach many places. A map can show where a signal is available. People check it before traveling.

examples.en: Spreading unverified rumors destroys an investigative journalist's professional credibility.
examples.zh: 隨意散布未經求證的傳聞將會徹底摧毀一位深度調查記者長年累積的專業公信力。

examples.en: Citing peer-reviewed studies significantly enhances the credibility of your research paper.
examples.zh: 引用經同儕審查的學術研究能大幅提升你的學術論文可信度。

examples.en: Once lost, an institution's credibility with the public is extremely hard to rebuild.
examples.zh: 一個機構在大眾心中的公信力一旦喪失，便極難再次重建。

explains: This is how much people believe someone or something can be trusted. A news source gains trust by checking facts. Readers look for reliable information.
A person’s honest actions can build trust over time. Keeping promises helps. One lie may damage it.
A report seems believable when it gives clear sources and evidence. Readers can check the details themselves. Careful research matters.

examples.en: We followed the creek through the woods.
examples.zh: 我們沿著溪流穿過樹林。

examples.en: A small bridge crossed the creek.
examples.zh: 一座小橋橫跨溪流。

examples.en: The children watched fish swim in the creek.
examples.zh: 孩子們看著魚在溪裡游泳。

explains: This is a small stream of water that flows through land. It may run beside trees or fields. People can hear the water move.
Rain and melting snow may feed the stream. It can become deeper after a storm. Visitors should be careful near fast water.
Fish and insects may live in this waterway. Plants along its banks give them shelter. Keeping litter away helps protect them.

examples.en: The flood crippled traffic across the town.
examples.zh: 洪水癱瘓了全鎮的交通。

examples.en: A broken wheel crippled the cart until it was repaired.
examples.zh: 車輪壞了，讓手推車無法使用，直到修好為止。

examples.en: The long delay crippled the team’s plan for the day.
examples.zh: 漫長的延誤嚴重打亂了隊伍當天的計畫。

explains: This means to badly damage something or make it difficult to use. A storm may damage roads and stop buses from running. Repair workers can help.
An injury can limit how well a body part works. A person may need support while healing. A health professional can explain care.
A lack of tools may seriously slow a project. The team can find another way to finish. Asking for help may solve the problem.

examples.en: Achieving a Noise Criterion (NC) rating below 15 requires extensive silencing across all mechanical systems.
examples.zh: 想要達到「噪音評定準則」（Noise Criterion NC）15 級以下的極限標準，必須對全館所有機電進行深度消音。

examples.en: Academic integrity and genuine research passion served as the primary criterion for selecting scholarship winners.
examples.zh: 學術誠信與對學術探究的真實熱忱，是評審委員會遴選今年度頂尖出國獎學金得主的最高核心準則。

examples.en: Financial institutions evaluate credit score history as a crucial criterion when reviewing mortgage applications.
examples.zh: 各家金融行庫在嚴格審核購屋房貸申請時，將申請人過往的聯徵個人信用評分紀錄列為關鍵核貸準則。

examples.en: Taiwan's green building evaluation system assesses projects across nine strict ecological criteria.
examples.zh: 台灣 EEWH 綠建築評估制度依據生態、節能、減廢與健康等九大嚴格評估指標進行分級。

examples.en: Projects must fulfill mandatory criteria regarding greenery coverage and soil water retention before receiving permits.
examples.zh: 新建建案在取得建照前，必須在綠化量指標與基地保水指標等強制性評鑑基準上全數達標。

examples.en: The review committee evaluated the architectural blueprint against established low-carbon criteria.
examples.zh: 審查委員會依照政府最新公告的低碳永續建築指標，對投標建築規劃藍圖進行逐項嚴格審核。

entries.definition: 國際音樂廳噪音評定準則 (NC 噪音曲線等級)；準則；台灣 EEWH 綠建築九大指標評估基準
explains: This is a rule or measure used to judge whether something meets a need. A teacher may use clear rules to grade a project. Students know what to aim for.
A group may compare options using several important measures. One choice may be safer or cheaper. Writing them down helps.
A person can decide whether a tool is right for a job. They check its size, strength, and cost. The best choice fits the task.

examples.en: It is crucial to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車時戴安全帽非常重要。

examples.en: Water is crucial for plants and animals.
examples.zh: 水對動植物至關重要。

examples.en: The final clue was crucial to solving the puzzle.
examples.zh: 最後一條線索對解開謎題極為關鍵。

explains: This describes something extremely important to a result. A key may help someone open a locked door. Without it, the person cannot get inside.
A decision may affect many people. They should learn the facts before choosing. Careful discussion can help.
One small step can be necessary to finish a larger task. A team checks each step on its list. Missing one can cause a delay.

examples.en: The carpenter used crude tools to shape the wood.
examples.zh: 木匠用粗糙的工具修整木頭。

examples.en: The oil was still crude before it was refined.
examples.zh: 石油尚未精煉前稱為原油。

examples.en: His crude joke upset the group.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的笑話讓大家不舒服。

explains: This describes something in a natural or unfinished state. A rough wooden board may need sanding before painting. It has not been smoothed.
A material that has not been cleaned or refined may be called this. Workers process it before using it. Careful handling is important.
A comment can be blunt or unpolished. The speaker may need to choose kinder words. Respectful speech helps.

examples.en: We booked a cruise around the islands.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了環島郵輪之旅。

examples.en: The ship will cruise along the coast.
examples.zh: 船將沿著海岸航行。

examples.en: They enjoyed a week-long cruise with their family.
examples.zh: 他們和家人享受了一週的郵輪假期。

explains: This is a trip taken for pleasure on a large ship. Passengers visit different ports during the journey. The ship may have rooms and places to eat.
A vehicle can move smoothly at a steady speed. A driver may travel along a road without rushing. Safe attention is needed.
The verb can mean to travel by boat or plane at a steady pace. People watch the route and weather. The journey can last many days.

examples.en: Instant freezing creates microscopic ice crystals, yielding an incomparably silky, velvety gelato.
examples.zh: 瞬間極速冷凍徹底消除了粗糙大冰晶，創造出細膩到「微米級冰晶結構」（Microscopic Ice Crystals）的絲滑冰淇淋。

examples.en: The chandelier in the historic ballroom was crafted from hundreds of hand-cut sparkling crystal prisms.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的國宴宴會廳水晶吊燈，由數百枚手工精密切割的水晶三稜鏡折射出璀璨光芒。

examples.en: Snowflakes form distinct hexagonal ice crystal patterns as moisture freezes high in winter clouds.
examples.zh: 當水氣在冬日高空凍結時，每一片飄落的雪花都會凝結成獨一無二的六角形冰晶圖案。

entries.definition: 極速冷凍消除大冰晶之極致絲滑頂級冰淇淋；水晶
explains: This is a clear solid that forms in a regular shape. Some kinds are found in rocks. Light can shine through them.
The word can describe clear glass or plastic shaped like a natural solid. It may be used in decorations. Its surfaces catch light.
Snowflakes form in tiny solid patterns in cold clouds. Each one has a delicate shape. People can see them under a magnifying glass.

examples.en: Taiwanese cuisine is celebrated globally for diverse night market snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣在地特色料理因豐富多元的夜市小吃而揚名國際。

examples.en: Cantonese cuisine emphasizes fresh seafood and gentle steaming techniques.
examples.zh: 經典粵菜菜系極為講究生猛鮮活的海鮮食材與原汁原味的清蒸火候技藝。

examples.en: The cosmopolitan city offers a vibrant variety of international cuisines.
examples.zh: 這座多元文化的國際大都會匯聚了令人目不暇給的各國道地風味料理。

entries.definition: 菜系；特色料理；烹飪藝術
explains: This is a style of cooking linked to a place or culture. A region may be known for noodles, herbs, or special sauces. Recipes pass between generations.
A meal can show the flavors people enjoy in an area. Visitors may try local dishes when traveling. Food can tell a story.
Different styles use different ingredients and methods. Cooks may roast, steam, or fry food. Each method creates a different taste.

examples.en: The local currency used in Taiwan is the New Taiwan Dollar (NTD).
examples.zh: 台灣使用的本地貨幣為新台幣（NTD）。

examples.en: Most European Union nations adopted the Euro as their common currency.
examples.zh: 多數歐盟國家採用歐元作為其通用流通貨幣。

examples.en: Exchange rates between foreign currencies fluctuate on financial markets daily.
examples.zh: 各國外幣之間的匯率每天在金融市場上持續浮動。

examples.en: The New Taiwan Dollar (NTD) is the official domestic currency.
examples.zh: 新台幣（NTD）是台灣法定的官方流通貨幣。

examples.en: Digital cryptocurrencies operate without central bank supervision.
examples.zh: 數位加密虛擬貨幣在沒有各國央行監管與背書的去中心化模式下運作。

examples.en: His unconventional philosophical arguments gained broad currency among students.
examples.zh: 他標新立異的哲學論述在大學校園學生群體中獲得了廣泛的認同與流傳。

entries.definition: 貨幣；通貨；流通貨幣；流通
explains: This is the kind of money used in a country or region. People use it to buy goods and pay for services. Coins and notes may look different.
Travelers may exchange one kind of money for another before a trip. The amount they receive can change. Checking the rate is helpful.
Some money exists as coins, paper notes, or digital amounts. Stores show prices using the money people use locally. Clear labels prevent confusion.

examples.en: The school curriculum includes art and science.
examples.zh: 學校課程包含美術和科學。

examples.en: The teacher changed the curriculum to add more reading time.
examples.zh: 老師修改了課程，增加閱讀時間。

examples.en: Our curriculum has lessons about plants and animals.
examples.zh: 我們的課程安排了關於動植物的課程。

explains: This is the set of subjects and lessons taught in a school or course. A class plan may include reading, math, and science. Students learn different skills.
Teachers use learning goals to decide what to teach. Lessons can build from simple ideas to harder ones. Planning helps students progress.
A course may include books, activities, and tests. Students can ask questions when they need help. A clear plan shows what to study.

examples.en: A rigorous chain of custody log proves that the blood sample was never altered or contaminated.
examples.zh: 嚴謹記載每位經手人的證物保管鏈，證明血液樣本從未遭受竄改或污染。

examples.en: Any break in the chain of custody can render crucial evidence completely inadmissible in court.
examples.zh: 證物保管鏈在傳遞過程中只要出現任何時間斷點或紀錄漏洞，都會導致關鍵證物在法庭上被全盤推翻。

examples.en: The forensic officer signed the custody transfer sheet before delivering the weapon to the ballistics lab.
examples.zh: 鑑識警官在將作案槍枝親自押送至彈道實驗室前，在證物保管移交清冊上鄭重簽字確認。

entries.definition: 證物保管鏈紀錄 (防竄改防調包)；監管
explains: This means the care and control of a person or object. A parent may look after a young child after school. The child stays safe.
A court may decide which adult a child lives with. The decision follows laws and the child’s needs. Families may need support.
A museum keeps valuable objects in a safe place. Workers record who handles each item. Careful records prevent loss.

examples.en: Declare any fresh agricultural products when passing customs.
examples.zh: 通過海關時，若攜帶任何新鮮農產品必須申報。

examples.en: The border customs officer inspected our declaration forms carefully.
examples.zh: 邊境海關官員仔細檢查了我們的申報單。

examples.en: It took almost an hour to pass through airport customs and immigration.
examples.zh: 通過機場海關與移民審查關卡花了將近一個小時。

examples.en: Passengers must pass through airport customs and declare fresh meat items.
examples.zh: 旅客入境時必須通過機場海關並主動申報生鮮肉類製品。

examples.en: The customs officer asked us to open our luggage for a routine random check.
examples.zh: 海關官員要求我們打開隨身行李接受例行隨機抽查。

examples.en: Different ethnic groups observe unique cultural customs during lunar new year festivities.
examples.zh: 不同族群在農曆春節節慶期間恪守著各自獨特的文化習俗。

examples.en: Go through the Red Channel at customs if you have goods exceeding duty allowances.
examples.zh: 若您隨身攜帶超過免稅限額之高價名品或外幣現鈔，通關時請主動走紅線應申報海關櫃檯。

examples.en: Customs agents randomly scan baggage to detect undeclared foreign currencies or plants.
examples.zh: 海關緝私關員在出關通道前隨機抽驗旅客隨身行李，以查緝未申報之高額外幣或管制生鮮植物。

examples.en: Walk through the Green Channel at customs if you have nothing to declare.
examples.zh: 若您本次入境所攜帶的行李物品皆完全符合免稅規範且無受管制品，可直接步入綠線免申報通道。

examples.en: Cross-border parcels undergo automated X-ray security scanning and customs clearance checks.
examples.zh: 每一件搭機抵達國門的跨境網購包裹皆必須通過高速 X 光安檢機掃描與海關嚴格報關審驗。

examples.en: All passengers carrying undeclared foreign currency exceeding regulatory limits will be detained by customs.
examples.zh: 旅客攜帶超出法定限額且未誠實申報的外幣現鈔通關入境時，一律將依法遭海關攔截沒入裁罰。

examples.en: Experienced brokers guide importers through complex customs classification codes and documentation.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的專業報關行人員協助進口商精確申報繁瑣的各類海關商品稅則號列與產地證明文件。

examples.en: Paperless electronic customs declarations clear compliant import cargo within minutes of ship arrival.
examples.zh: 採用無紙化智慧海關申報，在貨輪靠泊後數分鐘內即可完成合規貨物線上放行。

examples.en: High-risk shipments flagged by automated risk algorithms are diverted to customs inspection bays.
examples.zh: 被智慧風險評估演算法列為高風險的貨櫃，會被自動導引至海關專用人工開箱查驗區。

examples.en: Customs brokers assist importers by classifying tariff codes and ensuring trade compliance.
examples.zh: 專業報關行全力協助進口廠商精確申報貨品稅則號列，並確保百分之百符合各項貿易法規。

entries.definition: 海關；關稅；出入境檢查處；海關（貨物與行李申報稽查）；海關報關查驗；智慧無紙化二十四小時快速海關通關
explains: This is the government service that checks goods and luggage entering or leaving a country. Travelers may need to answer questions. Workers look for restricted items.
A border officer may ask what a person is carrying. Travelers should follow the rules and tell the truth. Clear forms help.
A country may charge money on certain goods brought from elsewhere. The amount depends on the rules. People can check requirements before a trip.

examples.en: The snake has a deadly bite.
examples.zh: 那條蛇的咬傷可能致命。

examples.en: A deadly storm moved toward the coast.
examples.zh: 致命的暴風雨朝海岸移動。

examples.en: The poison was deadly to small animals.
examples.zh: 這種毒藥對小動物有致命危險。

explains: This describes something that can cause death. A dangerous poison can harm a person if swallowed. People should never taste unknown substances.
A very serious storm may threaten lives. Families can follow safety instructions and move to shelter. Emergency workers help.
The word can describe an animal’s venom or a harmful disease. Experts explain the risks. People should take warnings seriously.

examples.en: Volunteer divers haul tons of discarded fishing nets and plastic marine debris from the seafloor.
examples.zh: 熱血潛水志工每週背著氣瓶潛入海底，合力割除並打撈重達數噸的沉底廢棄刺網與海洋塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: Ingested microplastic debris accumulates inside the digestive systems of seabirds and marine mammals.
examples.zh: 漂浮在海中的微塑膠碎片被誤食後，會長期沉積累積在海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的腸胃消化系統中。

examples.en: Giant ocean gyres trap floating plastic debris, forming massive offshore garbage patches across the Pacific.
examples.zh: 浩瀚的太平洋環流系統將數以億計的漂流塑膠廢棄物聚攏在一起，形成了震驚全球的「太平洋垃圾帶」。

examples.en: Thousands of defunct satellites and rocket fragments form dangerous orbiting space debris.
examples.zh: 數以萬計退役報廢的衛星與火箭殘骸在地球軌道以超音速狂飆，形成威脅太空站安全的太空垃圾。

examples.en: International space agencies collaborate to track microscopic space debris moving at bullet speeds.
examples.zh: 各國太空機構通力合作，嚴密監控那些以子彈般超高時速呼嘯飛馳的微型太空碎屑殘骸。

examples.en: Rescue workers cleared fallen concrete debris from the collapsed highway after the magnitude 7 tremor.
examples.zh: 在芮氏規模七的強震過後，救難人員全力清除從崩塌高架道路上掉落的混凝土瓦礫殘骸。

examples.en: International radar networks track over thirty thousand pieces of tracked space debris larger than a softball.
examples.zh: 國際太空雷達監測網絡日夜追蹤超過三萬件大於壘球、在軌道上以數十倍音速狂飆的太空垃圾殘骸。

examples.en: City sanitation workers cleared broken glass and tree debris from roads following the fierce typhoon.
examples.zh: 清潔隊環保人員在強颱過境後，迅速清除倒塌在市區幹道上的殘破碎玻璃與斷裂樹枝殘骸。

examples.en: Forensic investigators sifted through the burnt debris of the warehouse to pinpoint the origin of the fire.
examples.zh: 鑑識火調專家細心篩檢燒毀倉庫現場焦黑的火災殘骸碎片，以精確鎖定最初的起火點。

entries.definition: 海洋廢棄物；殘骸垃圾 (Marine Debris)；太空垃圾碎片 (Space Debris)；殘骸；太空垃圾高速廢棄物殘骸
explains: This is broken pieces left after something is damaged or destroyed. A storm may leave pieces of branches on the ground. Workers can clear them safely.
A crash can scatter bits of glass or metal. People should stay away from sharp pieces. Cleanup crews wear protective gear.
Space missions leave small human-made objects moving around Earth. Scientists track them carefully. These pieces can be dangerous to spacecraft.

examples.en: The actor made her debut in a school play.
examples.zh: 那位演員第一次在校園戲劇中登台演出。

examples.en: The phone made its debut at the technology show.
examples.zh: 這支手機在科技展上首次亮相。

examples.en: He scored a goal during his professional debut.
examples.zh: 他在職業生涯首場比賽中進了一球。

explains: This is a person’s first public appearance or performance. A young singer may perform on stage for the first time. The audience welcomes the new artist.
A new product can be shown to the public for the first time. People may read about it online. The event creates interest.
The first game of a sports player’s career can be a special moment. Fans may cheer. Practice prepares the player for the occasion.

examples.en: Improving roof ventilation arrests fungal wood decay, extending the lifespan of ancient rafters.
examples.zh: 改善屋架頂部的通風對流，能從根本阻絕真菌滋生引發的木材腐朽，大幅延長古木樑壽命。

examples.en: Entomologists discovered moisture trapped behind false ceilings was fueling internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 昆蟲與病理專家發現藏在木作夾層暗處的濕氣滯留，是導致內部古樑菌絲腐朽的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Left unchecked, wood decay fungi can hollow out load-bearing columns within a single decade.
examples.zh: 若不及時處置，木材腐朽菌會在短短十年間將整根主要承重木柱的核心徹底蛀空。

entries.definition: 濕氣引發之木結構真菌腐朽；腐爛
explains: This means to rot or break down over time. Fruit left in a warm place may soften and spoil. It should be thrown away.
A tooth can break down when germs damage its hard surface. Brushing and dental care help keep it clean. A dentist can examine it.
A building may weaken when water and weather damage its materials. Regular repairs can help protect it. People should stay away from unsafe structures.

examples.en: He deceived his friend by hiding the broken toy.
examples.zh: 他藏起壞掉的玩具來欺騙朋友。

examples.en: The fake message deceived many readers.
examples.zh: 這則假消息騙了許多讀者。

examples.en: She felt sad when the salesman deceived her family.
examples.zh: 銷售員欺騙她的家人時，她感到難過。

explains: This means to make someone believe something that is not true. A person may tell a lie to hide a mistake. The lie can hurt trust.
A trick can fool someone into giving away private information. People should check who is asking before sharing details. Careful questions help.
A story may include a character who hides the truth. Later, others discover what really happened. Honest words can repair trust.

examples.en: The hotel room was decent and clean.
examples.zh: 旅館房間整潔，住起來還不錯。

examples.en: He earned a decent score on the spelling test.
examples.zh: 他的拼字測驗成績還算不錯。

examples.en: She is a decent person who always helps her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她是個善良正派的人，總是幫助鄰居。

explains: This describes something acceptable or good enough. A clean room with a comfortable bed can be a suitable place to sleep. It does not need to be fancy.
A person may behave fairly and kindly. They listen and keep their promises. Good actions earn respect.
The word can also mean proper or appropriate for a situation. A quiet voice is right for a library. People follow shared rules.

examples.en: Travelers submit customs declaration forms declaring regulated foreign currencies or tobacco.
examples.zh: 入境旅客依法誠實填寫並繳交海關申報單，主動列明攜帶之受管制外幣現鈔與菸酒數量。

examples.en: Sign the legal declaration at the bottom confirming all entered details are accurate.
examples.zh: 在紙本或電子海關申報單最下方親筆簽名，鄭重確認所有填報的行李物品內容均完全屬實。

examples.en: Failure to make an honest declaration of agricultural products carries heavy monetary fines.
examples.zh: 入境時若未如實申報隨身攜帶的違禁動植物產品，一經查獲將面臨高達數十萬元的巨額罰鍰。

examples.en: Falsifying invoice values on import customs declarations violates national trade regulations.
examples.zh: 在進口海關報關申報單上低報商品發票價值以圖逃漏稅，屬於違法行為將面臨高額罰鍰。

examples.en: Travelers must submit an accurate currency declaration before walking through the red inspection channel.
examples.zh: 攜帶超額現鈔或高價應稅管制品之旅客，在走入海關紅線查驗櫃檯前必須填寫正確申報單。

examples.en: The electronic declaration system automatically cross-references submitted cargo lists against shipping manifests.
examples.zh: 海關電子申報審核系統會自動將報關行上傳的貨物清單，與航商申報的艙單提單進行大數據勾稽。

entries.definition: 海關申報單；鄭重聲明；進口報關申報單；宣告
explains: This is a clear statement made in public or on paper. A town may announce a new rule. Residents can read what it says.
A traveler may fill out a form about items being carried across a border. The form gives important facts. Honest answers are needed.
A group can officially say that something is true. Members may sign a paper to show agreement. The words should be clear.

examples.en: The temperature declined after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落後氣溫下降了。

examples.en: She declined the invitation because she was busy.
examples.zh: 她因為很忙而婉拒了邀請。

examples.en: The number of errors declined after the lesson.
examples.zh: 上完課後，錯誤數量減少了。

explains: This means to become smaller, weaker, or less. A puddle may get smaller under the sun. The water slowly disappears.
A person may politely refuse an offer. They can say no with kind words. The other person may ask someone else.
A number may go down over time. A chart can show the change. Checking the dates helps explain the pattern.

examples.en: She dedicated the song to her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她把這首歌獻給奶奶。

examples.en: He dedicated an hour each day to reading.
examples.zh: 他每天花一小時專心閱讀。

examples.en: They dedicated the new garden to the school community.
examples.zh: 他們把新花園獻給學校社區。

explains: This means to give time or effort to a person, task, or cause. A student may spend each afternoon practicing music. Regular effort can lead to progress.
A person may set aside a book for someone they love. The book can show care and thought. Small actions are meaningful.
A worker may use time to help a community project. The effort supports a shared goal. Teamwork can make a difference.

examples.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges during the initial hearing.
examples.zh: 被告在初次開庭審訊程序中針對檢方所起訴之罪名全數抗辯無罪。

examples.en: The public defender worked tirelessly to prepare an alibi defense for the indigent defendant.
examples.zh: 公設辯護人日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心為這名無力聘請大律師的貧困刑事被告搜集完整的不在場證明。

examples.en: Throughout the televised courtroom trial, the defendant remained completely silent and expressionless.
examples.zh: 在整場電視新聞全程轉播的法庭公開審理過程中，端坐在被告席上的被告始終緊抿雙唇且面無表情。

explains: This is a person accused of breaking a law in court. The court listens to evidence before deciding what happened. The person has legal rights.
A lawyer may speak for this person during a trial. The lawyer asks questions and explains the person’s side. The judge follows the law.
A person may be found guilty or not guilty after the case is heard. The decision depends on the evidence. A fair process matters.

examples.en: Maintaining a modest 300-calorie daily deficit results in sustainable fat loss.
examples.zh: 每天維持約三百大卡的溫和熱量赤字（Calorie Deficit），能達成健康不掉肌肉的減脂目標。

examples.en: Creating too severe a caloric deficit will slow your metabolism and lead to muscle atrophy.
examples.zh: 製造過度極端的熱量赤字會導致基礎代謝率驟降，並引發不必要的肌肉流失。

examples.en: Tracking food intake diligently makes it much easier to sustain a consistent calorie deficit.
examples.zh: 認真記錄每日飲食熱量攝取，能讓你更輕鬆且精準地維持穩定的熱量赤字。

entries.definition: 熱量赤字；赤字缺口；虧損
explains: This is an amount by which spending is greater than available money or income. A school may need to plan carefully if costs exceed its budget. Saving can help.
A shortage happens when there is not enough of something needed. A store may run low on bread before a holiday. Workers can bring more.
A game may have fewer points than the other team. Players can keep trying. Practice may improve the next result.

examples.en: The team defied the odds and won the game.
examples.zh: 隊伍克服重重困難，贏得比賽。

examples.en: She defied the rule and entered the closed room.
examples.zh: 她違反規定，走進了封閉的房間。

examples.en: The small boat defied the waves during the storm.
examples.zh: 小船在暴風雨中頂著浪前進。

explains: This means to resist a rule, command, or strong force. A child may refuse to follow an unfair order. They can explain why they disagree.
A person may face a difficult challenge bravely. They keep trying even when the task is hard. Support can help them continue.
Someone can openly refuse to accept an idea. They give reasons for their choice. Respectful disagreement is possible.

examples.en: Good managers delegate daily tasks so they can focus on strategy.
examples.zh: 優秀的管理者懂得授權分派日常瑣事，以便全神貫注於策略佈局。

examples.en: Hundreds of international delegates attended the United Nations climate conference.
examples.zh: 來自世界各國的數百位官方代表團代表，齊聚一堂出席了聯合國氣候變遷大會。

examples.en: You cannot do everything alone; learn to delegate responsibilities to your capable deputies.
examples.zh: 你不可能事必躬親凡事一人扛；學會將具體職責適度授權分派給得力副手是關鍵修煉。

explains: This means to give a task or responsibility to another person. A teacher may ask a student to hand out papers. Sharing jobs saves time.
A leader can choose someone to speak for a group. The person shares the group’s ideas at a meeting. Clear instructions help.
People can assign parts of a project to different helpers. Each person knows what to do. Working together helps finish the job.

examples.en: Effective task delegation improves team efficiency and trust.
examples.zh: 有效的任務授權委派能提高團隊效率並建立彼此互信。

examples.en: A prestigious international trade delegation visited Hsinchu Science Park yesterday.
examples.zh: 一個由多國政商領袖組成的高規格國際經貿代表團，於昨日親赴新竹科學園區參訪交流。

examples.en: Proper delegation of authority prevents managerial bottlenecks from strangling project growth.
examples.zh: 建立制度化的權責充分授權，能有效防範管理高層決策塞車瓶頸扼殺專案的敏捷擴張。

explains: This is a group of people chosen to speak or act for a larger group. They may travel to another city for a meeting. They share ideas and listen.
The group may represent a country, school, or organization. Members meet with other people and explain their views. Good preparation helps.
People in the group can bring different knowledge and skills. They work together toward a shared goal. Clear communication matters.

examples.en: The deliberate choice helped the team save time.
examples.zh: 深思熟慮的選擇幫助隊伍節省時間。

examples.en: She made a deliberate effort to include everyone.
examples.zh: 她刻意努力讓每個人都參與。

examples.en: He moved the cup with a deliberate hand.
examples.zh: 他慎重地移動杯子。

explains: This describes something done on purpose rather than by accident. A person may break a rule knowingly. They understand what they are doing.
The word can mean to think carefully before making a choice. A student may consider two projects before picking one. Taking time helps.
A slow and careful action may be planned in advance. A driver checks the road before turning. Care helps prevent mistakes.

examples.en: The democrat spoke at the local meeting.
examples.zh: 那位民主黨人出席了地方會議。

examples.en: She is a democrat who volunteers during elections.
examples.zh: 她是一位在選舉期間參與志工服務的民主黨人。

examples.en: The democrat explained his plan to the voters.
examples.zh: 那位民主黨人向選民說明他的計畫。

explains: This can mean someone who supports people's right to choose their leaders. They believe citizens should have a voice in how their country is run. The word describes a person's political beliefs.

In the United States, the capitalized form names a member or supporter of one of the two main political parties. A donkey is a familiar symbol of this party. A person may support its candidates in elections.

Someone with this belief may argue that people should vote on important public choices. They may oppose giving one ruler all the power. In this general sense, the word does not name membership in a particular party.

examples.en: His denial surprised the whole team.
examples.zh: 他的否認令全隊感到驚訝。

examples.en: She issued a denial of the rumor.
examples.zh: 她發表聲明否認那則謠言。

examples.en: The child’s denial did not change what the camera showed.
examples.zh: 攝影機拍到的畫面並未改變孩子的否認。

explains: This is a statement that says something is not true or did not happen. A person may say they did not break the vase. Others may check the facts.
A person may refuse to accept that a problem exists. Talking calmly can help them understand the situation. Care and patience matter.
A written statement can reject an accusation. The writer may explain their reasons. Evidence can help people learn what happened.

examples.en: High-density urban centers require efficient public metro transport and green parkways.
examples.zh: 人口稠密的高密度都會核心區高度仰賴四通八達的捷運大眾運輸網絡與綠意盎然的林蔭大道。

examples.en: Lead has an exceptionally high physical density, making it an effective shield against radiation.
examples.zh: 金屬鉛在物理學上擁有超高密度的原子排列結構，因而成為阻擋致命核輻射穿透最行之有效的屏蔽材料。

examples.en: Urban planners strive to balance residential population density with sufficient community open green space.
examples.zh: 都市空間規劃學者極力在居高不下的人口居住密度與維持充沛的社區公共綠地空間之間尋求最佳平衡。

examples.en: Extreme pixel density eliminates the screen-door effect, making virtual screens look like solid paper.
examples.zh: 極致的「像素密度」（Pixel Density），徹底消除了紗窗網格感，使虛擬螢幕細膩得如真實印刷紙張。

examples.en: Urban planners study population density when designing new MRT lines and bus transit routes.
examples.zh: 都市計畫專家在規劃新捷運路線與公車接駁路網時，會詳加研究人口密度。

examples.en: The metal alloy was chosen for its high tensile strength and relatively low material density.
examples.zh: 該金屬合金因兼具高抗拉強度與相對較低的材料密度而獲選採用。

entries.definition: 容積建蔽密度；人口密度；每英吋三千像素超高密度 (徹底消除紗窗效應)
explains: This is how tightly things are packed into a space. A box filled with many books has more items in it than an empty box. The weight may be greater.
A town with many homes close together has a high number of people in a small area. A map can show crowded places. The number helps compare different places.
A material may feel heavy for its size. Scientists compare its mass with the space it takes up. Measurements help describe it.

examples.en: The painting depicts a village beside the sea.
examples.zh: 那幅畫描繪了一座海邊村莊。

examples.en: The story depicts a brave child helping a friend.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一個勇敢的孩子幫助朋友。

examples.en: The diagram depicts how water moves through the pipe.
examples.zh: 圖表說明水如何在管線中流動。

explains: This means to show someone or something in a picture, story, or description. An artist may draw a bird sitting on a branch. The image helps viewers imagine it.
A writer can show what a character is like through actions and words. Readers learn about the person. Details make the story vivid.
A map may use colors to show hills, roads, and rivers. The symbols make information easier to see. A key explains them.

examples.en: The firefighters deployed extra trucks near the forest.
examples.zh: 消防隊在森林附近部署了更多消防車。

examples.en: The team deployed its players across the field.
examples.zh: 隊伍把選手部署在球場各處。

examples.en: The school deployed a new reading app on its tablets.
examples.zh: 學校在平板電腦上安裝了新的閱讀程式。

explains: This means to move people or equipment into position for a task. Helpers may bring supplies to a flood area. Careful planning helps them work.
A team can arrange its members where they are needed. Each person knows their role. Clear signals help everyone cooperate.
A computer program can be placed onto a device so it is ready to use. Workers test it first. Instructions help users.

examples.en: The rainy weather depressed the hikers.
examples.zh: 下雨的天氣讓登山客心情低落。

examples.en: The news depressed the audience for a moment.
examples.zh: 這則消息讓觀眾一時情緒低落。

examples.en: A lower score depressed the team, but they kept practicing.
examples.zh: 分數降低讓隊伍沮喪，但他們仍繼續練習。

explains: This means to make someone feel sad or lower something. Dark news may make a person feel unhappy. Talking with someone kind can help.
A lower price can make a store seem less busy or exciting. A change in plans may affect sales. People review the results.
A button can lower a number or level on a machine. The user follows the instructions. Small changes can make a room quieter.

examples.en: The deputy helped the sheriff speak with residents.
examples.zh: 副警長協助警長與居民交談。

examples.en: A deputy led the meeting while the chief was away.
examples.zh: 首長不在時，副手主持了會議。

examples.en: The deputy carried the message to the town office.
examples.zh: 副手把消息帶到鎮公所。

explains: This is an official who helps another leader and may take that person’s place. A town official can assist the head of a local office. The role has duties.
A person in law enforcement may support a sheriff or other local official. They help keep the community safe. Training is required.
The word can name someone chosen to represent a group. They attend meetings and share information. Clear communication helps.

examples.en: Many English words derive from Latin.
examples.zh: 許多英文單字源自拉丁文。

examples.en: The recipe derives its flavor from fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 食譜的風味來自新鮮香草。

examples.en: She derived the answer from the clues in the story.
examples.zh: 她從故事線索推導出答案。

explains: This means to get something from a source. A plant gets water from the soil. Its roots take in what it needs.
A word may come from an older language. Writers can study how its spelling and meaning changed. Dictionaries provide details.
A person can reach an answer by looking at facts. They connect the clues and explain how they know. Careful thinking helps.

examples.en: The climbers descended the mountain before dark.
examples.zh: 登山客在天黑前下了山。

examples.en: The stairs descend to the basement.
examples.zh: 樓梯通往地下室。

examples.en: She descended from a long line of musicians.
examples.zh: 她出身於一個音樂家世家。

explains: This means to move from a higher place to a lower one. A hiker may walk down a steep hill carefully. Slow steps help prevent a fall.
A person can come from a family or group that lived earlier. Stories and records show where relatives began. People may trace their history.
A path may slope toward a river. Rainwater flows down it. Plants can grow along the way.

examples.en: The descriptive paragraph helped me picture the garden.
examples.zh: 這段描寫生動的文字讓我想像出花園的樣子。

examples.en: She wrote a descriptive account of the parade.
examples.zh: 她寫了一篇描述遊行的文章。

examples.en: The guide gave a descriptive tour of the old house.
examples.zh: 導遊詳細介紹了那棟老房子。

explains: This describes writing or speech that gives details about a person, place, or thing. A reader may learn the color, size, and shape of a bird. Specific details help.
A story with many sensory details helps readers imagine a scene. They can picture sights, sounds, and smells. Clear words create an image.
A report may explain exactly what someone observed. Notes help keep the facts accurate. Careful description supports learning.

examples.en: He felt despair after losing the race.
examples.zh: 輸掉比賽後，他感到絕望。

examples.en: The family faced despair when their home was damaged.
examples.zh: 房子受損時，這家人陷入絕望。

examples.en: A message of hope helped ease her despair.
examples.zh: 充滿希望的訊息減輕了她的絕望。

explains: This is a feeling of having no hope. A person who fails at a hard task may feel very sad. Friends can offer support.
A character in a story may lose hope after many problems. The character may need help to try again. A kind friend can encourage them.
People can feel discouraged when a goal seems far away. Taking one small step may help. Talking with someone trusted is useful.

examples.en: Taroko Gorge is a world-renowned travel destination.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷是舉世聞名的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: We finally reached our destination after an eight-hour scenic train ride.
examples.zh: 經過八小時風景優美的火車車程後，我們終於抵達了目的地。

examples.en: The island has become a preferred destination for honeymoon vacations.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼已成為度蜜月度假的首選勝地。

examples.en: Jiufen Old Street is a must-visit mountain destination for overseas visitors.
examples.zh: 九份老街是海外觀光客必訪的山城旅遊勝地目的地。

examples.en: After a twelve-hour flight, the passengers finally reached their sunny European destination.
examples.zh: 經過十二小時的長途飛行，乘客們終於抵達了陽光明媚的歐洲目的地。

examples.en: Hualien remains one of the top holiday destinations for domestic ecotourism.
examples.zh: 花蓮一直是國內生態旅遊的首選度假勝地之一。

explains: This is the place someone plans to go. A family may travel to a beach for a holiday. They check the route before leaving.
A bus or train may stop at its final place on a route. Passengers get off there. Signs show where they are.
People may choose a place for a trip because it has interesting sights. A map can help them find it. Planning makes travel easier.

examples.en: We may not choose our starting conditions, but through persistent choices, we become the authors of our own destiny.
examples.zh: 我們或許無法選擇原生出身的起點，但透過每一次堅定而清醒的抉擇，我們終將成為自己命運（Destiny）的主宰者。

examples.en: The young athlete was convinced that standing atop the podium at the Olympic Games was her ultimate destiny.
examples.zh: 這位天才型短跑少女深信不疑，在四年一度的奧運最高殿堂披金戴銀奪冠，是上天賦予她這一生最神聖的宿命與命運。

examples.en: Courageous democratic movements proved that determined citizens can reshape the collective political destiny of their nation.
examples.zh: 壯烈的民主歷史運動充分證明：只要全體國民團結一心、無畏強權，我們完全有能力親手改寫整個國家的政治集體命運。

examples.en: Becoming a multi-planetary species ensures that human consciousness and destiny endure forever among the stars.
examples.zh: 跨出地球成為跨行星文明物種，能確保人類的意識火種與共同命運在繁星浩瀚宇宙中永恆延續。

examples.en: She firmly believed that dedication and continuous hard work, not blind luck, would shape her destiny.
examples.zh: 她堅定不移地相信：唯有一步一腳印的踏實努力與恆心毅力，才能真正掌握並開創自己的命運。

examples.en: Historical decisions made by world leaders often alter the destiny of entire nations for centuries.
examples.zh: 歷史關鍵轉折點上各國領袖所做出的抉擇，往往會在長達數個世紀的時間裡徹底改寫整個國家的命運。

examples.en: Venturing outward to become a multi-planetary species is the grand evolutionary destiny of humanity.
examples.zh: 勇敢走出搖籃、成為跨越星際的多行星物種，是人類文明在宇宙演化長河中不可迴避的崇高宿命。

examples.en: Visionary thinkers argue that Earth is merely the cradle of civilization, but one cannot remain in the cradle forever.
examples.zh: 具備遠見的先驅思想家深刻指出：地球不過是孕育人類文明最初的搖籃，但人類絕不可能永遠滯留在搖籃之中。

examples.en: Building self-sustaining cities across the solar system fulfills our cosmic evolutionary destiny.
examples.zh: 在整個太陽系各大行星上建立自給自足的永續城市，正是引領我們文明邁向星際演化的崇高宇宙宿命。

examples.en: Reaching beyond low Earth orbit fulfills humanity’s timeless destiny as an interplanetary, starfaring species.
examples.zh: 突破近地軌道藩籬、航向深空，正在一步步實現人類成為「跨行星星際物種」的神聖「命運」（Destiny）。

examples.en: She believed that hard work, perseverance, and ethical choices shape a person’s future destiny far more than chance.
examples.zh: 她深信腳踏實地的辛勤耕耘、百折不撓的堅定毅力與正直清白的道德抉擇，比起虛無縹緲的機運更能主宰個人的未來命運。

examples.en: Beethoven famously described the opening four notes of his Fifth Symphony as fate knocking at the door of destiny.
examples.zh: 貝多芬曾生動形象地將其第五號交響曲開頭那四聲震撼人心的標誌性動機，形容為宿命狠狠敲響命運大門的雄渾之音。

entries.definition: 主宰自我人生命運；命運；探索星辰大海之全人類共同命運；人類走出地球搖籃成為多行星物種之歷史宿命；實現人類跨出搖籃成為跨行星物種之星際命運
explains: This is what someone believes will happen in the future, often as if it were already decided. A character may think they are meant to become a great explorer. The belief can shape the character’s plans.
A person can imagine where life may lead. Their choices and effort can shape what happens. Plans can change over time.
Stories may describe a person’s future as guided by events beyond their control. The idea can make a tale feel mysterious. People still make choices.

examples.en: The destructive fire damaged several buildings.
examples.zh: 那場破壞性的火災損壞了幾棟建築。

examples.en: A destructive storm knocked down many trees.
examples.zh: 具有破壞力的暴風雨吹倒了許多樹。

examples.en: The destructive behavior upset the whole class.
examples.zh: 破壞性的行為讓全班感到不安。

explains: This describes something that causes serious damage. A strong storm can destroy houses and trees. People may need to leave the area.
A harmful habit may damage a friendship. Honest words and kind actions can help repair trust. Change takes time.
A careless action can ruin a project or object. Planning and using tools safely can prevent harm. Asking for help is wise.

examples.en: The master carver’s lifelong devotion to temple art shines through every stroke of his chisel.
examples.zh: 木雕大師畢生對宮廟藝術的無私奉獻與虔敬熱愛，在他落下的每一刀每一鑿中閃耀發光。

examples.en: Tens of thousands of worshippers demonstrate incredible spiritual devotion during the night procession.
examples.zh: 數萬名隨香信眾在徹夜進行的神轎夜巡遶境中，展現了感人肺腑的純粹信仰虔敬。

examples.en: Decades of unheralded devotion by preservationists rescued the old city gates from demolition.
examples.zh: 數十年間文史工作者默默無聞的奔走奉獻，終於成功將歷史老城門從怪手的無情拆卸下搶救保留。

examples.en: A luthier’s lifelong devotion to acoustic perfection echoes through every chord played by concert artists.
examples.zh: 製琴師一生對極致聲學追求的「虔誠奉獻」（Devotion），在演奏家指尖流淌出的每一個和弦中永遠迴盪。

examples.en: The veteran researcher was honored for her lifelong devotion to discovering treatments for rare pediatric illnesses.
examples.zh: 這位資深醫學科學家因其一生無私奉獻於罕見兒童遺傳疾病標靶新藥的開創性研發，榮獲最高榮譽表彰。

examples.en: Monks wake before dawn to engage in sacred chanting and silent devotion within the monastery walls.
examples.zh: 寺院僧侶在拂曉天色微明之際便已起身，在靜謐莊嚴的大雄寶殿內展開虔誠的晨鐘誦經與禪修靜心。

entries.definition: 匠人一生專注一事之無私奉獻虔敬；將靈魂注入木質樂器的一生虔誠奉獻熱忱
explains: This is strong care and dedication to a person, belief, or task. A musician may practice each day because they love music. Steady effort shows dedication.
A person may serve others with great care. They can spend time helping a neighbor. Kind actions matter.
Someone may feel deep religious respect. They can pray or take part in a faith tradition. Beliefs differ among people.

examples.en: The physician diagnosed him with the common seasonal cold.
examples.zh: 醫生診斷他患了常見的季節性感冒。

examples.en: Advanced MRI scans helped doctors diagnose the tumor accurately.
examples.zh: 先進的磁振造影掃描幫助醫生精準診斷出腫瘤。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with diabetes after a routine blood test.
examples.zh: 在一次例行驗血檢查後，她被診斷出罹患了糖尿病。

examples.en: The specialist diagnosed the rare skin rash after conducting lab tests.
examples.zh: 專科醫師在完成各項實驗室檢驗後，確診了該罕見皮膚紅疹。

examples.en: Doctors diagnosed her with mild pneumonia and prescribed antibiotic treatment.
examples.zh: 醫師診斷她罹患了輕微肺炎，並立即為她開立了對症的抗生素療程。

examples.en: Automotive technicians used computer software to diagnose the vehicle engine fault.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師運用專業電腦診斷軟體，迅速查明了車輛引擎故障代碼原因。

explains: This means to identify an illness or problem by studying its signs. A health professional asks questions and may perform tests. The results help guide care.
A mechanic may find why a machine is not working. They check each part and listen for unusual sounds. Careful testing helps.
A teacher may identify why a student is having trouble with a lesson. The teacher checks the work and asks questions. Extra practice can help.

examples.en: An early medical diagnosis significantly improves patient recovery rates.
examples.zh: 及早獲得明確的醫學診斷能顯著大幅提升病患的康復痊癒率。

examples.en: The family sought a second opinion after receiving a serious cancer diagnosis.
examples.zh: 在獲知罹患重大癌症的震驚診斷後，家屬決定尋求第二位專科權威醫師的複診意見。

examples.en: The technician explained his accurate diagnosis of the broken refrigerator compressor.
examples.zh: 維修技術人員向屋主條理分明地說明了他對冰箱壓縮機損壞原因的精確診斷。

examples.en: An MRI scan confirmed the accurate diagnosis of a torn knee ligament.
examples.zh: 核磁共振造影（MRI）掃描結果精準證實了右膝前十字韌帶撕裂傷的明確臨床診斷。

examples.en: Early cancer diagnosis significantly improves the chances of successful medical treatment.
examples.zh: 早期精準的癌症確診與篩檢發現，能大幅提高後續標靶與手術治療的五年存活率。

examples.en: Seeking a second medical opinion helps patients feel confident in their doctor's diagnosis.
examples.zh: 在面臨重大疾病開刀前尋求第二醫療意見諮詢，能讓病患與家屬對原診斷更具信心與掌握。

entries.definition: 診斷；診斷結果（複數 diagnoses）；臨床診斷；診斷結果
explains: This is the name of an illness or problem identified by a health professional. The person may use signs, questions, and tests to learn what is wrong. Doctors use the results to choose helpful next steps.
A report from a clinic may record the finding. The information helps guide care. A professional explains what it means.
A machine can also have a problem identified by a repair worker. The worker checks how it behaves and finds the cause. Careful testing helps.

examples.en: The family spoke a dialect used in their mountain village.
examples.zh: 這家人說著山村使用的方言。

examples.en: She learned the local dialect from her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她向鄰居學習當地方言。

examples.en: The actor practiced a southern dialect for the role.
examples.zh: 演員為這個角色練習南方方言。

explains: This is a form of a language spoken by people in a certain place or group. Speakers may use special words or sounds. Other people can learn them.
People from different areas may speak the same language in different ways. Their speech can show where they grew up. Listening helps notice patterns.
Families may pass a local way of speaking to children. Stories and songs help keep it alive. Each way of speaking has value.

examples.en: The wheel has a diameter of twenty centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個輪子的直徑是二十公分。

examples.en: Measure the diameter of the round table.
examples.zh: 量一量圓桌的直徑。

examples.en: The diagram shows the pipe’s diameter.
examples.zh: 圖表標示了管子的直徑。

explains: This is the distance across a round shape through its center. A ruler can measure from one edge to the opposite edge. The center lies halfway along.
A circle’s width can be compared with its radius. The radius goes from the center to the edge. The full width is twice as long.
A pipe or wheel can be measured this way. The measurement helps someone choose a part that fits. Accurate numbers are useful.

examples.en: The baby’s diaper was clean and dry.
examples.zh: 寶寶的尿布乾淨又乾爽。

examples.en: She packed extra diapers in the travel bag.
examples.zh: 她在旅行袋裡多放了幾片尿布。

examples.en: Dad changed the baby’s diaper after lunch.
examples.zh: 爸爸午餐後替寶寶換了尿布。

explains: This is a soft garment worn by a baby to catch waste. It keeps clothing and bedding cleaner. Caregivers change it when needed.
A disposable kind is thrown away after use. A reusable kind can be washed. Families choose what works for them.
Parents pack extra ones when going out with a baby. A clean changing surface is helpful. Keeping supplies ready saves time.

examples.en: Good digestion helps the body use food.
examples.zh: 良好的消化有助於身體利用食物。

examples.en: The doctor explained how digestion works.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋了消化的運作方式。

examples.en: Some foods take longer for digestion than others.
examples.zh: 有些食物需要較長時間才能消化。

explains: This is the process by which the body breaks food into forms it can use. Food moves through the body after a meal. The body takes in nutrients.
Different foods may be processed at different speeds. Eating slowly can help people notice when they feel full. Water is also important.
A health professional can explain how the body uses food. People may have different needs. Balanced meals support daily activities.

examples.en: The famous runaway trolley problem presents a heart-wrenching ethical dilemma about saving lives.
examples.zh: 著名的失控電車難題呈現了一個扣人心弦的道德兩難困境（Dilemma），拷問人性在生命抉擇時的取捨。

examples.en: Rising housing prices and low starting salaries place young college graduates in a severe economic dilemma.
examples.zh: 居高不下的都會房價與初出茅廬的起薪水準，讓無數剛踏入社會的年輕大學畢業生陷入嚴峻的經濟兩難困局。

examples.en: The hospital ethics board met urgently to resolve a complex life-support treatment dilemma for the patient.
examples.zh: 醫學中心臨床倫理委員會緊急召開特別會議，就病患是否繼續維持侵入性維生設備展開審慎的兩難抉擇研商。

entries.definition: 道德兩難困境；進退維谷
explains: This is a difficult choice between two options, each with a problem. A student may have to choose between two clubs that meet at the same time. The choice can be hard to make.
A person may not know which action is best. They can list the good and bad sides of each choice. Asking for advice can help.
A story may place a character in a hard situation. The character must make a choice. The reader wonders what will happen.

examples.en: Overlaying historical street scenes adds an unforgettable dimension to walking through ancient cities.
examples.zh: 在古城散步時將百年前的歷史街景疊加在眼前，為城市漫步增添了豐富動人的「時空維度」（Dimension）。

examples.en: The architect carefully verified the exact ceiling height and room dimension before ordering furniture.
examples.zh: 建築師在訂製系統家具前，仔細核對了天花板淨高與各個房間的精準空間尺寸。

examples.en: This sociological survey adds an essential human dimension to abstract macroeconomic inflation statistics.
examples.zh: 這份社會學深度訪談調查，為冰冷抽象的總體經濟通膨數據注入了真實溫熱的人文維度。

entries.definition: 為人類日常生活增添奇妙生動之數位全新維度
explains: This is a measurement in one direction, such as length, width, or height. A box has three measurements that describe its size. A ruler can help.
The word can also mean an aspect of an idea or problem. A story may have an emotional side and a practical side. Looking at both helps.
A room can feel different when its height or width changes. Designers plan how people will use the space. Measurements guide their choices.

examples.en: The candle flame diminished as the wax ran out.
examples.zh: 蠟燭隨著蠟慢慢燃盡，火焰也變小了。

examples.en: The noise diminished when the door closed.
examples.zh: 關上門後，噪音減弱了。

examples.en: Their worry diminished after they learned the plan.
examples.zh: 知道計畫後，他們的擔憂減輕了。

explains: This means to become smaller, weaker, or less important. A loud sound may grow softer over time. Quiet surroundings help people rest.
A plant may lose color if it does not get enough water. Care can help it recover. Regular attention is useful.
A person’s interest may grow smaller if an activity is repeated too often. Trying something new can renew excitement. Variety can help.

examples.en: The diplomatic student helped the two groups reach an agreement.
examples.zh: 善於協調的學生幫助兩組人達成協議。

examples.en: She gave a diplomatic answer to the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她對這個難題給了圓融的回答。

examples.en: A diplomatic approach helped keep the meeting calm.
examples.zh: 圓融的做法讓會議保持平和。

explains: This describes someone who is skilled at dealing with people and disagreements. A leader may listen to both sides before speaking. Calm words can help.
A person may work with representatives from different places. They choose respectful words and look for shared goals. Patience matters.
An official letter may use careful, formal language. The writer avoids rude or angry phrases. Clear communication supports cooperation.

examples.en: The phone directory listed the library’s number.
examples.zh: 電話簿列出了圖書館的電話號碼。

examples.en: I searched the directory for my teacher’s email.
examples.zh: 我在名錄中搜尋老師的電子郵件。

examples.en: The website has a directory of local clubs.
examples.zh: 網站上有當地社團名錄。

explains: This is a book or list that helps people find names, places, or information. A school list may show phone numbers and room locations. Readers can look things up.
A computer folder can store a list of files. Clear names help users find what they need. Organizing items saves time.
A group may publish a list of local services. People can search by name or topic. Keeping the information current is helpful.

examples.en: The teacher disapproved of copying another student’s work.
examples.zh: 老師不贊同抄襲其他同學的作業。

examples.en: Her parents disapproved of the unsafe plan.
examples.zh: 她的父母不贊成這項不安全的計畫。

examples.en: He disapproved when the players ignored the rules.
examples.zh: 球員忽視規則時，他表示反對。

explains: This means to show that you do not approve of an action or idea. A parent may say that unsafe behavior is not okay. The child can learn why.
A person may disagree with a plan and explain their concerns. Calm words help others listen. Respect matters during disagreement.
Someone can make a face or shake their head to show disapproval. A clear explanation is often more helpful. People can ask questions.

examples.en: The report disclosed the cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 報告揭露了延誤的原因。

examples.en: She disclosed the surprise plan to her sister.
examples.zh: 她向妹妹透露了驚喜計畫。

examples.en: The company disclosed its new schedule to workers.
examples.zh: 公司向員工公開了新時間表。

explains: This means to share information that was hidden or private. A report may reveal what happened during a meeting. Readers can learn the facts.
A person may tell a trusted adult about a problem. Speaking up can help get support. The adult should listen carefully.
An organization may publish information for the public. Clear facts help people understand a decision. Privacy rules still matter.

examples.en: The video call disconnected abruptly due to poor signal.
examples.zh: 由於訊號不良，視訊通話突然中斷連線。

examples.en: Always disconnect electrical appliances before cleaning or maintenance.
examples.zh: 在清潔或維護保養前，請務必先拔除切斷家電電源。

examples.en: Taking a weekend camping trip helps you disconnect from work stress.
examples.zh: 來一趟週末露營之旅有助於讓你暫時抽離工作壓力。

explains: This means to stop a link or connection between two things. A person may unplug a lamp from the wall. The lamp turns off.
A computer user can end a connection to the internet. The device no longer sends or receives data. This may protect privacy.
Friends may feel distant after an argument. Talking kindly can help them reconnect. A sincere apology can help.

examples.en: Civil public discourse thrives when opposing sides listen respectfully without personal hostility.
examples.zh: 唯有當不同立場的公民皆能摒棄敵意、互相傾聽與講理時，成熟健康的「公民公共論辯」（Discourse）方能開花結果。

examples.en: University campuses should be safe havens for open intellectual discourse, intellectual debate, and free inquiry.
examples.zh: 大學校園理應成為包容多元思想、鼓勵自由探索、以及展開健康學術公共論述的崇高精神避風港。

examples.en: Online social networks have regrettably coarsened political discourse, turning nuanced issues into crude slogans.
examples.zh: 令人遺憾的是，現代社群平台演算法大幅粗鄙化了嚴肅的公共論述，將原本需要細膩探討的公共議題簡化為粗暴口號。

entries.definition: 公民理性公共論辯；論述
explains: This is a spoken or written discussion of ideas. A class may talk about a story and share opinions. Students listen to one another.
A long piece of writing may examine a subject in detail. It can include reasons and examples. Clear structure helps readers.
People may discuss a public question in a meeting. They share facts and viewpoints. Respectful speech helps everyone take part.

examples.en: It is wrong to discriminate against someone because of their name.
examples.zh: 因為別人的名字而歧視對方是不對的。

examples.en: The rules forbid shops from discriminating against customers.
examples.zh: 規定禁止商店歧視顧客。

examples.en: A fair judge does not discriminate between teams.
examples.zh: 公正的裁判不會偏袒任何一隊。

explains: This means to treat someone unfairly because of a group they belong to. A person may be denied a chance for an unfair reason. Fair rules protect people.
A person can notice differences without treating people badly. Everyone should receive respect and a fair opportunity. Kind actions matter.
Some tests may give unfair results if they favor one group. Researchers check questions carefully. Fair design makes results more useful.

examples.en: The school has rules against discrimination.
examples.zh: 學校訂有禁止歧視的規定。

examples.en: She spoke out against discrimination in the workplace.
examples.zh: 她公開反對職場歧視。

examples.en: The report described discrimination in housing.
examples.zh: 報告描述了住房方面的歧視。

explains: This is unfair treatment of people because of their group or identity. A student may be left out for an unfair reason. Such behavior can cause harm.
Rules can protect people from unfair treatment at school or work. Adults should respond when someone is treated badly. Everyone deserves respect.
People can learn about unfair patterns and work to change them. Listening to those affected is important. Fair opportunities help communities.

examples.en: The construction work disrupted traffic downtown.
examples.zh: 施工影響了市中心的交通。

examples.en: A power cut disrupted the school day.
examples.zh: 停電打亂了學校的一天。

examples.en: The loud alarm disrupted our meeting.
examples.zh: 刺耳的警報聲打斷了我們的會議。

explains: This means to interrupt something or stop it from working normally. A loud noise may interrupt a lesson. The class can return to work afterward.
A storm may damage roads and interrupt travel. Workers repair the damage. People can choose a safe route.
A person can interrupt a plan by causing confusion. Clear communication helps everyone know what to do. Planning for changes is useful.

examples.en: The ice dissolved in the warm drink.
examples.zh: 冰溶化在溫熱的飲料裡。

examples.en: The committee dissolved after finishing its task.
examples.zh: 委員會完成任務後解散了。

examples.en: She dissolved the sugar in a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 她把糖溶在一杯茶中。

explains: This means to change a solid into liquid or make a group end. Ice changes into water when it warms. The water can flow.
A group may officially stop meeting. Members finish their work and go their separate ways. They may meet again later.
A substance can mix into liquid so it is no longer seen. Stirring sugar into tea helps it spread. Warm liquid can make the change faster.

examples.en: There is a distinction between a fact and an opinion.
examples.zh: 事實和意見之間有所區別。

examples.en: The award marked a special distinction for the young artist.
examples.zh: 這個獎項肯定了年輕藝術家的傑出成就。

examples.en: She explained the distinction between the two rules.
examples.zh: 她解釋了兩條規則之間的差異。

explains: This is a clear difference between two things or ideas. One color may look brighter than another. Comparing them helps people notice.
A special honor may recognize a person’s achievement. The award shows that the work stood out. Others may celebrate it.
People may have a disagreement about which choice is better. They can explain their reasons. Listening can reveal important differences.

examples.en: The bird has a distinctive yellow beak.
examples.zh: 這隻鳥有一個獨特的黃色鳥喙。

examples.en: Her distinctive voice was easy to recognize.
examples.zh: 她獨特的聲音很容易辨認。

examples.en: The building has a distinctive curved roof.
examples.zh: 這棟建築有一個獨特的弧形屋頂。

explains: This describes something that is easy to recognize because it has a special quality. A bird may have a bright red mark on its wing. That feature makes it stand out.
A person may have a clear style of drawing. Friends can recognize the pictures without seeing the name. Practice helps develop a style.
A sound can be different from all the others in a song. Listeners notice it quickly. Unique details make music interesting.

examples.en: Constant smartphone notifications distract students from studying.
examples.zh: 頻繁的手機推播通知會分散學生的讀書注意力。

examples.en: Loud construction drilling next door distracted everyone in the office meeting.
examples.zh: 隔壁工區傳來的巨大鑽牆施工噪音，讓會議室內開會的每位同仁頻頻分心。

examples.en: The magician waved a colorful silk scarf to distract the audience during the trick.
examples.zh: 魔術師在表演關鍵手法時，刻意揮舞五彩絲巾藉以巧妙轉移觀眾的視線注意力。

explains: This means to take someone’s attention away from what they are doing. A loud sound may make a reader look up from a book. Quiet can help.
A bright toy can make a child stop listening to instructions. Putting it away may help the child focus. Clear steps also help.
A person may lose focus when many things happen at once. Taking a short break can make it easier to return to the task. The teacher may pause to check that students are following.

examples.en: The class studied a doctrine from ancient history.
examples.zh: 全班在歷史課研讀一項古代教義。

examples.en: The leader explained the group’s doctrine to new members.
examples.zh: 領導者向新成員解釋團體的信條。

examples.en: The book described a doctrine about how the world began.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了一種世界起源的教義。

explains: This is a set of beliefs or rules taught by a group. A school club may agree on ways to work together. Members learn the shared ideas.
A religion or political group may teach ideas about how people should live. People can study those beliefs. Respectful discussion is useful.
A written guide may explain the main rules of an organization. New members can read it to understand expectations. Questions can clarify meaning.

examples.en: Always save your document frequently to avoid data loss.
examples.zh: 經常儲存你的文件以防資料遺失。

examples.en: You must bring valid identification documents to the bank.
examples.zh: 你必須攜帶有效的身分證明文件前往銀行。

examples.en: The journalist documented the daily life of Arctic wildlife.
examples.zh: 這位記者記錄了北極野生動物的日常生活。

explains: This can be a paper or digital file with information. A student may save a report on a computer. Clear labels help find it later.
The verb means to write down or record what happened. A teacher may note a science experiment’s steps. Details help others understand.
An official form may show a person’s name and address. People fill it out carefully. The information should be correct.

examples.en: 'Beyond Beauty: Taiwan from Above' is an inspiring nature documentary.
examples.zh: 《看見台灣》是一部發人深省的自然生態紀錄片。

examples.en: The television crew spent five years filming an investigative documentary on climate change.
examples.zh: 電視攝製團隊花了五年時間拍攝了一部關於氣候變遷的調查紀錄片。

examples.en: Watching historical documentaries provides a rich perspective on modern global affairs.
examples.zh: 收看歷史紀錄片能為理解當代國際事務提供深刻豐厚的視角。

examples.en: 'Beyond Beauty: Taiwan from Above' is an iconic environmental documentary.
examples.zh: 《看見台灣》是一部震撼人心、喚醒全民環保意識的標竿性空拍紀錄片。

examples.en: The investigative documentary exposed systemic regulatory negligence leading to the tragic train derailment.
examples.zh: 這部兼具深度調查與良知的深度專題紀錄片，徹底揭露了釀成那起慘烈列車出軌意外背後長期沉痾的制度性監管疏失。

examples.en: A gripping historical documentary uses restored archival footage and interviews to bring the past alive.
examples.zh: 一部扣人心弦的歷史文獻紀錄片，善用經現代數位修復的高畫質珍貴歷史影像與當事人訪談，讓塵封的歲月再度躍然眼前。

examples.en: The award-winning environmental documentary exposed illegal industrial ocean dumping.
examples.zh: 這部榮獲多座國際環保大獎的深度調查紀實紀錄片，勇敢揭露了不肖工廠偷排有毒廢水的真相。

examples.en: Watching a powerful investigative documentary altered her consumer choices regarding plastic packaging.
examples.zh: 觀看了一部震撼人心的深度調查紀錄片之後，徹底翻轉改變了她在日常生活中對塑膠包裝的消費選擇。

examples.en: The filmmaker spent seven years shooting documentary footage of migrating birds along the coast.
examples.zh: 這位紀錄片導演耗費了整整七年漫長歲月，沿著西海岸濕地實地蹲點跟拍珍稀候鳥遷徙的珍貴生態鏡頭。

entries.definition: 紀錄片；紀實的；文件的；紀實紀錄片
explains: This describes a film or program that presents real people, places, or events. It may include interviews and photographs. Viewers can learn from it.
A written report can also give facts about a real subject. The writer checks sources before sharing details. Reliable information matters.
A factual style may avoid made-up events. The audience can hear from people involved. Careful editing helps explain the topic.

examples.en: The butterfly is outside my domain of knowledge.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶不屬於我的知識範圍。

examples.en: The website uses a short domain name.
examples.zh: 這個網站使用簡短的網域名稱。

examples.en: This garden is the domain of the school’s science club.
examples.zh: 這座花園是學校科學社團的活動範圍。

explains: This is an area of knowledge, activity, or control. Science is a wide area with many subjects. Students may explore one part at a time.
On the internet, a group of pages may share one address. Visitors can search that address to find information. Clear names help.
A person may have a skill in one special area. They can learn more by reading and practicing. Experts share what they know.

examples.en: The museum has a glass dome over its central hall.
examples.zh: 博物館中央大廳上方有一座玻璃圓頂。

examples.en: We saw stars through the observatory dome.
examples.zh: 我們透過天文台圓頂觀賞星星。

examples.en: A golden dome shone above the old building.
examples.zh: 古老建築上方的金色圓頂閃閃發亮。

explains: This is a rounded roof or ceiling shaped like half a ball. It may cover a large room. The curved shape can make the space feel grand.
A building may have a rounded top above a hall. Builders use strong materials to support it. Light may enter through windows.
An observatory often has a curved cover that can open. A telescope inside can point toward the sky. The roof protects the equipment.

examples.en: High-tech executives donate laptops and tablets to rural learning centers.
examples.zh: 竹科科技高階主管大方捐贈全新筆記型電腦與平板給偏鄉數位學習中心。

examples.en: Many compassionate citizens choose to donate blood every three months.
examples.zh: 許多富有愛心的熱血民眾選擇每三個月定期挽袖捐血一次。

examples.en: You can donate gently used books and toys to the community library.
examples.zh: 你可以把保存良好的二手書本與玩具捐贈給社區圖書館。

explains: This means to give money or useful items to help others. A family may share warm coats with people who need them. Kindness can make a difference.
A person can give books or toys to a community center. The items may help children learn or play. Good condition matters.
People may give blood through a health service. Trained staff collect it safely. It can help patients who need care.

examples.en: All monetary donations receive official tax-deductible electronic receipts.
examples.zh: 每筆愛心捐款皆會即刻開立具備合法抵稅效力的正式電子捐款收據。

examples.en: The museum was built largely through generous private donations from alumni.
examples.zh: 這座博物館主要依靠歷屆校友慷慨解囊的民間善款捐贈興建而成。

examples.en: Even a small recurring donation of ten dollars a month helps save lives.
examples.zh: 即便是每個月十美元的小額定期定額捐款，也能發揮拯救生命的龐大力量。

explains: This is money, goods, or help given to support a person or cause. A school may receive money for new books. The gift helps students.
A person may give clothes or food to a local group. The group shares them with families. Generosity can support a community.
A gift can be made in memory of someone. The giver chooses a cause that mattered to them. The support may help many people.

examples.en: The donor gave books to the village school.
examples.zh: 捐贈者把書送給村裡的學校。

examples.en: A generous donor supported the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 一位慷慨的捐贈者支持了動物收容所。

examples.en: The blood donor thanked the nurses after the visit.
examples.zh: 捐血者離開前向護理師道謝。

explains: This is a person who gives money, time, or something useful to help others. A person may give books to a school library. The gift supports learning.
A health service may receive blood from someone who freely offers it. Trained workers collect it safely. The person helps patients.
A giver can choose a group or cause they care about. Even a small gift may help. Sharing can strengthen a community.

examples.en: She stood in the doorway and waved.
examples.zh: 她站在門口揮手。

examples.en: The doorway was too narrow for the large box.
examples.zh: 門口太窄，大箱子過不去。

examples.en: A welcome mat lay beside the doorway.
examples.zh: 歡迎地墊放在門口旁。

explains: This is the opening that leads through a door. People walk through it to enter or leave a room. A frame surrounds the opening.
A house may have several openings between rooms. A curtain can cover one for privacy. The space lets people move around.
A person standing there can greet someone who arrives. Keeping the area clear helps others pass. A light can make it safer at night.

examples.en: Gently perform stretch-and-folds every thirty minutes to strengthen wet dough.
examples.zh: 每隔半小時以雙手溫柔進行一次拉伸摺疊（Stretch and Fold），能持續強化濕黏麵團結構。

examples.en: Allow the pizza dough to rest at room temperature until it becomes supple and stretchy.
examples.zh: 將發酵好的披薩麵團置於室溫下充分鬆弛靜置，直到質地變得柔軟順滑且極易延展拉伸。

examples.en: He worked extra weekend shifts to earn some extra dough for his upcoming vacation.
examples.zh: 他在週末主動申請加班輪班，希望能為即將到來的海外度假多賺一點額外零用錢。

explains: This is a soft mixture of flour and liquid before it is baked. A baker kneads it on a clean table. It can become bread or noodles.
The mixture may be shaped into rounds or long pieces. Yeast can make it rise. Warmth helps it grow.
A cook may stir flour and water together to make a thick mixture. Different recipes use different ingredients. Clean hands are important.

examples.en: The dreadful storm kept us indoors all day.
examples.zh: 可怕的暴風雨讓我們整天待在室內。

examples.en: It was dreadful to lose the family photograph.
examples.zh: 弄丟家人的照片真令人難過。

examples.en: The movie had a dreadful ending that made us sad.
examples.zh: 電影有個糟糕的結局，讓我們很傷心。

explains: This describes something very bad or unpleasant. A stormy day can spoil an outdoor picnic. Friends may choose an indoor activity instead.
A frightening event can make someone feel afraid. A trusted person can offer comfort. People can talk about what happened.
A person may have a very poor experience with a service or product. They can explain the problem politely. Clear feedback may help.

examples.en: Dad parked the car in the driveway.
examples.zh: 爸爸把車停在車道上。

examples.en: The children drew chalk pictures on the driveway.
examples.zh: 孩子們在車道上用粉筆畫畫。

examples.en: A tree shades the long driveway to our house.
examples.zh: 一棵樹為通往我們家的長車道遮蔭。

explains: This is a path between a house and the street. Cars can use it to reach a garage. The surface may be concrete or gravel.
A family may ride bikes on the flat area near their home. Keeping it free of toys helps cars pass. Children should watch for vehicles.
The path can lead from the road to a parking space. It may be cleared in winter so people can walk safely. Regular care helps.

examples.en: Reservoir water levels dropped critically during the prolonged spring drought.
examples.zh: 在歷經長達數月的春季乾旱期間，各大水庫蓄水水位急遽下降。

examples.en: Farmers were forced to fallow their rice fields due to agricultural water rationing during the historic drought.
examples.zh: 在這場百年罕見的大旱期間，廣大農民因不得不配合政府農業分區輪灌限水措施而忍痛讓稻田休耕。

examples.en: Planting drought-tolerant indigenous crops helps rural communities adapt to changing climate patterns.
examples.zh: 積極選育並擴大推廣種植具備高度耐旱特性的本土原生作物，有助於偏鄉農村從容適應極端氣候模式。

explains: This is a long time with very little or no rain. Crops may dry out when the soil has no water. Farmers need careful plans.
A dry season can make rivers and ponds shrink. Animals may have trouble finding water. Communities can save what they have.
