A crowded bus may crush a paper cup in someone’s bag. Players also hit a small ball against a wall in a court. Context tells which meaning applies.

examples.en: Proper squats strengthen thigh muscles and glute strength.
examples.zh: 正確的深蹲能強化大腿肌力與臀部力量。

examples.en: The catcher stayed in a low squat position behind home plate.
examples.zh: 捕手在本壘板後方始終保持低姿勢蹲捕狀態。

examples.en: Squatting with heavy barbells requires flawless posture to prevent knee strain.
examples.zh: 扛著沉重槓鈴深蹲需要無可挑剔的標準姿勢以防膝蓋受傷。

examples.en: Barbell squats target quadriceps, hamstrings, and gluteal muscles effectively.
examples.zh: 槓鈴深蹲能強效針對大腿股四頭肌、後腿肌腱與臀大肌進行全面刺激。

examples.en: Keep your chest up and push through your heels when coming up from a deep squat.
examples.zh: 從底部深蹲動作發力起身時，請務必保持挺胸收腹，並將重心穩固落在腳跟處向上蹬地發力。

examples.en: The catcher in the baseball game had to squat behind home plate for nine full innings.
examples.zh: 棒球比賽中的捕手必須在整個九局正規賽程中，全程長時間維持深蹲半蹲姿勢蹲在本壘板後方。

examples.en: Barbell back squats strengthen quadriceps, glutes, and lower body stability.
examples.zh: 槓鈴後深蹲動作能強效鍛鍊股四頭肌、臀大肌並大幅提升下半身核心穩定度。

examples.en: Make sure to keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes when you squat.
examples.zh: 在進行深蹲動作時，請務必保持胸膛挺拔直立，並讓膝蓋行進方向與腳尖自然平行對齊。

examples.en: He set a new gym record by performing a 180-kilogram barbell back squat.
examples.zh: 他以標準姿勢成功完成了 180 公斤的槓鈴後深蹲，刷新了該健身房的個人紀錄。

examples.en: The barbell back squat is widely regarded as the king of lower-body exercises.
examples.zh: 槓鈴後背深蹲被全球健身界公認為鍛鍊大腿、臀部與下半身爆發力的動作之王。

examples.en: Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the depth of the squat.
examples.zh: 進行深蹲下沉時，務必確保雙膝行進方向始終與腳尖朝向保持一致。

examples.en: He decided to squat below parallel to fully activate his quadriceps and glutes.
examples.zh: 他決定深蹲至髖關節低於膝蓋平行線，以充分動員並刺激股四頭肌與臀大肌。

entries.definition: 深蹲；蹲下；深蹲動作；霸占；槓鈴深蹲
explains: This verb means to bend the knees and lower the body close to the ground. It can also describe a short, broad shape. As a noun, it names an exercise using this movement.
A child lowers down to look beneath a table. The knees bend while the feet remain on the floor. The verb describes this low position.
A person may do repeated leg exercises by lowering and rising. The movement strengthens the legs. In informal use, the word can also mean to occupy a place without permission.

examples.en: The table’s stability improved after we tightened the legs.
examples.zh: 我們鎖緊桌腳後，桌子變得更穩固。

examples.en: The bridge was tested for stability.
examples.zh: 這座橋接受了穩定性測試。

examples.en: A regular routine gave the child a sense of stability.
examples.zh: 固定的日常作息讓孩子感到生活安定。

explains: This noun means the condition of being steady and unlikely to change, fall, or fail. It can describe a structure, situation, or person’s emotions. The details depend on the subject.
A chair has four strong legs and does not wobble on a flat floor. It remains steady when someone sits down. This quality keeps it from tipping.
A family may feel secure when income and housing are dependable. A country can also have a steady government. The noun describes steadiness over time.

examples.en: The automated factory manufactures pressurized electrolyzer stacks capable of generating five tons of gas daily.
examples.zh: 自動化產線組裝的高壓「電解反應電堆」（Electrolyzer Stack），每日可穩定產出五公噸的高純度氫氣。

examples.en: The student placed a neat stack of library books on the wooden desk before beginning her essay.
examples.zh: 這位勤奮的學生在開始動筆撰寫學期報告前，將借來的一疊圖書整整齊齊碼在實木書桌角。

examples.en: Full-stack software developers understand both front-end user interfaces and back-end database servers.
examples.zh: 全端軟體工程師兼具精通前端網頁使用者互動介面與後端伺服器資料庫邏輯的全方位開發能力。

entries.definition: 由數百片鈦合金雙極板串聯緊固之高壓電解堆疊槽；堆疊
explains: This noun means a neat pile of things placed one on top of another. As a verb, it means to arrange things in this way. The items may be books, boxes, or dishes.
A librarian places books on a table in a tall pile. Each book rests on the one below it. The noun describes the pile.
A worker arranges boxes so they fit into a truck. The verb describes placing them carefully in layers. A tall pile may fall if it is not balanced.

examples.en: The coffee stain would not come out of the shirt.
examples.zh: 咖啡漬怎麼洗都洗不掉。

examples.en: Blue ink stained the edge of the paper.
examples.zh: 藍色墨水弄髒了紙張邊緣。

examples.en: They used a dark stain on the wooden shelf.
examples.zh: 他們在木架上塗了深色木材染劑。

explains: This noun means a mark that is difficult to remove from a surface or fabric. As a verb, it means to make such a mark or color something. Spilled food, ink, and paint can leave marks.
A drop of juice lands on a white shirt and leaves a colored spot. Washing may be needed to remove it. The mark may be hard to clean.
Woodworkers may add color to a wooden table to change its appearance. The verb describes applying that color. The noun can also mean a lasting mark on a reputation.

examples.en: They tied the young tree to a wooden stake.
examples.zh: 他們把小樹綁在木樁上。

examples.en: The hikers placed a stake to mark the trail.
examples.zh: 登山客立了一根木樁標示步道。

examples.en: She has a personal stake in the project.
examples.zh: 她對這項計畫有切身利害關係。

explains: This noun can mean a pointed post driven into the ground. It can also mean money or interest placed at risk in a bet or decision. As a verb, it may mean to mark or support a claim.
A gardener pushes a wooden post into the soil beside a young tree. A rope ties the trunk to the post so it stays upright. The object supports the plant.
In a contest, people may risk money on who will win. A person can also have an important interest in a project’s success. The word describes what may be gained or lost.

examples.en: The night market stall sells crispy scallion pancakes.
examples.zh: 那個夜市小吃攤販售香脆的蔥抓餅。

examples.en: She rented a market stall to sell handcrafted leather accessories.
examples.zh: 她租了一個市集攤位販售手工皮革配件飾品。

examples.en: Engine trouble caused the small passenger aircraft to stall briefly.
examples.zh: 引擎故障導致這架小型客機短暫失去動力失速。

examples.en: We stopped by a bustling night market stall selling crispy oyster cakes.
examples.zh: 我們停下腳步在人聲鼎沸、香氣撲鼻的夜市小吃攤前品嚐剛起鍋的香脆蚵嗲。

examples.en: Her grandfather has run a traditional noodle stall near the temple for over forty years.
examples.zh: 她的祖父在老廟口旁經營傳統麵攤已經超過四十餘年。

examples.en: The farmers market has dozens of stalls offering fresh organic seasonal produce.
examples.zh: 農夫市集裡有數十個攤位販售當天清晨新鮮採摘的有機時令蔬果。

entries.definition: 攤位；小攤子；拖延；攤子；貨攤
explains: This noun can mean a small booth where goods are sold or an enclosed space for an animal. As a verb, it means to delay or stop moving. The context determines the sense.
A farmer sells apples from a small table at a market. The booth has a sign and baskets of fruit. The noun can name this selling place.
A car engine may stop working, or a person may delay answering a question. The verb describes either stopping or putting off action. A horse has a small enclosed space in a stable.

examples.en: The boxer widened his stance before the match.
examples.zh: 拳擊手在比賽前站穩腳步。

examples.en: Her stance on recycling is clear.
examples.zh: 她對回收的立場很明確。

examples.en: The coach corrected my stance during practice.
examples.zh: 教練在練習時糾正了我的站姿。

explains: This noun means the way someone stands or positions their body. It can also mean a person’s opinion or attitude about an issue. The context shows whether it is physical or figurative.
A tennis player places both feet apart and bends the knees before serving. This body position helps with balance. The noun describes the pose.
A mayor may support building a new bridge and explain why. That stated view shows the mayor’s opinion. People can take different positions on the same question.

examples.en: The sudden clap startled the sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 突然的拍手聲嚇到了熟睡的貓。

examples.en: Please do not startle the horse from behind.
examples.zh: 請不要從後方驚嚇那匹馬。

examples.en: The loud bell startled everyone in the hall.
examples.zh: 響亮的鈴聲嚇了大廳裡的每個人一跳。

explains: This verb means to surprise someone suddenly and make them react. A loud noise or unexpected movement can cause this response. The feeling usually lasts only a short time.
A balloon pops behind a person who is reading. The sudden sound makes the person jump. The verb describes that brief surprise.
A bird may fly away when someone opens a door quietly but unexpectedly. The surprise interrupts what was happening. The verb can describe people or animals.

examples.en: The survival difference between groups reached statistical significance with a p-value below 0.001.
examples.zh: 兩組病患的存活率差異達到了極高的「統計學顯著性」（Statistical Significance），證實療效絕非偶然。

examples.en: Market researchers utilized sophisticated statistical models to forecast next quarter’s consumer spending.
examples.zh: 市場研究專家運用先進的統計計量模型，精準預測下一季度零售消費市場的整體支出動向。

examples.en: Without rigorous statistical controls, experimental correlations can easily lead researchers to false conclusions.
examples.zh: 若缺乏嚴謹的統計學控制變數與檢定，實驗中所呈現的表面關聯性極易引導研究員導出錯誤結論。

entries.definition: 具備高度統計學顯著差異 (p < 0.001) 的
explains: This adjective relates to collecting, organizing, or interpreting numerical information. It can describe methods, results, or reports based on data. The word is common in research and mathematics.
A school counts how many students ride the bus each day and makes a chart. The numbers help staff understand travel patterns. The adjective describes this data-based work.
A researcher compares results from two groups using mathematical methods. The report explains what the numbers show. This adjective relates to that kind of analysis.

examples.en: She steered the boat away from the rocks.
examples.zh: 她把船駛離岩石。

examples.en: The guide steered us toward the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 導覽員引導我們走向博物館入口。

examples.en: He steered the conversation back to the main question.
examples.zh: 他把談話帶回主要問題。

explains: This verb means to guide the direction of a vehicle or moving object. It can also mean to guide a conversation or person toward a choice. As a noun, it can refer to a young male ox.
A driver turns a wheel to guide a car around a bend. The movement changes the car’s direction. The verb describes controlling its path.
A teacher gently guides a discussion back to the lesson topic. In farming, the same word names a young castrated male bovine raised for beef. Context separates these meanings.

examples.en: Avoid cultural stereotypes and treat every individual with fresh respect.
examples.zh: 拋開對特定文化的刻板印象與成見，以真誠開放的態度尊重每一位個體。

examples.en: Media portrayals often reinforce gender stereotypes instead of challenging them.
examples.zh: 媒體描繪往往會強化性別刻板印象，而非挑戰這些既定觀念。

examples.en: She proved that hard work can break stereotypes about women in heavy engineering.
examples.zh: 她證明了努力不懈能打破女性在重工業工程領域的傳統刻板印象。

explains: This noun means a fixed and oversimplified belief about a group of people or things. It ignores differences among individuals. As a verb, it means to judge people by such a belief.
A person assumes every child from one town likes the same sport. The belief does not consider each child’s preferences. It is an unfair general idea about a group.
A film may repeat an unfair image of a group. Viewers should remember that individuals vary. The verb can describe judging people by a fixed belief.

examples.en: The beef stew simmered all afternoon.
examples.zh: 燉牛肉整個下午都在慢慢燉煮。

examples.en: She stewed the beans with tomatoes.
examples.zh: 她把豆子和番茄一起燉煮。

examples.en: He stewed over the missed opportunity.
examples.zh: 他一直為錯失的機會煩惱。

explains: This noun means a dish made by cooking meat or vegetables slowly in liquid. As a verb, it means to cook food this way or to worry about something for a long time. The context clarifies the use.
A cook simmers carrots, potatoes, and meat in a covered pot until tender. The broth becomes rich with flavor. The dish is a slow-cooked meal.
A person may worry about a mistake instead of moving on. In that use, the verb means to keep thinking anxiously. Slow cooking and lingering worry are separate senses.

examples.en: The puzzle stimulated the children’s curiosity.
examples.zh: 這個謎題激發了孩子們的好奇心。

examples.en: Bright colors can stimulate a baby’s attention.
examples.zh: 鮮豔的顏色能引起嬰兒的注意。

examples.en: The teacher used questions to stimulate discussion.
examples.zh: 老師用提問來帶動討論。

explains: This verb means to encourage activity, interest, or growth. A question can make people think, and exercise can make the body more active. The effect depends on what is being encouraged.
A teacher asks students to compare two possible endings for a story. The question encourages them to think and share ideas. The verb describes prompting mental activity.
Sunlight and water help a seed begin growing. In medicine or biology, a substance may also cause activity in a body part. The word has both everyday and technical uses.

examples.en: The bell was a stimulus for the dogs to run to the door.
examples.zh: 鈴聲讓狗跑向門口。

examples.en: The new toy provided a stimulus for creative play.
examples.zh: 新玩具激發了創意遊戲。

examples.en: Light is an important stimulus for plant growth.
examples.zh: 光是植物生長的重要刺激因素。

explains: This noun means something that causes a response or encourages activity. Light, sound, or an idea can act as a trigger. The plural form is stimuli.
A bright flash makes a person blink. The flash causes the body to respond. It is a trigger.
A teacher offers a question to encourage students to think. The question gives them a reason to participate. The noun can refer to any trigger that produces a response.

examples.en: The garbage began to stink in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 垃圾在夏日高溫中開始發臭。

examples.en: Those wet shoes stink after the game.
examples.zh: 那些濕鞋在比賽後臭得很。

examples.en: The unfair rule made parents raise a stink.
examples.zh: 這項不公平的規定讓家長們大聲抗議。

explains: This verb means to have a very unpleasant smell. It can also mean to be very bad at something in informal speech. As a noun, it can refer to a strong bad smell or a noisy complaint.
Food left in a warm container for days develops a foul odor. People notice it as soon as they open the lid. The verb describes that smell.
A person may say a broken toy is terrible to mean it is very disappointing. Someone may also make a loud public complaint. These informal uses are stronger in tone.

examples.en: The convenience store clerk checked the beverage stock in the back room.
examples.zh: 超商店員到後方庫房檢查飲品庫存。

examples.en: She owns several shares of dividend-paying tech stock in her portfolio.
examples.zh: 她的長期投資組合中持有數檔穩定配發豐厚現金股利的高科技績優股。

examples.en: Popular graphic novels are currently out of stock and will be reprinted soon.
examples.zh: 這部超人氣長篇圖文書目前全數缺貨中，出版商已緊急安排再版加印。

explains: This noun can mean the supply of goods a shop has available. It can also mean a share of ownership in a company or a liquid used in cooking. As a verb, it means to keep supplies available.
A store checks how many notebooks remain on its shelves. Staff order more when the supply gets low. The noun describes the goods available for sale.
An investor may own a share in a business. A cook may prepare a flavorful liquid from bones and vegetables. The same word has these distinct meanings.

examples.en: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) smooth out fluctuations in intermittent solar and wind generation.
examples.zh: 建置電網級大型電池儲能系統（BESS），能完美平滑並穩定太陽能與離岸風電間歇性發電所產生的波動。

examples.en: Moving seasonal winter jackets and bulky camping gear into rented climate-controlled storage freed up home space.
examples.zh: 將換季羽絨大衣與露營帳篷整齊收納移至具有恆溫恆濕空調的個人迷你倉儲中，瞬間釋放家中起居空間。

examples.en: Smartphone users often upgrade their cloud storage subscriptions to backup tens of thousands of family photos.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機重度用戶紛紛擴購更大容量的雲端備份儲存空間，以隨時自動同步數萬張珍貴高畫質相片。

examples.en: Grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) respond in milliseconds to absorb excess generation peaks.
examples.zh: 電網級電池儲能系統，能在毫秒之內迅速響應充電，將日間多餘的太陽光電完整存儲。

examples.en: Constructing high-capacity pumped storage hydro stations creates massive energy reservoirs in mountain valleys.
examples.zh: 擴建高落差抽蓄水力儲能電廠，在崇山峻嶺峽谷間打造出容量龐大的純天然綠色儲能大水庫。

examples.en: Energy storage facilities release electricity back to the grid during hot summer afternoons when air conditioners peak.
examples.zh: 大型電池儲能電站在炎夏午後全台冷氣用電飆升的極限時刻放電援馳，力保全國供電無虞。

entries.definition: 電網級儲能系統 (ESS)；儲存；電網級磷酸鋰鐵電池大型儲能系統 (BESS)
explains: This noun means keeping something in a place until it is needed. It can also name the space or equipment used for keeping items. In computers, it refers to saving information for later use.
A family puts winter coats in boxes during the summer. The boxes stay in a closet until cold weather returns. This keeps them safe until needed.
A phone keeps photos and music in its memory. A warehouse holds goods before stores receive them. The noun can describe saving data or keeping physical items.

examples.en: Please straighten the picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 請把牆上的畫掛正。

examples.en: She straightened the papers on her desk.
examples.zh: 她把桌上的文件整理整齊。

examples.en: They met to straighten out the mix-up.
examples.zh: 他們見面把這場誤會釐清。

explains: This verb means to make something straight or neat. It can also mean to correct a problem or put facts in order. The word describes making a change from a bent or messy state.
A child smooths a wrinkled poster against a wall. The paper becomes flat and even. The verb describes making it straight.
A teacher helps clear up a misunderstanding between two friends. They explain what happened and correct the confusion. The verb can describe fixing an untidy situation.

examples.en: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 說明簡單明瞭，很容易照著做。

examples.en: She gave me a straightforward answer.
examples.zh: 她直接給了我答案。

examples.en: This is a straightforward way to sort the cards.
examples.zh: 這是整理卡片的一個簡單方法。

explains: This adjective describes something easy to understand or do. It can also describe a person who speaks honestly and directly. The word suggests few hidden problems or surprises.
A recipe lists simple steps in the order they should be done. A new cook can follow it without confusion. The directions are easy to understand.
A friend tells the truth kindly instead of hinting around the subject. Others know what the friend means. The adjective describes a direct manner.

examples.en: The long hike put a strain on my knees.
examples.zh: 長途健行讓我的膝蓋承受很大負擔。

examples.en: She strained the tea to remove the leaves.
examples.zh: 她把茶過濾掉茶葉。

examples.en: He strained a muscle while moving the sofa.
examples.zh: 他搬沙發時拉傷了肌肉。

explains: This word can mean pressure or effort that makes something difficult. It can also mean to pull a muscle or filter a liquid. The sentence shows whether the meaning is physical or general.
A heavy bag makes a person’s back feel sore after carrying it. The effort puts pressure on the body. The noun describes that stress.
A cook pours soup through a mesh to remove small pieces. This action filters the liquid. Someone can also pull a muscle by stretching or lifting too hard.

examples.en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
examples.zh: 一縷頭髮垂到她臉上。

examples.en: The storm stranded several hikers overnight.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓幾位登山客受困一夜。

examples.en: One strand of the story follows the young artist.
examples.zh: 故事的其中一條線索跟著那位年輕藝術家。

explains: This noun can mean a single thin piece of hair, thread, or wire. It can also mean one part of a larger idea or story. As a verb, it means to leave someone unable to continue a journey.
A single hair falls across a person’s sleeve. It is one thin piece among many. The noun can name that small length.
A storm stops a ferry, leaving travelers unable to get home. The verb describes being left in that situation. The noun may also describe one line of a larger plan.

examples.en: The camera strap rested on her shoulder.
examples.zh: 相機背帶搭在她肩上。

examples.en: Please strap the box to the cart.
examples.zh: 請把箱子綁在推車上。

examples.en: A loose strap came off the backpack.
examples.zh: 背包的一條帶子鬆脫了。

explains: This noun means a narrow strip of material used to hold or carry something. It can be made of leather, cloth, or plastic. As a verb, it means to fasten something with such a strip.
A backpack has two narrow bands that go over the shoulders. They help hold it on the wearer’s back. These pieces keep the bag in place.
A worker ties a box to a cart so it will not fall. The verb describes fastening it securely. The noun also appears on sandals, watches, and bags.

examples.en: Forming a strategic alliance helped both tech firms enter European markets.
examples.zh: 組成緊密的策略性夥伴同盟幫助兩家科技品牌順利打入競爭激烈的歐洲市場。

examples.en: The board met to define long-term strategic objectives for the next five years.
examples.zh: 董事會齊聚一堂以制定未來五年的長期策略目標。

examples.en: Locating the distribution center near the international airport was a strategic move.
examples.zh: 將物流配送中心設在國際機場附近是一項極具戰略眼光的佈局舉措。

entries.definition: 策略性的；具戰略意義的
explains: This adjective describes actions planned to reach an important long-term goal. It can relate to business, games, or military decisions. The choices consider what may happen later.
A chess player moves a piece to protect the king several turns ahead. The choice is part of a careful plan. The adjective describes that kind of thinking.
A town chooses where to build a new road so people can reach several schools. The location supports a larger goal. The word can describe planning for future results.

examples.en: The painting has a striking mix of red and blue.
examples.zh: 這幅畫把紅色和藍色搭配得很醒目。

examples.en: She wore a striking silver necklace.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條引人注目的銀項鍊。

examples.en: The clock was striking twelve at noon.
examples.zh: 時鐘正敲響中午十二點。

explains: This adjective describes something that attracts attention because it is unusual, beautiful, or strong. It can also mean hitting something. The context reveals whether it is descriptive or an action form.
A bright yellow bird sits among dark green leaves. Its color stands out immediately. The adjective describes its appearance.
A clock hits a bell to show the hour. In this use, the word names an action. It can also describe something eye-catching or impressive.

examples.en: Safety inspectors confirmed that the building suffered no structural damage.
examples.zh: 安全鑑定技師證實該建築物在此次地震中未遭受任何結構性損傷。

examples.en: The city council approved structural economic reforms to attract foreign technology investment.
examples.zh: 市議會表決通過了深層的經濟結構改革法案，以全力吸引外商高科技投資。

examples.en: Cracks in the basement walls raised alarms regarding the tower's structural integrity.
examples.zh: 地下室承重牆面出現的龜裂裂縫，引發了各界對大樓結構安全完整性的高度警覺。

explains: This adjective relates to the way parts are arranged to form a whole. It can describe the frame of a building or the basic organization of a system. The word is used in engineering and many other fields.
Workers check the beams and walls that hold up a bridge. They make sure the frame can carry weight. The adjective describes those supporting parts.
A writer may change the order of chapters to improve a book. The change affects the way the whole work is organized. This word can describe such a basic arrangement.

examples.en: He stumbled over a tree root on the path.
examples.zh: 他在小徑上被樹根絆了一下。

examples.en: She stumbled through the first lines of her speech.
examples.zh: 她演講開頭幾句說得有些不順。

examples.en: We stumbled upon a quiet beach by accident.
examples.zh: 我們意外發現了一處寧靜的海灘。

explains: This verb means to trip or lose balance while walking. It can also mean to make a mistake while speaking or to find something by chance. The meaning depends on the situation.
A person catches a foot on a loose stone and takes a quick uneven step. The person nearly falls but stays upright. The verb describes that movement.
A student forgets a line during a speech, or a hiker finds an old path by chance. The verb can describe a speech mistake or an unexpected discovery. Both uses suggest difficulty or surprise.

examples.en: The sturdy table held all the science books.
examples.zh: 結實的桌子放得下所有自然科學書籍。

examples.en: Wear sturdy shoes on the rocky trail.
examples.zh: 在多石的步道上請穿耐穿的鞋。

examples.en: They built a sturdy fence around the garden.
examples.zh: 他們在花園周圍築起一道堅固的圍籬。

explains: This adjective describes something strong and solid enough to last or carry weight. It is not easily damaged or knocked over. It can describe furniture, tools, or a person’s build.
A pair of boots has thick bottoms that protect the feet on rocky ground. A strong table can also hold heavy books. The adjective describes dependable strength.
A pair of boots has thick soles that protect the feet on rocky ground. A strong table can also hold heavy books. The adjective describes dependable strength.

examples.en: Please submit your drawing by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前繳交你的畫作。

examples.en: He submitted an idea for the class project.
examples.zh: 他為班級計畫提出了一個想法。

examples.en: The team refused to submit without a fair match.
examples.zh: 隊伍拒絕在沒有公平比賽的情況下認輸。

explains: This verb means to give or send something for review or decision. It can also mean to accept another person’s authority or to yield. The setting changes the tone.
A student sends a completed form to the school office. The staff will check it before approval. The verb describes handing it in.
A team may stop resisting after an opponent becomes too strong. The verb can describe yielding or accepting control. It also appears in formal requests.

examples.en: Subsequent tests showed that the repair worked.
examples.zh: 後續測試顯示修理成功了。

examples.en: The team made a subsequent visit to the school.
examples.zh: 團隊之後又造訪了學校一次。

examples.en: She described the subsequent events in her diary.
examples.zh: 她在日記裡描述了後來發生的事情。

explains: This adjective means happening after something else. It refers to a later event or step in a sequence. The word is more formal than “next” or “later.”
A student takes a first test and then a second one a week later. The second test comes after the first. It occurs later in time.
A report may describe the days following a storm. These are later events. The adjective helps show order in time.

examples.en: Low-income families receive monthly rent subsidies from the local government.
examples.zh: 經濟弱勢租屋家庭每月皆可向地方政府領取中央擴大租金補貼減輕居住負擔。

examples.en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs provides solar panel subsidies for rooftop installations.
examples.zh: 經濟部針對民眾在自家住宅屋頂裝設太陽能光電發電板提供優厚專案補助津貼。

examples.en: Agricultural subsidies help local fruit farmers withstand unexpected crop losses from storms.
examples.zh: 政府提撥的農業天然災害救助補助金，有效協助在地果農抵禦颱風帶來的農損衝擊。

examples.en: Government conservation subsidy programs compensate poultry farmers who report wildlife damage peacefully.
examples.zh: 政府推動的「生態服務給付獎勵金」（Subsidy），為通報石虎吃雞而非私自設陷阱的友善農民提供實質補償。

examples.en: Farmers receive an annual ecological subsidy for maintaining pesticide-free buffer strips along forest edges.
examples.zh: 願意在森林交界處保留不噴灑農藥植被緩衝帶的耕作者，每年可申領專案生態給付津貼。

examples.en: The state subsidy helps rural landowners install animal-proof electric fences around fruit orchards.
examples.zh: 政府農政專案補助能協助山區果農在果園周圍架設防動物侵入的友善電牧線圍籬。

entries.definition: 政府津貼；補助金；生態服務給付農民友善耕作獎勵金；補貼
explains: This noun means money given by a government or organization to help pay for something. It can lower costs for people, businesses, or public services. The support usually has a specific purpose.
A city helps families pay part of the cost of bus passes. The money makes travel more affordable. This payment is financial aid.
A government may support farmers during a difficult season. The funds help keep important goods available. The noun describes financial assistance.

examples.en: The town received substantial help after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水後，小鎮獲得了大量援助。

examples.en: They made a substantial donation to the library.
examples.zh: 他們捐了一大筆錢給圖書館。

examples.en: The meal included a substantial serving of rice.
examples.zh: 這餐有一大份米飯。

explains: This adjective means large or important in amount, size, or value. It can also describe something strongly built or well supported. The exact meaning depends on the noun it describes.
A school raises a large amount of money for new books. The sum is much greater than expected. The adjective describes its size.
A house has thick walls and a strong frame. It feels solid and well made. The word can describe this kind of strength.

examples.en: The substitute teacher read us a story.
examples.zh: 代課老師唸了一個故事給我們聽。

examples.en: You can substitute beans for meat in this dish.
examples.zh: 這道菜可以用豆子代替肉。

examples.en: A spare key served as a substitute for the lost one.
examples.zh: 備用鑰匙代替了遺失的那把。

explains: This noun means a person or thing used in place of another. As a verb, it means to use one thing instead of another. The replacement may be temporary or permanent.
A teacher is sick, so another teacher leads the class for one day. This person takes the first teacher’s place. The temporary replacement fills the role.
A cook uses applesauce instead of oil in a recipe. The verb describes choosing one ingredient in place of another. The result may taste or feel different.

examples.en: There was a subtle change in the song’s rhythm.
examples.zh: 歌曲的節奏有一個細微變化。

examples.en: The soup had a subtle lemon flavor.
examples.zh: 湯帶有淡淡的檸檬味。

examples.en: She gave a subtle hint about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 她稍微暗示了驚喜派對的事。

explains: This adjective describes something small or quiet that may not be noticed right away. It can describe a slight change, hint, flavor, or difference. Careful attention may be needed to see it.
A painting uses a little more blue in one corner than elsewhere. The color shift is hard to notice at first. It is a very small change.
A soup has a mild herb flavor rather than a strong taste. A friend may also give a gentle hint instead of speaking directly. The adjective describes these slight effects.

examples.en: They moved to a suburban neighborhood with a small park.
examples.zh: 他們搬到一個有小公園的郊區社區。

examples.en: A suburban train carried workers downtown.
examples.zh: 郊區列車載著上班族前往市中心。

examples.en: The school serves several suburban communities.
examples.zh: 這所學校服務好幾個郊區社區。

explains: This adjective describes an area or life outside a large city, often with homes and local shops. People may travel from there into the city for work or school. The exact layout varies.
A neighborhood has family homes, small parks, and quiet streets beyond the downtown area. Many residents commute to jobs in the city. The adjective describes that place.
A train runs from a smaller community into a busy city each morning. The community lies outside the city center. The word can also describe homes, schools, or routines there.

examples.en: The mayor introduced her successor at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長在典禮上介紹了接任者。

examples.en: The new phone is the successor to last year’s model.
examples.zh: 這支新手機是去年款式的後繼機種。

examples.en: The king named his son as his successor.
examples.zh: 國王指定兒子為王位繼承人。

explains: This noun means a person or thing that takes the place of someone or something before it. The change may happen after retirement, death, or the end of a product line. The word points to what comes next.
A coach leaves a team, and another coach is chosen to lead it. The new person takes over the role. This person comes next in the job.
A company releases a new model after an older one. The later model replaces the earlier design. The noun can describe people, products, or systems.

examples.en: The presidential suite offers panoramic city views of Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 總統套房坐擁台北 101 的全景市景。

examples.en: They upgraded our reservation to a honeymoon suite for free.
examples.zh: 他們免費將我們的預訂升等至蜜月套房。

examples.en: The executive suite has a spacious living room and meeting area.
examples.zh: 行政套房擁有寬敞的客廳與會議空間。

examples.en: The penthouse master suite occupies an entire private floor featuring panoramic skyline vistas.
examples.zh: 頂樓豪宅大器的主臥套房（Master Suite）獨佔整個私人樓層，坐擁三百六十度台北信義區天際線。

examples.en: The luxury hotel suite boasts a private plunge pool, king-size bed, and personal butler service.
examples.zh: 這間五星級奢華總統套房配備了私人露天無邊際戲水池、特大雙人床與二十四小時專屬管家尊榮服務。

examples.en: The symphony orchestra performed an orchestral suite composed of enchanting fairy-tale themes.
examples.zh: 國家交響樂團在音樂廳深情演奏了一部由扣人心弦的夢幻童話旋律改編而成的經典管弦樂組曲（Suite）。

entries.definition: 套房；組曲；主臥大套房；套房組
explains: This noun can mean a set of connected rooms in a hotel or a group of matching things. In music, it means a set of pieces played together. Pronunciation may differ from “suit.”
A hotel room has a bedroom and sitting room connected by a door. Guests use both spaces together. This group of rooms is rented as one unit.
A company sells several computer programs that work well together. A composer may also write several related musical pieces. The noun can describe either set.

examples.en: The band gave a superb performance at the festival.
examples.zh: 樂團在音樂節上有精彩的演出。

examples.en: We had a superb view from the hilltop.
examples.zh: 我們從山頂看到極佳的景色。

examples.en: Her superb drawing won first prize.
examples.zh: 她出色的畫作贏得了第一名。

explains: This adjective means extremely good or impressive. It can describe a performance, meal, view, or skill. The word expresses strong praise.
A young pianist plays a difficult piece with great control and feeling. The audience applauds loudly. The performance is excellent.
A meal has fresh ingredients and is cooked very well. A person may also show great skill in a sport. The adjective gives strong praise.

examples.en: Pointing directly at the moon is an old childhood superstition.
examples.zh: 用手指直接指月亮是小時候聽過的古老民間迷信。

examples.en: Stepping on the raised wooden threshold of a temple doorway violates a classic superstition.
examples.zh: 腳踩寺廟大門口凸起的高聳木門檻，違背了一項傳統民俗禁忌與迷信。

examples.en: Modern scientific education helps dispel irrational fear and ancient superstition.
examples.zh: 現代科學普及教育有助於消除非理性的無端恐懼與陳舊的民間迷信觀念。

explains: This noun means a belief that an action or object can bring good or bad luck without proof. It may be passed down through families or cultures. People may follow it out of habit or fear.
A person avoids walking under a ladder because they think it brings bad luck. There is no clear evidence for the belief. This is an unfounded belief about luck.
Some people carry a lucky charm before an important test. Such customs can be meaningful, even though they do not control the result. The noun describes the belief behind them.

examples.en: A coach supervised the children during practice.
examples.zh: 教練在練習時照看孩子們。

examples.en: She supervises a team of library volunteers.
examples.zh: 她負責督導一組圖書館志工。

examples.en: An adult must supervise the cooking activity.
examples.zh: 烹飪活動必須由成人在旁監督。

explains: This verb means to watch over work or activity and make sure it is done properly. A person may guide others and check their progress. It does not mean doing every task personally.
A teacher stays near students during a science activity and checks that they use tools safely. The teacher guides their work. The verb describes this responsibility.
A manager may review a project as workers complete different jobs. Regular checks help the group stay organized. The word means overseeing an activity.

examples.en: The children played under adult supervision.
examples.zh: 孩子們在成人看顧下玩耍。

examples.en: The project needs close supervision.
examples.zh: 這項計畫需要密切督導。

examples.en: A teacher provided supervision during the field trip.
examples.zh: 老師在校外教學期間提供照看。

explains: This noun means the act of watching and guiding people or work. It helps ensure that tasks are done safely or correctly. A supervisor provides this oversight.
An adult stays nearby while children use a swimming pool. The adult watches and helps if needed. This careful watching helps keep them safe.
A construction job may need a trained person to check each stage. This guidance helps workers follow the plan. The noun can describe watching and direction.

examples.en: Always keep your direct supervisor updated on project milestones.
examples.zh: 請務必讓您的直屬主管隨時掌握專案最新里程碑進度。

examples.en: A supportive workplace supervisor gives clear guidance and constructive praise.
examples.zh: 一位優秀暖心的職場主管，總是能給予下屬清晰明確的指引與發自內心的真摯肯定。

examples.en: Her graduate thesis supervisor provided insightful revisions on her research methodology.
examples.zh: 她的研究所碩士論文指導教授，針對其研究方法論章節提出了精闢深刻的修改建議。

explains: This noun means a person who guides and checks the work of others. The person may plan tasks, answer questions, or review results. The role exists in schools, offices, and many workplaces.
A worker asks a team leader how to handle a problem. The leader gives advice and checks that the task is finished. This person is responsible for guiding the team.
A school may have an adult who watches students during an activity. The person helps keep the group safe and organized. The noun names someone responsible for oversight.

examples.en: The package supposedly arrived yesterday.
examples.zh: 據說包裹昨天就送到了。

examples.en: This supposedly rare coin is sold in many shops.
examples.zh: 這枚據稱稀有的硬幣在許多商店都買得到。

examples.en: He was supposedly the fastest runner in town.
examples.zh: 據說他是鎮上跑得最快的人。

explains: This adverb means according to what people say or believe, though it may not be certain or true. It can show doubt about a claim. The speaker may lack proof.
A friend says a café is open all night, but nobody has checked. People say it is open, though this may not be true. The adverb marks the claim as unconfirmed.
A story says a hidden tunnel runs under the old house. The speaker reports what is claimed without promising it is true. The word signals distance from the claim.

examples.en: The supreme court reviewed the case.
examples.zh: 最高法院審查了這個案件。

examples.en: She made a supreme effort to finish the race.
examples.zh: 她盡全力完成了比賽。

examples.en: The general held supreme command of the fleet.
examples.zh: 將軍掌握艦隊的最高指揮權。

explains: This adjective means highest in rank, authority, or degree. It can describe a top court, leader, or level of power. The word often appears in formal language.
A country has one court whose decisions are the highest legal authority. No lower court can overrule it. The adjective describes its rank.
A leader may hold the greatest power within a group. A person can also make a very great effort. The word signals the highest level.

examples.en: The farm sold its surplus eggs at the market.
examples.zh: 農場把多出的雞蛋拿到市場販售。

examples.en: We donated surplus blankets to the shelter.
examples.zh: 我們把多餘的毯子捐給收容所。

examples.en: The club had a budget surplus after the fair.
examples.zh: 園遊會後，社團預算還有結餘。

explains: This noun means an amount that is left over after needs are met. As an adjective, it describes more than is needed. The extra amount may be saved, sold, or shared.
A garden produces more tomatoes than the family can eat. The extra vegetables may be given to neighbors. They are more than the family needs.
A shop orders more paper than it needs for the year. The remaining supply is extra stock. The word can also describe extra money in a budget.

examples.en: Coastal radar networks and long-range drone surveillance detect illegal smuggling boats in dark night waters.
examples.zh: 岸際高解析雷達網與長滯空無人機全天候監控，在漆黑深夜中精準辨識非法走私可疑船隻。

examples.en: The semiconductor foundry implemented high-resolution video surveillance to protect its intellectual property.
examples.zh: 半導體晶圓廠安裝了高解析度視訊監控系統，全力保護其核心智慧財產權。

examples.en: Public health authorities expanded genomic surveillance to track new respiratory virus mutations quickly.
examples.zh: 衛福與疾管機關擴大了基因定序監測網，以快速追蹤新型呼吸道病毒的變異情形。

examples.en: High-definition traffic surveillance cameras tracked the getaway vehicle escaping onto the northbound highway.
examples.zh: 高畫質路口交通監視器，清晰捕捉到作案逃逸車輛一路開上國道往北逃逸。

examples.en: Undercover officers maintained 24-hour physical surveillance on the suspected smuggling warehouse.
examples.zh: 便衣刑警在涉案走私鐵皮倉庫周圍進行了二十四小時全天候的隱蔽埋伏與盯梢監控。

examples.en: Video surveillance from the convenience store captured the robbery suspect discarding the weapon.
examples.zh: 超商門口高解析監視器錄影畫面，清楚拍下了搶案嫌疑人將兇器隨手丟棄在水溝中的決定性瞬間。

entries.definition: 岸際雷達與無人機全天候監控；路口監視器高畫質天網行蹤調閱；監控
explains: This noun means careful watching of a person, place, or activity, often over time. Cameras, guards, or other tools may be used. The word appears in security and law.
A store uses cameras to watch entrances and checkout areas. Staff can review what happened if something goes missing. The cameras help keep watch.
Police may observe a location during an investigation. The action can raise questions about privacy. The noun describes organized monitoring.

examples.en: They suspended the game because of lightning.
examples.zh: 因為閃電，他們暫停了比賽。

examples.en: A glass ornament was suspended from the branch.
examples.zh: 一個玻璃飾品懸掛在樹枝上。

examples.en: The school suspended the student for two days.
examples.zh: 學校讓那名學生停課兩天。

explains: This verb can mean to hang something so it is held up, or to stop an activity temporarily. It can also mean removing someone from school or work for a time. The context shows which sense applies.
A lamp hangs from the ceiling on a cord. The cord holds it above the floor. The verb describes hanging it in place.
A game may stop because of heavy rain and begin later. A student may also be kept away from class for a short time after breaking a rule. The word can describe each kind of pause.

examples.en: The dense rosewood back captures energy, producing a crystalline note sustain that blooms for ten seconds.
examples.zh: 質地緻密的玫瑰木背板鎖住能量，讓彈出的每個音符在空氣中如花朵綻放般「悠長延音」（Sustain）達十秒之久。

examples.en: Eating complex whole carbohydrates provides steady metabolic energy to sustain runners through marathons.
examples.zh: 攝取富含膳食纖維的複合性全穀碳水化合物，能提供平穩釋放的熱量以支撐馬拉松跑者一路衝過終點。

examples.en: Deep root systems help desert cacti sustain vitality through months of scorching, rainless weather.
examples.zh: 深入地底的龐大發達根系，協助沙漠仙人掌在長達數月滴雨未下的酷熱烈日炙烤下依然長效維持盎然生機。

entries.definition: 悠長如歌唱般回盪不絕之音符延音長度；維持
explains: This verb means to keep something going or to support it over time. It can describe an effort, supply, or activity. It can also mean to suffer or experience something.
A garden needs water and care throughout the summer. The gardener keeps the plants growing. The verb describes maintaining their life.
A person may suffer an injury during a fall. In this use, the verb means to experience or receive harm. The meaning depends on what follows it.

examples.en: Utilizing solar energy is a sustainable way to power urban transportation.
examples.zh: 運用太陽能發電是一種兼顧環保與永續的都會大眾運輸供電方式。

examples.en: Consumers increasingly prefer sustainable fashion made from organic and recycled fibers.
examples.zh: 現代消費者日益青睞採用有機與再生回收纖維製成的永續時尚服飾。

examples.en: Overfishing threatens the survival of fish populations and prevents sustainable marine harvests.
examples.zh: 過度濫捕威脅著魚群的繁衍生存，並嚴重阻礙了海洋資源的可持續採捕。

examples.en: Walking, cycling, and taking the metro create a cleaner, sustainable mobility future.
examples.zh: 步行、騎自行車與搭乘捷運共同為我們的城市構築出更潔淨健康的永續移動未來。

examples.en: Organic farming practices promote sustainable agriculture without depleting soil nutrients.
examples.zh: 有機農法耕作實踐致力於推動永續農業，避免過度耗損土壤中天然的微量礦物質養分。

examples.en: Companies must adopt environmentally sustainable supply chains to comply with global ESG criteria.
examples.zh: 跨國企業必須建立環境友善的永續供應鏈架構，以完全符合國際嚴格的 ESG 審查準則。

examples.en: Conscious consumers support sustainable fashion brands that practice fair trade.
examples.zh: 具備環保意識的綠色消費者積極支持落實公平貿易與綠色低碳生產的永續時尚品牌。

examples.en: Using renewable resources is essential for building a truly sustainable future.
examples.zh: 使用可再生資源對於建立一個真正永續的未來至關重要。

examples.en: The company introduced sustainable packaging made from plant-based materials.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了採用植物性原料製成的環保永續包裝。

examples.en: Choosing battery-electric mobility contributes directly to a cleaner, quieter, and sustainable green future.
examples.zh: 選擇純電綠色出行方式，能為下一代留下更加純淨清新、安靜無污染的綠色永續美麗家園。

examples.en: Building offshore wind farms off Changhua creates sustainable renewable energy for island industries.
examples.zh: 在彰化外海大力建置離岸風力發電風場，為台灣各項支柱產業提供了充沛穩定的綠色永續再生能源。

examples.en: The fashion brand replaced virgin plastics with sustainable recycled ocean nylon yarns in its apparel line.
examples.zh: 這家知名戶外服飾品牌在機能運動服系列中全面淘汰原生塑膠，改採海廢回收尼龍紗線等永續環保面料。

examples.en: Investing in clean energy creates millions of high-paying jobs and builds a sustainable green economy.
examples.zh: 大力投資太陽能與離岸風電等潔淨能源，能創造數百萬高薪綠領就業機會並打造永續繁榮的綠色經濟。

examples.en: Marine protected zones allow depleted fish stocks to rebuild, securing sustainable fishing for local coastal villages.
examples.zh: 依法嚴格劃設沿海海洋生態保育禁漁區，讓枯竭的底棲魚類繁衍休養生息，確保近海漁村漁業生生不息的永續生計。

examples.en: Maintaining a sustainable work-life balance is essential to prevent chronic burnout and maintain mental well-being.
examples.zh: 隨時保持兼顧身心平衡的永續生活與工作節奏，是徹底杜絕長期職業倦怠並捍衛心理健康的不二法門。

entries.definition: 永續的；可持續發展的；環境友善可持續的；環保低碳的；綠色永續環保的；可持續的；綠色永續共好繁榮的
explains: This adjective describes something that can continue for a long time without using up needed resources or causing too much harm. It can describe farming, energy, or a way of life. The idea is long-term use.
A family uses a cloth bag again and again instead of taking a new plastic bag each time. This choice creates less waste over time. The adjective describes a practice that can continue.
A farm rotates crops and protects the soil. The land can keep producing food in future years. This word often appears in discussions about the environment and resources.

examples.en: We swapped seats so our friends could sit together.
examples.zh: 我們交換座位，讓朋友能坐在一起。

examples.en: The children swapped their lunch snacks.
examples.zh: 孩子們交換了午餐點心。

examples.en: They made a swap of books after class.
examples.zh: 他們下課後交換了書。

explains: This verb means to give one thing and receive another in return. It can also mean exchanging places or information. As a noun, it names the exchange.
Two children trade stickers from their collections. Each gives one and gets a different one. The verb describes their exchange.
Workers may switch shifts so each person can attend an appointment. They exchange times with one another. The noun can describe the agreed change.

examples.en: The team made a symbolic gesture of friendship.
examples.zh: 隊伍做出象徵友誼的舉動。

examples.en: A dove is a symbolic image of peace.
examples.zh: 鴿子是和平的象徵圖像。

examples.en: They planted a tree as a symbolic start to the project.
examples.zh: 他們種下一棵樹，象徵計畫正式開始。

explains: This adjective describes something that stands for a larger idea or meaning. A flag may represent a country, while a gift may represent friendship. It is connected with symbols.
A white dove in a picture can stand for peace. The bird represents an idea beyond itself. The adjective describes that meaning.
A small key given at a ceremony may represent trust or welcome. The object matters because of what it stands for. The word can describe an act, image, or item.

examples.en: Common flu symptoms include fever, chills, and body aches.
examples.zh: 流感的常見症狀包括發燒、畏寒及全身痠痛。

examples.en: Early detection of symptoms improves the chances of successful recovery.
examples.zh: 及早察覺症狀徵兆能大幅提高順利康復的機率。

examples.en: Rising inflation is a symptom of broader macroeconomic instability.
examples.zh: 通膨上升是更廣泛總體經濟不穩定的一種表徵徵兆。

examples.en: Common flu symptoms include high fever, body aches, fatigue, and sore throat.
examples.zh: 流行性感冒的常見典型症狀包含了高燒不退、全身肌肉痠痛、極度倦怠與喉嚨劇痛。

examples.en: Never ignore persistent abdominal pain as it could be a symptom of appendicitis.
examples.zh: 萬萬不可輕忽持續不斷的右下腹部隱痛，因為這極可能是急性盲腸炎的典型發病症狀。

examples.en: Many chronic diseases develop silently without presenting any noticeable early symptoms.
examples.zh: 許多慢性隱形殺手疾病在發病初期往往悄無聲息，幾乎不表現出任何容易察覺的早期病徵。

explains: This noun means a change in the body or mind that may show a person is ill. A cough or fever can be one such sign. It can also mean a clue that a larger problem exists.
A child has a sore throat and feels tired. These changes may happen when the child is sick. Each is a sign of illness.
A broken traffic light may point to a wider problem with city repairs. The noun can describe signs of trouble beyond health. It points to something that may need attention.

examples.en: The Kessler syndrome warns that cascading orbital collisions could render low Earth orbit unusable for generations.
examples.zh: 凱斯勒現象示警：軌道碎片連鎖撞擊引發的惡性循環，恐使近地軌道數百年無法使用。

examples.en: Chronic fatigue syndrome can cause severe muscle aches and prolonged cognitive exhaustion.
examples.zh: 慢性疲勞症候群會引發長期全身肌肉酸痛、無力感以及揮之不去的大腦認知遲鈍疲勞。

examples.en: Carpal tunnel syndrome is an occupational condition often affecting typists and assembly line workers.
examples.zh: 腕隧道症候群是一種常見的職場職業病，經常困擾著打字員、電腦工程師與產線組裝作業員。

entries.definition: 凱斯勒連鎖碰撞症候群（太空災難）
explains: This noun means a group of signs or features that often happen together and form a recognized condition. The causes can vary. Medical professionals use the word for defined sets of symptoms.
A person may have several related signs that doctors recognize as a named condition. The group is considered together rather than as one sign. This noun describes that collection.
The word is also used for a set of events or problems that tend to appear together. For example, a space science phrase names a chain of satellite collisions. Context shows the field.

examples.en: The city will tackle the traffic problem near the school.
examples.zh: 市府將處理學校附近的交通問題。

examples.en: The defender tackled the player with the ball.
examples.zh: 防守球員擒抱了持球球員。

examples.en: Dad packed his fishing tackle before dawn.
examples.zh: 爸爸在黎明前收拾好釣魚用具。

explains: This verb means to deal with a problem or try to solve it. In sports, it can mean stopping an opponent by taking or blocking the ball. As a noun, it can name fishing equipment.
A class notices litter around the playground and makes a cleanup plan. They begin working on the problem. The verb describes taking action to address it.
A football player knocks down an opponent who has the ball. A fisher may pack a rod, hooks, and other tools in a small box. The word has separate uses in games and fishing.

examples.en: The coach changed tactics during the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場改變了戰術。

examples.en: A simple tactic helped the team save time.
examples.zh: 一個簡單的方法幫助隊伍節省時間。

examples.en: They used different tactics to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 他們用不同的方法解謎。

explains: This noun means a planned action used to reach a goal or gain an advantage. It may be used in a game, discussion, or business. A larger strategy can include several such actions.
A chess player moves a piece to draw an opponent away from a key square. The move has a clear purpose. It is one planned action in the game.
A salesperson may ask a customer questions to learn what they need. The method can help move a conversation forward. The noun describes a chosen way to act.

examples.en: The kite string formed a tangle in the tree.
examples.zh: 風箏線在樹上纏成一團。

examples.en: My headphones tangled in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我的耳機線在背包裡纏在一起。

examples.en: I tangle the thread when I sew too quickly.
examples.zh: 她小心地把線解開。

explains: This noun means a twisted mass that is difficult to separate. As a verb, it means to become twisted or caught together. Hair, string, and fishing line can get knotted.
Headphones are left in a pocket and come out as a knot of wires. The wires cross over each other. This is a twisted mass.
A kitten plays with a ball of yarn until the strands twist together. The verb describes this knotting. People may also get caught in a confusing disagreement.

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread tempted us to enter the bakery.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味吸引我們走進麵包店。

examples.en: Do not tempt the dog with food near the table.
examples.zh: 不要在桌邊拿食物逗狗。

examples.en: The bright display tempted her to buy a new notebook.
examples.zh: 鮮亮的展示吸引她買了一本新筆記本。

explains: This verb means to make someone want to do or have something. The thing may be enjoyable but not wise or needed. It can also mean trying to get someone to take a risk.
A child sees a plate of cookies before dinner and wants one. The sweet smell makes the child want to take a cookie. The verb describes that pull.
A person may feel a strong wish to stay up late to finish a game. The choice might make them tired the next day. The word often refers to something attractive or hard to resist.

examples.en: I resisted the temptation to eat the whole cake.
examples.zh: 我忍住了把整個蛋糕吃掉的誘惑。

examples.en: The sale was a temptation for shoppers.
examples.zh: 這場特賣對購物者很有吸引力。

examples.en: He gave in to the temptation to skip practice.
examples.zh: 他抵不住誘惑，沒有去練習。

explains: This noun means a strong desire to do or have something, especially when it may be unwise. It can also name the thing that creates that desire. The word often suggests a struggle to resist.
A bowl of candy sits beside a student who is trying to finish homework. The student wants to take some before dinner. That desire may be hard to resist.
A sale sign may make someone want to buy an item they do not need. The attractive offer creates a pull. The noun can describe either the desire or its cause.

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport features Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場目前設有第一航廈與第二航廈。

examples.en: The airport Skytrain carries passengers between terminals in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 機場航廈電車僅需數分鐘即可載運旅客穿梭於各航廈之間。

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with terminal illness, but remained remarkably optimistic.
examples.zh: 雖然這名患者被診斷出罹患絕症末期，但內心依舊保持無比樂觀堅強。

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport is constructing a state-of-the-art Terminal 3.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場目前正全力興建具備智慧綠能建築特色的現代化第三航廈。

examples.en: Take the free airport skytrain to transfer between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
examples.zh: 旅客可免費搭乘機場航廈電車（Skytrain），在第一航廈與第二航廈之間快速穿梭往返。

examples.en: The long-distance coach terminal is located directly next to the central railway station.
examples.zh: 國道長途客運轉運總站就坐落在市中心中央火車站的正旁邊，轉乘高鐵火車十分便捷。

examples.en: Kaohsiung Port Terminal 7 operates Taiwan's first fully automated remote-controlled container yard.
examples.zh: 高雄港第七貨櫃中心引進全自動無人化遠端控制橋吊與自走車，打造全台首座世界級智慧碼頭。

examples.en: The modern cargo terminal processes import declarations around the clock to prevent tarmac congestion.
examples.zh: 現代化航空貨運航廈全天候二十四小時不間斷審驗進口報單，全力防止機場停機坪貨物積壓堵塞。

examples.en: Thousands of trucks enter the port terminal gates every morning to drop off export containers.
examples.zh: 每天清晨數以千計的大卡車浩浩蕩蕩駛進港口貨櫃碼頭通關閘口，依序交卸即將裝船出口的貨櫃。

examples.en: The modern all-in-one wireless POS terminal accepts chips, contactless Apple Pay, and barcode scans.
examples.zh: 這台多合一無線智慧 POS 刷卡收銀終端機，同時支援實體晶片插卡、感應式 Apple Pay 與掃碼條碼支付。

examples.en: Passengers queued at the newly inaugurated airport departure terminal to check in their luggage.
examples.zh: 準備出國度假的旅客們在全新啟用的第三航廈報到大廳前排起長龍，依序辦理登機手續並交運行李。

examples.en: System administrators execute configuration bash commands using the encrypted Linux command terminal.
examples.zh: 系統資深維運工程師透過 SSH 加密連線進入 Linux 指令終端機視窗，快速執行伺服器安全補丁更新。

entries.definition: 機場航廈；客運總站；末期的；末端的；港口貨櫃碼頭；航廈；終端；智慧收銀刷卡機 (POS 機)；終端機
explains: This adjective can mean located at the end of something or relating to a final stage. As a noun, it can mean a station building, a computer screen for entering commands, or a connection point for wires. The word has several uses.
A train line ends at its final station. That last stop is the final point of the route. The adjective describes its position at the end.
An airport building handles arriving and departing passengers. A computer screen lets someone enter commands. The word has several noun meanings in travel and technology.

examples.en: The thunder terrified the little dog.
examples.zh: 雷聲把小狗嚇壞了。

examples.en: The dark tunnel terrified the young hikers.
examples.zh: 黑暗的隧道讓年輕的登山客非常害怕。

examples.en: She was terrified by the sudden noise.
examples.zh: 她被突如其來的聲音嚇壞了。

explains: This verb means to make someone feel extreme fear. A sudden loud sound, danger, or frightening story can cause this feeling. The verb is stronger than “scare.”
A child hears a crash in a dark room and runs to a parent. The sound creates intense fear. The verb describes that reaction.
A frightening film may cause a viewer to hide behind a pillow. The feeling can be strong even when the danger is not real. The verb means causing great fear.

examples.en: The witness testified in court on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 證人在星期二出庭作證。

examples.en: She testified that she saw the car turn left.
examples.zh: 她作證說自己看見那輛車左轉。

examples.en: The old walls testify to the town’s long history.
examples.zh: 古老的城牆見證了這座城鎮悠久的歷史。

explains: This verb means to give a formal statement about what someone knows, especially in court. It can also mean to show that something is true. The word is common in legal settings.
A witness answers questions in a courtroom about what they saw. The answers become part of the case. The verb describes giving that formal account.
A broken window may show how strong the storm was. In this use, evidence proves that something happened. The verb can describe proof as well as speech.

examples.en: Taiwanese food lovers cherish the springy, chewy texture known as 'Q'.
examples.zh: 台灣老饕極為講究並鍾情於軟糯彈牙、富含嚼勁的「Q 彈」獨特口感。

examples.en: The silky texture of traditional handmade tofu contrasts nicely with crunchy pickles.
examples.zh: 純手工傳統鹽滷豆腐如絲般細膩滑順的軟嫩質地，與爽脆酸甜的泡菜形成絕妙對比。

examples.en: Heavy linen fabric has a distinctive rustic, natural texture.
examples.zh: 純天然粗亞麻面料帶有一種粗獷質樸、溫潤且富含手作溫度的獨特自然紋理質感。

examples.en: Van Gogh squeezed pure pigment directly from tubes to create swirling, sculptural oil paint textures.
examples.zh: 梵谷直接將未經稀釋的原色顏料厚厚堆疊擠上畫布，以刮刀堆砌出旋轉翻騰、充滿生命力的立體油畫肌理。

examples.en: We love this artisanal Taiwanese bakery because their sourdough bread possesses a crunchy crust and chewy texture.
examples.zh: 我們非常喜愛這家隱身於巷弄的台灣手作烘焙坊，因為其天然酸種麵包外皮酥脆且內部組織彈牙富有嚼勁。

examples.en: The coarse woven texture of traditional linen gives casual summer jackets a relaxed, natural feel.
examples.zh: 傳統粗紡亞麻布料特有的天然纖維紋理與觸感，賦予了炎夏休閒西裝一種自在瀟灑、透氣舒適的隨性風格。

examples.en: The hallmark of great pastry is contrast in texture—a crisp shell giving way to a meltingly soft filling.
examples.zh: 頂級法式甜點的最高靈魂在於口感對比——極致香脆的酥皮瞬間迎來入口即化、絲滑綿密的內餡。

examples.en: Adding toasted chopped pecans to the brownie batter introduces an appealing crumbly texture.
examples.zh: 在布朗尼蛋糕麵糊中拌入烘烤過的碧根果碎粒，能為濃郁綿密的蛋糕體增添驚豔的酥脆嚼感。

examples.en: Judges in baking competitions award top marks for desserts that master both crunchy and velvety textures.
examples.zh: 世界烘焙大賽國際評審在評分時，總是對能完美駕馭香脆酥皮與絲絨滑順雙重口感的作品給予最高分。

examples.en: Electro-tactile surfaces simulate the delicate texture of silk fabric and the coarse grit of raw stone.
examples.zh: 靜電觸覺技術能精準模擬出絲綢布料的滑順與粗糙岩石的「表面微細紋理」（Texture）。

examples.en: The artisan bakery is celebrated for sourdough bread with a chewy interior texture and crunchy crust.
examples.zh: 這家手工烘焙坊以內層口感彈牙、外皮焦香酥脆的酸種麵包而聞名遐邇。

examples.en: Interior decorators layered velvet cushions over leather sofas to introduce varied tactile textures.
examples.zh: 室內設計師在真皮沙發上鋪設天鵝絨靠墊，為居家空間增添豐富的觸覺層次。

examples.en: Low-temperature cooking breaks down tough sinews, yielding an impossibly tender, velvety meat texture.
examples.zh: 低溫慢煮徹底軟化了強韌的肌腱筋膜，營造出令人驚嘆、如絲絨般入口即化的「極致軟嫩口感」（Texture）。

examples.en: Pastry judges evaluate croissants based on outer flake flakiness and buttery interior texture.
examples.zh: 烘焙評審主要依據外層千層的酥脆度與內層濕潤柔軟的質地口感來評分可頌。

examples.en: The coarse woven texture of the linen curtain filters bright afternoon sunshine gently.
examples.zh: 亞麻窗簾粗獷質樸的手工織紋質地，溫和過濾了午後刺眼的烈日陽光。

entries.definition: 口感；質地；紋理；畫布厚塗油彩肌理質感；外酥脆內濕潤軟 Q 之極致多重口感；模擬絲綢滑順與砂紙粗糙之微震動紋理；膠原蛋白完全軟化之入口即化極致口感
explains: This noun means how a surface feels or looks, such as smooth, rough, or soft. It can also describe the feel of food or the layers in music and art. The exact meaning depends on the subject.
A towel feels rough while silk feels smooth against the skin. Touch helps people notice this quality. The noun describes the surface feel.
A soup may be creamy or chunky, while a song may have many layers of sound. The word can describe these qualities too. It helps explain how something feels or is put together.

examples.en: The theft of the bicycle was reported to the police.
examples.zh: 這輛自行車失竊一事已向警方報案。

examples.en: The store added cameras to prevent theft.
examples.zh: 商店加裝攝影機以防竊盜。

examples.en: They discovered the theft after checking the records.
examples.zh: 他們檢查紀錄後發現了竊盜事件。

explains: This noun means the act of taking something that belongs to someone else without permission. The action is against the law in many places. It can involve money, objects, or information.
A person takes a bicycle from a rack without asking the owner. The owner loses the bicycle. This is stealing.
Someone may secretly use another person’s bank details. That also involves taking something without permission. The noun names the act, not just the missing object.

examples.en: She studied theology at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀神學。

examples.en: The book introduces basic ideas in Christian theology.
examples.zh: 這本書介紹基督教神學的基本觀念。

examples.en: Their course compared theology across several religions.
examples.zh: 他們的課程比較了幾種宗教的神學。

explains: This noun means the study of ideas about God, religion, and religious belief. Students may compare teachings and sacred writings. The field can focus on one faith or many.
A class reads religious texts and discusses what they say about justice and creation. Students study beliefs and how they are explained. This is the academic study of religion.
A scholar may compare how different faiths understand life after death. The work involves careful reading and discussion. The noun names this area of study.

examples.en: The class discussed a theoretical problem in physics.
examples.zh: 全班討論了一個物理學理論問題。

examples.en: Her idea is interesting but still theoretical.
examples.zh: 她的想法很有趣，但仍停留在理論上。

examples.en: The design has both practical and theoretical uses.
examples.zh: 這項設計兼具實際與理論用途。

explains: This adjective describes ideas based on thought or models rather than direct practical use. It can also mean possible in theory but not yet proven in real life. The contrast is with actual practice.
A student learns a rule for how planets move by reading a book. The rule explains an idea but is not a hands-on activity. The adjective describes this kind of learning.
A plan may work on paper but fail when people try it. The idea has not been tested in real life. The word can describe a model or possibility.

examples.en: Talking with a licensed therapist helped him manage severe work anxiety.
examples.zh: 與領有合格執照的治療師晤談幫助他克服了嚴重的職場焦慮。

examples.en: The speech therapist taught the young child how to pronounce difficult consonants correctly.
examples.zh: 語言治療師悉心教導年幼孩子如何正確發出困難的子音音節。

examples.en: Her physical therapist recommended gentle stretching exercises for her sore shoulder.
examples.zh: 她的物理治療師建議做些溫和的拉筋伸展運動以舒緩肩膀痠痛。

entries.definition: 心理治療師；臨床治療師
explains: This noun means a trained person who helps someone improve health, movement, or emotional well-being. Different people in this work focus on different fields. The word is broader than one kind of care.
A person practices walking after an injury with help from a trained health worker. The worker plans safe exercises and tracks progress. This professional helps with recovery.
Some professionals help people talk through feelings, while others help with speech or movement. Their training and job duties differ. The noun names these kinds of helpers.

examples.en: Horticultural therapy calms anxious minds through the mindful tactile joy of planting.
examples.zh: 「園藝治療」（Horticultural Therapy）透過親手觸摸泥土與修剪花草的觸覺感知撫慰焦慮心靈。

examples.en: Digging hands into fresh earth serves as a grounding therapy that eases modern burnout.
examples.zh: 將雙手深深觸摸浸潤在溫暖微濕的新鮮泥土中，是一場能深層療癒現代人身心枯竭的接地療法。

examples.en: Hospitals establish healing gardens so patients can experience the restorative therapy of nature.
examples.zh: 現代綜合醫院紛紛在院區打造專屬療癒花園，讓住院病患能親身感受大自然的靜心撫慰力。

explains: This noun means treatment intended to improve health or help with a problem. It may involve talking, exercise, medicine, or other methods. The type depends on the need.
A person practices arm movements after an injury to regain strength. The planned care helps recovery. This is one kind of treatment.
A counselor may meet with someone regularly to discuss feelings and choices. A speech worker may help a child make sounds more clearly. The noun covers many kinds of care.

examples.en: She saved her notes, thereby avoiding lost work.
examples.zh: 她存下筆記，因此避免了資料遺失。

examples.en: The team shared tools, thereby finishing faster.
examples.zh: 隊伍共用工具，因此更快完成工作。

examples.en: He left early, thereby missing the traffic.
examples.zh: 他提早出發，因此避開了車潮。

explains: This adverb means by doing that or as a result of that action. It links an action with what follows from it. The word is more common in formal writing.
A student labels each box and makes the supplies easier to find. The labeling causes the helpful result. The adverb connects the two parts.
A town plants trees along a road and creates more shade. The second result follows from the action. The word helps show that connection.

examples.en: Graduate students spend months writing their master's thesis.
examples.zh: 碩士研究生花費數月撰寫其碩士學位論文。

examples.en: The central thesis of the essay argues that biodiversity is critical to planetary health.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的核心論點主張生物多樣性對地球整體健康至關重要。

examples.en: She submitted the final bound copy of her doctoral thesis to the academic committee.
examples.zh: 她將精裝裝訂完成的博士學位論文正式提交給學位學術委員會。

examples.en: Graduate students spent months writing their master's research thesis.
examples.zh: 碩士研究生耗費數月心血撰寫他們的碩士學位研究論文。

examples.en: The main thesis of her essay argues that green energy fuels sustainable economic growth.
examples.zh: 她這篇論述文的核心論點主張發展綠色潔淨能源是永續經濟增長的強大引擎。

examples.en: He spent endless nights in the library analyzing laboratory data for his thesis.
examples.zh: 他在大學圖書館裡度過了無數個漫漫長夜，只為替畢業論文嚴密分析實驗數據。

entries.definition: （碩士）學位論文；論點；碩士論文；畢業論文
explains: This noun can mean a long research paper written for a university degree. It can also mean the main idea someone tries to prove in an essay. The context shows which use is intended.
A student spends months researching a question and writing a long paper. The university reviews the work before granting a degree. The paper is written for an advanced degree.
An essay may state one main claim and support it with reasons. That central claim has a special name. The word is used in school and academic writing.

examples.en: The child rested a book on her thigh.
examples.zh: 孩子把一本書放在大腿上。

examples.en: He felt a cramp in his thigh after the run.
examples.zh: 跑步後，他的大腿抽筋了。

examples.en: We roasted chicken thighs with herbs.
examples.zh: 我們用香草烤了雞大腿。

explains: This noun means the upper part of the leg between the hip and knee. It contains strong muscles used for walking, running, and climbing. Animals also have this body part.
A runner stretches the muscles above the knee before a race. These muscles help move the leg forward. The noun names that area.
A cook may prepare meat from the upper leg of a chicken. The same body-part word names that cut of meat. Context distinguishes anatomy from food.

examples.en: She paused at the threshold before entering.
examples.zh: 她在門檻前停了一下才走進去。

examples.en: The noise rose above the threshold of hearing.
examples.zh: 噪音高到超過聽覺的門檻。

examples.en: The project is on the threshold of completion.
examples.zh: 這項計畫即將完成。

explains: This noun means the strip or level at the entrance to a room or doorway. It can also mean the point at which something begins or changes. The second use is figurative.
A door has a narrow piece of wood across the bottom. A person steps over it when entering. This part lies at the entrance.
A thermometer may show the point at which water begins to freeze. A sound level may also become loud enough to be heard. The noun can name such a starting point.

examples.en: The final goal gave the fans a thrill.
examples.zh: 最後的進球讓球迷們興奮不已。

examples.en: The children thrilled at the sight of the dolphins.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到海豚時興奮極了。

examples.en: It was a thrill to meet the author.
examples.zh: 能見到那位作者真令人興奮。

explains: This noun means a sudden feeling of excitement or pleasure. As a verb, it means to cause that strong happy feeling. A fast ride or close contest can give people great excitement.
A roller coaster drops quickly from a high point. Riders laugh and shout with excitement. The sudden drop can create a rush of joy.
A singer’s performance may excite an audience. A surprising gift can also delight someone. The verb describes causing strong excitement.

examples.en: We watched a thriller about a missing boat.
examples.zh: 我們看了一部關於失蹤船隻的驚悚片。

examples.en: The novel is a fast-paced thriller.
examples.zh: 這本小說是一部節奏明快的驚悚作品。

examples.en: She enjoys thrillers with clever mysteries.
examples.zh: 她喜歡有巧妙謎團的驚悚故事。

explains: This noun means a book, film, or show that creates excitement and suspense. The story often includes danger, mystery, or a race against time. Readers or viewers want to know what happens next.
A detective follows clues while a thief tries to escape. Each chapter brings a new danger. This kind of story keeps readers in suspense.
A movie may keep viewers tense with sudden turns and hidden secrets. The suspense makes them watch closely. The noun names this kind of exciting story.

examples.en: The flowers thrive in the sunny garden.
examples.zh: 這些花在陽光充足的花園裡長得很好。

examples.en: The young artist thrived with support from her teacher.
examples.zh: 在老師的支持下，年輕藝術家發展得很好。

examples.en: Their business thrives during the summer season.
examples.zh: 他們的生意在夏季蓬勃發展。

explains: This verb means to grow, develop, or do very well. Plants, people, and businesses can do well when conditions support them. The word suggests more than simply surviving.
A young tree gets enough sunlight and water. Its branches grow strong and healthy. The plant develops very well.
A small shop has loyal customers and careful planning. It earns enough money to grow. The verb can describe success in many areas.

examples.en: The king sat on the throne during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 國王在典禮期間坐在王座上。

examples.en: The story tells of a fight for the throne.
examples.zh: 故事描述了一場爭奪王位的鬥爭。

examples.en: A golden throne stood in the museum hall.
examples.zh: 博物館大廳裡放著一張金色王座。

explains: This noun means a special chair used by a king, queen, or other ruler during formal events. It can also represent royal power or the position of a monarch. It often appears in stories and history.
A ruler sits on a richly decorated chair during a ceremony. The seat may be raised above the others. This special chair shows the ruler’s status.
A story may tell how one person takes the place of a king. The word can represent the ruler’s position, not only the chair. It often appears in fairy tales and history.

examples.en: He thrust the note into my hand.
examples.zh: 他把紙條塞進我手裡。

examples.en: The boat thrust forward through the waves.
examples.zh: 船奮力向前穿過浪濤。

examples.en: She was thrust into a leadership role.
examples.zh: 她突然被推上領導職位。

explains: This verb means to push something suddenly and forcefully. It can also mean to place someone in a role or situation without warning. As a noun, it can name a strong forward push.
A person pushes a door open with one hard movement. The action is quick and forceful. The verb describes that push.
A sudden change may place a child in charge of a group. The child did not expect the responsibility. The word can describe being pushed into a new situation.

examples.en: The clock gave a soft tick in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 安靜的房間裡，時鐘發出輕微的滴答聲。

examples.en: A tick was crawling on the dog’s fur.
examples.zh: 一隻壁蝨在狗毛上爬行。

examples.en: Please tick the box beside your answer.
examples.zh: 請在你答案旁的方格打勾。

explains: This noun can mean a short clicking sound made by a clock. It can also name a tiny animal that attaches to skin and feeds on blood. As a verb, it means to make such a sound or mark a box.
A tiny arachnid may attach to an animal’s skin. It feeds on blood. This small creature can spread some illnesses.
A person may mark a box on a form to show a choice. The same verb can describe making a short clicking sound. The word has unrelated uses in nature and writing.

examples.en: Large-format matte porcelain tiles make the open kitchen look elegant.
examples.zh: 大尺寸消光霧面義大利進口石英地磚讓開放式廚房與玄關落塵區顯得沉穩典雅大器。

examples.en: Subway tiles laid in a classic herringbone pattern create a stylish bathroom shower wall.
examples.zh: 採用經典人字形拼接工法鋪貼的白色鐵道磚，打造出復古時尚的淋浴間特色主牆。

examples.en: Textured slip-resistant tiles were selected for the balcony floor to prevent falls in the rain.
examples.zh: 景觀陽台地面特地選用防滑係數高的止滑石英地磚，以防雨天濕滑不慎滑倒跌傷。

examples.en: Restored majolica tiles with vibrant pomegranate motifs symbolize wealth and abundant offspring.
examples.zh: 嘉義花磚博物館用心修復的百年古董立體彩釉馬約利卡花磚，上頭象徵多子多孫的石榴圖騰鮮麗奪目。

examples.en: Historic timber residences across Chiayi were adorned with imported glazed majolica tiles along their facades.
examples.zh: 嘉義許多歷史悠久的珍貴檜木日式民居外牆屋簷下，早期皆鑲嵌著自海外引進的立體彩釉磁磚。

examples.en: Volunteers painstakingly cleaned grease off century-old tiles salvaged from demolition sites.
examples.zh: 文史志工們耗費數週耐心使用特殊溶劑，仔細清除從老屋拆除工地上搶救回來的珍貴古董花磚油垢。

examples.en: Layers of overlapping barrel and pan tiles protect the roof timber boarding from monsoon leaks.
examples.zh: 陰陽相間、層層錯疊鋪設的琉璃筒瓦與板瓦，如堅固鎧甲般保護屋頂木板免受季風豪雨滲漏。

examples.en: Workers painstakingly stripped broken clay tiles and replaced them with hand-molded replacements.
examples.zh: 屋頂瓦匠逐一挑除破碎龜裂的舊陶瓦，並以純手工脫模的仿古板瓦予以替換修復。

examples.en: Proper tile spacing ensures water runs off roof slopes quickly without pooling.
examples.zh: 嚴謹精準的瓦壟排距與起伏弧度，確保暴雨能順著屋頂傾角飛速排瀉而不積水。

entries.definition: 磁磚；地磚；石英磚；台灣百年古董花磚 (馬約利卡花磚)；琉璃筒瓦與板瓦屋頂瓦作；鋪瓦
explains: This noun means a flat piece of hard material used to cover a floor, wall, or roof. It can be made from clay, stone, or glass. As a verb, it means to cover a surface with these pieces.
A kitchen floor has small square pieces that are easy to wipe clean. They fit closely together. Each one is a hard flat piece for covering a surface.
A roof may use curved pieces to keep rain out. A builder places them in rows. The noun also has a verb use for covering floors or walls.

examples.en: The old box was made of tin.
examples.zh: 那個舊盒子是用錫做的。

examples.en: She kept the biscuits in a blue tin.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾放在一個藍色鐵盒裡。

examples.en: The baker greased the cake tin.
examples.zh: 烘焙師在蛋糕烤模上抹了油。

explains: This noun means a soft, silvery metal used to coat steel or make containers. It can also mean a small metal container for food. In British English, it may name a baking pan.
A food can is made from steel with a thin layer of this silvery metal to help protect it. The coating is useful because it resists rust. The noun names the metal.
A baker pours cake batter into a round baking pan. In some places, people use this word for the pan. The meaning depends on the country and subject.

examples.en: We paid a toll before crossing the bridge.
examples.zh: 我們在過橋前付了通行費。

examples.en: The storm took a heavy toll on the coastal town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨重創了沿海小鎮。

examples.en: The church bells tolled at sunset.
examples.zh: 教堂的鐘在日落時分低沉地敲響。

explains: This noun can mean a fee paid to use a road or bridge. It can also mean the number of people hurt or killed in an event. As a verb, it means to ring a large bell slowly.
A driver pays money before crossing a private bridge. The payment helps cover its upkeep. The noun names this charge.
A storm damages homes and injures residents. News reports may count the number of deaths or injuries. The word can describe that total as well as a road fee.

examples.en: She used a torch to find the key under the bed.
examples.zh: 她用手電筒找床底下的鑰匙。

examples.en: The runner carried a torch through the town.
examples.zh: 跑者舉著火炬跑過城鎮。

examples.en: A small torch lit the tent at night.
examples.zh: 一支小手電筒在夜裡照亮帳篷。

explains: This noun can mean a handheld light powered by a battery in British English. In American English, it usually means a stick with a burning end. The context and country affect the meaning.
A camper switches on a small battery light to find a path in the dark. The light is easy to carry. In Britain, people often use a different word for it.
At a ceremony, a runner carries a flame in a special holder. The burning stick provides light. Both kinds serve as portable lights in different ways.

examples.en: The loud buzzing was a torment during the quiet test.
examples.zh: 安靜考試時，嗡嗡聲讓人十分煩躁。

examples.en: The bully tormented the younger child.
examples.zh: 那名霸凌者長期欺負年紀較小的孩子。

examples.en: She was tormented by worries about the lost dog.
examples.zh: 她一直為走失的狗感到焦慮。

explains: This noun means severe mental or physical suffering. As a verb, it means to cause someone great pain or worry over time. The word is stronger than ordinary annoyance.
A character cannot stop thinking about a painful mistake. The memory causes deep distress. The noun describes that suffering.
A child repeatedly teases a classmate about a fear. The repeated behavior causes distress. The verb describes causing lasting worry or pain.

examples.en: Hundreds of schools competed in the national high school baseball tournament.
examples.zh: 數百所學校參加了全國高中棒球錦標賽（黑豹旗）。

examples.en: The tennis tournament was delayed until the courts dried completely.
examples.zh: 網球錦標賽被迫暫停延後，直到球場完全乾燥為止。

examples.en: Our debate team advanced to the semi-finals of the intercollegiate tournament.
examples.zh: 我們的辯論隊晉級到了跨校辯論錦標賽的準決賽。

examples.en: The Taipei Open badminton tournament draws Olympic gold medalists annually.
examples.zh: 台北羽球公開賽錦標賽每年吸引多位奧運金牌得主齊聚較勁。

examples.en: She advanced through several elimination rounds to reach the tennis tournament finals.
examples.zh: 她一路過關斬將闖過數輪殘酷淘汰賽，昂首挺進網球錦標賽總決賽。

examples.en: The university chess club hosted an intercollegiate tournament over the weekend.
examples.zh: 大學西洋棋社在週末期間主辦了一場規模盛大的校際西洋棋聯賽。

entries.definition: 錦標賽；聯賽；淘汰賽；錦標錦標賽
explains: This noun means a series of games or contests in which people compete for a prize or title. Players may be removed after a loss or earn points across several rounds. Sports and games often use this format.
Chess players meet for several rounds over one weekend. They compete until a winner is chosen. The event is an organized contest.
A school may hold a contest among classes or teams. The matches determine which group does best. The noun describes this organized competition.

examples.en: The label warned that the liquid was toxic.
examples.zh: 標籤警告這種液體有毒。

examples.en: Toxic smoke filled the empty warehouse.
examples.zh: 有毒煙霧充滿了空倉庫。

examples.en: They left a toxic friendship that caused them stress.
examples.zh: 他們離開了一段讓自己壓力很大的有害友誼。

explains: This adjective describes something poisonous or harmful to living things. It can refer to chemicals, fumes, or an unhealthy relationship. The degree of harm depends on the substance or situation.
A cleaning liquid has a warning label because swallowing it can cause harm. It should be kept away from children. The adjective describes its dangerous nature.
A friendship may be harmful when one person repeatedly treats the other cruelly. This figurative use describes a damaging relationship. The word can refer to physical or emotional harm.

examples.en: Patience is a useful trait for a teacher.
examples.zh: 耐心是教師很有用的特質。

examples.en: The bird’s bright feathers are a distinctive trait.
examples.zh: 這隻鳥鮮豔的羽毛是明顯特徵。

examples.en: Curiosity was one of her best traits.
examples.zh: 好奇心是她最好的特質之一。

explains: This noun means a quality or feature of a person, animal, or thing. It may be part of someone’s personality or appearance. People and animals can share qualities or differ from one another.
A dog waits calmly for food and behaves kindly with children. This quality is part of the dog’s personality. Another dog may behave differently.
A plant has broad leaves that help it catch sunlight. That feature is part of the plant’s makeup. The word can describe physical or behavioral qualities.
