Some promises cover only certain problems or parts. A buyer can read the terms before relying on them. The noun names this kind of product guarantee.

examples.en: The waterproof jacket kept me dry in the rain.
examples.zh: 這件防水外套讓我在雨中保持乾爽。

examples.en: They bought a waterproof cover for the camera.
examples.zh: 他們買了防水相機罩。

examples.en: The workers waterproofed the basement wall.
examples.zh: 工人替地下室牆面做了防水處理。

explains: This adjective describes something that water cannot pass through easily. A raincoat keeps rain off the clothes beneath it. The material blocks water.
A sealed case helps protect a phone near water. A closed bag may keep papers dry. The item is made to resist getting wet.
As a verb, it means to treat something so water cannot enter. A worker may seal a wooden deck. This treatment helps keep it dry.

examples.en: The weary hikers rested beside the trail.
examples.zh: 疲憊的健行者在步道旁休息。

examples.en: She grew weary of waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 她等公車等得不耐煩了。

examples.en: The long speech wearied the audience.
examples.zh: 冗長的演講讓聽眾感到疲倦。

explains: This adjective means very tired after effort or worry. A long trip may leave a person exhausted. The person needs rest.
It can describe someone who has lost patience with something repeated. A teacher may hear the same excuse again and again. The feeling comes from being tired of it.
As a verb, it means to make someone tired or bored. Repeated delays can drain a traveler. The person may lose energy or interest.

examples.en: The fishing boat returned to the wharf at dawn.
examples.zh: 漁船在黎明時回到碼頭。

examples.en: Crates of fruit waited on the wharf.
examples.zh: 一箱箱水果在碼頭上等候搬運。

examples.en: They tied the small boat beside the wharf.
examples.zh: 他們把小船繫在碼頭旁。

explains: This noun is a platform beside water where ships load and unload goods or people. Boats can tie up along its edge. Workers move cargo between land and ship.
A town may build this landing near its harbor. Fishing boats return there with their catch. The structure helps connect boats with the shore.
As a verb, it can mean to place or secure a boat at such a landing. A crew brings the vessel alongside. This use is less common than the noun.

examples.en: He ordered a glass of whiskey with ice.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯加冰的威士忌。

examples.en: The recipe uses a little whisky in the sauce.
examples.zh: 這道食譜在醬汁中加了一點威士忌。

examples.en: The bottle of whiskey was kept in a cabinet.
examples.zh: 那瓶威士忌被收在櫥櫃裡。

explains: This is a strong alcoholic drink made from grain. It is aged in wooden barrels. Different places make it in different styles.
The spelling varies by country and maker. Some labels use an extra letter, while others leave it out. Both forms name a similar kind of drink.
People may serve it in a small glass or use it in cooking. It has a strong smell and taste. The drink is intended for adults.

examples.en: Buying snacks at wholesale stores like Costco saves family budgets.
examples.zh: 在好市多等批發賣場大量採買零食能節省家庭開銷。

examples.en: The boutique owner buys jewelry at wholesale prices directly from artisans.
examples.zh: 精品店老闆直接向工藝手作匠人以批發價大宗採購純手工精美飾品。

examples.en: Selling merchandise wholesale yields lower unit profit but generates immense total volume.
examples.zh: 採取整批大宗批發銷售模式單件毛利雖低，但能帶來龐大可觀的總出貨量。

explains: This word describes buying or selling goods in large quantities, often to shops. A shop owner may buy many boxes at once. The price per item is often lower.
As an adjective or adverb, it relates to sales in bulk. A bakery may buy flour at a low price for large orders. The deal serves businesses that resell goods.
As a noun, it refers to the business of selling goods in bulk. As a verb, it means to sell that way. A maker may sell toys by the case to stores.

examples.en: Board game nights with good friends offer clean, wholesome entertainment.
examples.zh: 與三五好友相約在週末暢玩桌遊，是一種既溫馨健康又增進感情的正派娛樂。

examples.en: Eating wholesome home-cooked meals made with organic greens boosts overall immunity.
examples.zh: 經常品嚐使用有機時令蔬菜用心烹調的健康家常飯菜，能大幅提振整體免疫力。

examples.en: Animated family movies with positive uplifting values provide wholesome fun for all ages.
examples.zh: 傳遞正向積極溫暖價值觀的閤家歡動畫長片，能為男女老幼帶來老少咸宜的正派歡樂。

entries.definition: 健康有益的；正派健全的
explains: This adjective describes something good for health or well-being. A meal with vegetables and grains can be nourishing. It helps the body.
It can also describe entertainment or behavior that is kind and suitable for families. A gentle comedy may be enjoyable for all ages. The content avoids harmful or crude parts.
A positive atmosphere feels safe and kind. People treat one another with care. The word can describe food, entertainment, or behavior.

examples.en: The widow kept her husband’s letters in a box.
examples.zh: 這位寡婦把丈夫的信件收在盒子裡。

examples.en: He became a widower after many years of marriage.
examples.zh: 結婚多年後，他成了鰥夫。

examples.en: The widows met for tea each month.
examples.zh: 幾位寡婦每個月相約喝茶。

explains: This noun names a person whose spouse has died. The feminine form is used for a woman and the masculine form for a man. The term describes a change in family status.
A person may continue to use the term years after the loss. Friends and family may offer support. The word does not tell how long ago the spouse died.
The plural form can refer to several people who lost spouses. A community group may bring them together. The paired forms cover women and men.

examples.en: The office will withhold payment until the form is signed.
examples.zh: 辦公室會等表格簽署後才扣住款項。

examples.en: He may withhold the news until the family arrives.
examples.zh: 他可能會等家人到齊後才公布消息。

examples.en: The employer withholds tax from each paycheck.
examples.zh: 雇主會從每份薪水中預扣稅款。

explains: This verb means to keep something back instead of giving or sharing it. A person may hold back a payment until a bill is checked. The item is not handed over yet.
A person can keep information from a group. The details may remain private. The verb describes choosing not to reveal or provide something.
A company may keep part of a worker’s pay for taxes. The money is set aside for a required purpose. The word often appears in formal situations.

examples.en: The family shared their woe after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，一家人共同承受悲傷。

examples.en: The hero faced many woes on the journey.
examples.zh: 主角在旅途中遭遇許多苦難。

examples.en: He joked about the woe of a broken umbrella.
examples.zh: 他開玩笑地抱怨雨傘壞掉的倒楣事。

explains: This noun means great sadness or trouble. A person may feel deep sorrow after losing a home. The feeling is serious and painful.
The word often appears in stories or formal writing. A character may face many problems during a difficult journey. It can refer to one sorrow or several troubles.
People sometimes use it in a light way about small troubles. A student may complain about a rainy day. The usual meaning is a serious sorrow.

examples.en: A woodpecker tapped on the oak tree.
examples.zh: 一隻啄木鳥在橡樹上啄擊。

examples.en: We heard a woodpecker in the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林裡聽見啄木鳥的聲音。

examples.en: The woodpecker searched the trunk for insects.
examples.zh: 啄木鳥在樹幹上尋找昆蟲。

explains: This is a bird that taps or drills tree trunks with its strong bill. It searches for insects beneath the bark. Its feet help it cling to the trunk.
Many kinds have sharp calls and patterned feathers. A bird may drum on wood to find food or signal another bird. The tapping can be heard across a quiet forest.
A bird of this kind has a long tongue that can reach into small holes. It pulls insects from the tree. Its body is suited to climbing and pecking.

examples.en: The company expanded its workforce last year.
examples.zh: 公司去年擴大了員工人數。

examples.en: A skilled workforce helps the factory meet orders.
examples.zh: 熟練的勞動力有助於工廠完成訂單。

examples.en: The report describes changes in the national workforce.
examples.zh: 這份報告說明全國勞動人口的變化。

explains: This noun means all the people who work for a company or in a country. A factory may have hundreds of workers. The group carries out the work.
A company’s employees may have different skills and ages. Managers plan jobs around those abilities. The term names the working people as a group.
A country’s working population includes people who are employed or seeking jobs. Reports may compare its size over time. The term can describe a company or a larger economy.

examples.en: The two athletes wrestled for the title.
examples.zh: 兩位運動員為了冠軍頭銜摔角競賽。

examples.en: She wrestled with a hard math problem.
examples.zh: 她努力思考一道困難的數學題。

examples.en: The puppies wrestled on the rug.
examples.zh: 小狗們在地毯上玩鬧扭打。

explains: This verb can mean to fight by holding and pushing an opponent, often in a sport. Two athletes try to pin each other. Strength and skill both matter.
People may struggle with a difficult problem. They think hard and try different answers. The phrase describes an effort to understand or solve it.
Two friends may playfully grapple on the grass. The movement can be rough but friendly. Context shows a sport, a problem, or playful action.

examples.en: There was a wrinkle in the sleeve of his shirt.
examples.zh: 他的襯衫袖子上有一道皺褶。

examples.en: Her nose wrinkled at the sour smell.
examples.zh: 她聞到酸味時皺起了鼻子。

examples.en: A late delivery added a wrinkle to the plan.
examples.zh: 延遲送貨為計畫增添了一個小麻煩。

explains: This noun is a small line or fold in skin or cloth. A shirt may have one after being packed. The line can often be smoothed out.
As a verb, it means to form small folds. A person may crease a sheet by sitting on it. Skin may also form lines with age.
A small complication in a plan is an unexpected difficulty. A delay may create a problem for the schedule. This figurative use describes a complication.

examples.en: She yearned to see her family again.
examples.zh: 她渴望再次見到家人。

examples.en: He yearned for a quiet home by the sea.
examples.zh: 他渴望在海邊擁有一個安靜的家。

examples.en: They yearned to return to their hometown.
examples.zh: 他們渴望回到家鄉。

explains: This verb means to want something very much, often over a long time. A child may long to see a faraway friend. The feeling can be strong and emotional.
Someone may long for a quieter life after years in a busy city. The person imagines a different way to live. The desire is deeper than a passing wish.
People may long to return to a place they remember fondly. They miss its people or familiar sights. The verb often expresses longing.

examples.en: Practicing morning yoga improves flexibility and reduces mental stress.
examples.zh: 練習晨間瑜伽能提升身體柔軟度並減輕心理壓力。

examples.en: Unroll your non-slip rubber yoga mat in a quiet, well-ventilated room.
examples.zh: 在安靜且通風良好的房間內攤開你的防滑橡膠瑜伽墊。

examples.en: Yoga breathing techniques help promote mindfulness and mental calm.
examples.zh: 瑜伽呼吸技巧有助於促進正念冥想與內心平靜。

explains: This is a practice that combines body positions, breathing, and attention. People may do it on a mat. Some use it to stretch and relax.
A class may guide people through slow poses and steady breaths. Some movements build balance and strength. Quiet attention is part of the practice.
People can follow a teacher or use a recorded lesson at home. They choose movements suited to their ability. The activity can support calm and flexibility.

examples.en: She added berries to her yogurt.
examples.zh: 她在優格裡加入莓果。

examples.en: The yogurt was creamy and slightly sour.
examples.zh: 這份優格口感滑順，帶點酸味。

examples.en: We used plain yogurt to make the dip.
examples.zh: 我們用原味優格製作沾醬。

explains: This is a soft food made when helpful bacteria change milk. It can taste plain or sweet. People often eat it for breakfast or a snack.
The food may be thick or thin, depending on how it is made. Fruit or honey can be mixed in. It can also be used in sauces and baking.
Some kinds contain live cultures. Cups are kept cold before serving. The food is made from milk, though plant-based versions also exist.

examples.en: The cyclist zoomed down the hill.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人飛快地衝下山坡。

examples.en: Please zoom in on the map.
examples.zh: 請把地圖放大。

examples.en: The camera has a powerful zoom lens.
examples.zh: 這台相機配有強大的變焦鏡頭。

explains: As a verb, this means to move very quickly. A race car may rush past the stands. The motion is fast and sudden.
A camera can enlarge a distant object so it looks closer. The view becomes larger without the photographer walking nearer. The verb describes changing the view.
A camera lens may change its view from wide to close. The noun can name this change or a lens that makes it possible. You can show a small detail without moving the camera.
